_note: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili ya maudhui ya kozi. IMETAFSIRIWA KWA MASHINE — inasubiri uhakiki wa mzungumzaji mzaliwa kabla ya kuchapishwa, kwa mujibu wa course/CLAUDE.md na Forex_Course_Style_Guide.md sehemu ya 5.
_conventions: Terminology follows course/Forex_Course_Glossary.md and Stock_Market_Terms_Glossary.md. Where those record that East African trading usage keeps the English term, it is kept — see keepAsIs below, which records the reason for every such decision so a reviewer can disagree with it.

Clock times stay in international format (10:00 asubuhi), NOT Swahili traditional time (saa nne). A trader compares these against ForexFactory or Investing.com, which show international time; converting would actively mislead. This was caught by the number-integrity gate rather than by judgement.
Percentages keep the % symbol and the numeral (40%, not 'asilimia arobaini'), so figures stay scannable in a lesson full of arithmetic and the gate can verify none were lost.
Currency amounts, price levels, ratios and dates are never re-expressed. $10,000 stays $10,000; 1.0800 stays 1.0800; 50:1 stays 50:1.
Citations — author names, journal titles, paper titles and years — stay in English. They are how a reader finds the source.

Diagram descriptions (alt text and captions) ARE translated, but the labels inside the SVG diagrams themselves are still English: they sit at fixed coordinates and Swahili runs longer, so translating them without re-running the generators would overflow the boxes.

0005a09963da.en: In the days before the bankruptcy, withdrawals slowed and then stopped. Users who attempted to withdraw early got their funds. Users who waited to see whether the situation resolved did not. The window between the first sign and the closure was measured in days.
0005a09963da.sw: Katika siku kabla ya kufilisika, utoaji ulipungua kasi kisha ukasimama. Watumiaji waliojaribu kutoa mapema walipata fedha zao. Watumiaji waliosubiri kuona kama hali itatatuliwa hawakupata. Dirisha kati ya ishara ya kwanza na kufungwa lilipimwa kwa siku.

0030b6183594.en: Risking too much per trade. Betting 10%, 20%, or an unmeasured amount on a single idea, so one bad run ends the account. Fixed by the fixed-fractional 1 to 2% rule and the position-sizing formula (Chapter 3, Lesson 1), and by keeping effective leverage low (Chapter 3, Lesson 2).
0030b6183594.sw: Kuhatarisha kupita kiasi kwa kila biashara. Kubashiri 10%, 20%, au kiasi kisichopimwa kwenye wazo moja, ili mfululizo mmoja mbaya umalize akaunti. Hurekebishwa na kanuni ya sehemu thabiti ya 1 hadi 2% na fomula ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1), na kwa kuweka leverage halisi chini (Sura ya 3, Somo la 2).

00316a5b4ea5.en: That the yield was generated by transaction fees on the network
00316a5b4ea5.sw: Kwamba mavuno yalizalishwa na ada za miamala katika mtandao

00316ea28e9d.en: A record of every trade and whether you followed your plan, used to measure real expectancy and catch repeated mistakes.
00316ea28e9d.sw: Rekodi ya kila biashara na kama ulifuata mpango wako, inayotumika kupima matarajio halisi na kukamata makosa yanayorudiwa.

004bf70763ba.en: The word stable was doing work that the design did not support. A label is not a property. UST was called a stablecoin because of what it was intended to do, and that intention was widely mistaken for a description of what it was. Chapter 1 Lesson 7 distinguished backed from algorithmic for exactly this reason: the two share a category name and do not share a failure mode.
004bf70763ba.sw: Neno imara lilikuwa likifanya kazi ambayo muundo haukuiunga mkono. Lebo si sifa. UST iliitwa sarafu imara kwa sababu ya kile ilichokusudiwa kufanya, na kusudi hilo lilikosewa sana kama maelezo ya ilivyokuwa. Sura ya 1 Somo la 7 lilitofautisha inayoungwa mkono na ya kialgoriti kwa sababu hiyo hasa: hizo mbili hushiriki jina la kundi na hazishiriki namna ya kushindwa.

0055242b0945.en: No plan, trading on emotion. Entering because a chart looks ready rather than because a written rule was met. Fixed by the trading plan in Lesson 2 and the pre-committed exits in Lesson 1.
0055242b0945.sw: Hakuna mpango, kufanya biashara kwa hisia. Kuingia kwa sababu chati inaonekana tayari badala ya kwa sababu kanuni iliyoandikwa ilikidhiwa. Hurekebishwa na mpango wa biashara katika Somo la 2 na kutoka kulikojitolewa mapema katika Somo la 1.

00632d01a3ff.en: A centralized exchange holds your coins and trades IOUs inside its own database; a decentralized exchange lets your own wallet trade on-chain against a formula-priced liquidity pool — opposite ends of Lesson 4's custody trade-off.
00632d01a3ff.sw: Soko la kubadilisha lenye kituo kikuu hushikilia sarafu zako na hufanya biashara ya madeni ndani ya hifadhidata yake mwenyewe; soko lisilo na kituo kikuu huruhusu pochi yako mwenyewe kufanya biashara kwenye mnyororo dhidi ya bwawa la ukwasi lenye bei ya fomula — pande kinyume za maafikiano ya utunzaji ya Somo la 4.

006b5f09da56.en: That no one can create extra bitcoins beyond the schedule — and nothing about what a bitcoin is worth
006b5f09da56.sw: Kwamba hakuna anayeweza kuunda bitcoin za ziada zaidi ya ratiba — na hakuna lolote kuhusu bitcoin ina thamani gani

0084e7226e26.en: The lesson inside the examples: majority attacks are a real, demonstrated risk — priced by the cost of the deciding resource. On the largest networks that cost is enormous and the attacks have not happened. On small chains the cost can be a few hours of rented hashpower, and the attacks happen with some regularity. "Secured by a blockchain" tells you nothing until you ask how expensive that particular chain's majority actually is.
0084e7226e26.sw: Somo lililo ndani ya mifano: mashambulizi ya wengi ni hatari halisi, iliyoonyeshwa — inayopangiwa bei na gharama ya rasilimali inayoamua. Katika mitandao mikubwa zaidi gharama hiyo ni kubwa mno na mashambulizi hayajatokea. Katika minyororo midogo gharama inaweza kuwa masaa machache ya nguvu ya heshi iliyokodishwa, na mashambulizi hutokea kwa kiasi fulani cha ukawaida. "Imelindwa na mnyororo wa vitalu" haikuambii lolote hadi uulize wingi wa mnyororo huo maalum ni ghali kiasi gani hasa.

0086c55723d9.en: A process where independent experts evaluate a study's methodology and findings before publication, specifically to catch errors or unsupported conclusions.
0086c55723d9.sw: Mchakato ambapo wataalamu huru hutathmini mbinu na matokeo ya utafiti kabla ya kuchapishwa, mahususi ili kubaini makosa au hitimisho lisilo na ushahidi.

009d4136c5c6.en: An attacker sends a tiny or zero-value transaction to your wallet from an address deliberately generated to match the first and last characters of an address you have used before. Their address now appears in your transaction history, looking familiar. The attack is complete when you later copy an address from your own history instead of from the source.
009d4136c5c6.sw: Mshambuliaji hutuma muamala mdogo mno au wa thamani sifuri kwa pochi yako kutoka anwani iliyozalishwa kwa makusudi kulingana na herufi za kwanza na za mwisho za anwani uliyoitumia awali. Anwani yao sasa hujitokeza katika historia yako ya miamala, ikionekana ya kawaida. Shambulizi hukamilika unapokuja kunakili anwani kutoka historia yako mwenyewe badala ya kutoka chanzo.

00aa3270ed3b.en: The gap between the forecast and the actual result — what actually moves price.
00aa3270ed3b.sw: Pengo kati ya utabiri na tokeo halisi — ndicho kinachosogeza bei hasa.

00c580d83768.en: Here is the honest state of the evidence, as verified for this lesson. The academic literature on on-chain metrics as return predictors is small and recent, and it is nothing like the decades of testing behind, say, the forward premium puzzle you met in the Forex track. The most specific published result found was Klaus Grobys, Sebastian Näsman and Davide Sandretto, "Using on-chain data to predict Bitcoin cycles," in Research in International Business and Finance in 2026. They tested three well-known on-chain indicators — net unrealized profit and loss, the market-value-to-realized-value Z-score, and cumulative value days destroyed — as simple rule-based strategies over 7 December 2013 to 12 April 2025. They report that the rules beat buying and holding, with the Sharpe ratio rising from 0.45 for buy-and-hold to 1.28 for the best rule, and that the results survive a Monte Carlo comparison against randomly timed entries.
00c580d83768.sw: Hii hapa hali ya kweli ya ushahidi, kama ilivyothibitishwa kwa somo hili. Fasihi ya kitaaluma juu ya vipimo vya kwenye mnyororo kama vitabiri vya faida ni ndogo na ya hivi karibuni, nayo si kama miongo ya upimaji iliyo nyuma ya, tuseme, kitendawili cha malipo ya mbele uliokutana nacho katika njia ya Forex. Matokeo maalum zaidi yaliyochapishwa yaliyopatikana yalikuwa Klaus Grobys, Sebastian Näsman na Davide Sandretto, "Using on-chain data to predict Bitcoin cycles," katika Research in International Business and Finance mwaka 2026. Walipima viashiria vitatu vinavyojulikana vya kwenye mnyororo — faida na hasara halisi isiyotimizwa, alama-Z ya thamani-ya-soko-kwa-thamani-iliyotimizwa, na siku za thamani jumlifu zilizoharibiwa — kama mikakati rahisi ya kanuni katika kipindi cha 7 Desemba 2013 hadi 12 Aprili 2025. Wanaripoti kwamba kanuni zilishinda kununua na kushikilia, huku uwiano wa Sharpe ukipanda kutoka 0.45 kwa kununua-na-kushikilia hadi 1.28 kwa kanuni bora zaidi, na kwamba matokeo yanausurika ulinganisho wa Monte Carlo dhidi ya viingilio vya muda wa nasibu.

00d5cc0bc772.en: EBITDA deliberately excludes depreciation, and depreciation is the accounting acknowledgement that equipment wears out and must be replaced. For a business that genuinely consumes physical assets, excluding it flatters the picture. It is a useful comparison tool and a poor summary of what a company keeps.
00d5cc0bc772.sw: EBITDA hutenga kushusha thamani kwa makusudi, na kushusha thamani ni utambuzi wa kihasibu kwamba vifaa huchakaa na lazima vibadilishwe. Kwa biashara inayotumia mali za kimwili kweli, kuitenga hupamba picha. Ni zana ya ulinganisho yenye manufaa na muhtasari mbaya wa kile kampuni huweka.

00e1e0a68304.en: Not quite. The spread describes the gap between the best bid and best ask; it says nothing about how many shares are available at those prices. Thin volume means a large order works through worse and worse levels.
00e1e0a68304.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Spread hueleza pengo kati ya bid bora na ask bora; haisemi chochote kuhusu hisa ngapi zinapatikana kwa bei hizo. Kiasi chembamba kinamaanisha agizo kubwa hufanya kazi kupitia viwango vibaya zaidi na zaidi.

00e28cf9724e.en: An asset that specifically holds zero or negative correlation during periods of market stress — even if it behaves completely differently the rest of the time.
00e28cf9724e.sw: Mali inayoshikilia mahususi uwiano wa sifuri au hasi wakati wa vipindi vya shinikizo la soko — hata kama inatenda tofauti kabisa wakati mwingine wote.

00f1c60dd7c6.en: That definition contains the most important honest sentence in this entire chapter: an indicator can only ever highlight something that is already visible in price itself. Since every indicator is computed from the prices on your screen, it cannot know anything the chart doesn't already contain. The reason traders use them anyway is practical, not magical — a good indicator makes a pattern easier to see and act on consistently.
00f1c60dd7c6.sw: Maana hiyo ina sentensi muhimu zaidi ya uaminifu katika sura hii nzima: kiashiria kinaweza tu kuangazia kitu ambacho tayari kinaonekana katika bei yenyewe. Kwa kuwa kila kiashiria hukokotolewa kutoka bei zilizo kwenye skrini yako, hakiwezi kujua chochote ambacho chati haina tayari. Sababu wafanyabiashara huvitumia hata hivyo ni ya kivitendo, si ya kimuujiza — kiashiria kizuri hurahisisha kuona mtindo na kuchukua hatua kwa uthabiti.

00ff78ed730d.en: You have already seen a pure version of this. In Chapter 1, Lesson 7, an algorithmic stablecoin held its peg because people believed it would hold. Confidence supported the mechanism, and the working mechanism supported confidence. When confidence broke, the same loop ran backwards and destroyed the peg it had been holding up. That was reflexivity in its most extreme form - the belief was the entire backing.
00ff78ed730d.sw: Tayari umeona toleo safi la hili. Katika Sura ya 1, Somo la 7, sarafu imara ya kialgoriti ilishikilia pegi yake kwa sababu watu waliamini itashikilia. Ujasiri uliunga mkono utaratibu, na utaratibu uliofanya kazi uliunga mkono ujasiri. Ujasiri ulipovunjika, kitanzi kilekile kilikimbia nyuma na kikaharibu pegi ambayo kilikuwa kikiishikilia. Hiyo ilikuwa kujiakisi katika namna yake kali zaidi - imani ilikuwa msaada mzima.

0102094e4fae.en: Why does the valuation pillar not transfer from equities to most crypto assets?
0102094e4fae.sw: Kwa nini nguzo ya tathmini haihamishiki kutoka hisa kwenda rasilimali nyingi za kripto?

01095a84ef38.en: Positioning and sentiment. In currencies this comes from futures positioning data. In equities the closest equivalents are short interest, fund flows and analyst estimate revisions. Chapter 5 gave both the reason to watch it and the reason not to trust a simple reading of it: GameStop had the most extreme short interest anywhere, and the regulator still found short covering was not what drove the price.
01095a84ef38.sw: Msimamo na hisia za soko. Katika sarafu hii hutoka data ya msimamo wa mikataba ya baadaye. Katika hisa vinavyokaribia zaidi ni maslahi ya uuzaji-mkopo, mitiririko ya mifuko na marekebisho ya makadirio ya wachambuzi. Sura ya 5 ilitoa sababu ya kuiangalia na sababu ya kutoamini usomaji rahisi wake: GameStop ilikuwa na maslahi makali zaidi ya uuzaji-mkopo popote, na mdhibiti bado alibaini kufunika uuzaji-mkopo si ndiko kulikoendesha bei.

0124ce9643be.en: Without a shared medium of exchange, both sides need to want exactly what the other has, at the same time.
0124ce9643be.sw: Bila njia ya pamoja ya kubadilishana, pande zote mbili zinahitaji kutaka hasa kile ambacho mwenzake anacho, kwa wakati mmoja.

0124d3ecea4b.en: Lump sum has the higher expected return, while averaging in reduces the chance of a regret-driven exit — a legitimate trade at a known cost
0124d3ecea4b.sw: Kiasi kamili kina faida inayotarajiwa ya juu zaidi, ilhali kupunguza wastani wa bei hupunguza nafasi ya kutoka kunakoendeshwa na majuto — biashara halali kwa gharama inayojulikana

0127cdadfb47.en: Reported volume on an unregulated venue is not evidence of anything. Do not use it to judge whether a token is liquid, whether an exchange is safe, or whether interest is rising. Volume is self-reported by the venue that profits from it looking high. Depth, by contrast, is much harder to fake convincingly, because faked depth has to be real orders that you can actually hit, and if you can hit them, someone can take your money by leaving them there.
0127cdadfb47.sw: Ujazo unaoripotiwa katika uwanja usiodhibitiwa si ushahidi wa lolote. Usiutumie kuhukumu kama tokeni ina ukwasi, kama soko la kubadilisha ni salama, au kama maslahi yanapanda. Ujazo huripotiwa na uwanja wenyewe unaonufaika na kuonekana kwake juu. Kina, kinyume chake, ni kigumu zaidi kughushi kwa kuaminika, kwa sababu kina kilichoghushiwa lazima kiwe maagizo halisi ambayo unaweza kuyagonga kweli, na ikiwa unaweza kuyagonga, mtu anaweza kuchukua pesa yako kwa kuyaacha hapo.

0142b41dfcf2.en: Why does digital money need a referee at all? Because of what computers do best: copy things.
0142b41dfcf2.sw: Kwa nini pesa ya kidijitali inahitaji mwamuzi kabisa? Kwa sababu ya kile ambacho kompyuta hufanya vizuri zaidi: kunakili vitu.

01468faaadcb.en: A rise driven by short sellers being forced to buy back shares to close their positions, whose buying pushes the price higher, forcing more shorts to buy.
01468faaadcb.sw: Kupanda kunakoendeshwa na wauzaji-mkopo kulazimishwa kununua tena hisa ili kufunga nafasi zao, ambapo ununuzi wao husukuma bei juu zaidi, ukilazimisha wauzaji-mkopo zaidi kununua.

014c446ce79f.en: Not quite - the objection is that a fully known future supply change should already sit in today's price. Note it does not prove markets are perfectly efficient either; efficiency is genuinely contested, and crypto markets are young and retail-heavy.
014c446ce79f.sw: Si sahihi kabisa - pingamizi ni kwamba badiliko la usambazaji la baadaye linalojulikana kikamilifu linapaswa kuwa tayari liko katika bei ya leo. Tambua halithibitishi masoko yana ufanisi kikamilifu pia; ufanisi unapingwa kweli, na masoko ya kripto ni machanga na yanategemea rejareja.

014e6caf35d9.en: You want to open a $50,000 EUR/USD position using 50:1 leverage. How much margin is required?
014e6caf35d9.sw: Unataka kufungua nafasi ya EUR/USD ya $50,000 ukitumia leverage ya 50:1. Margin kiasi gani inahitajika?

0175b395d66f.en: A four-step flow showing an ETF trading at 100.40 against a basket worth 100.00, an authorised participant buying the underlying shares, delivering them to the fund in exchange for new ETF shares, and selling those on the exchange, with the added supply closing the gap.
0175b395d66f.sw: Mtiririko wa hatua nne unaoonyesha ETF ikifanyiwa biashara kwa 100.40 dhidi ya kikapu chenye thamani ya 100.00, mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa akinunua hisa za msingi, akiziwasilisha kwa fund badala ya hisa mpya za ETF, na kuziuza hizo sokoni, ambapo ugavi ulioongezwa hufunga pengo.

0178b5986880.en: Smart contracts letting users trade on-chain directly from their own wallets.
0178b5986880.sw: Mikataba mahiri inayoruhusu watumiaji kufanya biashara kwenye mnyororo moja kwa moja kutoka pochi zao wenyewe.

0178fe089d09.en: Who was most likely to be financially ruined by the event?
0178fe089d09.sw: Ni nani aliyekuwa na uwezekano mkubwa zaidi wa kuharibiwa kifedha na tukio hilo?

017a3d5d54e8.en: Anchor paid roughly 20% a year on UST deposits, with close to 75% of all UST sitting in it. What did the yield test from Chapter 4 reveal?
017a3d5d54e8.sw: Anchor ililipa takriban 20% kwa mwaka juu ya amana za UST, huku karibu 75% ya UST yote ikiwa imeketi ndani yake. Mtihani wa mavuno kutoka Sura ya 4 ulifichua nini?

0181b3495eba.en: Five ways in, none of them price risk. Each surface has one specific mitigation, and all five end at the same irreversible transfer.
0181b3495eba.sw: Njia tano za kuingia, hakuna kati yake ni hatari ya bei. Kila uso una upunguzaji mmoja maalum, na nyuso zote tano huishia katika uhamisho uleule usioweza kutenduliwa.

018d1827c4a7.en: Two-factor authentication is genuinely effective, and you should have it everywhere. But the different kinds are not equally strong, and crypto users get attacked specifically at the weakest one.
018d1827c4a7.sw: Uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili una ufanisi kweli, nawe unapaswa kuwa nao kila mahali. Lakini aina tofauti si imara kwa usawa, na watumiaji wa kripto hushambuliwa hasa katika ile dhaifu zaidi.

01984c0073b4.en: Correct. Both studies find the gap is near zero in broad automatically-contributed funds and large in narrow actively traded ones. Averaging those two populations produces a number that describes neither. The useful question is which group your own behaviour puts you in.
01984c0073b4.sw: Sahihi. Tafiti zote mbili hubaini pengo liko karibu na sifuri katika mifuko mipana inayochangiwa kiotomatiki na ni kubwa katika mifuko finyu inayofanyiwa biashara kwa bidii. Kuchukua wastani wa makundi hayo mawili hutoa namba isiyoelezea lolote kati yao. Swali lenye manufaa ni tabia yako mwenyewe inakuweka katika kundi lipi.

01d7d31c50a9.en: A globally diversified fund is not automatically balanced across the world either. Because most broad global indices are weighted by market value, a small number of large markets dominate. Buying the world index buys the world in the proportions the rule specifies, and those proportions are far from equal. Check the country weights before assuming global means spread.
01d7d31c50a9.sw: Fund iliyosambazwa kimataifa pia haijasawazishwa kiotomatiki duniani kote. Kwa sababu index nyingi pana za kimataifa hupewa uzito kwa thamani ya soko, idadi ndogo ya masoko makubwa hutawala. Kununua index ya dunia hununua dunia kwa uwiano ambao kanuni inabainisha, na uwiano huo uko mbali na usawa. Kagua uzito wa nchi kabla ya kudhania kimataifa kunamaanisha kusambazwa.

01debe3c9b25.en: The largest example that ever existed: TerraUSD (UST) and its sister token LUNA. The rule: the system always lets you burn 1 UST to mint 1 dollar's worth of newly created LUNA, and burn 1 dollar's worth of LUNA to mint 1 UST. UST slips to 0.98 dollars on an exchange. An arbitrageur buys 1 UST for 0.98, burns it for 1.00 dollar of freshly minted LUNA, sells the LUNA, and pockets 0.02. That buying pressure pushes UST back toward 1 dollar. Above the peg, the loop runs in reverse. In calm markets, it works — UST held near 1 dollar for years and grew to tens of billions.
01debe3c9b25.sw: Mfano mkubwa zaidi uliowahi kuwepo: TerraUSD (UST) na tokeni yake dada LUNA. Kanuni: mfumo daima hukuruhusu kuchoma UST 1 ili kutengeneza thamani ya dola 1 ya LUNA iliyoundwa upya, na kuchoma thamani ya dola 1 ya LUNA ili kutengeneza UST 1. UST inateleza hadi dola 0.98 katika soko la kubadilisha. Mfanya-arbitraji hununua UST 1 kwa 0.98, huichoma kwa dola 1.00 ya LUNA iliyotengenezwa upya, huuza LUNA, na kuweka mfukoni 0.02. Shinikizo hilo la ununuzi husukuma UST kurudi kuelekea dola 1. Juu ya pegi, kitanzi huendeshwa kinyume. Katika masoko tulivu, hufanya kazi — UST ilishikilia karibu na dola 1 kwa miaka na ikakua hadi makumi ya mabilioni.

01e72e59923d.sw: Stop hutumika wakati wa saa zenye ukwasi tu

01f3a0611170.en: Mean Reversion & Levels — Bollinger Bands, RSI & Fibonacci
01f3a0611170.sw: Kurudi kwa Wastani na Viwango — Bollinger Bands, RSI na Fibonacci

01ffd46b2835.en: This is worth noticing because it has not changed. Liquidity still concentrates, users still benefit from concentration, and the resulting structure still means that a single failure can affect a very large share of the market at once. The industry replaced Mt. Gox with other dominant venues rather than with a system that does not have dominant venues, which is why the next case study in this chapter is a larger version of the same shape.
01ffd46b2835.sw: Hii inastahili kutambuliwa kwa sababu haijabadilika. Ukwasi bado hukusanyika, watumiaji bado hunufaika na ukusanyikaji, na muundo unaotokana bado humaanisha kwamba kushindwa moja kunaweza kuathiri sehemu kubwa sana ya soko kwa wakati mmoja. Tasnia ilibadilisha Mt. Gox na viwanja vingine vinavyotawala badala ya na mfumo usio na viwanja vinavyotawala, ndiyo maana uchunguzi wa tukio unaofuata katika sura hii ni toleo kubwa zaidi la umbo lilelile.

020df78a50de.en: The difference between a fund's return and the return its investors actually earned.
020df78a50de.sw: Tofauti kati ya faida ya mfuko na faida ambayo wawekezaji wake walipata hasa.

0247871fad53.en: Chapter 3 Lesson 3 said averaging in is a behavioural tool with a real cost. This is the same idea running the other way. The mechanical value of a contribution schedule is that it buys most units when prices are lowest, and that value only exists if the schedule is not interrupted precisely when prices are lowest.
0247871fad53.sw: Sura ya 3 Somo la 3 lilisema kuweka wastani kwa awamu ni zana ya kitabia yenye gharama halisi. Hii ni wazo lilelile likienda upande mwingine. Thamani ya kimitambo ya ratiba ya michango ni kwamba hununua vipimo vingi zaidi wakati bei ziko chini kabisa, na thamani hiyo ipo tu ikiwa ratiba haikatizwi hasa wakati bei ziko chini kabisa.

024ee2918092.en: The specific price, or condition, at which your thesis is proven wrong and the reason for the trade no longer holds. It is where your stop-loss belongs — not at an arbitrary distance, but where being wrong becomes a fact.
024ee2918092.sw: Bei mahususi, au hali, ambapo nadharia yako inathibitishwa kuwa batili na sababu ya biashara haishikilii tena. Ndipo stop-loss yako inapostahili kuwa — si kwa umbali wa bahati nasibu, bali pale kukosea kunapokuwa ukweli.

0251b34f14b6.en: The reasoning is simple enough to hold in your head: to break even, total winnings must equal total losses, so (win rate times reward) must equal (loss rate times risk). Solve that and the winning fraction is 1 / (1 + R). You do not need to memorise the algebra — you need to remember that a better reward-to-risk ratio lowers the win rate you need, and a worse one raises it, fast.
0251b34f14b6.sw: Hoja ni rahisi vya kutosha kuishikilia kichwani: ili kulingana, jumla ya ushindi lazima ilingane na jumla ya hasara, hivyo (kiwango cha ushindi mara tuzo) lazima kilingane na (kiwango cha hasara mara hatari). Tatua hilo na sehemu ya ushindi ni 1 / (1 + R). Huhitaji kukariri aljebra — unahitaji kukumbuka kwamba uwiano bora wa tuzo-kwa-hatari hushusha kiwango cha ushindi unachohitaji, na mbaya huupandisha, kwa kasi.

025aa3d4cfe0.en: Regimes deteriorate faster than they improve. A risk-on period builds over months and gives many opportunities to notice it. A shift into stress can complete in days, and in crypto sometimes in hours, because leverage unwinds mechanically rather than by decision. A plan that depends on reacting to a regime change is calibrated to the slower transition and will meet the faster one.
025aa3d4cfe0.sw: Tawala huzorota kwa kasi zaidi kuliko huboreka. Kipindi cha hatari-hai hujengeka kwa miezi na hutoa fursa nyingi za kukitambua. Kuhamia msongo kunaweza kukamilika ndani ya siku, na katika kripto wakati mwingine ndani ya masaa, kwa sababu mzingo hufunguka kimitambo badala ya kwa uamuzi. Mpango unaotegemea kuitikia mabadiliko ya utawala umepimwa kwa mabadiliko ya polepole nao utakutana na ya haraka.

The response had been to build a reserve of assets outside the system, so that a peg defence would not have to rely solely on minting LUNA. That reserve was held largely in Bitcoin by an organisation called the Luna Foundation Guard.
02a8c3eda57c.sw: Udhaifu wa utaratibu ulieleweka kabla ya Mei 2022. Mwitikio ulikuwa kujenga akiba ya rasilimali nje ya mfumo, ili ulinzi wa pegi usilazimike kutegemea kutengeneza LUNA pekee. Akiba hiyo ilishikiliwa hasa katika Bitcoin na shirika liitwalo Luna Foundation Guard.

02b28a198100.en: Not quite — the money at risk is 5,000 x 0.01 = 50 dollars and the stop distance is 2 x 1,900 = 3,800 dollars, so the size is 50 / 3,800 = 0.01316 Bitcoin, or about 789 dollars of exposure. The 0.18 Bitcoin answer is what a 278-dollar stop gives, which is the classic tight-stop error.
02b28a198100.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — pesa iliyo hatarini ni 5,000 x 0.01 = dola 50 na umbali wa kusimamisha ni 2 x 1,900 = dola 3,800, kwa hivyo ukubwa ni 50 / 3,800 = Bitcoin 0.01316, au takriban dola 789 za kufunuliwa. Jibu la Bitcoin 0.18 ndilo ambalo kusimamisha kwa dola 278 hutoa, ambako ni kosa la kawaida la kusimamisha kunakobana.

02d76127f279.en: Correct — discipline means following a plan committed to in advance, so the important decisions are not made live at all. It is a system that removes in-the-moment choices, not a feeling you summon.

02e981aac3dd.sw: Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilipoacha sakafu yake ya EUR/CHF mwaka 2015, stop na stop-out zilishindwa katika ombwe la ukwasi — na wafanyabiashara walionusurika hawakuwa wale walioitabiri, bali wale waliopimwa wadogo vya kutosha kukosea.

034383156182.en: Crypto has traded as the high-beta tail of the risk spectrum, not as digital gold: it fell with equities and much harder in the 2022 tightening cycle, and correlation is a moving number that rises toward 1 in exactly the crises diversification is meant to cover.
034383156182.sw: Kripto imefanyiwa biashara kama mkia wa beta kubwa wa msururu wa hatari, si kama dhahabu ya kidijitali: ilishuka pamoja na hisa na kwa nguvu zaidi katika mzunguko wa kubana wa 2022, na uhusiano ni namba inayosogea inayopanda kuelekea 1 hasa katika migogoro ambayo mtawanyiko unakusudiwa kuifunika.

03454a52ff54.en: Published figures for the three big drawdowns disagree, because sources use different exchanges and differ on whether they measure closing prices or intraday extremes. Reported honestly as ranges: the 2013 to 2015 decline is reported at roughly 84% to 87%; the 2017 to 2018 decline at roughly 83% to 84%; the 2021 to 2022 decline at roughly 77% to 78%. Every source agrees the falls exceeded 70%. Where they disagree is on the second digit, and this lesson does not pretend otherwise.
03454a52ff54.sw: Takwimu zilizochapishwa za kushuka kukubwa kutatu hazikubaliani, kwa sababu vyanzo hutumia masoko tofauti ya kubadilisha na hutofautiana kuhusu kama hupima bei za kufunga au vilele vya ndani ya siku. Zikiripotiwa kwa ukweli kama viwango: kushuka kwa 2013 hadi 2015 kunaripotiwa katika takriban 84% hadi 87%; kushuka kwa 2017 hadi 2018 katika takriban 83% hadi 84%; kushuka kwa 2021 hadi 2022 katika takriban 77% hadi 78%. Kila chanzo hukubali kushuka kulizidi 70%. Wanapotofautiana ni katika tarakimu ya pili, na somo hili halijifanyi vinginevyo.

0346c57f95f4.en: Your broker's platform usually shows a pip-value or position-size calculator, and you should use it — it does this arithmetic for you at live rates. Understanding the mechanism is still worth it for one reason: it lets you sanity-check the tool. The most common calculator error is having it set to the wrong account currency, which produces exactly the kind of silent mis-sizing above. A number you can check is safer than a number you have to trust.
0346c57f95f4.sw: Jukwaa la broker wako kwa kawaida huonyesha kikokotoo cha thamani ya pip au ukubwa wa nafasi, na unapaswa kukitumia — hufanya hesabu hii kwa niaba yako kwa viwango vya moja kwa moja. Kuelewa utaratibu bado kunastahili kwa sababu moja: kunakuruhusu kukagua uzima wa zana. Kosa la kawaida zaidi la kikokotoo ni kuwa limewekwa kwa sarafu isiyo sahihi ya akaunti, ambako huzalisha hasa aina ya upimaji mbaya wa kimyakimya hapo juu. Namba unayoweza kuikagua ni salama zaidi kuliko namba unayolazimika kuiamini.

03ae73fd5ca7.en: The providers say this themselves, which is worth noticing. Glassnode's documentation explains that its clustering work addresses only one of the two problems — grouping many addresses under one controller — and deliberately does not address the second, where one address holds many people's funds. For that reason the company calls its numbers entities rather than users or individuals. Coin Metrics' documentation makes the parallel point that active addresses are a proxy for usage and a poor proxy for unique people.
03ae73fd5ca7.sw: Watoa data wenyewe husema hivi, jambo linalostahili kutambuliwa. Nyaraka za Glassnode hueleza kwamba kazi yake ya kukusanya makundi hushughulikia tatizo moja tu kati ya mawili — kuweka anwani nyingi chini ya mdhibiti mmoja — nayo kwa makusudi haishughulikii la pili, ambapo anwani moja hushikilia fedha za watu wengi. Kwa sababu hiyo kampuni huita namba zake vyombo badala ya watumiaji au watu binafsi. Nyaraka za Coin Metrics hutoa hoja sambamba kwamba anwani hai ni kipimo mbadala cha matumizi na kipimo mbadala kibaya cha watu wa kipekee.

03b681e3ab72.sw: Dalali lazima afunge nafasi hiyo kiotomatiki

03b6d2d2b263.en: Stop and notice how strange this is. In the stock market, you cannot see who owns what. Ownership sits inside brokerage records that are private by law and by business practice. Large holdings surface only in delayed regulatory filings, and small holdings never surface at all. In forex, there is no central ledger to look at, because there is no central market.
03b6d2d2b263.sw: Simama na utambue jinsi hili lilivyo la ajabu. Katika soko la hisa, huwezi kuona nani anamiliki nini. Umiliki hukaa ndani ya rekodi za udalali ambazo ni za faragha kisheria na kwa mazoea ya kibiashara. Umiliki mkubwa hujitokeza tu katika mawasilisho ya udhibiti yaliyocheleweshwa, na umiliki mdogo haujitokezi kamwe. Katika forex, hakuna leja kuu ya kuangalia, kwa sababu hakuna soko kuu.

03ee53196e70.en: Predictable: that a yield paid from a reserve rather than from activity would end when the reserve did. That was arithmetic, it was public, and it required no view on the mechanism. Also predictable: that a design with no external anchor could fail catastrophically rather than gradually, since that follows from the structure and was discussed publicly well before May 2022.
03ee53196e70.sw: Lililotabirika: kwamba mavuno yaliyolipwa kutoka akiba badala ya kutoka shughuli yangeisha akiba itakapoisha. Hiyo ilikuwa hesabu, ilikuwa ya umma, nayo haikuhitaji mtazamo wowote juu ya utaratibu. Pia lililotabirika: kwamba muundo usio na nanga ya nje ungeweza kushindwa kwa maafa badala ya taratibu, kwa kuwa hilo hufuata kutoka muundo nalo lilijadiliwa hadharani muda mrefu kabla ya Mei 2022.

03f2fbc63717.en: Two holdings with a correlation near one give you almost no diversification however different their names are. Two with a low correlation give you a great deal even if you own only a few. This is why twenty banks behave like one position and why an investor holding five genuinely different businesses across five industries may be better diversified than one holding thirty within a single sector.
03f2fbc63717.sw: Umiliki miwili wenye uwiano karibu na moja hukupa karibu hakuna usambazaji hata majina yao yakitofautiana kiasi gani. Miwili yenye uwiano mdogo hukupa mengi hata ukimiliki chache tu. Ndiyo sababu benki ishirini hutenda kama nafasi moja na kwa nini mwekezaji anayeshikilia biashara tano tofauti kweli katika sekta tano anaweza kuwa amesambazwa vizuri zaidi kuliko anayeshikilia thelathini ndani ya sekta moja.

0489d0a12d1d.en: Spending works like signing a check that everyone can verify. Your wallet uses the private key to produce a digital signature on the transaction. The network checks that the signature matches the address the money is leaving from. The mathematics lets everyone verify the signature without ever seeing the private key itself — which is why you can transact in public without giving your key away. Notice what the ledger checks and what it does not. It checks the signature. It does not check intent. It has no idea whether you meant this payment, mistyped the address, or were tricked.
0489d0a12d1d.sw: Kutumia hufanya kazi kama kutia sahihi hundi ambayo kila mtu anaweza kuithibitisha. Pochi yako hutumia ufunguo wa faragha kutoa sahihi ya kidijitali juu ya muamala. Mtandao hukagua kwamba sahihi inalingana na anwani ambayo pesa inaondoka kwayo. Hisabati huruhusu kila mtu kuthibitisha sahihi bila kamwe kuona ufunguo wa faragha wenyewe — ndiyo maana unaweza kufanya miamala hadharani bila kutoa ufunguo wako. Tambua leja hukagua nini na haikagui nini. Hukagua sahihi. Haikagui nia. Haina wazo kama ulikusudia malipo haya, uliandika anwani vibaya, au ulidanganywa.

04a24b550eb8.sw: Kukubali hatari lakini kuweka kikomo cha kiasi inachoweza kukugharimu.

04c1827ce063.en: Fulkerson, Jordan, Riley and Yan examined the Mind the Gap methodology in a paper titled Bad Timing Does Not Cost Investors 15% of Their Funds' Returns, published in the Financial Analysts Journal in 2026. They identify three mathematical errors in the calculation. Recomputing the 2023 edition's reported 1.7 percentage point gap, they find it should have been 0.03 percentage points. Their estimate of what poor timing actually costs fund investors is around 0.10 percentage points a year — roughly a twelfth of the headline number.
04c1827ce063.sw: Fulkerson, Jordan, Riley na Yan walichunguza mbinu ya Mind the Gap katika karatasi yenye kichwa Bad Timing Does Not Cost Investors 15% of Their Funds' Returns, iliyochapishwa katika Financial Analysts Journal mwaka 2026. Wanabainisha makosa matatu ya kihisabati katika hesabu hiyo. Wakihesabu upya pengo la pointi 1.7 za asilimia lililoripotiwa katika toleo la 2023, wanabaini lilipaswa kuwa pointi 0.03 za asilimia. Makadirio yao ya kile ambacho muda mbaya hugharimu kweli wawekezaji wa mifuko ni takriban pointi 0.10 za asilimia kwa mwaka — takriban sehemu moja ya kumi na mbili ya takwimu ya kichwa cha habari.

04cd0ccdc5a9.en: With no fee at all, 10,000 becomes about 76,123. At an expense ratio of 0.05%, typical of a broad index ETF, it becomes about 75,063. At 0.75% it becomes about 61,641. At 1.50%, a level not unusual for an actively managed fund plus an adviser, it becomes about 49,840.
04cd0ccdc5a9.sw: Bila ada kabisa, 10,000 hukuwa takriban 76,123. Kwa uwiano wa gharama wa 0.05%, wa kawaida kwa ETF pana ya index, hukuwa takriban 75,063. Kwa 0.75% hukuwa takriban 61,641. Kwa 1.50%, kiwango kisicho cha kawaida kwa fund inayosimamiwa kwa bidii pamoja na mshauri, hukuwa takriban 49,840.

04e53d28db3b.sw: MA ya vipindi 20 yenye kanda za ±2 za mkengeuko sanifu, zinazopanuka kulingana na mtikisiko.

04ee2aae000c.sw: Kwa nini gharama ya kuhamia mfuko wa bei nafuu zaidi kwa kawaida ni ndogo kando ya gharama ya kubaki?

04f8768fa12c.en: Not quite — high volume next to a thin book is the signature of wash trading, not of demand. Volume is self-reported and costs nothing to manufacture by trading with yourself. Depth is the number to trust, because a fake bid has to be a real order you could hit, which makes it expensive to leave sitting there.
04f8768fa12c.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — ujazo mkubwa kando ya kitabu chembamba ni alama ya biashara ya kujiosha, si ya mahitaji. Ujazo huripotiwa na uwanja wenyewe na haugharimu chochote kuutengeneza kwa kufanya biashara na wewe mwenyewe. Kina ndiyo namba ya kuamini, kwa sababu zabuni bandia lazima iwe agizo halisi ambalo ungeweza kuligonga, jambo linalofanya iwe ghali kuliacha likiketi hapo.

051b3a67a29b.en: A professional does not look for positions everywhere at once. They first ask what kind of market this is, because the answer decides which of the six pillars has any power in it.
051b3a67a29b.sw: Mtaalamu hatafuti nafasi kila mahali kwa wakati mmoja. Kwanza huuliza hili ni soko la aina gani, kwa sababu jibu huamua ni ipi kati ya nguzo sita yenye nguvu ndani yake.

0534db930ff5.en: Chapter 2, Lesson 2 already showed you one narrative in detail: the four-year cycle built around the halving, examined against what the data can and cannot support. That lesson taught the specific story. This one teaches the shape that all of them share.
0534db930ff5.sw: Sura ya 2, Somo la 2 tayari lilikuonyesha simulizi moja kwa kina: mzunguko wa miaka minne uliojengwa kuzunguka kupunguzwa nusu, ukichunguzwa dhidi ya kile ambacho data inaweza na haiwezi kukiunga mkono. Somo hilo lilifundisha hadithi maalum. Hili hufundisha umbo ambalo zote hushirikiana.

0556de3ecf90.en: A decentralized exchange removes the deposit step entirely. You never send coins to the venue. You connect your own wallet, sign a transaction, and the trade settles on-chain: the blockchain records your tokens going into a smart contract and the tokens you bought coming out, all in one transaction. Custody never changes hands. Lesson 4's trade-off applies in reverse — you keep the keys, so you also keep every risk that comes with being your own bank.
0556de3ecf90.sw: Soko la kubadilisha lisilo na kituo kikuu huondoa hatua ya kuweka amana kabisa. Hutumi kamwe sarafu kwenye uwanja. Unaunganisha pochi yako mwenyewe, unatia sahihi muamala, na biashara hutimizwa kwenye mnyororo: mnyororo wa vitalu huandika tokeni zako zikiingia katika mkataba mahiri na tokeni ulizonunua zikitoka, yote katika muamala mmoja. Utunzaji haubadilishi mikono kamwe. Maafikiano ya Somo la 4 hutumika kinyume — unabakiza funguo, kwa hivyo pia unabakiza kila hatari inayokuja na kuwa benki yako mwenyewe.

056c687d2c17.en: Three panels comparing the popular short-squeeze and gamma-squeeze explanation of the GameStop episode, the SEC staff findings of 18 October 2021 that neither was the primary cause, and the clearing collateral mechanism that explains why brokerages allowed selling but not buying on 28 January 2021.
056c687d2c17.sw: Paneli tatu zikilinganisha maelezo maarufu ya mbano wa uuzaji-mkopo na mbano wa gamma ya tukio la GameStop, matokeo ya wafanyakazi wa SEC ya tarehe 18 Oktoba 2021 kwamba hakuna kati ya hayo kilichokuwa chanzo kikuu, na utaratibu wa dhamana ya utimizaji unaoeleza kwa nini madalali waliruhusu kuuza lakini si kununua tarehe 28 Januari 2021.

058eb5af6d9c.en: A position size calculated from a stop placed at a multiple of a volatility measure such as ATR, rather than at a fixed number of points or a fixed percentage. Because the stop widens automatically when the market becomes more volatile, the position size shrinks automatically, and the money at risk stays constant.
058eb5af6d9c.sw: Ukubwa wa nafasi uliohesabiwa kutoka kusimamisha kulikowekwa katika kizidishi cha kipimo cha mtikisiko kama ATR, badala ya katika idadi isiyobadilika ya pointi au asilimia isiyobadilika. Kwa sababu kusimamisha hupanuka kiotomatiki soko linapokuwa na mtikisiko zaidi, ukubwa wa nafasi hupungua kiotomatiki, na pesa iliyo hatarini hubaki thabiti.

0590e72acdf7.en: The first is digital gold — the idea that Bitcoin does what gold is supposed to do, holding purchasing power while currencies weaken. The second is uncorrelated diversifier — the idea that crypto moves independently of stocks and bonds, so adding it smooths a portfolio. The third is inflation hedge — the idea that a capped supply protects you when consumer prices rise.
0590e72acdf7.sw: La kwanza ni dhahabu ya kidijitali — wazo kwamba Bitcoin hufanya kile ambacho dhahabu inapaswa kufanya, ikishikilia uwezo wa kununua huku sarafu zikidhoofika. La pili ni mtawanyaji usio na uhusiano — wazo kwamba kripto husogea kwa kujitegemea na hisa na hatifungani, kwa hivyo kuiongeza hulainisha kasha. La tatu ni kinga dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei — wazo kwamba usambazaji wenye dari hukulinda bei za watumiaji zinapopanda.

05a2712d43dd.en: The asymmetry here is the whole point of the lesson. Nobody knows what the market will return over the next 30 years. Everybody can know, today, exactly what they will be charged. One of those two inputs to your final result is uncertain and outside your control. The other is printed on the fact sheet.
05a2712d43dd.sw: Ukosefu wa ulinganifu hapa ndio lengo zima la somo. Hakuna anayejua soko litarudisha nini kwa miaka 30 ijayo. Kila mtu anaweza kujua, leo, hasa atakachotozwa. Kimoja kati ya vigezo hivyo viwili vya matokeo yako ya mwisho hakina uhakika na kiko nje ya udhibiti wako. Kingine kimechapishwa kwenye karatasi ya taarifa.

05bed71ba96a.en: An instruction to buy or sell only at a specified price or better. Guarantees price. Does not guarantee execution — it may never fill if the market doesn't reach your level.

05f0943f4768.en: Two ways to make the next block expensive: Proof of Work pays with electricity and hardware, Proof of Stake with locked capital that can be slashed — and both face the same majority-attack question.

06388de79eab.en: Premiums and discounts widen exactly when you would least want them to. If the underlying market is closed, illiquid or falling fast, an authorised participant cannot price or trade the basket reliably, and the arbitrage that normally closes the gap weakens. ETFs holding hard-to-trade assets — small foreign markets, corporate bonds — show this most. The mechanism is strongest in the calm conditions where you need it least.

ETF zinazoshikilia mali ngumu kufanyiwa biashara — masoko madogo ya kigeni, hatifungani za kampuni — huonyesha hili zaidi. 0652c5c72b57.en: A company earns 100 in revenue. Suppliers take 40, staff take 35, interest on debt takes 10, and tax takes 5. If revenue had been 90 instead, the first four claims would still take 90, and the residual would be zero.

06d1900f2d54.en: A flash crash is not really about the news that started it. It is about a market so thin that a modest imbalance meets no resistance, and automated stop and hedging orders feed on each other. The same sell order that barely moves price during the busy London afternoon can crater it at one in the morning. Liquidity, not headlines, decided how far this move went.

Agizo lile lile la kuuza ambalo halisogezi bei sana wakati wa mchana wenye shughuli wa London linaweza kuliporomosha saa saba usiku. Ukwasi, si vichwa vya habari, ndio uliamua msogeo huu ulikwenda mbali kiasi gani.

0708719a8d0a.en: That raises an immediate practical question. Thousands of computers, all writing to the same record — how do you keep the record in one agreed order, and how do you stop anyone from quietly editing last month's page? The answer is the data structure this lesson covers. The ledger is not one long continuous file. It is a sequence of batches, added one at a time, with each batch cryptographically locked to the one before it.

0746f338599b.en: Longin and Solnik, in Extreme Correlation of International Equity Markets, published in the Journal of Finance in 2001, tested whether international equity market correlation rises in volatile periods. Using extreme value theory to model the tails of the joint distribution, they found the increase in the negative tail — falling markets — but not in the positive tail. Correlation between markets rises when they fall together, and does not rise when they rise together.

Wakitumia nadharia ya thamani kali kuiga mikia ya usambazaji wa pamoja, walibaini ongezeko katika mkia hasi — masoko yanayoshuka — lakini si katika mkia chanya. Uhusiano kati ya masoko hupanda yanaposhuka pamoja, na haupandi yanapopanda pamoja.

07e7451fc821.en: Three properties of that definition cause the damage. First, the limit is frequently unlimited, because many interfaces default to the maximum possible amount to save the user from re-approving on every future trade. You approved a 50 dollar swap; the permission covers every unit of that token your wallet will ever hold. Second, the permission persists. Closing the tab does nothing. Clicking disconnect wallet does nothing to it, because disconnecting is a browser-session action while the approval lives on the blockchain. Uninstalling the application does nothing. It remains until you send a transaction that revokes it. Third, the permission does not care who controls the contract later. If the contract you approved is exploited, upgraded maliciously, or was never honest, the holder of that permission can move your tokens without asking you for anything further. You already signed.
07e7451fc821.sw: Sifa tatu za ufafanuzi huo husababisha uharibifu. Kwanza, kikomo mara nyingi hakina mpaka, kwa sababu violesura vingi hutumia kiasi cha juu kabisa kinachowezekana kama chaguo-msingi kumwokoa mtumiaji kutoka kuidhinisha upya katika kila biashara ya baadaye. Uliidhinisha ubadilishaji wa dola 50; ruhusa hufunika kila kipimo cha tokeni hiyo ambacho pochi yako itawahi kushikilia. Pili, ruhusa hudumu. Kufunga kichupo hakufanyi lolote. Kubonyeza tenganisha pochi hakufanyi lolote kwake, kwa sababu kutenganisha ni kitendo cha kipindi cha kivinjari huku idhini ikiishi katika mnyororo wa vitalu. Kufuta programu hakufanyi lolote. Hubaki hadi utume muamala unaoibatilisha. Tatu, ruhusa haijali nani anadhibiti mkataba baadaye. Ikiwa mkataba ulioidhinisha utavamiwa, kuboreshwa kwa nia mbaya, au haukuwa mwaminifu kamwe, mwenye ruhusa hiyo anaweza kusogeza tokeni zako bila kukuuliza chochote zaidi. Tayari ulishatia sahihi.

08496018b086.en: Stake 1 unit on one number. You win 35 units with probability 1 in 37, and lose 1 unit with probability 36 in 37. The average outcome is (35 divided by 37) minus (36 divided by 37), which is about minus 0.027. Repeat it a thousand times and the average result is a loss of about 27 units, regardless of any streak along the way.
08496018b086.sw: Weka kipimo 1 juu ya namba moja. Unashinda vipimo 35 kwa uwezekano wa 1 kati ya 37, na kupoteza kipimo 1 kwa uwezekano wa 36 kati ya 37. Tokeo la wastani ni (35 kugawanywa kwa 37) toa (36 kugawanywa kwa 37), ambayo ni takriban toa 0.027. Rudia mara elfu na tokeo la wastani ni hasara ya takriban vipimo 27, bila kujali mfululizo wowote njiani.

085e0fea02f7.en: You have 10,000 and borrow another 10,000, buying 20,000 of shares. A 20% rise makes 4,000 on your 10,000 — a 40% return before interest. A 20% fall loses 4,000, which is 40% of your money. The shares moved 20%; you moved 40%.
085e0fea02f7.sw: Una 10,000 na unakopa 10,000 nyingine, ukinunua hisa za 20,000. Kupanda kwa 20% hufanya 4,000 juu ya 10,000 yako — faida ya 40% kabla ya riba. Kushuka kwa 20% hupoteza 4,000, ambayo ni 40% ya pesa zako. Hisa zilisogea 20%; wewe ulisogea 40%.

086c05df6a35.en: Two structural features of crypto make the wider stop a requirement rather than a preference. The first is that nothing stops the market. United States equity markets run market-wide circuit breakers: if the S&P 500 falls 7% or 13% during the trading day, trading halts for 15 minutes, and a 20% fall closes the market for the day. Those rules exist because of the 1987 crash, and they buy participants time to think. Crypto has no equivalent, and structurally cannot have one. There is no single venue, no shared session, no open and no close to measure a daily threshold against, and no authority able to pause dozens of independent exchanges at once. Individual exchanges can halt their own markets, which is not the same protection at all.
086c05df6a35.sw: Sifa mbili za kimuundo za kripto hufanya kusimamisha kupana kuwa hitaji badala ya upendeleo. Ya kwanza ni kwamba hakuna kinachosimamisha soko. Masoko ya hisa ya Marekani huendesha vizuizi vya mzunguko vya soko zima: ikiwa S&P 500 itashuka 7% au 13% wakati wa siku ya biashara, biashara husimama kwa dakika 15, na kushuka kwa 20% hufunga soko kwa siku. Kanuni hizo zipo kwa sababu ya mporomoko wa 1987, nazo huwanunulia washiriki muda wa kufikiri. Kripto haina kinacholingana, na kimuundo haiwezi kuwa nacho. Hakuna uwanja mmoja, hakuna kipindi kinachoshirikiwa, hakuna kufungua na hakuna kufunga cha kupimia kizingiti cha kila siku dhidi yake, na hakuna mamlaka inayoweza kusitisha masoko kadhaa huru kwa wakati mmoja. 089c1359bc91.en: This is where the famous "wait for 6 confirmations" rule comes from — and it is a convention, not a law. The 2008 Bitcoin paper worked through the attacker math: against an attacker holding 10 percent of the network's computing power, a transaction buried six blocks deep faces reversal odds below one in a thousand. Early services adopted six — roughly an hour of Bitcoin blocks — and the habit stuck. But nothing magic happens at six. Exchanges (Lesson 5) choose their own thresholds for crediting deposits, and many now credit after 2 or 3 confirmations; a stronger attacker than the paper's 10 percent example would need more. The number is a risk judgment, not a threshold in the software.
089c1359bc91.sw: Hapa ndipo kanuni maarufu ya "subiri uthibitisho 6" inapotoka — nayo ni desturi, si sheria. Karatasi ya Bitcoin ya 2008 ilifanyia kazi hesabu ya mshambuliaji: dhidi ya mshambuliaji anayeshikilia asilimia 10 ya nguvu ya kihesabu ya mtandao, muamala uliozikwa vitalu sita ndani hukabiliwa na uwezekano wa kutenduliwa chini ya moja katika elfu. Huduma za awali zilikubali sita — takriban saa moja ya vitalu vya Bitcoin — na desturi ikashikilia. Lakini hakuna kinachotokea kimuujiza katika sita. Masoko ya kubadilisha (Somo la 5) huchagua vizingiti vyao wenyewe kwa kuweka amana katika akaunti, na mengi sasa huweka baada ya uthibitisho 2 au 3; mshambuliaji mwenye nguvu zaidi ya mfano wa asilimia 10 wa karatasi angehitaji zaidi. Namba ni hukumu ya hatari, si kizingiti katika programu.

089de892bfdf.en: Correct - a token approval authorizes a contract to move a token, not an amount you traded, and not for a period you were active. Disconnecting a wallet is a browser action; the approval lives on the blockchain and stays in force until a revoke transaction removes it. This is exactly the BadgerDAO pattern from December 2021, where approvals harvested from around 20 November were drained on 2 December, and roughly 120 million dollars left wallets whose owners had signed nothing that day.

Huu ndio hasa muundo wa BadgerDAO kutoka Desemba 2021, ambapo idhini zilizovunwa kuanzia takriban 20 Novemba zilimwagwa tarehe 2 Desemba, na takriban dola milioni 120 ziliondoka katika pochi ambazo wamiliki wake hawakutia sahihi lolote siku hiyo.

Take the friendliest combination for crypto — a calm crypto window near 40% against a stressed forex year near 11% — and the ratio falls to about 3.6 times. 0aa591719d9a.en: The logic follows everything the course has taught. A central bank changes rates or signals a change (Chapter 2, Lesson 3). That reprices currencies and government bonds first, because they are closest to interest rates. Changing borrowing costs then feed into credit and company earnings, moving equities. Growth and rate expectations move commodities. And the most risk-sensitive assets — including cryptocurrencies — swing the most, because they sit at the far, high-beta end of the risk spectrum.

0ba94621a727.en: What to look for from here. Count the events: when someone shows a crypto cycle chart, ask how many completed cycles it contains, and note that the honest answer is three with a fourth in progress. Ask when the rule was written, because a window fitted after the data is a description of the past dressed as a forecast. Look for the confound: for any halving-driven claim, ask what central banks, regulators and adoption were doing in the same months. Ask what would falsify it, since a cycle claim that survives every outcome is not a strong claim. Separate the certain from the speculative, because the issuance schedule is certain and what price does in response is not. And distrust round numbers with no source, since Bitcoin always drops 80% collapses on contact with the actual published ranges, which disagree with each other.
0ba94621a727.sw: Cha kuangalia kuanzia hapa. Hesabu matukio: mtu anapokuonyesha chati ya mzunguko wa kripto, uliza ina mizunguko mingapi iliyokamilika, na tambua jibu la kweli ni mitatu ikiwa na wa nne unaoendelea. Uliza kanuni iliandikwa lini, kwa sababu dirisha lililowekwa baada ya data ni maelezo ya yaliyopita yakivaa nguo za utabiri. Tafuta kichanganyaji: kwa dai lolote linaloendeshwa na kupunguzwa nusu, uliza benki kuu, wadhibiti na matumizi vilikuwa vikifanya nini katika miezi ileile. Uliza kitakachokanusha, kwa kuwa dai la mzunguko linalonusurika kila matokeo si dai lenye nguvu. Tenganisha lililo na uhakika na la kudhania, kwa sababu ratiba ya utoaji ina uhakika na bei hufanya nini kujibu haina. Na usiamini namba za duara zisizo na chanzo, kwa kuwa Bitcoin daima hushuka 80% huanguka ikigusana na viwango halisi vilivyochapishwa, ambavyo havikubaliani kati yake.

In October 2025 top-of-book depth fell by well over 90%, with bids reappearing only 4% and 10% away from the mid price, so stops filled far from their levels and added to the cascade.

Mwezi Oktoba 2025 kina cha kilele cha kitabu kilishuka kwa zaidi ya 90%, huku zabuni zikijitokeza tena tu 4% na 10% mbali na bei ya katikati, kwa hivyo kusimamisha kulijazwa mbali na viwango vyake na kukaongeza katika mfuatano.

0c29020f1a1d.en: A pool holds 10 ETH and 20,000 USDC, so k = 10 × 20,000 = 200,000, and the pool's price is 20,000 ÷ 10 = 2,000 USDC per ETH. You swap in 5,000 USDC. The pool's USDC side rises to 25,000 — so to keep k at 200,000, the ETH side must fall to 200,000 ÷ 25,000 = 8 ETH. The pool pays out the difference: 10 − 8 = 2 ETH. You paid 5,000 USDC for 2 ETH — an effective price of 2,500 USDC per ETH, which is 25% worse than the 2,000 the pool quoted before you traded. A smaller trade hurts less: swapping in 1,000 USDC returns about 0.476 ETH, an effective price of about 2,100 — 5% worse than the quote. (Real pools also charge a small fee on each swap, 0.3% in the classic Uniswap design, which goes to the liquidity providers; we left it out to keep the arithmetic clean.)
0c29020f1a1d.sw: Bwawa lina ETH 10 na USDC 20,000, kwa hivyo k = 10 × 20,000 = 200,000, na bei ya bwawa ni 20,000 ÷ 10 = USDC 2,000 kwa ETH. Unabadilisha ndani USDC 5,000. Upande wa USDC wa bwawa hupanda hadi 25,000 — kwa hivyo kuweka k katika 200,000, upande wa ETH lazima ushuke hadi 200,000 ÷ 25,000 = ETH 8. Bwawa hulipa tofauti: 10 − 8 = ETH 2. Ulilipa USDC 5,000 kwa ETH 2 — bei halisi ya USDC 2,500 kwa ETH, ambayo ni 25% mbaya zaidi kuliko 2,000 ambayo bwawa lilinukuu kabla hujafanya biashara. Biashara ndogo huumiza kidogo: kubadilisha ndani USDC 1,000 hurudisha takriban ETH 0.476, bei halisi ya takriban 2,100 — 5% mbaya zaidi kuliko bei iliyonukuliwa. (Mabwawa halisi pia hutoza ada ndogo kwa kila ubadilishaji, 0.3% katika muundo wa kawaida wa Uniswap, ambayo huenda kwa watoa ukwasi; tuliiacha nje ili kuweka hesabu safi.)

0c32714e2671.en: A stop-loss becomes a market order when it fires, and in a collapsed book it fills far from its level or feeds the cascade itself
0c32714e2671.sw: Kusimamisha hasara huwa agizo la soko kunapofyatuka, na katika kitabu kilichoporomoka hujazwa mbali na kiwango chake au hulisha mfuatano wenyewe

0c355d15e451.en: Five: the custody map. Chapter 1 Lessons 4 and 5 taught the trade-off between holding your own keys and letting somebody else hold them. The plan turns that trade-off into thresholds.
0c355d15e451.sw: Tano: ramani ya utunzaji. Sura ya 1 Masomo ya 4 na 5 yalifundisha maafikiano kati ya kushikilia funguo zako mwenyewe na kumruhusu mtu mwingine azishikilie. Mpango hugeuza maafikiano hayo kuwa vizingiti.

0c6d4f40df00.en: Not quite. The portfolios and the average returns were identical and neither investor timed anything. What differed was the direction their money was flowing, which determines whether a fall hands you cheap assets or forces you to sell at a discount.
0c6d4f40df00.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Makasha na faida za wastani zilifanana na hakuna mwekezaji aliyepanga muda wa lolote. Kilichotofautiana ni mwelekeo ambao pesa yao ilikuwa ikitiririka, ambao huamua kama kushuka kunakukabidhi rasilimali za bei nafuu au kunakulazimisha kuuza kwa punguzo.

0c79f5038df7.en: Position size = (the money you are willing to lose) / (the distance from entry to your stop). The numerator is your decision. The denominator is the market's. That split is the entire lesson.
0c79f5038df7.sw: Ukubwa wa nafasi = (pesa uliyo tayari kuipoteza) / (umbali kutoka kuingia hadi kusimamisha kwako). Kigawanywa ni uamuzi wako. Kigawanyaji ni cha soko. Mgawanyo huo ndilo somo zima.

0c7b974ba26f.en: Six: the recovery plan. This is the section that separates a crypto plan from every other plan in this course, and it is the one most often skipped.
0c7b974ba26f.sw: Sita: mpango wa urejeshaji. Hii ndiyo sehemu inayotenganisha mpango wa kripto na kila mpango mwingine katika kozi hii, nayo ndiyo inayorukwa mara nyingi zaidi.

0c7bfcdb59e3.en: A worked reading makes the chain concrete, and shows what it does and does not tell you.
0c7bfcdb59e3.sw: Usomaji uliofanyiwa kazi hufanya mnyororo kuwa halisi, na huonyesha kinachokuambia na kisichokuambia.

0c8619579dd8.en: A position bought at 100, which rose to 400 and now trades at 150, feels like a loss of 250 to the person holding it. It is a gain of 50. The 400 was a price that existed on one day and was never realised, and it is doing more work in that person's reasoning than the price they actually paid.
0c8619579dd8.sw: Nafasi iliyonunuliwa katika 100, iliyopanda hadi 400 na sasa inafanyiwa biashara katika 150, huhisi kama hasara ya 250 kwa mtu anayeishikilia. Ni faida ya 50. 400 ilikuwa bei iliyokuwepo siku moja na haikutimizwa kamwe, nayo inafanya kazi zaidi katika hoja ya mtu huyo kuliko bei aliyoilipa hasa.

0c8875324590.en: Imagining a trade has already failed and listing why, to surface hidden risks before entry (Klein, 2007).
0c8875324590.sw: Kufikiria biashara tayari imeshindwa na kuorodhesha kwa nini, ili kufichua hatari fichi kabla ya kuingia (Klein, 2007).

0c979e9c22e6.en: A rule returning a holding to its target weight once it drifts beyond a set distance, rather than on a calendar date.
0c979e9c22e6.sw: Kanuni inayorudisha umiliki kwenye uzito wake lengwa mara unapotelezea zaidi ya umbali uliowekwa, badala ya katika tarehe ya kalenda.

0c9ad6159424.en: The phrase "left over" is doing the work in that sentence. A company pays its suppliers, its staff, its lenders and its tax bill first. Shareholders are last in the queue. What reaches them is the residual.
0c9ad6159424.sw: Msemo "iliyobaki" ndio unafanya kazi katika sentensi hiyo. Kampuni hulipa wasambazaji wake, wafanyakazi wake, wakopeshaji wake na bili yake ya kodi kwanza. Wanahisa ni wa mwisho kwenye foleni. Kinachowafikia ni mabaki.

0cc8ad00d5fb.en: What to look for as a standing habit rather than an occasional exercise. Watch government bond yields and credit spreads even if you hold neither, because they move first. Note whether market leadership is broad or concentrated in a few names, which distinguishes a healthy trend from a narrow one. Notice when volatility has been unusually low for an unusually long time, since that is the condition in which leveraged positions accumulate. And be honest when the answer is that nothing aligns, which is more often than a market commentary industry can afford to admit.
0cc8ad00d5fb.sw: Cha kuangalia kama tabia ya kudumu badala ya zoezi la mara kwa mara. Angalia mavuno ya hatifungani za serikali na mianya ya mikopo hata usipoishikilia yoyote, kwa sababu husonga kwanza. Tambua kama uongozi wa soko ni mpana au umekusanyika katika majina machache, jambo linalotofautisha mwelekeo wenye afya na finyu. Tambua wakati mtikisiko umekuwa mdogo isivyo kawaida kwa muda mrefu isivyo kawaida, kwa kuwa hiyo ndiyo hali ambayo nafasi zenye mzingo hujilimbikiza. Na kuwa mkweli jibu linapokuwa kwamba hakuna kinachopatana, jambo linalotokea mara nyingi zaidi kuliko tasnia ya maoni ya soko inavyoweza kumudu kukiri.

0ccb53ffd1ac.en: An exchange rate determined by open market supply and demand, rather than fixed or pegged by government agreement.
0ccb53ffd1ac.sw: Kiwango cha ubadilishaji kinachoamuliwa na ugavi na mahitaji ya soko huria, badala ya kuwekwa thabiti au kufungwa kwa makubaliano ya serikali.

0ccf2b04b3f8.en: Not quite. Market orders take whatever is available, so you buy at the ask (41.10) and sell at the bid (40.90). That is a loss of 0.20 per share even though the quoted price never moved. Only a resting limit order can avoid paying the spread — at the risk of not trading at all.
0ccf2b04b3f8.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Maagizo ya soko huchukua chochote kinachopatikana, hivyo unanunua kwa ask (41.10) na kuuza kwa bid (40.90). Hiyo ni hasara ya 0.20 kwa kila hisa ingawa bei iliyonukuliwa haikusogea kamwe. Agizo la kikomo linalopumzika tu ndilo linaloweza kuepuka kulipa spread — kwa hatari ya kutofanya biashara kabisa.

0cd0870529fb.sw: Forex na hisa ni masoko yanayofanana kabisa

0cd1ccc99ea1.en: A chart showing an on-chain metric overlaid on price, with arrows at the turning points, proves nothing. It is the same picture that Foundations Chapter 3 taught you to distrust when it was drawn with chart patterns. The questions are unchanged. How many indicators and thresholds were tried before this one was shown to you? What period was it fitted on, and what period was it then tested on? What would it have signalled at the times it was wrong, and are those times on the chart? If a claim cannot survive those four questions, it is a picture, not evidence.
0cd1ccc99ea1.sw: Chati inayoonyesha kipimo cha kwenye mnyororo kimewekwa juu ya bei, ikiwa na mishale katika nukta za kugeuka, haithibitishi lolote. Ni picha ileile ambayo Misingi Sura ya 3 lilikufundisha kutoiamini ilipochorwa kwa miundo ya chati. Maswali hayajabadilika. Ni viashiria vingapi na vizingiti vingapi vilijaribiwa kabla hiki hakijaonyeshwa kwako? Kiliwekwa kufaa kipindi kipi, na kikapimwa katika kipindi kipi kisha? Kingeashiria nini katika nyakati ambazo kilikosea, na je, nyakati hizo ziko kwenye chati? Ikiwa dai haliwezi kunusurika maswali hayo manne, ni picha, si ushahidi.

0ce8bd816121.sw: Msimamizi wa fund huweka upya bei ya ETF kwa mkono hadi 50.00

0cf4a19210a7.en: A fund with a slightly higher fee but tighter tracking can leave you better off than a cheaper one that lags. The advertised fee is the headline; the tracking difference is the result. Both are worth checking, and the next lesson explains why even small differences matter so much over time.
0cf4a19210a7.sw: Fund yenye ada kubwa kidogo lakini kufuatilia kwa ukaribu zaidi inaweza kukuacha bora zaidi kuliko ile ya bei nafuu inayokawia. Ada iliyotangazwa ni kichwa cha habari; tofauti ya kufuatilia ni tokeo. Vyote viwili vinastahili kukaguliwa, na somo lijalo linaeleza kwa nini hata tofauti ndogo zinahusika sana.

0cfc3c50f91e.en: Step back and the six chapters form one process. The mechanics (Chapter 1) let you place a trade. Reading the market (Chapter 2) and the case studies (Chapter 5) tell you what is happening and how it can go wrong. Risk management (Chapter 3) keeps you alive. Psychology and the plan (Chapter 4) make you follow your own rules. And this chapter assembles them into how a professional actually works: build a six-pillar thesis, define its invalidation and pre-mortem it, place it only in a suitable regime, size it against the risk of ruin, weight toward your best ideas, and review the decision afterwards. That loop, run honestly and repeatedly, is the whole craft.
0cfc3c50f91e.sw: Rudi nyuma na sura sita huunda mchakato mmoja. Utaratibu (Sura ya 1) hukuruhusu kuweka biashara. Kusoma soko (Sura ya 2) na uchunguzi wa matukio (Sura ya 5) hukuambia kinachotokea na jinsi kinavyoweza kwenda vibaya. Usimamizi wa hatari (Sura ya 3) hukuweka hai. Saikolojia na mpango (Sura ya 4) hukufanya ufuate kanuni zako mwenyewe. Na sura hii huviunganisha kuwa jinsi mtaalamu anavyofanya kazi hasa: jenga nadharia ya nguzo sita, fafanua kuvunjika kwake na uifanyie pre-mortem, iweke tu katika hali inayoifaa, ipime dhidi ya hatari ya kufilisika, elekeza uzito kwenye mawazo yako bora, na upitie uamuzi baadaye. Mzunguko huo, ukiendeshwa kwa uaminifu na kurudiwa, ndio ufundi wote.

0cfdd522373d.en: Buying shares that look cheap against a fundamental measure.
0cfdd522373d.sw: Kununua hisa zinazoonekana nafuu dhidi ya kipimo cha msingi.

0d00ee38dbe1.en: Here is the honest paragraph on those two mechanisms. The insurance fund is a genuine protection and it usually works, which is why most traders never hear of it. Auto-deleveraging is not a protection for you. It is a protection for the exchange's solvency, paid for by closing correct positions without consent. It is documented openly in the risk pages of Binance, Bybit, OKX and the major decentralised venues, so it is not a hidden term. But it means that on a leveraged perpetual, even a completely correct position can be closed early and at a price you did not choose, because someone on the other side defaulted and the fund ran dry. Reports from the October 2025 event describe exactly this happening across several venues. If you take one structural fact from this section, take that one: on a perpetual, being right does not guarantee you get paid in full.
0d00ee38dbe1.sw: Hii hapa aya ya kweli kuhusu taratibu hizo mbili. Mfuko wa bima ni ulinzi halisi nao kwa kawaida hufanya kazi, ndiyo maana wafanyabiashara wengi hawausikii kamwe. Kupunguza mzingo kiotomatiki si ulinzi kwako. Ni ulinzi wa uwezo wa kulipa wa soko la kubadilisha, unaolipwa kwa kufunga nafasi sahihi bila ridhaa. Umeandikwa wazi katika kurasa za hatari za Binance, Bybit, OKX na viwanja vikuu visivyo na kituo kikuu, kwa hivyo si sharti lililofichwa. Lakini humaanisha kwamba katika ya kudumu yenye mzingo, hata nafasi sahihi kabisa inaweza kufungwa mapema na katika bei ambayo hukuichagua, kwa sababu mtu upande wa pili alishindwa na mfuko ulikauka. Ripoti kutoka tukio la Oktoba 2025 huelezea hasa hili likitokea katika viwanja kadhaa. Ikiwa utachukua ukweli mmoja wa kimuundo kutoka sehemu hii, chukua huo: katika ya kudumu, kuwa sahihi hakuhakikishi utalipwa kikamilifu.

0d2b07d903ff.en: Correct, and deliberately unexciting. Around three quarters of retail investors in the BIS data likely lost money; roughly half the tokens on a major decentralised exchange were scam tokens; three of the industry's largest institutions failed completely for three different reasons; and diversification failed both within the class and across it. That evidence supports a small, survivable, rules-based position rather than either avoidance or conviction.
0d2b07d903ff.sw: Sahihi, na lisilovutia kwa makusudi. Takriban robo tatu ya wawekezaji wa rejareja katika data ya BIS pengine walipoteza pesa; takriban nusu ya tokeni katika soko kuu lisilo na kituo kikuu zilikuwa tokeni za ulaghai; taasisi tatu kubwa zaidi za tasnia zilishindwa kabisa kwa sababu tatu tofauti; na mtawanyiko ulishindwa ndani ya aina na baina yake. Ushahidi huo huunga mkono nafasi ndogo, inayonusurika, inayotegemea kanuni badala ya kuepuka au msimamo thabiti.

0d2dae1ef11c.en: Not quite — effective leverage is position divided by equity, so the 2,000 dollar account runs 25:1 versus 5:1 and is called after a far smaller move.
0d2dae1ef11c.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — leverage halisi ni nafasi kugawanywa kwa usawa, hivyo akaunti ya dola 2,000 huendesha 25:1 dhidi ya 5:1 na huitwa baada ya msogeo mdogo mno.

0d3d099288b2.en: The same effect on a contribution schedule: 200 a month for 30 years at 7% gross is 72,000 of your own money paid in. At 0.05% it grows to about 241,601. At 1.50% it grows to about 182,722. The 58,879 difference is close to what you contributed over the first twenty-four years.
0d3d099288b2.sw: Athari ile ile juu ya ratiba ya michango: 200 kwa mwezi kwa miaka 30 kwa 7% ghafi ni 72,000 za pesa zako mwenyewe ulizoingiza. Kwa 0.05% hukua hadi takriban 241,601. Kwa 1.50% hukua hadi takriban 182,722. Tofauti ya 58,879 iko karibu na kile ulichochangia katika miaka ishirini na minne ya kwanza.

0d61034f8cb5.en: Your wallet shows a payment as "sent," and you can see the transaction in the mempool. What is the honest description of its status?
0d61034f8cb5.sw: Pochi yako inaonyesha malipo kama "yametumwa," nawe unaweza kuona muamala katika mempool. Maelezo ya kweli ya hali yake ni yapi?

0d6c521d617d.en: Compare the two results, because the contrast is the lesson. The same 200,000,000 dollar market cap, and the same routine-looking 0.5% sale, produced a 1,800 dollar cost in one book and a 233,400 dollar cost in the other. And in the thin book, a sale that moved 766,600 dollars of real cash removed 60,000,000 dollars of market cap. That is the crypto multiplier, visible in a single trade. Nothing on the price page would have warned you. Price was 10.00 in both cases. Market cap was 200,000,000 in both cases. The only number that distinguished them was depth, and depth is not on the price page.
0d6c521d617d.sw: Linganisha matokeo hayo mawili, kwa sababu tofauti ndiyo somo. Kiasi kilekile cha soko cha dola 200,000,000, na uuzaji uleule unaoonekana wa kawaida wa 0.5%, ulizalisha gharama ya dola 1,800 katika kitabu kimoja na gharama ya dola 233,400 katika kingine. Na katika kitabu chembamba, uuzaji uliosogeza dola 766,600 za fedha halisi uliondoa dola 60,000,000 za kiasi cha soko. Hicho ndicho kizidishi cha kripto, kikionekana katika biashara moja. Hakuna kilicho katika ukurasa wa bei kingekuonya. Bei ilikuwa 10.00 katika kesi zote mbili. Kiasi cha soko kilikuwa 200,000,000 katika kesi zote mbili. Namba pekee iliyozitofautisha ilikuwa kina, na kina hakiko katika ukurasa wa bei.

0d9813839bcb.en: Individual cheap shares will outperform individual expensive ones
0d9813839bcb.sw: Hisa nafuu binafsi zitafanya vizuri kuliko hisa ghali binafsi

0d99e8c125f9.en: On January 15, 2015, the Swiss National Bank unexpectedly removed a floor it had defended for over three years, promising to hold EUR/CHF at 1.20 "with the utmost determination." Without warning, they abandoned it — and cut interest rates further into negative territory in the same announcement. EUR/CHF collapsed from 1.20 to as low as 0.85 within minutes. Every stop-loss order set anywhere near 1.20 triggered correctly and converted to a market order exactly as designed — but there was no buyer waiting nearby to fill them. Orders that should have closed near 1.19 or 1.15 instead filled at 0.90 or worse, if they filled at all. Alpari UK declared insolvency that same day. FXCM absorbed $225 million in client losses and needed an emergency bailout to survive. Many individual traders discovered they owed their broker more than their entire account balance, from a single trade.
0d99e8c125f9.sw: Tarehe 15 Januari 2015, Benki Kuu ya Uswisi iliondoa bila kutarajiwa sakafu iliyokuwa ikiitetea kwa zaidi ya miaka mitatu, ikiahidi kushikilia EUR/CHF kwa 1.20 "kwa uamuzi wa hali ya juu." Bila onyo, waliiacha — na kupunguza viwango vya riba zaidi hadi eneo hasi katika tangazo lile lile. EUR/CHF ilianguka kutoka 1.20 hadi chini kama 0.85 ndani ya dakika chache. Kila agizo la stop-loss lililowekwa popote karibu na 1.20 lilianzishwa kwa usahihi na kugeuka kuwa agizo la soko hasa kama lilivyoundwa — lakini hakukuwa na mnunuzi aliyesubiri karibu kulitimiza. Maagizo yaliyopaswa kufunga karibu na 1.19 au 1.15 badala yake yalitimizwa kwa 0.90 au vibaya zaidi, kama yalitimizwa kabisa. Alpari UK ilitangaza kufilisika siku hiyo hiyo. FXCM ilifyonza hasara za wateja za $225 milioni na ikahitaji uokoaji wa dharura ili kuendelea kuishi. Wafanyabiashara wengi binafsi waligundua walikuwa wanadaiwa na broker wao zaidi ya salio lote la akaunti yao, kutokana na biashara moja.

0dbc6cb78124.en: To celebrate a trade that worked

0dc4e36270d0.en: Every trade you place has two distances built into it: how far price can go against you before your stop-loss closes it, and how far it can go in your favour before you take profit. The relationship between those two distances is the most important number in a trading plan that Foundations Chapter 2 kept pointing toward without naming.
0dc4e36270d0.sw: Kila biashara unayoiweka ina umbali miwili iliyojengwa ndani yake: umbali ambao bei inaweza kwenda dhidi yako kabla stop-loss yako haijaifunga, na umbali ambao inaweza kwenda kwa manufaa yako kabla hujachukua faida. Uhusiano kati ya umbali hizo mbili ndio namba muhimu kuliko zote katika mpango wa biashara ambao Sura ya 2 ya Msingi iliendelea kuuelekeza bila kuutaja.

0ddc59f62c2a.en: Averaging in wins when prices fall during the schedule, and loses when they rise. Rising is the more common outcome.
0ddc59f62c2a.sw: Kupunguza wastani wa bei hushinda bei zinaposhuka wakati wa ratiba, na hupoteza zinapopanda. Kupanda ndilo tokeo la kawaida zaidi.

0def72a6ac5f.en: A live percentage measure of account equity relative to margin currently in use, calculated as (Equity ÷ Used Margin) × 100.
0def72a6ac5f.sw: Kipimo hai cha asilimia cha usawa wa akaunti ikilinganishwa na margin inayotumika sasa, kinachokokotolewa kama (Usawa ÷ Margin Iliyotumika) × 100.

0df07daaee51.en: Nothing enforces the link between an ETF price and what it holds. An incentive does, and it weakens under stress.
0df07daaee51.sw: Hakuna kinacholazimisha uhusiano kati ya bei ya ETF na kile inachoshikilia. Motisha ndiyo hufanya hivyo, na hudhoofika chini ya shinikizo.

0df36a2e3261.en: Notional is the number that does everything to you. Your margin is the number that runs out. Funding is charged on notional, not on margin, and that is what makes it dangerous at high leverage.
0df36a2e3261.sw: Ya kinadharia ndiyo namba inayokufanyia kila kitu. Mkopo wako ndiyo namba inayoisha. Ufadhili hutozwa juu ya ya kinadharia, si juu ya mkopo, na hilo ndicho kinachofanya iwe hatari katika mzingo mkubwa.

0e02fb6fb933.en: The arithmetic of the fall is worth stating because percentages stop being meaningful at this magnitude.
0e02fb6fb933.sw: Hesabu ya kuanguka inastahili kutajwa kwa sababu asilimia huacha kuwa na maana katika daraja hili.

0e29b29e1e59.en: Three regimes cover most of what a reader will meet, and each favours a different pillar.
0e29b29e1e59.sw: Tawala tatu hufunika mengi ya yale ambayo msomaji atakutana nayo, na kila moja hupendelea nguzo tofauti.

0e39901a0188.en: Once a thesis exists, two things have to be attached to it before it becomes a position.
0e39901a0188.sw: Mara nadharia inapokuwepo, vitu viwili lazima viambatishwe kwake kabla haijawa nafasi.

0e3cd84697e2.en: This is expected — value and momentum are negatively correlated, so a cheap share is usually one that has been falling
0e3cd84697e2.sw: Hili linatarajiwa — thamani na kasi zina uhusiano hasi, kwa hivyo hisa ya bei nafuu kwa kawaida ni ile iliyokuwa ikishuka

0f2ac93410c8.en: A calendar shows: 10:00am, CAD, HIGH impact, "Overnight Rate," Forecast 1.75%, Previous 1.75%. That tells you a lot before anything happens. The forecast matches the previous rate, so no change is expected — if the actual lands at 1.75%, the reaction is likely muted, because it's already priced in. But if the Bank of Canada surprises and hikes, every CAD pair can move sharply within seconds. Same event, wildly different outcomes, decided entirely by the gap between actual and forecast.
0f2ac93410c8.sw: Kalenda inaonyesha: 10:00 asubuhi, CAD, athari KUBWA, "Kiwango cha Usiku," Utabiri 1.75%, Iliyopita 1.75%. Hiyo inakuambia mengi kabla ya chochote kutokea. Utabiri unalingana na kiwango kilichopita, hivyo hakuna mabadiliko yanayotarajiwa — kama halisi itatua kwa 1.75%, mwitikio unawezekana kuwa mdogo, kwa sababu tayari umewekewa bei. Lakini kama Benki ya Kanada itashangaza na kupandisha, kila jozi la CAD linaweza kusogea kwa kasi ndani ya sekunde chache. Tukio lile lile, matokeo tofauti kabisa, yakiamuliwa kabisa na pengo kati ya halisi na utabiri.

0fbe0d88f653.en: Run these checks before every crypto trade. Do you know the current ATR of this asset, in the asset's own price units? Have you expressed your stop as a percentage of price, so it can be compared honestly with a forex stop? What do you get when you divide your intended stop distance by the ATR — and if the answer is below about 1, what will ordinary daily movement do to it? When the position looks too small to be worth taking, is that the sizing rule doing its job? And does the position still survive if the stop fills worse than its level in a fast move?

Unapata nini unapogawanya umbali wako uliokusudiwa wa kusimamisha na ATR — na ikiwa jibu ni chini ya takriban 1, msogeo wa kawaida wa kila siku utaufanyia nini? Nafasi inapoonekana ndogo mno kustahili kuchukuliwa, je, hiyo ni kanuni ya kupanga ukubwa ikifanya kazi yake? Na je, nafasi bado inanusurika ikiwa kusimamisha kutajazwa vibaya kuliko kiwango chake katika msogeo wa haraka?
