1014c061d2a0.en: Suppose the required ratio is 150 percent. You lock 300 dollars of ETH and mint 200 DAI — exactly 150 percent. ETH then falls 20 percent, so your collateral is worth 240 dollars and your ratio is 120 percent — below the requirement. The protocol liquidates you automatically: your ETH is auctioned to buy back and retire the 200 DAI, plus a liquidation penalty (around 13 percent on many collateral types, so roughly 226 dollars of your collateral is consumed), and the small remainder is returned to you. No court, no phone call — code.
1014c061d2a0.sw: Tuseme uwiano unaohitajika ni asilimia 150. Unafungia dola 300 za ETH na kutengeneza DAI 200 — hasa asilimia 150. ETH kisha inashuka asilimia 20, kwa hivyo dhamana yako ina thamani ya dola 240 na uwiano wako ni asilimia 120 — chini ya hitaji. Itifaki hukufilisi kiotomatiki: ETH yako hupigwa mnada kununua tena na kustaafisha DAI 200, pamoja na adhabu ya ufilisi (takriban asilimia 13 katika aina nyingi za dhamana, kwa hivyo takriban dola 226 za dhamana yako hutumika), na kilichobaki kidogo hurudishwa kwako. Hakuna mahakama, hakuna simu — msimbo.

102903ec54a5.en: Take a 10,000 dollar account, risking 1% (100 dollars), with a 50-pip stop-loss. On USD/JPY, true pip value is 6.67 dollars, so the correct size is 100 / (50 x 6.67) = 0.30 standard lots. If you had used the 10-dollar shortcut, you would have traded 0.20 lots — and actually risked only 0.20 x 50 x 6.67 = 66.70 dollars. You under-sized: your real risk was two-thirds of what you intended, quietly leaving return on the table. On EUR/GBP, true pip value is 12.70 dollars, so the correct size is 100 / (50 x 12.70) = 0.157 standard lots. Using the 10-dollar shortcut would have given 0.20 lots — and a real risk of 0.20 x 50 x 12.70 = 127 dollars. You over-sized: you risked 27% more than the 1% you decided on.
102903ec54a5.sw: Chukua akaunti ya dola 10,000, ukihatarisha 1% (dola 100), yenye stop-loss ya pip 50. Kwenye USD/JPY, thamani halisi ya pip ni dola 6.67, hivyo ukubwa sahihi ni 100 / (50 x 6.67) = lot 0.30 sanifu. Kama ungetumia njia ya mkato ya dola 10, ungefanya biashara ya lot 0.20 — na kwa kweli ungehatarisha dola 0.20 x 50 x 6.67 = 66.70 tu. Ulipima chini: hatari yako halisi ilikuwa theluthi mbili ya uliyokusudia, ukiacha faida mezani kimyakimya. Kwenye EUR/GBP, thamani halisi ya pip ni dola 12.70, hivyo ukubwa sahihi ni 100 / (50 x 12.70) = lot 0.157 sanifu. Kutumia njia ya mkato ya dola 10 kungetoa lot 0.20 — na hatari halisi ya 0.20 x 50 x 12.70 = dola 127. Ulipima juu: ulihatarisha 27% zaidi ya 1% uliyoiamua.

108ce4510612.en: Correct - the adverse move to liquidation is approximately 1 divided by leverage minus the maintenance margin rate: 2% minus 0.4% = 1.6%, so liquidation sits at 100,000 x (1 - 0.02 + 0.004) = 98,400 dollars. Bitcoin's one-day standard deviation at the 46% annualised figure this chapter uses is about 2.41%, so 1.6% is well inside a normal day's wandering.
108ce4510612.sw: Sahihi - msogeo mbaya hadi ufilisi ni takriban 1 ikigawanywa na mzingo ukiondoa kiwango cha mkopo wa kudumisha: 2% ukiondoa 0.4% = 1.6%, kwa hivyo ufilisi hukaa katika 100,000 x (1 - 0.02 + 0.004) = dola 98,400. Mkengeuko wa kawaida wa siku moja wa Bitcoin katika takwimu ya 46% kwa mwaka ambayo sura hii huitumia ni takriban 2.41%, kwa hivyo 1.6% iko ndani sana ya kutangatanga kwa siku ya kawaida.

10dfe29ca4b0.en: Here's the demystifying truth: MACD is measuring how two moving averages converge and diverge — which is exactly what you just learned to see directly on the chart with the 20/50 pair. When people talk about MACD crossovers, they're talking about the same underlying event as a moving-average crossover, expressed as an oscillating line below the chart instead of two lines on it. If you understand the crossover section, you already understand MACD. Some traders prefer its presentation (the histogram makes momentum shifts visually loud); others just read the averages directly. There is no extra information in it that the moving averages don't contain.
10dfe29ca4b0.sw: Huu hapa ukweli unaoondoa fumbo: MACD inapima jinsi wastani wawili unaosogea wanavyoungana na kutengana — ambacho ndicho hasa umejifunza kuona moja kwa moja kwenye chati kwa jozi la 20/50. Watu wanapozungumzia mikatizo ya MACD, wanazungumzia tukio lile lile la msingi kama mkatizo wa wastani unaosogea, likielezwa kama mstari unaoyumba chini ya chati badala ya mistari miwili juu yake. Kama unaelewa sehemu ya mkatizo, tayari unaelewa MACD. Baadhi ya wafanyabiashara hupendelea uwasilishaji wake (histogram hufanya mabadiliko ya kasi yaonekane wazi); wengine husoma tu wastani moja kwa moja. Hakuna taarifa ya ziada ndani yake ambayo wastani unaosogea hauna.

11588b5bc778.en: Holding shares in your own employer stacks two exposures on one event. If the company fails you lose the job and the holding in the same week, at the moment you most need savings. Chapter 2 warned about correlated holdings; this is the most concentrated correlation available, and it is common because employers encourage it. Treat employer shares as part of your position sizing, not as a separate benefit.

11616abf2f6c.en: The reported liquidation total is a floor, not a measurement, and the data providers say so themselves. CoinGlass has stated that Binance's public liquidation feed transmits only one liquidation order per second per contract, so during a burst the great majority of forced closures never enter the public data at all. CoinGlass put the resulting undercount at 10 to 20 times for that venue, and Hyperliquid's co-founder suggested it could be worse under some conditions. Estimates of the true October 2025 total run to 30 to 40 billion dollars. Treat every published liquidation figure, including the ones in this lesson, as the visible part of a larger number.
11616abf2f6c.sw: Jumla ya ufilisi iliyoripotiwa ni sakafu, si kipimo, na watoa data wenyewe husema hivyo. CoinGlass imesema kwamba mtiririko wa umma wa ufilisi wa Binance husambaza agizo moja tu la ufilisi kwa sekunde kwa kila mkataba, kwa hivyo wakati wa mlipuko sehemu kubwa mno ya kufungwa kwa lazima haiingii kabisa katika data ya umma. CoinGlass iliweka upungufu wa hesabu unaotokana na hilo katika mara 10 hadi 20 kwa uwanja huo, na mwanzilishi mwenza wa Hyperliquid alidokeza kingeweza kuwa kibaya zaidi chini ya hali fulani. Makadirio ya jumla halisi ya Oktoba 2025 hufikia dola bilioni 30 hadi 40. Chukulia kila takwimu ya ufilisi iliyochapishwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na zile zilizo katika somo hili, kama sehemu inayoonekana ya namba kubwa zaidi.

1260f26736e8.en: This reframes "free money" everywhere it appears in trading. A strategy that pays a little, reliably, for a long time, with rare but severe blow-ups, is not beating the market — it is being paid a premium for a risk that has not shown up yet. The forward premium puzzle from Chapter 2, Lesson 3 explains why the trade works at all; this crash risk explains what you are really being paid for.

Fumbo la malipo ya mbele kutoka Sura ya 2, Somo la 3 hueleza kwa nini biashara hufanya kazi kabisa; hatari hii ya kuanguka hueleza unalipwa kwa ajili ya nini hasa.

12694eda5ae1.en: What to look for when a market event becomes a story. Find out whether a regulator or exchange published an examination of it, since these exist more often than people expect and are usually free. Notice whether the popular explanation was formed before or after any data was available — for this episode it was formed within days, and the data took nine months. Ask who benefits from each version of the story. And keep the mechanism separate from the narrative: the settlement plumbing explains the restrictions completely, and it is the part of the episode nobody had a motive to publicise.

Tambua kama maelezo maarufu yaliundwa kabla au baada ya data yoyote kupatikana — kwa tukio hili yaliundwa ndani ya siku chache, na data ilichukua miezi tisa. Uliza ni nani ananufaika na kila toleo la hadithi. Na weka utaratibu tofauti na simulizi: mifereji ya utimizaji hueleza vizuizi kabisa, nayo ndiyo sehemu ya tukio ambayo hakuna aliyekuwa na sababu ya kuitangaza.

12ac93ee5f0d.en: The power of the pre-mortem is psychological. Once you have committed to a thesis, you are motivated to see it work, and that motivation quietly blinds you to its weaknesses — the overconfidence of Chapter 4, Lesson 1. Assuming failure flips the incentive: now your goal is to find problems, and you find far more than you would by asking "what could go wrong?" in the abstract.

Kudhania kushindwa hugeuza motisha: sasa lengo lako ni kupata matatizo, na unapata mengi zaidi kuliko ungepata kwa kuuliza "ni nini kingeweza kwenda vibaya?" kwa ujumla.

1334f2b69fc9.en: A 1% fee does not take 1%. Over 30 years it takes about a sixth of everything you end up with. The reason is that the fee is charged on the whole balance every year, including on the growth that previous years' fees already prevented. The gap compounds alongside the portfolio, in the opposite direction.

134353d843d4.en: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling & Schrimpf (2012), published in The Journal of Finance, showed that carry trade returns are strongly tied to global foreign-exchange volatility. The strategy earns steady profits in calm periods — then suffers sharp, correlated losses precisely when global volatility spikes (crises, panics). In other words, carry trade returns behave like compensation for taking on crash risk, not a free lunch. The interest edge is real, but you're being paid to hold a currency that can drop violently at the worst possible moment — a direct, real-world echo of the fat-tails warning from Lesson 2 and the SNB collapse from Chapter 1.
134353d843d4.sw: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling & Schrimpf (2012), waliochapisha katika The Journal of Finance, walionyesha kwamba faida za carry trade zimefungwa kwa nguvu na mtikisiko wa fedha za kigeni duniani. Mkakati hupata faida thabiti katika vipindi tulivu — kisha hupata hasara kali na zenye uwiano hasa mtikisiko wa kimataifa unapopanda ghafla (majanga, hofu). Kwa maneno mengine, faida za carry trade hutenda kama fidia kwa kuchukua hatari ya kuanguka, si chakula cha bure. Faida ya riba ni halisi, lakini unalipwa kushikilia sarafu inayoweza kushuka kwa nguvu wakati mbaya zaidi unaowezekana — mwangwi wa moja kwa moja wa dunia halisi wa onyo la mikia minene kutoka Somo la 2 na kuanguka kwa SNB kutoka Sura ya 1.

14b66db29de9.en: Market cap is not money that went in. A 200,000,000 dollar market cap does not mean investors put 200,000,000 dollars into the asset. It does not mean 200,000,000 dollars could come out. It means one recent trade happened at a price, and that price was multiplied by the supply. When a news article says 1 billion dollars was wiped off the crypto market today, it is describing a multiplication changing, not a billion dollars leaving anyone's pocket.
14b66db29de9.sw: Kiasi cha soko si pesa iliyoingia. Kiasi cha soko cha dola 200,000,000 hakimaanishi wawekezaji waliweka dola 200,000,000 katika rasilimali. Hakimaanishi dola 200,000,000 zingeweza kutoka. Humaanisha biashara moja ya hivi karibuni ilitokea katika bei, na bei hiyo ilizidishwa na usambazaji. Makala ya habari inaposema dola bilioni 1 zilifutwa kutoka soko la kripto leo, inaelezea kuzidisha kunakobadilika, si bilioni ya dola inayoondoka mfukoni mwa mtu.

150f0619969f.en: The lower bound comes from a legal arrangement most people never think about, and it is not a natural feature of ownership. If you own a corner shop outright and it fails owing money, the creditors can pursue you personally. If you own shares in a company that fails owing money, they cannot.
150f0619969f.sw: Kikomo cha chini hutoka kwenye mpangilio wa kisheria ambao watu wengi hawakuwahi kuufikiria, na si sifa ya asili ya umiliki. Kama unamiliki duka la kona kabisa na likashindwa likidaiwa pesa, wadai wanaweza kukufuata binafsi. Kama unamiliki hisa katika kampuni iliyoshindwa ikidaiwa pesa, hawawezi.

1517803c69c1.en: Trader A wins 40% of trades at 1:2. Out of 10 trades, 4 wins pay 2R each (+8R) and 6 losses cost 1R each (-6R), for +2R overall — a profit, from being wrong more often than right. Trader B wins 60% at 1:1: 6 wins (+6R) and 4 losses (-4R) also make +2R. Same result from opposite-looking records. Now Trader C wins 70% of trades but takes profits half the size of the risk (1:0.5): 7 wins pay 0.5R each (+3.5R) and 3 losses cost 1R each (-3R), for just +0.5R over 10 trades. Trader C is right far more often than A or B and makes a quarter as much.
1517803c69c1.sw: Mfanyabiashara A hushinda 40% ya biashara kwa 1:2. Kati ya biashara 10, ushindi 4 hulipa 2R kila moja (+8R) na hasara 6 hugharimu 1R kila moja (-6R), kwa +2R kwa jumla — faida, kutokana na kukosea mara nyingi zaidi kuliko kuwa sahihi. Mfanyabiashara B hushinda 60% kwa 1:1: ushindi 6 (+6R) na hasara 4 (-4R) pia hufanya +2R. Tokeo lile lile kutoka rekodi zinazoonekana za kinyume. Sasa Mfanyabiashara C hushinda 70% ya biashara lakini huchukua faida za nusu ya ukubwa wa hatari (1:0.5): ushindi 7 hulipa 0.5R kila moja (+3.5R) na hasara 3 hugharimu 1R kila moja (-3R), kwa +0.5R tu katika biashara 10. Mfanyabiashara C ni sahihi mara nyingi zaidi mno kuliko A au B na hupata robo moja ya kiasi.

152c130f3d0c.en: Both can exist for the same pattern. The question is never just "does it work" — it's "how do I know, and how sure can I actually be?"
152c130f3d0c.sw: Zote mbili zinaweza kuwepo kwa mtindo ule ule. Swali si tu "je, inafanya kazi" kamwe — ni "ninajuaje, na ninaweza kuwa na uhakika kiasi gani hasa?"

153d3cb1f12f.en: But the slogan is silent about the other side of the ledger, and the other side is also well documented. Self-custody has its own body count — measured in keys, not counterparties. The scale first, stated as carefully as the data allows. In a June 2020 analysis, the blockchain-data firm Chainalysis estimated that roughly 3.7 million bitcoin — about 20% of all coins in existence at the time — had not moved in five years or more, and were likely lost. Treat that number as an estimate, not a fact. Its method is dormancy: coins that have not moved for years are assumed lost, but the blockchain cannot distinguish a destroyed key from a patient holder, so the true figure is unknowable by nature. What the estimate honestly supports is the direction: the amount of crypto permanently stranded by lost keys is not an edge case. It is a meaningful share of everything ever created.
153d3cb1f12f.sw: Lakini kauli hiyo inanyamaza kuhusu upande mwingine wa leja, na upande mwingine pia umeandikwa vizuri. Utunzaji binafsi una idadi yake ya waliokufa — inayopimwa kwa funguo, si washirika. Kiwango kwanza, kikitajwa kwa uangalifu kadiri data inavyoruhusu. Katika uchambuzi wa Juni 2020, kampuni ya data ya mnyororo wa vitalu Chainalysis ilikadiria kwamba takriban bitcoin milioni 3.7 — takriban 20% ya sarafu zote zilizokuwepo wakati huo — hazikuwa zimesogea kwa miaka mitano au zaidi, na pengine zilikuwa zimepotea. Chukulia namba hiyo kama makadirio, si ukweli. Mbinu yake ni ulala: sarafu ambazo hazijasogea kwa miaka hudhaniwa zimepotea, lakini mnyororo wa vitalu hauwezi kutofautisha ufunguo ulioharibiwa na mmiliki mvumilivu, kwa hivyo takwimu halisi haijulikani kwa asili. Kile ambacho makadirio huunga mkono kwa ukweli ni mwelekeo: kiasi cha kripto kilichokwama kabisa kwa funguo zilizopotea si kesi ya pembeni. Ni sehemu yenye maana ya kila kilichowahi kuundwa.

153f331497ed.en: Correct — exotic pairs combine a major currency with a smaller or emerging-market currency — lower liquidity, wider spreads, more volatility.
153f331497ed.sw: Sahihi — jozi adimu huunganisha sarafu kuu na sarafu ya uchumi mdogo au unaoibukia — ukwasi mdogo, spread pana zaidi, mtikisiko zaidi.

15447beaefd0.en: Look up any share you follow and record the bid, the ask and the last price at two moments: shortly after the market opens, and in the middle of the session. Calculate the spread as a percentage of the midpoint each time. The difference between the two readings is a cost you would have paid without ever seeing it itemised.
15447beaefd0.sw: Tafuta hisa yoyote unayoifuatilia na urekodi bid, ask na bei ya mwisho katika nyakati mbili: muda mfupi baada ya soko kufunguliwa, na katikati ya kipindi. Kokotoa spread kama asilimia ya sehemu ya kati kila mara. Tofauti kati ya usomaji hizo mbili ni gharama ambayo ungeilipa bila kuiona ikiorodheshwa kamwe.

154c3029d72a.en: A blockchain is batches of transactions chained together by hash fingerprints — editing any old block breaks every link after it, and hiding the break means redoing all that work while the honest chain keeps growing. "Immutable" is economics, not magic.
154c3029d72a.sw: Mnyororo wa vitalu ni makundi ya miamala yaliyounganishwa pamoja kwa alama za vidole za heshi — kuhariri kitalu chochote cha zamani huvunja kila kiungo kinachofuata, na kuficha uvunjifu humaanisha kurudia kazi hiyo yote huku mnyororo mwaminifu ukiendelea kukua. "Isiyobadilika" ni uchumi, si uchawi.

156fb85d16b8.en: The funding rate on a Bitcoin perpetual swap has been strongly positive for two weeks. What does that tell you?
156fb85d16b8.sw: Kiwango cha ufadhili katika ubadilishano wa kudumu wa Bitcoin kimekuwa chanya kwa nguvu kwa wiki mbili. Hilo linakuambia nini?

1575dfccbc6a.en: Ghanem, Harasheh, Sbaih & Ajmal (2024), published in Cogent Business & Management — genuinely recent research — tested 497 technical trading rules across 10 currencies over 22 years (2000–2022). Technical trading rules significantly predicted price movements in both developed and emerging-market currencies, with emerging markets showing even higher predictability.
1575dfccbc6a.sw: Ghanem, Harasheh, Sbaih & Ajmal (2024), waliochapisha katika Cogent Business & Management — utafiti wa hivi karibuni kweli — walijaribu kanuni 497 za biashara za kiufundi katika sarafu 10 kwa miaka 22 (2000–2022). Kanuni za biashara za kiufundi zilitabiri msogeo wa bei kwa kiasi kikubwa katika sarafu za nchi zilizoendelea na za masoko yanayoibukia, ambapo masoko yanayoibukia yalionyesha utabirikaji wa juu zaidi.

159fa79493d9.en: Most attention in investing goes to what to buy. Position size — how much of it — does more to determine outcomes, and unlike the first question it has an answer you can actually compute.
159fa79493d9.sw: Umakini mwingi katika uwekezaji huenda kwa cha kununua. Ukubwa wa nafasi — kiasi gani chake — hufanya zaidi kuamua matokeo, na tofauti na swali la kwanza lina jibu unaloweza kulikokotoa hasa.

15ae413077e4.en: Information that is material and not public would reliably beat the market. Trading on it is also illegal in every developed market, and prosecutions are routine. This matters to the argument rather than to your conduct: the one form of information advantage that clearly works is the one the law removes from the available set, which is part of why the remaining edges are so thin.
15ae413077e4.sw: Taarifa zilizo muhimu na zisizo za umma zingeshinda soko kwa kutegemewa. Kufanya biashara juu yake pia ni kinyume cha sheria katika kila soko lililoendelea, na mashtaka ni ya kawaida. Hili linahusu hoja badala ya mwenendo wako: umbo moja la faida ya taarifa linaloonekana kufanya kazi ndilo ambalo sheria hulitoa kwenye seti inayopatikana, ambayo ni sehemu ya sababu faida zilizobaki ni nyembamba hivyo.

15c07569968c.en: Correct — Mt. Gox and FTX show counterparty risk on one end; millions of bitcoin stranded by lost keys show loss risk on the other. Self-custody transfers every custodial job to you, and whether that improves your position depends on amount, horizon, and demonstrated competence.
15c07569968c.sw: Sahihi — Mt. Gox na FTX huonyesha hatari ya mshirika upande mmoja; mamilioni ya bitcoin zilizokwama kwa funguo zilizopotea huonyesha hatari ya hasara upande mwingine. Utunzaji binafsi huhamisha kila kazi ya utunzaji kwako, na kama hilo linaboresha msimamo wako hutegemea kiasi, upeo, na uwezo ulioonyeshwa.

15cc1c6242e1.en: Your account is 5,000 dollars and your rule is 1% risk. Bitcoin trades at 60,000 dollars with a daily ATR of 1,900 dollars, and you set a stop at 2 x ATR. What position size does the formula give?
15cc1c6242e1.sw: Akaunti yako ni dola 5,000 na kanuni yako ni hatari ya 1%. Bitcoin hufanyiwa biashara katika dola 60,000 ikiwa na ATR ya kila siku ya dola 1,900, nawe unaweka kusimamisha katika mara 2 ya ATR. Fomula hutoa ukubwa gani wa nafasi?

15de1a7f59e9.en: Concentration is not automatically wrong. It is the only way to substantially beat an index, and every investor who has done so was concentrated in something. The trade-off is symmetrical and should be stated plainly: concentration raises the range of outcomes in both directions.
15de1a7f59e9.sw: Kujikita si kubaya kiotomatiki. Ndiyo njia pekee ya kushinda index kwa kiasi kikubwa, na kila mwekezaji aliyefanya hivyo alikuwa amejikita katika kitu. Mchanganyiko una usawa na unapaswa kuelezwa wazi: kujikita huongeza wigo wa matokeo pande zote mbili.

15eaeb0e4b07.en: A general decline in prices across an economy over time — the opposite of inflation — which can deepen a recession by encouraging people to delay spending.
15eaeb0e4b07.sw: Kushuka kwa jumla kwa bei katika uchumi kwa muda — kinyume cha mfumuko wa bei — ambako kunaweza kuzidisha mdororo kwa kuwahamasisha watu kuahirisha matumizi.

1601006d5fbe.en: Correct. Cap weighting tells you what the typical unit of money did; equal weighting tells you what the typical company did. When a small number of very large companies lead, those two answers diverge — and the headline always quotes the first.
1601006d5fbe.sw: Sahihi. Uzito wa mtaji hukuambia kipimo cha kawaida cha pesa kilifanya nini; uzito sawa hukuambia kampuni ya kawaida ilifanya nini. Idadi ndogo ya kampuni kubwa mno inapoongoza, majibu hayo mawili hutofautiana — na kichwa cha habari daima hunukuu la kwanza.

160797f42d44.en: Not quite. The evidence does not support total avoidance, nor a core holding, nor active trading as the default — Chapter 6 Lesson 1 noted the process mostly tells you when not to have a position. It supports a small slice you could lose entirely, governed by rules written in advance.
160797f42d44.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ushahidi hauungi mkono kuepuka kabisa, wala umiliki mkuu, wala kufanya biashara kwa bidii kama chaguo-msingi — Sura ya 6 Somo la 1 lilibainisha mchakato hasa hukuambia lini usiwe na nafasi. Huunga mkono kipande kidogo ambacho ungeweza kukipoteza kabisa, kinachotawaliwa na kanuni zilizoandikwa mapema.

160858ca1d64.sw: Kusambaza Uwekezaji — Kwa Nini "Usiweke Mayai Yako Yote Kwenye Kikapu Kimoja" Inaweza Kupimwa

16329772f931.en: Correct — since the London upgrade of August 2021, the protocol-set base fee is burned, and only the optional priority fee (the tip) goes to the validator. The tip is where the fee auction now operates when blocks are contested.

1633344d8c3b.en: A sensible annual review takes an hour. List every approval each wallet has granted and revoke the ones no longer used. Check every exchange balance against the cap and move the excess. Actually access each wallet rather than assuming you can. Confirm the recovery material is where the plan says, and that at least one other person knows the holdings exist.
1633344d8c3b.sw: Ukaguzi wa kila mwaka wenye maana huchukua saa moja. Orodhesha kila idhini ambayo kila pochi imeitoa na ubatilishe zile zisizotumika tena. Kagua kila salio la soko la kubadilisha dhidi ya dari na usogeze ziada. Fikia kila pochi hasa badala ya kudhania unaweza. Thibitisha nyenzo za urejeshaji ziko pale mpango unaposema, na kwamba angalau mtu mmoja mwingine anajua umiliki upo.

164136b281f5.en: Because withdrawal fees were about to increase
164136b281f5.sw: Kwa sababu ada za utoaji zilikuwa karibu kupanda

16570b6302f1.sw: Bei ya sarafu moja iliyoelezwa kwa sarafu nyingine.

16aba5e87987.en: These two families make opposite bets. A mean-reversion tool in a strong trend loses repeatedly ("it's stretched!" — it stretches further). A trend-following tool in a sideways market whipsaws to death. Neither tool is broken in those moments — it's being asked the wrong question. Diagnosing which kind of market you're in is the judgment that sits above every indicator, and no indicator can make it for you — which is exactly where this chapter goes next.
16aba5e87987.sw: Familia hizi mbili hufanya mabashiri ya kinyume. Zana ya kurudi kwa wastani katika mwelekeo mkali hupoteza mara kwa mara ("imenyooshwa!" — inanyooka zaidi). Zana ya kufuata mwelekeo katika soko la kando hujipiga whipsaw hadi kufa. Hakuna zana iliyoharibika katika nyakati hizo — inaulizwa swali lisilo sahihi. Kubaini ni aina gani ya soko uliomo ndiyo hukumu inayokaa juu ya kila kiashiria, na hakuna kiashiria kinachoweza kuifanya kwa niaba yako — ambako ndiko hasa sura hii inakoenda baadaye.

16c5574f370f.sw: Hoja ya mwisho kuhusu kile ambacho muongo wa kesi ulihusisha hasa, kwa sababu ndiyo sehemu ambayo hakuna anayeipangia.

16da2e947f12.en: Everything that changes in crypto lives in the denominator. Your risk per trade stays at 1% to 2% of the account, exactly as before, because that number is a statement about your survival and not about the asset. What changes is how far away a sensible stop has to sit — and because the stop distance is divided into your risk budget, a wider stop mechanically produces a smaller position. Not a slightly smaller one. In the example computed later in this lesson, it is smaller by a factor of about 14.
16da2e947f12.sw: Kila kinachobadilika katika kripto huishi katika kigawanyaji. Hatari yako kwa kila biashara hubaki katika 1% hadi 2% ya akaunti, hasa kama awali, kwa sababu namba hiyo ni kauli kuhusu kunusurika kwako na si kuhusu rasilimali. Kinachobadilika ni umbali ambao kusimamisha kwenye maana lazima kukae — na kwa sababu umbali wa kusimamisha hugawanywa katika bajeti yako ya hatari, kusimamisha kupana huzalisha kimitambo nafasi ndogo zaidi. Si ndogo kidogo. Katika mfano uliohesabiwa baadaye katika somo hili, ni ndogo kwa kipengele cha takriban 14.

16de51aca60e.en: The distance from entry to liquidation is roughly 1 divided by leverage. At 25x it is about one average daily bar away; at 50x and 100x it is a fraction of one.
16de51aca60e.sw: Umbali kutoka kuingia hadi ufilisi ni takriban 1 ikigawanywa na mzingo. Katika 25x ni takriban mstari mmoja wa wastani wa kila siku mbali; katika 50x na 100x ni sehemu ya mmoja.

17004f141195.en: Put the pieces together and the rule is simple and strict: the entire exit plan is written before the position exists.
17004f141195.sw: Unganisha vipande na kanuni ni rahisi na kali: mpango mzima wa kutoka umeandikwa kabla nafasi haijawepo.

171e9784f9d7.en: This is the practical meaning of counterparty risk in an industry where the counterparties are counterparties to each other. Knowing where your assets sit is necessary and insufficient; you also need to know what the institution holding them does with them, and in most cases that information is not published. Where it is not published, the cap from Chapter 4 Lesson 3 is the only defence available.
171e9784f9d7.sw: Hii ndiyo maana ya kivitendo ya hatari ya mshirika katika tasnia ambapo washirika ni washirika kwa kila mmoja. Kujua rasilimali zako zinapokaa ni lazima na hakutoshi; unahitaji pia kujua taasisi inayozishikilia hufanya nini nazo, na katika kesi nyingi taarifa hiyo haichapishwi. Pale isipochapishwa, dari kutoka Sura ya 4 Somo la 3 ndio ulinzi pekee unaopatikana.

17323e732c04.en: If you hold global equities but spend in a different currency, your return has two parts: what the shares did, and what the currency did. A year in which global markets rose 8% and your home currency strengthened 8% is a flat year for you. The shares performed exactly as reported, and none of it reached you.
17323e732c04.sw: Ikiwa unashikilia hisa za kimataifa lakini unatumia sarafu tofauti, faida yako ina sehemu mbili: hisa zilifanya nini, na sarafu ilifanya nini. Mwaka ambao masoko ya kimataifa yalipanda 8% na sarafu ya nyumbani ikaimarika 8% ni mwaka tuli kwako. Hisa zilifanya kazi hasa kama ilivyoripotiwa, na hakuna kati yake kilichokufikia.

1774c7266da4.en: Jegadeesh and Titman, in Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers, published in the Journal of Finance in 1993, found that buying stocks that had performed well over the previous three to twelve months and selling those that had performed badly produced significant positive returns over similar holding periods. They also found that part of the abnormal return dissipated over the following two years — the effect is real and it is not permanent.
1774c7266da4.sw: Jegadeesh na Titman, katika Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers, iliyochapishwa katika Journal of Finance mwaka 1993, walibaini kuwa kununua hisa zilizofanya vizuri katika miezi mitatu hadi kumi na miwili iliyopita na kuuza zile zilizofanya vibaya kulizalisha faida chanya kubwa katika vipindi vinavyofanana vya kushikilia. Pia walibaini kwamba sehemu ya faida isiyo ya kawaida ilitoweka katika miaka miwili iliyofuata — athari ni ya kweli nayo si ya kudumu.

177b705bbbfe.en: Correct — no surprise means the outcome was already priced in. Big moves come from the gap between actual and forecast, not from the event happening.
177b705bbbfe.sw: Sahihi — kutokuwa na mshangao kunamaanisha tokeo tayari lilikuwa limewekewa bei. Misogeo mikubwa hutoka kwenye pengo kati ya halisi na utabiri, si kutokana na tukio kutokea.

178e959cdd6f.en: Not quite. Withdrawals were already halted by 7 February, and holding several different coins would not have helped — they would all have been at the same venue. The difference was a rule set in advance, not superior judgement or timing.
178e959cdd6f.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Utoaji ulikuwa tayari umesimamishwa kufikia 7 Februari, na kushikilia sarafu kadhaa tofauti kusingesaidia — zote zingekuwa katika uwanja uleule. Tofauti ilikuwa kanuni iliyowekwa mapema, si hukumu bora au muda.

179894110be6.en: This is why the course keeps insisting that execution and risk control matter more than prediction. Two defences would have softened this: trading the pound during liquid hours rather than holding naked exposure through the thinnest part of the night, and sizing so that even a violent, illiquid spike against you is survivable. Neither requires predicting the crash — only respecting that liquidity and timing are real risks, not background details.
179894110be6.sw: Ndiyo sababu kozi inaendelea kusisitiza kwamba utekelezaji na udhibiti wa hatari vinahusika zaidi kuliko utabiri. Kinga mbili zingelilainisha hili: kufanya biashara ya pauni wakati wa saa zenye ukwasi badala ya kushikilia uwazi wazi katika sehemu nyembamba zaidi ya usiku, na kupima ili hata mwiba mkali wa soko lisilo na ukwasi dhidi yako uweze kunusurika. Hakuna kati yao kinachohitaji kutabiri anguko — kuheshimu tu kwamba ukwasi na muda ni hatari halisi, si maelezo ya nyuma.

179fc1455fce.en: Asking why — it can be ordinary growth in a business that bills before collecting, or sales booked to customers who may not pay
179fc1455fce.sw: Kuuliza kwa nini — kunaweza kuwa ukuaji wa kawaida katika biashara inayotuma bili kabla ya kukusanya, au mauzo yaliyorekodiwa kwa wateja wasioweza kulipa

17a7ccaeeb93.en: The market strongly expects a central bank to raise rates by 0.5%. The bank raises by only 0.25%. What's the most likely reaction in that currency?
17a7ccaeeb93.sw: Soko linatarajia kwa nguvu benki kuu ipandishe viwango kwa 0.5%. Benki inapandisha kwa 0.25% tu. Ni mwitikio upi unaowezekana zaidi katika sarafu hiyo?

17b572ff2c4c.en: The tendency of separate markets to move together far more closely during sharp falls than during normal or rising periods.
17b572ff2c4c.sw: Mwelekeo wa masoko tofauti kusonga pamoja kwa ukaribu zaidi wakati wa kushuka kwa kasi kuliko wakati wa vipindi vya kawaida au vinavyopanda.

17d06133d14a.en: Take any company whose shares you could buy. Find its most recent annual figures and write down four numbers: revenue, total costs, interest paid, and what remained. Then write down what a 10% fall in revenue would do to the last number if the first three were unchanged. That single calculation explains more about why the share price moves than any chart you will look at this month.
17d06133d14a.sw: Chukua kampuni yoyote ambayo ungeweza kununua hisa zake. Pata takwimu zake za hivi karibuni za mwaka na uandike namba nne: mapato, gharama za jumla, riba iliyolipwa, na kilichobaki. Kisha andika kushuka kwa 10% kwa mapato kungefanya nini kwa namba ya mwisho kama tatu za kwanza zingebaki bila kubadilika. Hesabu hiyo moja hueleza zaidi kuhusu kwa nini bei ya hisa husogea kuliko chati yoyote utakayoitazama mwezi huu.

17d0eb7147b2.en: Two linked orders where one executing cancels the other.
17d0eb7147b2.sw: Maagizo mawili yaliyounganishwa ambapo moja likitekelezwa hufuta lingine.

17d5f1a002b7.sw: Kampuni kubwa ya kifedha inayoruhusiwa kuunda hisa mpya za ETF au kukomboa zilizopo kwa kufanya biashara moja kwa moja na fund.

17e898c2c888.en: Fraud is a scheme designed so that the operator gains and you lose. Risk is a genuine activity that can lose money because the activity itself can fail.
17e898c2c888.sw: Udanganyifu ni mpango ulioundwa ili mwendeshaji apate na wewe upoteze. Hatari ni shughuli halisi inayoweza kupoteza pesa kwa sababu shughuli yenyewe inaweza kushindwa.

17e8e71a80af.en: That action is close to unbearable in the moment and it is why the rule has to exist in writing beforehand. Chapter 4 Lesson 3 makes the same point in the abstract. In March 2009 the abstract version and the lived version were very far apart, and only the people with the rule already written found the decision available to them.
17e8e71a80af.sw: Hatua hiyo ni karibu isiyovumilika wakati huo nayo ndiyo sababu kanuni lazima iwepo kwa maandishi kabla. Sura ya 4 Somo la 3 hutoa hoja hiyohiyo kinadharia. Mwezi Machi 2009 toleo la kinadharia na toleo la kuishi lilikuwa mbali sana, na ni watu waliokuwa tayari na kanuni iliyoandikwa pekee ndio waliopata uamuzi huo unapatikana kwao.

17fd25fcd972.en: True or False: according to Heimer and Simsek's (2019) study, capping leverage for US retail forex traders had no measurable effect on trader outcomes.
17fd25fcd972.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kwa mujibu wa utafiti wa Heimer na Simsek (2019), kuweka kikomo cha leverage kwa wafanyabiashara wa forex wa rejareja wa Marekani hakukuwa na athari yoyote inayopimika kwa matokeo ya wafanyabiashara.

17fd65d97d78.en: Giving every company in the index the same weight regardless of its size or share price, and restoring those weights periodically.
17fd65d97d78.sw: Kutoa kila kampuni katika index uzito ule ule bila kujali ukubwa wake au bei ya hisa, na kurejesha uzito huo mara kwa mara.

180adbc16e41.en: A note on time horizon, since this is the last chance to say it.
180adbc16e41.sw: Noti kuhusu upeo wa muda, kwa kuwa hii ndiyo nafasi ya mwisho ya kuisema.

180d374c4f78.en: Change the weighting rule and the same three companies tell three different stories.
180d374c4f78.sw: Badilisha kanuni ya uzito na kampuni zile zile tatu husimulia simulizi tatu tofauti.

1825af246dff.en: The most common method weights each company by its market value, so bigger companies move the index more.
1825af246dff.sw: Mbinu ya kawaida zaidi hutoa uzito kwa kila kampuni kwa thamani yake ya soko, hivyo kampuni kubwa zaidi husogeza index zaidi.

1838a6116cfd.en: The pound fell about 6% in two minutes with no major news, driven by thin overnight liquidity and a stop-and-algorithm cascade — showing that execution and liquidity risk can hurt you even when your direction is right.
1838a6116cfd.sw: Pauni ilishuka takriban 6% ndani ya dakika mbili bila habari kuu, ikiendeshwa na ukwasi mdogo wa usiku na mfululizo wa stop na algoriti — ikionyesha kwamba hatari ya utekelezaji na ukwasi inaweza kukuumiza hata mwelekeo wako ukiwa sahihi.

1843d9294ade.en: They were destroyed with the phone and are gone
1843d9294ade.sw: Ziliharibiwa pamoja na simu nazo zimeenda

184488b58eca.en: What to look for in your own record. Check whether your purchases cluster after strong periods, which is the honest test of performance chasing. Check whether the funds you trade most are also the narrowest, since that is where every study finds the gap. Check whether your contributions are automatic or discretionary. And treat any advertised return as a statement about the people who owned the fund before you.
184488b58eca.sw: Cha kuangalia katika rekodi yako mwenyewe. Kagua kama manunuzi yako hujikusanya baada ya vipindi vya nguvu, ambao ndio mtihani wa kweli wa kufuatilia utendaji. Kagua kama mifuko unayoifanyia biashara zaidi ndiyo pia iliyo finyu zaidi, kwa kuwa hapo ndipo kila utafiti hupata pengo. Kagua kama michango yako ni ya kiotomatiki au ya hiari. Na chukulia faida yoyote inayotangazwa kama kauli kuhusu watu waliomiliki mfuko kabla yako.

1858155a18c4.en: Exchange flows are the most heavily traded-on on-chain metric, and the clearest case of a number that underdetermines its own interpretation. The standard story goes: coins leaving exchanges means investors are moving to self-custody to hold long term, which is bullish. Coins arriving at exchanges means investors are preparing to sell, which is bearish.
1858155a18c4.sw: Mitiririko ya masoko ya kubadilisha ndicho kipimo cha kwenye mnyororo kinachofanyiwa biashara zaidi, na kesi iliyo wazi zaidi ya namba isiyoamua tafsiri yake yenyewe vya kutosha. Hadithi ya kawaida huendeshwa hivi: sarafu zinazoondoka masokoni humaanisha wawekezaji wanahamia utunzaji binafsi kushikilia kwa muda mrefu, jambo ambalo ni la kupanda. Sarafu zinazofika masokoni humaanisha wawekezaji wanajiandaa kuuza, jambo ambalo ni la kushuka.

1858b35113d2.en: Not quite. It is not evidence of fraud, and the two figures are certainly related. The point is that profit involves legitimate judgement — depreciation, when a sale counts, provisions — while cash from operations tracks money that actually arrived. A gap that persists for years is a question to investigate, not a verdict either way.
1858b35113d2.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Si ushahidi wa udanganyifu, na takwimu hizo mbili zinahusiana kwa hakika. Pointi ni kwamba faida huhusisha hukumu halali — kushusha thamani, lini mauzo huhesabika, matengo — ilhali fedha kutoka shughuli hufuatilia pesa zilizofika hasa. Pengo linalodumu kwa miaka ni swali la kuchunguza, si hukumu upande wowote.

1879f8407b9c.en: Six structures cover almost everything you will meet, and each has a marker you can check rather than a feeling you have to trust.
1879f8407b9c.sw: Miundo sita hufunika karibu kila kitu utakachokutana nacho, na kila mmoja una alama unayoweza kuikagua badala ya hisia unayolazimika kuiamini.

18861b94d83c.en: Picture this: you live in the U.S. and you're heading to Mexico for a week. Right now, the exchange rate is 1 USD = 20 MXN (Mexican pesos).
18861b94d83c.sw: Fikiria hivi: unaishi Marekani na unaelekea Mexico kwa wiki moja. Sasa hivi, kiwango cha ubadilishaji ni 1 USD = 20 MXN (peso za Mexico).

188b61339ed1.en: Two academic studies looked at whether Bitcoin is a safe haven for stock portfolios. One (Journal of Central Banking Theory and Practice, 2026) found Bitcoin showed statistically significant negative correlation with the S&P 500 — a real candidate for safe-haven status. Another found Bitcoin's correlation with stocks rose from roughly 0.05 in 2017 to 0.25–0.30 by 2021, and concluded crypto behaves as a diversifier, not a safe haven. Both studies used real data and careful methods. They still disagree — a sign the underlying relationship genuinely shifts over time.
188b61339ed1.sw: Tafiti mbili za kitaaluma zilichunguza kama Bitcoin ni kimbilio salama kwa mikusanyiko ya hisa. Moja (Journal of Central Banking Theory and Practice, 2026) iligundua Bitcoin ilionyesha uwiano hasi wenye maana kitakwimu na S&P 500 — mgombea halisi wa hadhi ya kimbilio salama. Nyingine iligundua uwiano wa Bitcoin na hisa ulipanda kutoka takriban 0.05 mwaka 2017 hadi 0.25–0.30 kufikia 2021, na ikahitimisha kwamba crypto hutenda kama msambazaji, si kimbilio salama. Tafiti zote mbili zilitumia data halisi na mbinu makini. Bado hazikubaliani — ishara kwamba uhusiano wa msingi hubadilika kweli kwa muda.

188f933804a2.en: Correct — majority control allows censoring, reorganizing recent history, and double-spending, which is exactly what the Ethereum Classic attackers did in August 2020. It does not conjure other people's keys, and rule-breaking blocks are rejected by every honest node.
188f933804a2.sw: Sahihi — udhibiti wa wingi huruhusu kuzuia, kupanga upya historia ya hivi karibuni, na kutumia-mara-mbili, ambacho ndicho hasa washambuliaji wa Ethereum Classic walichofanya mwezi Agosti 2020. Hakuzalishi funguo za watu wengine, na vitalu vinavyovunja kanuni hukataliwa na kila nodi mwaminifu.

18972a50358b.en: Locking tokens as collateral to participate in Proof of Stake consensus and earn rewards. On Ethereum, running your own validator requires exactly 32 ETH of stake.
18972a50358b.sw: Kufungia tokeni kama dhamana ili kushiriki katika makubaliano ya Uthibitisho wa Hisa na kupata zawadi. Katika Ethereum, kuendesha mthibitishaji wako mwenyewe kunahitaji hasa ETH 32 za hisa.

189c3c33d524.en: Strong forex-specific evidence backs support and resistance; the evidence for candlestick patterns is contested.
189c3c33d524.sw: Ushahidi imara mahususi wa forex huunga mkono msaada na upinzani; ushahidi kwa mitindo ya mishumaa una mgogoro.

18a2da2fa9ce.en: As far away as the account can withstand

18b529de96e7.en: This is the answer to the question this whole course has been building toward: forex exists specifically because currencies are no longer fixed to gold or each other. They float, they move — and where there's constant, unpredictable movement in something valuable, a market emerges to trade it. That market is the one you're learning to navigate.
18b529de96e7.sw: Hili ndilo jibu la swali ambalo kozi hii nzima imekuwa ikilielekea: forex ipo mahususi kwa sababu sarafu hazifungwi tena kwenye dhahabu wala kwa kila mmoja. Zinaelea, zinasogea — na palipo na msogeo wa kudumu usiotabirika katika kitu chenye thamani, soko hujitokeza kukifanyia biashara. Soko hilo ndilo unalojifunza kulipitia.

18b69a51ac32.en: That only insiders can make money in markets
18b69a51ac32.sw: Kwamba watu wa ndani tu ndio wanaweza kupata pesa katika masoko

18b9775d4023.en: Two: what will you hold? Chapter 2 Lesson 5 gave the honest answer on diversification. Name the funds or the allocation, not a vague intention to be diversified.
18b9775d4023.sw: Mbili: utashikilia nini? Sura ya 2 Somo la 5 lilitoa jibu la kweli kuhusu mtawanyiko. Taja mifuko au mgawanyo, si nia isiyo wazi ya kuwa na mtawanyiko.

18bcb4f7063a.en: Three nested boxes showing the weak, semi-strong and strong forms of market efficiency, each containing the one before it, beside a panel setting out the Grossman and Stiglitz argument that a perfectly efficient market could not exist because nobody would be paid to make it so.
18bcb4f7063a.sw: Masanduku matatu yaliyowekwa ndani ya mengine yakionyesha umbo dhaifu, la nusu-imara na imara la ufanisi wa soko, kila moja likiwa na lililotangulia, kando ya paneli ikieleza hoja ya Grossman na Stiglitz kwamba soko lenye ufanisi kamili halingeweza kuwepo kwa sababu hakuna angelipwa kulifanya liwe hivyo.

18c1d9513b25.en: The risk-to-reward ratio sets the win rate you need to break even, which is why a trader who is wrong more often than right can still make money — and a high win rate can still lose.
18c1d9513b25.sw: Uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo huweka kiwango cha ushindi unachohitaji ili kulingana, ndiyo sababu mfanyabiashara anayekosea mara nyingi zaidi kuliko kuwa sahihi anaweza bado kupata pesa — na kiwango kikubwa cha ushindi kinaweza bado kupoteza.

18c8e45a3422.en: You have already met the vocabulary for testing claims like these. The Foundation of Money and Trade, Chapter 2, Lesson 4 defined three genuinely different things that marketing treats as synonyms: a diversifier, a hedge, and a safe haven. That lesson also locked the definition of correlation this course uses. This lesson does not redefine any of those terms. It takes them and applies them to crypto with dated evidence. Crypto Chapter 1, Lesson 1 already flagged the store-of-value framing as contested rather than settled. This lesson is where that flag gets paid off with numbers.
18c8e45a3422.sw: Tayari umekutana na msamiati wa kupima madai kama haya. Msingi wa Pesa na Biashara, Sura ya 2, Somo la 4 lilifafanua vitu vitatu tofauti kweli ambavyo utangazaji huvichukulia kama visawe: mtawanyaji, kinga, na kimbilio salama. Somo hilo pia lilifunga ufafanuzi wa uhusiano ambao kozi hii huutumia. Somo hili halifafanui upya lolote kati ya maneno hayo. Huyachukua na kuyatumia kwa kripto kwa ushahidi wenye tarehe. Kripto Sura ya 1, Somo la 1 tayari liliashiria muktadha wa hifadhi ya thamani kama unaopingwa badala ya kutatuliwa. Somo hili ndipo alama hiyo inapolipwa kwa namba.

18d7636d8999.en: Look back at Chapter 3, Lesson 3 and you will recognise this. The disposition effect is Trader C — grabbing small wins while letting losses run — turned from a diagram into a documented pattern across thousands of real people. It is the psychological engine that manufactures a bad risk-to-reward ratio, one trade at a time.
18d7636d8999.sw: Tazama nyuma Sura ya 3, Somo la 3 na utalitambua hili. Athari ya kuachana na nafasi ni Mfanyabiashara C — kunyakua ushindi mdogo huku ukiacha hasara zikimbie — ikigeuzwa kutoka mchoro kuwa mtindo ulioandikwa katika maelfu ya watu halisi. Ndio injini ya kisaikolojia inayotengeneza uwiano mbaya wa hatari-kwa-tuzo, biashara moja kwa wakati.

1905ac480e45.en: A fake support agent is the most productive form. You post a problem in a public channel, and within minutes someone with a helpful name and a matching profile picture sends you a private message. They are attentive, patient and technically fluent. They eventually need you to restore, validate, sync or verify your wallet. A malicious link is the fastest-growing form. An unexpected token appears in your wallet, or a message announces an airdrop, a refund, or a compensation claim from a project you recognise. The link leads to a site that asks you to connect your wallet and sign something.
1905ac480e45.sw: Wakala bandia wa huduma ndiyo namna yenye tija zaidi. Unachapisha tatizo katika njia ya umma, na ndani ya dakika mtu mwenye jina la kusaidia na picha ya wasifu inayolingana hukutumia ujumbe wa faragha. Wako makini, wavumilivu na wenye ufasaha wa kiufundi. Hatimaye wanahitaji urejeshe, uthibitishe, usawazishe au uhakiki pochi yako. Kiungo hasidi ndiyo namna inayokua kwa kasi zaidi. Tokeni isiyotarajiwa hujitokeza katika pochi yako, au ujumbe hutangaza airdrop, marejesho, au dai la fidia kutoka mradi unaoutambua. Kiungo huelekeza kwenye tovuti inayokuomba uunganishe pochi yako na kutia sahihi kitu.

19236252e783.en: An app shows one number and calls it the price. That number is a summary of something more detailed, and the detail is where your costs live.
19236252e783.sw: Programu huonyesha namba moja na kuiita bei. Namba hiyo ni muhtasari wa kitu chenye undani zaidi, na undani ndipo gharama zako zinapoishi.

19347d7982cd.en: Tightening arrived with it. The Federal Reserve raised its target rate at seven consecutive meetings between March and December 2022, taking it from near zero to a range of 4.25% to 4.50% — the fastest tightening campaign since the 1980s.
19347d7982cd.sw: Kubana kulifika nako. Hifadhi ya Shirikisho ilipandisha kiwango chake lengwa katika mikutano saba mfululizo kati ya Machi na Desemba 2022, ikikipeleka kutoka karibu sifuri hadi kiwango cha 4.25% hadi 4.50% — kampeni ya kubana ya haraka zaidi tangu miaka ya 1980.

1953b3f58b0c.en: That the SEC report settled every question about the episode
1953b3f58b0c.sw: Kwamba ripoti ya SEC ilitatua kila swali kuhusu tukio hilo

195ade9e0b7e.en: Overtrading and revenge trading. Trading out of boredom or confidence, or forcing trades to win back a loss. Fixed by trading only setups that meet your rules, and by a plan rule that caps trades or enforces a cool-down after a loss (Chapter 4, Lesson 1).
195ade9e0b7e.sw: Kufanya biashara kupita kiasi na biashara ya kulipiza kisasi. Kufanya biashara kwa kuchoshwa au kujiamini, au kulazimisha biashara ili kurudisha hasara. Hurekebishwa kwa kufanya biashara ya mipangilio inayokidhi kanuni zako tu, na kwa kanuni ya mpango inayoweka kikomo cha biashara au kulazimisha kipindi cha kupoa baada ya hasara (Sura ya 4, Somo la 1).

19636ef49215.en: In "The Foundation of Money and Trade," you saw money evolve from barter to coins to paper to fiat currency. Here is the final step that track left you at: today, most money is not paper at all. It is entries in databases.
19636ef49215.sw: Katika "Msingi wa Pesa na Biashara," uliona pesa ikibadilika kutoka kubadilishana bidhaa hadi sarafu hadi karatasi hadi sarafu ya amri. Hii hapa ni hatua ya mwisho ambayo njia hiyo ilikuachia: leo, pesa nyingi si karatasi hata kidogo. Ni maingizo katika hifadhidata.

1963c77932f8.en: Expectancy in dollars and in R, a real edge versus a high win rate that still loses, and the long-run-average catch.
1963c77932f8.sw: Matarajio kwa dola na kwa R, faida halisi dhidi ya kiwango kikubwa cha ushindi kinachopoteza bado, na mtego wa wastani wa muda mrefu.

196a34d51ee2.en: Choosing not to take an action because the risk outweighs the benefit.
196a34d51ee2.sw: Kuchagua kutochukua kitendo kwa sababu hatari inazidi manufaa.

196e7d26cc8c.en: For an exchange holding your funds, the honest answer is usually that you would find out when a withdrawal failed, which is after the fact. For a self-custodied wallet, you would find out when you next looked, which might be months. For an approval you signed two years ago, you would find out when the funds were gone.
196e7d26cc8c.sw: Kwa soko la kubadilisha linaloshikilia fedha zako, jibu la kweli kwa kawaida ni kwamba ungegundua wakati utoaji utakaposhindwa, ambako ni baada ya tukio. Kwa pochi ya utunzaji binafsi, ungegundua utakapoangalia tena, ambako kunaweza kuwa miezi. Kwa idhini uliyoitia sahihi miaka miwili iliyopita, ungegundua wakati fedha zitakapokuwa zimeenda.

197d72c62128.en: None — the framework is purely intuitive
197d72c62128.sw: Hakuna — mfumo ni wa kueleweka tu

198ecdaa8a7f.sw: Bei ambayo soko litakutoza ili ununue sarafu ya msingi.

199c03e45f77.sw: Udanganyifu wa muda mrefu ambapo uhusiano hujengwa kwanza na jukwaa bandia la uwekezaji huanzishwa baadaye.

19a6e50b86a8.en: Correct — $5,000 × 2% = $100 risk. $100 ÷ 40 pips = $2.50 per pip needed. $2.50 ÷ $10 = 0.25 standard lots.
19a6e50b86a8.sw: Sahihi — $5,000 × 2% = hatari ya $100. $100 ÷ pip 40 = $2.50 kwa kila pip inayohitajika. $2.50 ÷ $10 = lot 0.25 sanifu.

19a6ec42c243.en: Check the per-trade charge before choosing the number of instalments. Four quarterly purchases capture most of the behavioural benefit of twelve monthly ones at a third of the trading cost, and the difference between four and twelve instalments has very little effect on the outcome the research measures.
19a6ec42c243.sw: Kagua malipo ya kila biashara kabla ya kuchagua idadi ya awamu. Ununuzi minne wa kila robo mwaka hunasa sehemu kubwa ya manufaa ya kitabia ya kumi na mbili ya kila mwezi kwa theluthi moja ya gharama ya biashara, na tofauti kati ya awamu nne na kumi na mbili ina athari ndogo mno kwa tokeo ambalo utafiti hupima.

19b217ffe546.en: First, whether you own shares in a company at all, or units in a fund that owns shares. These behave differently and Lesson 5 explains why. Second, if it is a single company, whether the class you hold votes. Third, where the company sits in the queue you met above: how much it owes, and to whom, because everything owed is paid before anything reaches you.
19b217ffe546.sw: Kwanza, kama unamiliki hisa katika kampuni kabisa, au vipimo katika fund inayomiliki hisa. Hivi hutenda tofauti na Somo la 5 linaeleza kwa nini. Pili, kama ni kampuni moja, kama daraja unaloshikilia hupiga kura. Tatu, mahali kampuni inapokaa katika foleni uliyokutana nayo hapo juu: inadaiwa kiasi gani, na na nani, kwa sababu kila kinachodaiwa hulipwa kabla ya chochote kukufikia.

19b429ad9944.en: A trailing multiple is a fact divided by a fact. A forward multiple contains a forecast, and the forecast was made by people whose estimates are revised regularly and are more optimistic than accurate on average. A company can look expensive on trailing earnings and cheap on forward earnings purely because someone expects a good year.
19b429ad9944.sw: Kizidishi cha nyuma ni ukweli kugawanywa kwa ukweli. Kizidishi cha mbele kina utabiri, na utabiri ulifanywa na watu ambao makadirio yao hurekebishwa mara kwa mara na yana matumaini zaidi kuliko usahihi kwa wastani. Kampuni inaweza kuonekana ghali kwa mapato ya nyuma na nafuu kwa mapato ya mbele kwa sababu tu mtu anatarajia mwaka mzuri.

19df03a31c84.en: Taking on a risk's full potential downside, with no limit.
19df03a31c84.sw: Kubeba hasara yote inayowezekana ya hatari, bila kikomo.

19dfb7ded818.en: Mean-reversion tools bet a stretched price will snap back to its average — powerful when the market is ranging, but built on tidy bell-curve statistics that real prices routinely break.
19dfb7ded818.sw: Zana za kurudi kwa wastani hubashiri kwamba bei iliyonyooshwa itarudi kwenye wastani wake — zenye nguvu soko linapokuwa kwenye ukanda, lakini zimejengwa juu ya takwimu safi za mkunjo wa kengele ambazo bei halisi huzivunja mara kwa mara.

19e9ab8cde51.en: Signals that appear to constitute independent checking — audits, listings, endorsements, published team identities — but that do not establish the thing the reader assumes they establish.
19e9ab8cde51.sw: Ishara zinazoonekana kuwa ukaguzi huru — ukaguzi, uorodheshaji, uidhinishaji, vitambulisho vya timu vilivyochapishwa — lakini zisizothibitisha kile ambacho msomaji hudhania zinathibitisha.

19f8d3a2a9c7.en: Who controls the keys — a company on your behalf, or you directly.
19f8d3a2a9c7.sw: Nani anadhibiti funguo — kampuni kwa niaba yako, au wewe moja kwa moja.

1a01c2c374ce.en: Chart patterns guarantee profitable trades 70% of the time
1a01c2c374ce.sw: Mitindo ya chati huhakikisha biashara zenye faida 70% ya muda

1a0e11619878.en: A public blockchain lets you count everything and identify nobody — so on-chain metrics measure addresses, not people, and almost every headline built on them adds an interpretation the ledger cannot support.
1a0e11619878.sw: Mnyororo wa vitalu wa umma hukuruhusu kuhesabu kila kitu na kutambua hakuna mtu — kwa hivyo vipimo vya kwenye mnyororo hupima anwani, si watu, na karibu kila kichwa cha habari kilichojengwa juu yake huongeza tafsiri ambayo leja haiwezi kuiunga mkono.

1a169d33635a.en: Map the regime before the trade: Name it — risk-on or risk-off, calm or volatile, trending or ranging — and ask whether your thesis suits it. Follow the transmission chain from its source: a central-bank move shows up in FX and rates first, then ripples outward; where is the cleanest expression? Treat crypto as a high-beta link in that chain in risk-off waves, not an independent safe haven. And when you scan and nothing aligns, recognise the all-quiet regime and take the cash position, not a forced trade.
1a169d33635a.sw: Chora ramani ya hali kabla ya biashara: Itaje — kukubali hatari au kukwepa hatari, tulivu au yenye mtikisiko, yenye mwelekeo au ya ukanda — na uulize kama nadharia yako inaifaa. Fuata mnyororo wa usambazaji kutoka chanzo chake: msogeo wa benki kuu hujitokeza katika FX na viwango kwanza, kisha husambaa nje; usemi safi zaidi uko wapi? Chukulia crypto kama kiungo cha beta kubwa katika mnyororo huo katika mawimbi ya kukwepa hatari, si kimbilio salama huru. Na unapotazama na hakuna kinacholingana, tambua hali ya utulivu kamili na uchukue nafasi ya fedha taslimu, si biashara ya kulazimishwa.

1a238f7c5da5.en: Independent expert evaluation of a study's methodology before publication.
1a238f7c5da5.sw: Tathmini huru ya wataalamu ya mbinu ya utafiti kabla ya kuchapishwa.

1a2a630b54bc.en: The 100,000-unit standard lot isn't an arbitrary round number — it reflects the historical scale of interbank trading, where banks moved large sums to settle international trade, long before individual retail traders had any access to the market. Mini, micro, and nano lots were introduced later specifically to make the market accessible to smaller accounts.

Lot ndogo, ndogo sana, na za nano zilianzishwa baadaye mahususi ili kufanya soko lipatikane kwa akaunti ndogo.

1a4e74f367ae.en: The pattern it names is this. A token priced at 0.0001 offers you a million units for a hundred dollars. Bitcoin at 60,000 offers you 0.001667 of one unit for the same money. The first feels like owning something and the second feels like owning a fragment, and the two purchases are identical in every respect that matters.

Ya kwanza huhisi kama kumiliki kitu na ya pili huhisi kama kumiliki kipande, na manunuzi mawili yanafanana katika kila hali yenye maana.

1a62a3dd926e.en: For most of human history — over 6,000 years — barter was how people exchanged what they had for what they needed: trading goods or services directly, with no money involved. It worked, but it had one serious flaw.

1cf343c79f02.en: In March 2019, a pseudonymous analyst writing as PlanB published Modeling Bitcoin's Value with Scarcity on Medium. The article fitted Bitcoin's market value to its stock-to-flow ratio, reported a very high statistical fit, and made a specific forecast: a market value near 1 trillion dollars after the May 2020 halving, which the article translated to roughly 55,000 dollars per coin. In April 2020, PlanB published a follow-up cross-asset version that put the 2020 to 2024 target near 288,000 dollars. A separate floor model published in 2021 gave month-by-month floors, including about 98,000 dollars for November 2021 and about 135,000 for December 2021.
1cf343c79f02.sw: Mwezi Machi 2019, mchambuzi wa jina la bandia akiandika kama PlanB alichapisha Modeling Bitcoin's Value with Scarcity katika Medium. Makala iliweka thamani ya soko ya Bitcoin kufaa uwiano wake wa hisa-kwa-mtiririko, iliripoti ufaafu mkubwa sana wa kitakwimu, na ikatoa utabiri maalum: thamani ya soko karibu na dola trilioni 1 baada ya kupunguzwa nusu kwa Mei 2020, ambayo makala ilitafsiri kuwa takriban dola 55,000 kwa sarafu. Mwezi Aprili 2020, PlanB alichapisha toleo la ufuatiliaji la kuvuka-rasilimali lililoweka lengo la 2020 hadi 2024 karibu na dola 288,000. Mfano tofauti wa sakafu uliochapishwa mwaka 2021 ulitoa sakafu za mwezi kwa mwezi, ikiwa ni pamoja na takriban dola 98,000 kwa Novemba 2021 na takriban 135,000 kwa Desemba 2021.
