1d5c5097b01c.en: On 31 October 2008, someone using the name Satoshi Nakamoto — a pseudonym; the real identity is still unknown — posted a nine-page paper to a cryptography mailing list. Its exact title: "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System." The abstract states the goal in its first sentence: a purely peer-to-peer version of electronic cash would let online payments go directly from one party to another without going through a financial institution. And it names the obstacle directly: the paper says, "We propose a solution to the double-spending problem using a peer-to-peer network."
1d5c5097b01c.sw: Tarehe 31 Oktoba 2008, mtu aliyetumia jina Satoshi Nakamoto — jina la bandia; utambulisho halisi bado haujulikani — alichapisha karatasi ya kurasa tisa katika orodha ya barua pepe ya kriptografia. Kichwa chake hasa: "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System." Muhtasari hutaja lengo katika sentensi yake ya kwanza: toleo la fedha taslimu ya kielektroniki la rika-kwa-rika kikamilifu lingeruhusu malipo ya mtandaoni kwenda moja kwa moja kutoka upande mmoja hadi mwingine bila kupitia taasisi ya kifedha. Nayo hutaja kizuizi moja kwa moja: karatasi inasema, "We propose a solution to the double-spending problem using a peer-to-peer network."

1d6f532d78ec.en: An order that sits inactive until price reaches a trigger level, at which point it becomes a market order. Once triggered, it carries a market order's guarantee: execution, not price.
1d6f532d78ec.sw: Agizo linalokaa bila kufanya kazi hadi bei ifikie kiwango cha kianzishi, wakati huo linakuwa agizo la soko. Mara linapoanzishwa, hubeba uhakika wa agizo la soko: utekelezaji, si bei.

1d6f5c74f64a.en: Neither machine is simply better. They occupy opposite ends of the trade-off Lesson 4 taught. CEX: easy on-ramps from bank cards and transfers, deep liquidity on major pairs, KYC identity checks — and custodial counterparty risk, because mid-trade your coins are their keys and your IOU. DEX: self-custody and permissionless access with no account or ID — and user-error risk with no support desk or undo, a network gas fee on every trade (Lesson 6), pool-dependent liquidity, and exposure to fake tokens.
1d6f5c74f64a.sw: Hakuna mashine iliyo bora tu. Zinakalia pande kinyume za maafikiano ambayo Somo la 4 lilifundisha. CEX: njia rahisi za kuingia kutoka kadi za benki na uhamisho, ukwasi wa kina katika jozi kuu, ukaguzi wa utambulisho wa KYC — na hatari ya mshirika ya utunzaji, kwa sababu katikati ya biashara sarafu zako ni funguo zao na deni lako. DEX: utunzaji binafsi na ufikiaji usiohitaji ruhusa bila akaunti au kitambulisho — na hatari ya kosa la mtumiaji bila dawati la msaada au kutendua, ada ya gesi ya mtandao kwa kila biashara (Somo la 6), ukwasi unaotegemea bwawa, na kufunuliwa kwa tokeni bandia.

1d7ef3cc744e.en: The bid-ask spread is a real, research-backed cost of trading — not just broker profit — and a pip is the unit you measure price moves in.
1d7ef3cc744e.sw: Spread ya bid-ask ni gharama halisi ya kufanya biashara inayoungwa mkono na utafiti — si faida ya broker tu — na pip ni kipimo unachopimia misogeo ya bei.

1d83c721694d.en: The periodic payment between longs and shorts in perpetual futures; a direct positioning signal.
1d83c721694d.sw: Malipo ya mara kwa mara kati ya warefu na wafupi katika mikataba ya baadaye ya kudumu; ishara ya moja kwa moja ya msimamo.

1d8628911d2d.en: An asset with an average positive — but imperfect — correlation to your existing holdings. Still tends to move with the rest of your portfolio, just not in lockstep.
1d8628911d2d.sw: Mali yenye uwiano chanya wa wastani — lakini usio kamili — na umiliki wako uliopo. Bado huelekea kusogea pamoja na mkusanyiko wako wote, ila si kwa hatua moja.

1d8bf4f69c67.en: The equivalent constraint on a short position is the cost of holding it, and that cost is not fixed.
1d8bf4f69c67.sw: Kizuizi kinacholingana kwenye nafasi ya short ni gharama ya kuishikilia, na gharama hiyo si thabiti.

1daa3223e7f9.en: Price action reading rests on three things you have largely met already. This lesson assembles them into one method rather than re-teaching them.
1daa3223e7f9.sw: Usomaji wa shughuli ya bei unategemea mambo matatu ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa tayari umekutana nayo. Somo hili huyaunganisha kuwa mbinu moja badala ya kuyafundisha tena.

1dbdfda813f1.en: You lost money, but only because of broker fees
1dbdfda813f1.sw: Ulipoteza pesa, lakini kwa sababu ya ada za broker tu

1dbe86968486.en: When an institution's ability to pay depends on most people not asking at once, the rational individual decision is to ask first — which makes the collective outcome certain.
1dbe86968486.sw: Wakati uwezo wa taasisi wa kulipa unategemea watu wengi kutoomba kwa wakati mmoja, uamuzi wenye mantiki wa mtu binafsi ni kuomba kwanza — jambo linalofanya matokeo ya pamoja kuwa ya hakika.

1e02f8ecc2a2.en: A network where participants connect directly to each other and share the work, instead of all connecting to one central server. In Bitcoin, thousands of computers each keep a full copy of the ledger.
1e02f8ecc2a2.sw: Mtandao ambapo washiriki huunganishwa moja kwa moja na kushirikiana kazi, badala ya wote kuunganishwa na seva moja kuu. Katika Bitcoin, maelfu ya kompyuta kila moja hutunza nakala kamili ya leja.

1e15bde9ee09.en: The market reacts asymmetrically: bad news moves prices more than equally-sized good news. A disappointing number tends to produce a bigger move than an equally-surprising positive one. Practically, this means downside surprises deserve more respect than upside ones when you're judging how much room to give an event — and it's another quiet echo of the fat-tails theme from Lesson 2 and the SNB collapse in Chapter 1.
1e15bde9ee09.sw: Soko huitikia bila usawa: habari mbaya husogeza bei zaidi kuliko habari njema ya ukubwa sawa. Namba ya kukatisha tamaa huelekea kuzalisha msogeo mkubwa zaidi kuliko ile chanya inayoshangaza vivyo hivyo. Kivitendo, hii inamaanisha mishangao ya upande wa chini inastahili heshima zaidi kuliko ya juu unapohukumu nafasi ya kutoa kwa tukio — na ni mwangwi mwingine wa kimyakimya wa mada ya mikia minene kutoka Somo la 2 na kuanguka kwa SNB katika Sura ya 1.

1e396c6d5224.en: Chapter 3, Lesson 1 gave you a position-sizing rule: decide the fraction of the account you are willing to lose on one idea, and size the position so that reaching your invalidation level costs exactly that. Leverage does not alter that budget. It alters how quickly you arrive at it.
1e396c6d5224.sw: Sura ya 3, Somo la 1 lilikupa kanuni ya kupanga ukubwa wa nafasi: amua sehemu ya akaunti ulio tayari kuipoteza katika wazo moja, na upange ukubwa wa nafasi ili kufikia kiwango chako cha kubatilisha kugharimu hasa hivyo. Mzingo haubadilishi bajeti hiyo. Hubadilisha kasi unayoifikia.

1e3c66ad751a.en: The build-up that paid twice, the crowded 2008 unwind, and the evidence that carry income is crash-risk compensation.
1e3c66ad751a.sw: Mkusanyiko uliolipa mara mbili, kuvunjika kwa msongamano wa mwaka 2008, na ushahidi kwamba mapato ya carry ni fidia ya hatari ya kuanguka.

1e6040f0fd6d.en: The disciplined version: wait for the RSI to exit the extreme zone. Price falls, RSI drops below 30 (oversold) — you wait. Only when RSI crosses back above 30 — meaning the selling pressure has actually broken — do you buy. Same mirrored for shorts: wait for RSI to fall back below 70 rather than shorting the moment it becomes overbought. You sacrifice a little of the move in exchange for confirmation that the reversal has actually begun, rather than betting that it will.
1e6040f0fd6d.sw: Toleo lenye nidhamu: subiri RSI itoke kwenye kanda ya kupindukia. Bei inashuka, RSI inashuka chini ya 30 (imeuzwa kupita kiasi) — unasubiri. Ni pale tu RSI itakapokatiza tena juu ya 30 — ikimaanisha shinikizo la kuuza limevunjika hasa — ndipo ununue. Vivyo hivyo kwa kioo kwa short: subiri RSI ishuke tena chini ya 70 badala ya kufanya short wakati inapokuwa imenunuliwa kupita kiasi. Unatoa sehemu ndogo ya msogeo kwa kubadilishana na uthibitisho kwamba mgeuko umeanza hasa, badala ya kubashiri kwamba utaanza.

1e738d1b193f.en: Not quite — this is moving the stop, which destroys your planned risk-to-reward. Set it at invalidation as an order before entry and never widen it.
1e738d1b193f.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — hii ni kusogeza stop, jambo linaloharibu hatari-kwa-tuzo uliyopanga. Iweke kwenye kuvunjika kama agizo kabla ya kuingia na usiipanue kamwe.

1e79a9fc1fe7.en: The average of the true range over a set number of recent bars. Wilder used 14 periods and his own running average, in which each new value is the previous ATR multiplied by 13, plus today's true range, divided by 14. ATR is quoted in the price's own units, not as a percentage, so an ATR of 1,900 dollars on Bitcoin means the typical daily bar covers about 1,900 dollars of ground.
1e79a9fc1fe7.sw: Wastani wa kiwango halisi katika idadi iliyowekwa ya mistari ya hivi karibuni. Wilder alitumia vipindi 14 na wastani wake mwenyewe unaoendelea, ambapo kila thamani mpya ni ATR ya awali ikizidishwa na 13, pamoja na kiwango halisi cha leo, ikigawanywa na 14. ATR hunukuliwa katika vipimo vya bei yenyewe, si kama asilimia, kwa hivyo ATR ya dola 1,900 katika Bitcoin humaanisha mstari wa kawaida wa kila siku hufunika takriban dola 1,900 za ardhi.

1e8df8a1e9a9.sw: Juu ya bei yako ya kuingia

1e9cdcdcd68d.en: Correct. Care does not fix a base rate that bad, and the same study found thousands of colluding addresses making the trading look organic — so the evidence you would use to be careful is itself manufactured. Websites and whitepapers are cheap to fabricate, and spreading small amounts across many listings simply buys the base rate more times.
1e9cdcdcd68d.sw: Sahihi. Uangalifu haurekebishi kiwango cha msingi kibaya hivyo, na utafiti uleule ulibaini maelfu ya anwani zinazoshirikiana kufanya biashara ionekane ya asili — kwa hivyo ushahidi ambao ungeutumia kuwa mwangalifu wenyewe umetengenezwa. Tovuti na karatasi nyeupe ni nafuu kughushi, na kutawanya kiasi kidogo katika uorodheshaji mwingi hununua tu kiwango cha msingi mara nyingi zaidi.

1ec9866ffeff.en: Selecting holdings in an attempt to beat an index, rather than tracking it.
1ec9866ffeff.sw: Kuchagua umiliki kwa jaribio la kushinda index, badala ya kuifuatilia.

1ed8a72b7262.en: Company A trades at 300 a share and is worth 10 billion in total. Company B trades at 50 a share and is worth 80 billion. Which has more influence on a price-weighted index like the Dow?
1ed8a72b7262.sw: Kampuni A hufanyiwa biashara kwa 300 kwa hisa na ina thamani ya bilioni 10 kwa jumla. Kampuni B hufanyiwa biashara kwa 50 kwa hisa na ina thamani ya bilioni 80. Ni ipi yenye ushawishi zaidi juu ya index yenye uzito wa bei kama Dow?

1ef6a888ca1a.en: Pressure-test your own plan: Is it actually written down, or does it live only in your head where it can quietly change? Can you state your system's expectancy — even a rough figure from past trades — in R or in dollars? Is that expectancy positive over a meaningful number of trades, not just your most recent, most memorable few? And is your risk per trade small enough that a normal losing streak cannot end you before the expectancy has time to play out?
1ef6a888ca1a.sw: Jaribu mpango wako mwenyewe kwa shinikizo: Je, umeandikwa hasa, au unaishi kichwani mwako tu ambapo unaweza kubadilika kimyakimya? Je, unaweza kutamka matarajio ya mfumo wako — hata takwimu ya jumla kutoka biashara zilizopita — kwa R au kwa dola? Je, matarajio hayo ni chanya katika idadi yenye maana ya biashara, si chache zako za hivi karibuni na zinazokumbukwa zaidi tu? Na je, hatari yako kwa kila biashara ni ndogo vya kutosha kiasi kwamba mfululizo wa kawaida wa hasara hauwezi kukumaliza kabla matarajio hayajapata muda wa kujitokeza?

1f07ec38337e.en: The second is a record of what actually happened.
1f07ec38337e.sw: Ya pili ni rekodi ya kilichotokea hasa.

1f10748e07ce.en: The useful steps are unglamorous. Move any remaining funds to a new wallet with a newly generated recovery phrase, since the old one must be assumed compromised. Revoke every outstanding approval on the affected wallet. Record the transaction hashes and addresses, which are permanent and public and are what any investigator would actually work from. Report it to the relevant national fraud authority and to the exchange the funds moved to, both of which can occasionally act. Then treat further payment of any kind as the second scam it almost always is.
1f10748e07ce.sw: Hatua zenye manufaa hazivutii. Sogeza fedha zozote zilizobaki kwenda pochi mpya yenye kifungu cha urejeshaji kilichozalishwa upya, kwa kuwa cha zamani lazima kidhaniwe kimeathiriwa. Batilisha kila idhini iliyosalia katika pochi iliyoathirika. Andika heshi za miamala na anwani, ambazo ni za kudumu na za umma nazo ndizo ambazo mchunguzi yeyote angefanyia kazi hasa. Ripoti kwa mamlaka husika ya kitaifa ya udanganyifu na kwa soko la kubadilisha ambako fedha zilikwenda, ambavyo vyote vinaweza mara kwa mara kutenda. Kisha chukulia malipo yoyote zaidi ya aina yoyote kama ulaghai wa pili ambao karibu daima ndio.

1f1f77215d1f.en: A trader who is right only 40% of the time can be consistently profitable, if every loss is small and controlled while winners are allowed to run. A trader who is right 90% of the time can still go broke, if a single uncontrolled loss is large enough to erase every gain before it. Being right often is not the same as trading well.
1f1f77215d1f.sw: Mfanyabiashara ambaye ni sahihi 40% tu ya muda anaweza kupata faida kwa uthabiti, kama kila hasara ni ndogo na inadhibitiwa huku washindi wakiruhusiwa kukimbia. Mfanyabiashara ambaye ni sahihi 90% ya muda anaweza bado kufilisika, kama hasara moja isiyodhibitiwa ni kubwa vya kutosha kufuta kila faida iliyotangulia. Kuwa sahihi mara nyingi si sawa na kufanya biashara vizuri.

1f2a71f22327.en: The order is the entire technique. You move from slowest to fastest, and each timeframe has exactly one job.
1f2a71f22327.sw: Mpangilio ndio mbinu yote. Unasogea kutoka polepole zaidi hadi kasi zaidi, na kila kipindi kina kazi moja hasa.

1f39d4e87471.en: A platform that shows growing profits and permits small early withdrawals, then demands a tax, fee or deposit before releasing a larger balance — a demand that repeats.
1f39d4e87471.sw: Jukwaa linaloonyesha faida zinazokua na huruhusu utoaji mdogo wa awali, kisha hudai kodi, ada au amana kabla ya kutoa salio kubwa zaidi — dai linalojirudia.

1f4d1bba956a.en: Not quite — you concentrate conviction toward the best theses while still sizing every trade to the fixed-fractional rule. Concentrate conviction, not risk.
1f4d1bba956a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — unajikita kwenye uhakika kuelekea nadharia bora huku bado ukipima kila biashara kwa kanuni ya sehemu thabiti. Jikite kwenye uhakika, si hatari.

1f5f8646f0d9.en: Four bars showing the portfolio impact of a 60 percent fall in one holding at position sizes of 2, 10, 25 and 40 percent, costing 1.2, 6, 15 and 24 percent of the portfolio, alongside a note that a 2 percent holding rising fivefold drifts to about 9 percent.
1f5f8646f0d9.sw: Vipau vinne vinavyoonyesha athari kwa mkusanyiko ya kushuka kwa asilimia 60 katika umiliki mmoja kwa ukubwa wa nafasi wa asilimia 2, 10, 25 na 40, vikigharimu asilimia 1.2, 6, 15 na 24 za mkusanyiko, pamoja na dokezo kwamba umiliki wa asilimia 2 unaopanda mara tano hupotea hadi takriban asilimia 9.

1f7fb77694d7.en: The second component is record keeping, which is boring and becomes urgent at the worst moment.
1f7fb77694d7.sw: Kipengele cha pili ni kutunza rekodi, ambako ni kuchosha nako huwa kwa dharura katika wakati mbaya zaidi.

1f92c66f8946.en: A second thing worth checking is how the fund actually obtains its exposure.
1f92c66f8946.sw: Kitu cha pili kinachostahili kukaguliwa ni jinsi fund inavyopata uwazi wake hasa.

1fa64b636e72.en: Correct. Ask where the return comes from and keep asking until you reach an activity: lending to borrowers who pay interest, fees from traders, protocol staking rewards. If the chain terminates in the platform's own token, in "our trading strategy", or in nothing, you have your answer — and this test does not require you to recognise the particular scheme.
1fa64b636e72.sw: Sahihi. Uliza faida hutoka wapi na uendelee kuuliza hadi ufikie shughuli: kukopesha wakopaji wanaolipa riba, ada kutoka wafanyabiashara, zawadi za kuweka hisa za itifaki. Ikiwa mnyororo utaishia katika tokeni ya jukwaa lenyewe, katika "mkakati wetu wa biashara", au katika lolote, una jibu lako — na mtihani huu haukuhitaji kutambua mpango fulani.

1faa54b95a3f.en: On 15 January 2015, without warning, the Swiss National Bank abandoned the floor. The franc did not drift — it detonated. EUR/CHF fell straight through 1.20 and collapsed by roughly 30% intraday, trading as low as around 0.85 in the chaos, before settling nearer parity. The move happened in minutes, and with so little liquidity that the exact bottom is genuinely disputed: one broker's own feed printed as low as 1.1659 within nine seconds as the banks providing its prices pulled them.
1faa54b95a3f.sw: Tarehe 15 Januari 2015, bila onyo, Benki Kuu ya Uswisi iliacha sakafu. Faranga haikusogea taratibu — ililipuka. EUR/CHF ilishuka moja kwa moja kupitia 1.20 na kuanguka kwa takriban 30% ndani ya siku, ikifanyiwa biashara chini kama karibu 0.85 katika machafuko, kabla ya kutulia karibu na usawa. Msogeo ulitokea ndani ya dakika chache, na kwa ukwasi mdogo mno kiasi kwamba sehemu kamili ya chini ina mgogoro kweli: mpasho wa broker mmoja ulionyesha chini kama 1.1659 ndani ya sekunde tisa benki zinazotoa bei zake zilipoziondoa.

1fb1bcbce1f1.en: The first day a share trades without the right to the upcoming dividend. Buy on or after this date and the seller keeps the payment.
1fb1bcbce1f1.sw: Siku ya kwanza ambayo hisa hufanyiwa biashara bila haki ya gawio linalokuja. Nunua siku hiyo au baadaye na muuzaji huweka malipo.

1fdcb1f4e656.en: The floor, the collapse, the fallout, and the survival lesson: being sized to be wrong beat being right.
1fdcb1f4e656.sw: Sakafu, anguko, matokeo, na fundisho la kunusurika: kupimwa ili ukosee kulishinda kuwa sahihi.

1fe39245c8fc.en: Currencies aren't traded in equal volume. Some are involved in a huge share of global trading; most barely register.
1fe39245c8fc.sw: Sarafu hazifanyiwi biashara kwa kiasi sawa. Baadhi zinahusika katika sehemu kubwa mno ya biashara ya kimataifa; nyingi hazionekani sana.

1fe945f34c74.en: A token trades at 0.40 dollars. There are 500,000,000 tokens in circulation. Market cap = 0.40 x 500,000,000 = 200,000,000 dollars. Now look at what actually happened that day. Only 2,000,000 tokens changed hands, which is 0.4% of the supply. At 0.40 dollars each, that is 800,000 dollars of real buying and selling. So 800,000 dollars of trading is being used to price a 200,000,000 dollar valuation. The other 99.6% of the supply never moved. It simply inherited the price set by the last trade.
1fe945f34c74.sw: Tokeni hufanyiwa biashara katika dola 0.40. Kuna tokeni 500,000,000 katika mzunguko. Kiasi cha soko = 0.40 x 500,000,000 = dola 200,000,000. Sasa angalia kilichotokea hasa siku hiyo. Tokeni 2,000,000 pekee zilibadilisha mikono, ambayo ni 0.4% ya usambazaji. Katika dola 0.40 kila moja, hiyo ni dola 800,000 za ununuzi na uuzaji halisi. Kwa hivyo dola 800,000 za biashara zinatumika kupanga bei ya tathmini ya dola 200,000,000. 99.6% nyingine ya usambazaji haikusogea kamwe. Ilirithi tu bei iliyowekwa na biashara ya mwisho.

1fee1fae5cce.en: Not quite. A low P/E is not automatically cheap: the ratio uses past earnings, so it falls when the market expects future earnings to drop. It is a prompt to investigate why the market disagrees with the historical figure, not a verdict in either direction.
1fee1fae5cce.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. P/E ndogo si nafuu kiotomatiki: uwiano hutumia mapato ya nyuma, hivyo hushuka soko linapotarajia mapato ya baadaye yatashuka. Ni kichocheo cha kuchunguza kwa nini soko halikubaliani na takwimu ya kihistoria, si hukumu upande wowote.

1feefbe3ad73.en: A portfolio set at 60% equities and left alone through a long bull market can arrive at 80% equities without a single decision having been made. The investor did not choose more risk. They simply did not act, and the market chose for them. Rebalancing is what makes that a decision again.
1feefbe3ad73.sw: Kasha lililowekwa katika 60% ya hisa na kuachwa peke yake katika soko refu la kupanda linaweza kufika 80% ya hisa bila uamuzi hata mmoja kufanywa. Mwekezaji hakuchagua hatari zaidi. Aliacha tu kutenda, na soko likamchagulia. Kusawazisha upya ndicho kinachofanya hilo kuwa uamuzi tena.

1ff26da3dc84.en: Not quite. The number of holdings is not what makes a portfolio diversified — their independence is. Twenty banks will tend to fall together in a banking crisis, so the count overstates the protection considerably. And diversification reduces specific risk, never market risk.
1ff26da3dc84.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Idadi ya umiliki si kinachofanya mkusanyiko usambazwe — kujitegemea kwao ndiko. Benki ishirini zitaelekea kushuka pamoja katika janga la kibenki, hivyo hesabu huzidisha ulinzi kwa kiasi kikubwa. Na kusambaza hupunguza hatari mahususi, kamwe si hatari ya soko.

201449c944eb.en: Why do companies whose value rests on distant future profits move most when interest rates change?
201449c944eb.sw: Kwa nini kampuni ambazo thamani yake hutegemea faida za mbali za baadaye husonga zaidi viwango vya riba vinapobadilika?

201544ae0772.en: Why is a plan built on reacting to a regime change unreliable in crypto specifically?
201544ae0772.sw: Kwa nini mpango uliojengwa juu ya kuitikia mabadiliko ya utawala hauaminiki katika kripto hasa?

2032bd473adf.en: Correct. A gap in the document is filled in the moment, and the moment is a drawdown. Where a decision genuinely cannot be made in advance, the right entry is that you have decided to do nothing — that is still a rule, and it is far better than an unwritten instinct.
2032bd473adf.sw: Sahihi. Pengo katika hati hujazwa papo hapo, na wakati huo ni wa kushuka. Pale uamuzi kwa kweli usipoweza kufanywa mapema, kiingizo sahihi ni kwamba umeamua kutofanya lolote — hiyo bado ni kanuni, nayo ni bora zaidi kuliko silika isiyoandikwa.

204340d01125.en: Most funds hold the real securities, which is called physical replication. Some instead enter a contract with a bank that agrees to pay the index return, which is called synthetic replication. The synthetic version can track more closely and reach otherwise awkward markets — but it introduces a party who has to honour the contract.
204340d01125.sw: Fund nyingi hushikilia dhamana halisi, ambako huitwa kuiga kwa kimwili. Baadhi badala yake huingia mkataba na benki inayokubali kulipa faida ya index, ambako huitwa kuiga kwa bandia. Toleo la bandia linaweza kufuatilia kwa ukaribu zaidi na kufikia masoko yasiyo rahisi vinginevyo — lakini huanzisha mtu anayelazimika kuheshimu mkataba.

2049db0eee55.en: Market structure. This is just the shape of the trend, also from Foundations Chapter 3: an uptrend is a series of higher highs and higher lows, a downtrend a series of lower highs and lower lows. Each recent high or low is a swing point — a local peak or trough. When price stops making higher highs and starts making lower lows, the structure has shifted. That shift, read from the bare chart, is the price-action trader's core signal.
2049db0eee55.sw: Muundo wa soko. Huu ni umbo la mwelekeo tu, pia kutoka Msingi Sura ya 3: mwelekeo wa kupanda ni mfululizo wa vilele vya juu zaidi na mabonde ya juu zaidi, mwelekeo wa kushuka ni mfululizo wa vilele vya chini zaidi na mabonde ya chini zaidi. Kila kilele au bonde la hivi karibuni ni sehemu ya mzunguko — kilele au bonde la eneo hilo. Bei inapoacha kufanya vilele vya juu zaidi na kuanza kufanya mabonde ya chini zaidi, muundo umebadilika. 20a5cd1596f4.en: Everything in this chapter so far — wallets and keys (Lesson 4), exchanges (Lesson 5), transactions and finality (Lesson 6) — moves coins whose price swings hard. That volatility is the last practical gap in the picture. If you sell bitcoin because you expect it to fall, what do you hold instead? Moving back to actual dollars means a bank, business hours, and days of settlement. Crypto markets run 24/7 and settle in minutes.

Kurudi kwa dola halisi humaanisha benki, saa za kazi, na siku za utimizaji. Masoko ya kripto huendeshwa saa 24/7 na hutimiza ndani ya dakika.

229c95b75ae3.en: This is not a theoretical risk. In December 2017, a single game — CryptoKitties, which let users breed digital cats — grew until it accounted for roughly 12 percent of all Ethereum transactions; the backlog of pending transactions reached about 30,000, and fees rose for every user on the network. In April 2021, Bitcoin's average fee crossed roughly 60 dollars per transaction — a record at the time, beating the previous bull-market peak of around 50 dollars from late 2017. And in May 2021, Ethereum's average fee peaked somewhere between about 50 and 70 dollars, depending on which data provider you check — sources genuinely disagree on the exact figure, which is itself a lesson in checking data before repeating it.
229c95b75ae3.sw: Hii si hatari ya kinadharia. Mwezi Desemba 2017, mchezo mmoja — CryptoKitties, uliowaruhusu watumiaji kuzalisha paka za kidijitali — ulikua hadi ukachukua takriban asilimia 12 ya miamala yote ya Ethereum; msongamano wa miamala inayosubiri ulifikia takriban 30,000, na ada zilipanda kwa kila mtumiaji katika mtandao. Mwezi Aprili 2021, ada ya wastani ya Bitcoin ilivuka takriban dola 60 kwa muamala — rekodi wakati huo, ikishinda kilele cha awali cha soko la ng'ombe cha takriban dola 50 kutoka mwishoni mwa 2017. Na mwezi Mei 2021, ada ya wastani ya Ethereum ilifikia kilele mahali fulani kati ya takriban dola 50 na 70, kutegemea mtoa data unayemkagua — vyanzo havikubaliani kweli kuhusu takwimu hasa, jambo ambalo lenyewe ni somo la kukagua data kabla ya kuirudia.

23641c8f0600.en: Two caveats belong with that, stated plainly. This is CFD and forex data, not crypto data. And a contract for difference is not a perpetual swap: different product, different venues, different regulator. It is still the most relevant regulator-grade measurement available, for two reasons. First, it measures the thing in question, which is retail accounts using leverage, rather than retail accounts generally. Second, the same regulator, looking at the same evidence, rated cryptocurrency as the most dangerous underlying on its entire list, capping it at 2 to 1 where major currencies got 30 to 1. That is a fifteen-fold difference, and the stated reason was the volatility of the underlying plus the difficulty of valuing it. If 74% to 89% of accounts lose at 30 to 1 on major currencies, there is no version of the argument in which crypto at 50x is the safer proposition.
23641c8f0600.sw: Tahadhari mbili zinaambatana na hilo, zikitajwa wazi. Hii ni data ya CFD na forex, si data ya kripto. Na mkataba wa tofauti si ubadilishano wa kudumu: bidhaa tofauti, viwanja tofauti, mdhibiti tofauti. Bado ndicho kipimo cha daraja la mdhibiti chenye uhusiano zaidi kinachopatikana, kwa sababu mbili. Kwanza, hupima kitu kinachohusika, ambako ni akaunti za rejareja zinazotumia mzingo, badala ya akaunti za rejareja kwa ujumla. Pili, mdhibiti yuleyule, akiangalia ushahidi uleule, aliipa sarafu ya kripto daraja la kuwa rasilimali ya msingi hatari zaidi katika orodha yake yote, akiiwekea dari ya 2 kwa 1 pale sarafu kuu zilipopata 30 kwa 1. Hiyo ni tofauti ya mara kumi na tano, na sababu iliyotajwa ilikuwa mtikisiko wa rasilimali ya msingi pamoja na ugumu wa kuitathmini. Ikiwa 74% hadi 89% ya akaunti hupoteza katika 30 kwa 1 katika sarafu kuu, hakuna toleo la hoja ambapo kripto katika 50x ni pendekezo salama zaidi.

242fd6f1c221.en: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003), published in the American Economic Review, examined six years of real-time exchange rate quotes alongside the matching macroeconomic expectations and actual realizations, across the dollar versus the German mark, pound, yen, Swiss franc, and euro. Their central finding: announcement surprises — the divergence between what was expected and what arrived — produce immediate jumps in exchange rates. Not the announcements themselves. The gap between expectation and reality is what moves price, confirming with high-frequency data exactly what Lesson 3 argued.

Tokeo lao kuu: mishangao ya matangazo — utofauti kati ya kile kilichotarajiwa na kile kilichofika — huzalisha miruko ya mara moja katika viwango vya ubadilishaji. Si matangazo yenyewe. 25c132e6792f.en: The custody decision checklist. Answer these three questions in writing before deciding where any crypto should live. (1) Amount — if this money vanished tomorrow, is it an annoyance, a wound, or a catastrophe? An annoyance can live wherever is convenient. A catastrophe should never depend on a single point of failure — including a single company, and including a single piece of paper. (2) Horizon — will you touch this money weekly, or not for years? Frequent trading pulls toward hot custody; long holding pulls toward cold, because every extra month of exchange custody is another month of counterparty risk you are not being paid for. (3) Competence — have you proven, not assumed, that you can do this? The test: send a small amount to a self-custody wallet, delete the wallet, and restore it from your written seed phrase on a different device. If you have never done that drill, your cold storage is a theory. Do the drill with an amount you can afford to lose before trusting the setup with an amount you cannot.
25c132e6792f.sw: Orodha ya kukagua uamuzi wa utunzaji. Jibu maswali haya matatu kwa maandishi kabla ya kuamua kripto yoyote inapaswa kuishi wapi. (1) Kiasi — ikiwa pesa hii ingetoweka kesho, ni usumbufu, jeraha, au maafa? Usumbufu unaweza kuishi popote panapofaa. Maafa hayapaswi kamwe kutegemea nukta moja ya kushindwa — ikiwa ni pamoja na kampuni moja, na ikiwa ni pamoja na kipande kimoja cha karatasi. (2) Upeo — je, utaigusa pesa hii kila wiki, au kwa miaka? Biashara ya mara kwa mara huvuta kuelekea utunzaji wa moto; kushikilia kwa muda mrefu huvuta kuelekea baridi, kwa sababu kila mwezi wa ziada wa utunzaji wa soko la kubadilisha ni mwezi mwingine wa hatari ya mshirika ambao hulipwi kwake. (3) Uwezo — je, umethibitisha, si kudhania, kwamba unaweza kufanya hivi? Mtihani: tuma kiasi kidogo kwa pochi ya utunzaji binafsi, futa pochi, na uirejeshe kutoka kifungu chako cha mbegu kilichoandikwa katika kifaa tofauti. Ikiwa hujawahi kufanya zoezi hilo, hifadhi yako baridi ni nadharia. Fanya zoezi kwa kiasi unachoweza kumudu kupoteza kabla ya kuamini mpangilio kwa kiasi usichoweza.

26022c3a9435.en: Daily chart: EUR/USD in a clear uptrend, higher highs and higher lows. Direction established — you're looking for longs only. Down to the 1-hour: price has pulled back to a support level that held twice before. That's a setup consistent with the daily trend. Down to the 15-minute: you wait for price to stop falling and turn up, then enter — with your stop just below that support level. Because the 15-minute chart let you enter close to your invalidation point, your stop distance is smaller, which by the position-sizing formula from Chapter 1, Lesson 5 means you can take a properly sized position for the same fixed dollar risk.

265ba46b54b3.en: The timing claim is the specific, checkable part, so check it. Measuring from each halving to the highest price of that cycle: November 2012 to November 2013 was 367 days, or 12.1 months. July 2016 to December 2017 was 525 days, or 17.2 months. May 2020 to November 2021 was 548 days, or 18.0 months. April 2024 to October 2025 was 534 days, or 17.5 months. All four land inside the stated window. That is the strongest form of the case, and it is a genuinely striking result. The rest of this lesson explains why a striking result is not the same as evidence.

Zote nne huanguka ndani ya dirisha lililotajwa. Hiyo ndiyo namna yenye nguvu zaidi ya hoja, nayo ni matokeo ya kushangaza kweli. 27178fe5679c.en: By late 2007 the Reserve Bank of Australia was paying around 6.75%, while the Bank of Japan paid about 0.5% — a gap of roughly five percentage points, earned simply for holding the position. On top of that interest, the trade itself kept rising: as more money poured in, the yen weakened and the Australian dollar strengthened, so carry traders were paid twice — the rate difference, plus the currency move. AUD/JPY climbed to an all-time high near 107.80 in October 2007.

Juu ya riba hiyo, biashara yenyewe iliendelea kupanda: pesa nyingi zilipomiminika, yen ilidhoofika na dola ya Australia iliimarika, hivyo wafanyabiashara wa carry walilipwa mara mbili — tofauti ya kiwango, pamoja na msogeo wa sarafu. 273c4fb22902.en: Anton, Cohen and Polk, in their study "Best Ideas," found that the positions in which professional managers showed the most conviction — their single best-analysed ideas — outperformed both the market and the managers' own other holdings by roughly 2.8 to 4.5% per year. The striking part is the rest: the majority of the other stocks those managers held did not beat the market at all. Their edge was concentrated in a handful of ideas, and diluted by everything else they owned.
273c4fb22902.sw: Anton, Cohen na Polk, katika utafiti wao "Best Ideas," waligundua kwamba nafasi ambazo wasimamizi wa kitaaluma walionyesha uhakika mkubwa zaidi — mawazo yao moja yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi — yalifanya vizuri zaidi kuliko soko na kuliko umiliki mwingine wa wasimamizi wenyewe kwa takriban 2.8 hadi 4.5% kwa mwaka. Sehemu ya kushangaza ni iliyobaki: hisa nyingi zilizobaki ambazo wasimamizi hao walizishikilia hazikushinda soko kabisa. Faida yao ilijikita katika mawazo machache, na ilipunguzwa na kila kitu kingine walichokimiliki.

27f2104a42ca.en: Consider a trader holding a long pound position with a sensible stop, asleep during the London night. The flash crash triggers the stop deep in the plunge, filling far below its level in the thin market — and then price recovers within minutes. The trader is left with a real, oversized loss from a move that had largely reversed by the time they woke. They were not wrong about the pound. They were caught by when and how the market moved, not by which direction it ultimately went.

Mfanyabiashara anaachwa na hasara halisi, kubwa kupita kiasi kutokana na msogeo ambao ulikuwa umegeuka kwa kiasi kikubwa wakati alipoamka. Hawakukosea kuhusu pauni. 29b281bddecf.en: Lesson 2 introduced the nonce: a number in the block header that miners change over and over, rehashing each time, until the block's hash falls below the network's target. There is no shortcut and no skill involved in any single guess. It is a lottery where each hash is one ticket, and more computing power simply buys tickets faster. The winner broadcasts the finished block. Every other computer checks it in milliseconds — verifying is cheap, only finding is expensive — and, if it is valid, adds it to their copy and starts racing on the next one.
29b281bddecf.sw: Somo la 2 lilianzisha nonce: namba katika kichwa cha kitalu ambayo wachimbaji huibadilisha tena na tena, wakifanya heshi upya kila mara, hadi heshi ya kitalu ianguke chini ya lengo la mtandao. Hakuna njia ya mkato wala ujuzi unaohusika katika kubahatisha kimoja. Ni bahati nasibu ambapo kila heshi ni tikiti moja, na nguvu zaidi ya kihesabu hununua tu tikiti kwa kasi zaidi. Mshindi hutangaza kitalu kilichokamilika. Kila kompyuta nyingine huikagua kwa milisekunde — kuthibitisha ni nafuu, kupata tu ndiko ghali — na, ikiwa ni halali, huiongeza katika nakala yao na kuanza kushindana kwa kinachofuata.

29f002f5dbde.en: What to look for from here. Translate every address-based figure back before reacting, because active addresses means addresses transacted and nothing more. Ask which provider produced any exchange flow figure, then list at least three explanations for the flow other than the one being offered. When two sources disagree about the same metric, check whether they use different label sets rather than assuming one is wrong. When an indicator is overlaid on price, ask what period it was fitted on and what period it was tested on. Set aside any narrative that explains every outcome, because a story that cannot be wrong cannot be informative. And treat historical on-chain series as revisable: note the provider and the date whenever you record a figure.
29f002f5dbde.sw: Cha kuangalia kuanzia hapa. Tafsiri kila takwimu inayotegemea anwani kurudi nyuma kabla ya kuitikia, kwa sababu anwani hai humaanisha anwani zilifanya miamala na si zaidi. Uliza ni mtoa data yupi alitoa takwimu yoyote ya mtiririko wa soko la kubadilisha, kisha orodhesha angalau maelezo matatu ya mtiririko zaidi ya yale yanayotolewa. Vyanzo viwili vinapotokubaliana kuhusu kipimo kilekile, kagua kama hutumia seti tofauti za lebo badala ya kudhania kimoja ni kibaya. Kiashiria kinapowekwa juu ya bei, uliza kiliwekwa kufaa kipindi kipi na kikapimwa katika kipindi kipi. Weka kando simulizi yoyote inayoeleza kila matokeo, kwa sababu hadithi isiyoweza kuwa si sahihi haiwezi kutoa taarifa. Na chukulia misururu ya kihistoria ya kwenye mnyororo kama inayoweza kurekebishwa: taja mtoa data na tarehe wakati wowote unapoandika takwimu.

2a1901231ae4.en: Your stop order is a request, not a guarantee. Foundations and Forex Chapter 1, Lesson 7 defined slippage as the gap between the price you expected and the price you got. In a fast crypto move on a thin book — and Crypto Chapter 2, Lesson 1 showed you exactly how thin those books can be away from the top of the market — a stop can fill well past its level. Size on the assumption that your actual loss may exceed your planned loss, rather than on the assumption that the stop will hold.

Katika msogeo wa haraka wa kripto katika kitabu chembamba — na Kripto Sura ya 2, Somo la 1 lilikuonyesha hasa jinsi vitabu hivyo vinavyoweza kuwa vyembamba mbali na kilele cha soko — kusimamisha kunaweza kujazwa mbali sana zaidi ya kiwango chake. Panga ukubwa kwa dhana kwamba hasara yako halisi inaweza kuzidi hasara yako iliyopangwa, badala ya kwa dhana kwamba kusimamisha kutashikilia.

2a1c9f4e52ed.en: You will constantly hear "Bitcoin fixes X" and "Bitcoin is digital gold, a store of value." Treat both as claims to verify, not facts to accept. The 2008 paper itself describes electronic cash — a payment system; the store-of-value framing came later. And the evidence on it is genuinely contested: Foundations Chapter 2 showed you that Bitcoin's volatility has repeatedly undermined its short-term inflation-hedge record (Lesson 3), and that two careful academic studies of whether Bitcoin protects a stock portfolio reached opposite conclusions (Lesson 4). A contested claim can still turn out true. But "contested" is the honest description today, and anyone presenting it as settled is selling something.
2a1c9f4e52ed.sw: Utasikia mara kwa mara "Bitcoin inarekebisha X" na "Bitcoin ni dhahabu ya kidijitali, hifadhi ya thamani." Yachukulie yote mawili kama madai ya kuthibitisha, si ukweli wa kukubali. Karatasi ya 2008 yenyewe huelezea fedha taslimu ya kielektroniki — mfumo wa malipo; muktadha wa hifadhi ya thamani ulikuja baadaye. Na ushahidi juu yake unapingwa kweli: Misingi Sura ya 2 lilikuonyesha kwamba mtikisiko wa Bitcoin umedhoofisha mara kwa mara rekodi yake ya muda mfupi ya kujikinga na mfumuko wa bei (Somo la 3), na kwamba tafiti mbili makini za kitaaluma za kama Bitcoin hulinda kasha la hisa zilifikia hitimisho zinazopingana (Somo la 4). Dai linalopingwa bado linaweza kujitokeza kuwa kweli. Lakini "linapingwa" ndiyo maelezo ya kweli leo, na yeyote anayeliwasilisha kama lililotatuliwa anauza kitu.

2a8da7c6d1b9.sw: Orodha ya maneno (BIP-39; kwa kawaida maneno 12 au 24) inayosimba siri kuu inayozalisha upya funguo zote za pochi.

2a8ff528aaad.en: Put both stops at 2 times the daily move computed earlier. Forex: 2 x 0.44% = 0.88% of price, which is about 95 pips. Position = 50 / 0.0088 = 5,669 dollars of exposure. Bitcoin: 2 x 2.41% = 4.82% of price. Position = 50 / 0.0482 = 1,038 dollars of exposure. The ratio is 5,669 / 1,038 = 5.5 times — the same 5.5 from the daily volatility comparison. Position size scales inversely with volatility. Everything above that comes from your choice of stop multiple, not from the asset.
2a8ff528aaad.sw: Weka kusimamisha kote kuwili katika mara 2 ya msogeo wa kila siku uliohesabiwa awali. Forex: 2 x 0.44% = 0.88% ya bei, ambayo ni takriban pipi 95. Nafasi = 50 / 0.0088 = dola 5,669 za kufunuliwa. Bitcoin: 2 x 2.41% = 4.82% ya bei. Nafasi = 50 / 0.0482 = dola 1,038 za kufunuliwa. Uwiano ni 5,669 / 1,038 = mara 5.5 — ileile 5.5 kutoka ulinganisho wa mtikisiko wa kila siku. Ukubwa wa nafasi hupimwa kinyume na mtikisiko. Kila kitu juu ya hicho hutoka chaguo lako la kizidishi cha kusimamisha, si kutoka rasilimali.

2aa4fb79736b.en: Correct — real trading never guarantees a return, so a promise of guaranteed or unusually high returns is the clearest sign of a scam. Losing streaks, spreads and news moves are ordinary features of real markets.
2aa4fb79736b.sw: Sahihi — biashara halisi haihakikishi faida kamwe, hivyo ahadi ya faida ya uhakika au kubwa isivyo kawaida ndiyo ishara iliyo wazi zaidi ya ulaghai. Mifululizo ya hasara, spread na misogeo ya habari ni sifa za kawaida za masoko halisi.

2aa71cee09d6.en: The shares are expensive relative to peers
2aa71cee09d6.sw: Hisa ni ghali ikilinganishwa na wenzake

2ab294b6a7f1.en: An annualized percentage is not something you can place a stop against. Convert it to a daily figure, because a stop lives inside a day or two of price movement. The conversion is the square root of time. Divide the annual figure by the square root of the number of trading periods in a year. Forex uses about 252 trading days, because the market closes at the weekend. Crypto uses 365, because it never closes at all.
2ab294b6a7f1.sw: Asilimia ya mwaka si kitu unachoweza kuweka kusimamisha dhidi yake. Ibadilishe kuwa takwimu ya kila siku, kwa sababu kusimamisha huishi ndani ya siku moja au mbili za msogeo wa bei. Ubadilishaji ni mzizi wa mraba wa wakati. Gawanya takwimu ya mwaka kwa mzizi wa mraba wa idadi ya vipindi vya biashara katika mwaka. Forex hutumia takriban siku 252 za biashara, kwa sababu soko hufunga wikendi. Kripto hutumia 365, kwa sababu haifungi kamwe kabisa.

2abee711822a.en: The journal is what turns expectancy (Lesson 2) from a formula into a number you actually know about yourself, and it is the only way to tell the difference between a losing system and a winning system in a normal losing streak. The checklist protects the next trade; the journal improves the next hundred.
2abee711822a.sw: Kumbukumbu ndicho kinachogeuza matarajio (Somo la 2) kutoka fomula kuwa namba unayoijua hasa kuhusu nafsi yako, na ndiyo njia pekee ya kutofautisha kati ya mfumo unaopoteza na mfumo unaoshinda katika mfululizo wa kawaida wa hasara. Orodha ya ukaguzi hulinda biashara inayofuata; kumbukumbu huboresha mia inayofuata.

2adb21bc3b11.en: This is the least glamorous lesson in the track and probably the most valuable. Nothing else in the course lets you change your expected outcome by a sixth using information that is already public and takes an afternoon to find.
2adb21bc3b11.sw: Hili ndilo somo lisilovutia zaidi katika njia hii na pengine lenye thamani kubwa zaidi. Hakuna kingine katika kozi kinachokuruhusu kubadilisha matokeo yako yanayotarajiwa kwa sehemu moja ya sita ukitumia taarifa ambazo tayari ni za umma na huchukua mchana mmoja kuzipata.

2af38204af00.en: This is why the recovery phrase matters more than the device. Standard recovery phrases can generally be restored into other compatible wallets, which means the phrase — not the hardware and not the app — is what you are actually preserving. A setup that can only be recovered using one company's software is a setup with a corporate dependency you did not intend to take on.
2af38204af00.sw: Ndiyo maana kifungu cha urejeshaji kina maana zaidi ya kifaa. Vifungu vya kawaida vya urejeshaji kwa ujumla vinaweza kurejeshwa katika pochi nyingine zinazoendana, jambo linalomaanisha kifungu — si maunzi na si programu — ndicho unachokihifadhi hasa. Mpangilio unaoweza kurejeshwa kwa kutumia programu ya kampuni moja pekee ni mpangilio wenye utegemezi wa kampuni ambao hukukusudia kuuchukua.

2b11c46b4a4b.en: Because implementation costs — spreads, management fees and taxes — apply to a real fund but not to the paper portfolios the study measured
2b11c46b4a4b.sw: Kwa sababu gharama za utekelezaji — spread, ada za usimamizi na kodi — hutumika kwa fund halisi lakini si kwa mikusanyiko ya karatasi ambayo utafiti ulipima

2b15173887ad.en: The pool of real-world assets an issuer holds to back its tokens.
2b15173887ad.sw: Bwawa la rasilimali za ulimwengu halisi ambazo mtoaji hushikilia kuunga mkono tokeni zake.

2b6b528421a8.en: A rule returning a holding to its target weight once it drifts beyond a set distance from it, rather than on a calendar date.
2b6b528421a8.sw: Kanuni inayorudisha umiliki kwenye uzito wake lengwa mara unapotelezea zaidi ya umbali uliowekwa kutoka kwake, badala ya katika tarehe ya kalenda.

2b820ceeee62.en: Buying a diversified basket of productive companies and holding it for twenty years passes the first test comfortably and makes the second largely irrelevant, because you are not trying to beat anyone. Trading in and out of single companies on the strength of a news headline fails both.
2b820ceeee62.sw: Kununua kikapu kilichosambazwa cha kampuni zenye tija na kukishikilia kwa miaka ishirini hupita jaribio la kwanza kwa raha na hufanya la pili lisihusike kwa kiasi kikubwa, kwa sababu hujaribu kumshinda mtu yeyote. Kufanya biashara ya kuingia na kutoka katika kampuni moja kwa nguvu ya kichwa cha habari hushindwa yote mawili.

2b93f7b3d6da.en: Diagram mapping each common beginner mistake to the fix and the lesson that already gives it — no plan, over-risking, moving stops, cutting winners and riding losers, overtrading, chasing news, indicator overload, and trusting unverified claims — plus the two habits that catch them: a pre-trade checklist and a trading journal
2b93f7b3d6da.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha kila kosa la kawaida la anayeanza dhidi ya suluhisho na somo linalotoa tayari — hakuna mpango, kuhatarisha kupita kiasi, kusogeza stop, kukata washindi na kupanda wapotezaji, kufanya biashara kupita kiasi, kufukuza habari, kujaza viashiria, na kuamini madai yasiyothibitishwa — pamoja na tabia mbili zinazoyakamata: orodha ya ukaguzi ya kabla ya biashara na kumbukumbu ya biashara

2b994537b7a8.en: The holding must now be sold entirely

2bac5ed5ca60.en: Decide this number in a form you would repeat out loud. Chapter 2 Lesson 3 showed that crypto behaves as a high-beta risk asset rather than as a diversifier, and that the diversification argument largely failed in 2022 when it was needed. An allocation you would be embarrassed to say to someone whose judgement you respect is a signal, and it is usually a reliable one.
2bac5ed5ca60.sw: Amua namba hii katika namna ambayo ungeirudia kwa sauti. Sura ya 2 Somo la 3 lilionyesha kwamba kripto hutenda kama rasilimali ya hatari yenye beta kubwa badala ya kama mtawanyaji, na kwamba hoja ya mtawanyiko kwa kiasi kikubwa ilishindwa mwaka 2022 ilipohitajika. Mgawanyo ambao ungeona aibu kumwambia mtu ambaye unaheshimu hukumu yake ni ishara, nayo kwa kawaida inaaminika.

2bb7514fff74.en: The academic work here is specific enough to be useful. Xia and colleagues, in a paper titled Trade or Trick, published in the Proceedings of the ACM on Measurement and Analysis of Computing Systems in 2021, examined tokens listed on the Uniswap decentralised exchange. They identified more than ten thousand scam tokens, and estimated that roughly half of all tokens listed there were scam tokens created for exactly this purpose.
2bb7514fff74.sw: Kazi ya kitaaluma hapa ni maalum vya kutosha kuwa na manufaa. Xia na wenzake, katika karatasi yenye kichwa Trade or Trick, iliyochapishwa katika Proceedings of the ACM on Measurement and Analysis of Computing Systems mwaka 2021, walichunguza tokeni zilizoorodheshwa katika soko lisilo na kituo kikuu la Uniswap. Walitambua zaidi ya tokeni elfu kumi za ulaghai, na wakakadiria kwamba takriban nusu ya tokeni zote zilizoorodheshwa hapo zilikuwa tokeni za ulaghai zilizoundwa kwa madhumuni hayo hasa.

2bbc81358baa.en: Set that beside the Nasdaq: a 78% fall took fifteen years, a 57% fall took five and a half. The relationship between how far a market falls and how long it takes to come back is not reliable enough to plan around, which is why Chapter 3 Lesson 1 insisted on treating drawdown depth and drawdown duration as two separate risks.
2bbc81358baa.sw: Weka hiyo kando ya Nasdaq: kushuka kwa 78% kulichukua miaka kumi na mitano, kushuka kwa 57% kulichukua miaka mitano na nusu. Uhusiano kati ya soko linashuka kiasi gani na linachukua muda gani kurudi hauaminiki vya kutosha kupangia, ndiyo maana Sura ya 3 Somo la 1 lilisisitiza kutendea kina cha kushuka na muda wa kushuka kama hatari mbili tofauti.

2bcf305214f5.en: Not quite. The finding is real and important, but it describes averages across large baskets over decades — not reliability, and certainly not individual shares. The value premium has gone missing for years at a stretch, which is exactly why "it worked on average historically" is a weaker claim than it sounds.
2bcf305214f5.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Tokeo ni halisi na muhimu, lakini hueleza wastani katika vikapu vikubwa katika miongo — si kutegemewa, na hakika si hisa binafsi. Malipo ya ziada ya thamani yamepotea kwa miaka mfululizo, ambayo ndiyo hasa sababu "ilifanya kazi kwa wastani kihistoria" ni dai dhaifu kuliko linavyosikika.

2be0d6194c06.en: Correct. Operating cash flow of 120 million less capital spending of 110 million leaves roughly 10 million of free cash flow. The 90 million profit figure describes a far more generous business than the cash actually available, and only the cash can be paid out or reinvested by choice.
2be0d6194c06.sw: Sahihi. Mtiririko wa fedha wa shughuli wa milioni 120 kutoa matumizi ya mtaji ya milioni 110 huacha takriban milioni 10 ya mtiririko huru wa fedha. Takwimu ya faida ya milioni 90 hueleza biashara yenye ukarimu mkubwa mno kuliko fedha zinazopatikana hasa, na fedha tu ndizo zinazoweza kulipwa au kuwekezwa tena kwa chaguo.

2be58d66731b.en: Diagram of the reflexive loop in a market with no cash flows: a story attracts buying, buying raises the price, the higher price is read as proof of the story, which attracts more buying - and the identical circle running in reverse, where doubt causes selling, falling prices are read as proof the story was wrong, and more selling follows
2be58d66731b.sw: Mchoro wa kitanzi cha kujiakisi katika soko lisilo na mitiririko ya fedha: hadithi huvutia ununuzi, ununuzi hupandisha bei, bei ya juu husomwa kama uthibitisho wa hadithi, jambo linalovutia ununuzi zaidi - na duara lilelile likikimbia kinyume, ambapo shaka husababisha uuzaji, bei zinazoshuka husomwa kama uthibitisho hadithi ilikuwa si sahihi, na uuzaji zaidi hufuata

2bf0484ee21e.en: Not quite. The advertised fee is only part of what separates a fund from its index. Tracking difference captures the total shortfall, and here the fund with the higher fee delivered a smaller one.
2bf0484ee21e.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ada iliyotangazwa ni sehemu tu ya kinachotenganisha fund na index yake. Tofauti ya kufuatilia hunasa upungufu wa jumla, na hapa fund yenye ada kubwa zaidi ilitoa upungufu mdogo zaidi.

2bfa8891d5cd.en: Academic work has documented how industrialised this has become. Bowen He and co-authors presented a study of what they call Drainer-as-a-Service at the ACM Internet Measurement Conference in October 2025. The picture they describe is a division of labour: specialist operators build and maintain the theft toolkits, while separate affiliates run the phishing sites and split the proceeds through automated profit-sharing contracts. Their dataset covered thousands of affiliate accounts and tens of thousands of profit-sharing transactions. The finding worth carrying away is not any single number. It is that the person targeting you is very unlikely to be improvising.
2bfa8891d5cd.sw: Kazi ya kitaaluma imeandika jinsi hii ilivyokuwa ya kiviwanda. Bowen He na waandishi wenzake waliwasilisha utafiti wa kile wanachokiita Drainer-as-a-Service katika ACM Internet Measurement Conference mwezi Oktoba 2025. Picha wanayoieleza ni mgawanyo wa kazi: waendeshaji wataalamu hujenga na kutunza vifaa vya wizi, huku washirika tofauti wakiendesha tovuti za uvuvi na kugawana mapato kupitia mikataba ya kiotomatiki ya kugawana faida. Seti yao ya data ilifunika maelfu ya akaunti za washirika na makumi ya maelfu ya miamala ya kugawana faida. Matokeo yanayostahili kuchukuliwa si namba yoyote moja. Ni kwamba mtu anayekulenga hana uwezekano wowote wa kuboreka papo hapo.

2c075765136f.en: The transmission chain from rates outward, how regimes pick the winning pillar, and why all-quiet means cash.
2c075765136f.sw: Mnyororo wa usambazaji kutoka viwango kwenda nje, jinsi hali zinavyochagua nguzo inayoshinda, na kwa nini utulivu kamili unamaanisha fedha taslimu.

2c089d381e97.en: Here is the step nobody explains at signup. When you deposit one bitcoin to a centralized exchange, the bitcoin moves on-chain to a wallet whose private keys the exchange controls. From that moment, the blockchain says the exchange owns that coin. What you own is a promise: a balance in the company's internal records that says the exchange owes you one bitcoin.
2c089d381e97.sw: Hii hapa hatua ambayo hakuna anayeieleza wakati wa kujisajili. Unapoweka bitcoin moja katika soko la kubadilisha lenye kituo kikuu, bitcoin husogea kwenye mnyororo kwenda pochi ambayo soko hudhibiti funguo zake za faragha. Kuanzia wakati huo, mnyororo wa vitalu husema soko linamiliki sarafu hiyo. Unachomiliki ni ahadi: salio katika rekodi za ndani za kampuni linalosema soko linakudai bitcoin moja.

2c1f82456903.en: Not quite. Drift means the fall lands on a much larger position than the one you chose: the portfolio finishes at roughly 99% of its peak, giving back essentially the entire gain. The position does return to about 5% afterwards, but only by losing the money first.
2c1f82456903.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Telezo humaanisha kushuka huangukia nafasi kubwa zaidi kuliko ile uliyoichagua: kasha humaliza katika takriban 99% ya kilele chake, likirudisha kimsingi faida yote. Nafasi hurudi takriban 5% baadaye, lakini kwa kupoteza pesa kwanza pekee.

2c578d22b975.en: Fund A charges 0.07% a year and has lagged its index by 0.19% annually. Fund B charges 0.12% and has lagged by 0.10%. Which has served its investors better, and why?
2c578d22b975.sw: Fund A hutoza 0.07% kwa mwaka na imekawia index yake kwa 0.19% kila mwaka. Fund B hutoza 0.12% na imekawia kwa 0.10%. Ni ipi imewahudumia wawekezaji wake vizuri zaidi, na kwa nini?

2c6b810e61d4.en: Correct — it is the stop-out mechanism from Chapter 3, Lesson 2 at scale: each wave of triggered stops adds selling into a thin market, driving price down and setting off the next wave.
2c6b810e61d4.sw: Sahihi — ni utaratibu wa stop-out kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 2 kwa kipimo kikubwa: kila wimbi la stop zilizoanzishwa huongeza kuuza katika soko jembamba, likisukuma bei chini na kuanzisha wimbi linalofuata.

2c6d96d78b39.en: Notice what the security actually rests on. Not secrecy — everything here is public. Not trust in any participant. It rests on arithmetic anyone can check in milliseconds, plus work that takes the whole world's mining power to produce. Cheap to verify, expensive to forge.
2c6d96d78b39.sw: Tambua usalama unategemea nini hasa. Si usiri — kila kitu hapa ni cha umma. Si imani kwa mshiriki yeyote. Unategemea hesabu ambayo yeyote anaweza kuikagua kwa milisekunde, pamoja na kazi inayochukua nguvu ya uchimbaji ya dunia nzima kuizalisha. Nafuu kuthibitisha, ghali kughushi.

2c73442a3b46.sw: Kutambua hatari, kuhukumu kama inastahili kuchukuliwa, na kudhibiti gharama yake inayowezekana.

2c7ee403f89d.en: An investor contributing monthly stopped their contributions in November 2008 and resumed in 2013, without ever selling. What was the main cost of that decision?
2c7ee403f89d.sw: Mwekezaji anayechangia kila mwezi aliacha michango yake mwezi Novemba 2008 na kuanza tena mwaka 2013, bila kuuza kamwe. Gharama kuu ya uamuzi huo ilikuwa ipi?

2c8c857a467c.sw: Mkakati huacha kufanya kazi kwa bahati nasibu

2ca0fed06e89.sw: Hukuwa agizo la kikomo (si agizo la soko) mara linapoanzishwa.

2cb74c29c9f8.sw: Mtumiaji wa kwanza alitoa baada ya kusimamishwa kwa biashara tarehe 7 Februari

2cbb558f8e3d.en: Once a year, read your plan from Chapter 4 Lesson 3 alongside what you actually did. Note every place they differ. For each difference, write whether the plan was wrong or the deviation was. Both happen. Only one of them is a reason to change the document.
2cbb558f8e3d.sw: Mara moja kwa mwaka, soma mpango wako kutoka Sura ya 4 Somo la 3 sambamba na kile ulichofanya hasa. Andika kila mahali wanapotofautiana. Kwa kila tofauti, andika kama mpango ulikuwa si sahihi au kupotoka ndiko kulikuwa si sahihi. Vyote hutokea. Ni kimoja tu kati yake ndicho sababu ya kubadilisha hati.

2cc74f176f60.en: For forex, a practical, widely-used pairing is the 20-period and 50-period SMA (stock traders often add the 200-day; that's a different market's convention). What a single SMA gives you is a cleaner read of the trend direction than raw candles — a downward-sloping 20 SMA says the last 20 periods have, on average, been falling.
2cc74f176f60.sw: Kwa forex, uwianishaji wa kivitendo unaotumika kwa upana ni SMA ya vipindi 20 na 50 (wafanyabiashara wa hisa mara nyingi huongeza ya siku 200; hiyo ni desturi ya soko tofauti). Kile ambacho SMA moja hukupa ni usomaji safi zaidi wa mwelekeo kuliko mishumaa ghafi — SMA ya 20 inayoteremka chini inasema vipindi 20 vya mwisho, kwa wastani, vimekuwa vikishuka.

2ccdea14ba7e.en: Write down the current balance you hold at each exchange, and next to each, the number that would remain if that exchange stopped responding tomorrow. Then compare the largest of those balances against the cap you wrote in your custody map last lesson. If you have not written the cap yet, this exercise is the argument for doing it.
2ccdea14ba7e.sw: Andika salio la sasa unaloshikilia katika kila soko la kubadilisha, na kando ya kila moja, namba ambayo ingebaki ikiwa soko hilo lingeacha kujibu kesho. Kisha linganisha kubwa zaidi kati ya salio hizo dhidi ya dari uliyoiandika katika ramani yako ya utunzaji somo lililopita. Ikiwa hujaandika dari bado, zoezi hili ndiyo hoja ya kuifanya.

2cd990f78136.en: Not quite — an attestation is a snapshot: it confirms the stated reserves existed on the report date, nothing more. It is not a full audit, not a guarantee, and it did not stop USDC trading near 0.88 dollars in March 2023.
2cd990f78136.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — ushuhuda ni picha ya wakati: huthibitisha akiba zilizotajwa zilikuwepo tarehe ya ripoti, si zaidi. Si ukaguzi kamili, si hakikisho, wala haukuzuia USDC kufanyiwa biashara karibu na dola 0.88 mwezi Machi 2023.

2cddc2576db6.en: FOMO, Unit Bias and the Hype Cycle
2cddc2576db6.sw: FOMO, Upendeleo wa Kipimo na Mzunguko wa Utangazaji

2cf267c6f3f4.en: Problem two is attribution. Even if the pattern were real, crediting it to the halving requires that nothing else large moved on a similar schedule. Something else always did.
2cf267c6f3f4.sw: Tatizo la pili ni kuhusisha sababu. Hata kama muundo ungekuwa halisi, kuuhusisha na kupunguzwa nusu kunahitaji kwamba hakuna kitu kingine kikubwa kilichosogea kwa ratiba inayofanana. Kitu kingine daima kilisogea.

2cf87da1a0ed.en: For a cyclical company the multiple looks most attractive at exactly the wrong moment.
2cf87da1a0ed.sw: Kwa kampuni ya mzunguko kizidishi kinaonekana cha kuvutia zaidi hasa katika wakati usio sahihi.

2cfdc8f1b71b.en: Funding payments are a genuine cash flow, and they are also unstable by construction: the rate exists to balance the two sides, so it moves against whichever side becomes crowded. Chapter 4 Lesson 2's test applies here as much as anywhere. Trace the yield to an activity, and note which activity it is.
2cfdc8f1b71b.sw: Malipo ya ufadhili ni mtiririko halisi wa fedha, nayo pia hayana uthabiti kwa muundo: kiwango kipo ili kusawazisha pande mbili, kwa hivyo husogea dhidi ya upande wowote unaojaa. Mtihani wa Sura ya 4 Somo la 2 hutumika hapa kama mahali pengine popote. Fuatilia mavuno hadi shughuli, na utambue ni shughuli ipi.

2d062f456ef8.en: Two rules admit no exceptions and are worth stating plainly. A recovery phrase is never typed into anything connected to the internet, and it is never photographed. A phrase that has been in a photo library, a password manager, a note application or a cloud backup should be treated as compromised, and the correct response is to move the funds to a newly generated wallet rather than to hope.
2d062f456ef8.sw: Kanuni mbili hazikubali vighairi nazo zinastahili kutajwa wazi. Kifungu cha urejeshaji hakiandikwi kamwe katika chochote kilichounganishwa na mtandao, wala hakipigwi picha kamwe. Kifungu kilichokuwa katika maktaba ya picha, meneja wa manenosiri, programu ya noti au nakala rudufu ya wingu kinapaswa kuchukuliwa kama kimeathiriwa, na jibu sahihi ni kusogeza fedha kwenda pochi iliyozalishwa upya badala ya kutumaini.

2d137a388b6d.en: A low market cap next to a huge FDV is not a bargain. It is a schedule. It tells you that a large quantity of supply is contracted to arrive later, usually at a cost basis far below yours. Before you use either number, check three things: what the circulating supply is, what the total supply is, and when the difference unlocks.
2d137a388b6d.sw: Kiasi kidogo cha soko kando ya FDV kubwa mno si bei nafuu. Ni ratiba. Hukuambia kwamba kiasi kikubwa cha usambazaji kimeahidiwa kwa mkataba kufika baadaye, kwa kawaida kwa msingi wa gharama ulio chini sana ya wako. Kabla ya kutumia namba yoyote kati ya hizo, kagua mambo matatu: usambazaji unaozunguka ni upi, usambazaji jumla ni upi, na tofauti hufunguliwa lini.

2d1f4f54405d.en: Diagram showing the base/quote breakdown of a currency pair and the historical pecking order that determines which currency is listed first
2d1f4f54405d.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha mgawanyo wa msingi/bei wa jozi la sarafu na daraja la kihistoria linaloamua ni sarafu ipi inaorodheshwa kwanza

2d1fe08c5212.en: A feedback loop in which the mechanism intended to restore a peg makes the underlying problem worse, so that each corrective step accelerates the collapse.

2d25342f94af.en: It is fair to ask whether this much care over a few dollars of pip value really matters. The answer comes from the mathematics of losing, not winning.

2d717431219e.en: No legitimate support agent, wallet company, exchange, or app will ever ask for your seed phrase. Ever. There is no technical task — "validating," "syncing," "unlocking," "verifying your wallet" — that requires it. A person or website asking for your seed phrase is attempting to take your money, with a script polished on thousands of victims before you. This is currently one of the most common ways crypto is actually stolen: not by breaking the mathematics, but by asking politely.
2d717431219e.sw: Hakuna wakala halali wa huduma, kampuni ya pochi, soko la kubadilisha, au programu itakayowahi kuomba kifungu chako cha mbegu. Kamwe. Hakuna kazi ya kiufundi — "kuthibitisha," "kusawazisha," "kufungua," "kuhakiki pochi yako" — inayohitaji kifungu. Mtu au tovuti inayoomba kifungu chako cha mbegu inajaribu kuchukua pesa yako, kwa hati iliyoboreshwa kwa maelfu ya waathiriwa kabla yako. Hii kwa sasa ni mojawapo ya njia zinazojitokeza zaidi ambazo kripto huibiwa hasa: si kwa kuvunja hisabati, bali kwa kuomba kwa adabu.

2e29f8f465ba.en: Watch for these in your own trading: When you close a trade early, ask honestly — is this my plan executing, or the disposition effect offering me a sure small win? When you are still holding a position past where your stop should have been, ask the same question in reverse — plan, or hope? Count your trades over a week: are you trading because a setup genuinely met your rules, or because you were bored, confident, or chasing a loss back? And is each trade's exit placed as an order before you enter, so the decision is already made and not left to you to fumble in the moment?

2ee5d178adcf.en: It's easy to casually call a pair like USD/MXN a "minor" pair, since it's less liquid than a major — but by standard classification, it's actually an exotic pair. A true minor (cross) pair never involves USD at all — it's two majors paired directly, like CAD/JPY. Precision matters here because exotic pairs carry meaningfully different risk (lower liquidity, wider spreads, higher volatility) than true minors.
2ee5d178adcf.sw: Ni rahisi kuliita jozi kama USD/MXN jozi "ndogo" kwa mzaha, kwa kuwa lina ukwasi mdogo kuliko jozi kuu — lakini kwa uainishaji wa kawaida, kwa kweli ni jozi adimu. Jozi la kweli ndogo (la kuvuka) halihusishi USD kabisa — ni jozi kuu mbili zilizowekwa pamoja moja kwa moja, kama CAD/JPY. Usahihi unahusika hapa kwa sababu jozi adimu hubeba hatari tofauti kwa maana halisi (ukwasi mdogo, spread pana zaidi, mtikisiko mkubwa zaidi) kuliko jozi ndogo za kweli.

2f874f690765.en: In 1933, with U.S. gold reserves under severe strain, the government required citizens to exchange gold coin and bullion for currency, ending public redemption of dollars for gold domestically. In 1934, the Gold Reserve Act officially devalued the dollar from $20.67 to $35 per ounce — the U.S. left the domestic gold standard, but kept a modified, international-only version alive at that new rate.
2f874f690765.sw: Mwaka 1933, akiba za dhahabu za Marekani zikiwa chini ya shinikizo kali, serikali iliwataka raia kubadilisha sarafu na madini ya dhahabu kwa fedha, ikimaliza ukombozi wa umma wa dola kwa dhahabu ndani ya nchi. Mwaka 1934, Sheria ya Akiba ya Dhahabu ilishusha rasmi thamani ya dola kutoka $20.67 hadi $35 kwa wakia — Marekani iliacha kiwango cha dhahabu cha ndani, lakini ikaweka hai toleo lililorekebishwa, la kimataifa tu, kwa kiwango hicho kipya.

2fb6f4ba2114.en: This reframes everything the course has built. The whole point of Chapters 1 through 3 was to let you decide the things that matter — position size, stop, target, the ratio — in advance, while you are calm and thinking clearly. Discipline is simply honouring those decisions when fear and greed show up, which they will. That is why the tools are the answer, not gritted teeth: an OCO order (Chapter 1, Lesson 7) executes your exit whether or not you can bring yourself to click; a pre-set position size (Chapter 3, Lesson 1) removes the greedy "go bigger just this once." The plan is your defence against your own psychology — and building that plan properly is the subject of the next lesson.
2fb6f4ba2114.sw: Hii hupanga upya kila kitu ambacho kozi imekijenga. Kusudi lote la Sura ya 1 hadi 3 lilikuwa kukuruhusu uamue mambo yanayohusika — ukubwa wa nafasi, stop, lengo, uwiano — mapema, ukiwa mtulivu na unafikiri kwa uwazi. Nidhamu ni kuheshimu tu maamuzi hayo hofu na tamaa zinapojitokeza, ambazo zitajitokeza. Ndiyo sababu zana ndizo jibu, si meno yaliyokazwa: agizo la OCO (Sura ya 1, Somo la 7) hutekeleza kutoka kwako iwe unaweza kujilazimisha kubofya au huwezi; ukubwa wa nafasi uliowekwa mapema (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1) huondoa "nenda kubwa zaidi mara hii tu" ya tamaa. Mpango ni kinga yako dhidi ya saikolojia yako mwenyewe — na kujenga mpango huo ipasavyo ni mada ya somo lijalo.

2fbf4b2fcfc8.en: Fees are quoted as small annual percentages, which makes them sound trivial. The arithmetic of compounding them over an investing lifetime is not trivial at all, and it is the most reliably ignored number in personal investing.

2fc1d20de2a3.en: Not quite. Carry, expressed as dividend or shareholder yield, is a legitimate pillar, and sentiment can genuinely support a case. The failure here is that all three readings derive from the same event, so they are not independent evidence.

2ff325dec436.en: As markets fell, leveraged investors rushed to close their carry positions all at once. The same crowding that had paid on the way up now punished everyone on the way down, together.

Kufunga biashara kulimaanisha kununua yen tena — mamilioni ya wafanyabiashara wakinunua sarafu ile ile kwa wakati mmoja — hivyo yen haikupona tu, ilipanda ghafla. Msongamano ule ule uliokuwa umelipa njiani kwenda juu sasa uliadhibu kila mtu njiani kwenda chini, kwa pamoja.

308338b4f073.en: At 1:1, break-even win rate = 1 / (1 + 1) = 50%. At 1:2, it is 1 / (1 + 2) = 33.3%. At 1:3, it is 1 / (1 + 3) = 25%. So with a 1:3 ratio, you can lose three trades out of four and still break even. Going the other way, if your reward is only half your risk (you take 15-pip profits behind a 30-pip stop), R is 0.5 and the break-even win rate climbs to 1 / 1.5 = 66.7% — you now have to win two out of every three trades just to stand still.
308338b4f073.sw: Kwa 1:1, kiwango cha ushindi cha kulingana = 1 / (1 + 1) = 50%. Kwa 1:2, ni 1 / (1 + 2) = 33.3%. Kwa 1:3, ni 1 / (1 + 3) = 25%. Hivyo kwa uwiano wa 1:3, unaweza kupoteza biashara tatu kati ya nne na bado ukalingana. Kwenda upande mwingine, kama tuzo yako ni nusu tu ya hatari yako (unachukua faida za pip 15 nyuma ya stop ya pip 30), R ni 0.5 na kiwango cha ushindi cha kulingana hupanda hadi 1 / 1.5 = 66.7% — sasa lazima ushinde biashara mbili kati ya kila tatu ili tu kusimama tuli.

30a37365597f.en: Heimer & Simsek (2019), published in the Journal of Financial Economics, studied exactly this question using a natural experiment: when the US imposed its 50:1/20:1 leverage cap in 2010, the researchers compared American traders (now capped) against otherwise-similar European traders (still uncapped at the time) using a difference-in-differences approach. They found the leverage constraint reduced trading volume by 23%, and — the key result — improved high-leverage traders' portfolio returns by 18 percentage points per month, alleviating their losses by roughly 40%. Their conclusion: the trading the cap eliminated was disproportionately speculative rather than informed, meaning the restriction removed harmful activity rather than useful market participation.
30a37365597f.sw: Heimer & Simsek (2019), waliochapisha katika Journal of Financial Economics, walisoma swali hili hasa kwa kutumia jaribio la asili: Marekani ilipoweka kikomo chake cha leverage cha 50:1/20:1 mwaka 2010, watafiti walilinganisha wafanyabiashara wa Marekani (sasa wenye kikomo) dhidi ya wafanyabiashara wa Ulaya wanaofanana kwa mengine (bado bila kikomo wakati huo) kwa kutumia mbinu ya tofauti-ndani-ya-tofauti. Waligundua kikwazo cha leverage kilipunguza kiasi cha biashara kwa 23%, na — tokeo muhimu — kiliboresha faida za mikusanyiko ya wafanyabiashara wa leverage kubwa kwa pointi 18 za asilimia kwa mwezi, kikipunguza hasara zao kwa takriban 40%. Hitimisho lao: biashara ambayo kikomo kiliiondoa ilikuwa ya kubahatisha kwa kiwango kisicholingana badala ya kuwa yenye taarifa, ikimaanisha kikwazo kiliondoa shughuli yenye madhara badala ya ushiriki wa soko wenye manufaa.

30da5a85aef0.en: So the roadmap's "5 times" is defensible as a rough floor, and it is not a fact. The verified range across the sources checked for this lesson runs from roughly 4 times to roughly 10 times, depending on which crypto window, which currency benchmark, and which years you pick. The academic measurement over 2014 to 2017 sits near 10 times; the recent commercial measurements sit nearer 5 to 7. Crypto's volatility has also fallen over the past decade, so an old multiple overstates today and a calm-period multiple understates a stress period. Never quote a bare multiple. Quote the window with it, or quote the range.
30da5a85aef0.sw: Kwa hivyo "mara 5" ya ramani inaweza kutetewa kama sakafu ya makadirio, nayo si ukweli. Kiwango kilichothibitishwa katika vyanzo vilivyokaguliwa kwa somo hili huenda kutoka takriban mara 4 hadi takriban mara 10, kutegemea ni dirisha lipi la kripto, ni kigezo kipi cha sarafu, na ni miaka ipi unayochagua. Kipimo cha kitaaluma katika 2014 hadi 2017 hukaa karibu na mara 10; vipimo vya kibiashara vya hivi karibuni hukaa karibu na 5 hadi 7. Mtikisiko wa kripto pia umeshuka katika muongo uliopita, kwa hivyo kizidishi cha zamani hukuza leo na kizidishi cha kipindi tulivu hupunguza kipindi cha msongo. Usinukuu kamwe kizidishi tupu. Nukuu dirisha pamoja nacho, au nukuu kiwango.

30db532fca09.en: Everything in Forex Chapter 1, Lesson 6 and Forex Chapter 3, Lesson 2 carries over intact. Leverage is borrowed buying power, margin is your own capital held as collateral, and the two are inverses: at 50x the margin requirement is 1 divided by 50, which is 2% of the position. Equity is balance plus or minus floating profit and loss. Free margin is equity minus used margin. Effective leverage is total position size divided by equity, and it, not the venue's advertised maximum, sets your distance to trouble. The crypto venue changes the vocabulary and one piece of the arithmetic. There is no broker phoning you. There is a threshold, and a bot.
30db532fca09.sw: Kila kitu katika Forex Sura ya 1, Somo la 6 na Forex Sura ya 3, Somo la 2 huendelea kikiwa kamili. Usawa ni salio pamoja au ukiondoa faida na hasara inayoelea. Mkopo huru ni usawa ukiondoa mkopo uliotumika. Mzingo halisi ni ukubwa jumla wa nafasi ukigawanywa na usawa, nao, si kiwango cha juu kinachotangazwa na uwanja, huweka umbali wako hadi matatizo. Uwanja wa kripto hubadilisha msamiati na kipande kimoja cha hesabu. Hakuna dalali anayekupigia simu. Kuna kizingiti, na roboti.
