32c78f6f4b88.en: True or False: once in a trade, it is fine to widen the stop if the thesis is still intact but price is moving against you uncomfortably.
32c78f6f4b88.sw: Kweli au Uongo: mara ukiwa ndani ya biashara, ni sawa kupanua stop kama nadharia bado iko sawa lakini bei inasogea dhidi yako kwa namna isiyostarehesha.

32e013c43f78.en: Correct — 240 dollars of collateral against 200 DAI of debt is a 120 percent ratio, below the 150 percent requirement, so the smart contract liquidates the position automatically. That machinery is what keeps every circulating DAI overbacked.
32e013c43f78.sw: Sahihi — dola 240 za dhamana dhidi ya deni la DAI 200 ni uwiano wa asilimia 120, chini ya hitaji la asilimia 150, kwa hivyo mkataba mahiri hufilisi nafasi kiotomatiki. Mitambo hiyo ndiyo inayoweka kila DAI inayozunguka ikiungwa mkono kwa ziada.

32e28acbb719.en: A 33 percent fall is unremarkable. Leverage converts it into a forced sale at the worst available price.
32e28acbb719.sw: Kushuka kwa asilimia 33 si kwa kawaida. Leverage hukugeuza kuwa uuzaji wa lazima kwa bei mbaya zaidi inayopatikana.

32e8e862a5ad.en: The hardest regime to trade is the one where nothing is happening.
32e8e862a5ad.sw: Hali ngumu zaidi kufanyia biashara ni ile ambapo hakuna kinachotokea.

3304a2255e02.en: Total supply is every unit that has been created, including locked and unvested units. Max supply is the hard ceiling the software will ever allow. For Bitcoin, Chapter 1 Lesson 1 showed that ceiling is just under 21 million. Many tokens have no max supply at all.
3304a2255e02.sw: Usambazaji jumla ni kila kipimo kilichoundwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na vipimo vilivyofungiwa na visivyoiva. Usambazaji wa juu kabisa ni dari ngumu ambayo programu itawahi kuiruhusu. Kwa Bitcoin, Sura ya 1 Somo la 1 lilionyesha dari hiyo ni chini kidogo ya milioni 21. Tokeni nyingi hazina usambazaji wa juu kabisa hata kidogo.

3328f86d7319.en: Kelly's formula is well-proven, but it has a serious practical problem for real trading: it requires you to already know your true win rate and reward-to-risk ratio — numbers a beginner (and honestly, most traders) can't estimate reliably. Worse, "full Kelly" is aggressive enough that even with a genuine edge, it can produce 50–80% drawdowns along the way. This is precisely why professional traders and quants typically use "fractional Kelly" — a half or quarter of the full formula — trading some theoretical growth for dramatically less volatility.
3328f86d7319.sw: Fomula ya Kelly ina uthibitisho mzuri, lakini ina tatizo kubwa la kivitendo kwa biashara halisi: inakuhitaji ujue tayari kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi na uwiano wa tuzo-kwa-hatari — namba ambazo anayeanza (na kwa uaminifu, wafanyabiashara wengi) hawawezi kuzikadiria kwa kutegemewa. Vibaya zaidi, "Kelly kamili" ni ya ukali wa kutosha kiasi kwamba hata ukiwa na faida halisi, inaweza kuzalisha kushuka kwa 50–80% njiani. Hii ndiyo hasa sababu wafanyabiashara wa kitaaluma na wataalamu wa hesabu kwa kawaida hutumia "Kelly ya sehemu" — nusu au robo ya fomula kamili, wakibadilisha ukuaji fulani wa kinadharia kwa mtikisiko mdogo zaidi kwa kiasi kikubwa.

333d095fc944.en: Because timing the market is prohibited for retail investors
333d095fc944.sw: Kwa sababu kupanga muda wa soko ni marufuku kwa wawekezaji wa rejareja

33456f37b867.en: Build these into your routine: Run the pre-trade checklist every single time — a planned setup, a real stop as an order, a ratio that clears your minimum, size within your risk percentage, and no chasing. When you break a rule, write down which one and why; the pattern in your journal is your real list of mistakes. Be most suspicious of anything that removes the need to think — a signal to copy, a promise of guaranteed returns, a can't-lose setup. And remember that a losing streak inside a positive-expectancy system is not a mistake; abandoning the system because of it is.
33456f37b867.sw: Jenga haya katika utaratibu wako: Pitia orodha ya ukaguzi ya kabla ya biashara kila mara moja — mpangilio uliopangwa, stop halisi kama agizo, uwiano unaopita kiwango chako cha chini, ukubwa ndani ya asilimia yako ya hatari, na kutokufukuza. Unapovunja kanuni, andika ni ipi na kwa nini; mtindo katika kumbukumbu yako ndio orodha yako halisi ya makosa. Kuwa na shaka zaidi na chochote kinachoondoa hitaji la kufikiri — ishara ya kunakili, ahadi ya faida ya uhakika, mpangilio usioweza kupoteza. Na kumbuka kwamba mfululizo wa hasara ndani ya mfumo wenye matarajio chanya si kosa; kuacha mfumo kwa sababu yake ndiyo kosa.

334e0e4b6b85.en: While researching this lesson, a live search turned up a trading blog claiming "a study covering over 8,000 chart setups" found a "62% average success rate" — no named author, no journal, no link. Before trusting a number like this, what would you want to see before believing it?
334e0e4b6b85.sw: Wakati wa kufanya utafiti wa somo hili, utafutaji wa moja kwa moja ulipata blogu ya biashara ikidai "utafiti unaohusu mipangilio zaidi ya 8,000 ya chati" uligundua "kiwango cha wastani cha mafanikio cha 62%" — hakuna mwandishi aliyetajwa, hakuna jarida, hakuna kiungo. Kabla ya kuamini namba kama hii, ungependa kuona nini kabla ya kuiamini?

334f93d8a48e.en: Notice that you already have every component from earlier chapters — the plan just assembles them. What and when to trade comes from Chapter 2 (indicators, fundamentals, the economic calendar). The stop goes at the invalidation level from Foundations Chapter 2 and Chapter 2, Lesson 5. The target sits at a real support or resistance level, and must clear your risk-to-reward minimum from Chapter 3, Lesson 3. Position size comes from the formula in Chapter 3, Lesson 1, capped by a fixed risk percentage. The plan is not new material; it is these decisions written down in advance.
334f93d8a48e.sw: Tambua kwamba tayari una kila kipengele kutoka sura zilizotangulia — mpango huviunganisha tu. Cha kufanyia biashara na lini hutoka Sura ya 2 (viashiria, misingi, kalenda ya kiuchumi). Stop huenda kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika kutoka Sura ya 2 ya Msingi na Sura ya 2, Somo la 5. Lengo hukaa kwenye kiwango halisi cha msaada au upinzani, na lazima lipite kiwango chako cha chini cha hatari-kwa-tuzo kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 3. Ukubwa wa nafasi hutoka kwenye fomula katika Sura ya 3, Somo la 1, ukiwekewa kikomo na asilimia thabiti ya hatari. Mpango si nyenzo mpya; ni maamuzi haya yakiandikwa mapema.

3350f29ff7dc.en: Every cycle in crypto's history has had a rotating cast of themes like this. This course will not tell you which theme is running now, and will never tell you which token expresses it. That is deliberate, and it is worth being clear about why.
3350f29ff7dc.sw: Kila mzunguko katika historia ya kripto umekuwa na kundi linalozunguka la mada kama hizi. Kozi hii haitakuambia ni mada ipi inayoendeshwa sasa, wala haitakuambia kamwe ni tokeni ipi inayoieleza. Hilo ni la makusudi, nayo inastahili kuwa wazi kwa nini.

3352f8e28996.en: Dollars make expectancy concrete, but they change with account size and position size, which makes it hard to compare trades or systems. The fix is to measure everything in the R unit from Chapter 3, Lesson 3.
3352f8e28996.sw: Dola hufanya matarajio kuwa halisi, lakini hubadilika kulingana na ukubwa wa akaunti na ukubwa wa nafasi, jambo linalofanya iwe vigumu kulinganisha biashara au mifumo. Suluhisho ni kupima kila kitu kwa kipimo cha R kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 3.

336400a75dcb.en: Start with the mechanisms, because two of them are genuinely important and Chapter 3 Lesson 4 introduced the first.
336400a75dcb.sw: Anza na taratibu, kwa sababu mbili kati yao ni muhimu kweli na Sura ya 3 Somo la 4 lilianzisha la kwanza.

3381fbd6cf5a.en: In crypto the no-trade regime is harder to observe than anywhere else in this course, because the market never closes and there is always something happening somewhere. A 24-hour market manufactures the appearance of opportunity continuously. Nothing aligning is a legitimate and common state, and the absence of an enforced pause means you have to supply it yourself.
3381fbd6cf5a.sw: Katika kripto utawala wa kutofanya biashara ni mgumu zaidi kuuona kuliko mahali pengine popote katika kozi hii, kwa sababu soko halifungi kamwe na daima kuna kitu kinachotokea mahali fulani. Soko la saa 24 hutengeneza mwonekano wa fursa kwa kuendelea. Kutokupatana kwa lolote ni hali halali na ya kawaida, na kukosekana kwa kusimama kwa lazima humaanisha lazima ukitoe wewe mwenyewe.

339313eb71b4.en: Not quite — the stop belongs at the invalidation level where the thesis is proven wrong, not at an arbitrary distance.
339313eb71b4.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — stop inastahili kuwa kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika ambapo nadharia inathibitishwa kuwa batili, si kwa umbali wa bahati nasibu.

339588686f69.en: Circle publishes monthly attestation reports for USDC signed by a major accounting firm. What does an attestation actually establish?
339588686f69.sw: Circle huchapisha ripoti za ushuhuda za kila mwezi za USDC zilizotiwa sahihi na kampuni kuu ya uhasibu. Ushuhuda huthibitisha nini hasa?

33a2d8bb5ed8.en: An attacker must redo the proof-of-work for the edited block and every block after it, faster than the honest network keeps extending the real chain
33a2d8bb5ed8.sw: Mshambuliaji lazima arudie uthibitisho-wa-kazi kwa kitalu kilichohaririwa na kila kitalu kinachofuata, kwa kasi zaidi kuliko mtandao mwaminifu unavyoendelea kupanua mnyororo halisi

33ac2b69320a.en: The fall from a peak price to the lowest point that follows, expressed as a percentage of the peak. A 77% drawdown means the price lost more than three-quarters of its value before it stopped falling. Recovering from an 80% drawdown requires a 400% gain.
33ac2b69320a.sw: Kushuka kutoka bei ya kileleni hadi nukta ya chini kabisa inayofuata, kukielezwa kama asilimia ya kilele. Kushuka kwa 77% humaanisha bei ilipoteza zaidi ya robo tatu ya thamani yake kabla ya kuacha kushuka. Kupona kutoka kushuka kwa 80% kunahitaji ongezeko la 400%.

33ae0887ab43.en: Diagram showing one trade measured in R with a stop at minus 1R and target at plus 2R, a table of break-even win rates (1:1 needs 50 percent, 1:2 needs 33.3 percent, 1:3 needs 25 percent), and three traders over ten trades where a 40 percent win rate at 1:2 and a 60 percent win rate at 1:1 both make plus 2R while a 70 percent win rate at 1:0.5 makes only plus 0.5R
33ae0887ab43.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha biashara moja ikipimwa kwa R ukiwa na stop kwa toa 1R na lengo kwa jumlisha 2R, jedwali la viwango vya ushindi vya kulingana (1:1 huhitaji asilimia 50, 1:2 huhitaji asilimia 33.3, 1:3 huhitaji asilimia 25), na wafanyabiashara watatu katika biashara kumi ambapo kiwango cha ushindi cha asilimia 40 kwa 1:2 na kiwango cha ushindi cha asilimia 60 kwa 1:1 vyote hufanya jumlisha 2R ilhali kiwango cha ushindi cha asilimia 70 kwa 1:0.5 hufanya jumlisha 0.5R tu

33c4be231ea0.en: Not quite — re-read the three functions: medium of exchange, store of value, and unit of account.
33c4be231ea0.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — soma tena kazi tatu: njia ya kubadilishana, hifadhi ya thamani, na kipimo cha hesabu.

33ddda526035.en: That ownership is real but limited. It does not entitle you to walk into the company and take a desk. It entitles you to two things: a vote on certain decisions, and a claim on whatever value is left over after everyone else has been paid.
33ddda526035.sw: Umiliki huo ni halisi lakini una mipaka. Haukupi haki ya kuingia kampunini na kuchukua dawati. Hukupa haki ya vitu viwili: kura juu ya maamuzi fulani, na dai juu ya thamani yoyote iliyobaki baada ya kila mtu mwingine kulipwa.

33e92b50442b.en: A correct market has no volatility

33ff2be251aa.en: Two panels comparing a roulette wheel, where 37 pockets and a 35 to 1 payout give an expected return of about 0.973 units per unit staked, with owning productive businesses, where cash is generated outside the transactions between investors so every owner can gain at once.

3414513d76b1.sw: Ada hutozwa juu ya salio lote kila mwaka, hivyo hujikusanya dhidi yako. 1.45% kwa mwaka ilikuwa theluthi moja ya chungu cha mwisho.

3424a16419b9.en: The value of the fund's holdings per fund share.
3424a16419b9.sw: Thamani ya umiliki wa fund kwa kila hisa ya fund.

343580f2c11a.en: Price repeatedly reverses at these levels — a probability built from history, not a guaranteed wall.
343580f2c11a.sw: Bei hugeuka mara kwa mara kwenye viwango hivi — uwezekano uliojengwa kutoka historia, si ukuta wa uhakika.

343c630c2241.en: Your equity minus the margin currently used by open positions. It is the cushion available to absorb further losses and to open new trades.
343c630c2241.sw: Usawa wako kutoa margin inayotumiwa sasa na nafasi zilizo wazi. Ndio mto unaopatikana kufyonza hasara zaidi na kufungua biashara mpya.

3446a6fd80c5.en: Profit involves judgement in a way cash does not. How quickly to depreciate equipment, when a sale counts as made, how much to set aside for bad debts — each is a legitimate choice within the rules, and each moves reported profit. Cash from operations is harder to shape because it tracks money that actually arrived. This is why experienced readers start with the cash flow statement, which is the opposite of what most beginners do.
3446a6fd80c5.sw: Faida huhusisha hukumu kwa njia ambayo fedha haihusishi. Kasi ya kushusha thamani ya vifaa, lini mauzo huhesabika kuwa yamefanyika, kiasi gani cha kutenga kwa madeni mabaya — kila kimoja ni chaguo halali ndani ya kanuni, na kila kimoja husogeza faida iliyoripotiwa. Fedha kutoka shughuli ni ngumu zaidi kuiumba kwa sababu hufuatilia pesa zilizofika hasa. Ndiyo sababu wasomaji wenye uzoefu huanza na taarifa ya mtiririko wa fedha, ambako ni kinyume cha wanaoanza wengi wanavyofanya.

3449601295a1.en: What to look for when you next open a holding. Confirm three things, in this order.
3449601295a1.sw: Cha kutazama utakapofungua umiliki wako ujao. Thibitisha vitu vitatu, kwa mpangilio huu.

344af402ecd8.en: Problem three gets skipped most often. The halving is not news. Its date has been calculable from Bitcoin's source code since 2009. Every participant knows the exact block height and the exact new subsidy, years ahead. The efficient-markets argument says that a fully known future supply change should already be reflected in today's price. Nobody should be able to earn a reliable profit from information everyone already has. This idea is associated with the economist Eugene Fama, whose 1970 review article Efficient Capital Markets: A Review of Theory and Empirical Work, in the Journal of Finance, set out the framework and the evidence for it.
344af402ecd8.sw: Tatizo la tatu hurukwa mara nyingi zaidi. Kupunguzwa nusu si habari. Tarehe yake imekuwa ikihesabika kutoka msimbo wa chanzo wa Bitcoin tangu 2009. Kila mshiriki hujua kimo hasa cha kitalu na ruzuku mpya hasa, miaka mapema. Hoja ya masoko yenye ufanisi husema kwamba badiliko la usambazaji la baadaye linalojulikana kikamilifu linapaswa kuwa tayari limeakisiwa katika bei ya leo. Hakuna anayepaswa kuweza kupata faida ya kuaminika kutoka taarifa ambayo kila mtu tayari anayo. Wazo hili linahusishwa na mchumi Eugene Fama, ambaye makala yake ya mapitio ya 1970 Efficient Capital Markets: A Review of Theory and Empirical Work, katika Journal of Finance, iliweka mfumo na ushahidi wake.

34514e875c47.en: Because trailing P/E ratios ignore the share price
34514e875c47.sw: Kwa sababu uwiano wa P/E wa nyuma hupuuza bei ya hisa

3456bfdbea12.en: The prevailing environment of the market: whether risk appetite is rising or falling, whether volatility is low or high, and whether prices are trending or ranging. The regime determines which strategies have an edge and which are traps.
3456bfdbea12.sw: Mazingira yaliyopo ya soko: kama hamu ya hatari inapanda au inashuka, kama mtikisiko uko chini au juu, na kama bei zina mwelekeo au ziko kwenye ukanda. Hali huamua ni mikakati ipi yenye faida na ipi ni mitego.

3485b3492b9b.en: Correct — if the reward per win is smaller than the risk per loss, even a 70% win rate can barely break even or lose. Win rate is only half the story; the risk-to-reward ratio is the other half.
3485b3492b9b.sw: Sahihi — kama tuzo kwa kila ushindi ni ndogo kuliko hatari kwa kila hasara, hata kiwango cha ushindi cha 70% kinaweza kulingana kwa shida au kupoteza. Kiwango cha ushindi ni nusu ya simulizi tu; uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo ni nusu nyingine.

34910e988b37.en: The ratio matters because it decides how often you actually have to be right just to stay level. Wins have to pay for losses, and a bigger reward per win means each win pays for more losses.
34910e988b37.sw: Uwiano unahusika kwa sababu huamua ni mara ngapi lazima uwe sahihi hasa ili tu kubaki sawa. Ushindi lazima ulipie hasara, na tuzo kubwa zaidi kwa kila ushindi inamaanisha kila ushindi hulipia hasara zaidi.

34a374ebb7cf.en: Nothing changes, because rates rose as predicted
34a374ebb7cf.sw: Hakuna kinachobadilika, kwa sababu viwango vilipanda kama ilivyotabiriwa

34b1bf917d54.en: Both studies agree on the pattern even where they disagree on the size. The gap is near zero in broad, boring, automatically-contributed funds. It is largest in the funds people trade actively.
34b1bf917d54.sw: Tafiti zote mbili zinakubaliana kuhusu muundo hata pale zinapotofautiana kuhusu ukubwa. Pengo liko karibu na sifuri katika mifuko mipana, ya kuchosha, inayochangiwa kiotomatiki. Ni kubwa zaidi katika mifuko ambayo watu huifanyia biashara kwa bidii.

34be0ed2f7df.en: Government bond yields have risen sharply over three months. Credit spreads have widened. You are considering a company valued almost entirely on profits expected after 2035. The chain says the two moves you have already observed work directly against the third position, through both the discount rate and the economic channel. That does not mean the company is a bad business or that the shares must fall. It means your thesis now owes an explanation for why this company is an exception, and if you do not have one, you have been reading the last link and calling it news.
34be0ed2f7df.sw: Mavuno ya hatifungani za serikali yamepanda kwa kasi katika miezi mitatu. Mianya ya mikopo imepanuka. Unafikiria kampuni inayotathminiwa karibu kabisa juu ya faida zinazotarajiwa baada ya 2035. Mnyororo unasema misogeo miwili uliyoiona tayari inafanya kazi moja kwa moja dhidi ya msimamo wa tatu, kupitia kiwango cha punguzo na njia ya kiuchumi. Hilo halimaanishi kampuni ni biashara mbaya au kwamba hisa lazima zishuke. Linamaanisha nadharia yako sasa inadaiwa maelezo ya kwa nini kampuni hii ni ubaguzi, na ikiwa huna moja, umekuwa ukisoma kiungo cha mwisho na kukiita habari.

34e136606b8c.en: Decompressing the forecast is what makes the thesis falsifiable. Cheap is an opinion and cannot be wrong on a date. The market expects a 5% annual decline and I expect flat can be wrong, visibly, at the next set of results. Only the second kind of claim can teach you anything.
34e136606b8c.sw: Kufungua utabiri ndicho kinachofanya nadharia iweze kukanushwa. Bei nafuu ni maoni na hayawezi kuwa si sahihi katika tarehe. Soko linatarajia kushuka kwa 5% kwa mwaka na mimi natarajia tuli kunaweza kuwa si sahihi, kwa kuonekana, katika seti ijayo ya matokeo. Ni aina ya pili tu ya dai inayoweza kukufundisha kitu.

34f7a87e0330.en: Not quite — the problem is timing. Correlations run toward 1 in severe selloffs, so the holdings you kept for independence fall together exactly when that independence was meant to help.
34f7a87e0330.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — tatizo ni muda. Uhusiano hukimbia kuelekea 1 katika uuzaji mkali, kwa hivyo umiliki uliouweka kwa ajili ya uhuru hushuka pamoja hasa wakati uhuru huo ulipaswa kusaidia.

35270e97c23a.en: Whether the fund is priced in their home currency
35270e97c23a.sw: Kama fund imewekewa bei kwa sarafu ya nyumbani kwao

353483488737.sw: Kwa sababu msogeo wa kawaida wa kila siku hufunika umbali huo mara kwa mara, kwa hivyo nafasi husimamishwa na kelele badala ya kwa kuwa si sahihi

3537ad7a693b.en: True or False: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003) found that markets respond symmetrically — good and bad news of equal size move prices by equal amounts.
3537ad7a693b.sw: Kweli au Uongo: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003) waligundua kwamba masoko huitikia kwa usawa — habari njema na mbaya za ukubwa sawa husogeza bei kwa viasi sawa.

353d42a3e13f.en: Not quite — difficulty adjustment retunes how hard the puzzle is, every 2,016 blocks, so the block pace stays near 10 minutes no matter how much mining power joins. The coin schedule never changes; only the cost of winning it does.
353d42a3e13f.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — marekebisho ya ugumu hurekebisha jinsi kitendawili kilivyo kigumu, kila vitalu 2,016, ili kasi ya vitalu ibaki karibu na dakika 10 bila kujali nguvu ngapi za uchimbaji zinajiunga. Ratiba ya sarafu haibadiliki kamwe; ni gharama ya kuishinda pekee inayobadilika.

3572b0a1e5fd.sw: Soko la Kubadilisha lisilo na Kituo Kikuu (DEX)

358e2944f2b0.en: An index is a rule. An exchange-traded fund is a way to own the thing the rule describes, in one purchase, on an exchange.
358e2944f2b0.sw: Index ni kanuni. Exchange-traded fund ni njia ya kumiliki kile ambacho kanuni huelezea, katika ununuzi mmoja, kwenye soko.

3595bb0b2346.en: Barber and Odean (2000), in The Journal of Finance, tracked 66,465 households at a discount broker over 1991 to 1996. Their finding is one of the most cited in behavioural finance: the households that traded the most earned 11.4% a year, while the market itself returned 17.9%. Same market, same years — the gap was activity. They concluded that overconfidence drives the excessive trading, and the excessive trading drives the underperformance. Their title puts it bluntly: trading is hazardous to your wealth.
3595bb0b2346.sw: Barber na Odean (2000), katika The Journal of Finance, walifuatilia kaya 66,465 kwenye broker wa punguzo kwa 1991 hadi 1996. Tokeo lao ni mojawapo yanayonukuliwa zaidi katika fedha za kitabia: kaya zilizofanya biashara zaidi zilipata 11.4% kwa mwaka, ilhali soko lenyewe lilirudisha 17.9%. Soko lile lile, miaka ile ile — pengo lilikuwa shughuli. Walihitimisha kwamba kujiamini kupita kiasi huendesha biashara ya kupita kiasi, na biashara ya kupita kiasi huendesha utendaji duni. Kichwa chao kinaeleza wazi: kufanya biashara ni hatari kwa utajiri wako.

359e09f59ba8.en: A feedback loop in which participants' beliefs change prices, and the changed prices are then treated as evidence for those beliefs. The market's opinion becomes part of what the market is measuring. The financier George Soros popularised the term for financial markets, most fully in a 2013 paper in the Journal of Economic Methodology.
359e09f59ba8.sw: Kitanzi cha mrejesho ambapo imani za washiriki hubadilisha bei, na bei zilizobadilika kisha huchukuliwa kama ushahidi wa imani hizo. Maoni ya soko huwa sehemu ya kile soko linachokipima. Mfadhili George Soros alifanya neno hili kuwa maarufu kwa masoko ya kifedha, kikamilifu zaidi katika karatasi ya 2013 katika Journal of Economic Methodology.

35be92cc719f.en: The three-letter codes you see in every currency pair aren't arbitrary abbreviations — they follow a real, formally maintained international standard.
35be92cc719f.sw: Misimbo ya herufi tatu unayoiona katika kila jozi la sarafu si vifupisho vya bahati nasibu — inafuata kiwango halisi cha kimataifa kinachodumishwa rasmi.

35c3f851688e.en: Long-term ownership, since the same shares are involved
35c3f851688e.sw: Umiliki wa muda mrefu, kwa kuwa hisa zile zile zinahusika

35d2a4f5034d.en: A known person, project or support channel imitated to solicit funds or a recovery phrase.
35d2a4f5034d.sw: Mtu, mradi au njia ya msaada inayojulikana ikiigwa ili kuomba fedha au kifungu cha urejeshaji.

35d5450ea3ad.en: A share has cash flows, so its price implies a specific forecast that can be stated and disagreed with; a currency has none, so its valuation is always relative
35d5450ea3ad.sw: Hisa ina mitiririko ya fedha, kwa hivyo bei yake huashiria utabiri maalum unaoweza kutajwa na kutokubaliwa; sarafu haina, kwa hivyo tathmini yake daima ni ya kulinganisha

35ed70eafc8f.sw: Ishara moja, mifumo mitatu tofauti — na kila mmoja wao unaweza kuzidiwa nguvu na hisia za soko.

36001364f6e3.en: The SEC's own framing is that the market price is generally kept close to NAV because of this arbitrage function inherent in the structure. Note the word generally. It is a mechanism, not a guarantee.
36001364f6e3.sw: Uwasilishaji wa SEC wenyewe ni kwamba bei ya soko kwa ujumla huwekwa karibu na NAV kwa sababu ya kazi hii ya arbitrage iliyomo katika muundo. Tambua neno kwa ujumla. Ni utaratibu, si uhakika.

3602ec146ed4.en: Not quite. Nobody chose the 9%, which is exactly the problem — and drift concentrates a portfolio rather than diversifying it. The remedy is not necessarily a full sale but a rule that restores the intended size.
3602ec146ed4.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Hakuna aliyechagua ile 9%, ambako ndilo hasa tatizo — na kupotea hujikita mkusanyiko badala ya kuusambaza. Suluhisho si lazima uuzaji kamili bali kanuni inayorejesha ukubwa uliokusudiwa.

3614fd5f71b0.en: This is what turns the pillars from a feeling into an edge. When your valuation pillar and your carry pillar and your momentum pillar all point the same way, you are not stacking opinions — you are aligning several independently documented return sources on a single trade.
3614fd5f71b0.sw: Hiki ndicho kinachogeuza nguzo kutoka hisia kuwa faida. Nguzo yako ya uthaminishaji na nguzo yako ya carry na nguzo yako ya kasi zote zinapoelekea upande ule ule, hurundiki maoni — unalinganisha vyanzo kadhaa vya faida vilivyoandikwa kwa kujitegemea kwenye biashara moja.

361566a79bf8.en: Be honest about the limits here, in the spirit of the Kelly caution from Chapter 1, Lesson 5. The precise risk-of-ruin number for a real strategy depends on inputs — your true win rate, your average win and loss, how correlated your trades are — that most traders cannot pin down reliably. So do not chase a specific ruin percentage from a calculator as if it were fact. Respect the direction the mathematics points, which is not in doubt: a smaller fraction risked per trade means dramatically lower odds of ruin.
361566a79bf8.sw: Kuwa mwaminifu kuhusu mipaka hapa, kwa roho ya tahadhari ya Kelly kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 5. Namba kamili ya hatari ya kufilisika kwa mkakati halisi hutegemea pembejeo — kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi, ushindi na hasara yako ya wastani, jinsi biashara zako zilivyo na uwiano — ambazo wafanyabiashara wengi hawawezi kuzibainisha kwa kutegemewa. Hivyo usifukuze asilimia mahususi ya kufilisika kutoka kikokotoo kana kwamba ni ukweli. Heshimu mwelekeo ambao hisabati inauonyesha, ambao hauna shaka: sehemu ndogo inayohatarishwa kwa kila biashara inamaanisha uwezekano mdogo mno wa kufilisika.

36177602c95c.en: This is the oldest structure in finance wearing new vocabulary, and it has one test that works every time.
36177602c95c.sw: Huu ndio muundo wa zamani zaidi katika fedha ukivaa msamiati mpya, nao una mtihani mmoja unaofanya kazi kila mara.

3627d65136f0.en: An investor holding both equities and cash finds their equity weight has dropped sharply after a large fall, purely because equities fell and cash did not. A rebalancing rule moves money from cash into equities to restore the intended weights, which means buying at depressed prices without any judgement about the bottom being required.
3627d65136f0.sw: Mwekezaji anayeshikilia hisa na fedha taslimu hukuta uzito wake wa hisa umeshuka kwa kasi baada ya kushuka kukubwa, kwa sababu tu hisa zilishuka na fedha taslimu haikushuka. Kanuni ya kusawazisha upya huhamisha pesa kutoka fedha taslimu kwenda hisa ili kurudisha uzito uliokusudiwa, jambo linalomaanisha kununua kwa bei zilizoshuka bila hukumu yoyote kuhusu bonde kuhitajika.

3648d9d9f88b.en: Counting holdings is in any case the wrong question, because holdings can be far less independent than they look.
3648d9d9f88b.sw: Kuhesabu umiliki ni swali lisilo sahihi kwa vyovyote vile, kwa sababu umiliki unaweza kuwa huru kwa kiwango kidogo mno kuliko unavyoonekana.

364912489d2c.en: Chang & Osler (1999), published in The Economic Journal, tested head-and-shoulders specifically on foreign exchange rates. It did generate statistically significant profits — but was "dominated" by simpler trading rules, meaning a plainer strategy achieved the same or better result with less complexity.
364912489d2c.sw: Chang & Osler (1999), waliochapisha katika The Economic Journal, walijaribu head-and-shoulders mahususi kwenye viwango vya ubadilishaji wa fedha za kigeni. Ulizalisha faida yenye maana kitakwimu — lakini ulikuwa "umezidiwa" na kanuni rahisi zaidi za biashara, ikimaanisha kwamba mkakati sahili zaidi ulifikia matokeo sawa au bora zaidi kwa utata mdogo.

3657fee55131.en: Both people in a trade have to want exactly what the other one has, at the same time. A farmer with vegetables who wants shoes has to find a shoemaker who happens to want vegetables — not meat, not tools. If not, the trade just doesn't happen.
3657fee55131.sw: Watu wote wawili katika biashara lazima watake hasa kile ambacho mwenzake anacho, kwa wakati mmoja. Mkulima mwenye mboga anayetaka viatu lazima ampate mshona-viatu ambaye kwa bahati anataka mboga — si nyama, si zana. Kama sivyo, biashara haifanyiki tu.

366adaac8669.en: Correct. A P/E well below peers is a question, not an answer. It usually means the market expects earnings to fall. Sometimes that expectation is wrong, which is where returns come from — but the ratio alone cannot distinguish an overlooked business from one whose problems are already known.
366adaac8669.sw: Sahihi. P/E iliyo chini mno ya wenzake ni swali, si jibu. Kwa kawaida humaanisha soko linatarajia mapato yatashuka. Wakati mwingine matarajio hayo hukosea, ambako ndiko faida hutoka — lakini uwiano peke yake hauwezi kutofautisha biashara iliyopuuzwa na ile ambayo matatizo yake tayari yanajulikana.

3691185ff537.en: The second currency listed in a pair. It's the currency the price is expressed in — how much of it one unit of the base currency costs.
3691185ff537.sw: Sarafu ya pili iliyoorodheshwa katika jozi. Ndiyo sarafu ambayo bei inaelezwa kwayo — kiasi chake ambacho kipimo kimoja cha sarafu ya msingi kinagharimu.

36dc87b95366.en: Correct — prediction accuracy alone doesn't determine success. A trader who controls losses well can be profitable even with a mediocre prediction record.
36dc87b95366.sw: Sahihi — usahihi wa utabiri peke yake hauamui mafanikio. Mfanyabiashara anayedhibiti hasara vizuri anaweza kupata faida hata akiwa na rekodi ya utabiri ya wastani.

36edb0300452.en: Correct. The instrument is the same but the source of return is not. Over a holding period of minutes, the businesses have generated nothing new, so any gain comes from whoever took the other side — before costs, which make the activity negative-sum in aggregate.
36edb0300452.sw: Sahihi. Chombo ni kile kile lakini chanzo cha faida si kile kile. Katika kipindi cha kushikilia cha dakika, biashara hazijazalisha chochote kipya, hivyo faida yoyote hutoka kwa yeyote aliyechukua upande mwingine — kabla ya gharama, ambazo hufanya shughuli iwe jumla-hasi kwa jumla.

370a59e3d551.en: Forex Chapter 6 Lesson 1 replaced a strong feeling with a written thesis scored against six pillars: fundamentals, valuation, catalyst, positioning, momentum and carry. The Stocks track adapted it for an asset with cash flows. This chapter adapts it for an asset that has none, which is a harder problem and an honest one.
370a59e3d551.sw: Forex Sura ya 6 Somo la 1 lilibadilisha hisia kali na nadharia iliyoandikwa iliyopimwa dhidi ya nguzo sita: misingi, tathmini, kichocheo, msimamo, kasi na kubeba. Njia ya Hisa iliirekebisha kwa rasilimali yenye mitiririko ya fedha. Sura hii huirekebisha kwa rasilimali isiyo na yoyote, ambalo ni tatizo gumu zaidi na la kweli.

371d2b32a180.en: The supply effect is real and easy to state. Before April 2024, the network issued about 328,500 new coins a year against a circulating supply near 19.7 million, roughly 1.67% annual growth. After April 2024, it issues about 164,250 a year against a supply that passed 20 million in March 2026, roughly 0.82%. Around 95% of the 21 million cap has already been mined.
371d2b32a180.sw: Athari ya usambazaji ni halisi na rahisi kutaja. Kabla ya Aprili 2024, mtandao ulitoa takriban sarafu mpya 328,500 kwa mwaka dhidi ya usambazaji unaozunguka karibu na milioni 19.7, takriban ukuaji wa 1.67% kwa mwaka. Baada ya Aprili 2024, hutoa takriban 164,250 kwa mwaka dhidi ya usambazaji uliopita milioni 20 mwezi Machi 2026, takriban 0.82%. Takriban 95% ya dari ya milioni 21 tayari imechimbwa.

37313f98fdcd.en: An ETF trading above or below its net asset value.
37313f98fdcd.sw: ETF inayofanyiwa biashara juu au chini ya thamani halisi ya mali yake.

374eac3419d6.en: Yes, pip value is always 10 dollars on a standard lot
374eac3419d6.sw: Ndiyo, thamani ya pip daima ni dola 10 kwenye lot sanifu

375d9123c20a.en: Correct. The pot is about 235,200 with no fee and about 195,900 at 6% net, so the fee took about 39,400 — roughly 16.7%. The fee is charged annually on the entire balance, including on growth that earlier fees already prevented, so the shortfall compounds alongside the portfolio.
375d9123c20a.sw: Sahihi. Kiasi ni takriban 235,200 bila ada na takriban 195,900 kwa 6% halisi, kwa hivyo ada ilichukua takriban 39,400 — takriban 16.7%. Ada hutozwa kila mwaka juu ya salio lote, ikijumuisha juu ya ukuaji ambao ada za awali tayari zilizuia, kwa hivyo upungufu hujilimbikiza sambamba na kasha.

37690840613e.en: It means the halving cannot happen on schedule
37690840613e.sw: Humaanisha kupunguzwa nusu hakuwezi kutokea kwa ratiba

378f03b3be18.en: Write down every recurring percentage you currently pay: fund charges, platform fees, and any advice fee. Add them into a single number. Then find the cheapest equivalent broad fund available to you and write its total next to yours. The gap between those two figures is the one number in this course you can change today with certainty.
378f03b3be18.sw: Andika kila asilimia ya kudumu unayoilipa sasa: malipo ya fund, ada za jukwaa, na ada yoyote ya ushauri. Ziongeze kuwa namba moja. Kisha pata fund pana inayolingana ya bei nafuu zaidi inayopatikana kwako na uandike jumla yake kando ya yako. Pengo kati ya takwimu hizo mbili ni namba moja katika kozi hii unayoweza kuibadilisha leo kwa uhakika.

37a2f12464f2.en: The diversification failed and was never real
37a2f12464f2.sw: Mtawanyiko ulishindwa na haukuwa halisi kamwe

37a32f3e59e1.en: The rule is tested hardest in the opposite direction to drift, when a holding falls and the temptation is to buy more of it.
37a32f3e59e1.sw: Kanuni hujaribiwa kwa ukali zaidi kwa mwelekeo wa kinyume na kupotea, umiliki unaposhuka na kishawishi ni kununua zaidi yake.

37a627fa0d4e.en: The gap between the bid and ask price. This is the built-in cost of entering and exiting a trade.
37a627fa0d4e.sw: Pengo kati ya bei ya bid na ask. Hii ndiyo gharama iliyojengwa ndani ya kuingia na kutoka katika biashara.

37a887ba03d2.sw: Aina za Maagizo na Utekelezaji wa Biashara

37b713b27e00.en: A unit of ownership in a company — a part-owner, not a lender.
37b713b27e00.sw: Kipimo cha umiliki katika kampuni — mmiliki mshirika, si mkopeshaji.

37b92c7bc121.en: A network where participants connect directly and share the work, with no central server.
37b92c7bc121.sw: Mtandao ambapo washiriki huunganishwa moja kwa moja na kushirikiana kazi, bila seva kuu.

37cdd96c2742.en: Cutting winners, riding losers. Taking small profits quickly while letting losses run — the disposition effect. Fixed by setting a risk-to-reward minimum before entry (Chapter 3, Lesson 3) and letting linked OCO orders execute the exit (Chapter 4, Lesson 1).
37cdd96c2742.sw: Kukata washindi, kupanda wapotezaji. Kuchukua faida ndogo kwa haraka huku ukiacha hasara zikimbie — athari ya kuachana na nafasi. Hurekebishwa kwa kuweka kiwango cha chini cha hatari-kwa-tuzo kabla ya kuingia (Sura ya 3, Somo la 3) na kuacha maagizo ya OCO yaliyounganishwa yatekeleze kutoka (Sura ya 4, Somo la 1).

37d6d9538afa.en: As a reliable source of extra return, since selling high and buying low adds value
37d6d9538afa.sw: Kama chanzo cha kuaminika cha faida ya ziada, kwa kuwa kuuza juu na kununua chini huongeza thamani

37e76a75f5bb.en: Borrowing and selling shares hoping to buy them back cheaper. Loss is unbounded.
37e76a75f5bb.sw: Kukopa na kuuza hisa ukitumaini kuzinunua tena kwa bei ya chini zaidi. Hasara haina kikomo.

37e928fcd832.en: The bunching of stop-loss and take-profit orders at round-number levels, which makes those levels act as support and resistance.
37e928fcd832.sw: Kurundikana kwa maagizo ya stop-loss na take-profit kwenye viwango vya namba za mviringo, kunakofanya viwango hivyo vitende kama msaada na upinzani.

37f33589024f.en: A typical explorer transaction page shows, whatever the chain: status — pending (still in the mempool), success (in a block), or failed (and failed transactions on Ethereum still pay gas, because the network did the work of running them); confirmations — how deep the transaction is buried, often shown as a live count; fee — what was actually paid, and on Ethereum, how it split between burned base fee and tip; and the from address, to address, and amount — the ledger entry itself.
37f33589024f.sw: Ukurasa wa kawaida wa muamala wa kichunguzi huonyesha, bila kujali mnyororo: hali — inasubiri (bado katika mempool), mafanikio (katika kitalu), au imeshindwa (na miamala iliyoshindwa katika Ethereum bado hulipa gesi, kwa sababu mtandao ulifanya kazi ya kuiendesha); uthibitisho — muamala umezikwa kwa kina kiasi gani, mara nyingi ukionyeshwa kama hesabu hai; ada — kilicholipwa hasa, na katika Ethereum, jinsi kilivyogawanyika kati ya ada ya msingi iliyochomwa na bakshishi; na anwani ya kutoka, anwani ya kwenda, na kiasi — kiingizo cha leja chenyewe.

381e11f48155.en: Market cap is one multiplication — the last traded price times circulating supply. It is not money invested, and it is not what you could sell for. What decides that is depth: how many orders are actually resting near the price. Volume, meanwhile, is the number crypto fakes most.
381e11f48155.sw: Kiasi cha soko ni kuzidisha kumoja — bei ya mwisho iliyofanyiwa biashara mara usambazaji unaozunguka. Si pesa iliyowekezwa, wala si kile ungeweza kuuza kwacho. Kinachoamua hilo ni kina: ni maagizo mangapi hasa yaliyopumzika karibu na bei. Ujazo, wakati huohuo, ndiyo namba ambayo kripto huighushi zaidi.

38366ddc6574.en: A position size that survived a 78% fall in one holding, from Chapter 3 Lesson 2. Diversification beyond a single concentrated index, from Chapter 2 Lesson 5. Continued contributions through the fall, which bought the trough. And a written sell condition, from the previous lesson, so that the decision to hold was a decision rather than a paralysis.
38366ddc6574.sw: Ukubwa wa nafasi unaonusurika kushuka kwa 78% katika umiliki mmoja, kutoka Sura ya 3 Somo la 2. Mtawanyiko unaozidi faharasa moja iliyokusanywa, kutoka Sura ya 2 Somo la 5. Michango inayoendelea wakati wa kushuka, iliyonunua bondeni. Na sharti la kuuza lililoandikwa, kutoka somo lililotangulia, ili uamuzi wa kushikilia uwe uamuzi badala ya kupooza.

383a67e20615.en: Take any market event you believe you understand and find the primary document about it — a regulator's report, an exchange notice, or a company filing. Read the summary. Then compare it with the version you held. This is the single habit that separates the course's method from the commentary that surrounds it, and it costs an hour.
383a67e20615.sw: Chukua tukio lolote la soko unaloamini unalielewa na utafute hati ya msingi kulihusu — ripoti ya mdhibiti, tangazo la soko, au wasilisho la kampuni. Soma muhtasari. Kisha ulinganishe na toleo ulilokuwa nalo. Hii ndiyo tabia moja inayotenganisha mbinu ya kozi na maoni yanayoizunguka, nayo hugharimu saa moja.

3852db82e35e.en: Before trading, put it into practice: check the actual current spread on the pair you're using rather than a marketing headline number, which is often a best-case minimum that doesn't hold at all hours. Compare the all-in cost (spread plus any commission), not just the quoted spread — a "0.0 pip spread" account with a large commission can cost the same as, or more than, a wider-spread account with no commission. And notice when spreads widen around news events or thin trading hours, factoring that into when you enter or exit a position.
3852db82e35e.sw: Kabla ya kufanya biashara, itekeleze: kagua spread halisi ya sasa kwenye jozi unalotumia badala ya namba ya kichwa cha habari cha matangazo, ambayo mara nyingi ni kiwango cha chini cha hali bora zaidi kisichoshikilia saa zote. Linganisha gharama ya jumla (spread pamoja na kamisheni yoyote), si spread inayonukuliwa tu — akaunti ya "spread ya pip 0.0" yenye kamisheni kubwa inaweza kugharimu sawa na, au zaidi ya, akaunti yenye spread pana isiyo na kamisheni. Na tambua spread inapopanuka wakati wa matukio ya habari au saa za biashara chache, ukizingatia hilo unapoingia au kutoka katika nafasi.

38647c28d573.en: Because the fund changed its investment strategy between the two years
38647c28d573.sw: Kwa sababu mfuko ulibadilisha mkakati wake wa uwekezaji kati ya miaka hiyo miwili

38675d4e33b4.en: The most important part of this case study is that none of it was a surprise to the research. Chapter 2, Lesson 3 gave you the finding in advance.
38675d4e33b4.sw: Sehemu muhimu zaidi ya uchunguzi huu ni kwamba hakuna kati ya haya kilichoushangaza utafiti. Sura ya 2, Somo la 3 lilikupa tokeo mapema.

386e032820f7.en: Two practical points finish the document, and both are about the plan surviving contact with real life.
386e032820f7.sw: Mambo mawili ya vitendo humalizia hati, na yote mawili yanahusu mpango kunusurika mkutano na maisha halisi.

3880c833cc25.en: Correct. No investor regards a large gain as a problem, yet the measure counts it as variation. More importantly, it is calibrated on the ordinary range, and extreme moves occur far more often than a normal distribution implies — so the measure understates precisely the event that matters.
3880c833cc25.sw: Sahihi. Hakuna mwekezaji anayechukulia faida kubwa kama tatizo, hata hivyo kipimo huihesabu kama kutofautiana. Muhimu zaidi, kimerekebishwa juu ya kiwango cha kawaida, na misogeo ya kupindukia hutokea mara nyingi zaidi mno kuliko mtawanyiko wa kawaida unavyodokeza — hivyo kipimo hueleza chini hasa tukio linalohusika.

388e35943e88.en: How much a price moves around. High volatility means large swings in both directions.
388e35943e88.sw: Kiasi bei inavyosogea. Mtikisiko mkubwa unamaanisha kuyumba kukubwa pande zote mbili.

38ac42999588.en: The recognisable feature of this structure is that the relationship comes first and the investment comes second. Nobody who contacts you unprompted, builds rapport over weeks, and then mentions an opportunity is doing those things in that order by accident.
38ac42999588.sw: Sifa inayotambulika ya muundo huu ni kwamba uhusiano huja kwanza na uwekezaji huja pili. Hakuna anayekufikia bila kuulizwa, anayejenga uhusiano kwa wiki, kisha anataja fursa anayefanya mambo hayo kwa mpangilio huo kwa bahati mbaya.

38d072ce2181.en: Fundamentals. In currencies this means growth, inflation and policy — economy-level data nobody controls. In equities it means the three statements from Chapter 2 Lesson 1, produced by the company being assessed, audited but not neutral. The information is far richer and its source has an interest in how it looks. Cash flow is the statement hardest to dress up, which is why that lesson gave it the most weight.
38d072ce2181.sw: Misingi. Katika sarafu hii humaanisha ukuaji, mfumuko wa bei na sera — data ya ngazi ya uchumi ambayo hakuna anayeidhibiti. Katika hisa humaanisha taarifa tatu kutoka Sura ya 2 Somo la 1, zinazotolewa na kampuni inayotathminiwa, zilizokaguliwa lakini si za upande wowote. Taarifa ni tajiri zaidi na chanzo chake kina maslahi katika jinsi inavyoonekana. Mtiririko wa fedha ndiyo taarifa ngumu zaidi kuipamba, ndiyo maana somo hilo lilitoa uzito mkubwa zaidi kwake.

38d38ec876eb.en: You place a stop to sell at 45. Bad news arrives overnight and the share opens at 38. The stop triggers immediately and sells near 38, not 45. Nothing malfunctioned. The order did exactly what it says, and what it says is different from what most people assume it says.
38d38ec876eb.sw: Unaweka stop ya kuuza kwa 45. Habari mbaya hufika usiku na hisa hufunguliwa kwa 38. Stop huanzishwa mara moja na huuza karibu na 38, si 45. Hakuna kilichoharibika. Agizo lilifanya hasa linavyosema, na linavyosema ni tofauti na watu wengi wanavyodhania linasema.

38d713712648.en: You invest 10,000, borrow 10,000, and hold 20,000 of shares with a 25% maintenance requirement. How far do the shares have to fall before a margin call?

38f8d54e9324.en: Here is the honest version of the trade-off. Exchange custody: the exchange holds the keys, you carry counterparty risk — hacks, frozen withdrawals, insolvency — and in return you get password resets, customer support, and instant trading. Hot wallet: you hold the keys on a connected device, you carry phishing, malware, and mistyped-address risk, and in return you use the network directly with no one's permission. Cold storage: you hold the keys offline, you carry irreversible-loss risk — lost seed, destroyed device, your own errors — and in return you get the strongest protection against remote theft.
38f8d54e9324.sw: Hii hapa toleo la kweli la maafikiano. Utunzaji wa soko la kubadilisha: soko hushikilia funguo, wewe hubeba hatari ya mshirika — udukuzi, utoaji uliogandishwa, kufilisika — na kwa malipo unapata kuweka upya nenosiri, huduma kwa wateja, na biashara ya papo hapo. Pochi ya moto: wewe hushikilia funguo katika kifaa kilichounganishwa, wewe hubeba hatari ya uvuvi, programu hasidi, na anwani iliyoandikwa vibaya, na kwa malipo unatumia mtandao moja kwa moja bila ruhusa ya mtu yeyote. Hifadhi ya baridi: wewe hushikilia funguo nje ya mtandao, wewe hubeba hatari ya hasara isiyoweza kutenduliwa — mbegu iliyopotea, kifaa kilichoharibiwa, makosa yako mwenyewe — na kwa malipo unapata ulinzi imara zaidi dhidi ya wizi wa mbali.

39b9924d7867.en: Standards bodies have caught up with this. The United States National Institute of Standards and Technology, in the fourth revision of its Digital Identity Guidelines, Special Publication 800-63B, classifies one-time passcodes delivered over the public telephone network as a restricted authenticator. The stated reasons include exactly this attack, namely the demonstrated ability of attackers to have telephone numbers reassigned to devices they control, alongside known weaknesses in telecom signalling that allow message interception.

Sababu zilizotajwa zinajumuisha shambulizi hili hasa, yaani uwezo ulioonyeshwa wa washambuliaji kufanya namba za simu zipewe upya kwa vifaa wanavyodhibiti, sambamba na udhaifu unaojulikana katika uashiriaji wa mawasiliano unaoruhusu kunasa ujumbe.

39e9770f8dc5.en: Most central banks target around 2% inflation, not 0%. Zero inflation removes a central bank's room to maneuver — it can't cut rates to fight a slowdown without risking deflation, which discourages spending and can deepen a recession. Moderate, steady inflation is the target precisely because both extremes are worse.

3a2f0285834f.en: A major currency pair at 7% annualized: 7 / square root of 252 = 0.44% per day. Bitcoin at 46% annualized: 46 / square root of 365 = 2.41% per day. The daily ratio is 2.41 / 0.44 = 5.5 times. On these inputs, an ordinary day in Bitcoin covers about five and a half times as much ground, in percentage terms, as an ordinary day in a major currency pair.
3a2f0285834f.sw: Jozi kuu ya sarafu katika 7% kwa mwaka: 7 / mzizi wa mraba wa 252 = 0.44% kwa siku. Bitcoin katika 46% kwa mwaka: 46 / mzizi wa mraba wa 365 = 2.41% kwa siku. Uwiano wa kila siku ni 2.41 / 0.44 = mara 5.5. Katika viingizo hivi, siku ya kawaida katika Bitcoin hufunika takriban mara tano na nusu ya ardhi, kwa maneno ya asilimia, kama siku ya kawaida katika jozi kuu ya sarafu.

Any plan that depends on reacting to a regime change is depending on the slower of the two, and it is the faster one that causes the damage.

3be8914f729a.en: If you have taken the Forex track, you already know this machine: bid, ask, and spread are Forex Chapter 1, Lesson 4; market orders, limit orders, and slippage are Forex Chapter 1, Lesson 7. A crypto CEX works the same way — the only twist is that the "coins" being matched are entries in the company's own ledger. How deep those books really are, and why reported volume can mislead, is Chapter 2, Lesson 1.

3c0df0a0e0fb.en: Position sizing assumes the asset stays yours while the price moves. Security risk breaks that assumption. A compromised key, a stolen exchange account, or a permission you granted eleven months ago does not reduce your position by 2%. It takes the position. The stop-loss is irrelevant, because the loss did not arrive through the price.
3c0df0a0e0fb.sw: Kupanga ukubwa wa nafasi hudhania rasilimali hubaki yako huku bei ikisogea. Hatari ya usalama huvunja dhana hiyo. Ufunguo ulioathiriwa, akaunti ya soko la kubadilisha iliyoibiwa, au ruhusa uliyoitoa miezi kumi na moja iliyopita haipunguzi nafasi yako kwa 2%. Huichukua nafasi. Kusimamisha hasara hakuna maana, kwa sababu hasara haikufika kupitia bei.

3c0e6393166a.en: In "The Foundation of Money and Trade," we covered why currencies exist and why their values float freely today rather than being pegged to gold. This lesson is where that history becomes practical.

3c27ca19cc52.en: What to look for before acting on any thesis, your own or someone else's. Check that each pillar rests on a different piece of evidence. Check that at least one has a date attached, since a thesis with no catalyst is a reason to wait. Write down what would falsify the valuation claim specifically, because that is the pillar most likely to be an opinion in disguise. And confirm that the position size would be acceptable if every pillar turned out to be wrong at once, which happens.

3ce12e776093.en: Crypto: Bitcoin is often called "digital gold" because its supply is capped at 21 million coins. But short-term price volatility has repeatedly overshadowed that case — an asset that can swing 10% in a day doesn't behave like a stable inflation hedge. Rising rates (the usual inflation response) also tend to pull speculative capital out of crypto, often pushing prices down exactly when the "digital gold" narrative would predict a rise.
3ce12e776093.sw: Crypto: Bitcoin mara nyingi huitwa "dhahabu ya kidijitali" kwa sababu ugavi wake una kikomo cha sarafu milioni 21. Lakini mtikisiko wa bei wa muda mfupi umefunika hoja hiyo mara kwa mara — mali inayoweza kuyumba 10% kwa siku moja haitendi kama kinga thabiti dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei. Viwango vya riba vinavyopanda (jibu la kawaida kwa mfumuko wa bei) pia huelekea kuvuta mtaji wa kubahatisha nje ya crypto, mara nyingi zikisukuma bei chini hasa wakati simulizi ya "dhahabu ya kidijitali" ingetabiri kupanda.

3d03f01d3346.en: What to look for. Anyone asking for your seed phrase is attacking you, with no exception, and support agent remains the most common costume. Anyone who contacts you first about a crypto problem is suspect by default, however helpful and technically fluent they are. An unexpected token, airdrop notice, refund claim or compensation offer in your wallet is a lure, not a windfall. When you connect a wallet to any site, look at what the approval actually asks for, and edit the limit before signing if it is unlimited. When your wallet asks you to sign something you cannot read or explain, reject it, because not being able to tell what a transaction does is the warning and not an inconvenience. When an account offers only SMS two-factor authentication, treat it as an account that should not hold much value. When a hardware wallet arrives with a recovery phrase already provided, or was bought anywhere other than the manufacturer, do not use it. And when a security figure is quoted at you, ask who published it, for which year, and by what method: the 2025 stolen-funds total ranged from roughly 3.35 billion to 4.04 billion dollars across three firms measuring the same thing.
3d03f01d3346.sw: Cha kuangalia. Yeyote anayeomba kifungu chako cha mbegu anakushambulia, bila ubaguzi wowote, na wakala wa huduma hubaki kuwa vazi linalojitokeza zaidi. Yeyote anayekufikia kwanza kuhusu tatizo la kripto ana shaka kwa msingi, hata awe msaidizi na mwenye ufasaha wa kiufundi kiasi gani. Tokeni isiyotarajiwa, tangazo la airdrop, dai la marejesho au ofa ya fidia katika pochi yako ni chambo, si bahati. Unapounganisha pochi na tovuti yoyote, angalia idhini inaomba nini hasa, na uhariri kikomo kabla ya kutia sahihi ikiwa hakina mpaka. Pochi yako inapokuomba utie sahihi kitu usichoweza kukisoma au kukieleza, kikatae, kwa sababu kutoweza kutambua muamala unafanya nini ndilo onyo na si usumbufu. Akaunti inapotoa uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili wa SMS pekee, ichukulie kama akaunti isiyopaswa kushikilia thamani nyingi. Pochi ya maunzi inapofika ikiwa na kifungu cha urejeshaji tayari kimetolewa, au ilinunuliwa mahali pengine popote zaidi ya mtengenezaji, usiitumie. Na takwimu ya usalama inaponukuliwa kwako, uliza nani aliichapisha, kwa mwaka upi, na kwa mbinu gani: jumla ya fedha zilizoibiwa za 2025 ilikuwa kati ya takriban dola bilioni 3.35 hadi bilioni 4.04 katika kampuni tatu zilizopima kitu kilekile.

3d2847087c54.en: There is a second-order point that connects back to Chapter 2. Funding rises precisely when one side is crowded. So the cost of holding is highest exactly when the position is most popular, which is exactly when the crowd is most vulnerable to being unwound. You pay the most to hold at the moment the position is most fragile. That is not a coincidence. It is the mechanism working as designed.
3d2847087c54.sw: Kuna hoja ya daraja la pili inayounganisha kurudi Sura ya 2. Ufadhili hupanda hasa wakati upande mmoja umejaa. Kwa hivyo gharama ya kushikilia ni kubwa zaidi hasa wakati nafasi ni maarufu zaidi, ambao ndio hasa wakati kundi liko hatarini zaidi kufunguliwa. Unalipa zaidi kushikilia wakati ambapo nafasi ni dhaifu zaidi. Hiyo si bahati mbaya. Ni utaratibu ukifanya kazi kama ulivyoundwa.

3d3cd3f1335b.en: Two careful studies, major US stocks, overlapping years, opposite conclusions. How? A large part of the answer is methodology — and in particular the exit rule. Caginalp and Laurent closed each trade at an averaged price over a fixed short holding period; Marshall, Young and Rose tested differently. The pattern entry was similar; the rule for getting out differed, and the profitability flipped with it.
3d3cd3f1335b.sw: Tafiti mbili makini, hisa kuu za Marekani, miaka inayoingiliana, hitimisho za kinyume. Vipi? Sehemu kubwa ya jibu ni mbinu — na hasa kanuni ya kutoka. Caginalp na Laurent walifunga kila biashara kwa bei ya wastani katika kipindi kifupi thabiti cha kushikilia; Marshall, Young na Rose walijaribu tofauti. Kuingia kwa mtindo kulikuwa sawa; kanuni ya kutoka ilitofautiana, na faida ilibadilika nayo.

More than a hundred papers have since argued about whether the shortfall is really about tax at all, or about market microstructure — the fact that prices historically moved in discrete tick sizes, so the drop could not land exactly on the dividend. The finding that the drop is less than the dividend is robust. Why has been contested for over fifty years.

3dff64da63e0.en: A buyer says a token could easily reach one dollar, because one dollar is a small number. Chapter 2 Lesson 1 gave the arithmetic that makes this checkable. If the token has one trillion units in supply, a price of one dollar is a market capitalisation of one trillion dollars. The claim was never about the price. It was about the size the whole thing would have to become, and stated that way most people withdraw it.
3dff64da63e0.sw: Mnunuzi husema tokeni inaweza kufikia dola moja kwa urahisi, kwa sababu dola moja ni namba ndogo. Sura ya 2 Somo la 1 lilitoa hesabu inayofanya hili likaguliwe. Ikiwa tokeni ina vipimo trilioni moja katika usambazaji, bei ya dola moja ni kiasi cha soko cha dola trilioni moja. Dai halikuwahi kuhusu bei. Lilikuwa kuhusu ukubwa ambao kitu kizima kingelazimika kuwa, na likitajwa hivyo watu wengi hulirudisha nyuma.

3e0708c4c982.en: An investor holds a well-diversified portfolio through a 40% fall. Nothing they own is impaired and their time horizon is twenty years, so the fall is volatility rather than permanent loss. Then they lose their job in the same downturn, and they sell to pay for living costs. The volatility became a permanent loss at the moment their circumstances forced the sale — and the two events had the same cause.
3e0708c4c982.sw: Mwekezaji anashikilia mkusanyiko uliosambazwa vizuri kupitia kushuka kwa 40%. Hakuna anachomiliki kimeharibika na upeo wake wa muda ni miaka ishirini, hivyo kushuka ni mtikisiko badala ya hasara ya kudumu. Kisha anapoteza kazi yake katika kushuka kule kule, na anauza kulipia gharama za maisha. Mtikisiko ukawa hasara ya kudumu wakati hali zake zilipolazimisha uuzaji — na matukio hayo mawili yalikuwa na sababu ile ile.

3e140dc41e3b.en: One further limit, stated plainly because the whole chapter depends on it. Everything described here is visible to everybody. Bond yields, credit spreads, funding rates and open interest are public and watched by people with far better tools than yours. Reading them correctly is not an edge over professionals, and this course will not pretend it is. It is protection against a specific and common error: buying a story that the wider market priced out weeks ago, in the asset class that receives that pricing last and hardest.

3e51d837534d.en: Read the last of those figures carefully, because it is the operationally useful one. Crypto is not merely a thing people are defrauded about. This is finality as an attack surface, and it is the same property.

3ee227ac1852.en: Yen pairs break the pattern. Because the yen has a much lower per-unit value than currencies like the dollar or euro, USD/JPY and other yen pairs are quoted to only two decimal places — so a pip there is the second decimal place (0.01), not the fourth. If USD/JPY moves from 149.50 to 150.00, that's a 50-pip move, not a 0.5-pip move. This trips up nearly every beginner at least once.
3ee227ac1852.sw: Jozi za yen huvunja mtindo huo. Kama USD/JPY itasogea kutoka 149.50 hadi 150.00, huo ni msogeo wa pip 50, si msogeo wa pip 0.5. Hili huwakwaza karibu kila anayeanza angalau mara moja.

4030a406a71a.en: On proof-of-work chains like Bitcoin, settlement is probabilistic. Lesson 2 gave you the reason: rewriting history means redoing the proof-of-work for the rewritten block and every block after it, faster than the honest network extends the chain. Each confirmation adds another block's worth of work an attacker would have to redo. The transaction is never mathematically final — it just becomes exponentially more expensive to reverse.

Kila uthibitisho huongeza kazi ya kitalu kingine ambayo mshambuliaji angelazimika kuirudia. Muamala haukamiliki kamwe kihisabati — huwa tu ghali zaidi kwa kuzidisha kutendua.

40c8dc52af62.en: Do this with your own numbers before you trade anything. Take an account of 2,000 dollars and a risk rule of 1.5% per trade. The asset trades at 3,200 dollars, and its 14-period daily ATR is 96 dollars. You have decided on a 2.5 x ATR stop. Work through it in four steps. What is the money at risk? What is the stop distance in dollars? What position size does the formula give? What is that position worth at the current price? The answers, so you can check yourself: the money at risk is 2,000 x 0.015 = 30 dollars. The stop distance is 2.5 x 96 = 240 dollars, which is 7.5% of the price. The position is 30 / 240 = 0.125 units. That is 0.125 x 3,200 = 400 dollars of exposure. Verify it the way this lesson keeps verifying things: 7.5% of 400 dollars is 30 dollars, which is what you decided to risk. Now redo it with the real ATR of an asset you are actually watching. If the position it produces looks embarrassingly small, the formula is working.
40c8dc52af62.sw: Fanya hivi kwa namba zako mwenyewe kabla ya kufanya biashara ya lolote. Chukua akaunti ya dola 2,000 na kanuni ya hatari ya 1.5% kwa kila biashara. Rasilimali hufanyiwa biashara katika dola 3,200, na ATR yake ya kila siku ya vipindi 14 ni dola 96. Umeamua kusimamisha kwa mara 2.5 ya ATR. Ipitie katika hatua nne. Pesa iliyo hatarini ni ipi? Umbali wa kusimamisha kwa dola ni upi? Fomula hutoa ukubwa gani wa nafasi? Nafasi hiyo ina thamani gani katika bei ya sasa? Majibu, ili uweze kujikagua: pesa iliyo hatarini ni 2,000 x 0.015 = dola 30. Umbali wa kusimamisha ni 2.5 x 96 = dola 240, ambayo ni 7.5% ya bei. Nafasi ni 30 / 240 = vipimo 0.125. Hiyo ni 0.125 x 3,200 = dola 400 za kufunuliwa. Ithibitishe kwa njia ambayo somo hili huendelea kuthibitisha mambo: 7.5% ya dola 400 ni dola 30, ambayo ndiyo uliyoamua kuiweka hatarini. Sasa ifanye upya kwa ATR halisi ya rasilimali unayoiangalia hasa. Ikiwa nafasi inayozalishwa inaonekana ndogo kwa aibu, fomula inafanya kazi.

423f011021f2.en: The International Monetary Fund published a blog post on 11 January 2022 by Tobias Adrian, Tara Iyer and Mahvash Qureshi reporting a specific pair of measurements. Over 2017 to 2019, the correlation between Bitcoin returns and the S&P 500 was 0.01 — effectively no relationship. Over 2020 to 2021, the same measure was 0.36. The relationship did not stay constant. It changed after the extraordinary central-bank response of early 2020, when easy financial conditions lifted both crypto and equities together.

Katika 2017 hadi 2019, uhusiano kati ya faida za Bitcoin na S&P 500 ulikuwa 0.01 — kwa kweli hakuna uhusiano. Katika 2020 hadi 2021, kipimo kilekile kilikuwa 0.36. Uhusiano haukubaki thabiti. Ulibadilika baada ya mwitikio wa ajabu wa benki kuu wa mwanzoni mwa 2020, wakati hali rahisi za kifedha ziliinua kripto na hisa pamoja.

4293b6c08170.en: Cash does not fall in nominal terms, which makes it feel safe. Over thirty years, a sustained 3% inflation rate roughly halves what a fixed sum will buy. Equities are volatile and have historically compensated for inflation over long periods; cash is stable and reliably does not. Avoiding the risk you can see by accepting one you cannot is the most common error in the whole subject.

433592cf98ad.en: Build these habits: Know the quiet hours for the pairs you trade — thin sessions (deep night for a currency's home market) are where small imbalances become large moves. Treat any stop held through an illiquid period as one that may fill far from its level, exactly as in a gap. Recognise a stop cascade — falling price triggering stops that push price lower still — as the same stop-out mechanism from Chapter 3, Lesson 2 at market scale. And judge your exposure by what a thin-market spike could do to it, not only by whether your directional view is right.

Chukulia stop yoyote inayoshikiliwa katika kipindi kisicho na ukwasi kama inayoweza kutimizwa mbali na kiwango chake, hasa kama katika kuruka. Tambua mfululizo wa stop — bei inayoshuka ikianzisha stop zinazosukuma bei chini zaidi — kama utaratibu ule ule wa stop-out kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 2 kwa kipimo cha soko. Na hukumu uwazi wako kwa kile ambacho mwiba wa soko jembamba ungeweza kufanya kwake, si tu kwa kama mtazamo wako wa mwelekeo ni sahihi.

43ce5935eed4.en: This is a real technical achievement. Now here is the part the hype leaves out, stated plainly: scarcity of the token is not value of the token. Scarcity limits supply. Value requires demand. Something can be perfectly, provably scarce and still be worth nothing — if you sign 21 copies of a napkin and burn the pen, you have created verifiable scarcity, not wealth. The 21 million cap tells you no one can inflate the supply. It tells you nothing about why anyone should want a bitcoin, or what one should cost. Supply and demand set prices — Foundations taught you that, and no software cap repeals it.

Thamani inahitaji mahitaji. Kitu kinaweza kuwa adimu kikamilifu na kwa uthibitisho na bado kisiwe na thamani yoyote — ukitia sahihi nakala 21 za kitambaa cha meza na kuchoma kalamu, umeunda uadimu unaothibitishika, si utajiri. Dari ya milioni 21 hukuambia hakuna anayeweza kupanua usambazaji. Haikuambii lolote kuhusu kwa nini yeyote anapaswa kutaka bitcoin, au moja inapaswa kugharimu kiasi gani. Usambazaji na mahitaji hupanga bei — Misingi ilikufundisha hilo, na hakuna dari ya programu inayolibatilisha.

4440c40635f3.en: Global liquidity conditions, a landmark regulatory approval, and the halving all moved together. That is the identification problem, and it is fatal to a causal claim. When two or more causes change at the same time, the data cannot tell you which one produced the effect. No amount of chart-overlaying fixes it. At least four candidate drivers co-move with the halving cycle: macro liquidity, since central bank policy sets the price of risk everywhere and crypto sits at the far end of that chain; regulatory and access events, since the 2024 spot-ETF approval changed who could buy, not how much was mined; the adoption S-curve, since a new technology's user base grows fastest in its middle years and rising adoption produces rising demand on its own multi-year arc; and leverage cycles, since borrowed money builds up through a rally and unwinds violently in a fall, a mechanism that creates boom-bust shapes in markets with no halving at all.
4440c40635f3.sw: Hali za ukwasi wa kimataifa, idhini muhimu ya udhibiti, na kupunguzwa nusu vyote vilisogea pamoja. Hilo ndilo tatizo la kubainisha, nalo ni la kifo kwa dai la kisababishi. Wakati visababishi viwili au zaidi vinabadilika kwa wakati mmoja, data haiwezi kukuambia ni kipi kilizalisha athari. Hakuna kiasi cha kuweka chati juu ya nyingine kinachorekebisha hilo. Angalau visababishi vinne watarajiwa husogea pamoja na mzunguko wa kupunguzwa nusu: ukwasi wa uchumi mkuu, kwa kuwa sera ya benki kuu hupanga bei ya hatari kila mahali na kripto hukaa mwisho wa mnyororo huo; matukio ya udhibiti na ufikiaji, kwa kuwa idhini ya ETF ya papo hapo ya 2024 ilibadilisha nani angeweza kununua, si kiasi gani kilichimbwa; kipindi cha ukuaji wa matumizi, kwa kuwa kundi la watumiaji wa teknolojia mpya hukua haraka zaidi katika miaka yake ya katikati na matumizi yanayopanda huzalisha mahitaji yanayopanda katika safu yake yenyewe ya miaka mingi; na mizunguko ya mzingo, kwa kuwa pesa iliyokopwa hujilimbikiza kupitia kupanda na hufunguka kwa ukali katika kushuka, utaratibu unaounda maumbo ya ustawi-na-mporomoko katika masoko yasiyo na kupunguzwa nusu kabisa.
