44c01f8c7a49.en: Chapter 1, Lesson 3 gave you the mechanics. Miners who add a valid block earn the block subsidy, meaning newly created coins, plus the block's transaction fees. Every 210,000 blocks, the software cuts that subsidy in half. That is the halving. The difficulty adjustment holds the block pace near 10 minutes no matter how much mining power joins, so the schedule advances in blocks, not in calendar time.
44c01f8c7a49.sw: Sura ya 1, Somo la 3 lilikupa mitambo. Wachimbaji wanaoongeza kitalu halali hupata ruzuku ya kitalu, ikimaanisha sarafu zilizoundwa upya, pamoja na ada za miamala za kitalu. Kila vitalu 210,000, programu hupunguza ruzuku hiyo nusu. Hiyo ndiyo kupunguzwa nusu. Marekebisho ya ugumu hushikilia kasi ya vitalu karibu na dakika 10 bila kujali nguvu ngapi za uchimbaji zinajiunga, kwa hivyo ratiba husonga katika vitalu, si katika muda wa kalenda.

44db902f0a10.en: You break even, because the price did not change

44e5e480d411.en: Transferring a victim's phone number to an attacker's SIM, so that calls, texts and reset codes arrive with the attacker.
44e5e480d411.sw: Kuhamisha namba ya simu ya mwathiriwa kwenda SIM ya mshambuliaji, ili simu, ujumbe na misimbo ya kuweka upya vifike kwa mshambuliaji.

44ec44ed1bd6.en: Now the claim itself, put as strongly as its supporters put it. This lesson is not a hatchet job. A claim you cannot state fairly is a claim you have not understood. The narrative borrows a four-phase market model from Richard Wyckoff, an American investor who set out his framework in the early 1900s. The four phases are accumulation, markup, distribution and markdown.
44ec44ed1bd6.sw: Sasa dai lenyewe, likiwekwa kwa nguvu kadiri wafuasi wake wanavyoliweka. Somo hili si shambulizi la kikatili. Dai usiloweza kulitaja kwa haki ni dai ambalo hujalielewa. Simulizi hukopa mfumo wa awamu nne wa soko kutoka Richard Wyckoff, mwekezaji Mmarekani aliyeweka mfumo wake mwanzoni mwa miaka ya 1900. Awamu nne ni ukusanyaji, upandishaji, ugawaji na ushushaji.

45127cdc918b.sw: Kwa sababu uchambuzi wa kampuni hauna thamani

4518e993c7f7.en: Write the thesis down with its date, its pillars and its invalidation conditions, and keep it after the position closes. A file of past theses, each with what you expected and what happened, is the only instrument that reliably improves judgement in this asset class. Chapter 6 Lesson 3 explains why memory cannot do this job here: the moves are large enough that outcomes carry almost no information about whether the reasoning was sound.
4518e993c7f7.sw: Andika nadharia pamoja na tarehe yake, nguzo zake na masharti yake ya kubatilisha, na uiweke baada ya nafasi kufungwa. Faili la nadharia za awali, kila moja ikiwa na ulichotarajia na kilichotokea, ndicho chombo pekee kinachoboresha hukumu kwa uhakika katika aina hii ya rasilimali. Sura ya 6 Somo la 3 hueleza kwa nini kumbukumbu haiwezi kufanya kazi hii hapa: misogeo ni mikubwa vya kutosha hivi kwamba matokeo hubeba taarifa ndogo mno kuhusu kama hoja ilikuwa imara.

45346aa1db94.en: A mode in which the whole account balance backs every open position. A position can absorb a much larger adverse move before liquidation, because it draws on the entire balance. The cost is that a single bad position can consume the whole account, and positions become linked: a loss on one reduces the cushion under all the others.
45346aa1db94.sw: Hali ambapo salio lote la akaunti huunga mkono kila nafasi iliyo wazi. Nafasi inaweza kufyonza msogeo mbaya mkubwa zaidi kabla ya ufilisi, kwa sababu huchota kutoka salio lote. Gharama ni kwamba nafasi moja mbaya inaweza kutumia akaunti nzima, na nafasi huunganishwa: hasara katika moja hupunguza mto ulio chini ya zote nyingine.

455de42b6712.en: A company whose earnings rise and fall sharply with the economic cycle — miners, carmakers, chemicals, shipping and similar.
455de42b6712.sw: Kampuni ambayo mapato yake hupanda na kushuka kwa kasi pamoja na mzunguko wa kiuchumi — wachimbaji, watengeneza-magari, kemikali, usafirishaji wa baharini na kadhalika.

45681a3c43d4.en: Not quite — remember the POW camp example. Money just needs trust and acceptance, not physical value.
45681a3c43d4.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kumbuka mfano wa kambi ya wafungwa. Pesa inahitaji tu imani na kukubalika, si thamani ya kimwili.

4580f2d87357.en: A market order crosses the spread on purpose: you take the best price on offer and accept the 0.04. A limit order sits in the book and waits for someone to come to you. If they do, you avoid the spread. If they do not, you simply do not trade — and if the price runs away in the meantime, not trading may have cost more than the spread would have.
4580f2d87357.sw: Agizo la soko huvuka spread kwa makusudi: unachukua bei bora inayotolewa na unakubali ile 0.04. Agizo la kikomo hukaa kwenye kitabu na kusubiri mtu aje kwako. Kama watakuja, unaepuka spread. Kama hawatakuja, hufanyi biashara tu — na kama bei itakimbia wakati huo, kutofanya biashara kunaweza kuwa kumegharimu zaidi ya spread ingegharimu.

4590847b0e27.en: Not quite — Osler (2003) showed the cause is order clustering: stop-loss and take-profit orders bunch at round-number levels, so price genuinely reacts there.
4590847b0e27.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — Osler (2003) alionyesha sababu ni mkusanyiko wa maagizo: maagizo ya stop-loss na take-profit hujikusanya kwenye viwango vya namba za mviringo, hivyo bei huitikia hapo kweli.

45b1de2d31d6.en: The defence that worked was structural, and it is the same one from the Mt. Gox lesson. Assets in self-custody were unaffected. Not less affected: unaffected. The failure of the exchange had no mechanism by which to reach them.
45b1de2d31d6.sw: Ulinzi uliofanya kazi ulikuwa wa kimuundo, nao ni uleule kutoka somo la Mt. Gox. Rasilimali zilizo katika utunzaji binafsi hazikuathirika. Si kuathirika kidogo: hazikuathirika. Kushindwa kwa soko la kubadilisha hakukuwa na utaratibu wowote wa kuzifikia.

45cf1518fd8c.en: Fama and French measured cheapness as book-to-market — the accounting value of the company against its market price. Other researchers and funds use earnings, cash flow, sales or dividends. These produce overlapping but genuinely different sets of companies, and they have not performed identically. A finding about one definition of value is not automatically a finding about the fund that calls itself a value fund.
45cf1518fd8c.sw: Fama na French walipima unafuu kama kitabu-kwa-soko — thamani ya kihasibu ya kampuni dhidi ya bei yake ya soko. Watafiti na fund nyingine hutumia mapato, mtiririko wa fedha, mauzo au gawio. Hivi huzalisha seti zinazoingiliana lakini tofauti kweli za kampuni, na hazijafanya kazi vivyo hivyo. Tokeo kuhusu maana moja ya thamani si tokeo kiotomatiki kuhusu fund inayojiita fund ya thamani.

45d4f9306427.en: A plan is silent on what to do when a holding halves in value. Why is this the most common failure mode?
45d4f9306427.sw: Mpango unanyamaza kuhusu la kufanya umiliki unapoporomoka nusu ya thamani. Kwa nini hii ndiyo namna ya kushindwa inayojitokeza zaidi?

45d83f4760bc.en: A measure of how closely two assets' prices tend to move in relation to each other, ranging from perfectly together (+1) to perfectly opposite (-1), with 0 meaning no consistent relationship.
45d83f4760bc.sw: Kipimo cha jinsi bei za mali mbili zinavyoelekea kusogea kwa uhusiano na kila mmoja, kuanzia pamoja kabisa (+1) hadi kinyume kabisa (-1), ambapo 0 humaanisha hakuna uhusiano wa kudumu.

45d8ffacdb7c.en: A portfolio holds 5% crypto and 95% everything else. Crypto rises fourfold with the rest flat, and the slice becomes about 17.4% of the total without any decision being taken. An 80% fall from there — ordinary in this asset class, not a catastrophe — leaves the portfolio at about 99% of its peak, having given back essentially the entire gain. Restoring 5% at the top would have moved about 14 units into the rest of the portfolio, permanently, as a rule rather than as a call.
45d8ffacdb7c.sw: Kasha lina 5% ya kripto na 95% ya kila kitu kingine. Kripto hupanda mara nne huku kilichobaki kikiwa tuli, na kipande huwa takriban 17.4% ya jumla bila uamuzi wowote kuchukuliwa. Kushuka kwa 80% kutoka hapo — kwa kawaida katika aina hii ya rasilimali, si maafa — huacha kasha katika takriban 99% ya kilele chake, likiwa limerudisha kimsingi faida yote. Kurejesha 5% kileleni kungehamisha takriban vipimo 14 kwenda kasha lililobaki, kwa kudumu, kama kanuni badala ya kama wito.

45deb3527bf3.en: True or False: the Swiss franc shock shows that a good enough model can be trusted to rule out extreme moves.
45deb3527bf3.sw: Kweli au Uongo: mshtuko wa faranga ya Uswisi unaonyesha kwamba muundo mzuri vya kutosha unaweza kuaminiwa kuondoa uwezekano wa misogeo ya kupindukia.

45e81504a247.en: Switch entirely to cash until the market is calm
45e81504a247.sw: Wahamie kabisa fedha taslimu hadi soko litulie

45e976c72ef8.en: "Price is king" is itself a claim, and this course does not accept claims because they sound confident. Reading a naked chart removes indicator clutter, but it does not remove the hard problem — deciding what the price is likely to do next. The rest of this lesson tests where that decision has real evidence behind it and where it does not.
45e976c72ef8.sw: "Bei ni mfalme" nalo ni dai lenyewe, na kozi hii haikubali madai kwa sababu yanasikika kwa uhakika. Kusoma chati tupu huondoa msongamano wa viashiria, lakini hakuondoi tatizo gumu — kuamua bei inawezekana kufanya nini baadaye. Sehemu iliyobaki ya somo hili hujaribu mahali uamuzi huo una ushahidi halisi nyuma yake na mahali usipokuwa nao.

45f84fa63249.en: The automatic destruction of part of a misbehaving validator's stake, followed by ejection from the validator set. On Ethereum this is a real, live mechanism, not a threat on paper: in February 2021, one staking operator had around 75 validators slashed for double-signing, losing roughly $30,000 at the time.
45f84fa63249.sw: Uharibifu wa kiotomatiki wa sehemu ya hisa ya mthibitishaji anayefanya vibaya, ukifuatiwa na kufukuzwa kutoka kundi la wathibitishaji. Katika Ethereum huu ni utaratibu halisi, hai, si tishio la karatasi: mwezi Februari 2021, mwendeshaji mmoja wa uwekaji hisa alikuwa na takriban wathibitishaji 75 waliokatwa kwa kutia sahihi mara mbili, akipoteza takriban $30,000 wakati huo.

4611d11cecef.en: The honest distinction is structural, and it has two parts: where the return comes from, and who is on the other side of you.
4611d11cecef.sw: Tofauti ya uaminifu ni ya kimuundo, na ina sehemu mbili: faida inatoka wapi, na ni nani aliye upande mwingine wako.

4621988c0af6.en: There is a particular trap in the recovery figures, and it catches people who think they are being sophisticated. Creditors were repaid in bitcoin, and bitcoin was worth vastly more in 2024 than in 2014, which is sometimes presented as things working out. It was not a return on an investment decision. It was a decade of holding an asset you could not sell, could not use as collateral, and could not have abandoned if you wanted to. Being unable to lose is not the same as choosing to hold.
4621988c0af6.sw: Kuna mtego maalum katika takwimu za urejeshaji, nao huwanasa watu wanaodhani wana ustadi. Wadai walilipwa kwa bitcoin, na bitcoin ilikuwa na thamani kubwa mno mwaka 2024 kuliko mwaka 2014, jambo ambalo wakati mwingine huwasilishwa kama mambo kwenda vizuri. Haikuwa faida ya uamuzi wa uwekezaji. Ilikuwa muongo wa kushikilia rasilimali ambayo hukuweza kuiuza, hukuweza kuitumia kama dhamana, na usingeweza kuiacha ikiwa ungetaka. Kutoweza kupoteza si sawa na kuchagua kushikilia.

4626caf9f7a2.en: Compounded over 20 years, 10,000 growing at 17.9% becomes about 269,000. The same 10,000 at 11.4% becomes about 87,000. The activity did not cost a slice of the return; it cost most of the outcome.
4626caf9f7a2.sw: Ikijilimbikiza kwa miaka 20, 10,000 ikikua kwa 17.9% inakuwa takriban 269,000. Hiyohiyo 10,000 kwa 11.4% inakuwa takriban 87,000. Shughuli hiyo haikugharimu kipande cha faida; iligharimu sehemu kubwa ya matokeo.

4637c940efba.en: The gambler's ruin problem is old and well understood: a player with limited money making repeated bets has a calculable chance of eventually losing everything, and the single biggest lever on that chance is not the win rate — it is the fraction of the account risked on each bet. Ralph Vince brought this framework to trading in The Mathematics of Money Management (Wiley, 1992), formalising the "fixed fractional" approach this course has used since Foundations: risk a small, constant fraction of the account each time.
4637c940efba.sw: Tatizo la kufilisika kwa mchezaji wa kamari ni la zamani na linaeleweka vizuri: mchezaji mwenye pesa chache anayefanya mabashiri ya kurudia-rudia ana nafasi inayoweza kukokotolewa ya hatimaye kupoteza kila kitu, na lever kubwa kuliko zote juu ya nafasi hiyo si kiwango cha ushindi — ni sehemu ya akaunti inayohatarishwa kwa kila dau. Ralph Vince alileta mfumo huu kwenye biashara katika The Mathematics of Money Management (Wiley, 1992), akirasimisha mbinu ya "sehemu thabiti" ambayo kozi hii imeitumia tangu Msingi: hatarisha sehemu ndogo thabiti ya akaunti kila mara.

463f4c001fd3.en: You buy EUR/USD at 1.1050 with a 30-pip trailing stop. If price rises to 1.1080, your stop automatically rises to 1.1050 (breakeven). If price continues to 1.1120, your stop rises again to 1.1090 — now locking in 40 pips of profit even if price reverses. The stop only ever moves in your favor; it never moves back.
463f4c001fd3.sw: Unanunua EUR/USD kwa 1.1050 ukiwa na trailing stop ya pip 30. Kama bei itapanda hadi 1.1080, stop yako itapanda kiotomatiki hadi 1.1050 (usawa). Kama bei itaendelea hadi 1.1120, stop yako itapanda tena hadi 1.1090 — sasa ikihifadhi faida ya pip 40 hata kama bei itageuka. Stop husogea kwa manufaa yako tu; hairudi nyuma kamwe.

463f7d60bf86.en: A number an index is divided by so splits and membership changes do not create artificial jumps.
463f7d60bf86.sw: Namba ambayo index hugawanywa kwayo ili mgawanyo na mabadiliko ya uanachama yasizalishe miruko ya bandia.

464ce2931931.en: The last thing worth extracting is about time, and it is the same lesson Mt. Gox taught in a different decade.
464ce2931931.sw: Jambo la mwisho linalostahili kutolewa linahusu wakati, nalo ni somo lilelile ambalo Mt. Gox ilifundisha katika muongo tofauti.

464d66be2529.en: None, since they never sold and so never realised a loss
464d66be2529.sw: Hakuna, kwa kuwa hakuuza kamwe na hivyo hakutimiza hasara kamwe

465f416c1a1c.en: The lenders, because they rank first in every situation
465f416c1a1c.sw: Wakopeshaji, kwa sababu wana daraja la kwanza katika kila hali

4669821cb59c.en: What to look for once a year, as the closing habit of this track. Recalculate what crypto is as a percentage of your total wealth, since drift has been working all year. Check every exchange balance against your cap. Revoke stale approvals and verify you can still access every wallet. Confirm somebody else knows the holdings exist. Reread your written plan and note where reality diverged from it, and for each difference decide whether the plan was wrong or the deviation was.
4669821cb59c.sw: Cha kuangalia mara moja kwa mwaka, kama tabia ya kufunga ya njia hii. Hesabu upya kripto ni asilimia ngapi ya utajiri wako jumla, kwa kuwa telezo limekuwa likifanya kazi mwaka mzima. Kagua kila salio la soko la kubadilisha dhidi ya dari yako. Batilisha idhini zilizopitwa na wakati na uthibitishe bado unaweza kufikia kila pochi. Thibitisha mtu mwingine anajua umiliki upo. Soma tena mpango wako ulioandikwa na uandike mahali uhalisia ulipotofautiana nao, na kwa kila tofauti amua kama mpango ulikuwa si sahihi au kupotoka ndiko kulikuwa si sahihi.

466f5b2ba701.en: There is a final piece of evidence worth putting next to all of this, because it describes the population you are joining. The Bank for International Settlements published Working Paper No. 1049, Crypto trading and Bitcoin prices: evidence from a new database of retail adoption, by Raphael Auer, Giulio Cornelli, Sebastian Doerr, Jon Frost and Leonardo Gambacorta, built from daily data on crypto exchange app use across 95 countries over 2015 to 2022. Their estimate is that between 73% and 81% of users are likely to have lost money on their Bitcoin investments. They also find that new users arrive after prices rise, and that when prices rise, larger holders sell — probably to those arriving users.
466f5b2ba701.sw: Kuna kipande cha mwisho cha ushahidi kinachostahili kuwekwa kando ya haya yote, kwa sababu huelezea idadi ya watu unayojiunga nayo. Benki ya Malipo ya Kimataifa ilichapisha Working Paper No. 1049, Crypto trading and Bitcoin prices: evidence from a new database of retail adoption, ya Raphael Auer, Giulio Cornelli, Sebastian Doerr, Jon Frost na Leonardo Gambacorta, iliyojengwa kutoka data ya kila siku ya matumizi ya programu za masoko ya kripto katika nchi 95 kuanzia 2015 hadi 2022. Makadirio yao ni kwamba kati ya 73% na 81% ya watumiaji wana uwezekano wa kuwa wamepoteza pesa katika uwekezaji wao wa Bitcoin. Pia hubaini kwamba watumiaji wapya hufika baada ya bei kupanda, na kwamba bei zinapopanda, wamiliki wakubwa zaidi huuza — pengine kwa watumiaji hao wanaofika.

467105a2463d.sw: Kujifanya mtu mwingine na udanganyifu wa zawadi

46737f094e4b.en: The total size of your open positions divided by your account equity. Unlike the broker's maximum offered leverage, this is the leverage you are actually using right now.
46737f094e4b.sw: Ukubwa wa jumla wa nafasi zako zilizo wazi kugawanywa kwa usawa wa akaunti yako. Tofauti na leverage ya juu zaidi inayotolewa na broker, hii ndiyo leverage unayoitumia hasa sasa hivi.

46855b5944f0.en: Someone with a sum to invest faces a choice that feels much harder than it is: put it in now, or spread it over months. The evidence has a clear answer, and the clear answer is not the whole story.
46855b5944f0.sw: Mtu mwenye kiasi cha kuwekeza hukabiliwa na chaguo linaloonekana gumu zaidi kuliko lilivyo: kiweke sasa, au kikieneza katika miezi. Ushahidi una jibu wazi, na jibu wazi si simulizi nzima.

468a92f532b1.en: Inflation — What It Is, and How It Moves Every Market
468a92f532b1.sw: Mfumuko wa Bei — Ni Nini, na Jinsi Unavyosogeza Kila Soko

468cb9cd5e60.en: Roughly 20% a year was paid on billions of dollars, in public, for months. The mechanism was disclosed the whole time. It ended in six days.
468cb9cd5e60.sw: Takriban 20% kwa mwaka ililipwa juu ya mabilioni ya dola, hadharani, kwa miezi. Utaratibu ulifichuliwa muda wote. Uliisha katika siku sita.

46937617d6e3.en: A service promising guaranteed or unusually high returns
46937617d6e3.sw: Huduma inayoahidi faida ya uhakika au kubwa isivyo kawaida

469d80abcfd7.en: It is also worth separating two claims that get merged.
469d80abcfd7.sw: Pia inastahili kutenganisha madai mawili yanayounganishwa.

469fd3cc7fe8.en: A stablecoin peg deserves strictly more skepticism than that, not less: the issuer is not a central bank, the promise is contractual rather than sovereign, and in the algorithmic case the promise is only a loop. The transferable habit is the same one this course keeps teaching — a peg is a promise with a mechanism, and the mechanism is exactly what you must verify before you rely on it.
469fd3cc7fe8.sw: Pegi ya sarafu imara inastahili mashaka zaidi kabisa kuliko hiyo, si machache: mtoaji si benki kuu, ahadi ni ya kimkataba badala ya kimamlaka, na katika hali ya kialgoriti ahadi ni kitanzi tu. Tabia inayohamishika ni ileile ambayo kozi hii huendelea kuifundisha — pegi ni ahadi yenye utaratibu, na utaratibu ndicho hasa unachopaswa kukithibitisha kabla ya kuutegemea.

46a0047e13f5.en: It is a real improvement and it does not solve the problem it was offered as solving. FTX did hold assets. What it also had was liabilities far exceeding them, and a reserves attestation generally shows one side of that. An exchange can publish a genuine proof of reserves while owing several times what it holds. The measurement is also a snapshot, so assets can be present on the measurement date and not otherwise, and it does not establish whether those assets are already pledged to somebody else.
46a0047e13f5.sw: Ni maboresho halisi nayo hayatatui tatizo lililotolewa kama linalotatua. FTX ilishikilia rasilimali. Kile ilichokuwa nacho pia kilikuwa madeni yaliyozidi mno hizo, na ushuhuda wa akiba kwa kawaida huonyesha upande mmoja wa hilo. Soko la kubadilisha linaweza kuchapisha uthibitisho halisi wa akiba huku likidaiwa mara kadhaa ya kile linaloshikilia. Kipimo pia ni picha ya wakati, kwa hivyo rasilimali zinaweza kuwepo katika tarehe ya kipimo na si vinginevyo, nao hauthibitishi kama rasilimali hizo tayari zimeahidiwa kwa mtu mwingine.

46ab2476eabc.en: Because sell conditions must be set at a specific price to be valid
46ab2476eabc.sw: Kwa sababu masharti ya kuuza lazima yawekwe kwenye bei maalum ili yawe halali

46b34992b7aa.en: Which raises the question this course has to answer honestly: what could a careful user actually have done?
46b34992b7aa.sw: Jambo linaloibua swali ambalo kozi hii lazima ilijibu kwa ukweli: mtumiaji makini angeweza kufanya nini hasa?

46c086c34a5a.en: Funds removed later using a spending permission the owner signed earlier.
46c086c34a5a.sw: Fedha zilizoondolewa baadaye kwa kutumia ruhusa ya kutumia ambayo mmiliki alitia sahihi awali.

46c9c5b912f9.en: The shareholders, because a residual claim is a claim on whatever remains after all obligations are met
46c9c5b912f9.sw: Wanahisa, kwa sababu dai la mabaki ni dai juu ya chochote kilichobaki baada ya majukumu yote kutimizwa

46dd63dd9a39.en: Share ownership is less risky, because share prices cannot fall to zero
46dd63dd9a39.sw: Umiliki wa hisa una hatari ndogo, kwa sababu bei za hisa haziwezi kushuka hadi sifuri

46e29c52d281.en: For an equity investor the no-trade regime does not mean sell everything. A long-term contribution schedule is not a position taken on a regime, and stopping it on a regime read is exactly the error Chapter 5 Lesson 2 documented. No-trade applies to discretionary additions: the single company you were about to buy because the story is good and nothing else is happening.
46e29c52d281.sw: Kwa mwekezaji wa hisa utawala wa kutofanya biashara haumaanishi uza kila kitu. Ratiba ya michango ya muda mrefu si nafasi iliyochukuliwa juu ya utawala, na kuisimamisha kwa msingi wa usomaji wa utawala ni kosa hasa ambalo Sura ya 5 Somo la 2 liliandika. Kutofanya biashara hutumika kwa nyongeza za hiari: kampuni moja uliyokuwa karibu kuinunua kwa sababu hadithi ni nzuri na hakuna kingine kinachotokea.

46fbbf5d0d60.en: A record of every trade — the setup, entry, stop, target, size, the R-multiple result, and an honest note on whether you followed your plan — kept so you can measure your real expectancy and spot the mistakes you keep repeating.
46fbbf5d0d60.sw: Rekodi ya kila biashara — mpangilio, kuingia, stop, lengo, ukubwa, tokeo la kizidishi-R, na dokezo la uaminifu kama ulifuata mpango wako — inayowekwa ili uweze kupima matarajio yako halisi na kuona makosa unayoyarudia.

470ed3ec2354.en: Most early losses come from a short, repeating list of mistakes the course has already solved — and nearly all of them are the same failure: acting on feeling or hope instead of a pre-decided, evidence-checked rule.
470ed3ec2354.sw: Hasara nyingi za awali hutoka kwenye orodha fupi inayojirudia ya makosa ambayo kozi tayari imeyatatua — na karibu yote ni kushindwa kule kule: kutenda kwa hisia au matumaini badala ya kanuni iliyoamuliwa mapema na kukaguliwa kwa ushahidi.

4714dfa2aacf.en: Crypto traders are less intelligent than stock investors
4714dfa2aacf.sw: Wafanyabiashara wa kripto wana akili kidogo kuliko wawekezaji wa hisa

47185344ecad.en: What to look for in your own portfolio. Calculate each holding as a percentage of the total, not in currency, because currency amounts conceal proportions. Identify the largest one and write down what a total loss of it would do. Check whether any position is larger than you would deliberately choose to buy today at that size. And add up your holdings by industry, since three positions of 8% in the same industry is a 24% position wearing three names.
47185344ecad.sw: Cha kutazama katika mkusanyiko wako mwenyewe. Kokotoa kila umiliki kama asilimia ya jumla, si kwa sarafu, kwa sababu viasi vya sarafu huficha uwiano. Tambua mkubwa zaidi na uandike hasara kamili yake ingefanya nini. Kagua kama nafasi yoyote ni kubwa kuliko ungechagua kwa makusudi kununua leo kwa ukubwa huo. Na jumlisha umiliki wako kwa sekta, kwa kuwa nafasi tatu za 8% katika sekta ile ile ni nafasi ya 24% ikivaa majina matatu.

473b2c146e2f.en: Holding your own keys, so that no company stands between you and your coins. You gain independence from any custodian — and you inherit every job the custodian was doing: security, backups, and the consequences of mistakes.
473b2c146e2f.sw: Kushikilia funguo zako mwenyewe, ili hakuna kampuni inayosimama kati yako na sarafu zako. Unapata uhuru kutoka kwa mtunzaji yeyote — nawe unarithi kila kazi ambayo mtunzaji alikuwa akiifanya: usalama, nakala rudufu, na matokeo ya makosa.

47556fe11ad4.en: This is standard practice for traders who can't watch a screen all day — the exit plan is built into the order itself, decided in advance, exactly the discipline Foundations Chapter 2 established as the foundation of real risk management.
47556fe11ad4.sw: Hii ni desturi ya kawaida kwa wafanyabiashara wasioweza kutazama skrini mchana kutwa — mpango wa kutoka umejengwa ndani ya agizo lenyewe, ukiamuliwa mapema, hasa nidhamu ambayo Sura ya 2 ya Msingi iliiweka kama msingi wa usimamizi halisi wa hatari.

47d782543ac6.en: Not quite. Returns are perfectly measurable, and neither trading hours nor holding periods are the mechanism. It is the size of the moves: the noise overwhelms the signal, so a good decision and a bad one are indistinguishable by result over any short window.
47d782543ac6.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Faida zinapimika kikamilifu, na wala saa za biashara wala vipindi vya kushikilia si utaratibu. Ni ukubwa wa misogeo: kelele huzidi ishara, kwa hivyo uamuzi mzuri na mbaya hautofautishiki kwa matokeo katika dirisha lolote fupi.

47e4a1104bc0.en: The last traded price multiplied by circulating supply — one multiplication, not money invested.

47e751e0cb28.en: Correct. For roughly three years customers saw accurate records of what the exchange said it owed them, and progressively inaccurate records of what it held. A screen displays a database entry. The exchange itself did not know what was in its own wallets — 200,000 bitcoin turned up in one last used before June 2011.
47e751e0cb28.sw: Sahihi. Kwa takriban miaka mitatu wateja waliona rekodi sahihi za kile ambacho soko lilisema linadaiwa nao, na rekodi zisizo sahihi kwa kuongezeka za kile lilichoshikilia. Skrini huonyesha kiingizo cha hifadhidata. Soko lenyewe halikujua kilichokuwa katika pochi zake mwenyewe — bitcoin 200,000 zilijitokeza katika moja iliyotumika mwisho kabla ya Juni 2011.

47e887dfcf6c.en: There is one more consequence that surprises people. Because labels are continuously revised as clustering improves, the historical series can change. Glassnode's own transparency notice states that its exchange metrics come from verified addresses, external sources and clustering algorithms, that complete accuracy remains out of reach, and that recent data points may be revised as labels update. A chart you screenshot today may not match the same chart next month.
47e887dfcf6c.sw: Kuna matokeo mengine moja yanayowashangaza watu. Kwa sababu lebo hurekebishwa mfululizo kadiri ukusanyaji wa makundi unavyoboreka, msururu wa kihistoria unaweza kubadilika. Tangazo la uwazi la Glassnode lenyewe husema kwamba vipimo vyake vya masoko ya kubadilisha hutoka anwani zilizothibitishwa, vyanzo vya nje na algoriti za kukusanya makundi, kwamba usahihi kamili unabaki nje ya kufikiwa, na kwamba nukta za data za hivi karibuni zinaweza kurekebishwa kadiri lebo zinavyosasishwa. Chati unayoipiga picha leo huenda isilingane na chati ileile mwezi ujao.

47f34bec910b.en: Recall the Proof of Work definition from Lesson 1: adding to the history must cost real computation. The nonce is where that cost lives. A valid block requires a rare hash, a rare hash requires an enormous number of guesses, and guesses cost electricity and hardware. Finding a valid nonce is expensive; checking one is instant — anyone can hash the block once and confirm it.
47f34bec910b.sw: Kumbuka ufafanuzi wa Uthibitisho wa Kazi kutoka Somo la 1: kuongeza katika historia lazima kugharimu hesabu halisi. Nonce ndipo gharama hiyo inapoishi. Kitalu halali kinahitaji heshi adimu, heshi adimu inahitaji idadi kubwa mno ya kubahatisha, na kubahatisha hugharimu umeme na maunzi. Kupata nonce halali ni ghali; kuikagua ni papo hapo — yeyote anaweza kufanya heshi ya kitalu mara moja na kuthibitisha.

480aea2172b7.en: Chapter 1 described the margin call as one event. In a live account there are usually two levels, and knowing the difference matters.
480aea2172b7.sw: Sura ya 1 ilielezea wito wa margin kama tukio moja. Katika akaunti hai kwa kawaida kuna viwango viwili, na kujua tofauti kunahusika.

Supply growing 2.7% a month while you hold is a headwind the price has to overcome before anything else you believe becomes relevant, and it is published. Most token theses never mention it, which tells you how many of them have been through this exercise.

Nadharia nyingi za tokeni hazitaji kamwe, jambo linalokuambia ni ngapi kati yake zimepitia zoezi hili.

486f670cf9ef.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — hakuna kinapolingana, fedha taslimu ndiyo nafasi sahihi. Kulazimisha biashara ni kufanya biashara kupita kiasi, ambako hurudisha faida.

487221088846.en: Notice what difficulty adjustment implies. More mining power does not produce more bitcoins — the schedule is fixed. It only raises the cost of producing the same bitcoins, and with it, the cost of attacking the history. The electricity is not an unfortunate inefficiency someone forgot to fix. Burning it is the security. Whether that price is worth paying is a fair question — but "why not just use less energy?" misunderstands the design: an attacker must outspend the honest network, so the honest network's spending is the wall.
487221088846.sw: Tambua marekebisho ya ugumu yanadokeza nini. Nguvu zaidi ya uchimbaji haizalishi bitcoin zaidi — ratiba imewekwa. Hupandisha tu gharama ya kuzalisha bitcoin zilezile, na pamoja nayo, gharama ya kushambulia historia. Umeme si upotevu wa bahati mbaya ambao mtu alisahau kuurekebisha. Kuuchoma ndiyo usalama. Kama bei hiyo inastahili kulipwa ni swali la haki — lakini "kwa nini tusitumie nishati kidogo tu?" hulielewa vibaya muundo: mshambuliaji lazima azidi matumizi ya mtandao mwaminifu, kwa hivyo matumizi ya mtandao mwaminifu ndiyo ukuta.

489960347da9.en: The resolution is that "best ideas" governs where your conviction goes, while the fixed-fractional risk rule governs how much any single trade can cost you. You concentrate toward your strongest theses, but each one is still sized so that being wrong is survivable — the 1 to 2% risk per trade never gets abandoned because a thesis feels certain. Concentration of conviction, not concentration of risk. The 2015 franc traders who blew up (Chapter 5, Lesson 1) had concentrated risk; that is the opposite of this.
489960347da9.sw: Suluhisho ni kwamba "mawazo bora" huongoza mahali uhakika wako unakokwenda, ilhali kanuni ya hatari ya sehemu thabiti huongoza kiasi ambacho biashara yoyote moja inaweza kukugharimu. Unajikita kuelekea nadharia zako imara zaidi, lakini kila moja bado inapimwa ili kukosea kuweze kunusurika — hatari ya 1 hadi 2% kwa kila biashara haiachwi kamwe kwa sababu nadharia inahisi ya uhakika. Kujikita kwa uhakika, si kujikita kwa hatari. Wafanyabiashara wa faranga wa mwaka 2015 waliolipuka (Sura ya 5, Somo la 1) walikuwa wamejikita kwa hatari; hiyo ni kinyume cha hii.

4938dd4db49d.en:
Legitimate written sell conditions: the money is needed for its stated purpose; the holding has drifted outside its rebalancing band; the fund raised its fee; the specific reason you bought a single company no longer holds, such as the business you invested in being sold. Each of these can be checked against fact.

Not a sell condition: it fell a lot and I feel bad. That is a feeling, and feelings are what the document exists to overrule.
4938dd4db49d.sw:
Masharti halali ya kuuza yaliyoandikwa: pesa inahitajika kwa madhumuni yaliyotajwa; umiliki umetelezea nje ya ukanda wake wa kusawazisha upya; mfuko umepandisha ada yake; sababu maalum uliyonunulia kampuni moja haipo tena, kama vile biashara uliyowekeza ndani yake kuuzwa. Kila moja kati ya haya inaweza kukaguliwa dhidi ya ukweli.

Si sharti la kuuza: imeshuka sana na ninajisikia vibaya. Hilo ni hisia, na hisia ndizo hati hii ipo ili kuzikataa.

493902fe2c0c.en: The purpose of the cap is that it forces the question in advance. Every person who lost funds in the collapses in the next chapter had an implicit answer to how much do I leave on this exchange, and the implicit answer was almost always everything. Chapter 5 covers three cases where the implicit answer was tested.

493a6fe53de8.en: A derivative contract that tracks an asset's price and never expires. Ordinary futures expire on a set date, which forces their price back to the spot price. A perpetual has no such date, so it needs another mechanism to stay tethered to spot.

Mikataba ya kawaida ya baadaye hukwisha muda katika tarehe iliyowekwa, jambo linalolazimisha bei yao kurudi kwenye bei ya papo hapo. Ya kudumu haina tarehe kama hiyo, kwa hivyo inahitaji utaratibu mwingine kubaki imefungwa kwenye bei ya papo hapo.

49b364bb5966.en: A ledger built as a sequence of blocks in which each block contains the hash of the block before it. Any change to an old block changes its hash, which breaks the link stored in the next block — so tampering anywhere is detectable everywhere downstream.
49b364bb5966.sw: Leja iliyojengwa kama mfuatano wa vitalu ambapo kila kitalu kina heshi ya kitalu kilichokitangulia. Mabadiliko yoyote kwa kitalu cha zamani hubadilisha heshi yake, jambo linalovunja kiungo kilichohifadhiwa katika kitalu kinachofuata — kwa hivyo uchakachuaji popote hugunduliwa kila mahali kuelekea chini.

4a22a27bd6e4.en: Kelly's original paper, "A New Interpretation of Information Rate," was published in the Bell System Technical Journal — and wasn't even primarily about gambling or trading. Kelly was extending Claude Shannon's information theory, and discovered that the same math describing optimal information transmission also describes optimal bet sizing. The formula requires knowing your real win rate and your reward-to-risk ratio precisely; given those, it tells you exactly what fraction of your capital to risk to grow fastest over time.
4a22a27bd6e4.sw: Karatasi asilia ya Kelly, "A New Interpretation of Information Rate," ilichapishwa katika Bell System Technical Journal — na haikuhusu hata kwanza kamari wala biashara. Kelly alikuwa akipanua nadharia ya taarifa ya Claude Shannon, na akagundua kwamba hisabati ile ile inayoeleza usambazaji bora wa taarifa pia inaeleza upimaji bora wa ukubwa wa dau. Fomula inahitaji kujua kiwango chako halisi cha ushindi na uwiano wako wa tuzo-kwa-hatari kwa usahihi; ukiwa na hivyo, inakuambia hasa sehemu ipi ya mtaji wako ya kuhatarisha ili kukua kwa kasi zaidi kwa muda.

4a375565be91.en: Pairs split into major, minor, and exotic classes, alongside the current 2025 BIS ranking of the major pairs by turnover.
4a375565be91.sw: Jozi hugawanyika katika madaraja ya kuu, ndogo, na adimu, pamoja na daraja la sasa la BIS la mwaka 2025 la jozi kuu kwa mzunguko wa biashara.

4a3e59e07085.en: Statman challenged it directly. In the Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis in 1987 (volume 22, pages 353 to 363), in a paper titled How Many Stocks Make a Diversified Portfolio, he argued that a well-diversified portfolio of randomly chosen shares needs at least 30 for a borrowing investor and 40 for a lending one — several times the accepted figure.
4a3e59e07085.sw: Statman aliipinga moja kwa moja. Katika Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis mwaka 1987 (juzuu 22, kurasa 353 hadi 363), katika karatasi iliyoitwa How Many Stocks Make a Diversified Portfolio, alihoji kwamba mkusanyiko uliosambazwa vizuri wa hisa zilizochaguliwa kwa bahati unahitaji angalau 30 kwa mwekezaji anayekopa na 40 kwa anayekopesha — mara kadhaa ya takwimu iliyokubaliwa.

4a62ca36d4ca.en: The professional replaces the feeling with a thesis: a set of independent questions, each answered with evidence, that either line up or do not. Conviction then means something real — not "how sure am I?" but "how many separate, evidence-based reasons point the same way?"
4a62ca36d4ca.sw: Mtaalamu hubadilisha hisia kwa nadharia: seti ya maswali huru, kila moja likijibiwa kwa ushahidi, ambayo hulingana au hayalingani. Uhakika basi humaanisha kitu halisi — si "nina uhakika kiasi gani?" bali "ni sababu ngapi tofauti zenye msingi wa ushahidi zinaelekea upande ule ule?"

4a76fe4fda2e.en: That example is Lesson 1 again from another angle, and it is why the balance sheet matters even to someone who never intends to value a company. It tells you how much has to go wrong before the residual is gone.
4a76fe4fda2e.sw: Mfano huo ni Somo la 1 tena kutoka pembe nyingine, na ndiyo sababu mizania inahusika hata kwa mtu asiyekusudia kuthamini kampuni kamwe. Hukuambia mangapi lazima yaende vibaya kabla mabaki hayajaisha.

4a83c7426b1d.en: The distinction between a stop order and a limit order is where beginners lose money without understanding how. A stop order at 45 does not sell at 45. It sends a market order once 45 trades, and that order fills at whatever the book offers next, which in a fast fall may be well below.
4a83c7426b1d.sw: Tofauti kati ya agizo la stop na agizo la kikomo ndipo wanaoanza hupoteza pesa bila kuelewa jinsi gani. Agizo la stop kwa 45 haliuzi kwa 45. Hutuma agizo la soko mara 45 inapofanyiwa biashara, na agizo hilo hutimizwa kwa chochote kitabu kinachotoa baadaye, ambacho katika kushuka kwa kasi kinaweza kuwa chini mno.

4a841bc31236.en: Start with the place most beginners keep everything. Chapter 1 Lesson 5 established what an exchange balance actually is. When you deposit, the coin moves to a wallet the exchange controls, and the blockchain now records the exchange as the owner. Your balance is a row in the exchange's internal database, which is the exchange's IOU to you. Every trade you make there is a database update, not a blockchain transaction. That structure creates a risk that has nothing to do with price. If the exchange is hacked, becomes insolvent, or freezes withdrawals, the chain still shows the coins where they always were. What fails is your claim on them.
4a841bc31236.sw: Anza na mahali ambapo waanzilishi wengi huweka kila kitu. Sura ya 1 Somo la 5 lilithibitisha salio la soko la kubadilisha ni nini hasa. Unapoweka amana, sarafu husogea kwenda pochi ambayo soko huidhibiti, na mnyororo wa vitalu sasa huandika soko kama mmiliki. Salio lako ni safu katika hifadhidata ya ndani ya soko, ambayo ni deni la soko kwako. Kila biashara unayoifanya hapo ni sasisho la hifadhidata, si muamala wa mnyororo wa vitalu. Muundo huo huunda hatari isiyohusiana kabisa na bei. Ikiwa soko litadukuliwa, kufilisika, au kugandisha utoaji, mnyororo bado huonyesha sarafu zilipo daima. Kinachoshindwa ni dai lako juu yake.

4a9849a7fd30.en: Nothing at all; diversification never works
4a9849a7fd30.sw: Hakuna kabisa; kusambaza hakufanyi kazi kamwe

4aaf59d50cca.en: James Howells, a British IT worker, mined roughly 8,000 bitcoin in 2009 and lost the hard drive holding his private keys when it was mistakenly thrown out in 2013 and buried in a landfill in Newport, Wales. He spent over a decade trying to excavate it. In January 2025, the UK High Court dismissed his claim against the city council, ruling the buried drive was legally the council's property; his appeal was rejected two months later. Note what that story actually teaches: the coins were never stolen. The ledger still shows them. No hacker, no fraud — just a backup that ended up in the ground, and a legal system that could not help. Programmer Stefan Thomas tells the same story in miniature: 7,002 bitcoin earned in 2011, keys locked on an encrypted IronKey drive whose password he lost, with a device that erases itself after 10 wrong guesses — eight of which he has already used.
4aaf59d50cca.sw: James Howells, mfanyakazi wa IT wa Uingereza, alichimba takriban bitcoin 8,000 mwaka 2009 na akapoteza diski ngumu iliyoshikilia funguo zake za faragha ilipotupwa kwa makosa mwaka 2013 na kuzikwa katika jaa la taka mjini Newport, Wales. Alitumia zaidi ya muongo akijaribu kuichimbua. Mwezi Januari 2025, Mahakama Kuu ya Uingereza ilitupilia mbali dai lake dhidi ya halmashauri ya jiji, ikiamua kwamba diski iliyozikwa ilikuwa kisheria mali ya halmashauri; rufaa yake ilikataliwa miezi miwili baadaye. Tambua hadithi hiyo inafundisha nini hasa: sarafu hazikuibiwa kamwe. Leja bado inazionyesha. Hakuna mdukuzi, hakuna udanganyifu — nakala rudufu tu iliyoishia ardhini, na mfumo wa kisheria ambao haukuweza kusaidia. Programu Stefan Thomas husimulia hadithi ileile kwa udogo: bitcoin 7,002 zilizopatikana mwaka 2011, funguo zimefungiwa katika diski ya IronKey iliyosimbwa ambayo nenosiri lake alilipoteza, kwa kifaa kinachojifuta baada ya makisio 10 yasiyo sahihi — nane kati yake tayari ameyatumia.

4aef140c87fa.en: It falls by 10% only if the company chooses to pay a smaller dividend
4aef140c87fa.sw: Hushuka kwa 10% tu kama kampuni itachagua kulipa gawio dogo zaidi

4afd476679db.en: A perfect read of a chart, paired with no risk management, is still a losing strategy waiting to happen.
4afd476679db.sw: Usomaji kamili wa chati, ukiambatanishwa na kutokuwa na usimamizi wa hatari, bado ni mkakati wa hasara unaosubiri kutokea.

4b10c9ceee26.en: Correct. Every redemption did what the documentation said it would. The design was not broken; it was destroying the thing it was executing on. A system can be functioning perfectly and be catastrophic — LUNA went from about 87 dollars on 5 May to below 0.00005 by 13 May, a fall of roughly 99.99994%.
4b10c9ceee26.sw: Sahihi. Kila ukombozi ulifanya kile nyaraka zilisema utafanya. Muundo haukuvunjika; ulikuwa ukiharibu kitu kilichokuwa ukitekelezwa juu yake. Mfumo unaweza kuwa unafanya kazi kikamilifu na ukawa wa maafa — LUNA ilitoka takriban dola 87 tarehe 5 Mei hadi chini ya 0.00005 kufikia 13 Mei, kushuka kwa takriban 99.99994%.

4b1b520638b0.en: That last point ties the whole risk chapter together. Position sizing (Chapter 3, Lesson 1) keeps you alive through the variance. The risk-to-reward ratio and win rate (Chapter 3, Lesson 3) combine into expectancy. Discipline (Lesson 1) is what lets a positive expectancy actually be realised, instead of abandoned in the middle of a normal drawdown. The trading plan is the document that binds all of it into one repeatable process — which is the only thing that turns an edge on paper into money in an account.
4b1b520638b0.sw: Pointi hiyo ya mwisho huunganisha sura nzima ya hatari. Upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1) hukuweka hai katika utofauti. Uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo na kiwango cha ushindi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 3) huungana kuwa matarajio. Nidhamu (Somo la 1) ndicho kinachoruhusu matarajio chanya kutimizwa hasa, badala ya kuachwa katikati ya kushuka kwa kawaida. Mpango wa biashara ndio hati inayounganisha yote kuwa mchakato mmoja unaorudiwa — ambacho ndicho kitu pekee kinachogeuza faida kwenye karatasi kuwa pesa kwenye akaunti.

4b1cb39d10c4.en: Case Study — The 2016 Sterling Flash Crash
4b1cb39d10c4.sw: Uchunguzi wa Tukio — Anguko la Ghafla la Pauni la Mwaka 2016

4b20fd200911.en: Settlement looks like plumbing, and for a long-term holder it is. It becomes visible at exactly two moments: when you need the cash by a specific date, and when a market is under stress. Chapter 5 covers January 2021, when settlement mechanics stopped being invisible and became the story.
4b20fd200911.sw: Kutatua kunaonekana kama mabomba, na kwa mwenye kushikilia muda mrefu ni hivyo. Hujitokeza katika nyakati mbili hasa: unapohitaji fedha kwa tarehe mahususi, na soko linapokuwa chini ya shinikizo. Sura ya 5 inashughulikia Januari 2021, wakati utaratibu wa kutatua uliacha kuwa usioonekana na ukawa simulizi.

4b375d1b2caf.en: A professional does not take a trade just because the case is good; the payoff has to justify the risk. Using the risk-to-reward and break-even math from Chapter 3, Lesson 3, a serious thesis is expected to offer a reward-to-risk of at least roughly 2 to 1, and often more — enough that the trade is worth taking even at a modest win rate, and enough to carry the whole process's expectancy (Chapter 4, Lesson 2) into positive territory after the inevitable losers.
4b375d1b2caf.sw: Mtaalamu hachukui biashara kwa sababu hoja ni nzuri tu; malipo lazima yaihalalishe hatari. Kwa kutumia hisabati ya hatari-kwa-tuzo na kulingana kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 3, nadharia nzito inatarajiwa kutoa tuzo-kwa-hatari ya angalau takriban 2 kwa 1, na mara nyingi zaidi — vya kutosha kwamba biashara inastahili kuchukuliwa hata kwa kiwango cha wastani cha ushindi, na vya kutosha kubeba matarajio ya mchakato mzima (Sura ya 4, Somo la 2) hadi eneo chanya baada ya wapotezaji wasioepukika.

4b7075b8b7ef.en: A related finding sharpens it. Cremers and Petajisto (2009), in The Review of Financial Studies, introduced "Active Share" — how much a portfolio actually differs from its benchmark — and found that the managers who deviated most from the crowd, with the highest Active Share, were the ones who outperformed, before and after fees. Doing something genuinely different from the consensus is where returns come from — but only, both studies imply, when that difference is backed by real analysis rather than mere boldness.
4b7075b8b7ef.sw: Tokeo linalohusiana hulinoa. Cremers na Petajisto (2009), katika The Review of Financial Studies, walianzisha "Active Share" — kiasi ambacho mkusanyiko hutofautiana hasa na kigezo chake — na wakagundua kwamba wasimamizi waliopotoka zaidi kutoka kwa umati, wenye Active Share kubwa zaidi, ndio waliofanya vizuri zaidi, kabla na baada ya ada. Kufanya kitu tofauti kweli na makubaliano ya jumla ndipo faida zinapotoka — lakini tu, tafiti zote mbili zinadokeza, tofauti hiyo inapoungwa mkono na uchambuzi halisi badala ya ujasiri tu.

4b7bf725dc67.en: Bands are better than calendar dates for a practical reason. A fixed annual date makes you trade in years when nothing has drifted, and forbids you from acting in the year when everything has. A band responds to the portfolio rather than to the calendar. Either rule beats no rule, and the choice between them matters far less than writing one down.
4b7bf725dc67.sw: Kanda ni bora kuliko tarehe za kalenda kwa sababu ya kivitendo. Tarehe maalum ya kila mwaka hukufanya ufanye biashara katika miaka ambayo hakuna kilichotelezea, na hukukataza kutenda katika mwaka ambao kila kitu kimetelezea. Ukanda hujibu kasha badala ya kalenda. Kanuni yoyote kati ya hizo ni bora kuliko kutokuwa na kanuni, na chaguo kati yao lina maana ndogo zaidi kuliko kuandika moja.

4b813ef2f2b0.en: Three panels setting out what the income statement, the balance sheet and the cash flow statement each answer, noting that profit involves accounting judgement while cash either arrived or did not.
4b813ef2f2b0.sw: Paneli tatu zikieleza kile ambacho taarifa ya mapato, mizania na taarifa ya mtiririko wa fedha kila moja hujibu, zikibainisha kwamba faida huhusisha hukumu ya kihasibu ilhali fedha ama zilifika au hazikufika.

4b962761b414.en: Pick one high-impact event this week on a pair you follow. Before it lands, note the forecast. When the actual arrives, record: (1) was it a surprise, and in which direction? (2) where was price 5 minutes later? (3) 1 hour later? (4) the next day? Do this for a few events and you'll have something no article can give you — your own evidence base for how that specific release behaves. That's how you earn the right to trade news later, rather than guessing.
4b962761b414.sw: Chagua tukio moja lenye athari kubwa wiki hii kwenye jozi unalolifuatilia. Kabla halijafika, andika utabiri. Halisi inapofika, rekodi: (1) je, ilikuwa mshangao, na kwa mwelekeo upi? (2) bei ilikuwa wapi dakika 5 baadaye? (3) saa 1 baadaye? (4) siku iliyofuata? Fanya hivi kwa matukio machache na utakuwa na kitu ambacho hakuna makala inayoweza kukupa — msingi wako mwenyewe wa ushahidi wa jinsi toleo hilo mahususi linavyotenda. Ndivyo unavyopata haki ya kufanya biashara ya habari baadaye, badala ya kukisia.

4bb390c604fa.en: Not quite. Shorting is not free to hold. The borrow fee is charged for the whole period the position is open — 20% a year on 5,000 is 500 over six months, a 10% loss with the share price completely unchanged.
4bb390c604fa.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kuuza-mkopo si bure kushikilia. Ada ya kukopa hutozwa kwa kipindi chote ambacho nafasi ipo wazi — 20% kwa mwaka juu ya 5,000 ni 500 kwa miezi sita, hasara ya 10% huku bei ya hisa haijabadilika hata kidogo.

4bd4710349af.en: Before 2008, there was exactly one working answer: put a trusted central party in charge of the ledger. The bank, the card network, or the payment company records every transaction and rejects any coin that has already been spent. The "coin" never really moves — the referee's ledger just updates. This answer works. It runs the entire modern banking system. Its cost is that you must trust the referee: to stay honest, to stay solvent, to not freeze your account, and to stay in business.
4bd4710349af.sw: Kabla ya 2008, kulikuwa na jibu moja tu lililofanya kazi: weka upande mkuu unaoaminika kusimamia leja. Benki, mtandao wa kadi, au kampuni ya malipo huandika kila muamala na hukataa sarafu yoyote ambayo tayari imetumika. "Sarafu" haisogei kamwe kweli — leja ya mwamuzi hujisasisha tu. Jibu hili hufanya kazi. Huendesha mfumo mzima wa kisasa wa benki. Gharama yake ni kwamba lazima umwamini mwamuzi: abaki mwaminifu, abaki na uwezo wa kulipa, asifungie akaunti yako, na abaki katika biashara.

4be2a93da2eb.en: A cyclical mining company trades at a P/E of 6 at the peak of a commodity cycle and a P/E of 40 two years later. What does this pattern illustrate?
4be2a93da2eb.sw: Kampuni ya uchimbaji ya mzunguko hufanyiwa biashara kwa P/E ya 6 katika kilele cha mzunguko wa bidhaa na P/E ya 40 miaka miwili baadaye. Mtindo huu unaonyesha nini?

4bebdc477f76.en: Correct - a SIM swap transfers your number to a SIM the attacker controls, and everything sent to that number follows. The Princeton study presented at USENIX SOUPS in 2020 found roughly 80% of its 50 SIM-swap attempts across five carriers succeeded, and identified 17 sites that could be taken over by a SIM swap alone. The SEC's own X account was taken over this way in January 2024. NIST now classifies telephone-network one-time codes as a restricted authenticator. An authenticator app or hardware security key removes the phone number from the attack path entirely.
4bebdc477f76.sw: Sahihi - ubadilishaji wa SIM huhamisha namba yako kwenda SIM ambayo mshambuliaji huidhibiti, na kila kinachotumwa kwa namba hiyo hufuata. Utafiti wa Princeton uliowasilishwa katika USENIX SOUPS mwaka 2020 ulibaini takriban 80% ya majaribio yake 50 ya ubadilishaji wa SIM katika watoa huduma watano yalifanikiwa, na ulitambua tovuti 17 zingeweza kuchukuliwa kwa ubadilishaji wa SIM pekee. Akaunti ya X ya SEC yenyewe ilichukuliwa hivi mwezi Januari 2024. NIST sasa huainisha misimbo ya matumizi-moja ya mtandao wa simu kama kithibitishaji kilichozuiwa. Programu ya kuthibitisha au ufunguo halisi wa usalama huondoa namba ya simu katika njia ya shambulizi kabisa.

4bf1e58b86a6.en: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling and Schrimpf (2012), in The Journal of Finance, showed that carry trade returns are strongly tied to global currency volatility: the strategy earns steadily in calm periods and then suffers sharp, correlated losses exactly when volatility spikes. The broader work on this — including Brunnermeier, Nagel and Pedersen's study "Carry Trades and Currency Crashes" — describes the same shape: carry profits are not a free lunch but compensation for bearing crash risk. The 2008 yen unwind is that theory playing out in the open.
4bf1e58b86a6.sw: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling na Schrimpf (2012), katika The Journal of Finance, walionyesha kwamba faida za carry trade zimefungwa kwa nguvu na mtikisiko wa sarafu duniani: mkakati hupata faida kwa uthabiti katika vipindi tulivu na kisha hupata hasara kali zenye uwiano hasa mtikisiko unapopanda ghafla. Kazi pana juu ya hili — ikiwemo utafiti wa Brunnermeier, Nagel na Pedersen "Carry Trades and Currency Crashes" — huelezea umbo lile lile: faida za carry si chakula cha bure bali fidia kwa kubeba hatari ya kuanguka. Kuvunjika kwa yen kwa mwaka 2008 ni nadharia hiyo ikijitokeza waziwazi.

4bfb66e89f7d.en: Correct — these are precise, different relationships. An asset can be one without being the other.
4bfb66e89f7d.sw: Sahihi — haya ni mahusiano sahihi na tofauti. Mali inaweza kuwa moja bila kuwa nyingine.

4bfc678473d9.en: Lump sum always wins, so the timing decision does not matter
4bfc678473d9.sw: Kiasi kamili daima hushinda, hivyo uamuzi wa muda hauhusiki

4c057ff382bc.en: When a currency can buy more of another currency than before, it has appreciated (strengthened). When it can buy less, it has depreciated (weakened). In the example above, the peso appreciated against the dollar — it took fewer pesos to equal one dollar, which meant each peso was now worth more.
4c057ff382bc.sw: Sarafu inapoweza kununua kiasi kikubwa cha sarafu nyingine kuliko awali, imeimarika. Inapoweza kununua kidogo, imedhoofika. Katika mfano hapo juu, peso iliimarika dhidi ya dola — ilihitaji peso chache kufikia dola moja, jambo lililomaanisha kila peso sasa ilikuwa na thamani kubwa zaidi.

4c0b873f49a9.en: Selling losing trades quickly and letting winners run
4c0b873f49a9.sw: Kuuza biashara za hasara kwa haraka na kuacha washindi wakimbie

4c0fa7058228.en: Here is the catch that undoes beginners who understand everything above. Expectancy is an average over many trades. Any short stretch is dominated by luck, not edge.
4c0fa7058228.sw: Huu hapa mtego unaowamaliza wanaoanza wanaoelewa kila kitu hapo juu. Matarajio ni wastani katika biashara nyingi. Mfululizo wowote mfupi hutawaliwa na bahati, si faida.

4c429dae3088.en: The periodic payment between long and short holders of a perpetual futures contract, which turns positive when longs are crowded and negative when shorts are.
4c429dae3088.sw: Malipo ya mara kwa mara kati ya wamiliki warefu na wafupi wa mkataba wa baadaye wa kudumu, ambayo huwa chanya wakati warefu wamejaa na hasi wakati wafupi wamejaa.

4c458f228c25.en: Not quite — the 2015 SNB event proved the opposite: stop-losses triggered correctly but filled far from their set price. A stop-loss guarantees a trigger, not a fill price.
4c458f228c25.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — tukio la SNB la mwaka 2015 lilithibitisha kinyume: stop-loss zilianzishwa kwa usahihi lakini zilitimizwa mbali na bei yao iliyowekwa. Stop-loss huhakikisha kianzishi, si bei ya kutimizwa.

4c525ad9fd96.en: A decentralized ledger needs a way to agree on the next block, so both systems make writing history expensive — PoW with electricity, PoS with confiscatable capital — and both face the same 51% question.
4c525ad9fd96.sw: Leja isiyo na kituo kikuu inahitaji njia ya kukubaliana kuhusu kitalu kinachofuata, kwa hivyo mifumo yote miwili hufanya kuandika historia kuwa ghali — PoW kwa umeme, PoS kwa mtaji unaoweza kutaifishwa — na yote miwili hukabiliana na swali lilelile la 51%.

4c65c96bcfd2.en: Expect a second approach. People who have been defrauded are contacted again by supposed recovery services, investigators or lawyers offering to trace and return the funds for an upfront fee. This is frequently the same operation or one that bought the victim list, and it works because the target is now desperate rather than merely hopeful. No legitimate recovery service asks for payment in crypto, and nobody can reverse a settled transaction — Chapter 1 Lesson 6 established that finality is not negotiable by anyone.
4c65c96bcfd2.sw: Tarajia kufikiwa mara ya pili. Watu waliodanganywa hufikiwa tena na huduma zinazodaiwa za urejeshaji, wachunguzi au mawakili wanaotoa kufuatilia na kurudisha fedha kwa ada ya awali. Hii mara nyingi ni shughuli ileile au moja iliyonunua orodha ya waathiriwa, nayo hufanya kazi kwa sababu lengwa sasa amekata tamaa badala ya kuwa na matumaini tu. Hakuna huduma halali ya urejeshaji inayoomba malipo kwa kripto, na hakuna anayeweza kutendua muamala uliotimizwa — Sura ya 1 Somo la 6 lilithibitisha kwamba umalizio hauwezi kujadiliwa na yeyote.

4c668b4143a2.en: It has fallen by 2.00 — the price dropped and the dividend does not compensate
4c668b4143a2.sw: Umeshuka kwa 2.00 — bei ilishuka na gawio halifidii

4c6dd02f82ff.en: Evaluating a currency based on the underlying economic forces that drive its value — interest rates, inflation, growth, employment, and central bank policy — rather than on chart patterns.
4c6dd02f82ff.sw: Kutathmini sarafu kwa msingi wa nguvu za kiuchumi za msingi zinazoendesha thamani yake — viwango vya riba, mfumuko wa bei, ukuaji, ajira, na sera ya benki kuu — badala ya mitindo ya chati.

4c872a7c0aed.en: A note on rebalancing, because crypto makes it both harder and more necessary than anywhere else in this course.
4c872a7c0aed.sw: Noti kuhusu kusawazisha upya, kwa sababu kripto hufanya iwe ngumu zaidi na yenye ulazima zaidi kuliko mahali pengine popote katika kozi hii.

4c98b6985693.en: "Uncorrelated" is a claim about a period, not a property of an asset. Correlation is measured over a window of time. Change the window and the number changes. When someone tells you crypto is uncorrelated, the only useful reply is a question: uncorrelated with what, measured over which dates? An answer that cannot name the window is not evidence.
4c98b6985693.sw: "Isiyo na uhusiano" ni dai kuhusu kipindi, si sifa ya rasilimali. Uhusiano hupimwa katika dirisha la muda. Badilisha dirisha na namba hubadilika. Mtu anapokuambia kripto haina uhusiano, jibu pekee lenye manufaa ni swali: haina uhusiano na nini, ikipimwa katika tarehe zipi? Jibu lisiloweza kutaja dirisha si ushahidi.

4cbced9c8c7f.en: Before your next discretionary equity decision, write down three things: what government bond yields have done over the last three months, what has happened to credit spreads, and whether the shares you are considering derive their value mainly from near or distant profits. If the first two have moved against the third, your thesis needs a reason why — and if you cannot supply one, you have learned something for the cost of ten minutes.
4cbced9c8c7f.sw: Kabla ya uamuzi wako ujao wa hiari wa hisa, andika mambo matatu: mavuno ya hatifungani za serikali yamefanya nini katika miezi mitatu iliyopita, nini kimetokea kwa mianya ya mikopo, na kama hisa unazozifikiria hupata thamani yake hasa kutoka faida za karibu au za mbali. Ikiwa mbili za kwanza zimesonga kinyume na ya tatu, nadharia yako inahitaji sababu ya kwa nini — na ikiwa huwezi kutoa moja, umejifunza kitu kwa gharama ya dakika kumi.

4ce18ea084c3.en: At the invalidation level — the price or condition at which the thesis is proven wrong
4ce18ea084c3.sw: Kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika — bei au hali ambapo nadharia inathibitishwa kuwa batili

4d291d4fc772.en: Lesson 1 of this chapter gave you the arithmetic for price risk. You size a position so that a move against you costs a known, survivable amount. That machinery works. It also has one blind spot, and the blind spot is total. You can be completely right about the market and still lose everything.
4d291d4fc772.sw: Somo la 1 la sura hii lilikupa hesabu ya hatari ya bei. Unapanga ukubwa wa nafasi ili msogeo dhidi yako ugharimu kiasi kinachojulikana, kinachonusurika. Mitambo hiyo hufanya kazi. Pia ina doa moja la upofu, na doa la upofu ni la jumla. Unaweza kuwa sahihi kabisa kuhusu soko na bado ukapoteza kila kitu.

4d2d10756cd6.en: Read the 25x figure again, because it is the quietest and the most damning. At 25x the distance to your liquidation is about 1.1 average daily bars. A single day that runs slightly wider than average covers it. Not a crash, not a news event, just a day. You can also estimate how likely a random price path is to touch that level. Using a driftless random walk with a 2.41% daily standard deviation, the probability of touching the liquidation level at least once is roughly: at 10x, near zero in a day, 13% in a week, 47% in a month. At 25x, 13% in a day, 57% in a week, 79% in a month. At 50x, 51% in a day, 80% in a week, 90% in a month. At 100x, 80% in a day, 93% in a week, 96% in a month.
4d2d10756cd6.sw: Soma takwimu ya 25x tena, kwa sababu ndiyo ya kimya zaidi na ya kulaumu zaidi. Katika 25x umbali hadi ufilisi wako ni takriban mistari 1.1 ya wastani ya kila siku. Siku moja inayokimbia pana kidogo kuliko wastani huufunika. Si mporomoko, si tukio la habari, siku tu. Unaweza pia kukadiria uwezekano wa njia ya bei ya nasibu kugusa kiwango hicho. Ukitumia mwendo wa nasibu usio na msukumo wenye mkengeuko wa kawaida wa 2.41% kwa siku, uwezekano wa kugusa kiwango cha ufilisi angalau mara moja ni takriban: katika 10x, karibu sifuri katika siku, 13% katika wiki, 47% katika mwezi. Katika 25x, 13% katika siku, 57% katika wiki, 79% katika mwezi. Katika 50x, 51% katika siku, 80% katika wiki, 90% katika mwezi. Katika 100x, 80% katika siku, 93% katika wiki, 96% katika mwezi.

4d4f9a63d2a4.en: Correct — unwinding a yen-funded carry trade means buying yen back. With everyone forced to unwind together in the crisis, the crowded, simultaneous buying sent the yen sharply higher.
4d4f9a63d2a4.sw: Sahihi — kuvunja carry trade iliyofadhiliwa na yen kunamaanisha kununua yen tena. Kila mtu akilazimika kuvunja kwa pamoja katika janga, ununuzi wa msongamano na wa wakati mmoja uliipandisha yen kwa kasi.

4d53a246ea9a.en: In July 1944, representatives of 44 Allied nations met in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, to design a new system: instead of every country backing its own currency with its own gold, every country would peg its currency to the U.S. dollar, and only the dollar would remain convertible to gold — at that same $35-per-ounce rate from 1934.
4d53a246ea9a.sw: Mwezi Julai 1944, wawakilishi wa mataifa 44 ya Washirika walikutana Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, kubuni mfumo mpya: badala ya kila nchi kuunga mkono sarafu yake kwa dhahabu yake yenyewe, kila nchi ingefunga sarafu yake kwenye dola ya Marekani, na dola pekee ndiyo ingebaki inabadilishwa kuwa dhahabu — kwa kiwango kile kile cha $35 kwa wakia cha mwaka 1934.

4d662f3c0e6e.en: Ethereum's unit for measuring computational work. Every operation costs a fixed number of gas units: a simple transfer of ETH from one address to another always costs 21,000 gas, while interacting with a complex program can cost many times more. Your fee is the gas your transaction used multiplied by the price per unit of gas.
4d662f3c0e6e.sw: Kipimo cha Ethereum cha kupima kazi ya kihesabu. Kila operesheni hugharimu idadi isiyobadilika ya vipimo vya gesi: uhamisho rahisi wa ETH kutoka anwani moja kwenda nyingine daima hugharimu gesi 21,000, huku kuingiliana na programu changamano kunaweza kugharimu mara nyingi zaidi. Ada yako ni gesi ambayo muamala wako ulitumia ikizidishwa na bei kwa kila kipimo cha gesi.

4d6f364d2cb7.en: Look at the job postings at any serious investment firm. You'll see plenty of listings for risk managers. You will not see a "profit-taking manager." These firms don't primarily focus on how much they're making — they focus on how much they could lose, and how to control it.
4d6f364d2cb7.sw: Angalia matangazo ya kazi katika kampuni yoyote nzito ya uwekezaji. Utaona matangazo mengi ya wasimamizi wa hatari. Hutaona "msimamizi wa kuchukua faida." Kampuni hizi hazizingatii kwanza kiasi wanachopata — zinazingatia kiasi wanachoweza kupoteza, na jinsi ya kukidhibiti.

4d971fb63973.en: The pool of real-world assets an issuer holds to back its tokens. "Fully backed" means the reserve's value at least equals the tokens in circulation. Whether that is true, and what the reserve actually contains, is a claim to verify — not a fact to assume.

4dd9f90f7765.en: This next part is the section most beginners have never been taught, and it is the one that produces losses long after the mistake. To trade on a decentralized exchange, or use most on-chain applications, you do not send your tokens to the application. You grant its smart contract permission to move a token out of your wallet on your behalf. That permission is a separate transaction, and it is recorded on the blockchain as its own standing fact.

Unatoa ruhusa kwa mkataba wake mahiri kusogeza tokeni kutoka pochi yako kwa niaba yako. Ruhusa hiyo ni muamala tofauti, nayo huandikwa katika mnyororo wa vitalu kama ukweli wake wa kudumu.

4e5038ed1eb0.en: A system wins 45% of the time, with an average win of 300 dollars and an average loss of 150 dollars. Expectancy = (0.45 times 300) minus (0.55 times 150) = 135 minus 82.50 = +52.50 dollars per trade. Over 200 trades, that is about +10,500 dollars before costs — from a system that loses more often than it wins. Now the warning case: a system wins 60% of the time, but the average win is only 80 dollars against an average loss of 150. Expectancy = (0.60 times 80) minus (0.40 times 150) = 48 minus 60 = minus 12 dollars per trade. A 60% win rate that steadily loses money — Chapter 3, Lesson 3's point, now measured in dollars.
4e5038ed1eb0.sw: Mfumo hushinda 45% ya muda, wenye ushindi wa wastani wa dola 300 na hasara ya wastani ya dola 150. Matarajio = (0.45 mara 300) toa (0.55 mara 150) = 135 toa 82.50 = +dola 52.50 kwa kila biashara. Katika biashara 200, hiyo ni takriban +dola 10,500 kabla ya gharama — kutoka mfumo unaopoteza mara nyingi zaidi kuliko unavyoshinda. Sasa kesi ya onyo: mfumo hushinda 60% ya muda, lakini ushindi wa wastani ni dola 80 tu dhidi ya hasara ya wastani ya 150. Matarajio = (0.60 mara 80) toa (0.40 mara 150) = 48 toa 60 = toa dola 12 kwa kila biashara. Kiwango cha ushindi cha 60% kinachopoteza pesa kwa uthabiti — pointi ya Sura ya 3, Somo la 3, sasa ikipimwa kwa dola.

4e9a7c12b04e.en: On 21 February 2025, Bybit was moving funds from a cold multisignature wallet to a hot wallet. That is a routine operation, performed by professionals, using a well-regarded multisignature tool. Public analyses converged on the mechanism: a developer machine belonging to the wallet-software provider was compromised, and the interface shown to Bybit's signers was altered. The signers saw a normal internal transfer on their screens. What they actually authorized was a transaction handing control of the wallet to the attacker. Roughly 1.5 billion dollars left in a single operation. Nobody guessed a private key. Nobody broke any cryptography. The signature was valid, and the ledger did exactly what a valid signature told it to do. The attack was on what the humans were shown.
4e9a7c12b04e.sw: Tarehe 21 Februari 2025, Bybit ilikuwa ikisogeza fedha kutoka pochi baridi ya sahihi nyingi kwenda pochi ya moto. Hiyo ni shughuli ya kawaida, inayofanywa na wataalamu, ikitumia zana ya sahihi nyingi inayoheshimika. Uchambuzi wa umma ulikubaliana kuhusu utaratibu: mashine ya msanidi programu ya mtoa programu ya pochi iliathiriwa, na kiolesura kilichoonyeshwa kwa watiaji sahihi wa Bybit kilibadilishwa. Watiaji sahihi waliona uhamisho wa kawaida wa ndani kwenye skrini zao. Kile walichoidhinisha hasa kilikuwa muamala uliokabidhi udhibiti wa pochi kwa mshambuliaji. Takriban dola bilioni 1.5 ziliondoka katika shughuli moja. Hakuna aliyekisia ufunguo wa faragha. Hakuna aliyevunja kriptografia yoyote. Sahihi ilikuwa halali, na leja ilifanya hasa kile sahihi halali iliyoiambia ifanye. Shambulizi lilikuwa juu ya kile binadamu walichoonyeshwa.

4efd21e7347c.en: On a leveraged perpetual the distance from entry to liquidation is set by leverage and almost nothing else - roughly 1 divided by leverage - so at 50x that distance is 1.6% while bitcoin's ordinary daily standard deviation is about 2.4%, which means what ends most leveraged accounts is not being wrong about direction but being closed out before direction has a chance to matter.

4efdf107e3ea.en: The window length is the whole personality of the indicator. In a short SMA (say 20 periods), each new candle is 1/20 of the data, so the line reacts quickly and hugs price. In a long SMA (say 50), each new candle is only 1/50 of the data, so the line is smoother and slower — it filters out noise at the cost of reacting late. Neither is "better"; they answer different questions: what has price done recently versus what has price done over the longer stretch.
4efdf107e3ea.sw: Urefu wa dirisha ndio tabia yote ya kiashiria. Katika SMA fupi (tuseme vipindi 20), kila mshumaa mpya ni 1/20 ya data, hivyo mstari huitikia haraka na kushikamana na bei. Katika SMA ndefu (tuseme 50), kila mshumaa mpya ni 1/50 tu ya data, hivyo mstari ni laini na wa polepole zaidi — huchuja kelele kwa gharama ya kuitikia kwa kuchelewa. Hakuna "bora"; zinajibu maswali tofauti: bei imefanya nini hivi karibuni dhidi ya bei imefanya nini kwa kipindi kirefu zaidi.

4f538ba97c8a.en: Two feelings do most of the damage, and they are worth naming plainly. Fear, in trading, is the pull to cut a gain short before it can turn, or to avoid the discomfort of admitting a loss. Greed is the pull to want more — a bigger position, one more trade, a target stretched further out. The rest of this lesson is really about the specific, documented mistakes those two feelings produce, and the one thing that actually defends against them.

Tamaa ni mvuto wa kutaka zaidi — nafasi kubwa zaidi, biashara moja zaidi, lengo lililonyooshwa mbali zaidi. Sehemu iliyobaki ya somo hili kwa kweli inahusu makosa mahususi yaliyoandikwa ambayo hisia hizo mbili huzalisha, na kitu kimoja kinachozilinda hasa.

That's precisely why currency values move, and why markets like this one exist at all.

5062d84a86af.en: The data does not support these claims: that the halving causes the subsequent price move, because three confounded, dependent cycles cannot separate the halving from macro liquidity, regulatory access or adoption; that there is a reliable, tradeable timing rule, because the strongest published attempt was tested by two peer-reviewed studies and underperformed buying and holding in one and failed out-of-sample in the other; and that the pattern must continue, because it has been checked four times with a window fitted after the fact.
