507c14895f05.en: It has two limitations that matter to a reader rather than to a statistician. It treats an upward move and a downward move as equally undesirable, which no investor does. And it describes the ordinary range of variation, which is precisely not the part of the distribution that damages people.
507c14895f05.sw: Kina vikomo viwili vinavyomhusu msomaji badala ya mtaalamu wa takwimu. Huchukulia msogeo wa juu na msogeo wa chini kama visivyotakiwa sawasawa, jambo ambalo hakuna mwekezaji hufanya. Na hueleza kiwango cha kawaida cha kutofautiana, ambako si hasa sehemu ya mtawanyiko inayowadhuru watu.

507f70518d26.en: Two stacked bars showing the same company in a good year and after a 10 percent fall in revenue. Suppliers take 40, staff 35, interest 10 and tax 5 in both cases, leaving a residual of 10 in the first and nothing in the second, illustrating that a 10 percent fall in revenue can remove the shareholders claim entirely.
507f70518d26.sw: Vipau viwili vilivyorundikwa vinavyoonyesha kampuni ile ile katika mwaka mzuri na baada ya kushuka kwa asilimia 10 kwa mapato. Wasambazaji huchukua 40, wafanyakazi 35, riba 10 na kodi 5 katika kesi zote mbili, zikiacha mabaki ya 10 katika ya kwanza na hakuna katika ya pili, zikionyesha kwamba kushuka kwa asilimia 10 kwa mapato kunaweza kuondoa dai la wanahisa kabisa.

50868c752163.sw: Kiasi cha soko dola 200,000,000; FDV dola 2,000,000,000

50a5ae1977a6.en: Because the index switched to price weighting
50a5ae1977a6.sw: Kwa sababu faharasa ilibadilika kwenda uzani wa bei

50ab67f127fd.en: Each charge is small, so the total is not a concern
50ab67f127fd.sw: Kila malipo ni madogo, kwa hivyo jumla si jambo la kuhofia

50c20943e50c.en: 200 dollars, because that is the amount you actually traded
50c20943e50c.sw: Dola 200, kwa sababu hicho ndicho kiasi ulichofanyia biashara hasa

50c3827381d4.en: Not quite. The fee applies to your whole balance every year, not once, so it compounds against you. On 10,000 over 30 years at 7%, the difference between 0.05% and 1.50% is about 25,223 — the expensive fund finishes with roughly two thirds of what the cheap one produced.
50c3827381d4.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ada hutumika kwa salio lako lote kila mwaka, si mara moja, hivyo hujikusanya dhidi yako. Kwa 10,000 katika miaka 30 kwa 7%, tofauti kati ya 0.05% na 1.50% ni takriban 25,223 — fund ghali humalizia na takriban theluthi mbili ya kile ile ya bei nafuu ilizalisha.

50cd82c2f095.en: Correct. Longin and Solnik found correlation rises in the negative tail and not the positive one. The protection was real in ordinary years and weakest in the worst ones, which is the honest description of what diversification buys — and the reason to hold things that are different in kind, plus cash, rather than relying on region alone.
50cd82c2f095.sw: Sahihi. Longin na Solnik walibaini uhusiano hupanda katika mkia hasi na si katika chanya. Ulinzi ulikuwa halisi katika miaka ya kawaida na dhaifu zaidi katika mibaya zaidi, ambayo ndiyo maelezo ya kweli ya kile ambacho mtawanyiko hununua — na sababu ya kushikilia vitu vilivyo tofauti kwa aina, pamoja na fedha taslimu, badala ya kutegemea kanda pekee.

50d303ab3d06.en: This is why share prices move so much more than a company's revenue does. The residual is the thin layer at the end of a stack, so a small change in the size of the stack is a large change in the layer. A 10% fall in revenue in that example does not reduce the shareholders' claim by 10%. It removes it entirely.
50d303ab3d06.sw: Ndiyo sababu bei za hisa husogea zaidi mno kuliko mapato ya kampuni yanavyosogea. Mabaki ni safu nyembamba mwishoni mwa rundo, hivyo mabadiliko madogo ya ukubwa wa rundo ni mabadiliko makubwa ya safu. Kushuka kwa 10% kwa mapato katika mfano huo hakupunguzi dai la wanahisa kwa 10%. Kunaliondoa kabisa.

50d91e6a9d6c.en: The distinction is not how risky it feels. It is whether anything is being created outside the transactions.
50d91e6a9d6c.sw: Tofauti si jinsi inavyohisi hatari. Ni kama kitu chochote kinaundwa nje ya miamala.

50ebd6b9edfa.en: Because crypto is taxed differently on death
50ebd6b9edfa.sw: Kwa sababu kripto hutozwa kodi tofauti wakati wa kifo

50f816d59204.en: Crypto rose while equities fell, confirming the inflation-hedge claim
50f816d59204.sw: Kripto ilipanda huku hisa zikishuka, ikithibitisha dai la kinga dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei

51043a06aaf7.en: A signal generated when a shorter-period moving average crosses a longer-period one. Short crossing above long = recent prices outperforming the longer stretch (buy signal). Short crossing below long = recent prices underperforming (sell signal).
51043a06aaf7.sw: Ishara inayozalishwa wastani wa kipindi kifupi unapokatiza ule wa kipindi kirefu. Fupi kukatiza juu ya ndefu = bei za hivi karibuni kufanya vizuri kuliko kipindi kirefu (ishara ya kununua). Fupi kukatiza chini ya ndefu = bei za hivi karibuni kufanya vibaya (ishara ya kuuza).

510b83823920.en: Take any confirmed transaction — one of your own if you have made one, or any recent transaction listed on a public explorer's front page. Find three things: (1) its status, (2) its number of confirmations right now, then refresh after a few minutes and watch the number grow, and (3) its fee — then compute the fee as a percentage of the amount moved. Would you have accepted that percentage knowingly? You have just done, for free, the settlement check that most crypto users never do.
510b83823920.sw: Chukua muamala wowote uliothibitishwa — wako mwenyewe ikiwa umewahi kufanya, au muamala wowote wa hivi karibuni ulioorodheshwa katika ukurasa wa mbele wa kichunguzi cha umma. Tafuta mambo matatu: (1) hali yake, (2) idadi yake ya uthibitisho sasa hivi, kisha onyesha upya baada ya dakika chache na uangalie namba ikikua, na (3) ada yake — kisha hesabu ada kama asilimia ya kiasi kilichohamishwa. Je, ungeikubali asilimia hiyo ukijua? Umefanya tu, bure, ukaguzi wa utimizaji ambao watumiaji wengi wa kripto hawaufanyi kamwe.

51449fac35ae.en: A reader who wants to run the full six-pillar process on crypto assets themselves now has everything required to do it, and to judge whether someone else has done it properly. That second skill is the more valuable one. Running the process well is time-consuming, and some readers who understand it completely will still prefer not to do it themselves; for them, Scere Training sells completed theses built with this framework through its research service. That is the only mention it gets, and the framework is taught in full here precisely so that you can evaluate such a thesis — including ours — rather than take it on trust.
51449fac35ae.sw: Msomaji anayetaka kuendesha mchakato kamili wa nguzo sita katika rasilimali za kripto mwenyewe sasa ana kila kinachohitajika kuufanya, na kuhukumu kama mtu mwingine ameufanya ipasavyo. Ujuzi huo wa pili ndio wenye thamani zaidi. Kuendesha mchakato vizuri huchukua muda mwingi, na wasomaji baadhi wanaouelewa kabisa bado watapendelea wasiufanye wenyewe; kwao, Scere Training huuza nadharia kamili zilizojengwa kwa mfumo huu kupitia huduma yake ya utafiti. Hilo ndilo tajo pekee linalopata, na mfumo hufundishwa kikamilifu hapa hasa ili uweze kutathmini nadharia kama hiyo — ikiwa ni pamoja na yetu — badala ya kuichukua kwa imani.

514c3456d6ae.en: A stop-loss order becomes a market order once triggered, and a market order fills at the best price available. On 15 January there was almost no price available: buyers vanished exactly as the sell orders arrived. Stop-losses set safely near 1.20 did trigger — and then filled hundreds of pips lower, or not at all. Even the broker's own stop-out (Chapter 3, Lesson 2), meant to close positions before an account goes negative, could not work in a market with no bids to sell into.
514c3456d6ae.sw: Agizo la stop-loss hukuwa agizo la soko mara linapoanzishwa, na agizo la soko hutimizwa kwa bei bora inayopatikana. Tarehe 15 Januari hakukuwa na bei karibu yoyote iliyopatikana: wanunuzi walitoweka hasa maagizo ya kuuza yalipofika. Stop-loss zilizowekwa salama karibu na 1.20 zilianzishwa kweli — kisha zikatimizwa mamia ya pip chini, au hazikutimizwa kabisa. Hata stop-out ya broker mwenyewe (Sura ya 3, Somo la 2), iliyokusudiwa kufunga nafasi kabla akaunti haijawa hasi, haikuweza kufanya kazi katika soko lisilo na bid za kuuzia.

515a1c2db408.en: Correct — a bank run is a confidence problem, not necessarily a wrongdoing problem. The bank can be doing exactly what it always does and still run out if enough people show up at once.
515a1c2db408.sw: Sahihi — kukimbilia benki ni tatizo la imani, si lazima liwe tatizo la kosa. Benki inaweza kuwa inafanya hasa inavyofanya daima na bado ikaishiwa kama watu wa kutosha watafika kwa wakati mmoja.

51605a49b2c4.en: What replaces it is supply arithmetic, which is the closest thing to a hard constraint available. Chapter 4 Lesson 1 covered this as denominator blindness: the unit price is meaningless without the supply, the total supply and the unlock schedule are published, and the implied market capitalisation of a price target is a number you can compare against things that exist.
51605a49b2c4.sw: Kinachochukua nafasi yake ni hesabu ya usambazaji, ambako ni kitu kinachokaribia zaidi kizuizi kigumu kinachopatikana. Sura ya 4 Somo la 1 lilishughulikia hili kama upofu wa kigawanyaji: bei ya kipimo haina maana bila usambazaji, usambazaji jumla na ratiba ya kufungua vimechapishwa, na kiasi cha soko kinachoashiriwa na lengo la bei ni namba unayoweza kuilinganisha na vitu vilivyopo.

5164a603d506.en: A written set of rules covering what you trade, the conditions for entering, where the stop and target go, how position size is calculated, the maximum you will risk, and how you review results. Its purpose is to move decisions out of the emotional moment and into calm preparation.
5164a603d506.sw: Seti ya kanuni zilizoandikwa zinazohusu unachofanyia biashara, masharti ya kuingia, mahali stop na lengo huenda, jinsi ukubwa wa nafasi unavyokokotolewa, kiwango cha juu utakachohatarisha, na jinsi unavyopitia matokeo. Kusudi lake ni kuhamisha maamuzi kutoka kwenye wakati wa kihisia hadi kwenye maandalizi ya utulivu.

5171f87c8a41.en: Not quite — the stop fills deep in the plunge, locking in a real loss, and a later recovery cannot undo an exit that already executed.
5171f87c8a41.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — stop hutimizwa ndani kabisa ya kuporomoka, ikihifadhi hasara halisi, na kupona baadaye hakuwezi kubatilisha kutoka kulikotekelezwa tayari.

51860c7b9384.en: Because it only affects professional investors, not beginners
51860c7b9384.sw: Kwa sababu huathiri wawekezaji wa kitaalamu pekee, si waanzilishi

518c0c89102f.en: The Japanese bankruptcy-protection process Mt. Gox filed under on 28 February 2014.
518c0c89102f.sw: Mchakato wa ulinzi wa kufilisika wa Kijapani ambao Mt. Gox iliwasilisha ombi chini yake tarehe 28 Februari 2014.

5196950344b5.en: And read what you are signing. If your wallet shows you a transaction summary and you cannot tell what it does, that is a reason to reject it, not a reason to proceed. The Bybit signers lost 1.5 billion dollars by approving something whose real contents they could not see. The same discipline scales down to a 50 dollar swap.
5196950344b5.sw: Na soma unachotia sahihi. Ikiwa pochi yako itakuonyesha muhtasari wa muamala nawe huwezi kutambua unafanya nini, hiyo ni sababu ya kuukataa, si sababu ya kuendelea. Watiaji sahihi wa Bybit walipoteza dola bilioni 1.5 kwa kuidhinisha kitu ambacho yaliyomo yake halisi hawakuweza kuyaona. Nidhamu ileile hupimika chini hadi ubadilishaji wa dola 50.

519ffdaf13d4.en: Keep that distinction in view. "The company is fine" and "the shares are fine" are different statements, and Chapter 5 has case studies where they came apart badly.
519ffdaf13d4.sw: Weka tofauti hiyo mtazamoni. "Kampuni iko sawa" na "hisa ziko sawa" ni kauli tofauti, na Sura ya 5 ina uchunguzi wa matukio ambapo zilitengana vibaya.

51a0bde077a4.en: What to look for when deciding for yourself. Establish first whether you are actually facing this decision, or simply investing a salary as it arrives, in which case there is no choice to make. If you do hold a sum, decide the schedule and its end date before the first purchase. Ask honestly what you would do if the market fell 25% in month two, since the strategy is worthless if you would stop. And treat the expected cost of averaging in as the price of a behavioural guarantee, which is a fair thing to buy.
51a0bde077a4.sw: Cha kutazama unapoamua mwenyewe. Bainisha kwanza kama unakabiliwa na uamuzi huu hasa, au unawekeza mshahara unapofika tu, ambapo hakuna chaguo la kufanya. Kama unashikilia kiasi, amua ratiba na tarehe yake ya mwisho kabla ya ununuzi wa kwanza. Uliza kwa uaminifu ungefanya nini kama soko lingeshuka 25% mwezi wa pili, kwa kuwa mkakati hauna thamani kama ungesimama. Na chukulia gharama inayotarajiwa ya kupunguza wastani wa bei kama bei ya uhakika wa kitabia, ambayo ni kitu cha haki kununua.

51ac9741bf97.en: A stop-loss on a single company does not protect you against the event that matters most. Bad news arrives when the market is closed, and the shares reopen far below your stop — a gap, not a slide. The Forex track showed this with the Swiss franc in 2015; for a single company it happens on any results morning. Sizing so that the worst case is survivable is more reliable than a stop, because it does not depend on being able to trade.
51ac9741bf97.sw: Stop-loss kwenye kampuni moja haikulindi dhidi ya tukio linalohusika zaidi. Habari mbaya hufika soko likiwa limefungwa, na hisa hufunguliwa tena mbali chini ya stop yako — kuruka, si kuteleza. Njia ya Forex ilionyesha hili kwa faranga ya Uswisi mwaka 2015; kwa kampuni moja hutokea asubuhi yoyote ya matokeo. Kupima ili hali mbaya zaidi iweze kunusurika ni ya kutegemewa zaidi kuliko stop, kwa sababu haitegemei kuweza kufanya biashara.

51df75e77d14.en: Correct. Global means the rule includes companies worldwide, not that the money is spread evenly. Market-value weighting concentrates heavily in the largest markets, so the actual country exposure can be far less balanced than the word global suggests.
51df75e77d14.sw: Sahihi. Kimataifa kunamaanisha kanuni inajumuisha kampuni duniani kote, si kwamba pesa zimesambazwa sawasawa. Uzito wa thamani ya soko hujikita sana katika masoko makubwa zaidi, hivyo uwazi halisi wa nchi unaweza kuwa usiosawazishwa mno kuliko neno kimataifa linavyodokeza.

51efa1d792a5.en: The price of one currency expressed in terms of another. It tells you how much of one currency you'd get for one unit of the other.
51efa1d792a5.sw: Bei ya sarafu moja iliyoelezwa kwa sarafu nyingine. Inakuambia utapata kiasi gani cha sarafu moja kwa kipimo kimoja cha nyingine.

51f95f5641b3.en: Because the tracking difference measures the total shortfall against the index, and a fund with a slightly higher fee can deliver more of the index
51f95f5641b3.sw: Kwa sababu tofauti ya kufuatilia hupima upungufu wa jumla dhidi ya index, na fund yenye ada kubwa kidogo inaweza kutoa sehemu kubwa zaidi ya index

51fc47a1f7f8.en: Correct — (0.60 times 80) minus (0.40 times 150) = 48 minus 60 = minus 12 dollars. A high win rate does not save a system whose losses are much larger than its wins.
51fc47a1f7f8.sw: Sahihi — (0.60 mara 80) toa (0.40 mara 150) = 48 toa 60 = toa dola 12. Kiwango kikubwa cha ushindi hakiokoi mfumo ambao hasara zake ni kubwa mno kuliko ushindi wake.

520a4895caff.en: The single most common mistake beginners make with correlation is treating it as a fact about an asset, like its ticker. It is not. It is a statistic computed over a chosen stretch of dates.
520a4895caff.sw: Kosa moja linalojitokeza zaidi ambalo waanzilishi hulifanya kuhusu uhusiano ni kuuchukulia kama ukweli kuhusu rasilimali, kama alama yake ya biashara. Si hivyo. Ni takwimu iliyohesabiwa katika kipindi kilichochaguliwa cha tarehe.

520eed9b82f0.en: Support and resistance are not hard physical barriers — they're levels where enough traders have historically reacted that the reaction becomes somewhat self-reinforcing.
520eed9b82f0.sw: Msaada na upinzani si vizuizi vigumu vya kimwili — ni viwango ambapo wafanyabiashara wa kutosha wamekuwa wakiitikia kihistoria kiasi kwamba mwitikio huo unakuwa wa kujiimarisha wenyewe kwa kiasi fulani.

520f5de40dcf.en: Phishing is the dominant way individuals lose crypto, and it works because it targets recognition rather than technology. The shapes it takes are worth naming, because recognising the shape is most of the defence. A fake website is the oldest form: the address differs from the real one by a character or two, or it is a paid advertisement sitting above the genuine search result, and the page looks correct because it was copied from the real one.
520f5de40dcf.sw: Uvuvi ndiyo njia inayotawala ambayo watu binafsi hupoteza kripto, nao hufanya kazi kwa sababu hulenga utambuzi badala ya teknolojia. Maumbo inayochukua yanastahili kutajwa, kwa sababu kutambua umbo ndio sehemu kubwa ya ulinzi. Tovuti bandia ndiyo namna ya zamani zaidi: anwani hutofautiana na halisi kwa herufi moja au mbili, au ni tangazo linalolipiwa likikaa juu ya tokeo halisi la utafutaji, na ukurasa huonekana sahihi kwa sababu ulinakiliwa kutoka halisi.

52350f025b96.en: An analyst says "Bitcoin's correlation with the S&P 500 is 0.36, so it is a weak diversifier." What is the most important thing missing from that statement?
52350f025b96.sw: Mchambuzi anasema "uhusiano wa Bitcoin na S&P 500 ni 0.36, kwa hivyo ni mtawanyaji dhaifu." Kitu muhimu zaidi kinachokosekana katika kauli hiyo ni kipi?

523770fbae8a.en: Moving money into a fund after a strong run and out after a weak one, so purchases cluster near highs and sales near lows.
523770fbae8a.sw: Kuhamisha pesa ndani ya mfuko baada ya kipindi cha nguvu na kuitoa baada ya kipindi dhaifu, hivyo manunuzi hujikusanya karibu na vilele na mauzo karibu na mabonde.

524ab01be7c7.en: Rules that are broken and concealed are not much protection at the moment they are broken, and the enforcement arrives afterwards — a conviction on seven counts in November 2023 and a 25-year sentence in March 2024. That is justice, and it is not restitution. For a customer deciding where to keep funds, a licence is a reason for mild comfort, not a reason to remove the cap.
524ab01be7c7.sw: Kanuni zinazovunjwa na kufichwa si ulinzi mkubwa katika wakati zinapovunjwa, na utekelezaji hufika baadaye — hatia katika mashtaka saba mwezi Novemba 2023 na hukumu ya miaka 25 mwezi Machi 2024. Hiyo ni haki, nayo si fidia. Kwa mteja anayeamua mahali pa kuweka fedha, leseni ni sababu ya faraja kidogo, si sababu ya kuondoa dari.

524ed513cfe2.en: Because FTT holders were given priority in the queue
524ed513cfe2.sw: Kwa sababu wamiliki wa FTT walipewa kipaumbele katika foleni

5251af15f673.en: Keep this history in mind whenever someone tells you crypto invented digital money. Digital money existed for decades before Bitcoin. The unsolved problem was narrower and harder: how do you stop double-spending with no referee at all? That specific problem is what the 2008 paper attacked.
5251af15f673.sw: Weka historia hii akilini wakati wowote mtu anapokuambia kripto ilivumbua pesa ya kidijitali. Pesa ya kidijitali ilikuwepo kwa miongo kabla ya Bitcoin. Tatizo lisilotatuliwa lilikuwa finyu zaidi na gumu zaidi: unazuiaje kutumia-mara-mbili bila mwamuzi kabisa? Tatizo hilo maalum ndilo karatasi ya 2008 iliyolishambulia.

5288758ade5a.en: The live list of resting buy orders (bids) and sell orders (asks) for an asset at each price. The gap between the best bid and best ask is the spread. Trades happen when an incoming order matches a resting one.
5288758ade5a.sw: Orodha hai ya maagizo ya kununua yaliyopumzika (zabuni) na maagizo ya kuuza (bei za kuuliza) kwa rasilimali katika kila bei. Pengo kati ya zabuni bora na bei bora ya kuuliza ni mwanya. Biashara hutokea agizo linaloingia linapolingana na lililopumzika.

528f68229964.en: Five: when do you rebalance? This needs its own definition, because it is where most plans quietly fail.
528f68229964.sw: Tano: unasawazisha upya lini? Hili linahitaji ufafanuzi wake, kwa sababu hapo ndipo mipango mingi hushindwa kimya kimya.

52af0eec5dc6.en: Identity checks (documents, proof of address) that regulated financial firms must run on their customers. Centralized exchanges require them; a DEX smart contract has no operator to run them.
52af0eec5dc6.sw: Ukaguzi wa utambulisho (hati, uthibitisho wa anwani) ambao kampuni za kifedha zinazodhibitiwa lazima ziuendeshe kwa wateja wao. Masoko ya kubadilisha yenye kituo kikuu huuhitaji; mkataba mahiri wa DEX hauna mwendeshaji wa kuuendesha.

52bd330cc010.en: Write down the sum you would invest, the number of months you would spread it over, and the date of the final purchase. Then write one sentence describing what you will do if prices fall sharply during the schedule. If that sentence says you would pause, rewrite the plan as a lump sum, because a schedule you would abandon at the low point delivers the cost of averaging in without the benefit.
52bd330cc010.sw: Andika kiasi ungewekeza, idadi ya miezi ungeieneza, na tarehe ya ununuzi wa mwisho. Kisha andika sentensi moja ikieleza utafanya nini kama bei zitashuka kwa kasi wakati wa ratiba. Kama sentensi hiyo inasema ungesimama, andika upya mpango kama kiasi kamili, kwa sababu ratiba ambayo ungeiacha katika sehemu ya chini hutoa gharama ya kupunguza wastani wa bei bila manufaa.

52be2c6ff44e.en: Correct — there's a genuine, historically rooted pecking order (EUR > GBP > AUD/NZD > USD > CAD/CHF/JPY, roughly) that determines the conventional order for major pairs — it's market history, not arbitrary choice.
52be2c6ff44e.sw: Sahihi — kuna daraja halisi lenye mizizi ya kihistoria (EUR > GBP > AUD/NZD > USD > CAD/CHF/JPY, kwa ujumla) linaloamua mpangilio wa kawaida wa jozi kuu — ni historia ya soko, si chaguo la bahati nasibu.

52cf36909bc1.en: When a headline says that adoption hit a record because 1.1 million addresses were active, it has quietly swapped a count of cryptographic identifiers for a count of human beings. The correct reading is narrower and duller: 1.1 million addresses transacted. That is compatible with adoption growing, with one exchange restructuring its wallets, or with a single service batching its payouts differently. The metric cannot tell you which.
52cf36909bc1.sw: Kichwa cha habari kinaposema matumizi yalifikia rekodi kwa sababu anwani milioni 1.1 zilikuwa hai, kimebadilisha kimya kimya hesabu ya vitambulisho vya kikriptografia kwa hesabu ya binadamu. Usomaji sahihi ni finyu zaidi na wa kuchosha zaidi: anwani milioni 1.1 zilifanya miamala. Hilo linaendana na matumizi yakikua, na soko moja likipanga upya pochi zake, au na huduma moja ikilipa malipo yake kwa makundi tofauti. Kipimo hakiwezi kukuambia ni kipi.

52e26ef2fa47.en: Not quite — a broker delivers the same exposure to exchange rate movement without any travel or physical cash, which is why retail forex exists.
52e26ef2fa47.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — broker hutoa uwazi ule ule kwa msogeo wa kiwango cha ubadilishaji bila safari wala fedha taslimu za kimwili, ndiyo maana forex ya rejareja ipo.

52e9f4e1a498.en: Choose any listed company and open its last three annual reports. Write down six numbers: profit and operating cash flow for each year. Then write one sentence saying whether they moved together. That comparison, done honestly, filters out more bad holdings than any valuation ratio you will learn next lesson.
52e9f4e1a498.sw: Chagua kampuni yoyote iliyoorodheshwa na ufungue ripoti zake tatu za mwisho za mwaka. Andika namba sita: faida na mtiririko wa fedha wa shughuli kwa kila mwaka. Kisha andika sentensi moja ikisema kama zilisogea pamoja. Ulinganisho huo, ukifanywa kwa uaminifu, huchuja umiliki mbaya zaidi kuliko uwiano wowote wa uthaminishaji utakaojifunza somo lijalo.

53016dcc8282.en: Because average returns are not a meaningful measure
53016dcc8282.sw: Kwa sababu faida za wastani si kipimo chenye maana

53123c299541.en: The Swiss franc shock taught that a stop-loss may not fill at its level. The sterling flash crash sharpens the point: even without any fundamental reason, the market itself can move against you faster than any exit can keep up — and then move back, having taken out your position on the way.
53123c299541.sw: Mshtuko wa faranga ya Uswisi ulifundisha kwamba stop-loss inaweza isitimizwe kwenye kiwango chake. Anguko la ghafla la pauni hunoa pointi: hata bila sababu yoyote ya msingi, soko lenyewe linaweza kusogea dhidi yako kwa kasi zaidi kuliko kutoka kokote kunavyoweza kuendana — kisha likasogea tena, likiwa limeondoa nafasi yako njiani.

5318b80b2653.en: They show the same open/high/low/close data, but candlesticks add a colored body for faster visual reading
5318b80b2653.sw: Huonyesha data ile ile ya kufungua/juu/chini/kufunga, lakini mishumaa huongeza mwili wenye rangi kwa usomaji wa haraka wa kuona

533279a4daa4.en: Diagram of EUR/CHF holding the 1.20 floor from 2011 until it collapsed about 30 percent to roughly 0.85 on 15 January 2015, the fallout (FXCM's 225 million dollars of client negative balances and 300 million dollar bailout, Alpari UK insolvency, Everest Capital's roughly 1 billion dollar loss), and the survival lesson that small position size and low leverage were what mattered
533279a4daa4.sw: Mchoro wa EUR/CHF ikishikilia sakafu ya 1.20 kutoka 2011 hadi ilipoanguka takriban asilimia 30 hadi karibu 0.85 tarehe 15 Januari 2015, matokeo (salio hasi la wateja la FXCM la dola milioni 225 na uokoaji wa dola milioni 300, kufilisika kwa Alpari UK, hasara ya Everest Capital ya takriban dola bilioni 1), na fundisho la kunusurika kwamba ukubwa mdogo wa nafasi na leverage ndogo ndivyo vilivyohusika

5344550c0896.en: The total value of all coins priced at the level each one last moved at on-chain, rather than at today's price.
5344550c0896.sw: Thamani jumla ya sarafu zote zikipangiwa bei katika kiwango ambacho kila moja ilisogea nacho mwisho kwenye mnyororo, badala ya bei ya leo.

539a5fa633a0.en: When you scan the pillars and the regime and nothing lines up — valuation neutral, no catalyst, momentum flat, positioning unremarkable — the professional answer is not to lower the bar until something qualifies. It is to hold cash and wait.
539a5fa633a0.sw: Unapotazama nguzo na hali na hakuna kinacholingana — uthaminishaji wa kati, hakuna kichocheo, kasi tuli, nafasi za soko za kawaida — jibu la kitaaluma si kushusha kizingiti hadi kitu kistahili. Ni kushikilia fedha taslimu na kusubiri.

53aa2f3796e7.en: They triggered but filled far from their level, because liquidity vanished and there were no buyers nearby
53aa2f3796e7.sw: Yalianzishwa lakini yakatimizwa mbali na kiwango chao, kwa sababu ukwasi ulitoweka na hakukuwa na wanunuzi karibu

53b81951ed3f.en: Valuation — is the currency cheap or expensive versus a sensible measure of fair value? A cheap currency with a reason to rise is a very different trade from an expensive one.
53b81951ed3f.sw: Uthaminishaji — je, sarafu ni rahisi au ghali ikilinganishwa na kipimo chenye busara cha thamani halali? Sarafu rahisi yenye sababu ya kupanda ni biashara tofauti sana na ile ghali.

53b8ba80aac9.en: A timeline showing the theft running undetected from 2011, then the compressed sequence of February and March 2014: withdrawals halted on 7 February, Tokyo civil rehabilitation filing on 28 February disclosing 850,000 bitcoin lost including 750,000 belonging to customers, United States filing on 9 March, and about 200,000 bitcoin found on 20 March in a wallet last used before June 2011.
53b8ba80aac9.sw: Ratiba ya matukio ikionyesha wizi ukiendeshwa bila kugunduliwa tangu 2011, kisha mfuatano uliobanwa wa Februari na Machi 2014: utoaji ulisimamishwa tarehe 7 Februari, ombi la urekebishaji wa kiraia Tokyo tarehe 28 Februari likifichua bitcoin 850,000 zilizopotea ikiwa ni pamoja na 750,000 za wateja, ombi la Marekani tarehe 9 Machi, na takriban bitcoin 200,000 zilizopatikana tarehe 20 Machi katika pochi iliyotumika mwisho kabla ya Juni 2011.

53c06282cbd5.en: You lock 300 dollars of ETH in a DAI vault with a 150 percent minimum collateral ratio and mint 200 DAI. ETH falls 20 percent. What happens?
53c06282cbd5.sw: Unafungia dola 300 za ETH katika kasha la DAI lenye uwiano wa chini kabisa wa dhamana wa asilimia 150 na kutengeneza DAI 200. ETH inashuka asilimia 20. Nini hutokea?

53c26f0b8efa.en: A firm backing its balance sheet with a token it created itself, whose value depends on confidence in that same firm.
53c26f0b8efa.sw: Kampuni ikiunga mkono karatasi yake ya salio kwa tokeni iliyoiunda yenyewe, ambayo thamani yake hutegemea ujasiri katika kampuni hiyohiyo.

53d62e64cbcc.en: Not quite. Rebalancing has a clear and measurable effect on risk, but it is not a forecast about the asset being bought and its return benefit is period-dependent rather than reliable. Its real job is keeping your allocation where you chose to put it.
53d62e64cbcc.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kusawazisha upya kuna athari wazi na inayopimika juu ya hatari, lakini si utabiri kuhusu rasilimali inayonunuliwa na faida yake hutegemea kipindi badala ya kuaminika. Kazi yake halisi ni kuweka mgawanyo wako pale ulipochagua kuuweka.

53f0cbaeb975.en: This is the lived version of the fat tails you met in Chapter 2, Lesson 2, and Mandelbrot's 1963 finding. A standard bell curve model would have called a move this size an event of once in many thousands of years. It happened on an ordinary Thursday. Markets produce extreme moves far more often than tidy models predict — and forex, with its leverage, punishes that fact hardest.
53f0cbaeb975.sw: Hili ndilo toleo la kuishi la mikia minene uliyokutana nayo katika Sura ya 2, Somo la 2, na tokeo la Mandelbrot la mwaka 1963. Muundo sanifu wa mkunjo wa kengele ungeuita msogeo wa ukubwa huu tukio la mara moja katika maelfu mengi ya miaka. Ulitokea Alhamisi ya kawaida. Masoko huzalisha misogeo ya kupindukia mara nyingi zaidi mno kuliko miundo safi inavyotabiri — na forex, kwa leverage yake, huadhibu ukweli huo kwa ukali zaidi.

54130754de9c.en: Be careful with the phrase the average investor. Both the Morningstar and DALBAR figures describe an average of money, not a typical person. A population where most people do nothing and a small minority trade heavily produces an average that describes neither group. The correct question is not what the average investor loses; it is which of the two groups you are in.
54130754de9c.sw: Kuwa makini na msemo mwekezaji wa wastani. Takwimu zote za Morningstar na DALBAR huelezea wastani wa pesa, si mtu wa kawaida. Idadi ya watu ambapo wengi hawafanyi lolote na wachache hufanya biashara kwa wingi hutoa wastani usioelezea kundi lolote. Swali sahihi si mwekezaji wa wastani hupoteza kiasi gani; ni wewe uko katika kundi lipi kati ya mawili.

5429fc6ed7f4.en: SMS two-factor authentication is much better than no two-factor authentication, and much worse than the alternatives. Its weakness is precise: it is strong against automated attacks and weak against someone who has chosen you. Crypto holders are, by definition, sometimes chosen. If a crypto account offers only SMS, use it, and treat that account as one you should not keep much value in.
5429fc6ed7f4.sw: Uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili wa SMS ni bora zaidi kuliko kutokuwa na uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili, na mbaya zaidi kuliko mbadala. Udhaifu wake ni sahihi: ni imara dhidi ya mashambulizi ya kiotomatiki na dhaifu dhidi ya mtu aliyekuchagua. Wamiliki wa kripto, kwa ufafanuzi, wakati mwingine huchaguliwa. Ikiwa akaunti ya kripto hutoa SMS pekee, itumie, na uchukulie akaunti hiyo kama ambayo hupaswi kuweka thamani nyingi ndani yake.

542ce8081ec4.en: A share trades at 40.00 and pays a 1.00 dividend. On the ex-dividend date it opens at roughly 39.00. A holder who owned it through that date now has a share worth 39.00 and 1.00 in cash — the same 40.00 they had the day before. Nothing was created.
542ce8081ec4.sw: Hisa hufanyiwa biashara kwa 40.00 na hulipa gawio la 1.00. Katika tarehe ya bila-gawio hufunguliwa kwa takriban 39.00. Aliyeishikilia hadi tarehe hiyo sasa ana hisa yenye thamani ya 39.00 na 1.00 ya fedha taslimu — 40.00 ile ile aliyokuwa nayo siku iliyotangulia. Hakuna kilichoundwa.

5443da38e7e7.en: A loop diagram showing UST trading below one dollar, being redeemed for newly minted LUNA, that LUNA being sold, the LUNA price falling, and each subsequent redemption requiring more LUNA to be minted — with a timeline marking 7 May 2022 when 375 million UST left Anchor and 13 May when LUNA had fallen from about 87 dollars to below 0.00005.
5443da38e7e7.sw: Mchoro wa kitanzi ukionyesha UST ikifanyiwa biashara chini ya dola moja, ikikombolewa kwa LUNA iliyotengenezwa upya, LUNA hiyo ikiuzwa, bei ya LUNA ikishuka, na kila ukombozi unaofuata ukihitaji LUNA zaidi kutengenezwa — ukiwa na ratiba ya matukio ikiweka alama 7 Mei 2022 wakati UST milioni 375 ziliondoka Anchor na 13 Mei wakati LUNA ilikuwa imeshuka kutoka takriban dola 87 hadi chini ya 0.00005.

544d35710977.en: Here's where this course's habit of checking the textbook against real evidence pays off. The clean "higher rates → stronger currency" story runs into one of the most famous anomalies in all of financial economics.
544d35710977.sw: Hapa ndipo tabia ya kozi hii ya kukagua kitabu dhidi ya ushahidi halisi inalipa. Simulizi safi ya "viwango vya juu → sarafu imara zaidi" hukumbana na mojawapo ya matukio yasiyo ya kawaida maarufu zaidi katika uchumi wote wa kifedha.

54636b0ff8d9.en: Diversification isn't about quantity — owning twenty things isn't automatically safer than owning five. It's about relationship.
54636b0ff8d9.sw: Kusambaza uwekezaji si suala la wingi — kumiliki vitu ishirini si salama zaidi kiotomatiki kuliko kumiliki vitano. Ni suala la uhusiano.

546778835e9a.en: That the chain of answers ended at a reserve being topped up — capital, not an activity — which can continue exactly as long as the capital lasts
546778835e9a.sw: Kwamba mnyororo wa majibu uliishia katika akiba iliyokuwa ikijazwa — mtaji, si shughuli — ambao unaweza kuendelea hasa kwa muda ambao mtaji hudumu

548cee56d401.en: How should the hype cycle — the curve from inflated expectations through disillusionment to a plateau — be treated?
548cee56d401.sw: Mzunguko wa utangazaji — mkunjo kutoka matarajio yaliyokuzwa kupitia kukata tamaa hadi uwanda — unapaswa kuchukuliwaje?

549d93f0a456.en: Crypto does not change the mechanism. It changes the speed at which you can act on it, and the size of the moves you are acting on. A position that has halved in a week produces the same reluctance to sell as one that has halved in a year, with far less time to think.
549d93f0a456.sw: Kripto haibadilishi utaratibu. Hubadilisha kasi ambayo unaweza kutenda juu yake, na ukubwa wa misogeo unayotenda juu yake. Nafasi iliyopungua nusu katika wiki huzalisha kusita kuuza kuleile kama iliyopungua nusu katika mwaka, ikiwa na muda mdogo zaidi wa kufikiri.

54b200239d5a.en: Usable invalidation conditions for the thesis above: fee revenue falls for two consecutive quarters; the protocol change is delayed indefinitely or ships and is not adopted; the unlock schedule is altered to release supply faster; funding turns persistently and strongly positive, meaning the crowd has arrived. Each of these can be checked against a fact on a date. None of them is "the price went down", which is a description rather than a condition.
54b200239d5a.sw: Masharti ya kubatilisha yanayotumika kwa nadharia iliyo hapo juu: mapato ya ada hushuka kwa robo mbili mfululizo; mabadiliko ya itifaki huahirishwa bila kikomo au husafirishwa na hayakubaliwi; ratiba ya kufungua hubadilishwa kutoa usambazaji kwa kasi zaidi; ufadhili hugeuka chanya kwa kudumu na kwa nguvu, ukimaanisha kundi limefika. Kila moja kati ya haya kinaweza kukaguliwa dhidi ya ukweli katika tarehe. Hakuna kati yake ni "bei ilishuka", ambayo ni maelezo badala ya sharti.

54b5ac1606a7.en: Correct — a higher true pip value than the one you sized with means each pip costs more than you assumed, so the same lot size risks more: 127 dollars instead of 100.
54b5ac1606a7.sw: Sahihi — thamani halisi ya pip iliyo juu kuliko ile uliyopima nayo inamaanisha kila pip inagharimu zaidi ya ulivyodhania, hivyo ukubwa ule ule wa lot huhatarisha zaidi: dola 127 badala ya 100.

54c3b5865509.en: For an individual holder, the practical implication is uncomfortable and simple. An asset can be harmed by the failure of something you do not own, through a chain of counterparties you cannot see and were never told about. That is not a reason for paralysis. It is a reason the position is sized so that its complete loss is survivable, which is what Chapter 3 Lesson 1 and Chapter 4 Lesson 3 have both been building toward.
54c3b5865509.sw: Kwa mmiliki binafsi, athari ya kivitendo ina usumbufu na ni rahisi. Rasilimali inaweza kudhurika na kushindwa kwa kitu usichokimiliki, kupitia mnyororo wa washirika ambao huwezi kuwaona na ambao hukuwahi kuambiwa kuwahusu. Hiyo si sababu ya kupooza. Ni sababu nafasi hupangwa ukubwa ili hasara yake kamili inusurike, ambacho ndicho Sura ya 3 Somo la 1 na Sura ya 4 Somo la 3 vyote vimekuwa vikijenga kuelekea.

54cf61bca37c.en: When withdrawals were halted in February 2014, Mt. Gox attributed the problem to a known quirk of the Bitcoin protocol.
54cf61bca37c.sw: Utoaji uliposimamishwa mwezi Februari 2014, Mt. Gox ilihusisha tatizo na tabia ya kipekee inayojulikana ya itifaki ya Bitcoin.

54d22b9466db.en: Side-by-side diagram of Proof of Work, where miners spend electricity racing to find a valid nonce and the winner earns the subsidy and fees, and Proof of Stake, where validators lock capital to be selected to propose blocks and face slashing for provable misbehavior
54d22b9466db.sw: Mchoro wa kando kwa kando wa Uthibitisho wa Kazi, ambapo wachimbaji hutumia umeme wakishindana kupata nonce halali na mshindi hupata ruzuku na ada, na Uthibitisho wa Hisa, ambapo wathibitishaji hufungia mtaji ili wachaguliwe kupendekeza vitalu na hukabiliwa na kukatwa kwa tabia mbaya inayothibitishika

54d82c37cf3f.en: Clipper malware is old, effective and quiet. Kaspersky researchers documented one campaign in 2023 that spread through modified installers of a popular privacy browser, distributed outside official channels. They identified more than 15,000 affected users across 52 countries and estimated roughly 400,000 dollars stolen. Their analysis makes the key operational point: this class of malware produces no network traffic and shows no symptoms. It can sit on a machine for years, doing nothing at all, until the day an address appears on the clipboard.
54d82c37cf3f.sw: Programu hasidi ya clipper ni ya zamani, yenye ufanisi na kimya. Watafiti wa Kaspersky waliandika kampeni moja mwaka 2023 iliyoenea kupitia visakinishi vilivyobadilishwa vya kivinjari maarufu cha faragha, vilivyosambazwa nje ya njia rasmi. Walitambua zaidi ya watumiaji 15,000 walioathirika katika nchi 52 na kukadiria takriban dola 400,000 zilizoibiwa. Uchambuzi wao hutoa hoja muhimu ya kiutendaji: aina hii ya programu hasidi haizalishi trafiki ya mtandao na haionyeshi dalili. Inaweza kukaa katika mashine kwa miaka, ikifanya lolote, hadi siku ambayo anwani inajitokeza katika ubao wa kunakili.

54e98e29b551.en: Two accounts hold the exact same 50,000 dollar position at the same 50:1 broker leverage — one with 2,000 dollars of equity, one with 10,000 dollars. Which faces a margin call after a much smaller move against it?
54e98e29b551.sw: Akaunti mbili zinashikilia nafasi ile ile hasa ya dola 50,000 kwa leverage ile ile ya broker ya 50:1 — moja yenye usawa wa dola 2,000, nyingine yenye dola 10,000. Ni ipi inayokabiliwa na wito wa margin baada ya msogeo mdogo zaidi dhidi yake?

54f214128c37.en: Whale metrics carry the same problem in a sharper form. The largest addresses on most chains are exchange and custodian wallets, so a naive list of top holders is largely a list of institutions holding other people's coins. And whale accumulation narratives are usually built so that no observation can refute them: if the price rises, whales were accumulating; if it falls, whales were distributing; if it moves sideways, whales are quietly accumulating. A story that survives every outcome told you nothing before the outcome arrived.
54f214128c37.sw: Vipimo vya nyangumi hubeba tatizo lilelile kwa namna kali zaidi. Anwani kubwa zaidi katika minyororo mingi ni pochi za masoko ya kubadilisha na watunzaji, kwa hivyo orodha ya kijinga ya wamiliki wakuu kwa kiasi kikubwa ni orodha ya taasisi zinazoshikilia sarafu za watu wengine. Na simulizi za ukusanyaji wa nyangumi kwa kawaida hujengwa ili hakuna uchunguzi unaoweza kuzikanusha: ikiwa bei itapanda, nyangumi walikuwa wakikusanya; ikiwa itashuka, nyangumi walikuwa wakigawa; ikiwa itasogea kwa upande, nyangumi wanakusanya kimya kimya. Hadithi inayonusurika kila matokeo haikuambii lolote kabla matokeo hayajafika.

54fd1160b668.en: That is a brutal result for anyone relying on diversification. The correlation you measured in the calm period is not the correlation you get in the crash. The protection weakens exactly when it is needed. You have seen this thread before under a different name. Foundations Chapter 2, Lesson 4 warned that a well-diversified portfolio can still lose money in a broad shock because correlations rise together. The course's fat-tails thread — Mandelbrot in 1963, and the Swiss franc collapse of 2015 in Forex Chapter 1, Lesson 7 — is the same idea from the single-asset side. Extreme events are more common than tidy models predict, and they arrive correlated.
54fd1160b668.sw: Hayo ni matokeo ya kikatili kwa yeyote anayetegemea mtawanyiko. Uhusiano uliopima katika kipindi tulivu si uhusiano unaoupata katika mporomoko. Ulinzi hudhoofika hasa unapohitajika. Umeuona uzi huu awali chini ya jina tofauti. Misingi Sura ya 2, Somo la 4 lilionya kwamba kasha lililotawanywa vizuri bado linaweza kupoteza pesa katika mshtuko mpana kwa sababu uhusiano hupanda pamoja. Uzi wa mikia minene wa kozi — Mandelbrot mwaka 1963, na kuanguka kwa faranga ya Uswisi kwa 2015 katika Forex Sura ya 1, Somo la 7 — ni wazo lilelile kutoka upande wa rasilimali moja. Matukio makali ni ya kawaida zaidi kuliko mifano nadhifu inavyotabiri, nayo hufika yakiwa na uhusiano.

54fd97e818d6.en: Chapter 1, Lesson 5 gave you the position-sizing formula, and it used a simple figure: on a standard lot, one pip is worth about 10 dollars. That lesson was careful to label it — "USD-quoted pairs" — because it is not the whole story. This lesson tells the whole story.
54fd97e818d6.sw: Sura ya 1, Somo la 5 lilikupa fomula ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi, na lilitumia takwimu rahisi: kwenye lot sanifu, pip moja ina thamani ya takriban dola 10. Somo hilo lilikuwa makini kuiweka lebo — "jozi zinazonukuliwa kwa USD" — kwa sababu si simulizi nzima. Somo hili linaeleza simulizi nzima.

55106aadd1e9.en: That the exchange cannot be hacked

5520456e0e9e.en: It is burned — destroyed and removed from the ETH supply
5520456e0e9e.sw: Huchomwa — huharibiwa na kuondolewa katika usambazaji wa ETH

55238935210e.en: A currency strengthening (buying more) or weakening (buying less) relative to another.
55238935210e.sw: Sarafu kuimarika (kununua zaidi) au kudhoofika (kununua kidogo) ikilinganishwa na nyingine.

5556ca1ed0c6.en: The recurring practices that keep self-custodied assets reachable by you and unreachable by anyone else: revoking stale approvals, verifying recovery material, testing access, and keeping exchange balances under a stated cap.
5556ca1ed0c6.sw: Mazoea yanayojirudia yanayoweka rasilimali zilizo katika utunzaji binafsi zikifikika na wewe na zisifikike na mtu mwingine yeyote: kubatilisha idhini zilizopitwa na wakati, kuthibitisha nyenzo za urejeshaji, kupima ufikiaji, na kuweka salio za masoko ya kubadilisha chini ya dari iliyotajwa.

5559bd737107.en: Soros's argument is that prices are not a clean mirror of underlying facts. Participants act on an imperfect understanding of a situation, and their actions then change the situation itself. In his framing markets therefore drift away from equilibrium rather than toward it, because the feedback runs in a self-reinforcing direction for long stretches.
5559bd737107.sw: Hoja ya Soros ni kwamba bei si kioo safi cha ukweli wa msingi. Washiriki hutenda juu ya uelewa usio kamili wa hali, na matendo yao kisha hubadilisha hali yenyewe. Katika muktadha wake masoko hivyo hutelezea mbali na usawa badala ya kuelekea kwake, kwa sababu mrejesho huenda katika mwelekeo unaojiimarisha kwa vipindi virefu.

5562c3415100.en: Do not convert this into market timing. The evidence that anyone reliably switches between regimes in advance is weak, and Chapter 4 Lesson 1 showed what the attempt costs the people who make it most often. Regime mapping tells you which pillar to trust in the environment you are already in. It does not tell you what the environment will be next quarter.
5562c3415100.sw: Usigeuze hili kuwa kupanga muda wa soko. Ushahidi kwamba mtu yeyote hubadilisha kati ya tawala mapema kwa uhakika ni dhaifu, na Sura ya 4 Somo la 1 lilionyesha jaribio hilo huwagharimu nini wanaolifanya mara nyingi zaidi. Kuchora ramani ya utawala hukuambia ni nguzo ipi ya kuiamini katika mazingira ambayo tayari uko ndani yake. Hakukuambii mazingira yatakuwa yapi robo ijayo.

556c278be0e5.en: A central bank signals tighter policy for longer. Government bond yields rise first. Currencies adjust. Credit spreads widen. Equities fall, and the longest-duration equities — companies valued on distant profits — fall hardest. Crypto, which has no cash flows at all and therefore the longest duration of anything, falls hardest of all. Nothing happened on-chain. The regime changed several links up the chain and arrived here magnified.
556c278be0e5.sw: Benki kuu inaashiria sera kali zaidi kwa muda mrefu zaidi. Mavuno ya hatifungani za serikali hupanda kwanza. Sarafu hujirekebisha. Mianya ya mikopo hupanuka. Hisa hushuka, na hisa za muda mrefu zaidi — kampuni zinazotathminiwa juu ya faida za mbali — hushuka kwa nguvu zaidi. Kripto, isiyo na mitiririko ya fedha kabisa na hivyo yenye muda mrefu zaidi kuliko chochote, hushuka kwa nguvu zaidi kuliko yote. Hakuna kilichotokea kwenye mnyororo. Utawala ulibadilika viungo kadhaa juu ya mnyororo na ukafika hapa ukiwa umekuzwa.

557b4a583b0d.en: Because new users are less intelligent than existing ones
557b4a583b0d.sw: Kwa sababu watumiaji wapya wana akili kidogo kuliko waliopo

557dde52f40e.en: And apply the base rate. In a category where a peer-reviewed study found roughly half of the listings on a major venue to be scam tokens, the prior probability that an unfamiliar new token is legitimate is not high, and it is your job to move it — not the promoter's job to be reassuring.
557dde52f40e.sw: Na tumia kiwango cha msingi. Katika kundi ambapo utafiti uliopitiwa na wenzao ulibaini takriban nusu ya uorodheshaji katika uwanja mkuu kuwa tokeni za ulaghai, uwezekano wa awali kwamba tokeni mpya isiyojulikana ni halali si mkubwa, nayo ni kazi yako kuusogeza — si kazi ya mtangazaji kutuliza.

559d71af0609.en: Correct — ATR measures the distance price typically covers in a day, so a stop well inside that distance is reached by movement that carries no information. In the worked example the smallest of five daily true ranges was 6.1 times the stop distance.
559d71af0609.sw: Sahihi — ATR hupima umbali ambao bei hufunika kwa kawaida katika siku, kwa hivyo kusimamisha ndani sana ya umbali huo hufikiwa na msogeo usiobeba taarifa. Katika mfano uliofanyiwa kazi kiwango halisi kidogo zaidi kati ya vitano vya kila siku kilikuwa mara 6.1 ya umbali wa kusimamisha.

55b7c5bbfc11.en: The exact percentages are set by each broker, not by law — 100% and 50% are common, but yours may differ. Find your broker's real margin call and stop-out levels before you trade, not during your first losing position.
55b7c5bbfc11.sw: Asilimia kamili huwekwa na kila broker, si kwa sheria — 100% na 50% ni za kawaida, lakini zako zinaweza kutofautiana. Pata viwango halisi vya wito wa margin na stop-out vya broker wako kabla ya kufanya biashara, si wakati wa nafasi yako ya kwanza ya hasara.

55c377b39d19.en: How much of a portfolio is held in one investment.
55c377b39d19.sw: Kiasi gani cha mkusanyiko kinashikiliwa katika uwekezaji mmoja.

55c7869a85bb.en: If EUR/USD moves from 1.0800 to 1.0815, that's a 15-pip move.
55c7869a85bb.sw: Kama EUR/USD itasogea kutoka 1.0800 hadi 1.0815, huo ni msogeo wa pip 15.

55cee732682c.en: One further mechanism deserves attention because it was how many participants actually took part.
55cee732682c.sw: Utaratibu mmoja zaidi unastahili uangalifu kwa sababu ndivyo washiriki wengi walivyoshiriki hasa.

55cff1cef365.en: Correct. Diversification across assets addresses asset risk. It does nothing about the single point of failure holding all of them. Venue risk is not correlated with market conditions at all — it depends on whether one institution keeps functioning, which is a separate question from anything the assets do.
55cff1cef365.sw: Sahihi. Mtawanyiko katika rasilimali hushughulikia hatari ya rasilimali. Haufanyi lolote kuhusu nukta moja ya kushindwa inayozishikilia zote. Hatari ya uwanja haina uhusiano na hali za soko kabisa — hutegemea kama taasisi moja inaendelea kufanya kazi, ambalo ni swali tofauti na lolote ambalo rasilimali hufanya.

55ed41c2cb8e.en: It always balances, because of an identity rather than a coincidence. Everything the company owns was funded either by borrowing or by owners. Assets equal liabilities plus equity — and that equity line is the residual claim from Lesson 1, in accounting form.
55ed41c2cb8e.sw: Daima hulingana, kwa sababu ya utambulisho badala ya sadfa. Kila kitu kampuni inachomiliki kilifadhiliwa ama kwa kukopa au na wamiliki. Mali ni sawa na madeni pamoja na usawa — na mstari huo wa usawa ni dai la mabaki kutoka Somo la 1, katika umbo la kihasibu.

55f07b2176a5.en: A token trades at 2.00 dollars with 100,000,000 tokens circulating and 1,000,000,000 total supply. What is its market cap and its FDV?
55f07b2176a5.sw: Tokeni hufanyiwa biashara katika dola 2.00 ikiwa na tokeni 100,000,000 zinazozunguka na usambazaji jumla wa 1,000,000,000. Kiasi chake cha soko na FDV yake ni vipi?

55f444b3141f.en: Four events is a very small sample, the window was fitted after the data, and other large drivers moved at the same time
55f444b3141f.sw: Matukio manne ni sampuli ndogo sana, dirisha liliwekwa baada ya data, na visababishi vingine vikubwa vilisogea kwa wakati mmoja

56007f6c1632.en: Take these into any carry-like position: Be suspicious of any strategy that looks like steady, easy income — ask what rare event it is quietly exposed to, and how bad that event would be. Remember that a carry position's real risk is not the daily wiggle but the sudden, correlated unwind, which arrives fastest in a crisis. Notice crowding: if everyone is in the same trade for the same reason, the exit is narrow and the reversal is violent. And size for the crash, not the calm — the quiet years are not the ones that decide whether you survive.
56007f6c1632.sw: Chukua haya katika nafasi yoyote inayofanana na carry: Kuwa na shaka na mkakati wowote unaoonekana kama mapato thabiti na rahisi — uliza ni tukio gani nadra ambalo umefunuliwa nalo kimyakimya, na tukio hilo lingekuwa baya kiasi gani. Kumbuka kwamba hatari halisi ya nafasi ya carry si mtikisiko wa kila siku bali kuvunjika kwa ghafla kwenye uwiano, kunakofika kwa kasi zaidi katika janga. Tambua msongamano: kama kila mtu yuko katika biashara ile ile kwa sababu ile ile, mlango wa kutoka ni mwembamba na mgeuko ni mkali. Na pima kwa anguko, si kwa utulivu — miaka ya kimya si ndiyo inayoamua kama utanusurika.

5604ac7a9f23.en: For over three years, the Swiss National Bank held a floor under EUR/CHF, promising to defend a minimum of 1.20 francs per euro "with the utmost determination" — a cap it set in September 2011 to stop the franc strengthening too far. Traders came to treat that floor as almost a law of nature: you could not lose much buying EUR/CHF near 1.20, because the central bank guaranteed it would not fall below.
5604ac7a9f23.sw: Kwa zaidi ya miaka mitatu, Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilishikilia sakafu chini ya EUR/CHF, ikiahidi kutetea kiwango cha chini cha faranga 1.20 kwa euro "kwa uamuzi wa hali ya juu" — kikomo ilichokiweka Septemba 2011 kuzuia faranga kuimarika mno. Wafanyabiashara walikuja kuichukulia sakafu hiyo karibu kama sheria ya asili: usingeweza kupoteza sana kununua EUR/CHF karibu na 1.20, kwa sababu benki kuu ilihakikisha haitashuka chini yake.

560e596b4050.en: Not quite. Different voting rights do not usually mean a different claim on profits, and they place no restriction on selling. What changes is who controls the company — which means the vote is not your protection, and the position stands or falls on the business itself.
560e596b4050.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Haki tofauti za kupiga kura kwa kawaida hazimaanishi dai tofauti juu ya faida, na haziweki kizuizi chochote juu ya kuuza. Kinachobadilika ni nani anayedhibiti kampuni — ambako kunamaanisha kura si ulinzi wako, na nafasi husimama au huanguka juu ya biashara yenyewe.

56230a6b5ff1.en: What to look for whenever a product offers a yield you would like to accept. Trace the yield to an activity, and stop when the chain stops. Ask what proportion of the asset's demand exists only because of that yield, since demand that is renting itself will leave when the rate does. Ask what the product depends on that is not anchored outside itself, which is the reflexivity test. And treat the size of the thing as no evidence at all, since 60 billion dollars of value disappeared here in six days.
56230a6b5ff1.sw: Cha kuangalia wakati wowote bidhaa inapotoa mavuno ambayo ungependa kuyakubali. Fuatilia mavuno hadi shughuli, na usimame mnyororo unaposimama. Uliza ni sehemu gani ya mahitaji ya rasilimali ipo kwa sababu ya mavuno hayo pekee, kwa kuwa mahitaji yanayojikodisha yataondoka kiwango kitakapoondoka. Uliza bidhaa hutegemea nini kisichotiwa nanga nje yake yenyewe, ambao ndio mtihani wa kujiakisi. Na chukulia ukubwa wa kitu kama ushahidi wowote, kwa kuwa dola bilioni 60 za thamani zilitoweka hapa katika siku sita.

5624f213e024.en: Schematic only, not plotted data: crypto sits at the highest-beta end of the transmission chain, and correlation runs toward 1 in the stress window.
5624f213e024.sw: Wa kimuundo pekee, si data iliyochorwa: kripto hukaa mwisho wa beta kubwa zaidi wa mnyororo wa usambazaji, na uhusiano hukimbia kuelekea 1 katika dirisha la msongo.

5650c2b534d8.en: The recurring trap is that a widely known and long-scheduled event is not a catalyst in the sense the thesis means. Everyone can read the same calendar. Chapter 2 Lesson 2 made this point about halvings specifically: an event known years ahead has had years to be priced. A catalyst has to be something whose outcome is genuinely uncertain, not merely something whose date is certain.
5650c2b534d8.sw: Mtego unaojirudia ni kwamba tukio linalojulikana sana na lililopangwa kwa muda mrefu si kichocheo kwa maana ambayo nadharia huikusudia. Kila mtu anaweza kusoma kalenda ileile. Sura ya 2 Somo la 2 lilitoa hoja hii kuhusu kupunguzwa nusu hasa: tukio linalojulikana miaka mapema limekuwa na miaka ya kupangiwa bei. Kichocheo lazima kiwe kitu ambacho matokeo yake hayana uhakika kweli, si tu kitu ambacho tarehe yake ina uhakika.

566c1095f7f7.sw: Kutumia ukubwa wa juu zaidi wa nafasi

5678c6d0031c.en: Volatility is movement you can wait out. Permanent loss is not. Confusing the two produces both panic selling and reckless holding.
5678c6d0031c.sw: Mtikisiko ni msogeo unaoweza kuusubiri. Hasara ya kudumu si hivyo. Kuvichanganya hivyo viwili huzalisha kuuza kwa hofu na kushikilia kwa uzembe.

5679826d6a02.en: Higher rates are supposed to pull in foreign demand and lift a currency — the clean chain the evidence then complicates.
5679826d6a02.sw: Viwango vya juu vinapaswa kuvuta mahitaji ya kigeni na kuinua sarafu — mnyororo safi ambao ushahidi kisha huutatiza.

56afc611a1a8.en: No stop, or a moving stop. Trading without a stop-loss, or widening it when price approaches to avoid being closed. Fixed by placing the stop at the invalidation level as an order before entry, and never widening it (Chapter 1, Lesson 7; Chapter 3, Lesson 3).
56afc611a1a8.sw: Hakuna stop, au stop inayosogea. Kufanya biashara bila stop-loss, au kuipanua bei inapokaribia ili kuepuka kufungwa. Hurekebishwa kwa kuweka stop kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika kama agizo kabla ya kuingia, na kutoipanua kamwe (Sura ya 1, Somo la 7; Sura ya 3, Somo la 3).

56c7fac7f004.en: The coins were gone for years before anyone noticed. What collapsed in February 2014 was not the balance — it was the belief that the number on the screen described anything real.
56c7fac7f004.sw: Sarafu zilikuwa zimeenda kwa miaka kabla hakuna aliyetambua. Kilichoanguka mwezi Februari 2014 hakikuwa salio — kilikuwa imani kwamba namba iliyo kwenye skrini ilielezea kitu halisi.

56d8749e67f2.en: A small slice, sized so a total loss is survivable, held with written rules in custody you control and reviewed on a schedule rather than in reaction to news
56d8749e67f2.sw: Kipande kidogo, kilichopangwa ukubwa ili hasara ya jumla inusurike, kikishikiliwa kwa kanuni zilizoandikwa katika utunzaji unaoudhibiti na kikikaguliwa kwa ratiba badala ya kwa mwitikio kwa habari

56f87dde2e37.en: Because forward earnings are always higher than trailing earnings
56f87dde2e37.sw: Kwa sababu mapato ya mbele daima yako juu kuliko mapato ya nyuma

56f8f1bc41da.en: A convention for selecting complementary timeframes: choose your medium-term chart first (it should reflect your typical holding period), then set the long-term at roughly four times that interval, and the short-term at roughly a quarter of it.
56f8f1bc41da.sw: Desturi ya kuchagua vipindi vinavyokamilishana: chagua chati yako ya muda wa kati kwanza (inapaswa kuakisi muda wako wa kawaida wa kushikilia), kisha weka muda mrefu kwa takriban mara nne ya kipindi hicho, na muda mfupi kwa takriban robo yake.

56f9af13cdc3.en: Correct. Neither side was anchored to anything outside the pair. While confidence held this was invisible; when it went there was nothing underneath to arrest the fall, because the thing underneath was the same thing falling. That is the reflexivity test worth applying to any structure.
56f9af13cdc3.sw: Sahihi. Hakuna upande uliotiwa nanga katika chochote nje ya jozi. Wakati ujasiri ulipokuwa umeshikilia hili halikuonekana; ulipoondoka hakukuwa na chochote chini ya kuzuia kuanguka, kwa sababu kilichokuwa chini kilikuwa kitu kilekile kilichokuwa kikianguka. Huo ndio mtihani wa kujiakisi unaostahili kutumika kwa muundo wowote.

56fb799b9462.en: Proof-of-stake Ethereum works differently. Validators vote on checkpoints, and once a checkpoint gathers votes from two-thirds of all staked ETH across two voting rounds, every block behind it is marked finalized — this takes about two epochs, roughly 13 minutes. Reversing a finalized block is not just expensive to attempt; the protocol is designed so that it cannot happen unless at least one-third of all staked ETH — billions of dollars of validators' own money — breaks the rules simultaneously, and slashing (Lesson 3) destroys that stake as the penalty. Not impossible in principle. But the cost is explicit, enormous, and borne by identifiable stakers.
56fb799b9462.sw: Ethereum ya uthibitisho-wa-hisa hufanya kazi tofauti. Wathibitishaji hupiga kura juu ya vituo vya ukaguzi, na mara kituo kinapokusanya kura kutoka theluthi mbili ya ETH yote iliyowekwa kama hisa katika mizunguko miwili ya kupiga kura, kila kitalu kilicho nyuma yake huwekewa alama ya kukamilika — hii huchukua takriban enzi mbili, takriban dakika 13. Kutendua kitalu kilichokamilika si ghali tu kujaribu; itifaki imeundwa ili isiweze kutokea isipokuwa angalau theluthi moja ya ETH yote iliyowekwa kama hisa — mabilioni ya dola za pesa za wathibitishaji wenyewe — ivunje kanuni kwa wakati mmoja, na kukata (Somo la 3) huharibu hisa hiyo kama adhabu. Si kutowezekana kimsingi. Lakini gharama ni ya wazi, kubwa mno, nayo hubebwa na wawekaji hisa wanaotambulika.

5718bba32bd5.en: A lending protocol whose borrowers default is not a scam. A liquidity position that loses money to price movement is not a scam. An honest project whose token falls 90% is not a scam. Treating every loss as fraud is as unhelpful as treating none of them as fraud, and it prevents you from learning anything from the losses that were simply losses.
5718bba32bd5.sw: Itifaki ya kukopesha ambayo wakopaji wake hushindwa kulipa si ulaghai. Nafasi ya ukwasi inayopoteza pesa kwa msogeo wa bei si ulaghai. Mradi mwaminifu ambao tokeni yake hushuka 90% si ulaghai. Kuchukulia kila hasara kama udanganyifu hakusaidii kama vile kutochukulia hata moja kama udanganyifu, nako hukuzuia kujifunza lolote kutoka hasara ambazo zilikuwa hasara tu.

57227745eb6f.en: This is the clearest example in the entire course of the thread the course keeps returning to. A story can be vivid, mechanically plausible, universally repeated, told by people who were there, and still wrong. What separated the story from the fact was that someone had the order data and looked.
57227745eb6f.sw: Huu ndio mfano ulio wazi zaidi katika kozi nzima wa uzi ambao kozi huendelea kurejea kwake. Hadithi inaweza kuwa hai, yenye mantiki ya kimitambo, iliyorudiwa ulimwenguni kote, ikisimuliwa na watu waliokuwepo, na bado ikawa si sahihi. Kilichotenganisha hadithi na ukweli ni kwamba mtu alikuwa na data ya maagizo na akaiangalia.

57298bdb3937.en: Correct — this is the avalanche effect. "Alice pays Bob 10 coins" and "Alice pays Bob 70 coins" produce fingerprints that share nothing, and the output length never changes. That is what makes even the smallest tampering stand out.
57298bdb3937.sw: Sahihi — hii ni athari ya poromoko. "Alice pays Bob 10 coins" na "Alice pays Bob 70 coins" hutoa alama za vidole zisizoshiriki chochote, na urefu wa toleo haubadiliki kamwe. Ndicho kinachofanya hata uchakachuaji mdogo kabisa ujitokeze.

5746ca8e0a46.en: True or False: keeping a trading journal is mainly useful for tax records, not for improving as a trader.
5746ca8e0a46.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kuweka kumbukumbu ya biashara kuna manufaa hasa kwa rekodi za kodi, si kwa kuboreka kama mfanyabiashara.

5758d3a40403.en: Averaging in must have an end date decided in advance. Without one it becomes indefinite hesitation with a respectable name — and the person spreading a sum over six months and the person who has been about to invest for six months look identical from outside. Write down the schedule before starting.
5758d3a40403.sw: Kupunguza wastani wa bei lazima kuwe na tarehe ya mwisho iliyoamuliwa mapema. Bila hiyo kunakuwa kusita kusiko na mwisho kwenye jina linaloheshimika — na mtu anayeeneza kiasi katika miezi sita na mtu ambaye amekuwa karibu kuwekeza kwa miezi sita huonekana sawa kutoka nje. Andika ratiba kabla ya kuanza.

575ab83ce01f.en: A company's revenue falls by 10%, and its obligations to suppliers, staff, lenders and tax are unchanged. What happens to the shareholders' claim?
575ab83ce01f.sw: Mapato ya kampuni hushuka kwa 10%, na majukumu yake kwa wasambazaji, wafanyakazi, wakopeshaji na kodi hayajabadilika. Kinatokea nini kwa dai la wanahisa?

575f9dd900a3.en: A currency whose value is fixed, or held within a narrow band, relative to another currency rather than allowed to move freely.
575f9dd900a3.sw: Sarafu ambayo thamani yake ni thabiti, au inashikiliwa ndani ya ukanda mwembamba, ikilinganishwa na sarafu nyingine badala ya kuruhusiwa kusogea kwa uhuru.

577fb3051850.en: Six scored bars for a worked equity thesis: fundamentals weakly supportive, valuation supportive at 9 times earnings against a ten-year average of 15, a dated catalyst supportive, positioning neutral, momentum against after a 30 percent fall, and carry supportive on a covered 4 percent dividend.
577fb3051850.sw: Nguzo sita zilizopimwa kwa nadharia ya hisa iliyofanyiwa kazi: misingi inayounga mkono kwa udhaifu, tathmini inayounga mkono katika mara 9 ya mapato dhidi ya wastani wa miaka kumi wa 15, kichocheo chenye tarehe kinachounga mkono, msimamo wa kati, kasi inayopinga baada ya kushuka kwa asilimia 30, na kubeba kunakounga mkono juu ya gawio la asilimia 4 linalofunikwa.

57867fd28e86.en: The trade is straightforward once stated plainly. Isolated margin risks a defined amount and liquidates sooner. Cross margin survives longer and risks everything. Beginners frequently choose cross margin because it feels safer, since the position lasts longer, and that is exactly the misreading. It lasts longer by putting more of your money behind it.
57867fd28e86.sw: Maafikiano ni ya wazi mara yanapotajwa wazi. Mkopo uliotengwa huweka hatarini kiasi kilichofafanuliwa na hufilisi mapema. Mkopo mtambuka hunusurika muda mrefu zaidi na huweka hatarini kila kitu. Waanzilishi mara nyingi huchagua mkopo mtambuka kwa sababu huhisi salama zaidi, kwa kuwa nafasi hudumu muda mrefu zaidi, na hilo ndilo hasa usomaji usio sahihi. Hudumu muda mrefu zaidi kwa kuweka pesa yako zaidi nyuma yake.

57966b40b3bf.en: Support and resistance. You met these in Foundations Chapter 3, Lesson 1: support is a level where falling prices have repeatedly reversed upward, and resistance is a level where rising prices have repeatedly reversed downward. On a naked chart these levels are the primary map. A price-action trader marks them and watches how price behaves as it approaches.
57966b40b3bf.sw: Msaada na upinzani. Ulikutana navyo katika Msingi Sura ya 3, Somo la 1: msaada ni kiwango ambapo bei zinazoshuka zimegeuka kupanda mara kwa mara, na upinzani ni kiwango ambapo bei zinazopanda zimegeuka kushuka mara kwa mara. Kwenye chati tupu viwango hivi ni ramani kuu. Mfanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei huviweka alama na kutazama jinsi bei inavyotenda inapovikaribia.

579da93b2d98.en: The count of unique addresses that appeared in at least one successful transaction during a period, as a sender or a receiver. An address active five times in a day is counted once. Coin Metrics and Glassnode, two of the larger data providers, both define the metric this way in their public documentation.
579da93b2d98.sw: Hesabu ya anwani za kipekee zilizojitokeza katika angalau muamala mmoja uliofanikiwa wakati wa kipindi, kama mtumaji au mpokeaji. Anwani iliyokuwa hai mara tano kwa siku huhesabiwa mara moja. Coin Metrics na Glassnode, watoa data wawili wakubwa zaidi, wote hufafanua kipimo kwa njia hii katika nyaraka zao za umma.

57ad9c780ef4.en: Nobody — surplus cash returns to the government
57ad9c780ef4.sw: Hakuna — fedha za ziada hurudi serikalini

57c29b8d4010.en: A premium that shows up as an average over decades can be absent for years at a time, and the value premium has spent long stretches doing exactly that. An investor who adopted the strategy on the strength of the historical average and then lived through one of those stretches experienced something the average never described. The average is real. It is also not what any individual investor gets.
57c29b8d4010.sw: Malipo ya ziada yanayojitokeza kama wastani katika miongo yanaweza kutokuwepo kwa miaka mfululizo, na malipo ya ziada ya thamani yametumia vipindi virefu yakifanya hasa hivyo. Mwekezaji aliyekubali mkakati kwa nguvu ya wastani wa kihistoria na kisha akaishi kupitia mojawapo ya vipindi hivyo alipata kitu ambacho wastani haukukieleza kamwe. Wastani ni halisi. Pia si kile ambacho mwekezaji yeyote binafsi hupata.

57c49f5e4db4.en: Not quite. Two thirds is not always, and the remaining third is exactly when averaging in helps. The finding says lump sum has the higher expected return; it does not say averaging in is a mistake, because reducing the chance of panic-selling has real value that the average return figure does not capture.
57c49f5e4db4.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Theluthi mbili si daima, na theluthi iliyobaki ndipo hasa kupunguza wastani wa bei husaidia. Tokeo husema kiasi kamili kina faida inayotarajiwa ya juu zaidi; halisemi kupunguza wastani wa bei ni kosa, kwa sababu kupunguza nafasi ya kuuza kwa hofu kuna thamani halisi ambayo takwimu ya faida ya wastani hainasi.

57c779b30b13.en: That across large baskets over long periods there was a premium — which can be, and has been, absent for years at a time
57c779b30b13.sw: Kwamba katika vikapu vikubwa katika vipindi virefu kulikuwa na malipo ya ziada — ambayo yanaweza, na yamekuwa, hayapo kwa miaka mfululizo

57f0d3c23791.en: Risk is used to mean several different things, and the differences decide what you should do. Two matter most, and they call for opposite responses.
57f0d3c23791.sw: Hatari hutumika kumaanisha vitu kadhaa tofauti, na tofauti huamua unapaswa kufanya nini. Viwili vinahusika zaidi, na huhitaji majibu ya kinyume.

580f9f6db143.en: Not quite — the cap only limits supply. It says nothing about demand, price, or store-of-value reliability. A provably scarce token with no demand is worth nothing.
580f9f6db143.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — dari hupunguza usambazaji pekee. Haisemi lolote kuhusu mahitaji, bei, au uaminifu wa hifadhi ya thamani. Tokeni adimu kwa uthibitisho isiyo na mahitaji haina thamani yoyote.

581867e35fda.en: Because regulators require the scenario to be documented
581867e35fda.sw: Kwa sababu wadhibiti wanahitaji hali hiyo iandikwe

5829f74be1c9.en: The time from a peak to the recovery of that peak, as distinct from the depth of the fall in between.
5829f74be1c9.sw: Muda kutoka kileleni hadi kupona kwa kilele hicho, tofauti na kina cha kushuka kilichopo katikati.

584a2f56395b.en: The timetable on which tokens not yet circulating enter the supply.
584a2f56395b.sw: Ratiba ambayo kwayo tokeni ambazo bado hazizunguki huingia katika usambazaji.

584b1ddfcacf.en: Because forward P/E ratios are not published
584b1ddfcacf.sw: Kwa sababu uwiano wa P/E wa mbele hauchapishwi

585b4be82278.en: This is what turns a temporary fall into a permanent loss. Chapter 3 Lesson 1 distinguished volatility, which you can wait out, from permanent loss, which you cannot. A margin call removes the ability to wait — the position is closed at the bottom, by someone else, and any later recovery happens without you.
585b4be82278.sw: Hii ndiyo hugeuza kushuka kwa muda kuwa hasara ya kudumu. Sura ya 3 Somo la 1 lilitofautisha mtikisiko, ambao unaweza kuusubiri, na hasara ya kudumu, ambayo huwezi. Wito wa margin huondoa uwezo wa kusubiri — nafasi hufungwa chini kabisa, na mtu mwingine, na kupona kokote kwa baadaye hutokea bila wewe.

58749272abac.en: USD/CAD = 1.35 means the U.S. dollar is the base currency, the Canadian dollar is the quote currency, and one U.S. dollar costs 1.35 Canadian dollars.
58749272abac.sw: USD/CAD = 1.35 inamaanisha dola ya Marekani ni sarafu ya msingi, dola ya Kanada ni sarafu ya bei, na dola moja ya Marekani inagharimu dola 1.35 za Kanada.

588ba8c58d4a.en: The shares are cheap and should be bought
588ba8c58d4a.sw: Hisa ni nafuu na zinapaswa kununuliwa

588e7400ba3a.en: A general, sustained rise in prices that reduces what a currency can buy.
588e7400ba3a.sw: Kupanda kwa jumla na kwa kudumu kwa bei kunakopunguza kile ambacho sarafu inaweza kununua.

58be6d62785a.en: Short-term trading in shares is much closer to the roulette wheel than to ownership. Over a holding period of minutes or days, the businesses underneath have produced almost nothing. Nearly all of what you gain in that window comes from another trader, minus costs — so the activity is close to zero-sum before fees and negative-sum after them. The asset being productive does not make every activity involving it productive.
58be6d62785a.sw: Biashara ya muda mfupi ya hisa iko karibu zaidi na gurudumu la roulette kuliko na umiliki. Katika kipindi cha kushikilia cha dakika au siku, biashara zilizo chini zimezalisha karibu chochote. Karibu kila unachopata katika dirisha hilo hutoka kwa mfanyabiashara mwingine, kutoa gharama — hivyo shughuli iko karibu jumla-sifuri kabla ya ada na jumla-hasi baada yake. Mali kuwa yenye tija hakufanyi kila shughuli inayoihusisha kuwa yenye tija.

59d88f0fa026.en: The reason it matters is precise. The sizing formula turns your account size, your risk percentage, and your stop-loss into an exact position. Every input has to be exact for the output to be exact. Pip value is the one input that quietly changes from pair to pair, and getting it wrong is the most common way a carefully planned "one percent risk" turns into something else entirely.
59d88f0fa026.sw: Sababu inahusika ni sahihi. Fomula ya upimaji hugeuza ukubwa wa akaunti yako, asilimia yako ya hatari, na stop-loss yako kuwa nafasi kamili. Kila pembejeo lazima iwe kamili ili tokeo liwe kamili. Thamani ya pip ndiyo pembejeo moja inayobadilika kimyakimya kutoka jozi hadi jozi, na kuikosea ndiyo njia ya kawaida zaidi ambayo "hatari ya asilimia moja" iliyopangwa kwa makini hugeuka kuwa kitu tofauti kabisa.

59ee312b645b.en: Not quite — market cap always uses circulating supply and FDV always uses total or maximum supply. Here that is 2.00 x 100,000,000 = 200,000,000 dollars of market cap, and 2.00 x 1,000,000,000 = 2,000,000,000 dollars of FDV. The 10% ratio between them is the warning sign: 90% of the supply has not reached the market yet.
59ee312b645b.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kiasi cha soko daima hutumia usambazaji unaozunguka na FDV daima hutumia usambazaji jumla au wa juu kabisa. Hapa hiyo ni 2.00 x 100,000,000 = dola 200,000,000 za kiasi cha soko, na 2.00 x 1,000,000,000 = dola 2,000,000,000 za FDV. Uwiano wa 10% kati yake ndiyo ishara ya onyo: 90% ya usambazaji haijafika sokoni bado.

5a129d481286.en:
On 7 February 2014, Mt. Gox halted withdrawals.
On 28 February 2014, it filed in Tokyo for civil rehabilitation, a form of bankruptcy protection, disclosing the loss of 850,000 bitcoin — of which 750,000 belonged to customers.
On 9 March 2014, it filed for bankruptcy protection in the United States.
On 20 March 2014, it announced that roughly 200,000 bitcoin had been found in an old wallet last used before June 2011, reducing the net loss to about 650,000.
Repayments to creditors began in July 2024, slightly over a decade later.
5a129d481286.sw:
Tarehe 7 Februari 2014, Mt. Gox ilisimamisha utoaji.
Tarehe 28 Februari 2014, iliwasilisha Tokyo ombi la urekebishaji wa kiraia, namna ya ulinzi wa kufilisika, ikifichua hasara ya bitcoin 850,000 — kati yake 750,000 zilikuwa za wateja.
Tarehe 9 Machi 2014, iliwasilisha ombi la ulinzi wa kufilisika nchini Marekani.
Tarehe 20 Machi 2014, ilitangaza kwamba takriban bitcoin 200,000 zilikuwa zimepatikana katika pochi ya zamani iliyotumika mwisho kabla ya Juni 2011, ikipunguza hasara halisi hadi takriban 650,000.
Malipo kwa wadai yalianza mwezi Julai 2024, zaidi kidogo ya muongo mmoja baadaye.

5a27248892e2.en: Barber, Lee, Liu and Odean studied the complete transaction records of the Taiwan Stock Exchange. In a typical six-month period, more than 80% of day traders lost money after costs. In the follow-up work published in the Review of Asset Pricing Studies (2020, volume 10, issue 1, pages 61 to 93), they found that profitable and unprofitable traders were almost equally likely to keep trading the following year — roughly 96% against 95%. Losing money did not, in practice, stop people.
5a27248892e2.sw: Barber, Lee, Liu na Odean walisoma rekodi kamili za miamala za Soko la Hisa la Taiwan. Katika kipindi cha kawaida cha miezi sita, zaidi ya 80% ya wafanyabiashara wa siku walipoteza pesa baada ya gharama. Katika kazi iliyofuata iliyochapishwa katika Review of Asset Pricing Studies (2020, juzuu 10, toleo 1, kurasa 61 hadi 93), waligundua kwamba wafanyabiashara wenye faida na wasio na faida walikuwa na uwezekano karibu sawa wa kuendelea kufanya biashara mwaka uliofuata — takriban 96% dhidi ya 95%. Kupoteza pesa hakukuwazuia watu kivitendo.

5a2aa3e93d2a.en: About 17%, because the fee is charged on the whole balance every year and its effect compounds
5a2aa3e93d2a.sw: Takriban 17%, kwa sababu ada hutozwa juu ya salio lote kila mwaka na athari yake hujilimbikiza

5ab74ebecf5c.en: UST's stability required LUNA to be valuable. LUNA was valuable largely because it underpinned UST. Each supported the other, and neither was anchored to anything outside the pair. While confidence held, this was invisible. When it went, there was nothing underneath to arrest the fall, because the thing underneath was the same thing falling.

Kila moja iliunga mkono nyingine, na hakuna iliyotiwa nanga katika chochote nje ya jozi. Wakati ujasiri ulipokuwa umeshikilia, hili halikuonekana. Ulipoondoka, hakukuwa na chochote chini ya kuzuia kuanguka, kwa sababu kilichokuwa chini kilikuwa kitu kilekile kilichokuwa kikianguka.

5b056c02d8b2.en: A full accounting of this — combining win rate and average sizes into a single "expectancy" number, and building a plan around it — is the subject of Chapter 4, Lesson 2. For now, the practical takeaway is enough: protect the ratio, and you can be wrong a lot and still win.
