5b0c6b2d8cb2.en: What was visible in 1999: companies with no earnings valued at large multiples of revenue, index concentration rising, and a widely repeated argument that traditional valuation no longer applied to a new kind of business. What was not visible: when it would end, or which of the companies would survive and become genuinely enormous. Both of those questions were answered, and some of the survivors did justify remarkable valuations.
5b0c6b2d8cb2.sw: Kilichoonekana mwaka 1999: kampuni zisizo na mapato zikitathminiwa kwa vizidishi vikubwa vya mauzo, ukusanyiko wa faharasa ukipanda, na hoja iliyorudiwa sana kwamba tathmini ya kimapokeo haikutumika tena kwa aina mpya ya biashara. Kisichoonekana: ingeisha lini, au ni kampuni zipi zingenusurika na kuwa kubwa mno kweli. Maswali hayo yote mawili yalijibiwa, na baadhi ya walionusurika walihalalisha tathmini za kushangaza.

5b1929c47058.en: How many units rest as orders at each price level, and therefore how much can trade before price moves.
5b1929c47058.sw: Ni vipimo vingapi vilivyopumzika kama maagizo katika kila kiwango cha bei, na hivyo kiasi gani kinaweza kufanyiwa biashara kabla bei haijasogea.

5b19691b90c5.en: A ranging regime, with no clear trend and no genuine catalyst, is where most forced positions are taken and most accounts are slowly worn down by fees, funding and spreads.
5b19691b90c5.sw: Utawala wa kuzunguka, usio na mwelekeo wazi na usio na kichocheo halisi, ndipo nafasi nyingi za kulazimishwa huchukuliwa na akaunti nyingi huchakazwa taratibu na ada, ufadhili na mianya.

5b235c22d74d.en: The position-sizing formula is identical to forex — risk budget divided by stop distance — but crypto's much larger daily range forces a much wider stop, and a wider stop in the denominator produces a much smaller position for the same 1% risk.
5b235c22d74d.sw: Fomula ya kupanga ukubwa wa nafasi ni ileile kama forex — bajeti ya hatari ikigawanywa na umbali wa kusimamisha — lakini kiwango kikubwa zaidi cha kila siku cha kripto hulazimisha kusimamisha kupana zaidi, na kusimamisha kupana katika kigawanyaji huzalisha nafasi ndogo zaidi kwa hatari ileile ya 1%.

5b31b3f6ddc1.en: A company you hold falls 60% on bad results. If it was 2% of your portfolio you are down 1.2% — an ordinary week. If it was 40% you are down 24%, which needs a 31.6% gain to undo. Same company, same news, same day. The only difference was a decision made before any of it happened.
5b31b3f6ddc1.sw: Kampuni unayoishikilia hushuka 60% kwa matokeo mabaya. Kama ilikuwa 2% ya mkusanyiko wako umeshuka 1.2% — wiki ya kawaida. Kama ilikuwa 40% umeshuka 24%, ambako kunahitaji faida ya 31.6% kubatilisha. Kampuni ile ile, habari zile zile, siku ile ile. Tofauti pekee ilikuwa uamuzi uliofanywa kabla ya yoyote kati yake kutokea.

5b40a68a200a.en: Before you can judge these numbers you need to know what each one literally counts. Read each definition twice: once for what it includes, once for what it quietly leaves out.

5b81b148da2d.en: Trade immediately at the best available price. Certain to execute, uncertain in price.
5b81b148da2d.sw: Fanya biashara mara moja kwa bei bora inayopatikana. Ya uhakika kutekelezwa, isiyo na uhakika kwa bei.

5b865f8a5cc9.en: Risk management is almost entirely about the stop-loss. Making "too much" profit is never a problem worth solving. Losing more than you planned to is the only outcome risk management exists to prevent.
5b865f8a5cc9.sw: Usimamizi wa hatari unahusu karibu kabisa stop-loss. Kupata faida "nyingi mno" si tatizo linalostahili kutatuliwa kamwe. Kupoteza zaidi ya ulivyopanga ndilo tokeo pekee ambalo usimamizi wa hatari upo kulizuia.

5b8d218ddaed.en: The third discipline is reviewing decisions separately from outcomes.
5b8d218ddaed.sw: Nidhamu ya tatu ni kukagua maamuzi kwa kutenganisha na matokeo.

5b91f4e58995.en: Owning shares in productive businesses is positive-sum. The companies employ people, sell things, and generate cash. That cash accrues to the residual claim you learned about in Lesson 1. If every shareholder in the world held their shares and did nothing, they could still collectively be better off in ten years, because the businesses underneath produced something.
5b91f4e58995.sw: Kumiliki hisa katika biashara zenye tija ni jumla-chanya. Kampuni huajiri watu, huuza vitu, na huzalisha fedha. Fedha hizo hujilimbikizia kwenye dai la mabaki ulilojifunza katika Somo la 1. Kama kila mwanahisa duniani angeshikilia hisa zake na kutofanya chochote, bado wangeweza kwa pamoja kuwa bora zaidi baada ya miaka kumi, kwa sababu biashara zilizo chini yake zilizalisha kitu.

5b92b46c3731.en: Risk that affects nearly all companies together — a recession, a rate shock, a war. No amount of diversification within equities removes it.
5b92b46c3731.sw: Hatari inayoathiri karibu kampuni zote kwa pamoja — mdororo, mshtuko wa viwango, vita. Hakuna kiasi cha kusambaza kinachoiondoa ndani ya hisa.

5b977fa06fcc.en: Investing a fixed amount at regular intervals, so more units are bought when prices are low and fewer when they are high.
5b977fa06fcc.sw: Kuwekeza kiasi thabiti kwa vipindi vya kawaida, ili vipimo vingi zaidi vinunuliwe bei zikiwa chini na vichache zikiwa juu.

5bb9f9b68af4.en: An approval you granted once can drain your wallet months later, without any further action from you and without any warning. This is the failure mode that catches careful people, because the harmful click and the loss are separated in time. If you have used any on-chain application, you almost certainly hold approvals you have forgotten. Assume you do, and go and look.
5bb9f9b68af4.sw: Idhini uliyoitoa mara moja inaweza kumwaga pochi yako miezi baadaye, bila kitendo chochote zaidi kutoka kwako na bila onyo lolote. Hii ndiyo namna ya kushindwa inayowanasa watu makini, kwa sababu bonyezo la kudhuru na hasara vimetenganishwa kwa wakati. Ikiwa umewahi kutumia programu yoyote ya kwenye mnyororo, karibu kwa hakika unashikilia idhini ambazo umezisahau. Dhania unazo, na uende ukatazame.

5bfa2b8ba06e.en: Next time you see a blockchain called "immutable," ask one question: how much honest computing power protects this particular chain? For Bitcoin the answer is enormous. For a small chain, the same word can be covering a network that rented hash power rewrote last year. And notice what hashing actually guarantees: that the record has not been altered since it entered the chain — a lie recorded on a blockchain is a tamper-evident lie. Garbage in, immutable garbage out.
5bfa2b8ba06e.sw: Wakati ujao unapoona mnyororo wa vitalu ukiitwa "usiobadilika," uliza swali moja: ni nguvu ngapi ya kihesabu ya waaminifu inayolinda mnyororo huu maalum? Kwa Bitcoin jibu ni kubwa mno. Kwa mnyororo mdogo, neno lilelile linaweza kuwa linafunika mtandao ambao nguvu ya heshi iliyokodishwa iliuandika upya mwaka jana. Na tambua kile ambacho kufanya heshi huhakikisha hasa: kwamba rekodi haijabadilishwa tangu iingie katika mnyororo — uongo ulioandikwa katika mnyororo wa vitalu ni uongo unaogundulika kwa uchakachuaji. Takataka zikiingia, takataka zisizobadilika zikitoka.

5c0aaabb434b.en: 2.5 ETH, because the quoted price is 2,000 USDC per ETH
5c0aaabb434b.sw: ETH 2.5, kwa sababu bei iliyonukuliwa ni USDC 2,000 kwa ETH

5c0bf836c37c.en: Not quite — nothing physically forbids the edit. The attacker must redo the work for the edited block and every block above it while the honest chain keeps growing, which on a large chain costs more than it pays. On small chains it has actually happened — Lesson 3 covers how.

5d98524a3b49.en: The last surface is the one people assume is safe, because it is the one they bought specifically to be safe. Two documented cases show both halves. The hardware half: Kaspersky researchers examined a counterfeit hardware wallet bought by a victim from a seller on a classifieds site. The device was a convincing physical copy of a well-known model, sealed in packaging with the manufacturer's holographic labels, showing no external sign of tampering. Inside, the firmware had been replaced. The security checks that would normally reject unofficial firmware had been removed, and the recovery phrase the device produced was fixed in advance. The attacker knew the keys before the victim opened the box. There was nothing for the victim to notice and no moment at which the device behaved oddly.

Nusu ya maunzi: watafiti wa Kaspersky walichunguza pochi bandia ya maunzi iliyonunuliwa na mwathiriwa kutoka muuzaji katika tovuti ya matangazo. Kifaa kilikuwa nakala halisi ya kushawishi ya modeli inayojulikana, kikiwa kimezibwa katika kifungashio chenye lebo za holografia za mtengenezaji, kisichoonyesha dalili yoyote ya nje ya kuchakachuliwa. Ndani, firmware ilikuwa imebadilishwa. Ukaguzi wa usalama ambao kwa kawaida ungekataa firmware isiyo rasmi ulikuwa umeondolewa, na kifungu cha urejeshaji ambacho kifaa kilikizalisha kilikuwa kimewekwa mapema. Mshambuliaji alijua funguo kabla mwathiriwa hajafungua kisanduku. Hakukuwa na chochote kwa mwathiriwa kutambua wala wakati wowote ambapo kifaa kilitenda kwa ajabu.

5dc4c37ed99e.en: You have a high-conviction short on a currency: fundamentals, valuation, and a rate-decision catalyst all agree. Pre-mortem: it is three weeks later and the trade lost. Why? Perhaps the central bank surprised dovishly the other way; perhaps positioning was already so short that there was no one left to sell (Chapter 5, Lesson 2); perhaps a risk-off shock sent money into the currency as a safe haven; perhaps the move happened in an illiquid session and your stop filled far away (Chapter 5, Lesson 3). Each reason you surface becomes something you plan for now — a wider or differently placed stop, a smaller size, a decision to wait past the event, or a reason not to take the trade at all.
5dc4c37ed99e.sw: Una short ya uhakika wa juu kwenye sarafu: misingi, uthaminishaji, na kichocheo cha uamuzi wa kiwango vyote vinakubaliana. Pre-mortem: ni wiki tatu baadaye na biashara ilipoteza. Kwa nini? Labda benki kuu ilishangaza kwa dovish upande mwingine; labda nafasi za soko tayari zilikuwa short mno kiasi kwamba hakukuwa na aliyebaki kuuza (Sura ya 5, Somo la 2); labda mshtuko wa kukwepa hatari ulipeleka pesa kwenye sarafu kama kimbilio salama; labda msogeo ulitokea katika kipindi kisicho na ukwasi na stop yako ikatimizwa mbali (Sura ya 5, Somo la 3). Kila sababu unayoifichua hukuwa kitu unachokipangia sasa — stop pana au iliyowekwa tofauti, ukubwa mdogo, uamuzi wa kusubiri baada ya tukio, au sababu ya kutochukua biashara kabisa.

5e6b5f29634a.en: Sullivan, Timmermann & White (1999), published in The Journal of Finance, examined the data-snooping problem directly: they took a huge universe of technical trading rules and tested them against 100 years of daily Dow Jones data. The best-performing rule genuinely did beat the benchmark over the original sample period, even after statistically accounting for data-snooping. But when they applied that same best rule to the following ten years of out-of-sample data, it failed to outperform. The rule hadn't found a durable truth about markets — it had found a pattern that fit the data it was selected on.
5e6b5f29634a.sw: Sullivan, Timmermann & White (1999), waliochapisha katika The Journal of Finance, walichunguza tatizo la kupekua data moja kwa moja: walichukua ulimwengu mkubwa wa kanuni za biashara za kiufundi na kuzijaribu dhidi ya miaka 100 ya data ya kila siku ya Dow Jones. Kanuni iliyofanya vizuri zaidi kweli iliushinda mchezo wa kigezo katika kipindi asilia cha sampuli, hata baada ya kuzingatia kitakwimu kupekua data. Lakini walipoitumia kanuni ile ile bora kwa miaka kumi iliyofuata ya data ya nje ya sampuli, ilishindwa kufanya vizuri zaidi. Kanuni haikuwa imepata ukweli wa kudumu kuhusu masoko — ilikuwa imepata mtindo uliolingana na data iliyochaguliwa juu yake.

But the very next long gets stopped almost immediately when a large red candle drags the 20 back below the 50 — a small, quick loss. Then another short signal, another profitable leg. This sequence — several winning trades punctuated by small whipsaw losses — is what crossover trading actually looks like.

Lakini long ile inayofuata kabisa inasimamishwa karibu mara moja mshumaa mkubwa mwekundu unapovuta 20 kurudi chini ya 50 — hasara ndogo ya haraka. Kisha ishara nyingine ya short, mguu mwingine wenye faida. Mfululizo huu — biashara kadhaa za ushindi zikiingiliwa na hasara ndogo za whipsaw — ndivyo biashara ya mkatizo inavyoonekana hasa.

6200354a8c88.en: Decades of evidence show UIP fails badly over short horizons — and fails in the opposite direction to what it predicts. Rather than depreciating, high-interest-rate currencies have historically tended to keep appreciating in the short run. Economist Eugene Fama documented this in 1984, and it's been known ever since as the "forward premium puzzle" (or "Fama puzzle") — described in the literature as one of the most robust empirical regularities in international finance. In plain terms: the simple story isn't just imperfect, the real world has often done the reverse of what the clean theory predicts.
6200354a8c88.sw: Miongo ya ushahidi inaonyesha UIP hushindwa vibaya katika vipindi vifupi — na hushindwa kwa mwelekeo wa kinyume na inavyotabiri. Badala ya kudhoofika, sarafu za viwango vya juu vya riba zimeelekea kihistoria kuendelea kuimarika kwa muda mfupi. Mwanauchumi Eugene Fama aliliandika hili mwaka 1984, na limejulikana tangu wakati huo kama "fumbo la malipo ya mbele" (au "fumbo la Fama") — likielezwa katika fasihi kama mojawapo ya utaratibu imara zaidi wa kimajaribio katika fedha za kimataifa. Kwa lugha rahisi: simulizi rahisi si tu isiyo kamili, dunia halisi mara nyingi imefanya kinyume cha kile nadharia safi inavyotabiri.

6237fa98a2fd.en: Build a two-block toy chain by hand. Use this deliberately weak hash: convert letters to numbers (A=1, B=2, up to Z=26), count digits as themselves, ignore spaces, add everything up — including the previous block's hash — and keep only the last digit of the total. Block 1 contains "PAY BOB 5" (no earlier block, so use 0 as the previous hash): the letters sum to 61, plus 5, plus 0, gives 66 — hash 6. Block 2 contains "PAY SUE 4" plus the previous hash 6: compute it yourself — 87 plus 4 plus 6 gives 97, hash 7. Now tamper: change block 1 to "PAY BOB 9" and recompute. You get 70 — hash 0, but block 2 still says "previous hash: 6." Broken, detectably. Fix block 2's link to 0 and its own hash changes from 7 to 1, which would break block 3 if there were one. You have just watched tamper-evidence propagate down a chain, with pencil and paper. Two honest caveats: this toy hash has no avalanche effect and is trivial to fake — which is exactly why real chains use SHA-256 — and re-hashing here costs you nothing, which is why real chains also attach proof-of-work.
6237fa98a2fd.sw: Jenga mnyororo wa kuchezea wa vitalu viwili kwa mkono. Tumia heshi hii dhaifu kwa makusudi: badilisha herufi kuwa namba (A=1, B=2, hadi Z=26), hesabu tarakimu kama zilivyo, puuza nafasi, jumlisha kila kitu — ikiwa ni pamoja na heshi ya kitalu kilichotangulia — na baki na tarakimu ya mwisho pekee ya jumla. Kitalu 1 kina "PAY BOB 5" (hakuna kitalu cha awali, kwa hivyo tumia 0 kama heshi iliyotangulia): herufi zinajumlika hadi 61, pamoja na 5, pamoja na 0, hutoa 66 — heshi 6. Kitalu 2 kina "PAY SUE 4" pamoja na heshi iliyotangulia 6: hesabu mwenyewe — 87 pamoja na 4 pamoja na 6 hutoa 97, heshi 7. Sasa chakachua: badilisha kitalu 1 kuwa "PAY BOB 9" na uhesabu upya. Unapata 70 — heshi 0, lakini kitalu 2 bado kinasema "heshi iliyotangulia: 6." Kimevunjika, kwa kugundulika. Rekebisha kiungo cha kitalu 2 kuwa 0 na heshi yake mwenyewe hubadilika kutoka 7 hadi 1, jambo lingelivunja kitalu 3 kama kingekuwepo. Umetazama tu ushahidi wa uchakachuaji ukisambaa chini ya mnyororo, kwa penseli na karatasi. Tahadhari mbili za kweli: heshi hii ya kuchezea haina athari ya poromoko na ni rahisi mno kuighushi — ndiyo hasa sababu minyororo halisi hutumia SHA-256 — na kufanya heshi upya hapa hakukugharimu chochote, ndiyo sababu minyororo halisi pia huambatanisha uthibitisho-wa-kazi.

Crypto momentum operates over weeks rather than the three-to-twelve-month horizons documented in equities, and a pillar that decays that fast is one you must be willing to see reverse without treating the reversal as a personal failure.
62d93e87372c.sw: Kasi. Hii ina msaada imara zaidi kuliko nguzo yoyote hapa, kwa kuwa ni mojawapo ya vipengele vitatu ambavyo Liu, Tsyvinski na Wu walivitambua. Pia ina nusu-uhai mfupi zaidi. Kasi ya kripto hufanya kazi katika wiki badala ya upeo wa miezi mitatu-hadi-kumi-na-miwili ulioandikwa katika hisa, na nguzo inayooza kwa kasi hiyo ni ambayo lazima uwe tayari kuiona ikigeuka bila kuchukulia kugeuka kama kushindwa binafsi.

62dcca27f54e.en: You will see the figure "90% of day traders lose money" repeated constantly, usually with no source attached. The carefully measured number from complete exchange records is "more than 80% in a typical six-month period" — which is a different and more precise claim. When a striking statistic circulates without a traceable source, treat the statistic itself as the thing to check first. That habit is worth more than the number.
62dcca27f54e.sw: Utaona takwimu "90% ya wafanyabiashara wa siku hupoteza pesa" ikirudiwa kila mara, kwa kawaida bila chanzo. Namba iliyopimwa kwa makini kutoka rekodi kamili za soko ni "zaidi ya 80% katika kipindi cha kawaida cha miezi sita" — ambalo ni dai tofauti na sahihi zaidi. Takwimu ya kushtua inaposambaa bila chanzo kinachoweza kufuatiliwa, chukulia takwimu yenyewe kama kitu cha kukagua kwanza. Tabia hiyo ina thamani zaidi ya namba.

62ef8ddfb590.en: The possibility that an action or decision doesn't go the way you intended, exposing you to a loss or a bad outcome.
62ef8ddfb590.sw: Uwezekano kwamba kitendo au uamuzi hauendi jinsi ulivyokusudia, ukikuweka wazi kwa hasara au matokeo mabaya.

62f284482e1f.en: Correct — reserves are assets, but solvency is assets versus liabilities, and these reports typically say nothing about liabilities or whether the assets were borrowed for the snapshot. The U.S. audit regulator's 2023 advisory said plainly they are not audits.
62f284482e1f.sw: Sahihi — akiba ni rasilimali, lakini uwezo wa kulipa ni rasilimali dhidi ya madeni, na ripoti hizi kwa kawaida hazisemi lolote kuhusu madeni wala kama rasilimali zilikopwa kwa ajili ya picha hiyo. Ushauri wa 2023 wa mdhibiti wa ukaguzi wa Marekani ulisema wazi kwamba si ukaguzi.

62f91ef1ef76.en: This ordering isn't based on economic size or trading volume — it's rooted in history. The British pound "sat on top" of the hierarchy because sterling was the world's dominant reserve currency before the U.S. dollar took over that role. When euro trading launched on January 4, 1999, brokers initially supported both EUR/GBP and GBP/EUR quote conventions and let the market decide — EUR/GBP won out almost immediately, with the euro effectively inheriting the German mark's position in the pecking order. The convention persists today for reasons of market habit and consistency, not because it's the only logical way to write it.
62f91ef1ef76.sw: Mpangilio huu haujengwi juu ya ukubwa wa kiuchumi wala kiasi cha biashara — una mizizi katika historia. Pauni ya Uingereza "ilikaa juu" ya daraja kwa sababu sterling ilikuwa sarafu kuu ya akiba duniani kabla dola ya Marekani haijachukua nafasi hiyo. Biashara ya euro ilipoanza tarehe 4 Januari 1999, mabroker awali waliunga mkono makubaliano yote mawili ya nukuu ya EUR/GBP na GBP/EUR na kuliacha soko liamue — EUR/GBP ilishinda karibu mara moja, euro ikirithi kwa hakika nafasi ya alama ya Ujerumani katika daraja. Makubaliano yanaendelea leo kwa sababu za mazoea ya soko na uthabiti, si kwa sababu ndiyo njia pekee ya kimantiki ya kuiandika.

62fc151b09a1.en: On a DEX, listing requires no review, no application, and no permission — anyone can create a token and a pool for it in minutes, including a fake token named after a real one. This is not a rare edge case. A 2021 measurement study of Uniswap (Xia and co-authors, published in the ACM's measurement journal) flagged over 10,000 scam tokens — roughly half of all tokens examined — most built for "rug pulls," where the creator drains the pool after buyers pile in; the scams they traced netted at least 16 million dollars from nearly 40,000 victims. Permissionless listing is a real feature and a real attack surface at the same time. Never trade a token from a search box; verify its contract address from the project's official source first.
62fc151b09a1.sw: Katika DEX, kuorodhesha hakuhitaji mapitio, hakuna maombi, wala ruhusa — yeyote anaweza kuunda tokeni na bwawa kwa ajili yake ndani ya dakika, ikiwa ni pamoja na tokeni bandia iliyopewa jina la halisi. Hii si kesi adimu ya pembeni. Utafiti wa kipimo wa 2021 wa Uniswap (Xia na waandishi wenzake, uliochapishwa katika jarida la kipimo la ACM) ulionya kuhusu zaidi ya tokeni 10,000 za ulaghai — takriban nusu ya tokeni zote zilizochunguzwa — nyingi zikijengwa kwa ajili ya "rug pulls," ambapo muundaji humwaga bwawa baada ya wanunuzi kujazana; ulaghai waliofuatilia ulipata angalau dola milioni 16 kutoka karibu waathiriwa 40,000. Kuorodhesha bila ruhusa ni sifa halisi na uso halisi wa shambulizi kwa wakati mmoja. Usifanyie biashara tokeni kutoka kisanduku cha kutafuta kamwe; thibitisha anwani ya mkataba wake kutoka chanzo rasmi cha mradi kwanza.

63012ab62fda.en: The evidence that it is routine is unusually good. In January 2020, Kevin Lee, Benjamin Kaiser, Jonathan Mayer and Arvind Narayanan of Princeton University published an empirical study of carrier authentication for SIM swaps, later presented at the USENIX Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security in 2020. The researchers opened 50 prepaid accounts, 10 at each of five major United States carriers, and then called in to request a SIM swap on each. Roughly 80% of their attempts succeeded. They also surveyed websites that relied on phone-based recovery and identified 17 on which an account could be taken over by a SIM swap alone, with no password compromise at all.
63012ab62fda.sw: Ushahidi kwamba ni la kawaida ni mzuri isivyo kawaida. Mwezi Januari 2020, Kevin Lee, Benjamin Kaiser, Jonathan Mayer na Arvind Narayanan wa Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton walichapisha utafiti wa kimatendo wa uthibitishaji wa watoa huduma kwa ubadilishaji wa SIM, uliowasilishwa baadaye katika USENIX Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security mwaka 2020. Watafiti walifungua akaunti 50 za malipo ya awali, 10 kwa kila mmoja wa watoa huduma watano wakuu wa Marekani, kisha wakapiga simu kuomba ubadilishaji wa SIM katika kila moja. Takriban 80% ya majaribio yao yalifanikiwa. Pia walichunguza tovuti zilizotegemea urejeshaji unaotegemea simu na wakatambua 17 ambazo akaunti ingeweza kuchukuliwa kwa ubadilishaji wa SIM pekee, bila nenosiri kuathiriwa kabisa.

6308f4cb101a.en: The mechanics were simple. Borrow (or sell) the low-yielding yen, and buy a high-yielding currency like the Australian dollar, whose central bank paid far more. AUD/JPY became the classic expression of the trade.
6308f4cb101a.sw: Utaratibu ulikuwa rahisi. Kopa (au uza) yen yenye mavuno madogo, na ununue sarafu yenye mavuno makubwa kama dola ya Australia, ambayo benki kuu yake ililipa zaidi mno. AUD/JPY likawa usemi wa kawaida wa biashara hiyo.

631a0fa65ed5.en: Zhiyong Cheng, Jun Deng, Tianyi Wang and Mei Yu studied forced liquidations directly on BitMEX perpetual bitcoin futures, using generalised extreme value theory to model the tails rather than assuming normality. Their paper is "Liquidation, leverage and optimal margin in bitcoin futures markets," published in Applied Economics, Volume 53, Issue 47, in 2021, and circulated earlier as arXiv preprint 2102.04591. Daily forced liquidations ran at 3.51% of outstanding long positions and 1.89% of outstanding short positions, every day, at the venue's prevailing margin rules. Traders who were liquidated had been running average leverage of 60x. To bring the daily liquidation probability down to 1%, the authors calculated the exchange would need to raise its 1% margin requirement to 33%, which is 3x leverage for longs, and to 20%, which is 5x for shorts. They also found that assuming normally distributed returns significantly underestimates the margin actually required.
631a0fa65ed5.sw: Zhiyong Cheng, Jun Deng, Tianyi Wang na Mei Yu walichunguza ufilisi wa lazima moja kwa moja katika mikataba ya baadaye ya bitcoin ya kudumu ya BitMEX, wakitumia nadharia ya jumla ya thamani kali kuiga mikia badala ya kudhania hali ya kawaida. Karatasi yao ni "Liquidation, leverage and optimal margin in bitcoin futures markets," iliyochapishwa katika Applied Economics, Juzuu 53, Toleo la 47, mwaka 2021, na ilizunguka mapema kama arXiv preprint 2102.04591. Ufilisi wa lazima wa kila siku ulikimbia katika 3.51% ya nafasi ndefu zilizosalia na 1.89% ya nafasi fupi zilizosalia, kila siku, katika kanuni za mkopo zilizotawala katika uwanja. Wafanyabiashara waliofilisiwa walikuwa wakiendesha mzingo wa wastani wa 60x. Ili kushusha uwezekano wa ufilisi wa kila siku hadi 1%, waandishi walihesabu soko la kubadilisha lingehitaji kupandisha hitaji lake la mkopo la 1% hadi 33%, ambao ni mzingo wa 3x kwa warefu, na hadi 20%, ambao ni 5x kwa wafupi. Pia walibaini kwamba kudhania faida zimegawanywa kwa kawaida hupunguza kwa kiasi kikubwa mkopo unaohitajika hasa.

6326026b1e16.en: Not quite — the stops did trigger, but a triggered stop fills at the available price, and liquidity had vanished, so they filled far from their level.
6326026b1e16.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — stop zilianzishwa kweli, lakini stop iliyoanzishwa hutimizwa kwa bei inayopatikana, na ukwasi ulikuwa umetoweka, hivyo zilitimizwa mbali na kiwango chao.

633aebd83db5.en: Why did TerraUSD's peg mechanism fail in May 2022 when many holders redeemed at once?
633aebd83db5.sw: Kwa nini utaratibu wa pegi wa TerraUSD ulishindwa mwezi Mei 2022 wamiliki wengi walipokomboa kwa wakati mmoja?

633c4529ea45.en: Compensation for bearing a rare but severe crash risk
633c4529ea45.sw: Fidia kwa kubeba hatari nadra lakini kali ya kuanguka

6342ac30b84a.en: The balancing act, echoing Foundations Chapter 2's inflation lesson: raise rates to cool an overheating economy and fight inflation; lower rates to encourage borrowing and spending when growth stalls. Too fast, and inflation erodes the currency; too slow, and unemployment rises.
6342ac30b84a.sw: Tendo la kusawazisha, likiakisi somo la mfumuko wa bei la Sura ya 2 ya Msingi: pandisha viwango kupoza uchumi unaozidi joto na kupambana na mfumuko wa bei; shusha viwango kuhamasisha kukopa na kutumia ukuaji unaposimama. Kwa kasi mno, na mfumuko wa bei humomonyoa sarafu; kwa polepole mno, na ukosefu wa ajira hupanda.

634737f091aa.en: That the stated reserves existed at the moment covered by the report — a snapshot, not a full audit of the business
634737f091aa.sw: Kwamba akiba zilizotajwa zilikuwepo wakati uliofunikwa na ripoti — picha ya wakati, si ukaguzi kamili wa biashara

635b02e84afd.en: Swaps counterparty risk (exchange hacks, freezes, insolvency) for operational risk (lost seed, user error, irreversible mistakes)
635b02e84afd.sw: Hubadilisha hatari ya mshirika (udukuzi wa masoko, kugandishwa, kufilisika) kwa hatari ya kiuendeshaji (mbegu iliyopotea, kosa la mtumiaji, makosa yasiyoweza kutenduliwa)

638aa94a8255.en: You open the $50,000 position above with $1,000 margin, on a $5,000 account. The other $4,000 is "free margin," available to absorb losses. If the trade moves against you enough to erode that cushion, your broker will issue a margin call — and if you don't add funds, they'll start closing your positions automatically to protect themselves from your account going negative.
638aa94a8255.sw: Unafungua nafasi ile ya $50,000 hapo juu kwa margin ya $1,000, kwenye akaunti ya $5,000. Ile $4,000 nyingine ni "margin huru," inayopatikana kufyonza hasara. Kama biashara itasogea dhidi yako vya kutosha kumomonyoa mto huo, broker wako atatoa wito wa margin — na kama hutaongeza fedha, wataanza kufunga nafasi zako kiotomatiki ili kujilinda dhidi ya akaunti yako kuwa hasi.

63a4f9afed68.en: Correct — you may exit if the thesis breaks, but never move the stop or target just because price is uncomfortable; that undoes the reward-to-risk and the discipline the plan was built on.
63a4f9afed68.sw: Sahihi — unaweza kutoka kama nadharia itavunjika, lakini kamwe usisogeze stop au lengo kwa sababu tu bei haistarehe; hilo huvunja tuzo-kwa-hatari na nidhamu ambayo mpango ulijengwa juu yake.

63b0d7e11dfb.en: For years it looked like free money: a steady, high return with a calm, rising chart. That appearance is exactly the trap.
63b0d7e11dfb.sw: Kwa miaka ilionekana kama pesa za bure: faida thabiti kubwa yenye chati tulivu inayopanda. Muonekano huo ndio hasa mtego.

63d9aa786789.en: Now the three sections this asset class requires and no other does.
63d9aa786789.sw: Sasa sehemu tatu ambazo aina hii ya rasilimali huzihitaji na hakuna nyingine.

63dcc94658e0.en: The disagreement runs wider than one institution. Foundations Chapter 2, Lesson 4 already showed you two careful academic studies of Bitcoin as a safe haven reaching opposite conclusions, one of which put Bitcoin's correlation with United States and European stocks at roughly 0.05 in 2017 rising to somewhere between 0.25 and 0.30 by 2021. That is a lower figure than the IMF's 0.36, over overlapping but not identical periods, using different data. Do not smooth those into one tidy number. The direction of travel is consistent across all of them: upward. The exact level depends on the window, the price feed, and the return frequency.
63dcc94658e0.sw: Kutokubaliana huenea zaidi ya taasisi moja. Misingi Sura ya 2, Somo la 4 tayari lilikuonyesha tafiti mbili makini za kitaaluma za Bitcoin kama kimbilio salama zikifikia hitimisho zinazopingana, moja yake ikiweka uhusiano wa Bitcoin na hisa za Marekani na Ulaya katika takriban 0.05 mwaka 2017 ukipanda hadi mahali fulani kati ya 0.25 na 0.30 kufikia 2021. Hiyo ni takwimu ya chini kuliko 0.36 ya IMF, katika vipindi vinavyoingiliana lakini visivyofanana, vikitumia data tofauti. Usizilainishe kuwa namba moja nadhifu. Mwelekeo wa safari ni thabiti katika zote: kuelekea juu. Kiwango hasa hutegemea dirisha, mtiririko wa bei, na masafa ya faida.

63e8c1247a13.en: Not quite - packaging is the easiest part of a hardware wallet to copy, and Kaspersky documented a counterfeit that reproduced the seals and holographic labels convincingly. The decisive detail is the supplied recovery phrase. A real device generates your phrase on the device at first setup and nobody else ever sees it, so a phrase provided in the box is a phrase the attacker already holds. Changing the PIN does not help, because the keys were never yours.
63e8c1247a13.sw: Si sahihi kabisa - kifungashio ndiyo sehemu rahisi zaidi ya pochi ya maunzi kunakili, na Kaspersky iliandika bandia iliyozalisha mihuri na lebo za holografia kwa kushawishi. Kipengele cha maamuzi ni kifungu cha urejeshaji kilichotolewa. Kifaa halisi huzalisha kifungu chako katika kifaa wakati wa usanidi wa kwanza na hakuna mwingine anayekiona kamwe, kwa hivyo kifungu kilichotolewa katika kisanduku ni kifungu ambacho mshambuliaji tayari anakishikilia. Kubadilisha PIN hakusaidii, kwa sababu funguo hazikuwa zako kamwe.

6405bb010ec8.en: Every trade you then make on the exchange happens inside that internal database. Sell your bitcoin for dollars, buy it back, trade it fifty times — nothing touches the blockchain. The exchange lowers one number in its ledger and raises another, exactly like the bank ledgers in Lesson 1. The blockchain only gets involved again when you withdraw, and the exchange sends coins from its wallet to yours.
6405bb010ec8.sw: Kila biashara unayofanya kisha katika soko hutokea ndani ya hifadhidata hiyo ya ndani. Uza bitcoin yako kwa dola, inunue tena, ifanyie biashara mara hamsini — hakuna kinachogusa mnyororo wa vitalu. Soko hupunguza namba moja katika leja yake na kupandisha nyingine, hasa kama leja za benki katika Somo la 1. Mnyororo wa vitalu huhusika tena tu unapotoa, na soko hutuma sarafu kutoka pochi yake kwenda yako.

6410b4e4a479.en: Now the structures. Six cover the overwhelming majority of what you will meet.
6410b4e4a479.sw: Sasa miundo. Sita hufunika sehemu kubwa mno ya kile utakachokutana nacho.

64312972bb31.en: Correct. That asymmetry is what makes a run complete in days rather than months: roughly 5 billion dollars of withdrawal requests arrived within about 72 hours. When an institution can only pay if most people do not ask at once, the rational individual choice makes the collective outcome certain.
64312972bb31.sw: Sahihi. Ukosefu huo wa ulinganifu ndicho kinachofanya mkimbio ukamilike ndani ya siku badala ya miezi: takriban dola bilioni 5 za maombi ya utoaji zilifika ndani ya takriban masaa 72. Wakati taasisi inaweza kulipa tu ikiwa watu wengi hawaombi kwa wakati mmoja, chaguo la mtu binafsi lenye mantiki hufanya matokeo ya pamoja kuwa ya hakika.

643bec74d75a.en: The first is that regimes are named confidently in hindsight and are ambiguous while you are inside them. Nobody rang a bell at the bottom in 2022 or at the top in 2021. The value of regime mapping is not that it calls turns. It is that it stops you applying a momentum thesis to a market that has stopped trending, and stops you reading a liquidity-driven fall as a verdict on a protocol.
643bec74d75a.sw: Cha kwanza ni kwamba tawala hutajwa kwa ujasiri baada ya tukio na huwa na utata ukiwa ndani yake. Hakuna aliyepiga kengele bondeni mwaka 2022 au kileleni mwaka 2021. Thamani ya kuchora ramani ya utawala si kwamba hutabiri mabadiliko. Ni kwamba hukuzuia kutumia nadharia ya kasi katika soko ambalo limeacha kuelekea, na hukuzuia kusoma kushuka kunakoendeshwa na ukwasi kama hukumu juu ya itifaki.

6444fe5d00c3.en: Your phone, with your only crypto wallet app on it, is destroyed. You have your seed phrase written on paper at home. What happened to your coins?
6444fe5d00c3.sw: Simu yako, ikiwa na programu yako pekee ya pochi ya kripto, imeharibiwa. Una kifungu chako cha mbegu kilichoandikwa kwenye karatasi nyumbani. Nini kimetokea kwa sarafu zako?

646b03e4e54b.en: One user creates many addresses; one exchange address hides millions of users. The two counting errors run in opposite directions and neither can be measured.
646b03e4e54b.sw: Mtumiaji mmoja huunda anwani nyingi; anwani moja ya soko la kubadilisha huficha mamilioni ya watumiaji. Makosa mawili ya kuhesabu huenda mielekeo kinyume na hakuna linaloweza kupimwa.

646e2c4e1dd4.en: Everything in the next lesson — every valuation multiple — is built from these numbers. A multiple calculated on a profit figure you have not examined is a precise-looking number resting on an unexamined one.
646e2c4e1dd4.sw: Kila kitu katika somo lijalo — kila kizidishi cha uthaminishaji — kimejengwa kutoka namba hizi. Kizidishi kilichokokotolewa juu ya takwimu ya faida ambayo hujaichunguza ni namba inayoonekana sahihi ikikaa juu ya isiyochunguzwa.

6485f4f4d265.en: Correct. Self-custody moves the failure mode from a counterparty to you, which is usually the better trade and is not a free one. If nobody else knows the holding exists or where the recovery material is kept, there is no institution to appeal to and no record to find. A sealed written record held by someone you trust is the minimum version.
6485f4f4d265.sw: Sahihi. Utunzaji binafsi husogeza namna ya kushindwa kutoka kwa mshirika hadi kwako, ambayo kwa kawaida ndiyo maafikiano bora nayo si ya bure. Ikiwa hakuna mwingine anayejua umiliki upo au nyenzo za urejeshaji zinapohifadhiwa, hakuna taasisi ya kuomba wala rekodi ya kupata. Rekodi iliyoandikwa na kufungwa inayoshikiliwa na mtu unayemwamini ndilo toleo la chini kabisa.

648e0e1d5ef0.en: Shorting also carries an ongoing cost. You pay to borrow the shares, and on a heavily shorted company that fee can be substantial — so the position loses money while nothing happens, and being right eventually is not the same as being right in time.
648e0e1d5ef0.sw: Kufanya short pia hubeba gharama ya kudumu. Unalipia kukopa hisa, na kwenye kampuni inayofanyiwa short sana ada hiyo inaweza kuwa kubwa — hivyo nafasi hupoteza pesa huku hakuna kinachotokea, na kuwa sahihi hatimaye si sawa na kuwa sahihi kwa wakati.

64931218795b.en: There is also causal evidence that capping leverage helps, which Forex Chapter 1, Lesson 6 already covered. Rawley Heimer and Alp Simsek, in "Should retail investors' leverage be limited?", Journal of Financial Economics, Volume 132, Issue 3, 2019, pages 1 to 21, used the 2010 United States cap on retail forex leverage as a natural experiment, comparing capped American traders against still-uncapped European ones. They found the constraint reduced trading volume by 23% and alleviated high-leverage traders' losses by about 40%. The trading the cap removed was disproportionately speculative rather than informed.
64931218795b.sw: Pia kuna ushahidi wa kisababishi kwamba kuweka dari kwa mzingo husaidia, ambao Forex Sura ya 1, Somo la 6 lilikwisha kulishughulikia. Rawley Heimer na Alp Simsek, katika "Should retail investors' leverage be limited?", Journal of Financial Economics, Juzuu 132, Toleo la 3, 2019, kurasa 1 hadi 21, walitumia dari ya 2010 ya Marekani juu ya mzingo wa forex wa rejareja kama jaribio la asili, wakilinganisha wafanyabiashara Wamarekani waliowekewa dari dhidi ya Wazungu ambao bado hawakuwa wamewekewa dari. Walibaini kizuizi kilipunguza ujazo wa biashara kwa 23% na kikapunguza hasara za wafanyabiashara wenye mzingo mkubwa kwa takriban 40%. Biashara ambayo dari iliiondoa ilikuwa ya kubahatisha kwa kiasi kikubwa isivyo sawia badala ya yenye taarifa.

649322405b2c.en: The highest price anyone is currently willing to pay.
649322405b2c.sw: Bei ya juu zaidi ambayo mtu yeyote yuko tayari kuilipa sasa.

64b06904fc22.en: Not quite - positive funding means longs pay shorts because the perpetual is trading above spot, so the long side is crowded. That is a statement about fragility, not a timing signal, and it is a transfer between traders rather than an exchange fee.
64b06904fc22.sw: Si sahihi kabisa - ufadhili chanya humaanisha warefu hulipa wafupi kwa sababu ya kudumu inafanyiwa biashara juu ya papo hapo, kwa hivyo upande mrefu umejaa. Hiyo ni kauli kuhusu udhaifu, si ishara ya muda, nayo ni uhamisho kati ya wafanyabiashara badala ya ada ya soko la kubadilisha.

64cee6bfbcdf.en: Not quite - the reason is structural, not about who is trading. Most crypto assets produce no cash flows, so a story about future adoption has nothing measurable to collide with. That missing anchor works in both directions, on the way up and on the way down.
64cee6bfbcdf.sw: Si sahihi kabisa - sababu ni ya kimuundo, si kuhusu nani anafanya biashara. Rasilimali nyingi za kripto hazizalishi mitiririko ya fedha, kwa hivyo hadithi kuhusu matumizi ya baadaye haina cha kupimika cha kugongana nacho. Nanga hiyo inayokosekana hufanya kazi pande zote mbili, njiani kupanda na njiani kushuka.

64d0bc7e4b23.en: Informal term for an address, or a cluster of addresses, holding a large amount of a coin. There is no standard threshold. Providers publish supply-distribution bands, such as addresses holding at least 1,000 BTC, and different providers draw the lines differently.
64d0bc7e4b23.sw: Neno lisilo rasmi kwa anwani, au kundi la anwani, linaloshikilia kiasi kikubwa cha sarafu. Hakuna kizingiti cha kawaida. Watoa data huchapisha kanda za mgawanyo wa usambazaji, kama vile anwani zinazoshikilia angalau BTC 1,000, na watoa data tofauti huchora mistari tofauti.

64d89e42385b.en: Three growth curves for 10,000 invested over 30 years at an underlying 7 percent return, with annual fees of 0.05 percent, 0.75 percent and 1.50 percent, finishing at about 75,063, about 61,641 and about 49,840 respectively.
64d89e42385b.sw: Mikunjo mitatu ya ukuaji kwa 10,000 zilizowekezwa katika miaka 30 kwa faida ya msingi ya asilimia 7, ikiwa na ada za kila mwaka za asilimia 0.05, asilimia 0.75 na asilimia 1.50, ikimalizia kwa takriban 75,063, takriban 61,641 na takriban 49,840 mtawalia.

64f91cfa1e1b.en: It increases the block subsidy when more miners join

655dc50c3abe.en: GBP/USD is "Cable" — dating to the mid-1800s, when exchange rates between London and New York were transmitted via transatlantic telegraph cable (the first successful one completed in 1866). USD/CAD is "the Loonie" — after the loon bird on Canada's one-dollar coin, introduced in 1987. AUD/USD is "the Aussie," NZD/USD is "the Kiwi," and USD/CHF is "the Swissy" — each simply shortened from the country name.
655dc50c3abe.sw: GBP/USD ni "Cable" — likianzia katikati ya miaka ya 1800, viwango vya ubadilishaji kati ya London na New York vilipotumwa kupitia kebo ya telegrafu iliyovuka Atlantiki (ya kwanza iliyofanikiwa ilikamilika mwaka 1866). USD/CAD ni "Loonie" — kwa jina la ndege loon aliye kwenye sarafu ya dola moja ya Kanada, iliyoanzishwa mwaka 1987. AUD/USD ni "Aussie," NZD/USD ni "Kiwi," na USD/CHF ni "Swissy" — kila moja likifupishwa tu kutoka jina la nchi.

6567f9b8f693.en: You have a $10,000 account, and you've decided (per Foundations Chapter 2) to risk 1% per trade — that's $100. You're planning a trade with a 50-pip stop-loss. On a standard lot, each pip is worth $10, so you need to find the lot size where 50 pips of movement costs exactly $100. $100 ÷ 50 pips = $2 of risk per pip needed. Since a standard lot is $10 per pip, $2 ÷ $10 = 0.2 standard lots — 20,000 units, or 2 mini lots. If the trade hits your stop-loss, you lose exactly $100. Not roughly $100. Exactly $100, because you sized the position specifically to make that true.
6567f9b8f693.sw: Una akaunti ya $10,000, na umeamua (kwa mujibu wa Sura ya 2 ya Msingi) kuhatarisha 1% kwa kila biashara — hiyo ni $100. Unapanga biashara yenye stop-loss ya pip 50. Kwenye lot sanifu, kila pip ina thamani ya $10, hivyo unahitaji kupata ukubwa wa lot ambapo pip 50 za msogeo zinagharimu hasa $100. $100 ÷ pip 50 = $2 ya hatari kwa kila pip inayohitajika. Kwa kuwa lot sanifu ni $10 kwa pip, $2 ÷ $10 = lot 0.2 sanifu — vipimo 20,000, au lot 2 ndogo. Kama biashara itagonga stop-loss yako, unapoteza hasa $100. Si takriban $100. Hasa $100, kwa sababu ulipima nafasi mahususi ili kufanya hilo liwe kweli.

656b125a4f21.en:
The S&P 500 closed at its pre-crisis peak of 1,565.15 on 9 October 2007.
It closed at its trough of 676.53 on 9 March 2009.
That is a fall of 56.8%, and required a gain of about 131% to recover.
It closed at a new all-time high on 28 March 2013, at about 1,569.
The round trip took approximately five and a half years.

S&P 500 ilifungwa katika kilele chake cha kabla ya mgogoro cha 1,565.15 tarehe 9 Oktoba 2007.
Ilifungwa katika bonde lake la 676.53 tarehe 9 Machi 2009.
Hiyo ni kushuka kwa 56.8%, na kulihitaji ongezeko la takriban 131% ili kupona.
Ilifungwa katika kilele kipya cha wakati wote tarehe 28 Machi 2013, katika takriban 1,569.
Safari ya kwenda na kurudi ilichukua takriban miaka mitano na nusu.

66334891e4a1.en: Screening for the lowest P/E ratios and buying them systematically selects for companies whose earnings the market expects to fall. Sometimes the market is wrong, which is the entire basis of value investing. But the screen is not finding cheap companies — it is finding disliked ones, and sorting those two apart is the actual work.

6642285067f6.en: "Stable" describes the target, not a guarantee. A stablecoin's name, marketing, and years of trading at 1 dollar are all statements about intent and history — not about what happens under stress. The only thing that holds any peg is its mechanism, and mechanisms differ enormously: a redeemable reserve, an overcollateralized buffer, or a loop of pure confidence. Price charts of all three look identical right up until they don't.
6642285067f6.sw: "Imara" huelezea lengo, si hakikisho. Jina la sarafu imara, utangazaji, na miaka ya kufanyiwa biashara katika dola 1 yote ni kauli kuhusu nia na historia — si kuhusu kinachotokea chini ya msongo. Kitu pekee kinachoshikilia pegi yoyote ni utaratibu wake, na taratibu hutofautiana kwa kiasi kikubwa mno: akiba inayoweza kukombolewa, buffer ya dhamana ya ziada, au kitanzi cha imani tupu. Chati za bei za zote tatu huonekana zinazofanana hadi zisipofanana.

6657aad7eb5f.en: According to the Bank for International Settlements' 2025 Triennial Central Bank Survey — the most authoritative, comprehensive measurement of global currency trading, conducted every three years by central banks worldwide — global foreign exchange turnover reached $9.6 trillion per day in April 2025, up 28% from three years earlier. The U.S. dollar appeared on one side of 89% of all trades. EUR/USD remains the single largest currency pair by volume, though the Chinese yuan's share has been steadily rising — USD/CNY is now the third most-traded pair globally, ahead of GBP/USD.

Dola ya Marekani ilijitokeza upande mmoja wa 89% ya biashara zote. EUR/USD linabaki jozi kubwa zaidi la sarafu kwa kiasi, ingawa sehemu ya yuan ya China imekuwa ikipanda kwa uthabiti — USD/CNY sasa ni jozi la tatu linalofanyiwa biashara zaidi duniani, mbele ya GBP/USD.

670b2b7e7e1c.en: You buy USD/CAD near a support zone at 1.34, believing the price will rise. Your take-profit sits above your entry. Your stop-loss sits below your entry — near the support zone, where price would have real difficulty falling through if your read is correct. If price falls to your stop instead, you exit there and move on.
670b2b7e7e1c.sw: Unanunua USD/CAD karibu na eneo la msaada kwa 1.34, ukiamini bei itapanda. Take-profit yako iko juu ya kiingilio chako. Stop-loss yako iko chini ya kiingilio chako — karibu na eneo la msaada, ambapo bei ingekuwa na ugumu halisi kupenya kama usomaji wako ni sahihi. Kama bei itashuka hadi stop yako badala yake, unatoka hapo na kuendelea.

670b74eaebeb.en: Note what this means for a retail investor. You could hold a share, be entirely correct about it, and be prevented from acting by a collateral rule between two institutions you have never heard of and have no relationship with. That is a real risk and it is not in any valuation model. It is also a large part of why the United States moved to a shorter settlement cycle in May 2024, as Chapter 1 Lesson 3 noted — less time between trade and settlement means less risk to collateralise.
670b74eaebeb.sw: Tambua hili linamaanisha nini kwa mwekezaji wa rejareja. Ungeweza kushikilia hisa, kuwa sahihi kabisa kuihusu, na kuzuiwa kutenda na kanuni ya dhamana kati ya taasisi mbili ambazo hujawahi kuzisikia na huna uhusiano nazo. Hiyo ni hatari halisi nayo haiko katika mfano wowote wa tathmini. Pia ni sehemu kubwa ya sababu Marekani ilihamia mzunguko mfupi zaidi wa utimizaji mwezi Mei 2024, kama Sura ya 1 Somo la 3 lilivyobainisha — muda mfupi kati ya biashara na utimizaji humaanisha hatari ndogo ya kuwekewa dhamana.

674bab75c6d9.en: A stablecoin is a peg in miniature — a promise to hold $1 with a mechanism behind it — and the mechanism (redeemable reserves, overcollateralized crypto, or an algorithmic loop) is exactly what you must verify before relying on the promise.

674d8775e637.en: What to look for. Compute the liquidation price before you open any leveraged position, not after; if you cannot state it as a number and as a percentage move, you do not know what the position is. Compare that percentage to the asset's ordinary daily range, not to your expectation of where price is going. Check the funding rate and the settlement interval, then multiply by your leverage to get the daily cost as a share of your margin. Know which margin mode you are in, because cross margin collateralises the position with your whole balance. Treat published liquidation totals as floors, since the public feeds throttle during exactly the events you would want to measure. Never rely on a stop-loss to define your worst case in a leveraged crypto position. And if a venue's marketing leads with the maximum leverage available, read that as a statement about the venue's revenue model, not about your opportunity.
674d8775e637.sw: Cha kuangalia. Hesabu bei ya ufilisi kabla ya kufungua nafasi yoyote yenye mzingo, si baadaye; ikiwa huwezi kuitaja kama namba na kama msogeo wa asilimia, hujui nafasi ni nini. Linganisha asilimia hiyo na kiwango cha kawaida cha kila siku cha rasilimali, si na matarajio yako ya bei inakoenda. Kagua kiwango cha ufadhili na kipindi cha utimizaji, kisha zidisha kwa mzingo wako kupata gharama ya kila siku kama sehemu ya mkopo wako. Jua uko katika hali ipi ya mkopo, kwa sababu mkopo mtambuka huwekea nafasi dhamana ya salio lako lote. Chukulia jumla za ufilisi zilizochapishwa kama sakafu, kwa kuwa mitiririko ya umma hujizuia wakati wa matukio hasa ambayo ungependa kuyapima. Usitegemee kamwe kusimamisha hasara kufafanua kesi yako mbaya zaidi katika nafasi ya kripto yenye mzingo. Na ikiwa utangazaji wa uwanja unaongoza kwa mzingo wa juu kabisa unaopatikana, isome hiyo kama kauli kuhusu mfumo wa mapato wa uwanja, si kuhusu fursa yako.

676d3fc740e9.en: A hardware wallet that arrives with a recovery phrase already written down, printed on a card, or shown as your phrase during setup is not a wallet. It is a trap. A genuine device generates your phrase on the device itself, in front of you, the first time you set it up, and the manufacturer never knows it. Any phrase supplied to you is a phrase someone else already has.
676d3fc740e9.sw: Pochi ya maunzi inayofika ikiwa na kifungu cha urejeshaji tayari kimeandikwa, kimechapishwa katika kadi, au kikionyeshwa kama kifungu chako wakati wa usanidi si pochi. Ni mtego. Kifaa halisi huzalisha kifungu chako katika kifaa chenyewe, mbele yako, mara ya kwanza unapokisanidi, na mtengenezaji hakijui kamwe. Kifungu chochote kilichotolewa kwako ni kifungu ambacho mtu mwingine tayari anacho.

6788131275ff.en: Gold became the dominant choice almost everywhere it was available — scarce, durable, divisible, and easy to verify. The first standardized gold and silver coins date to the Kingdom of Lydia, around 700 B.C. But because money is defined by function and not material, gold was never the only option.
6788131275ff.sw: Dhahabu ikawa chaguo kuu karibu kila mahali ilipopatikana — adimu, ya kudumu, inayoweza kugawanywa, na rahisi kuthibitisha. Sarafu za kwanza sanifu za dhahabu na fedha zilianza katika Ufalme wa Lydia, karibu mwaka 700 K.K. Lakini kwa sababu pesa inafafanuliwa kwa kazi na si kwa dutu, dhahabu haikuwa chaguo pekee kamwe.

67fe172b2902.en: Correct — stop distance sits in the denominator, so position size moves inversely to it. 6.33 / 0.463 = 13.7, so the trader with the wider stop holds about one-fourteenth as much, while both still lose the same money if stopped out.
67fe172b2902.sw: Sahihi — umbali wa kusimamisha hukaa katika kigawanyaji, kwa hivyo ukubwa wa nafasi husogea kinyume nao. 6.33 / 0.463 = 13.7, kwa hivyo mfanyabiashara mwenye kusimamisha kupana hushikilia takriban sehemu moja ya kumi na nne kiasi, huku wote wawili bado wakipoteza pesa ileile wakisimamishwa.

68391d627349.en: Cross margin does not reduce risk. It relocates it, from a defined loss on one position to an undefined loss across the account. A trader using cross margin on a 50x position has not made the position safer; they have volunteered the entire balance as its collateral. Chapter 3, Lesson 1 built you a risk budget. Cross margin is the setting that quietly overrides it.

Mfanyabiashara anayetumia mkopo mtambuka katika nafasi ya 50x hajafanya nafasi kuwa salama zaidi; amejitolea salio lote kama dhamana yake. Sura ya 3, Somo la 1 lilikujengea bajeti ya hatari. Mkopo mtambuka ndio mpangilio unaoibatilisha kimya kimya.

6863447efcb2.en: Hold both failure lists in your head at once, because each one is regularly used to sell you something. "Not your keys, not your coins" is the sales pitch for hardware wallets; "self-custody is too dangerous" is the sales pitch for custodians. Both are half-arguments. Exchange failures prove custody risk is real. Lost-key stories prove self-custody is a skill — one that Howells and Thomas, both technically sophisticated, still failed at. Moving to self-custody does not make you safer by itself. It makes you responsible.
6863447efcb2.sw: Shikilia orodha zote mbili za kushindwa akilini mwako kwa wakati mmoja, kwa sababu kila moja hutumiwa mara kwa mara kukuuzia kitu. "Si funguo zako, si sarafu zako" ni hoja ya kuuzia pochi za maunzi; "utunzaji binafsi ni hatari mno" ni hoja ya kuuzia watunzaji. Zote ni hoja nusu. Kushindwa kwa masoko ya kubadilisha huthibitisha hatari ya utunzaji ni halisi. Hadithi za funguo zilizopotea huthibitisha utunzaji binafsi ni ujuzi — ambao Howells na Thomas, wote wenye ustadi wa kiufundi, bado walishindwa nao. Kuhamia utunzaji binafsi hakukufanyi salama zaidi peke yake. Hukufanya uwe na jukumu.

686740f7874e.en: This is not hypothetical, and the largest documented case shows the mechanism cleanly. In December 2021, users of the decentralized finance project BadgerDAO lost roughly 120 million dollars. The project's smart contracts were not broken. Instead, the project's website front end was compromised, and it silently inserted extra approval requests into transactions that users were already expecting to sign. Post-incident analyses found the malicious approvals had begun accumulating from around 20 November, and that hundreds of wallets granted them. The actual draining happened on 2 December, days or weeks after most victims had signed. Between signing and losing, nothing on their screens indicated anything was wrong.
686740f7874e.sw: Hii si ya kudhania, na kesi kubwa zaidi iliyoandikwa huonyesha utaratibu wazi. Mwezi Desemba 2021, watumiaji wa mradi wa fedha usio na kituo kikuu BadgerDAO walipoteza takriban dola milioni 120. Mikataba mahiri ya mradi haikuvunjwa. Badala yake, sehemu ya mbele ya tovuti ya mradi iliathiriwa, nayo iliingiza kimya kimya maombi ya ziada ya idhini katika miamala ambayo watumiaji walikuwa tayari wanatarajia kuitia sahihi. Uchambuzi wa baada ya tukio ulibaini idhini hasidi zilikuwa zimeanza kujilimbikiza kuanzia takriban 20 Novemba, na kwamba mamia ya pochi ziliziotoa. Umwagaji halisi ulitokea tarehe 2 Desemba, siku au wiki baada ya waathiriwa wengi kutia sahihi. Kati ya kutia sahihi na kupoteza, hakuna kilichokuwa kwenye skrini zao kilichoashiria lolote lilikuwa baya.

688163e60ac2.en: It is refunded to the sender once the transaction is buried
688163e60ac2.sw: Hurudishwa kwa mtumaji mara muamala unapozikwa

68956632f108.en: In Lesson 4's terms: an exchange account is custody. You have moved from "your keys" to "their keys," and taken on the referee-risk this track keeps returning to. The exchange can be hacked, can freeze withdrawals, can go bankrupt, or can quietly spend customer deposits. If it fails, the blockchain is no help — the blockchain correctly shows the exchange owning the coins. Your claim is against a company, not against the chain. That is precisely what customers of Mt. Gox learned in 2014 and customers of FTX learned in November 2022 — both are full case studies in Chapter 5.
68956632f108.sw: Kwa maneno ya Somo la 4: akaunti ya soko la kubadilisha ni utunzaji. Umehama kutoka "funguo zako" hadi "funguo zao," na umechukua hatari-ya-mwamuzi ambayo njia hii huendelea kurudi kwake. Soko linaweza kudukuliwa, linaweza kugandisha utoaji, linaweza kufilisika, au linaweza kutumia amana za wateja kimya kimya. Likishindwa, mnyororo wa vitalu hausaidii — mnyororo wa vitalu huonyesha kwa usahihi soko likimiliki sarafu. Dai lako liko dhidi ya kampuni, si dhidi ya mnyororo. Hicho ndicho hasa wateja wa Mt. Gox walichojifunza mwaka 2014 na wateja wa FTX walichojifunza mwezi Novemba 2022 — vyote ni uchunguzi kamili wa matukio katika Sura ya 5.

689bda465052.en: Asness, Moskowitz and Pedersen (2013), in The Journal of Finance, studied value and momentum across eight different markets and asset classes at once and found both earn consistent return premia everywhere they looked, with a common structure — and, usefully, that value and momentum are negatively correlated, so they complement each other. Separately, Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen and Vrugt (2018), in the Journal of Financial Economics, showed that carry — long studied only in currencies — predicts returns across global bonds, equities, commodities, and more, a genuinely general phenomenon.
689bda465052.sw: Asness, Moskowitz na Pedersen (2013), katika The Journal of Finance, walisoma thamani na kasi katika masoko na madaraja nane tofauti ya mali kwa wakati mmoja na wakagundua zote mbili hupata malipo thabiti ya ziada ya faida kila mahali walipotazama, zikiwa na muundo wa pamoja — na, kwa manufaa, kwamba thamani na kasi zina uwiano hasi, hivyo hukamilishana. Kwa tofauti, Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen na Vrugt (2018), katika Journal of Financial Economics, walionyesha kwamba carry — iliyosomwa kwa muda mrefu katika sarafu tu — hutabiri faida katika hatifungani za kimataifa, hisa, bidhaa, na zaidi, jambo la jumla kweli.

689e7f87976b.en: Shows the same open/high/low/close data as a bar chart, with a colored "body" between open and close, making bullish and bearish periods obvious at a glance.
689e7f87976b.sw: Huonyesha data ile ile ya kufungua/juu/chini/kufunga kama chati ya vipau, ikiwa na "mwili" wenye rangi kati ya kufungua na kufunga, jambo linalofanya vipindi vya kupanda na vya kushuka vionekane wazi kwa mtazamo mmoja.

68a55945e98a.en: Most jurisdictions treat disposals of crypto as taxable events, and in many a swap from one token to another is a disposal even though no conventional currency was involved. This course cannot tell you your local rules and will not invent them. What it can tell you is that the record you need is created at the moment of the transaction and is very difficult to reconstruct years later, particularly across exchanges that may no longer exist.
68a55945e98a.sw: Mamlaka nyingi huchukulia utupaji wa kripto kama matukio yanayotozwa kodi, na katika nyingi ubadilishaji kutoka tokeni moja kwenda nyingine ni utupaji hata kama hakuna sarafu ya kawaida iliyohusika. Kozi hii haiwezi kukuambia kanuni zako za mahali hapo wala haitazibuni. Kile inachoweza kukuambia ni kwamba rekodi unayoihitaji huundwa wakati wa muamala nayo ni ngumu sana kuijenga upya miaka baadaye, hasa katika masoko ya kubadilisha ambayo huenda hayapo tena.

68aa07c3f979.en: Here's the part that actually matters for this course: nothing about that $25 profit required an actual vacation. The only thing that mattered was holding one currency while it strengthened against another, then converting back.
68aa07c3f979.sw: Hii ndiyo sehemu inayohusika kwa kozi hii hasa: hakuna chochote kuhusu faida ile ya $25 kilichohitaji likizo halisi. Kitu pekee kilichohusika ni kushikilia sarafu moja inapoimarika dhidi ya nyingine, kisha kubadilisha tena.

68c62edacd73.en: The second is that this is not permission to time the market. Chapter 4 Lesson 1 gave the evidence on what retail timing achieves: an estimated 73 to 81% of retail investors in the BIS data had likely lost money, with entries clustered after price rises. Regime reading tells you which evidence has power in conditions you are already in. It does not tell you what next quarter looks like, and anyone who claims otherwise is selling something.
68c62edacd73.sw: Cha pili ni kwamba hii si ruhusa ya kupanga muda wa soko. Sura ya 4 Somo la 1 lilitoa ushahidi juu ya kile ambacho kupanga muda kwa rejareja hufanikisha: makadirio ya 73 hadi 81% ya wawekezaji wa rejareja katika data ya BIS pengine walipoteza pesa, huku viingilio vikikusanyika baada ya kupanda kwa bei. Kusoma utawala hukuambia ni ushahidi upi wenye nguvu katika hali ambazo tayari uko ndani yake. Hakukuambii robo ijayo inaonekanaje, na yeyote anayedai vinginevyo anauza kitu.

691ebd951b05.en: The evidence that crypto has behaved as a high-beta risk asset comes from several independent directions. No single study settles it. Together they point the same way.

693962321edb.en: Read that ratio again. In the paper that founded this field, the majority of the ledger could not be attached to any identity, and the identities that were attached came from the researchers physically transacting with services, one at a time. Commercial providers have far more resources and better methods today. They still start from the same position: the ledger volunteers no names.
693962321edb.sw: Soma uwiano huo tena. Katika karatasi iliyoanzisha uwanja huu, sehemu kubwa ya leja haikuweza kuambatanishwa na utambulisho wowote, na vitambulisho vilivyoambatanishwa vilitoka kwa watafiti kufanya miamala kimwili na huduma, moja baada ya nyingine. Watoa data wa kibiashara wana rasilimali nyingi zaidi na mbinu bora zaidi leo. Bado huanza kutoka msimamo uleule: leja haitoi majina.

6946792abc59.en: This is diversification's central limitation and it must be stated plainly. The protection is weakest exactly when you need it. A portfolio spread across countries behaves like several different investments for years, and then, on the worst days, behaves like one. Anyone who tells you geographic diversification protects you in a crisis is describing the average day rather than the day that matters.
6946792abc59.sw: Hiki ndicho kikomo kikuu cha mtawanyiko nacho lazima kitajwe wazi. Ulinzi ni dhaifu zaidi hasa unapouhitaji. Kasha lililotawanywa katika nchi hutenda kama uwekezaji kadhaa tofauti kwa miaka, kisha, katika siku mbaya zaidi, hutenda kama kimoja. Yeyote anayekuambia mtawanyiko wa kijiografia hukulinda katika mgogoro anaelezea siku ya wastani badala ya siku yenye maana.

696f8b12ec81.en: Not quite - the peaks really did land in the window. The problem is that four dependent observations carry little weight, the window was fitted after the fact, and other large drivers moved at the same time. Note that saying no pattern can ever exist overreaches in the opposite direction: not established is not the same as impossible.

Tatizo ni kwamba uchunguzi manne tegemezi hubeba uzito mdogo, dirisha liliwekwa baada ya tukio, na visababishi vingine vikubwa vilisogea kwa wakati mmoja. Tambua kwamba kusema hakuna muundo unaoweza kuwepo kamwe hupindukia upande mwingine: haijathibitishwa si sawa na haiwezekani.

69874cf2f677.en: Spreading across industries and countries diversifies within one asset class. Market risk, by definition, survives all of it. The only remaining tool is to hold something whose returns come from a different source altogether — bonds, cash, or property — and the trade is that these have generally produced lower long-run returns in exchange for behaving differently when equities fall.

Zana pekee iliyobaki ni kushikilia kitu ambacho faida zake hutoka chanzo tofauti kabisa — hatifungani, fedha taslimu, au mali isiyohamishika — na biashara ni kwamba hivi kwa ujumla vimezalisha faida ndogo za muda mrefu badala ya kutenda tofauti hisa zinaposhuka.

699db5cf086d.en: Not quite — the real difference is the cost profile: PoW charges in external hardware and electricity, PoS in internal staked collateral that slashing can destroy. Both use cryptography, both face the 51% question, and both have concentration concerns — pools on one side, staking intermediaries on the other.
699db5cf086d.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — tofauti halisi ni mchoro wa gharama: PoW hutoza katika maunzi na umeme wa nje, PoS katika dhamana ya ndani iliyowekwa kama hisa ambayo kukata kunaweza kuiharibu. Yote miwili hutumia kriptografia, yote miwili hukabiliana na swali la 51%, na yote miwili yana wasiwasi wa ukusanyikaji — vikundi upande mmoja, wapatanishi wa uwekaji hisa upande mwingine.

6a35e30bc090.en: The same study traced at least 16 million dollars of profit taken from 39,762 potential victims, and found thousands of addresses colluding with the token creators to make the trading look organic. The wallets buying alongside you were frequently the same people selling to you.
6a35e30bc090.sw: Utafiti uleule ulifuatilia angalau dola milioni 16 za faida iliyochukuliwa kutoka waathiriwa watarajiwa 39,762, na ukabaini maelfu ya anwani zikishirikiana na waundaji wa tokeni kufanya biashara ionekane ya asili. Pochi zilizonunua sambamba nawe mara nyingi zilikuwa watu waleule waliokuwa wakikuuzia.

6a3b7cc9d20c.en: You buy a hardware wallet at a discount from a marketplace seller. It arrives sealed, with holographic labels, and setup produces a recovery phrase on a printed card in the box. What should you conclude?
6a3b7cc9d20c.sw: Unanunua pochi ya maunzi kwa punguzo kutoka muuzaji wa soko. Inafika ikiwa imezibwa, ikiwa na lebo za holografia, na usanidi huzalisha kifungu cha urejeshaji katika kadi iliyochapishwa ndani ya kisanduku. Unapaswa kuhitimisha nini?

6a4952aa083b.en: Investing everything the day before a 30% fall is a specific and memorable experience. It produces the feeling that you did this, which is what makes people sell at the bottom and stay out for years. That reaction has a cost, and the cost is often larger than the expected advantage of investing at once.
6a4952aa083b.sw: Kuwekeza kila kitu siku moja kabla ya kushuka kwa 30% ni uzoefu mahususi na unaokumbukwa. Huzalisha hisia kwamba ulifanya hivi, ambayo ndiyo huwafanya watu wauze chini kabisa na wabaki nje kwa miaka. Mwitikio huo una gharama, na gharama mara nyingi ni kubwa kuliko faida inayotarajiwa ya kuwekeza mara moja.

6a5bfb698d93.en: It does not establish that the design is sound, that the team will not act against you, or that the deployed contract is the version reviewed. A contract can be audited and still contain a documented function letting the owner mint unlimited tokens, because that function is not a bug — it is a feature the auditors correctly reported and the reader never read. Audited is a statement about code review, not a statement about safety.
6a5bfb698d93.sw: Hauthibitishi kwamba muundo ni imara, kwamba timu haitatenda dhidi yako, au kwamba mkataba uliowekwa ni toleo lililopitiwa. Mkataba unaweza kukaguliwa na bado ukawa na kitendakazi kilichoandikwa kinachomruhusu mmiliki kutengeneza tokeni bila kikomo, kwa sababu kitendakazi hicho si hitilafu — ni sifa ambayo wakaguzi waliiripoti kwa usahihi na msomaji hakuisoma kamwe. Umekaguliwa ni kauli kuhusu mapitio ya msimbo, si kauli kuhusu usalama.

6a78275b20ba.en: Correct. The value of the finding is that it collapses apparent variety into a few exposures, which matters when you believe you hold several independent bets. It is the strongest evidence this asset class currently has, and it is weaker than the equity equivalents: a cross-sectional description over a sample, not a promise about persistence or about any one asset.
6a78275b20ba.sw: Sahihi. Thamani ya tokeo ni kwamba huponda tofauti inayoonekana kuwa kufunuliwa kuchache, jambo lenye maana unapoamini unashikilia madau kadhaa huru. Ndio ushahidi imara zaidi ambao aina hii ya rasilimali inao kwa sasa, nao ni dhaifu zaidi kuliko visawe vya hisa: maelezo ya sehemu-mtambuka katika sampuli, si ahadi kuhusu kudumu au kuhusu rasilimali yoyote moja.

6a7b93b30617.en: What to look for when you read a set of accounts. Compare profit with operating cash flow across at least three years and note whether the gap is stable or widening. Check whether free cash flow is positive after capital spending. Look at how fast receivables and inventory are growing relative to revenue. And read the notes to the accounts, which is where anything genuinely awkward is disclosed in the smallest available typeface.
6a7b93b30617.sw: Cha kutazama unaposoma seti ya hesabu. Linganisha faida na mtiririko wa fedha wa shughuli katika angalau miaka mitatu na utambue kama pengo ni thabiti au linapanuka. Kagua kama mtiririko huru wa fedha ni chanya baada ya matumizi ya mtaji. Tazama kasi ya ukuaji wa madeni ya wateja na bidhaa ikilinganishwa na mapato. Na soma maelezo ya hesabu, ambapo chochote kigumu kweli hufichuliwa kwa herufi ndogo zaidi zinazopatikana.

6a7d74457bd8.en: A wallet is connected to a site that requests permission to spend its tokens, and the permission — once granted — is used to remove them later, without any further action by the owner.
6a7d74457bd8.sw: Pochi huunganishwa na tovuti inayoomba ruhusa ya kutumia tokeni zake, na ruhusa — mara ikitolewa — hutumika kuziondoa baadaye, bila kitendo chochote zaidi cha mmiliki.

6a8ea1690e39.en: Since the FTX collapse, exchanges publish "proof of reserves" reports to show they hold customer assets. Read these skeptically. A proof-of-reserves snapshot shows assets, not liabilities — it can show the exchange holds 10,000 BTC without showing it owes customers 15,000 BTC, and it cannot show whether the assets were borrowed for the snapshot. In March 2023, the U.S. audit regulator's investor advocate (the PCAOB) warned investors directly that these reports are not audits and "do not provide any meaningful assurance." The accounting firm Mazars had already suspended its crypto proof-of-reserves work in December 2022 — days after producing one for Binance — citing concerns about how the public understood the reports. A real audit examines assets and liabilities. A reserves snapshot is half a balance sheet.
6a8ea1690e39.sw: Tangu kuanguka kwa FTX, masoko ya kubadilisha huchapisha ripoti za "uthibitisho wa akiba" kuonyesha kwamba wanashikilia rasilimali za wateja. Zisome kwa mashaka. Picha ya uthibitisho wa akiba huonyesha rasilimali, si madeni — inaweza kuonyesha soko linashikilia BTC 10,000 bila kuonyesha linadaiwa na wateja BTC 15,000, wala haiwezi kuonyesha kama rasilimali zilikopwa kwa ajili ya picha hiyo. Mwezi Machi 2023, mtetezi wa wawekezaji wa mdhibiti wa ukaguzi wa Marekani (PCAOB) aliwaonya wawekezaji moja kwa moja kwamba ripoti hizi si ukaguzi na "do not provide any meaningful assurance." Kampuni ya uhasibu Mazars ilikuwa tayari imesimamisha kazi yake ya uthibitisho wa akiba ya kripto mwezi Desemba 2022 — siku chache baada ya kutoa moja kwa Binance — ikitaja wasiwasi kuhusu jinsi umma ulivyozielewa ripoti. Ukaguzi halisi huchunguza rasilimali na madeni. Picha ya akiba ni nusu ya karatasi ya salio.

6ab03c2309ad.en: What to look for when assessing whether you are actually diversified. Group your holdings by industry rather than by name and see how the totals fall. Do the same by country, and then again by currency, which is often a different answer. Add your employer and your property to the picture, since both are exposures you already hold. And ask which single event would damage the largest share of the total, because that is your real concentration whatever the holdings list says.
6ab03c2309ad.sw: Cha kutazama unapotathmini kama umesambazwa hasa. Panga umiliki wako kwa sekta badala ya jina na uone jumla zinavyoanguka. Fanya vivyo hivyo kwa nchi, kisha tena kwa sarafu, ambako mara nyingi ni jibu tofauti. Ongeza mwajiri wako na mali yako kwenye picha, kwa kuwa vyote ni uwazi ambao tayari unao. Na uliza ni tukio gani moja lingeharibu sehemu kubwa zaidi ya jumla, kwa sababu hiyo ndiyo mkusanyiko wako halisi chochote orodha ya umiliki inayosema.

6ab579f4f341.en: Correct — Nakamoto's paper never claims impossibility. It claims the honest chain outruns an attacker as long as most computing power is honest. On small chains that cost has actually been paid, and history was rewritten — Lesson 3 covers how.
6ab579f4f341.sw: Sahihi — karatasi ya Nakamoto haidai kutowezekana kamwe. Inadai mnyororo mwaminifu humpita mshambuliaji maadamu nguvu nyingi za kihesabu ni waaminifu. Katika minyororo midogo gharama hiyo imelipwa kweli, na historia iliandikwa upya — Somo la 3 hushughulikia jinsi gani.

6ac2e1fd965b.en: That is also why the fat tails thread from Foundations Chapter 3 and Forex Chapter 5 returns here. Extreme joint moves are more frequent than a model assuming a normal distribution predicts, and Longin and Solnik's method exists precisely because that assumption fails in the tail. They reject multivariate normality for the negative tail and not for the positive one.
6ac2e1fd965b.sw: Hiyo pia ndiyo sababu uzi wa mikia minene kutoka Misingi Sura ya 3 na Forex Sura ya 5 unarudi hapa. Misogeo mikali ya pamoja ni ya mara kwa mara zaidi kuliko mfano unaodhania usambazaji wa kawaida unavyotabiri, na mbinu ya Longin na Solnik ipo hasa kwa sababu dhana hiyo hushindwa katika mkia. Wanakataa hali ya kawaida ya vigezo vingi kwa mkia hasi na si kwa chanya.

6ac5d15b1053.en: Your bank balance is not a stack of notes in a vault with your name on it. It is a row in your bank's records. When you pay someone, no object moves. Your bank lowers one number and raises another.
6ac5d15b1053.sw: Salio lako la benki si rundo la noti katika kasha lenye jina lako. Ni safu katika rekodi za benki yako. Unapomlipa mtu, hakuna kitu kinachosogea. Benki yako hupunguza namba moja na kupandisha nyingine.

6ac788693e16.en: Why do transactions pay fees at all? Because block space is scarce. Lesson 2 showed you that each block holds a limited amount of data, and blocks arrive on a roughly fixed schedule — about every 10 minutes on Bitcoin, about every 12 seconds on Ethereum. The network can only record so many transactions per hour, no matter how many people want in. When more transactions wait in the mempool than the next blocks can hold, someone must decide which ones get in. The mechanism is simple and brutal: transactions offer fees, and block producers — who keep the fees — pick the best-paying ones first. It is an auction, and you are bidding against every other user on the network at that moment. Quiet network: fees are small. Busy network: everyone raises their bid to jump the queue, and the price of block space can multiply within hours.
6ac788693e16.sw: Kwa nini miamala hulipa ada kabisa? Kwa sababu nafasi ya kitalu ni adimu. Somo la 2 lilikuonyesha kwamba kila kitalu hushikilia kiasi kidogo cha data, na vitalu hufika kwa ratiba karibu isiyobadilika — takriban kila dakika 10 katika Bitcoin, takriban kila sekunde 12 katika Ethereum. Mtandao unaweza kuandika idadi fulani tu ya miamala kwa saa, bila kujali watu wangapi wanataka kuingia. Miamala mingi inaposubiri katika mempool kuliko vitalu vinavyofuata vinavyoweza kushikilia, mtu lazima aamue ipi inaingia. Utaratibu ni rahisi na wa kikatili: miamala hutoa ada, na wazalishaji wa vitalu — wanaobakiza ada — huchagua inayolipa vizuri zaidi kwanza. Ni mnada, nawe unanadi dhidi ya kila mtumiaji mwingine katika mtandao wakati huo. Mtandao tulivu: ada ni ndogo. Mtandao wenye shughuli: kila mtu hupandisha zabuni yake ili kuruka foleni, na bei ya nafasi ya kitalu inaweza kuzidishwa ndani ya masaa.

6ac8d14d6e64.en: Peer-reviewed work lands at the top of that range for an earlier period. Dirk G. Baur and Thomas Dimpfl published The volatility of Bitcoin and its role as a medium of exchange and a store of value in Empirical Economics, volume 61, issue 5, in 2021, pages 2663 to 2683. Using data from January 2014 to January 2017 across six Bitcoin markets and two foreign exchange markets, they report that Bitcoin's volatility is extreme and almost 10 times higher than the volatility of the major exchange rates they measured, the US dollar against the euro and against the yen. Their conclusion is that this excess volatility is what stops Bitcoin functioning as a medium of exchange.
6ac8d14d6e64.sw: Kazi iliyopitiwa na wenzao huanguka juu ya kiwango hicho kwa kipindi cha awali. Dirk G. Baur na Thomas Dimpfl walichapisha The volatility of Bitcoin and its role as a medium of exchange and a store of value katika Empirical Economics, juzuu 61, toleo la 5, mwaka 2021, kurasa 2663 hadi 2683. Wakitumia data kutoka Januari 2014 hadi Januari 2017 katika masoko sita ya Bitcoin na masoko mawili ya kubadilisha fedha za kigeni, wanaripoti kwamba mtikisiko wa Bitcoin ni mkali na karibu mara 10 zaidi ya mtikisiko wa viwango vikuu vya kubadilisha walivyovipima, dola ya Marekani dhidi ya yuro na dhidi ya yeni. Hitimisho lao ni kwamba mtikisiko huu wa ziada ndicho kinachozuia Bitcoin kufanya kazi kama njia ya kubadilishana.

6b0bad6e892d.sw: Jozi kuu yana majina ya utani yasiyo rasmi ambayo wafanyabiashara huyatumia kila mara — yanastahili kutambuliwa hata kama hutayatumia mwenyewe kamwe.

6b1118b7eee3.sw: Hakuna tofauti halisi; vyote ni mabashiri juu ya tokeo lisilo na uhakika

6b111a00eec6.en: Not quite. The two are routinely merged and should not be. Efficiency says available information is in the price. It makes no promise that the resulting price will look sensible in hindsight, because the future was never available information.
6b111a00eec6.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Hizo mbili huunganishwa mara kwa mara na hazipaswi. Ufanisi husema taarifa zinazopatikana ziko kwenye bei. Haitoi ahadi kwamba bei itakayotokana itaonekana yenye busara kwa kutazama nyuma, kwa sababu ya baadaye haikuwahi kuwa taarifa inayopatikana.

6b134432e9ac.en: A trading approach betting that a stretched price will return toward its average. Bollinger Bands and RSI are mean-reversion tools. Crossovers (Lesson 1) are the opposite — trend-following tools, betting that movement will continue.

6b17a665b5da.en: Lesson 1 ended with a design: everyone keeps a full copy of the ledger, so a coin that was already spent is visible to all, and a second spend gets rejected. Lesson 2 showed why old history is hard to rewrite: each block's hash is locked into the next block, so changing anything old means redoing every block after it.
6b17a665b5da.sw: Somo la 1 lilimalizika na muundo: kila mtu hutunza nakala kamili ya leja, ili sarafu ambayo tayari ilitumika ionekane kwa wote, na matumizi ya pili yakataliwe. Somo la 2 lilionyesha kwa nini historia ya zamani ni ngumu kuandika upya: heshi ya kila kitalu imefungiwa katika kitalu kinachofuata, kwa hivyo kubadilisha chochote cha zamani humaanisha kurudia kila kitalu kinachofuata.

6b1e3fb28cca.en: This lesson is not a guide to trading perpetuals. It is a guide to understanding what they are before someone offers you 100x on one. Chapter 2 ended with the sensible use of funding data for a beginner: read it, and stay in spot. Nothing in this lesson changes that recommendation. What follows is the arithmetic that justifies it.
6b1e3fb28cca.sw: Somo hili si mwongozo wa kufanya biashara ya za kudumu. Ni mwongozo wa kuelewa ni nini kabla mtu hajakupa 100x juu ya moja. Sura ya 2 ilimalizika na matumizi yenye maana ya data ya ufadhili kwa mwanzilishi: isome, na ubaki katika papo hapo. Hakuna kilicho katika somo hili kinachobadilisha pendekezo hilo. Kinachofuata ni hesabu inayolihalalisha.

6b3a95502d87.en: Correct. Correlation, not count, determines the benefit. Twenty banks share the same exposure to rates, credit losses and regulation, so they behave as one bet. Five businesses in five genuinely different industries can spread risk more effectively than thirty in one.
6b3a95502d87.sw: Sahihi. Uwiano, si hesabu, huamua manufaa. Benki ishirini hushiriki uwazi ule ule kwa viwango, hasara za mikopo na udhibiti, hivyo hutenda kama dau moja. Biashara tano katika sekta tano tofauti kweli zinaweza kusambaza hatari kwa ufanisi zaidi kuliko thelathini katika moja.

6b8c269a5657.en: So "the market" depends on which index you mean. A day when a few very large companies fall and most smaller ones rise can be a down day for a cap-weighted index and an up day for an equally-weighted one covering the same companies. Neither number is lying. They are answering different questions.
