Siku ambapo kampuni chache kubwa mno hushuka na nyingi ndogo hupanda inaweza kuwa siku ya kushuka kwa index yenye uzito wa mtaji na siku ya kupanda kwa ile yenye uzito sawa inayohusu kampuni zile zile. Hakuna namba inayodanganya. Zinajibu maswali tofauti.

6ba181418ac7.en: Twelve purchases instead of one means twelve spreads, and where a platform charges per trade, twelve commissions. On a large sum this is trivial and on a small one it is not. Someone spreading 3,000 over twelve monthly purchases of 250 with a fixed charge per trade can lose a meaningful percentage to costs that a single purchase would have avoided.
6ba181418ac7.sw: Ununuzi kumi na mbili badala ya mmoja unamaanisha spread kumi na mbili, na pale jukwaa linapotoza kwa kila biashara, kamisheni kumi na mbili. Kwa kiasi kikubwa hii haina maana na kwa kidogo si hivyo. Mtu anayeeneza 3,000 katika ununuzi kumi na mbili wa kila mwezi wa 250 akiwa na malipo thabiti kwa kila biashara anaweza kupoteza asilimia yenye maana kwa gharama ambazo ununuzi mmoja ungeziepuka.

6bb458cafa28.en: A mechanism that makes adding to the transaction history require real computational effort (and therefore real electricity and money). Rewriting old history would require redoing all that work faster than the honest network adds new work — economically brutal, though not physically impossible. Lesson 3 covers how this actually operates.
6bb458cafa28.sw: Utaratibu unaofanya kuongeza katika historia ya miamala kuhitaji juhudi halisi ya kihesabu (na hivyo umeme halisi na pesa halisi). Kuandika upya historia ya zamani kungehitaji kurudia kazi hiyo yote kwa kasi zaidi kuliko mtandao mwaminifu unavyoongeza kazi mpya — ni kikatili kiuchumi, ingawa si haiwezekani kimwili. Somo la 3 hushughulikia jinsi hii inavyofanya kazi hasa.

6bbb357cbd5e.en: A stop-loss you decide on after you're already losing money is not risk management — it's hope with a delay. The entire value of a stop-loss comes from setting it before you enter, while you're still thinking clearly.
6bbb357cbd5e.sw: Stop-loss unayoiamua baada ya tayari kuanza kupoteza pesa si usimamizi wa hatari — ni matumaini yaliyochelewa. Thamani yote ya stop-loss inatokana na kuiweka kabla ya kuingia, ukiwa bado unafikiri kwa uwazi.

6bd71e1dafc3.en: Do not assume they always behave differently. There have been periods when bonds and equities fell together, and the assumption that one reliably cushions the other is a claim about a sample rather than a law. Chapter 6 returns to this with the evidence on what correlations do in the worst months.
6bd71e1dafc3.sw: Usidhani daima hutenda tofauti. Kumekuwa na vipindi ambapo hatifungani na hisa zilishuka pamoja, na dhana kwamba moja hulainisha nyingine kwa kutegemewa ni dai kuhusu sampuli badala ya sheria. Sura ya 6 hurudi kwenye hili kwa ushahidi wa uwiano hufanya nini katika miezi mibaya zaidi.

6bf49b5d3210.en: A major currency paired with the currency of a smaller or emerging economy — for example, USD/MXN, USD/TRY, or USD/ZAR.
6bf49b5d3210.sw: Sarafu kuu iliyowekwa pamoja na sarafu ya uchumi mdogo au unaoibukia — kwa mfano, USD/MXN, USD/TRY, au USD/ZAR.

6bf975e3be6f.en: You are not comparing an investment against alternatives. You are comparing a decision made now against a return that already happened to somebody else. The second is always more vivid, and it is never available.
6bf975e3be6f.sw: Hulinganishi uwekezaji dhidi ya mbadala. Unalinganisha uamuzi unaofanywa sasa dhidi ya faida ambayo tayari ilimtokea mtu mwingine. Ya pili daima ni hai zaidi, nayo haipatikani kamwe.

6c1d61a8c22b.en: The gap between bid and ask — a real cost paid when you trade, not billed separately.
6c1d61a8c22b.sw: Pengo kati ya bid na ask — gharama halisi inayolipwa unapofanya biashara, isiyotozwa tofauti.

6c1eeed92887.en: Users left smaller venues for the largest ones, on the reasonable theory that scale implies survival. The result is a market where a larger share of activity sits at fewer institutions than before. Chapter 5 Lesson 1 noted that liquidity concentrates for genuine reasons and that this concentration is what makes a single failure systemic. That structure did not change after FTX. It intensified.
6c1eeed92887.sw: Watumiaji waliacha viwanja vidogo kwenda vikubwa zaidi, kwa nadharia yenye mantiki kwamba ukubwa hudokeza kunusurika. Matokeo ni soko ambapo sehemu kubwa zaidi ya shughuli hukaa katika taasisi chache kuliko awali. Sura ya 5 Somo la 1 lilibainisha kwamba ukwasi hukusanyika kwa sababu halisi na kwamba ukusanyikaji huu ndicho kinachofanya kushindwa moja kuwa kwa kimfumo. Muundo huo haukubadilika baada ya FTX. Ulizidi.

6c2271fe360f.en: Correct — in a violent gap the stop-out can fill far from its level; the 2015 Swiss franc move pushed many accounts negative. That is why negative balance protection exists — the stop-out is a strong safeguard, not an absolute guarantee.
6c2271fe360f.sw: Sahihi — katika kuruka kwa nguvu stop-out inaweza kutimizwa mbali na kiwango chake; msogeo wa faranga ya Uswisi wa mwaka 2015 ulisukuma akaunti nyingi kuwa hasi. Ndiyo sababu ulinzi wa salio hasi upo — stop-out ni kinga imara, si uhakika kabisa.

6c2b8c68068e.en: The concern is not patriotism. It is that your salary, your house and your pension are already exposed to your national economy. Concentrating your equities there too stacks several bets on one outcome, and Chapter 3 covers why correlated bets are the ones that hurt.
6c2b8c68068e.sw: Wasiwasi si uzalendo. Ni kwamba mshahara wako, nyumba yako na pensheni yako tayari zimefunuliwa kwa uchumi wa taifa lako. Kujikita kwa hisa zako hapo pia hurundika mabashiri kadhaa juu ya tokeo moja, na Sura ya 3 inashughulikia kwa nini mabashiri yenye uwiano ndiyo yanayoumiza.

6c2ffc2bf10c.en: Correct - Shelton (2024) in the Journal of Risk and Financial Management found stock-to-flow helped explain returns in-sample but had limited to no ability to predict them out-of-sample, and Morillon and Chacon (2022) in Studies in Economics and Finance found that trading on a look-ahead-free version was far less profitable than buying and holding.
6c2ffc2bf10c.sw: Sahihi - Shelton (2024) katika Journal of Risk and Financial Management alibaini hisa-kwa-mtiririko ilisaidia kueleza faida ndani ya sampuli lakini ilikuwa na uwezo mdogo hadi hakuna wa kuzitabiri nje ya sampuli, na Morillon na Chacon (2022) katika Studies in Economics and Finance walibaini kwamba kufanya biashara juu ya toleo lisilo na kuangalia mbele lilikuwa na faida ndogo zaidi kuliko kununua na kushikilia.

6c64b73de484.en: Osler (2003), published in The Journal of Finance, examined the actual order books behind the market. Stop-loss and take-profit orders turned out to be strongly clustered at round numbers — almost 10 percent of all such orders sat at rates ending in "00," such as 1.1000. Those round numbers are exactly the levels traders draw as support and resistance. Take-profit orders bunched at a level push price back from it, which is why trends reverse at support and resistance. Stop-loss orders bunched just beyond it accelerate price once the level breaks, which is why a decisive break tends to run.
6c64b73de484.sw: Osler (2003), aliyechapisha katika The Journal of Finance, alichunguza vitabu halisi vya maagizo nyuma ya soko. Maagizo ya stop-loss na take-profit yaligundulika kujikusanya kwa nguvu kwenye namba za mviringo — karibu asilimia 10 ya maagizo yote hayo yalikaa kwenye viwango vinavyoishia kwa "00," kama 1.1000. Namba hizo za mviringo ni hasa viwango ambavyo wafanyabiashara huchora kama msaada na upinzani. Maagizo ya take-profit yaliyojikusanya kwenye kiwango husukuma bei kurudi kutoka kwake, ndiyo maana mielekeo hugeuka kwenye msaada na upinzani. Maagizo ya stop-loss yaliyojikusanya nje kidogo yake huharakisha bei mara kiwango kinapovunjika, ndiyo maana kuvunjika kwa uamuzi huelekea kukimbia.

6c66e0b51794.en: Correct. A stop order specifies a trigger, not a price. Once the level is reached it sends a market order, which fills at whatever the book offers — in a gap down, well below the stop level. This is the single most common misunderstanding about protective orders.
6c66e0b51794.sw: Sahihi. Agizo la stop hubainisha kianzishi, si bei. Mara kiwango kinapofikiwa hutuma agizo la soko, ambalo hutimizwa kwa chochote kitabu kinachotoa — katika kuruka chini, chini mno ya kiwango cha stop. Hili ndilo kutoelewana kunakojulikana zaidi kuhusu maagizo ya kinga.

6c6712ffb87d.en: Forex Chapter 4 Lesson 2 built a trading plan around expectancy: the average result of a repeated process rather than the outcome of any single trade. Everything in that lesson transfers. This one adds the part that is specific to an asset you can hold yourself, and therefore lose yourself.
6c6712ffb87d.sw: Forex Sura ya 4 Somo la 2 lilijenga mpango wa biashara kuzunguka matarajio: matokeo ya wastani ya mchakato unaorudiwa badala ya matokeo ya biashara yoyote moja. 6f9f5d3e6b83.en: On 10 October 2025, crypto markets ran the loop at record scale. The trigger was outside crypto: an announcement of new United States tariffs on Chinese imports set off cross-asset selling, and crypto entered that shock with open interest near record highs and heavily one-sided long positioning. The reported figures, from the derivatives data firm CoinGlass: roughly 19.1 to 19.5 billion dollars of leveraged positions liquidated within 24 hours, across roughly 1.62 million accounts, with longs approximately 85% to 90% of the total. That is the largest single-day liquidation total on record, more than twice the roughly 8 to 8.6 billion dollars liquidated on 19 May 2021, which had held the record until then. Sources disagree on bitcoin's exact intraday path, and it is worth saying so rather than picking the most dramatic number: reports place the fall at roughly 15% to 18% within hours, from a starting point variously given as about 122,000 to 126,300 dollars down to about 103,300 to 106,600 dollars. Smaller tokens fell far harder, with several major altcoins printing intraday falls in the 60% to 80% range. The depth collapse was the amplifier: analysis of exchange order books during the event found top-of-book depth on major venues falling by well over 90%, with bids reappearing only 4% and 10% away from the mid price. CoinDesk reported in November 2025 that depth remained well below early-October levels a month later.
6f9f5d3e6b83.sw: Tarehe 10 Oktoba 2025, masoko ya kripto yalikimbiza kitanzi kwa kiwango cha rekodi. Kichocheo kilikuwa nje ya kripto: tangazo la ushuru mpya wa Marekani juu ya bidhaa kutoka China lilianzisha uuzaji wa rasilimali mtambuka, na kripto iliingia katika mshtuko huo ikiwa na maslahi wazi karibu na rekodi za juu na msimamo mrefu wa upande mmoja mkali. Takwimu zilizoripotiwa, kutoka kampuni ya data ya viderivativi CoinGlass: takriban dola bilioni 19.1 hadi 19.5 za nafasi zenye mzingo zilifilisiwa ndani ya masaa 24, katika takriban akaunti milioni 1.62, huku warefu wakiwa takriban 85% hadi 90% ya jumla. Hiyo ndiyo jumla kubwa zaidi ya ufilisi ya siku moja iliyoandikwa, zaidi ya mara mbili ya takriban dola bilioni 8 hadi 8.6 zilizofilisiwa tarehe 19 Mei 2021, ambayo ilikuwa imeshikilia rekodi hadi wakati huo. Vyanzo havikubaliani kuhusu njia hasa ya bitcoin ndani ya siku, na inastahili kusema hivyo badala ya kuchagua namba ya kushtua zaidi: ripoti huweka kushuka katika takriban 15% hadi 18% ndani ya masaa, kutoka nukta ya kuanzia iliyotolewa kwa namna mbalimbali kama takriban dola 122,000 hadi 126,300 kushuka hadi takriban dola 103,300 hadi 106,600. Tokeni ndogo zaidi zilishuka kwa nguvu zaidi sana, huku altcoin kadhaa kuu zikichapisha kushuka ndani ya siku katika kiwango cha 60% hadi 80%. Kuporomoka kwa kina ndicho kilichokuwa kikuza: uchambuzi wa vitabu vya maagizo vya masoko wakati wa tukio ulibaini kina cha kilele cha kitabu katika viwanja vikuu kikishuka kwa zaidi ya 90%, huku zabuni zikijitokeza tena tu 4% na 10% mbali na bei ya katikati. 70b40ef6de02.en: What to look for before using either. Establish the maintenance requirement and calculate the exact price at which a call arrives, in advance and in writing. Establish the interest rate on the loan, which is charged whether the position works or not. For a short, establish the borrow fee and whether the shares are hard to borrow, which is a warning that a recall is more likely. And ask whether you would survive the position being closed for you at the worst moment, because that is the scenario both instruments are built to produce.

Kwa short, bainisha ada ya kukopa na kama hisa ni ngumu kukopa, ambako ni onyo kwamba kurudishwa kunawezekana zaidi. Na uliza kama ungenusurika nafasi kufungwa kwa niaba yako wakati mbaya zaidi, kwa sababu hiyo ndiyo hali ambayo vyombo vyote viwili vimejengwa kuizalisha.

70e0ee6b8cfe.en: A stop set at one-fifth of a normal day's movement is not a risk control. It is a coin flip with a fee attached. Ordinary noise — the movement that happens with no news, no trend, and no reason — will reach it, and reach it repeatedly. You have not reduced your risk. You have converted a position with a chance of working into a position that closes at a loss almost immediately, over and over, while paying spread and fees each time.
70e0ee6b8cfe.sw: Kusimamisha kulikowekwa katika sehemu moja ya tano ya msogeo wa siku ya kawaida si udhibiti wa hatari. Ni kurusha sarafu kukiwa na ada iliyoambatishwa. Kelele za kawaida — msogeo unaotokea bila habari, bila mwelekeo, na bila sababu — utakufikia, na kukufikia mara kwa mara. Hujapunguza hatari yako. Umegeuza nafasi yenye nafasi ya kufanya kazi kuwa nafasi inayofungwa kwa hasara karibu papo hapo, tena na tena, huku ukilipa mwanya na ada kila mara.

710dbf07191a.en: Aggregate open interest in perpetual futures, together with the funding rate, is a direct measurement of how much leverage is in the system and which way it leans. When open interest is elevated and funding has been persistently positive for a sustained period, the market is carrying crowded leveraged long positioning. That is not a prediction that prices will fall. It is a statement that the conditions for a liquidation cascade are present, and Chapter 3 Lesson 3 described what happens when one starts.

Wakati maslahi wazi yameinuka na ufadhili umekuwa chanya kwa kudumu kwa kipindi cha muda, soko linabeba msimamo mrefu wenye mzingo uliojaa. Hilo si utabiri kwamba bei zitashuka. 71570aef02eb.en: Your banking app works the same way, and you already trust it. The app on your phone contains no money. Delete the app, and your balance still exists at the bank. Reinstall and log in, and access returns. A crypto wallet is the same — with one enormous difference. At the bank, the referee from Lesson 1 keeps the master record and can restore your access. On a blockchain, there is no referee. The keys are the only access there is.

Sakinisha upya na uingie, na ufikiaji hurudi. Pochi ya kripto ni ileile — kwa tofauti moja kubwa mno. Katika benki, mwamuzi kutoka Somo la 1 hutunza rekodi kuu na anaweza kurejesha ufikiaji wako. Katika mnyororo wa vitalu, hakuna mwamuzi. Funguo ndio ufikiaji pekee uliopo.

The people who discover it was written down incorrectly discover it at the worst possible moment, and this exercise moves that discovery to a Tuesday afternoon.

71b56c767476.en: You have a 1,000 dollar account and you are willing to risk 1% of it, which is 10 dollars, on one idea. You have decided that a 5% adverse move in the asset would prove you wrong. Correct sizing: notional = 10 divided by 0.05 = 200 dollars. On a 1,000 dollar account that is effective leverage of 0.2x. You are using less than one times your capital. That is what a 1% risk budget with a 5% invalidation level actually produces in an asset this volatile, and it is why Chapter 3, Lesson 1 warned that crypto's volatility makes correct positions look uncomfortably small. Now the reverse. Suppose you open 50x instead: 50,000 dollars of notional on the same 1,000 dollar account. How far can the price move before you have lost your 10 dollar budget? 10 divided by 50,000 = 0.02%. Two hundredths of one percent. Your entire risk budget is consumed by the bid-ask spread and a moment of noise.
71b56c767476.sw: Una akaunti ya dola 1,000 nawe uko tayari kuweka hatarini 1% yake, ambayo ni dola 10, katika wazo moja. Umeamua kwamba msogeo mbaya wa 5% katika rasilimali ungethibitisha wewe si sahihi. Kupanga ukubwa sahihi: ya kinadharia = 10 ikigawanywa na 0.05 = dola 200. Katika akaunti ya dola 1,000 huo ni mzingo halisi wa 0.2x. Unatumia chini ya mara moja ya mtaji wako. Ndicho ambacho bajeti ya hatari ya 1% ikiwa na kiwango cha kubatilisha cha 5% huzalisha hasa katika rasilimali yenye mtikisiko huu, nayo ndiyo sababu Sura ya 3, Somo la 1 lilionya kwamba mtikisiko wa kripto hufanya nafasi sahihi zionekane ndogo kwa usumbufu. Sasa kinyume. Tuseme unafungua 50x badala yake: dola 50,000 za ya kinadharia katika akaunti ileile ya dola 1,000. Bei inaweza kusogea umbali gani kabla hujapoteza bajeti yako ya dola 10? 10 ikigawanywa na 50,000 = 0.02%. Sehemu mbili za mia za asilimia moja. Bajeti yako yote ya hatari hutumiwa na mwanya wa zabuni-na-bei ya kuuliza na wakati mmoja wa kelele.

71bb7e039680.en: The SEC published its Staff Report on Equity and Options Market Structure Conditions in Early 2021 on 18 October 2021. Examining the trade and order data directly, staff found that the price rise was driven mainly by buying from investors who did not hold short positions, and that short covering peaked and declined before the price reached its highest levels. The report concluded that neither a short squeeze nor a gamma squeeze was the primary cause of the rise. The explanation everyone repeats is the one the data does not support.
71bb7e039680.sw: SEC ilichapisha Staff Report on Equity and Options Market Structure Conditions in Early 2021 tarehe 18 Oktoba 2021. Wakichunguza data ya biashara na maagizo moja kwa moja, wafanyakazi walibaini kwamba kupanda kwa bei kuliendeshwa hasa na ununuzi kutoka kwa wawekezaji ambao hawakushikilia nafasi za uuzaji-mkopo, na kwamba kufunika uuzaji-mkopo kulifikia kilele na kupungua kabla bei haijafikia viwango vyake vya juu zaidi. Ripoti ilihitimisha kwamba wala mbano wa uuzaji-mkopo wala mbano wa gamma haukuwa chanzo kikuu cha kupanda. Maelezo ambayo kila mtu huyarudia ndiyo yale ambayo data haiyaungi mkono.

72f8ee8359ba.en: Three items inside a block matter for this lesson. First, the transactions — the actual ledger entries, who paid whom and how much. This is the cargo. Second, the hash of the previous block — a compact fingerprint of the block that came before, the link in the chain that does all the security work. Third, the nonce — a number with no meaning of its own, which exists only to be changed. To understand the last two, you need one tool first.
72f8ee8359ba.sw: Vitu vitatu ndani ya kitalu vina maana kwa somo hili. Kwanza, miamala — maingizo halisi ya leja, nani alimlipa nani na kiasi gani. Hii ndiyo mizigo. Pili, heshi ya kitalu kilichotangulia — alama ya vidole fupi ya kitalu kilichokuja kabla, kiungo katika mnyororo kinachofanya kazi yote ya usalama. Tatu, nonce — namba isiyo na maana yake yenyewe, iliyopo tu ili ibadilishwe. Kuelewa mbili za mwisho, unahitaji zana moja kwanza.

72fadeda5102.en: An exchange holding hundreds of thousands of customer bitcoin did not know what was in its own wallets. That is not sophisticated fraud or an advanced attack. It is an absence of the most basic control in custody, which is knowing what you are holding. The people trusting it with their savings could not have discovered this, because nothing they could see would have shown it.

Ni kukosekana kwa udhibiti wa msingi zaidi katika utunzaji, ambako ni kujua unachoshikilia. Watu waliolikabidhi akiba zao wasingeweza kugundua hili, kwa sababu hakuna walichoweza kukiona kingekionyesha.

Mtumiaji anayeshikilia 20 zilezile katika soko la kubadilisha kwa sababu hapo ndipo alipozinunua alipoteza kila kitu. Hakuna mtumiaji aliyejua chochote ambacho mwingine hakujua. At the top of a cycle, earnings are at their highest, so the P/E is at its lowest, and the shares look cheap immediately before earnings collapse. At the bottom, earnings are minimal and the P/E is enormous or undefined, which is often the better moment to buy.

Katika kilele cha mzunguko, mapato yako juu zaidi, hivyo P/E iko chini zaidi, na hisa zinaonekana nafuu mara moja kabla mapato hayajaanguka. Chini, mapato ni madogo mno na P/E ni kubwa mno au haifafanuliki, ambako mara nyingi ndio wakati bora zaidi wa kununua.

73797dcd17c3.en: Standard deviation of returns is the right idea, but it is awkward to compute on a chart. Traders use a simpler measure built for exactly this job, and it is older than crypto by three decades. J. Welles Wilder Jr. introduced it in his book New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems, published by Trend Research in Greensboro, North Carolina, in 1978 — the same book that introduced the Relative Strength Index you met in Forex Chapter 2, Lesson 2, and the Average Directional Index. Wilder was writing about commodity futures, which gap between sessions, so he needed a range measure that did not ignore the gap.
73797dcd17c3.sw: Mkengeuko wa kawaida wa faida ni wazo sahihi, lakini ni gumu kuhesabu kwenye chati. Wafanyabiashara hutumia kipimo rahisi zaidi kilichojengwa kwa kazi hii hasa, nacho ni cha zamani zaidi ya kripto kwa miongo mitatu. J. Welles Wilder Jr. alikianzisha katika kitabu chake New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems, kilichochapishwa na Trend Research huko Greensboro, North Carolina, mwaka 1978 — kitabu kilekile kilichoanzisha Relative Strength Index uliyokutana nayo katika Forex Sura ya 2, Somo la 2, na Average Directional Index. Wilder alikuwa akiandika kuhusu mikataba ya baadaye ya bidhaa, ambayo hupata mapengo kati ya vipindi, kwa hivyo alihitaji kipimo cha kiwango kisichopuuza pengo.

Lilifanya mambo kinyume kwa watu wawili.

That the reserve would be replenished by growth. That the founders were credible and well-funded. That an enormous amount of capital was already committed, so it could not simply be wrong. Each of these is a reason to believe rather than an answer to the question, and the question was where does the money come from.

Kwamba kiasi kikubwa mno cha mtaji kilikuwa tayari kimeahidiwa, kwa hivyo hakingeweza kuwa si sahihi tu. It says the system is secure "as long as a majority of CPU power is controlled by nodes that are not cooperating to attack the network." That is a stated assumption, not a guarantee. If an attacker ever controlled most of the network's computing power, the protections weaken — Lesson 3 covers this as the 51% attack.

Inasema mfumo ni salama "as long as a majority of CPU power is controlled by nodes that are not cooperating to attack the network." Hiyo ni dhana iliyotajwa, si hakikisho. Ikiwa mshambuliaji atawahi kudhibiti nguvu nyingi za kihesabu za mtandao, ulinzi hudhoofika — Somo la 3 hushughulikia hili kama shambulizi la 51%.

Critics had been making the structural argument for over a year while the system grew, and anyone who acted on that argument early watched it appear wrong for a long time. Being right about a mechanism and being right about a date are different skills, and only one of them is available. That is precisely why the response taught in this course is sizing rather than timing.

Wakosoaji walikuwa wakitoa hoja ya kimuundo kwa zaidi ya mwaka huku mfumo ukikua, na yeyote aliyetenda juu ya hoja hiyo mapema aliiona ikionekana si sahihi kwa muda mrefu. Kuwa sahihi kuhusu utaratibu na kuwa sahihi kuhusu tarehe ni ujuzi tofauti, na ni mmoja tu kati yake unaopatikana. 747e1513bb25.en: Depegs happen even to the biggest, best-run coins. In March 2023, Circle disclosed that 3.3 billion dollars of USDC's reserves — about 8 percent — were stuck in the just-collapsed Silicon Valley Bank. USDC, the transparency leader among fiat-backed coins, traded down to roughly 0.87-0.88 dollars that weekend. It recovered its peg within days, after US regulators guaranteed SVB's deposits. Read that carefully: the peg was restored by the reserve being made whole — the mechanism working — not by faith. Holders who panic-sold at 0.88 took a real loss on a coin that was, in fact, money-good. Knowing the mechanism is what tells you which depegs are survivable.
747e1513bb25.sw: Kuvunjika kwa pegi hutokea hata kwa sarafu kubwa zaidi, zinazoendeshwa vizuri zaidi. Mwezi Machi 2023, Circle ilifichua kwamba dola bilioni 3.3 za akiba za USDC — takriban asilimia 8 — zilikuwa zimekwama katika Silicon Valley Bank iliyokuwa imeanguka hivi karibuni. USDC, kiongozi wa uwazi kati ya sarafu zinazoungwa mkono na fedha za amri, ilifanyiwa biashara hadi takriban dola 0.87-0.88 wikendi hiyo. Ilirejesha pegi yake ndani ya siku, baada ya wadhibiti wa Marekani kuhakikisha amana za SVB. Soma hilo kwa uangalifu: pegi ilirejeshwa kwa akiba kufanywa kamili — utaratibu ukifanya kazi — si kwa imani. Wamiliki waliouza kwa hofu katika 0.88 walichukua hasara halisi katika sarafu ambayo, kwa kweli, ilikuwa nzuri kifedha. Kujua utaratibu ndicho kinachokuambia ni kuvunjika kupi kwa pegi kunanusurika.

7497f6d0cb58.en: Correct. No decision was taken; the market took it. This is position drift, and it is why keeping a limit requires periodic action rather than a single choice at purchase. Chapter 4 turns that action into a rebalancing band so it is governed by a rule written in advance.

Huku ni kupotea kwa nafasi, na ndiyo sababu kuweka kikomo kunahitaji hatua ya mara kwa mara badala ya chaguo moja wakati wa kununua. Sura ya 4 hugeuza hatua hiyo kuwa ukanda wa kusawazisha ili iongozwe na kanuni iliyoandikwa mapema.

756d572cdf47.en: Look closely at that example, because it demonstrates three things at once. Two of the most respected firms in the industry read the same public ledger and reached opposite conclusions about what had happened. The disagreement was not about arithmetic — it was about attribution, which is inference. And the market moved billions of dollars on the interpretation before the disagreement was resolved.

Kampuni mbili zinazoheshimika zaidi katika tasnia zilisoma leja ileile ya umma na zikafikia hitimisho zinazopingana kuhusu kilichotokea. Kutokubaliana hakukuwa kuhusu hesabu — kulikuwa kuhusu kuhusisha, ambako ni kukisia. Na soko lilisogeza mabilioni ya dola juu ya tafsiri kabla kutokubaliana hakujatatuliwa.

75a305f99cb4.en: Be honest about the limit: no one eliminates fear and greed, professionals included. Aim for a process that does not depend on you being calm at the worst possible moment.

75f9aa4ab0fc.en: Caginalp and Laurent (1998), in Applied Mathematical Finance, tested candlestick reversal patterns on S&P 500 stocks from 1992 to 1996 and found them profitable — a return of roughly 0.9 percent over a two-day holding period, a result they reported as strongly significant. Eight years later, Marshall, Young and Rose (2006), in the Journal of Banking & Finance, tested candlestick strategies on Dow Jones stocks over 1992 to 2001 using a bootstrap method and found no value at all.
75f9aa4ab0fc.sw: Caginalp na Laurent (1998), katika Applied Mathematical Finance, walijaribu mitindo ya mgeuko ya mishumaa kwenye hisa za S&P 500 kutoka 1992 hadi 1996 na wakaipata yenye faida — faida ya takriban asilimia 0.9 katika kipindi cha kushikilia cha siku mbili, tokeo walilolieleza kama lenye maana kubwa. Miaka minane baadaye, Marshall, Young na Rose (2006), katika Journal of Banking & Finance, walijaribu mikakati ya mishumaa kwenye hisa za Dow Jones kwa 1992 hadi 2001 wakitumia mbinu ya bootstrap na hawakupata thamani yoyote kabisa.

7637ae44307d.en: This is not theoretical — on smaller chains it has happened repeatedly, because a small PoW chain can be attacked by renting hashpower by the hour. Ethereum Classic, a small PoW network, suffered three separate 51% attacks in August 2020 alone. In the second, over 5-6 August 2020, the attacker reorganized 4,236 blocks — over 15 hours of the chain's history — and double-spent about $1.7 million of ETC, using hashpower rented through a commercial marketplace. Bitcoin Gold, in May 2018, lost around $18 million to 51% double-spend attacks aimed at exchanges. Note the pattern in both cases: the victims were exchanges that credited deposits after too few confirmations — not ordinary wallet holders, whose coins the attackers had no way to touch.
7637ae44307d.sw: Hili si la kinadharia — katika minyororo midogo limetokea mara kwa mara, kwa sababu mnyororo mdogo wa PoW unaweza kushambuliwa kwa kukodisha nguvu ya heshi kwa saa. Ethereum Classic, mtandao mdogo wa PoW, ilipatwa na mashambulizi matatu tofauti ya 51% mwezi Agosti 2020 pekee. Katika la pili, tarehe 5-6 Agosti 2020, mshambuliaji alipanga upya vitalu 4,236 — zaidi ya masaa 15 ya historia ya mnyororo — na kutumia-mara-mbili takriban $1.7 milioni za ETC, akitumia nguvu ya heshi iliyokodishwa kupitia soko la kibiashara. Bitcoin Gold, mwezi Mei 2018, ilipoteza takriban $18 milioni kwa mashambulizi ya kutumia-mara-mbili ya 51% yaliyolenga masoko ya kubadilisha. Tambua muundo katika matukio yote mawili: waathiriwa walikuwa masoko ya kubadilisha yaliyoweka amana katika akaunti baada ya uthibitisho mchache mno — si wamiliki wa kawaida wa pochi, ambao sarafu zao washambuliaji hawakuwa na njia ya kuzigusa.

763ad1b7bbdf.en: Cross-source figures for the same metric are not comparable. Providers use different address label sets, different clustering rules, different exchange coverage, and different proprietary adjustments. Two exchange-balance charts that disagree are not evidence that one is lying. They are evidence that you are looking at two different estimates of an unobservable quantity. Never combine numbers from two providers in the same comparison, and always name the provider when you cite a figure.
763ad1b7bbdf.sw: Takwimu za vyanzo mtambuka za kipimo kilekile hazilinganishiki. Watoa data hutumia seti tofauti za lebo za anwani, kanuni tofauti za kukusanya makundi, ufunikaji tofauti wa masoko ya kubadilisha, na marekebisho tofauti ya kimiliki. Chati mbili za salio la soko la kubadilisha zisizokubaliana si ushahidi kwamba moja inadanganya. Ni ushahidi kwamba unatazama makadirio mawili tofauti ya kiasi kisichoweza kuonekana. Usichanganye kamwe namba kutoka watoa data wawili katika ulinganisho uleule, na daima taja mtoa data unaponukuu takwimu.

7664146f436a.en: That negative correlation is why the value pillar and the momentum pillar so often point opposite ways. A cheap share is usually cheap because it has been falling. When valuation and momentum both point the same way, that is genuinely rare and worth noticing — but check first that they are two independent readings rather than the same story counted twice.

Tathmini na kasi zinapoelekeza upande mmoja, hiyo ni nadra kweli na inastahili kutambuliwa — lakini kagua kwanza kwamba ni usomaji miwili huru badala ya hadithi ileile ikihesabiwa mara mbili.

767cc7cf4a29.en: What to look for when reviewing your own plan a year later. Check whether you did what it says, and where you did not, whether the deviation improved anything. Check whether any rule turned out to be unusable in practice, since a rule you cannot follow is worse than no rule because it teaches you to ignore the document. And check whether your circumstances have changed, which is the only legitimate reason to change the plan itself.

76a7726f39c8.en: Share price on its own says nothing about the size of a company. A company can halve its share price tomorrow by splitting its shares two-for-one, without anything about the business changing. In a price-weighted index that split permanently reduces the company's influence. This is why price weighting is generally regarded as a historical artefact rather than a good design — it was easy to compute in 1896, when the arithmetic was done by hand.
76a7726f39c8.sw: Bei ya hisa peke yake haisemi chochote kuhusu ukubwa wa kampuni. Katika index yenye uzito wa bei mgawanyo huo hupunguza kabisa ushawishi wa kampuni. Ndiyo sababu uzito wa bei kwa ujumla huchukuliwa kama mabaki ya kihistoria badala ya muundo mzuri — ulikuwa rahisi kukokotoa mwaka 1896, hesabu ilipofanywa kwa mkono.

76cc20deb978.en:
On 2 November 2022, CoinDesk published a report on the balance sheet of Alameda Research, the trading firm affiliated with FTX. It showed a very large position in FTT, the token FTX itself had issued.
On 6 November 2022, Binance announced it would sell its holdings of FTT.
Within about 72 hours, roughly 5 billion dollars of withdrawal requests arrived at FTX.
On 8 November 2022, Binance said it would buy FTX. On 9 November it withdrew.
On 11 November 2022, FTX filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the United States.
The shortfall was around 8 billion dollars: about 9 billion of liabilities against roughly 900 million of assets that could readily be sold.
76cc20deb978.sw:
Tarehe 2 Novemba 2022, CoinDesk ilichapisha ripoti juu ya karatasi ya salio ya Alameda Research, kampuni ya biashara iliyoshirikiana na FTX. Ilionyesha nafasi kubwa sana katika FTT, tokeni ambayo FTX yenyewe ilikuwa imeitoa.
Tarehe 6 Novemba 2022, Binance ilitangaza itauza umiliki wake wa FTT.
Ndani ya takriban masaa 72, takriban dola bilioni 5 za maombi ya utoaji zilifika FTX.
Tarehe 8 Novemba 2022, Binance ilisema ingeinunua FTX. Tarehe 9 Novemba ilijiondoa.
Tarehe 11 Novemba 2022, FTX iliwasilisha ombi la ulinzi wa kufilisika wa Chapter 11 nchini Marekani.
Upungufu ulikuwa takriban dola bilioni 8: takriban bilioni 9 za madeni dhidi ya takriban milioni 900 za rasilimali ambazo zingeweza kuuzwa kwa urahisi.

76d9d3c1aafc.en: 2022 was not a hypothetical. It was the exact scenario the marketing described, and the results are on the record. Inflation arrived. United States consumer prices rose 9.1% over the 12 months ending June 2022, the largest 12-month increase since the period ending November 1981, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. If a capped-supply asset protects you from inflation, this was the moment.

Ikiwa rasilimali yenye dari ya usambazaji hukulinda dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei, huu ndio ulikuwa wakati.

7798b5294222.en: Watch the move in that last sentence, because you will see it again everywhere. A model made a falsifiable prediction. The prediction failed. 77af9feda9e8.en: Bitcoin's software rules started the reward for adding a block of transactions at 50 bitcoins and cut it in half every 210,000 blocks — roughly every four years. Add up that shrinking series and you get a hard ceiling of just under 21 million coins (20,999,999.98, to be precise), with new issuance ending around the year 2140. Every computer on the network enforces this: a block that tries to create extra coins is rejected as invalid.
77af9feda9e8.sw: Kanuni za programu za Bitcoin zilianzisha zawadi ya kuongeza kitalu cha miamala katika bitcoin 50 na kuipunguza nusu kila vitalu 210,000 — takriban kila miaka minne. Jumlisha msururu huo unaopungua na unapata dari ngumu ya chini kidogo ya sarafu milioni 21 (20,999,999.98, kwa usahihi), huku utoaji mpya ukiisha karibu mwaka 2140. Kila kompyuta katika mtandao hutekeleza hili: kitalu kinachojaribu kuunda sarafu za ziada hukataliwa kama batili.

7804e52661b1.en: First, the boundary. Security risk means attacks aimed at your access: your keys, your accounts, your devices, your phone number. It is not the same thing as investment fraud, meaning the fake project, the guaranteed-yield scheme, the rug pull. Those are attacks on your judgment rather than your access, and Chapter 4 Lesson 2 handles them as a separate skill. The two overlap at the edges, and both end with your money gone. But the defences are different, so the lessons are separate.

Hayo ni mashambulizi juu ya hukumu yako badala ya ufikiaji wako, na Sura ya 4 Somo la 2 huyashughulikia kama ujuzi tofauti. Hayo mawili huingiliana kwenye kingo, na yote huishia kwa pesa yako kuondoka. Lakini ulinzi ni tofauti, kwa hivyo masomo ni tofauti.

7862d0324ad6.en: The defences here are physical and boring, which is why people skip them. Verify the address on your hardware wallet's own screen, not on the computer's, because that is the entire reason the device has a screen: malware can control what your computer displays, but it cannot control what the signing device displays, and if the two disagree the device is right and you should stop. Check the middle of the address, not only the ends, since checking the first and last four characters is exactly the check that address poisoning is built to pass. Send a small test transaction first whenever the amount matters, and wait for it to confirm before sending the rest. Never copy an address out of your own transaction history; get it from the recipient, or from the exchange's deposit page, each time.
7862d0324ad6.sw: Ulinzi hapa ni wa kimwili na wa kuchosha, ndiyo maana watu huuruka. Thibitisha anwani katika skrini ya pochi yako ya maunzi yenyewe, si katika ya kompyuta, kwa sababu hiyo ndiyo sababu nzima kifaa kina skrini: programu hasidi inaweza kudhibiti kile kompyuta yako inachoonyesha, lakini haiwezi kudhibiti kile kifaa cha kutia sahihi kinachoonyesha, na ikiwa vyote viwili havikubaliani kifaa kiko sahihi nawe unapaswa kusimama. Kagua katikati ya anwani, si ncha pekee, kwa kuwa kukagua herufi nne za kwanza na za mwisho ndio hasa ukaguzi ambao utiaji sumu wa anwani umejengwa kuupita. Tuma muamala mdogo wa majaribio kwanza wakati wowote kiasi kinapokuwa na maana, na usubiri uthibitishwe kabla ya kutuma kilichobaki. Usinakili kamwe anwani kutoka historia yako mwenyewe ya miamala; ipate kutoka mpokeaji, au kutoka ukurasa wa amana wa soko la kubadilisha, kila mara.

7867d80e535d.en: The position sizing formula worked through step by step, turning account size, risk percentage, and stop-loss into an exact lot size.
7867d80e535d.sw: Fomula ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi ikipitiwa hatua kwa hatua, ikigeuza ukubwa wa akaunti, asilimia ya hatari, na stop-loss kuwa ukubwa kamili wa lot.

788c21583ddf.en: True or False: according to Glosten and Milgrom's (1985) research, bid-ask spreads exist purely because market makers want to profit, with no other cause.
788c21583ddf.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kwa mujibu wa utafiti wa Glosten na Milgrom (1985), spread za bid-ask zipo kwa sababu tu watengeneza-soko wanataka faida, bila sababu nyingine yoyote.

788cce92834c.en: Crypto Chapter 2, Lesson 2 gives you the reason this matters more here than in forex. Bitcoin has recorded three peak-to-trough falls above 70%, reported at roughly 84% to 87%, 83% to 84%, and 77% to 78%. An asset that has done that three times is an asset your position size has to be able to survive, not one your position size can afford to be brave about.
788cce92834c.sw: Kripto Sura ya 2, Somo la 2 hukupa sababu hii ina maana zaidi hapa kuliko katika forex. Bitcoin imeandika kushuka kutatu kutoka kileleni hadi bondeni juu ya 70%, kukiripotiwa katika takriban 84% hadi 87%, 83% hadi 84%, na 77% hadi 78%. Rasilimali iliyofanya hivyo mara tatu ni rasilimali ambayo ukubwa wa nafasi yako lazima uweze kuinusurika, si ambayo ukubwa wa nafasi yako unaweza kumudu kuwa jasiri kuihusu.

78a472b7e3b1.en: Notice what the example shows: on an AMM, your own trade moves the price, and it moves it more the larger your trade is relative to the pool. This price impact is the AMM version of a familiar idea — slippage, the gap between the price you expected and the price you got, which the forex track defines in Chapter 1, Lesson 7. On a DEX the interface shows you the estimated impact before you sign, and lets you set a maximum slippage you will tolerate. Look at that number every single time. Against a small pool, a trade that looks routine can cost you double-digit percentages.
78a472b7e3b1.sw: Tambua mfano huonyesha nini: katika AMM, biashara yako mwenyewe husogeza bei, nayo huisogeza zaidi kadiri biashara yako inavyokuwa kubwa ikilinganishwa na bwawa. Athari hii ya bei ni toleo la AMM la wazo linalojulikana — mtelezo, pengo kati ya bei uliyotarajia na bei uliyoipata, ambalo njia ya forex huifafanua katika Sura ya 1, Somo la 7. Katika DEX kiolesura hukuonyesha athari inayokadiriwa kabla ya kutia sahihi, na hukuruhusu kuweka mtelezo wa juu kabisa utakaovumilia. Angalia namba hiyo kila mara bila kukosa. Dhidi ya bwawa dogo, biashara inayoonekana ya kawaida inaweza kukugharimu asilimia za tarakimu mbili.

78b32c3a611b.en: Correct — USD is listed first, making it the base; JPY is the quote, meaning one US dollar costs 149.50 yen.
78b32c3a611b.sw: Sahihi — USD imeorodheshwa kwanza, jambo linaloifanya kuwa msingi; JPY ni bei, ikimaanisha dola moja ya Marekani inagharimu yen 149.50.

78b893e9bcb7.en: Investing a fixed amount at regular intervals.
78b893e9bcb7.sw: Kuwekeza kiasi thabiti kwa vipindi vya kawaida.

78c2f678716f.en: Open any crypto price site. The first column is price. The second is almost always market capitalization, and coins are ranked by it. It is the number that decides whether something is called a large cap or a small cap, and the number most people use to decide whether an asset is still early. Almost nobody who quotes it can say what it actually measures.
78c2f678716f.sw: Fungua tovuti yoyote ya bei za kripto. Safu ya kwanza ni bei. Ya pili karibu daima ni kiasi cha soko, na sarafu hupangwa kwacho. Ni namba inayoamua kama kitu kinaitwa kiasi kikubwa au kiasi kidogo, na namba ambayo watu wengi huitumia kuamua kama rasilimali bado iko mapema. Karibu hakuna anayeinukuu anayeweza kusema hupima nini hasa.

78ce8074f47a.en: None of this makes shares safe. Foundations Chapter 2 made the point that being right often is not the same as trading well, and it holds here: the positive-sum nature of ownership is a statement about the long run and about diversified baskets, not a promise about any single company or any single year.
78ce8074f47a.sw: Hakuna kati ya haya kinachofanya hisa kuwa salama. Sura ya 2 ya Msingi ilitoa pointi kwamba kuwa sahihi mara nyingi si sawa na kufanya biashara vizuri, na hushikilia hapa: hali ya jumla-chanya ya umiliki ni kauli kuhusu muda mrefu na kuhusu vikapu vilivyosambazwa, si ahadi kuhusu kampuni yoyote moja au mwaka wowote mmoja.

78cfb8aa6384.en: What makes this case different from the Swiss franc shock is that there was no single dramatic announcement behind it. No central bank moved. No headline number was released. A currency of a major economy simply lost a large fraction of its value in minutes and then partly reappeared, in a market that is supposed to be the most liquid on earth.
78cfb8aa6384.sw: Kinachofanya kesi hii kuwa tofauti na mshtuko wa faranga ya Uswisi ni kwamba hakukuwa na tangazo moja la kushtua nyuma yake. Hakuna benki kuu iliyosogea. Hakuna namba ya kichwa cha habari iliyotolewa. Sarafu ya uchumi mkubwa ilipoteza tu sehemu kubwa ya thamani yake ndani ya dakika chache na kisha ikajitokeza tena kwa sehemu, katika soko linalopaswa kuwa lenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi duniani.

78d49bb2c0d7.en: That the rise was caused entirely by the brokerage trading restrictions
78d49bb2c0d7.sw: Kwamba kupanda kulisababishwa kabisa na vizuizi vya biashara vya madalali

78d6436217b8.en: That the balance does not exist — a genuine platform would deduct any fee from the balance it holds, so requiring outside money to release it is proof the money is not there
78d6436217b8.sw: Kwamba salio halipo — jukwaa halisi lingekata ada yoyote kutoka salio linaloshikilia, kwa hivyo kuhitaji pesa ya nje kulitoa ni uthibitisho kwamba pesa haipo

791634ab4748.en: Every lesson in this chapter so far has added a tool on top of the chart: moving averages, MACD, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Fibonacci levels. Price action trading goes the other way. It strips all of that off and reads the raw price movement directly.
791634ab4748.sw: Kila somo katika sura hii hadi sasa limeongeza zana juu ya chati: wastani unaosogea, MACD, Bollinger Bands, RSI, viwango vya Fibonacci. Biashara ya shughuli ya bei huenda njia nyingine. Huvua vyote hivyo na kusoma msogeo ghafi wa bei moja kwa moja.

79201fc29347.en: Finally, no fund tracks its index exactly. Fees, trading costs, and the timing of dividends all cause small gaps.
79201fc29347.sw: Hatimaye, hakuna fund inayofuatilia index yake hasa. Ada, gharama za biashara, na muda wa gawio vyote husababisha mapengo madogo.

792d5753a1cf.en: The bid, the ask, and the spread between them — and how the pip shifts decimal place for yen pairs.
792d5753a1cf.sw: Bid, ask, na spread iliyo kati yao — na jinsi pip inavyohamisha nafasi ya desimali kwa jozi za yen.

792ea0437704.en: Self-custody moves the failure mode from counterparty risk to you. That is usually the better trade, and it is not a free one. A recovery phrase written on paper can be lost, destroyed, photographed, or found. The plan needs to say where it is, how many copies exist, where they are, and what physically happens to them in a fire or a flood.
792ea0437704.sw: Utunzaji binafsi husogeza namna ya kushindwa kutoka hatari ya mshirika hadi kwako. Hiyo kwa kawaida ndiyo maafikiano bora, nayo si ya bure. Kifungu cha urejeshaji kilichoandikwa kwenye karatasi kinaweza kupotea, kuharibiwa, kupigwa picha, au kupatikana. Mpango unahitaji kusema kiko wapi, nakala ngapi zipo, ziko wapi, na nini kinawatokea kimwili katika moto au mafuriko.

79347fb4c5b4.en: An instruction to trade only at a stated price or better. Certain in price, uncertain whether it executes at all.
79347fb4c5b4.sw: Maelekezo ya kufanya biashara kwa bei iliyotajwa au bora zaidi tu. Ya uhakika kwa bei, isiyo na uhakika kama itatekelezwa kabisa.

7949df718297.en: Something that holds its purchasing power over time.
7949df718297.sw: Kitu kinachoshikilia uwezo wake wa kununua kwa muda.

796eab360467.en: Recent history has made the point without any help from this lesson. Bitcoin reached an all-time high near 126,000 dollars on 6 October 2025, inside the 12-to-18-month window, and therefore read by many as the cycle holding. Through the first half of 2026 it fell to the low 60-thousands, more than half off that peak. As this lesson is written in late July 2026, prominent analysts publicly disagree about whether the four-year cycle is intact, stretched or finished. That disagreement is not a failure of the analysts. It is what a genuinely small sample looks like from the inside.
796eab360467.sw: Historia ya hivi karibuni imetoa hoja bila msaada wowote kutoka somo hili. Bitcoin ilifikia kilele cha wakati wote karibu na dola 126,000 tarehe 6 Oktoba 2025, ndani ya dirisha la miezi 12-hadi-18, na hivyo ikasomwa na wengi kama mzunguko ukishikilia. Katika nusu ya kwanza ya 2026 ilishuka hadi elfu 60 za chini, zaidi ya nusu chini ya kilele hicho. Somo hili linapoandikwa mwishoni mwa Julai 2026, wachambuzi mashuhuri hawakubaliani hadharani kuhusu kama mzunguko wa miaka minne uko sawa, umenyooshwa au umeisha. Kutokubaliana huko si kushindwa kwa wachambuzi. Ndivyo sampuli ndogo kweli inavyoonekana kutoka ndani.

796ebeed6194.en: That the shares became more expensive as the business improved
796ebeed6194.sw: Kwamba hisa zikawa ghali zaidi biashara ilipoboreka

79794b1181c2.en: Because it averages a population where most people do very little and a minority trade heavily, describing neither group
79794b1181c2.sw: Kwa sababu inachukua wastani wa idadi ya watu ambapo wengi hufanya kidogo mno na wachache hufanya biashara kwa wingi, bila kuelezea kundi lolote

797ed1331efa.en: Carry these forward: For any pair pinned by a central bank policy (a peg or a floor), remember that "it cannot move past here" is a promise that can be withdrawn without notice. Never assume a stop-loss guarantees your exit price — it guarantees a trigger, not a fill, and in a gap the two can be far apart. Size every position so that a violent gap through your stop is a survivable loss, not an account-ending one. And confirm your broker offers negative balance protection, but treat it as a backstop, never as permission to size larger.
797ed1331efa.sw: Beba haya mbele: Kwa jozi lolote lililobanwa na sera ya benki kuu (kufungwa au sakafu), kumbuka kwamba "haiwezi kusogea zaidi ya hapa" ni ahadi inayoweza kuondolewa bila taarifa. Kamwe usidhani stop-loss inahakikisha bei yako ya kutoka — inahakikisha kianzishi, si kutimizwa, na katika kuruka hizo mbili zinaweza kuwa mbali sana. Pima kila nafasi ili kuruka kwa nguvu kupitia stop yako kuwe hasara inayoweza kunusurika, si inayomaliza akaunti. Na thibitisha broker wako anatoa ulinzi wa salio hasi, lakini uchukulie kama kizuizi, kamwe si ruhusa ya kupima kubwa zaidi.

79a8694a3841.en: That the platform is complying with tax law and the payment is normal
79a8694a3841.sw: Kwamba jukwaa linafuata sheria ya kodi na malipo ni ya kawaida

79e06d53221a.en: What to look for before acting on any crypto thesis. Check that each pillar rests on different evidence rather than on the same price move. Check that the valuation pillar has been replaced by supply arithmetic rather than quietly filled with a narrative. Check that any carry is funded by fees rather than issuance. And write down what would falsify the thesis, with a date, because a thesis that cannot be wrong cannot teach you anything.
79e06d53221a.sw: Cha kuangalia kabla ya kutenda juu ya nadharia yoyote ya kripto. Kagua kwamba kila nguzo inasimama juu ya ushahidi tofauti badala ya juu ya msogeo uleule wa bei. Kagua kwamba nguzo ya tathmini imebadilishwa na hesabu ya usambazaji badala ya kujazwa kimya kimya na simulizi. Kagua kwamba kubeba kokote hufadhiliwa na ada badala ya utoaji. Na andika kitakachokanusha nadharia, kikiwa na tarehe, kwa sababu nadharia isiyoweza kuwa si sahihi haiwezi kukufundisha lolote.

79e884aa14c0.en: Before entering, run these checks: Can you state the trade's risk-to-reward ratio as a number, from a real stop price and a real target price? Does that ratio clear its break-even win rate with room to spare, given a win rate you can honestly expect rather than a hoped-for one? Are your stop and target placed at meaningful levels — invalidation, support, resistance — or chosen to manufacture a nice-looking ratio? And do you ever widen a stop or pull in a target mid-trade? That is the ratio quietly collapsing, the one habit this lesson most wants you to catch.
79e884aa14c0.sw: Kabla ya kuingia, fanya ukaguzi huu: Je, unaweza kutamka uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo wa biashara kama namba, kutoka bei halisi ya stop na bei halisi ya lengo? Je, uwiano huo unapita kiwango chake cha ushindi cha kulingana kwa nafasi ya ziada, kwa kuzingatia kiwango cha ushindi unachoweza kukitarajia kwa uaminifu badala ya kile unachokitumaini? Je, stop na lengo lako vimewekwa kwenye viwango vyenye maana — kuvunjika, msaada, upinzani — au vimechaguliwa kutengeneza uwiano unaoonekana mzuri? Na je, unawahi kupanua stop au kuvuta lengo karibu katikati ya biashara? Huo ni uwiano ukiporomoka kimyakimya, tabia moja ambayo somo hili linataka zaidi ukamate.

7a01757d355d.en: According to the Bank for International Settlements' 2025 Triennial Survey — the definitive, authoritative measurement of global currency trading — the U.S. dollar was on one side of 89% of all FX trades. The euro was second at 28.9%. That works out to the dollar being traded roughly three times more than the euro — a real, current, precisely sourced number, not a rough guess.
7a01757d355d.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Utafiti wa Kila Miaka Mitatu wa mwaka 2025 wa Benki ya Malipo ya Kimataifa — kipimo cha uhakika na chenye mamlaka cha biashara ya sarafu duniani — dola ya Marekani ilikuwa upande mmoja wa 89% ya biashara zote za FX. Euro ilikuwa ya pili kwa 28.9%. Hilo linatokea kuwa dola inafanyiwa biashara takriban mara tatu zaidi ya euro — namba halisi, ya sasa, yenye chanzo sahihi, si kadirio la jumla.

7a0600515b84.en: The software half: on 14 December 2023, an attacker obtained access to the software-publishing account of the hardware-wallet manufacturer Ledger, through a phishing attack on a former employee, and published malicious versions of a widely used code library. Sites that included that library, several well-known decentralized exchanges and, with some irony, an approval-revoking tool, began serving a wallet drainer to their own users. The malicious file was live for around five hours. Reported losses were roughly 600,000 dollars, with early estimates varying as the incident was traced. The users affected had done nothing wrong. They visited sites they had used many times before.
7a0600515b84.sw: Nusu ya programu: tarehe 14 Desemba 2023, mshambuliaji alipata ufikiaji wa akaunti ya kuchapisha programu ya mtengenezaji wa pochi za maunzi Ledger, kupitia shambulizi la uvuvi kwa mfanyakazi wa zamani, na akachapisha matoleo hasidi ya maktaba ya msimbo inayotumika sana. Tovuti zilizojumuisha maktaba hiyo, masoko kadhaa yanayojulikana yasiyo na kituo kikuu na, kwa kejeli fulani, zana ya kubatilisha idhini, zilianza kuwahudumia watumiaji wao kimwaga pochi. Faili hasidi lilikuwa hai kwa takriban masaa matano. Hasara zilizoripotiwa zilikuwa takriban dola 600,000, huku makadirio ya awali yakitofautiana kadiri tukio lilivyofuatiliwa. Watumiaji walioathirika hawakufanya kosa lolote. Walitembelea tovuti walizozitumia mara nyingi awali.

7a4850a8d40f.en: A minimum record, kept as a single file: date, asset, amount, price in your home currency, the venue, and the transaction hash where there is one. Written at the time, this takes under a minute per transaction. Reconstructed four years later from an exchange that has since shut down, it can be impossible, and the assumption a tax authority makes in that situation is rarely the one you would prefer.
7a4850a8d40f.sw: Rekodi ya chini kabisa, iliyowekwa kama faili moja: tarehe, rasilimali, kiasi, bei katika sarafu yako ya nyumbani, uwanja, na heshi ya muamala pale ilipo. Ikiandikwa wakati huo, hii huchukua chini ya dakika kwa kila muamala. Ikijengwa upya miaka minne baadaye kutoka soko la kubadilisha lililofungwa tangu wakati huo, inaweza kuwa haiwezekani, na dhana ambayo mamlaka ya kodi huifanya katika hali hiyo mara chache ndiyo ungeipendelea.

7a78dbe09dea.en: Sizing a position is a decision made once. Keeping it sized is a decision made repeatedly, because success itself breaks the rule.
7a78dbe09dea.sw: Kupima nafasi ni uamuzi unaofanywa mara moja. Kuiweka imepimwa ni uamuzi unaofanywa mara kwa mara, kwa sababu mafanikio yenyewe huvunja kanuni.

7a8e319946ad.en: The last traded price multiplied by the number of units in circulation. It is one multiplication, nothing more. It measures what every unit would be worth if every unit could be sold at the most recent price.
7a8e319946ad.sw: Bei ya mwisho iliyofanyiwa biashara ikizidishwa na idadi ya vipimo vilivyo katika mzunguko. Ni kuzidisha kumoja, si zaidi. Hupima kila kipimo kingekuwa na thamani gani ikiwa kila kipimo kingeweza kuuzwa kwa bei ya hivi karibuni zaidi.

7a9d6f85a00c.en: Correct. The strongest days clustered inside the most frightening weeks, so waiting for conditions to look safe meant being absent for the recovery. That is not an argument that cash is never appropriate — it is an argument for deciding the rule in advance rather than during the week the news is at its worst.
7a9d6f85a00c.sw: Sahihi. Siku zenye nguvu zaidi zilijikusanya ndani ya wiki zenye hofu zaidi, kwa hivyo kusubiri hali zionekane salama kulimaanisha kutokuwepo wakati wa kupona. Hiyo si hoja kwamba fedha taslimu haifai kamwe — ni hoja ya kuamua kanuni mapema badala ya wakati wa wiki ambayo habari ziko mbaya zaidi.

7aa12f04f4bb.en: The company is in distress, because capital spending exceeds profit
7aa12f04f4bb.sw: Kampuni iko katika dhiki, kwa sababu matumizi ya mtaji yanazidi faida

7aa79d6e8190.en: A 1% annual fee sounds small and takes about a sixth of a thirty-year pot. Fees are the only input to your result that you know in advance with certainty.
7aa79d6e8190.sw: Ada ya 1% kwa mwaka husikika ndogo na huchukua takriban sehemu moja ya sita ya kiasi cha miaka thelathini. Ada ndiyo kigezo pekee cha matokeo yako unachokijua mapema kwa uhakika.

7abcd50a9571.en: Why is position sizing often more important than which company you choose?
7abcd50a9571.sw: Kwa nini upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi mara nyingi ni muhimu zaidi kuliko kampuni unayoichagua?

7ad790911f98.en: The total outstanding quantity of major stablecoins, which approximates the amount of capital positioned inside the crypto system and ready to be deployed.
7ad790911f98.sw: Kiasi jumla kilichosalia cha sarafu imara kuu, ambacho hukadiria kiasi cha mtaji uliowekwa ndani ya mfumo wa kripto na tayari kupelekwa.

7ad8b61c7cac.en: Software or hardware that creates and stores your keys, and uses them to sign transactions. A wallet holds no coins. The coins are entries on the blockchain's ledger; the wallet holds the keys that control them.
7ad8b61c7cac.sw: Programu au maunzi yanayounda na kuhifadhi funguo zako, na kuzitumia kutia sahihi miamala. Pochi haishikilii sarafu yoyote. Sarafu ni maingizo katika leja ya mnyororo wa vitalu; pochi hushikilia funguo zinazozidhibiti.

7ae9022c6bd4.en: The shared story a market tells itself about why an asset should be worth more.
7ae9022c6bd4.sw: Hadithi inayoshirikiwa ambayo soko hujisimulia kuhusu kwa nini rasilimali inapaswa kuwa na thamani zaidi.

7ae9be237d84.en: The fall from a portfolio's or an asset's highest point to its subsequent lowest point, expressed as a percentage. It measures the worst loss an investor holding through the period would have experienced.
7ae9be237d84.sw: Kushuka kutoka nukta ya juu kabisa ya kasha au rasilimali hadi nukta yake ya chini kabisa inayofuata, kukielezwa kama asilimia. Hupima hasara mbaya zaidi ambayo mwekezaji aliyeshikilia kupitia kipindi angeipata.

7afcd21e9d79.en: You enter a long position on a currency pair at 1.50. Where should your stop-loss sit relative to your entry?
7afcd21e9d79.sw: Unaingia katika nafasi ya long kwenye jozi la sarafu kwa 1.50. Stop-loss yako inapaswa kuwa wapi ikilinganishwa na kiingilio chako?

7b05f6a21a97.en: Not quite. The paper does not establish predictability, does not single out momentum as the only workable strategy, and makes no efficiency claim. It shows that a range of distinct-looking strategies share underlying exposures.
7b05f6a21a97.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Karatasi haithibitishi kutabirika, haitengi kasi kama mkakati pekee unaotumika, wala haitoi dai la ufanisi. Huonyesha kwamba mikakati mbalimbali inayoonekana tofauti hushiriki kufunuliwa kwa msingi.

7b17fc148d22.en: A fund's annual fee as a percentage of assets, deducted from the fund rather than billed.
7b17fc148d22.sw: Ada ya kila mwaka ya fund kama asilimia ya mali, inayotolewa kutoka kwenye fund badala ya kutozwa bili.

7b1fff00bc37.en: A limit on how many different protocols, wallets, chains and products you are willing to hold, set by how many you can actually keep track of rather than by how many look attractive.
7b1fff00bc37.sw: Kikomo cha itifaki, pochi, minyororo na bidhaa ngapi tofauti ulizo tayari kuzishikilia, kilichowekwa na ngapi unaweza kuzifuatilia hasa badala ya ngapi zinaonekana za kuvutia.

7b42e159de08.en: A portfolio of 5 equally-weighted companies has 20% in each. One failing costs a fifth of everything. A portfolio of 30 has 3.3% in each, and one failing is a bad month. The first can also produce a return the second cannot. Neither is correct in the abstract — but only one of them can be recovered from with an ordinary income and ordinary patience.
7b42e159de08.sw: Mkusanyiko wa kampuni 5 zenye uzito sawa una 20% katika kila moja. Moja ikishindwa hugharimu sehemu ya tano ya kila kitu. Mkusanyiko wa 30 una 3.3% katika kila moja, na moja ikishindwa ni mwezi mbaya. Wa kwanza pia unaweza kuzalisha faida ambayo wa pili hauwezi. Hakuna ulio sahihi kwa ujumla — lakini mmoja tu kati yao unaweza kuponeka kwa mapato ya kawaida na subira ya kawaida.

7b43e4357c92.en: That liquidation machinery is the whole trick: the buffer absorbs ordinary volatility, and forced liquidations rebuild the buffer when it thins. The honest cost is capital inefficiency — 1.50 dollars locked up to create 1 dollar — and the honest risk is a crash so fast that liquidations cannot keep up. DAI has held its peg through several such stress events, with visible wobbles. Its reserves are the most transparent of the three models: you can check them on a block explorer (Lesson 6) right now, which is more than any fiat-backed issuer offers.
7b43e4357c92.sw: Mitambo hiyo ya ufilisi ndiyo hila nzima: buffer hufyonza mtikisiko wa kawaida, na ufilisi wa lazima hujenga upya buffer inapokonda. Gharama ya kweli ni ukosefu wa ufanisi wa mtaji — dola 1.50 zimefungiwa kuunda dola 1 — na hatari ya kweli ni mporomoko wa haraka mno hivi kwamba ufilisi hauwezi kufuata kasi. DAI imeshikilia pegi yake kupitia matukio kadhaa ya msongo kama hayo, ikiwa na miyumbo inayoonekana. Akiba zake ndizo za uwazi zaidi kati ya mifumo mitatu: unaweza kuzikagua katika kichunguzi cha vitalu (Somo la 6) sasa hivi, jambo ambalo ni zaidi ya kile mtoaji yeyote anayeungwa mkono na fedha za amri anachotoa.

7b6b42b6e062.en: Their first rule: if two addresses are used together as inputs to the same transaction, the same party probably controls both. Applied across the Bitcoin ledger of the time, this collapsed roughly 12 million public keys into about 5.5 million clusters. Their second rule identified one-time change addresses, and applied on top of the first it cut the total to about 3.3 million clusters. They found about 3.5 million change addresses this way, with an estimated false positive rate of 0.17 percent.
7b6b42b6e062.sw: Kanuni yao ya kwanza: ikiwa anwani mbili zinatumika pamoja kama viingizo vya muamala uleule, upande uleule pengine hudhibiti zote mbili. Ikitumika katika leja ya Bitcoin ya wakati huo, hii iliponda takriban funguo za umma milioni 12 kuwa takriban makundi milioni 5.5. Kanuni yao ya pili ilitambua anwani za kibaki za matumizi-moja, na ikitumika juu ya ya kwanza ilipunguza jumla hadi takriban makundi milioni 3.3. Walipata takriban anwani za kibaki milioni 3.5 kwa njia hii, zikiwa na kiwango kilichokadiriwa cha uongo chanya cha asilimia 0.17.

7b775fb58e43.en: Correction: an earlier version of this lesson stated USD/CNY was the "fourth" most-traded pair. Checking the precise 2025 BIS breakdown (EUR/USD 21.2%, USD/JPY 14.3%, USD/CNY 8.1%, GBP/USD 7.6%), it's actually third, ahead of GBP/USD. Flagging this directly rather than quietly fixing it — checking a specific number against the actual data, even your own course's earlier claim, is exactly the habit this course is trying to build.
7b775fb58e43.sw: Marekebisho: toleo la awali la somo hili lilisema USD/CNY lilikuwa jozi la "nne" linalofanyiwa biashara zaidi. Kukagua mgawanyo kamili wa BIS wa mwaka 2025 (EUR/USD 21.2%, USD/JPY 14.3%, USD/CNY 8.1%, GBP/USD 7.6%), kwa kweli ni la tatu, mbele ya GBP/USD. Tunaliweka wazi moja kwa moja badala ya kulirekebisha kimyakimya — kukagua namba mahususi dhidi ya data halisi, hata dai la awali la kozi yako mwenyewe, ndiyo hasa tabia ambayo kozi hii inajaribu kuijenga.

7b81da669c2f.en: The shareable half of the key pair. An address (derived from the public key) works like the slot on a mailbox: anyone who knows it can put money in, and nobody can take money out through it. Sharing your address is safe — it is how people pay you.
7b81da669c2f.sw: Nusu inayoweza kushirikiwa ya jozi ya funguo. Anwani (inayotokana na ufunguo wa umma) hufanya kazi kama tundu la sanduku la barua: yeyote anayeijua anaweza kuweka pesa ndani, na hakuna anayeweza kutoa pesa kupitia hiyo. Kushiriki anwani yako ni salama — ndivyo watu wanavyokulipa.

7b9d0606cb7e.sw: Kwa sababu vifungu vya urejeshaji hukwisha muda baada ya kipindi kilichowekwa

7bb00a4561f9.en: Cryptocurrencies are worth a specific note, because they are often assumed to be a world apart. Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu (2022), in The Journal of Finance, found that cryptocurrency returns are captured by just three factors — a crypto market factor, size, and momentum — a structure that echoes the factor logic of ordinary asset markets rather than escaping it. In a risk-off transmission wave, crypto has tended to behave as a high-beta risk asset, falling hardest, not as an independent safe haven.
7bb00a4561f9.sw: Sarafu za crypto zinastahili dokezo mahususi, kwa sababu mara nyingi hudhaniwa kuwa dunia tofauti. Liu, Tsyvinski na Wu (2022), katika The Journal of Finance, waligundua kwamba faida za sarafu za crypto hunaswa na vipengele vitatu tu — kipengele cha soko la crypto, ukubwa, na kasi — muundo unaoakisi mantiki ya vipengele ya masoko ya kawaida ya mali badala ya kuikwepa. Katika wimbi la usambazaji la kukwepa hatari, crypto imeelekea kutenda kama mali hatarishi ya beta kubwa, ikianguka kwa nguvu zaidi, si kama kimbilio salama huru.

7bb05b202eef.en: Not quite — judge the decision and thesis, not only the money. Good processes lose to variance and bad ones win by luck.
7bb05b202eef.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — hukumu uamuzi na nadharia, si pesa tu. Michakato mizuri hupoteza kwa utofauti na mibaya hushinda kwa bahati.

7c130c1b8841.en: Not quite. A low unit price is not itself evidence of fraud, and an exchange listing does not address the claim. The claim is about price, and price only means something multiplied by supply — which converts "one dollar" into a valuation you can compare against real companies.
7c130c1b8841.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Bei ndogo ya kipimo yenyewe si ushahidi wa udanganyifu, na uorodheshaji katika soko la kubadilisha haushughulikii dai. Dai linahusu bei, na bei humaanisha kitu tu ikizidishwa na usambazaji — jambo linalogeuza "dola moja" kuwa tathmini unayoweza kuilinganisha na kampuni halisi.

7c233c9611a1.en: Each common mistake mapped to the lesson that already solves it, plus the checklist and journal that catch them before and after.
7c233c9611a1.sw: Kila kosa la kawaida likiunganishwa na somo linalolitatua tayari, pamoja na orodha ya ukaguzi na kumbukumbu zinazoyakamata kabla na baada.

7c250f135b69.en: Before and during a leveraged trade, check: Do you actually know your broker's margin call and stop-out levels, in numbers, before you need them? What is your effective leverage right now — total open position size divided by equity — a small number or a large one? Could your free-margin cushion absorb a realistic adverse move without triggering a margin call? And are you relying on the stop-out as a safety net, or sizing your positions so that you never come close to it?
7c250f135b69.sw: Kabla na wakati wa biashara ya leverage, kagua: Je, unajua kweli viwango vya wito wa margin na stop-out vya broker wako, kwa namba, kabla ya kuvihitaji? Leverage yako halisi ni ipi sasa hivi — ukubwa wa jumla wa nafasi zilizo wazi kugawanywa kwa usawa — namba ndogo au kubwa? Je, mto wako wa margin huru ungeweza kufyonza msogeo mbaya halisi bila kuanzisha wito wa margin? Na je, unategemea stop-out kama wavu wa usalama, au unapima nafasi zako ili usikaribie kamwe?

7c29ade2d375.en: Correct — UST had no external reserve, only the swap loop with LUNA. Mass redemptions flooded the market with new LUNA, LUNA's price collapsed, and the falling backing triggered more redemptions: a reflexive death spiral, with roughly 40 billion dollars destroyed. Chapter 5 dissects it fully.
7c29ade2d375.sw: Sahihi — UST haikuwa na akiba ya nje, kitanzi cha ubadilishaji na LUNA pekee. Ukombozi wa wingi ulifurikisha soko kwa LUNA mpya, bei ya LUNA ikaporomoka, na msaada uliokuwa ukishuka ukachochea ukombozi zaidi: mzunguko wa kifo wa kujiakisi, ukiwa na takriban dola bilioni 40 zilizoharibiwa. Sura ya 5 huuchambua kikamilifu.

7c29d7ac4dbb.en: The first is where it lives. A plan stored only in your own head or in an application you may lose access to is not a plan. Keep it somewhere you will still be able to read in ten years, and keep it in the same place as the list of what you hold and where it is held.
7c29d7ac4dbb.sw: La kwanza ni mahali unapoishi. Mpango uliohifadhiwa kichwani mwako pekee au katika programu ambayo unaweza kupoteza ufikiaji wake si mpango. Uweke mahali ambapo bado utaweza kusoma baada ya miaka kumi, na uuweke mahali pamoja na orodha ya kile unachoshikilia na kinaposhikiliwa.

7c783514a42a.en: Lesson 3 ended on a specific idea: markets trade the surprise, not the raw decision. The economic calendar is the tool that makes that idea usable in practice.
7c783514a42a.sw: Somo la 3 lilimalizia kwa wazo mahususi: masoko hufanya biashara ya mshangao, si uamuzi ghafi. Kalenda ya kiuchumi ndiyo zana inayofanya wazo hilo litumike kivitendo.

7cadb3471231.en: The forex trade. EUR/USD, a 50-pip stop, a US-dollar account. Forex Chapter 3, Lesson 1 established that pip value on a standard lot is exactly 10 dollars when the quote currency is your account currency, which is Case A. Position size = 50 / (50 pips x 10 dollars) = 0.10 standard lots, which is 10,000 euro. At a rate of 1.0800, that is 10,800 dollars of notional exposure. The stop distance is 0.463% of price. Check the risk: 0.463% of 10,800 dollars = 50 dollars.
7cadb3471231.sw: Biashara ya forex. EUR/USD, kusimamisha kwa pipi 50, akaunti ya dola ya Marekani. Forex Sura ya 3, Somo la 1 lilithibitisha kwamba thamani ya pipi katika loti ya kawaida ni hasa dola 10 wakati sarafu ya nukuu ni sarafu ya akaunti yako, ambayo ni Kesi A. Ukubwa wa nafasi = 50 / (pipi 50 x dola 10) = loti 0.10 za kawaida, ambayo ni yuro 10,000. Katika kiwango cha 1.0800, hiyo ni dola 10,800 za kufunuliwa kwa kinadharia. Umbali wa kusimamisha ni 0.463% ya bei. Kagua hatari: 0.463% ya dola 10,800 = dola 50.

7cb502737ba2.en: So why does averaging in survive as advice? Because the return-maximising choice and the choice someone can actually stick to are not always the same.
7cb502737ba2.sw: Basi kwa nini kupunguza wastani wa bei hunusurika kama ushauri? Kwa sababu chaguo linaloongeza faida na chaguo ambalo mtu anaweza kulishikilia hasa si sawa daima.

7cb7f073d98a.en: Three things to carry forward. Position sizing, from Chapter 3 Lesson 2, is the only defence against an instrument that can move like this in either direction. The unbounded loss on a short, from Chapter 3 Lesson 4, was demonstrated live and at scale. And the most confidently repeated explanation of a famous market event was checked against the order data by the people who have it, and did not survive.
7cb7f073d98a.sw: Mambo matatu ya kuchukua mbele. Ukubwa wa nafasi, kutoka Sura ya 3 Somo la 2, ndio ulinzi pekee dhidi ya chombo kinachoweza kusonga hivi kwa mwelekeo wowote. Hasara isiyo na kikomo katika uuzaji-mkopo, kutoka Sura ya 3 Somo la 4, ilionyeshwa moja kwa moja na kwa kiwango kikubwa. Na maelezo yaliyorudiwa kwa ujasiri zaidi ya tukio maarufu la soko yalikaguliwa dhidi ya data ya maagizo na watu wanaoimiliki, nayo hayakunusurika.

7cd4b3b5de9e.en: Miller and Modigliani addressed this in 1961, in the Journal of Business (volume 34, pages 411 to 433). Under a set of idealised assumptions — no taxes, no transaction costs, and investment decisions held fixed — they showed that dividend policy does not affect the value of the firm. A shareholder wanting cash can sell a small part of their holding, and one not wanting cash can reinvest the dividend. The two are equivalent.
7cd4b3b5de9e.sw: Miller na Modigliani walishughulikia hili mwaka 1961, katika Journal of Business (juzuu 34, kurasa 411 hadi 433). Chini ya seti ya dhana bora — hakuna kodi, hakuna gharama za miamala, na maamuzi ya uwekezaji yamewekwa thabiti — walionyesha kwamba sera ya gawio haiathiri thamani ya kampuni. Mwanahisa anayetaka fedha anaweza kuuza sehemu ndogo ya umiliki wake, na asiyetaka fedha anaweza kuwekeza tena gawio. Hizo mbili zinalingana.

7d2d7209dcb2.en: Here is the misunderstanding that this lesson exists to fix. The broker advertises a maximum leverage — 30:1, 50:1, sometimes far more. That number is a ceiling on what you are allowed to do. It says nothing about the risk you are actually running. That is a different number.
7d2d7209dcb2.sw: Hapa hapa kutoelewana ambako somo hili lipo kulirekebisha. Broker hutangaza leverage ya juu zaidi — 30:1, 50:1, wakati mwingine zaidi mno. Namba hiyo ni dari ya kile unachoruhusiwa kufanya. Haisemi chochote kuhusu hatari unayoiendesha hasa. Hiyo ni namba tofauti.

7d6d76eb6002.en: To fix both problems — too many competing currencies, and the instability of fractional reserve banking — countries began establishing central banks. The Bank of England, founded in 1694, is one of the earliest examples: a single, trusted institution issuing one national currency and regulating the banks around it.
7d6d76eb6002.sw: Ili kutatua matatizo yote mawili — sarafu nyingi sana zinazoshindana, na kutokuwa imara kwa benki ya akiba ya sehemu — nchi zilianza kuanzisha benki kuu. Benki ya Uingereza, iliyoanzishwa mwaka 1694, ni mojawapo ya mifano ya awali kabisa: taasisi moja inayoaminika inayotoa sarafu moja ya taifa na kudhibiti benki zinazoizunguka.

7dc05adce77f.en: It worked — until a war forced every participating country to choose between keeping its promise to gold and paying for the war. When World War I began in 1914, major economies suspended gold convertibility so they could print the money needed to fund it.

Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia vilipoanza mwaka 1914, uchumi mkubwa ulisimamisha ubadilishaji wa dhahabu ili uweze kuchapisha pesa zilizohitajika kuvifadhili.

7e0bfe32dc49.en: Aggregate open interest in perpetual futures, read together with funding, measures how much leverage is in the system and which way it leans. Chapter 3 Lesson 3 described the mechanics of a liquidation cascade. As a regime reading, elevated open interest with persistently positive funding says the fuel is present, and that a fall which would otherwise be ordinary has the potential to become mechanical and self-accelerating.
7e0bfe32dc49.sw: Maslahi wazi jumlifu katika mikataba ya baadaye ya kudumu, yakisomwa pamoja na ufadhili, hupima mzingo kiasi gani upo katika mfumo na unaegemea upande upi. Sura ya 3 Somo la 3 lilielezea mitambo ya mfuatano wa ufilisi. Kama usomaji wa utawala, maslahi wazi yaliyoinuka pamoja na ufadhili chanya wa kudumu husema mafuta yapo, na kwamba kushuka ambako vinginevyo kungekuwa kwa kawaida kuna uwezekano wa kuwa kwa kimitambo na kunakojiharakisha.

7e0ce3cf6a84.en: Readers who took the Forex track have met this already, in Chapter 1 Lesson 4. The mechanism is identical; only the units differ. Currency traders count it in pips, share traders count it in cents, and both are paying the same thing.
7e0ce3cf6a84.sw: Wasomaji waliochukua njia ya Forex tayari wamekutana na hili, katika Sura ya 1 Somo la 4. Utaratibu unafanana; vipimo tu ndivyo vinavyotofautiana. Wafanyabiashara wa sarafu huihesabu kwa pip, wafanyabiashara wa hisa huihesabu kwa senti, na wote wanalipa kitu kile kile.

7e11be711814.en: A seven-section plan diagram: allocation, position sizing, leverage, entry and exit conditions, then three crypto-specific sections — a custody map showing an exchange cap above which holdings move to self-custody, a recovery plan covering where the recovery phrase lives, and succession covering who else knows the holding exists.
7e11be711814.sw: Mchoro wa mpango wa sehemu saba: mgawanyo, kupanga ukubwa wa nafasi, mzingo, masharti ya kuingia na kutoka, kisha sehemu tatu maalum kwa kripto — ramani ya utunzaji ikionyesha dari ya soko la kubadilisha ambayo juu yake umiliki huhamia utunzaji binafsi, mpango wa urejeshaji unaofunika kifungu cha urejeshaji kinapoishi, na urithi unaofunika ni nani mwingine anajua umiliki upo.

7e1e14f13db6.en: Holding more than one company reduces risk. That much is uncontroversial. How much, how quickly, and how many holdings it takes are all less settled than the usual advice suggests.
7e1e14f13db6.sw: Kushikilia zaidi ya kampuni moja hupunguza hatari. Kiasi hicho hakina mabishano. Kiasi gani, kwa kasi gani, na umiliki mingapi unahitajika vyote havijakamilika kuliko ushauri wa kawaida unavyodokeza.

7e2715c2ee13.en: How easily an asset can be bought or sold in reasonable size without moving its price. High volume and a narrow spread together indicate it; either alone does not.
7e2715c2ee13.sw: Jinsi mali inavyoweza kununuliwa au kuuzwa kwa urahisi kwa ukubwa wa busara bila kusogeza bei yake. Kiasi kikubwa na spread finyu kwa pamoja huionyesha; kimojawapo peke yake hakiionyeshi.

7e3674f1fb05.en: Not quite. Identifying the top reliably is exactly what nobody managed, and avoiding the sector meant missing its eventual winners. The defence that works without a forecast is limiting how much any single story can cost you.
7e3674f1fb05.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kutambua kilele kwa uhakika ndicho hasa ambacho hakuna aliyefanikiwa, na kuepuka sekta kulimaanisha kukosa washindi wake wa mwisho. Ulinzi unaofanya kazi bila utabiri ni kupunguza kiasi ambacho hadithi moja inaweza kukugharimu.

7e39ff1b17a8.en: Turn a thesis into a survivable trade by placing the stop at the invalidation level, demanding a reward-to-risk that justifies it, running a pre-mortem to surface hidden failure modes, and writing the full exit before entry.
7e39ff1b17a8.sw: Geuza nadharia kuwa biashara inayoweza kunusurika kwa kuweka stop kwenye kiwango cha kuvunjika, kudai tuzo-kwa-hatari inayoihalalisha, kufanya pre-mortem kufichua hali fichi za kushindwa, na kuandika kutoka kamili kabla ya kuingia.

7e473635b6ae.en: It has given you the mechanics: what a blockchain does, how consensus works, what a wallet actually holds, how exchanges take custody, what a transaction costs and when it is final, and what separates a backed stablecoin from an algorithmic one. It has given you how to read the market: what market capitalisation does and does not mean, what the cycle evidence supports, how crypto behaves as a risk asset, what on-chain data can and cannot show, and how narratives function where there are no cash flows. It has given you the risk arithmetic at crypto volatility, the custody threat model, and the mechanics of leverage and liquidation. It has given you the psychology, the fraud structures, three case studies, and a process.
7e473635b6ae.sw: Imekupa mitambo: mnyororo wa vitalu hufanya nini, makubaliano hufanya kazi vipi, pochi hushikilia nini hasa, masoko ya kubadilisha huchukua utunzaji vipi, muamala hugharimu nini na hukamilika lini, na nini hutenganisha sarafu imara inayoungwa mkono na ya kialgoriti. Imekupa jinsi ya kusoma soko: kiasi cha soko humaanisha nini na hakimaanishi nini, ushahidi wa mzunguko huunga mkono nini, kripto hutenda vipi kama rasilimali ya hatari, data ya kwenye mnyororo inaweza kuonyesha nini na haiwezi, na simulizi hufanya kazi vipi pale hakuna mitiririko ya fedha. Imekupa hesabu ya hatari katika mtikisiko wa kripto, mfano wa tishio la utunzaji, na mitambo ya mzingo na ufilisi. Imekupa saikolojia, miundo ya udanganyifu, uchunguzi wa matukio matatu, na mchakato.

7e4aaad67478.en: Because the payoff is asymmetric — if the firm was fine, withdrawing cost nothing; if it was not, withdrawing was the only thing that helped
