7e5ac697d1a3.sw: Kuunda upya huanzisha malipo ya kodi kwa wote wanaoshikilia

7e7d0d0ab08c.en: Two shares each yield 5%. One pays 2.50 on a 50.00 price after years of steady increases. The other paid 2.50 on a price that has fallen from 100.00 to 50.00 in eighteen months. The yield is identical and the situations have nothing in common. Only looking at the yield makes them look like the same investment.
7e7d0d0ab08c.sw: Hisa mbili kila moja hutoa mavuno ya 5%. Moja hulipa 2.50 kwa bei ya 50.00 baada ya miaka ya ongezeko thabiti. Nyingine ililipa 2.50 kwa bei iliyoshuka kutoka 100.00 hadi 50.00 katika miezi kumi na minane. Mavuno yanafanana na hali hazina chochote cha pamoja. Kutazama mavuno tu hufanya zionekane kama uwekezaji ule ule.

7e8487808c9d.en: The US government banned algorithmic stablecoins
7e8487808c9d.sw: Serikali ya Marekani ilipiga marufuku sarafu imara za kialgoriti

7e966fc13ea6.en: A common measure for comparing the value of different things.
7e966fc13ea6.sw: Kipimo cha pamoja cha kulinganisha thamani ya vitu tofauti.

7e969c72e7fb.en: Not quite — the dominant lever is position size, the fraction of the account risked per trade, ahead of the win rate.
7e969c72e7fb.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — lever kuu ni ukubwa wa nafasi, sehemu ya akaunti inayohatarishwa kwa kila biashara, mbele ya kiwango cha ushindi.

7e9c59eff3cc.en: Elton and Gruber studied this in 1970, in the Review of Economics and Statistics (volume 52, pages 68 to 74), using dividends paid between April 1966 and March 1967. They found the price drop was significantly less than the dividend, on average — and argued the gap reflected tax, since dividends were then taxed more heavily than capital gains, so a dividend was worth less than its face value to the marginal holder.
7e9c59eff3cc.sw: Elton na Gruber walisoma hili mwaka 1970, katika Review of Economics and Statistics (juzuu 52, kurasa 68 hadi 74), wakitumia gawio lililolipwa kati ya Aprili 1966 na Machi 1967. Waligundua kushuka kwa bei kulikuwa kudogo kwa kiasi kikubwa kuliko gawio, kwa wastani — na wakahoji kwamba pengo lilionyesha kodi, kwa kuwa gawio wakati huo lilitozwa kodi zaidi kuliko faida za mtaji, hivyo gawio lilikuwa na thamani ndogo kuliko thamani yake ya uso kwa mwenye kushikilia wa pembeni.

7eafe80226a4.en: Adding holdings removes specific risk toward zero. It does nothing at all to market risk.
7eafe80226a4.sw: Kuongeza umiliki huondoa hatari mahususi kuelekea sifuri. Hakufanyi chochote kabisa kwa hatari ya soko.

7ee77e0ccac0.en: A pair combining two major currencies, with no USD involved.
7ee77e0ccac0.sw: Jozi linalounganisha sarafu mbili kuu, bila USD kuhusika.

7eef5d19a248.en: Correct. When the noise is that large relative to the signal, results tell you very little about whether the reasoning was sound. Reviewing only outcomes means systematically learning the wrong lesson, and learning it with great confidence because the evidence appears so strong.
7eef5d19a248.sw: Sahihi. Kelele zinapokuwa kubwa hivyo ikilinganishwa na ishara, matokeo hukuambia kidogo sana kuhusu kama hoja ilikuwa imara. Kukagua matokeo pekee humaanisha kujifunza somo lisilo sahihi kwa utaratibu, na kulijifunza kwa ujasiri mkubwa kwa sababu ushahidi huonekana imara hivyo.

7ef15ee9f6e5.en: Searching many possibilities for one that fits your data, then mistaking it for a real discovery.
7ef15ee9f6e5.sw: Kutafuta uwezekano mwingi kwa moja inayolingana na data yako, kisha kuikosea kuwa ugunduzi halisi.

7ef781bb4f78.en: Correct - a genuine device generates the recovery phrase on the device, in front of you, at first setup, and nobody else ever sees it. A supplied phrase is a phrase the supplier holds, so the coins are spendable by them from the moment you fund it. Kaspersky documented exactly this: a counterfeit of a well-known model, with convincing packaging and holographic seals, whose replaced firmware produced a recovery phrase fixed in advance. Buy direct from the manufacturer, and generate your own phrase.
7ef781bb4f78.sw: Sahihi - kifaa halisi huzalisha kifungu cha urejeshaji katika kifaa, mbele yako, wakati wa usanidi wa kwanza, na hakuna mwingine anayekiona kamwe. Kifungu kilichotolewa ni kifungu ambacho mtoaji anakishikilia, kwa hivyo sarafu zinaweza kutumiwa naye kuanzia wakati unapokifadhili. Kaspersky iliandika hasa hili: bandia ya modeli inayojulikana, yenye kifungashio cha kushawishi na mihuri ya holografia, ambayo firmware yake iliyobadilishwa ilizalisha kifungu cha urejeshaji kilichowekwa mapema. Nunua moja kwa moja kutoka mtengenezaji, na uzalishe kifungu chako mwenyewe.

7f16d7843488.en: This is uncomfortable and it is the single most neglected item in personal crypto. An asset secured so that only you can reach it is, by construction, an asset nobody else can reach. If you are the only person who knows a holding exists and where the recovery phrase is, then your death or incapacity destroys it as effectively as any hack.
7f16d7843488.sw: Hii ina usumbufu nayo ndiyo jambo linalopuuzwa zaidi katika kripto binafsi. Rasilimali iliyolindwa ili wewe pekee uweze kuifikia ni, kwa muundo, rasilimali ambayo hakuna mwingine anayeweza kuifikia. Ikiwa wewe ndiye mtu pekee anayejua umiliki upo na kifungu cha urejeshaji kiko wapi, basi kifo chako au kutokuwa na uwezo huuharibu kama vile udukuzi wowote.

7f24dbfe8f2d.en: There is a second version of the same error that is harder to spot. It is to keep the correct wide stop, and then quietly raise the risk per trade from 1% to 5% so that the position feels meaningful again. That is not a sizing decision. It is an abandonment of the sizing rule, and it runs straight into the risk-of-ruin result from Forex Chapter 3, Lesson 1: the fraction risked per trade is the dominant lever on the probability of blowing up, ahead of win rate. Ralph Vince's fixed-fractional framework in The Mathematics of Money Management (Wiley, 1992) formalises what the classical gambler's-ruin problem already implied. A strategy with a genuine edge still has a high probability of ruin if it is over-sized.
7f24dbfe8f2d.sw: Kuna toleo la pili la kosa lilelile ambalo ni gumu zaidi kugundua. Ni kubakiza kusimamisha kupana sahihi, kisha kimya kimya kupandisha hatari kwa kila biashara kutoka 1% hadi 5% ili nafasi ihisi yenye maana tena. Huo si uamuzi wa kupanga ukubwa. Ni kuachana na kanuni ya kupanga ukubwa, nao huingia moja kwa moja katika matokeo ya hatari-ya-kuangamia kutoka Forex Sura ya 3, Somo la 1: sehemu inayowekwa hatarini kwa kila biashara ndiyo lever kuu juu ya uwezekano wa kulipuka, mbele ya kiwango cha kushinda. Mfumo wa Ralph Vince wa sehemu isiyobadilika katika The Mathematics of Money Management (Wiley, 1992) hurasimisha kile ambacho tatizo la kawaida la kuangamia kwa mchezaji tayari lilidokeza. Mkakati wenye ubora halisi bado una uwezekano mkubwa wa kuangamia ikiwa umepangwa ukubwa mkubwa mno.

7f2956b89641.en: Grossman and Stiglitz published it in the American Economic Review in 1980 (volume 70, issue 3, pages 393 to 408), under the title On the Impossibility of Informationally Efficient Markets. The argument runs: gathering information costs money. People gather it because doing so is profitable. But it is only profitable if prices do not already reflect it. So if prices perfectly reflected all information, nobody would have any reason to gather it — and prices would stop reflecting it.
7f2956b89641.sw: Grossman na Stiglitz waliichapisha katika American Economic Review mwaka 1980 (juzuu 70, toleo 3, kurasa 393 hadi 408), chini ya kichwa On the Impossibility of Informationally Efficient Markets. Hoja inakwenda hivi: kukusanya taarifa hugharimu pesa. Watu huzikusanya kwa sababu kufanya hivyo kuna faida. Lakini kuna faida tu kama bei hazikuziakisi tayari. Hivyo kama bei zingeakisi taarifa zote kikamilifu, hakuna angekuwa na sababu yoyote ya kuzikusanya — na bei zingeacha kuziakisi.

7f3720098c1a.en: The Nasdaq Composite fell 78% and took fifteen years to regain its peak. Recovery is a fact about indexes; whether it is a fact about you depends on how long you had.
7f3720098c1a.sw: Nasdaq Composite ilishuka 78% na ilichukua miaka kumi na mitano kurejea kilele chake. Kupona ni ukweli kuhusu faharasa; kama ni ukweli kukuhusu wewe hutegemea ulikuwa na muda kiasi gani.

7f3735925aeb.en: Crypto sits at the far end of the transmission chain, which means it is usually reacting to something that was decided in a bond market weeks earlier. Reading the regime tells you which pillar has any power — and often that none does.
7f3735925aeb.sw: Kripto hukaa mwisho kabisa wa mnyororo wa usambazaji, jambo linalomaanisha kwa kawaida huitikia kitu kilichoamuliwa katika soko la hatifungani wiki kadhaa mapema. Kusoma utawala hukuambia ni nguzo ipi yenye nguvu yoyote — na mara nyingi kwamba hakuna yenye nguvu.

7f38500c990b.en: Not quite. Momentum is well documented for individual shares, and neither pillar overrides the other. Their disagreement here is the normal case: cheapness usually arises from a falling price, which is exactly what negative momentum measures.
7f38500c990b.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kasi imeandikwa vizuri kwa hisa mmoja mmoja, na hakuna nguzo inayoshinda nyingine. Kutokubaliana kwao hapa ndiyo hali ya kawaida: bei nafuu kwa kawaida hutokana na bei inayoshuka, ambacho ndicho hasa kasi hasi hupima.

7f4afc536687.en: You deposit 1 BTC to a centralized exchange and your account shows "1 BTC." Where is the bitcoin?
7f4afc536687.sw: Unaweka BTC 1 katika soko la kubadilisha lenye kituo kikuu na akaunti yako inaonyesha "BTC 1." Bitcoin iko wapi?

7f6b1bb74a6c.en: A meaningful version would attest to assets and liabilities together, verified by an independent party with access to the full books. Some venues have moved toward this. The point for a reader is narrower: when a venue publishes reassurance, check which of the two sides it covers, because the side FTX failed on is usually the side that is missing.
7f6b1bb74a6c.sw: Toleo lenye maana lingeshuhudia rasilimali na madeni kwa pamoja, likithibitishwa na upande huru wenye ufikiaji wa vitabu kamili. Viwanja baadhi vimehamia kuelekea hili. Lengo kwa msomaji ni finyu zaidi: uwanja unapochapisha kutuliza, kagua ni upande upi kati ya wawili unaoufunika, kwa sababu upande ambao FTX ilishindwa juu yake kwa kawaida ndio upande unaokosekana.

7f6ce5aacbc5.en: Backing a balance sheet with a token you created, whose value depends on confidence in you.
7f6ce5aacbc5.sw: Kuunga mkono karatasi ya salio kwa tokeni uliyoiunda, ambayo thamani yake hutegemea ujasiri kwako.

7f79c3cbf0d9.en: Profit is an opinion shaped by accounting choices. Cash is a fact. That is why the three statements exist rather than one.
7f79c3cbf0d9.sw: Faida ni maoni yaliyoumbwa na chaguo za uhasibu. Fedha ni ukweli. Ndiyo sababu taarifa tatu zipo badala ya moja.

7f7ca52398ad.en: The pressure to enter a position because others appear to be profiting, rather than because the position meets a standard you set in advance.
7f7ca52398ad.sw: Shinikizo la kuingia katika nafasi kwa sababu wengine wanaonekana kupata faida, badala ya kwa sababu nafasi hukidhi kiwango ulichoweka mapema.

7f97ee56174e.en: Two operational details from the case are worth carrying forward, because both are checkable today.
7f97ee56174e.sw: Vipengele viwili vya kiuendeshaji kutoka kesi vinastahili kuchukuliwa mbele, kwa sababu vyote vinaweza kukaguliwa leo.

7f9d2bf3dd39.en: Lesson 2 established where coins live: on the blockchain, the shared ledger that thousands of computers each keep a full copy of. Coins never leave that ledger. When someone "sends you bitcoin," no coin file arrives on your phone. The ledger updates to say that a certain amount is now spendable by a certain address — and every copy of the ledger agrees. So if the coins stay on the ledger, what does a wallet actually hold?
7f9d2bf3dd39.sw: Somo la 2 lilithibitisha sarafu zinapoishi: katika mnyororo wa vitalu, leja inayoshirikiwa ambayo maelfu ya kompyuta kila moja hutunza nakala kamili yake. Sarafu haziondoki kamwe kwenye leja hiyo. Mtu "anapokutumia bitcoin," hakuna faili la sarafu linalofika kwenye simu yako. Leja hujisasisha kusema kwamba kiasi fulani sasa kinaweza kutumiwa na anwani fulani — na kila nakala ya leja hukubaliana. Kwa hivyo ikiwa sarafu hubaki kwenye leja, pochi hushikilia nini hasa?

7f9f752031e7.en: Find the fact sheet for any broad index fund and locate the combined weight of its ten largest holdings. Write the figure down. Then decide honestly whether you would have chosen to put that proportion of your money into those ten companies as a deliberate decision. The rule made that choice for you, and the fact sheet is where you find out what it chose.
7f9f752031e7.sw: Tafuta karatasi ya taarifa ya index fund yoyote pana na upate uzito wa pamoja wa umiliki wake kumi mkubwa zaidi. Andika takwimu hiyo. Kisha amua kwa uaminifu kama ungechagua kuweka uwiano huo wa pesa zako katika kampuni hizo kumi kama uamuzi wa makusudi. Kanuni ilikufanyia chaguo hilo, na karatasi ya taarifa ndipo unapogundua ilichagua nini.

7fa530eefe5e.en: The six pillars are fundamentals, valuation, catalyst, positioning and sentiment, momentum, and carry. Take each in its equity form.
7fa530eefe5e.sw: Nguzo sita ni misingi, tathmini, kichocheo, msimamo na hisia za soko, kasi, na kubeba. Chukua kila moja katika umbo lake la hisa.

7fa5bc697f3a.en: The Anchor Protocol offered roughly 20% a year on UST deposits. At the peak, close to 75% of all UST in existence was sitting in Anchor. The stablecoin was not being used as a stablecoin. It was the ticket required to collect the yield.
7fa5bc697f3a.sw: Anchor Protocol ilitoa takriban 20% kwa mwaka juu ya amana za UST. Katika kilele, karibu 75% ya UST yote iliyokuwepo ilikuwa imeketi katika Anchor. Sarafu imara haikuwa ikitumika kama sarafu imara. Ilikuwa tikiti inayohitajika kukusanya mavuno.

7fba10c7a826.en: Multiples do not travel well across industries or across countries. A software company and a shipping company have different capital requirements, different growth prospects and different risks, so their multiples should differ permanently rather than converge. Accounting standards also differ by jurisdiction, which means the earnings figure in the denominator is not always constructed the same way.
7fba10c7a826.sw: Vizidishi havisafiri vizuri katika sekta mbalimbali wala nchi mbalimbali. Kampuni ya programu na kampuni ya usafirishaji wa baharini zina mahitaji tofauti ya mtaji, matarajio tofauti ya ukuaji na hatari tofauti, hivyo vizidishi vyao vinapaswa kutofautiana kwa kudumu badala ya kuungana. Viwango vya uhasibu pia hutofautiana kwa eneo la kisheria, jambo linalomaanisha takwimu ya mapato katika kigawanyaji haijengwi kwa njia ile ile daima.

7fd1fa8c193f.en: What did the Nixon Shock actually announce?
7fd1fa8c193f.sw: Mshtuko wa Nixon ulitangaza nini hasa?

7fd59bed5a95.en: Notice what a narrative does to the burden of proof. A story explains why an asset should be worth more. Buying pressure then makes the price go up. Nothing about the rising price tested the story - the price rose because people acted on it. But to a newcomer arriving at the point where prices are already rising, the chart looks like evidence. The story and its proof have quietly become the same event.
7fd59bed5a95.sw: Tambua simulizi hufanya nini kwa jukumu la kuthibitisha. Hadithi hueleza kwa nini rasilimali inapaswa kuwa na thamani zaidi. Shinikizo la kununua kisha hufanya bei ipande. Hakuna kuhusu bei inayopanda kilichoipima hadithi - bei ilipanda kwa sababu watu walitenda juu yake. Lakini kwa mgeni anayefika katika nukta ambapo bei tayari zinapanda, chati huonekana kama ushahidi. Hadithi na uthibitisho wake kimya kimya vimekuwa tukio lilelile.

7fd5ecc3891d.en: What does fractional reserve banking actually allow a bank to do?
7fd5ecc3891d.sw: Benki ya akiba ya sehemu inairuhusu benki kufanya nini hasa?

7fe23216bdeb.en: A bank holding 100 gold coins but promising 500 IOUs can only cover a fraction of holders if they all show up at once.
7fe23216bdeb.sw: Benki inayoshikilia sarafu 100 za dhahabu lakini ikiahidi hati 500 za IOU inaweza kulipa sehemu tu ya wenye nazo kama wote watafika kwa wakati mmoja.

80084829ac30.en: Take someone investing 200 a month for 30 years. Assume the underlying market returns 7% a year. Everything below uses that same schedule and differs only in the fee.
80084829ac30.sw: Chukua mtu anayewekeza 200 kwa mwezi kwa miaka 30. Dhania soko la msingi hurudisha 7% kwa mwaka. Kila kitu kilicho hapa chini hutumia ratiba hiyohiyo na hutofautiana katika ada pekee.

800ba4804474.en: Total supply is every unit created including locked units; max supply is the hard ceiling the software allows.
800ba4804474.sw: Usambazaji jumla ni kila kipimo kilichoundwa ikiwa ni pamoja na vipimo vilivyofungiwa; usambazaji wa juu kabisa ni dari ngumu ambayo programu huiruhusu.

802dd8706121.en: One more general lesson, and it applies well beyond this case.
802dd8706121.sw: Somo moja zaidi la jumla, nalo hutumika mbali zaidi ya kesi hii.

803d6228ad23.en: What did the peer-reviewed research actually find about the stock-to-flow model?
803d6228ad23.sw: Utafiti uliopitiwa na wenzao ulibaini nini hasa kuhusu mfano wa hisa-kwa-mtiririko?

80490ec51ff3.en: About 2%, and it depends on how accurate your analysis is
80490ec51ff3.sw: Takriban 2%, nao hutegemea uchambuzi wako ulivyo sahihi

80530aa9028b.en: There's a long-standing hierarchy — sometimes called a "pecking order" — that determines which currency conventionally sits as the base when two major currencies are paired: the euro outranks the British pound, which outranks the Australian and New Zealand dollars, which outrank the U.S. dollar itself, which outranks the Canadian dollar, Swiss franc, and Japanese yen. That's why the market quotes EUR/USD and USD/CAD, but never USD/EUR or CAD/USD.
80530aa9028b.sw: Kuna daraja la muda mrefu — wakati mwingine huitwa "pecking order" — linaloamua ni sarafu ipi kwa kawaida hukaa kama msingi sarafu mbili kuu zinapowekwa pamoja: euro huizidi pauni ya Uingereza, ambayo huzidi dola za Australia na New Zealand, ambazo huzidi dola ya Marekani yenyewe, ambayo huzidi dola ya Kanada, faranga ya Uswisi, na yen ya Japani. Ndiyo maana soko hunukuu EUR/USD na USD/CAD, lakini kamwe si USD/EUR au CAD/USD.

805ecb0557ed.en: Chapter 3 Lesson 2 gave the recovery arithmetic. Applied here it is brutal.
805ecb0557ed.sw: Sura ya 3 Somo la 2 lilitoa hesabu ya kupona. Ikitumika hapa ni ya kikatili.

80662aefdfe7.en: Be careful with any strategy discovered by searching historical data. Test enough rules against the same history and some will look excellent by chance alone. The course made this point in Foundations Chapter 3 about chart patterns, and it applies with equal force here — the difference is that the value premium was found in a much larger body of data and has been re-tested across many markets, which is a reason to take it more seriously, not a reason to treat it as settled.
80662aefdfe7.sw: Kuwa makini na mkakati wowote uliogunduliwa kwa kutafuta data ya kihistoria. Jaribu kanuni za kutosha dhidi ya historia ile ile na baadhi zitaonekana bora kwa bahati peke yake. Kozi ilitoa pointi hii katika Sura ya 3 ya Msingi kuhusu mitindo ya chati, na inatumika kwa nguvu sawa hapa — tofauti ni kwamba malipo ya ziada ya thamani yalipatikana katika mkusanyiko mkubwa mno wa data na yamejaribiwa upya katika masoko mengi, ambayo ni sababu ya kuyachukulia kwa uzito zaidi, si sababu ya kuyachukulia kama yaliyokamilika.

80665902170e.en: So the equity version of the question is not where would I get out, but how much of this can I hold and still be fine if it goes to zero overnight.
80665902170e.sw: Hivyo toleo la hisa la swali si ningetokea wapi, bali ninaweza kushikilia kiasi gani cha hiki na bado nikawa sawa kama kitaenda sifuri usiku mmoja.

80822ae8c510.en: Correct — central ledgers run by banks, card networks, and even Chaum's DigiCash solved double-spending for decades. The cost was trusting the referee; Nakamoto's 2008 paper proposed a peer-to-peer network and proof-of-work instead.
80822ae8c510.sw: Sahihi — leja kuu zinazoendeshwa na benki, mitandao ya kadi, na hata DigiCash ya Chaum zilitatua kutumia-mara-mbili kwa miongo. Gharama ilikuwa kumwamini mwamuzi; karatasi ya Nakamoto ya 2008 ilipendekeza mtandao wa rika-kwa-rika na uthibitisho-wa-kazi badala yake.

80a3916699e2.en: Not quite — it's the opposite. Defending a fixed gold peg during a recession usually means tightening money, not loosening it.
80a3916699e2.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — ni kinyume chake. Kutetea kifungo thabiti cha dhahabu wakati wa mdororo kwa kawaida kunamaanisha kubana pesa, si kuzilegeza.

80b734b6cac8.en: The next lesson but one examines a case where roughly 20% a year was paid on billions of dollars of deposits, in public, for months, and where the answer to where does the yield come from was that it was being paid out of a reserve until the reserve ran out. It was not hidden. It was disclosed, discussed, and widely rationalised, and it still ended the way the arithmetic said it had to.
80b734b6cac8.sw: Somo linalofuata lakini moja huchunguza kesi ambapo takriban 20% kwa mwaka ililipwa juu ya mabilioni ya dola za amana, hadharani, kwa miezi, na ambapo jibu la mavuno hutoka wapi lilikuwa kwamba yalikuwa yakilipwa kutoka akiba hadi akiba ilipoisha. Halikufichwa. Lilifichuliwa, kujadiliwa, na kuhalalishwa sana, na bado liliisha kwa njia ambayo hesabu ilisema lazima liishe.

80bdd29bfe4d.en: They made a valuation error when they first invested
80bdd29bfe4d.sw: Walifanya kosa la uthaminishaji walipowekeza mwanzoni

80f6855c4e94.sw: Kubadilisha kanuni za mtandao kwa kudumu

8120b6dc45c6.en: The tendency for many traders' stop-loss and take-profit orders to pile up at the same round-number price levels, making those levels act as real support and resistance.
8120b6dc45c6.sw: Mwelekeo wa maagizo ya stop-loss na take-profit ya wafanyabiashara wengi kurundikana kwenye viwango vile vile vya bei za namba za mviringo, na kufanya viwango hivyo vitende kama msaada na upinzani halisi.

81288429d8f7.en: The portfolio ends at about 99% of its peak, having given back essentially the whole gain; a band restoring 5% at the top would have taken roughly 14 units off the table as a rule rather than a forecast
81288429d8f7.sw: Kasha huishia katika takriban 99% ya kilele chake, likiwa limerudisha kimsingi faida yote; ukanda unaorejesha 5% kileleni ungeondoa takriban vipimo 14 mezani kama kanuni badala ya utabiri

812cad3990ce.en: Central banks don't actually target any specific inflation rate
812cad3990ce.sw: Benki kuu hazilengi kiwango chochote mahususi cha mfumuko wa bei kwa kweli

814693e3269d.en: They lost the dividends on shares they already held
814693e3269d.sw: Alipoteza gawio la hisa alizokuwa tayari anazishikilia

814a0c1bf1e4.en: The value of coins moving into addresses an analyst believes belong to a centralized exchange (inflows), and out of them (outflows). Net flow is inflows minus outflows over a period.
814a0c1bf1e4.sw: Thamani ya sarafu zinazoingia katika anwani ambazo mchambuzi anaamini ni za soko la kubadilisha lenye kituo kikuu (miingizo), na zinazotoka kwake (mitoko). Mtiririko halisi ni miingizo ukiondoa mitoko katika kipindi.

816060f6bb6b.en: Because holdings cannot be counted accurately in a fund
816060f6bb6b.sw: Kwa sababu umiliki hauwezi kuhesabiwa kwa usahihi katika fund

816528008626.en: Free cash flow is about 10 million, so very little of the reported profit is genuinely available to owners
816528008626.sw: Mtiririko huru wa fedha ni takriban milioni 10, hivyo sehemu ndogo mno ya faida iliyoripotiwa inapatikana kweli kwa wamiliki

8180072c21f7.en: That word roughly is carrying real weight, and the honest version of this is more interesting than the tidy one.

81b7568fbe01.en: Two funds track the same index. The first charges 0.07% and lagged the index by 0.19% a year. The second charges 0.12% and lagged by 0.10%. The second is more expensive on the page and cheaper in reality, and only the tracking difference reveals it.

81d5a0b71175.en: Bankruptcy is not an event but a process, measured in years. Customers became unsecured creditors, filed claims, waited, and made decisions about whether to sell those claims to specialist buyers at a discount. Many sold, because they needed the money or could not tolerate the uncertainty, and they crystallised a loss that later recoveries would have partly reversed. None of that shows on a chart, and all of it is what a counterparty failure actually costs the person it happens to.
81d5a0b71175.sw: Kufilisika si tukio bali mchakato, unaopimwa kwa miaka. Wateja wakawa wadai wasio na dhamana, waliwasilisha madai, walisubiri, na walifanya maamuzi kuhusu kama kuuza madai hayo kwa wanunuzi wataalamu kwa punguzo. Wengi waliuza, kwa sababu walihitaji pesa au hawakuweza kuvumilia kutokuwa na uhakika, nao walitimiza hasara ambayo urejeshaji wa baadaye ungeitendua kwa sehemu. Hakuna kati ya hayo kinachoonekana kwenye chati, na yote hayo ndiyo hasa kushindwa kwa mshirika hugharimu mtu kinachomtokea.

81d8f7641be1.en: On the crypto side, Bitcoin's annualized realized volatility has been running in the low-to-mid 40s in percentage terms in recent years. Fidelity Digital Assets, in its research note A Closer Look at Bitcoin's Volatility, reported Bitcoin's 90-day realized volatility averaging in the mid-40s over the two years to 2024 to 2025. BlackRock's iShares published a higher figure of roughly 54% for a window ending near the start of 2025, alongside 15.1% for gold and 10.5% for global equities. The two figures differ because the windows and the ending dates differ, which is exactly the point. Treat both as commercial research from firms that sell exposure to these assets, and note that they agree on the range even where they disagree on the second digit.
81d8f7641be1.sw: Upande wa kripto, mtikisiko uliotimizwa wa mwaka wa Bitcoin umekuwa ukiendeshwa katika 40 za chini-hadi-kati kwa maneno ya asilimia katika miaka ya hivi karibuni. Fidelity Digital Assets, katika andiko lake la utafiti A Closer Look at Bitcoin's Volatility, iliripoti mtikisiko uliotimizwa wa siku 90 wa Bitcoin ukiwa wastani katika 40 za kati katika miaka miwili hadi 2024 hadi 2025. iShares ya BlackRock ilichapisha takwimu ya juu zaidi ya takriban 54% kwa dirisha lililoishia karibu na mwanzo wa 2025, sambamba na 15.1% kwa dhahabu na 10.5% kwa hisa za kimataifa. Takwimu hizo mbili hutofautiana kwa sababu madirisha na tarehe za kuishia hutofautiana, ambacho ndicho hasa kiini. Zichukulie zote kama utafiti wa kibiashara kutoka kampuni zinazouza kufunuliwa kwa rasilimali hizi, na utambue kwamba zinakubaliana kuhusu kiwango hata pale zinapotofautiana kuhusu tarakimu ya pili.

81f2d39d29d6.en: Same 5,000-dollar account, same 50 dollars at risk, same Bitcoin at 60,000 dollars. But now use the forex-sized stop: 0.463% of price, which is 278 dollars. Position size = 50 / 278 = 0.18 Bitcoin. At 60,000 dollars, that is 10,800 dollars of exposure — the same size as the forex trade, achieved exactly as hoped. Now measure that stop against the market instead of against your ambition. The ATR was 1,900 dollars. The stop is 278 / 1,900 = 0.146 of one ATR, or about one-seventh of a single average day. On the five bars used to compute that ATR, the smallest true range was 1,700 dollars, which is 6.1 times the stop distance. On every one of those five days, price travelled more than six times the distance to your stop.
81f2d39d29d6.sw: Akaunti ileile ya dola 5,000, dola 50 zilezile hatarini, Bitcoin ileile katika dola 60,000. Lakini sasa tumia kusimamisha kwa ukubwa wa forex: 0.463% ya bei, ambayo ni dola 278. Ukubwa wa nafasi = 50 / 278 = Bitcoin 0.18. Katika dola 60,000, hiyo ni dola 10,800 za kufunuliwa — ukubwa uleule kama biashara ya forex, ukifikiwa hasa kama ulivyotumaini. Sasa pima kusimamisha huko dhidi ya soko badala ya dhidi ya tamaa yako. ATR ilikuwa dola 1,900. Kusimamisha ni 278 / 1,900 = 0.146 ya ATR moja, au takriban sehemu moja ya saba ya siku moja ya wastani. Katika mistari mitano iliyotumika kuhesabu ATR hiyo, kiwango halisi kidogo zaidi kilikuwa dola 1,700, ambacho ni mara 6.1 ya umbali wa kusimamisha. Katika kila moja ya siku hizo tano, bei ilisafiri zaidi ya mara sita ya umbali hadi kusimamisha kwako.

81fb3f9d5480.en: Every piece of that maps onto something you already know. Thin liquidity is the flip side of the bid-ask spread from Chapter 1, Lesson 4 — when few participants are willing to trade, prices move much further for a given order. The stop-loss cascade is the stop-out mechanics of Chapter 3, Lesson 2 at market scale: falling prices trigger stops, which become market sell orders, which push prices lower, which trigger more stops. And the timing is the mirror image of the economic-calendar discipline in Chapter 2, Lesson 4 — the market was fragile precisely because it was the hour when almost no one was trading.
81fb3f9d5480.sw: Kila kipande cha hicho kinaunganika na kitu unachokijua tayari. Ukwasi mdogo ni upande wa pili wa spread ya bid-ask kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 4 — washiriki wachache wanapokuwa tayari kufanya biashara, bei husogea mbali zaidi mno kwa agizo fulani. Mfululizo wa stop-loss ni utaratibu wa stop-out wa Sura ya 3, Somo la 2 kwa kipimo cha soko: bei zinazoshuka huanzisha stop, ambazo hukuwa maagizo ya soko ya kuuza, ambayo husukuma bei chini, ambayo huanzisha stop zaidi. Na muda ni kioo cha nidhamu ya kalenda ya kiuchumi katika Sura ya 2, Somo la 4 — soko lilikuwa dhaifu hasa kwa sababu ilikuwa saa ambayo karibu hakuna aliyekuwa akifanya biashara.

820c8ec29e31.en: One argument you will meet constantly deserves taking apart. It runs: this token's market cap is 20 million dollars and that other token's is 20 billion, so this one has 1,000 times the room to grow. Every part of that is a supply-side statement. Market cap is price times circulating supply, so saying the cap is small says only that price times float is small. It says nothing about whether anyone wants the token.
820c8ec29e31.sw: Hoja moja utakayokutana nayo mara kwa mara inastahili kuchambuliwa. Inaendeshwa hivi: kiasi cha soko cha tokeni hii ni dola milioni 20 na cha tokeni ile nyingine ni bilioni 20, kwa hivyo hii ina nafasi mara 1,000 ya kukua. Kila sehemu ya hiyo ni kauli ya upande wa usambazaji. Kiasi cha soko ni bei mara usambazaji unaozunguka, kwa hivyo kusema kiasi ni kidogo husema tu kwamba bei mara uelezi ni ndogo. Haisemi lolote kuhusu kama yeyote anataka tokeni.

JPY inagawanyika kama JP (Japan) + Y (Yen). CAD ni CA (Canada) + D (Dollar).

824e3d93048d.en: You go long EUR/USD at 1.1000 with your stop at 1.0970, a 30-pip risk. That stop distance is your 1R. If you set your target at 1.1060 — 60 pips away, twice the stop distance — the trade is a 1:2 risk-to-reward. If price reaches the target you gain 2R; if it hits the stop you lose 1R.

Kama utaweka lengo lako kwa 1.1060 — pip 60 mbali, mara mbili ya umbali wa stop — biashara ni hatari-kwa-tuzo ya 1:2. Kama bei itafikia lengo unapata 2R; kama itagonga stop unapoteza 1R.

8269083e6fee.en: The intuitive mean-reversion play: price touches the lower band (stretched low) → buy → exit at the middle band. Price touches the upper band (stretched high) → short → exit at the middle. Tighter bands (2 SD) give more frequent, earlier signals; wider bands (3 SD) give fewer, more extreme ones. This logic works best on instruments that genuinely oscillate around a mean — for example, currency pairs between similar, linked economies (CAD and AUD-style pairs), which tend to deviate and re-converge — and works badly on anything in a strong trend, where "stretched" just keeps stretching.
8269083e6fee.sw: Mchezo wa kueleweka wa kurudi kwa wastani: bei inagusa kanda ya chini (imenyooshwa chini) → nunua → toka kwenye kanda ya kati. Bei inagusa kanda ya juu (imenyooshwa juu) → fanya short → toka katikati. Kanda finyu (SD 2) hutoa ishara za mara kwa mara na za mapema zaidi; kanda pana (SD 3) hutoa chache na za kupindukia zaidi. Mantiki hii hufanya kazi vizuri zaidi kwenye vyombo vinavyoyumba kweli kuzunguka wastani — kwa mfano, jozi za sarafu kati ya uchumi unaofanana na uliounganishwa (jozi za mtindo wa CAD na AUD), ambazo huelekea kupotoka na kuungana tena — na hufanya kazi vibaya kwenye chochote kilicho katika mwelekeo mkali, ambapo "kunyooshwa" kunaendelea kunyooka tu.

82a5c6780250.en: Apply the test from Chapter 4 Lesson 2 here. Where did that 20% come from? Not from borrowers, because borrowing demand never came close to funding it. It came from a reserve that had been topped up to keep the rate attractive. That is a rate being paid out of capital, which can continue exactly as long as the capital lasts and not one day longer. The arithmetic was public, discussed at the time, and widely rationalised.

Ilitoka akiba iliyokuwa imejazwa ili kuweka kiwango kivutie. Hicho ni kiwango kinacholipwa kutoka mtaji, ambacho kinaweza kuendelea hasa kwa muda ambao mtaji hudumu na si siku moja zaidi. Hesabu ilikuwa ya umma, ilijadiliwa wakati huo, na ikahalalishwa sana.

82aa3cb13f78.en: Consider how an ordinary investor might realistically find an edge. Not by reading published results, which are priced within minutes. Not from price charts, which every participant sees. Possibly from a genuinely long horizon — being willing to hold through a decade that a fund manager judged quarterly cannot survive. That is a structural advantage a private investor actually has, and it does not require beating anyone at analysis.

Si kutoka chati za bei, ambazo kila mshiriki huziona. Huenda kutoka kwa upeo mrefu kweli — kuwa tayari kushikilia kupitia muongo ambao msimamizi wa fund anayehukumiwa kila robo mwaka hawezi kunusurika. Hiyo ni faida ya kimuundo ambayo mwekezaji binafsi anayo hasa, na haihitaji kumshinda mtu yeyote katika uchambuzi.

82c1fe1d0bb8.en: What does the evidence say? One of the most-cited academic studies of technical analysis — Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), Journal of Finance — tested exactly these moving-average rules on nearly a century of Dow Jones data and found they showed genuine predictive ability. But the follow-up literature matters just as much: later research questioned how well those results survive transaction costs and the risk of data-snooping (testing many rules and reporting the ones that happened to work). Meanwhile the recent FX-specific study you met in Foundations Chapter 3 — Ghanem et al. (2024), 497 rules, 10 currencies, 22 years — found technical rules do significantly predict currency movements. The honest summary: crossovers are one of the few indicator families with real academic support, and also one where the support comes with genuine caveats. Use them as a tool, not a truth.
82c1fe1d0bb8.sw: Ushahidi unasema nini? Mojawapo ya tafiti za kitaaluma zinazonukuliwa zaidi za uchambuzi wa kiufundi — Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), Journal of Finance — ilijaribu kanuni hizi hizi za wastani unaosogea kwa karibu karne moja ya data ya Dow Jones na ikagundua zilionyesha uwezo halisi wa kutabiri. Lakini fasihi iliyofuata inahusika kwa kiasi kile kile: utafiti wa baadaye ulihoji jinsi matokeo hayo yanavyonusurika gharama za miamala na hatari ya kupekua data (kujaribu kanuni nyingi na kuripoti zile zilizobahatika kufanya kazi). Wakati huo huo utafiti wa hivi karibuni mahususi wa FX uliokutana nao katika Sura ya 3 ya Msingi — Ghanem et al. (2024), kanuni 497, sarafu 10, miaka 22 — uligundua kanuni za kiufundi hutabiri kwa kiasi kikubwa misogeo ya sarafu. Muhtasari wa uaminifu: mikatizo ni mojawapo ya familia chache za viashiria zenye uungwaji mkono halisi wa kitaaluma, na pia mojawapo ambapo uungwaji mkono huo unakuja na maonyo halisi. Zitumie kama zana, si ukweli.

83b45ae9b82d.en: This is why the standard advice is to write a seed phrase on paper or metal and store it offline, and why no serious wallet ever emails it to you or stores it "in your account." A phrase kept only in your head can be forgotten. A phrase kept as a screenshot can be stolen by any app that reads your photos. The backup problem is real, physical, and yours.
83b45ae9b82d.sw: Ndiyo maana ushauri wa kawaida ni kuandika kifungu cha mbegu kwenye karatasi au chuma na kukihifadhi nje ya mtandao, na ndiyo maana hakuna pochi makini inayowahi kukutumia kwa barua pepe au kukihifadhi "katika akaunti yako." Kifungu kilichohifadhiwa kichwani pekee kinaweza kusahaulika. Kifungu kilichohifadhiwa kama picha ya skrini kinaweza kuibiwa na programu yoyote inayosoma picha zako. Tatizo la nakala rudufu ni halisi, la kimwili, nalo ni lako.

83c94371cc6b.en: Diagram showing the interest-rate-to-currency transmission chain, hawkish vs dovish stances, and the academic complication from the forward premium puzzle
83c94371cc6b.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha mnyororo wa usambazaji kutoka kiwango cha riba hadi sarafu, misimamo ya hawkish dhidi ya dovish, na utata wa kitaaluma kutoka fumbo la malipo ya mbele

83d15c010d07.en: A sequence of words (commonly 12 or 24, from the BIP-39 standard's fixed word list) that encodes the master secret from which a wallet generates all of its private keys. Anyone who has the phrase can rebuild the entire wallet — every key, every coin — on any device, anywhere.
83d15c010d07.sw: Mfuatano wa maneno (kwa kawaida 12 au 24, kutoka orodha isiyobadilika ya maneno ya kiwango cha BIP-39) unaosimba siri kuu ambayo kutoka kwake pochi huzalisha funguo zake zote za faragha. Yeyote aliye na kifungu anaweza kujenga upya pochi nzima — kila ufunguo, kila sarafu — katika kifaa chochote, popote.

83da00b2d86d.en: Diagram of portfolio-level discipline — the research funnel narrowing many scanned ideas down to the few traded, the evidence that best-analysed ideas outperform by about 2.8 to 4.5 percent a year (Anton/Cohen/Polk) and that high Active Share backed by analysis outperforms (Cremers & Petajisto 2009), the rule to concentrate conviction but not risk, and post-trade review that judges the decision rather than the result
83da00b2d86d.sw: Mchoro wa nidhamu ya kiwango cha mkusanyiko — faneli ya utafiti ikipunguza mawazo mengi yaliyochunguzwa hadi machache yanayofanyiwa biashara, ushahidi kwamba mawazo yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi hufanya vizuri zaidi kwa takriban asilimia 2.8 hadi 4.5 kwa mwaka (Anton/Cohen/Polk) na kwamba Active Share kubwa inayoungwa mkono na uchambuzi hufanya vizuri zaidi (Cremers & Petajisto 2009), kanuni ya kujikita kwa uhakika lakini si hatari, na ukaguzi wa baada ya biashara unaohukumu uamuzi badala ya tokeo

83f3062df971.en: The 1944 international agreement under which most currencies were pegged to the U.S. dollar, while the dollar itself remained convertible to gold at a fixed rate.
83f3062df971.sw: Makubaliano ya kimataifa ya mwaka 1944 ambapo sarafu nyingi zilifungwa kwenye dola ya Marekani, huku dola yenyewe ikibaki inabadilishwa kuwa dhahabu kwa kiwango thabiti.

840222ee9efc.en: Spreading a sum over twelve months means that on average only about half of it is invested during that year. If the market rises over the period — the more common outcome — the uninvested half earned nothing. The strategy did not fail; it did exactly what it promised, and what it promised was less exposure.
840222ee9efc.sw: Kueneza kiasi katika miezi kumi na miwili kunamaanisha kwamba kwa wastani takriban nusu yake tu imewekezwa katika mwaka huo. Kama soko litapanda katika kipindi hicho — tokeo la kawaida zaidi — nusu isiyowekezwa haikupata chochote. Mkakati haukushindwa; ulifanya hasa ulichoahidi, na ulichoahidi ni uwazi mdogo.

840645adf1d8.en: This is the whole logic of the written plan in Lesson 3, and it is worth understanding why it works. A rule written on a calm Sunday is not smarter than you are at two in the morning. It was simply written by someone who was not looking at a price at the time, and that turns out to be the entire advantage.
840645adf1d8.sw: Hii ndiyo mantiki nzima ya mpango ulioandikwa katika Somo la 3, nayo inastahili kuelewa kwa nini hufanya kazi. Kanuni iliyoandikwa Jumapili tulivu si yenye akili zaidi kuliko wewe saa nane usiku. Iliandikwa tu na mtu ambaye hakuwa akiangalia bei wakati huo, na hilo hujitokeza kuwa faida nzima.

8420a1379931.en: "Dollar," "peso," and "franc" are used by many different, unrelated currencies — the peso alone belongs to Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, the Philippines, and several other countries, each a completely separate currency. A currency name is genuinely ambiguous. A three-letter ISO code is not — which is the entire reason the standard exists.
8420a1379931.sw: "Dola," "peso," na "faranga" hutumiwa na sarafu nyingi tofauti zisizohusiana — peso peke yake ni ya Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Kolombia, Ufilipino, na nchi nyingine kadhaa, kila moja ikiwa sarafu tofauti kabisa. Jina la sarafu lina utata kweli. Msimbo wa ISO wa herufi tatu hauna — ndiyo sababu yote ya kuwepo kwa kiwango hicho.

8422865672d7.en: It guarantees transactions are processed in under ten minutes
8422865672d7.sw: Huhakikisha miamala inashughulikiwa chini ya dakika kumi

84274f973aed.en: Correct — at 1:2, break-even is 33.3%, so a 40% win rate is profitable (+0.2R per trade). At 1:1, break-even is 50%, so the same 40% win rate loses. The ratio, not the win rate, flips the outcome.
84274f973aed.sw: Sahihi — kwa 1:2, kulingana ni 33.3%, hivyo kiwango cha ushindi cha 40% kina faida (+0.2R kwa kila biashara). Kwa 1:1, kulingana ni 50%, hivyo kiwango kile kile cha ushindi cha 40% hupoteza. Uwiano, si kiwango cha ushindi, ndio hubadilisha tokeo.

845461b64244.en: A website or tool that lets anyone look up any transaction, address, or block on a public blockchain and see its status, confirmations, and fees. Every major chain has several independent explorers; no account is needed.

8464cbe89411.en: Efficiency is a spectrum, not a switch, and it means prices reflect information rather than that they are right.

846b165e5188.sw: Kwa sababu pesa nyingi iliwasili baada ya mwaka wa nguvu, hivyo kila kipimo cha wastani cha pesa kilipitia hasa mwaka wa pili

84a23cd98f2a.en: The price of the underlying asset at which a position's equity falls to its maintenance margin, so the exchange closes it. For a long position it sits below the entry price; for a short, above. It can be computed before you open the trade, and it should be.
84a23cd98f2a.sw: Bei ya rasilimali ya msingi ambapo usawa wa nafasi hushuka hadi mkopo wake wa kudumisha, kwa hivyo soko la kubadilisha huifunga. Kwa nafasi ndefu hukaa chini ya bei ya kuingia; kwa fupi, juu. Inaweza kuhesabiwa kabla hujafungua biashara, nayo inapaswa.

84a3af0373f2.en: Risk management is what makes a good trader — not the ability to predict market direction.
84a3af0373f2.sw: Usimamizi wa hatari ndicho kinachomfanya mfanyabiashara mzuri — si uwezo wa kutabiri mwelekeo wa soko.

84a8928ad4f0.en: In crypto the counterparty is frequently the risk. Fraud recognition is not an add-on to the skill set — it is part of it, and it runs on structural markers rather than on instinct.
84a8928ad4f0.sw: Katika kripto mshirika mara nyingi ndiye hatari. Kutambua udanganyifu si nyongeza kwa seti ya ujuzi — ni sehemu yake, nako hukimbia juu ya alama za kimuundo badala ya juu ya silika.

84b79883f7f7.sw: Noti kuhusu kile ambacho kufilisika kulitoa na kisichotoa, kwa sababu mara nyingi huripotiwa vibaya.

84e4b78c3398.en: That double channel is why long-duration shares — companies whose value depends on profits far in the future — move most when rates move. It is the same arithmetic as Chapter 2 Lesson 2. A high multiple is a bet on distant cash flows, and distant cash flows are exactly what a higher discount rate reduces most.
84e4b78c3398.sw: Njia hiyo maradufu ndiyo sababu hisa za muda mrefu — kampuni ambazo thamani yake hutegemea faida za mbali za baadaye — husonga zaidi viwango vya riba vinaposonga. Ni hesabu ileile kama Sura ya 2 Somo la 2. Kizidishi kikubwa ni dau juu ya mitiririko ya fedha ya mbali, na mitiririko ya fedha ya mbali ndiyo hasa kile ambacho kiwango cha juu cha punguzo hukipunguza zaidi.

84f424d1027d.en: A bank solves this by decree: the bank's version is the version. A decentralized network cannot decree. So it does something stranger: it makes the right to write the next block expensive, and it pays the writer for doing it honestly. The two dominant systems differ only in what the expense is. Proof of Work makes it expensive in electricity and hardware. Proof of Stake makes it expensive in locked-up capital that can be destroyed. Everything else in this lesson is detail.
84f424d1027d.sw: Benki hutatua hili kwa amri: toleo la benki ndilo toleo. Mtandao usio na kituo kikuu hauwezi kuamuru. Kwa hivyo hufanya kitu cha ajabu zaidi: hufanya haki ya kuandika kitalu kinachofuata kuwa ghali, na humlipa mwandishi kwa kufanya hivyo kwa uaminifu. Mifumo miwili inayotawala hutofautiana katika gharama ni nini pekee. Uthibitisho wa Kazi hufanya iwe ghali katika umeme na maunzi. Uthibitisho wa Hisa hufanya iwe ghali katika mtaji uliofungiwa unaoweza kuharibiwa. Kila kitu kingine katika somo hili ni maelezo.

84f4bf5788e9.en: A workable default. Anything you are actively trading stays on the exchange, capped at an amount you would be prepared to lose entirely if that exchange failed. Everything above that cap moves to self-custody within a stated period, such as a week. The cap is a number, written down, and it is reviewed when the portfolio grows rather than when the news is bad.
84f4bf5788e9.sw: Chaguo-msingi linalofanya kazi. Chochote unachokifanyia biashara kwa bidii hubaki katika soko la kubadilisha, kikiwekewa dari ya kiasi ambacho ungekuwa tayari kukipoteza kabisa ikiwa soko hilo litashindwa. Kila kitu juu ya dari hiyo huhamia utunzaji binafsi ndani ya kipindi kilichotajwa, kama vile wiki. Dari ni namba, iliyoandikwa, nayo hukaguliwa kasha linapokua badala ya wakati habari zikiwa mbaya.

852135b25ec9.en: That the issuer's entire business, controls, and operations have been examined and approved
852135b25ec9.sw: Kwamba biashara nzima ya mtoaji, udhibiti, na uendeshaji vimechunguzwa na kuidhinishwa

855d31c419e0.en: Chapter 2 Lesson 3 established the evidence that crypto trades as a high-beta risk asset rather than as an independent one, and that the diversification argument largely failed in 2022 when it was needed. This lesson is what to do with that fact.
855d31c419e0.sw: Sura ya 2 Somo la 3 lilithibitisha ushahidi kwamba kripto hufanyiwa biashara kama rasilimali ya hatari yenye beta kubwa badala ya kama huru, na kwamba hoja ya mtawanyiko kwa kiasi kikubwa ilishindwa mwaka 2022 ilipohitajika. Somo hili ni la kufanya nini na ukweli huo.

856483751e88.en: That exchange interfaces are usually inaccurate
856483751e88.sw: Kwamba violesura vya masoko ya kubadilisha kwa kawaida si sahihi

856b3c318151.en: If you are contributing steadily, a fall early on is helpful — your later contributions buy at lower prices. If you are drawing an income, the same fall early on is severe, because you sell units at depressed prices to live on and there are fewer left to recover.
856b3c318151.sw: Kama unachangia kwa uthabiti, kushuka mapema ni msaada — michango yako ya baadaye hununua kwa bei za chini. Kama unatoa mapato, kushuka kule kule mapema ni kali, kwa sababu unauza vipimo kwa bei zilizoshuka ili kuishi na vichache vinabaki kupona.

8577d2a0797a.en: This sharpens the stop-loss from Chapter 3. A beginner puts a stop "far enough away to not get hit." A professional puts it exactly where the thesis breaks: below the support that the whole case rested on, or beyond the level that would mean the catalyst failed. If price reaches the invalidation level, you are not unlucky — you were wrong, and the stop is simply recording that.
8577d2a0797a.sw: Hii hunoa stop-loss kutoka Sura ya 3. Anayeanza huweka stop "mbali vya kutosha isigongwe." Mtaalamu huiweka hasa pale nadharia inapovunjika: chini ya msaada ambao hoja yote ilikaa juu yake, au zaidi ya kiwango ambacho kingemaanisha kichocheo kimeshindwa. Kama bei itafikia kiwango cha kuvunjika, huna bahati mbaya — ulikosea, na stop inarekodi hilo tu.

8582474da6b8.en: The first is a pre-trade checklist — a handful of yes-or-no questions you run before every entry. Did a planned setup actually trigger? Is the stop at a real invalidation level, placed as an order? Does the risk-to-reward clear my minimum? Is my size within my risk percentage? Am I trading a rule, or chasing? If any answer is no, there is no trade. The checklist catches mistakes in advance, while you can still not make them.
8582474da6b8.sw: Ya kwanza ni orodha ya ukaguzi ya kabla ya biashara — maswali machache ya ndiyo-au-hapana unayoyapitia kabla ya kila kuingia. Je, mpangilio uliopangwa ulianzishwa hasa? Je, stop iko kwenye kiwango halisi cha kuvunjika, imewekwa kama agizo? Je, hatari-kwa-tuzo inapita kiwango changu cha chini? Je, ukubwa wangu uko ndani ya asilimia yangu ya hatari? Je, ninafanya biashara ya kanuni, au ninafukuza? Kama jibu lolote ni hapana, hakuna biashara. Orodha ya ukaguzi hukamata makosa mapema, ukiwa bado unaweza kutoyafanya.

85cb6848a759.en: Through the late 1990s, companies with internet business models attracted valuations that could not be justified by cash flows, because most had none. Chapter 2 Lesson 2 explained that a multiple is a compressed forecast. In 1999 the forecast being compressed was that revenue would arrive later and be enormous.
85cb6848a759.sw: Katika miaka ya mwisho ya 1990, kampuni zenye mifumo ya biashara ya mtandaoni zilivutia tathmini zisizoweza kuhalalishwa na mitiririko ya fedha, kwa sababu nyingi hazikuwa nayo. Sura ya 2 Somo la 2 lilieleza kuwa kizidishi ni utabiri uliobanwa. Mwaka 1999 utabiri uliokuwa unabanwa ni kwamba mapato yangefika baadaye na yangekuwa makubwa mno.

85d62511e868.en: Chapter 1: The Mechanics of a Trade

85d94ac53729.en: Most of the time, slippage is a minor, routine cost — a fraction of a pip here or there as prices move in the instant between your order and its execution. Academic research tracking real retail futures orders end-to-end, from submission to fill, found execution is generally fast and not systematically biased against retail traders, contrary to a common complaint that "the system" favors professionals.
85d94ac53729.sw: Mara nyingi, slippage ni gharama ndogo ya kawaida — sehemu ya pip hapa au pale bei zinaposogea katika kitambo kati ya agizo lako na utekelezaji wake. Utafiti wa kitaaluma unaofuatilia maagizo halisi ya rejareja ya futures kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho, kutoka kuwasilisha hadi kutimizwa, uligundua utekelezaji kwa ujumla ni wa haraka na hauna upendeleo wa kimfumo dhidi ya wafanyabiashara wa rejareja, kinyume na lalamiko la kawaida kwamba "mfumo" unapendelea wataalamu.

85f6007c3ab9.en: A workable default: decide the maximum you would hold in any single company before you look at any company, and write it down. Deciding a limit while looking at a specific holding you are enthusiastic about is not deciding a limit.
85f6007c3ab9.sw: Chaguo-msingi linalofanya kazi: amua kiwango cha juu ungeshikilia katika kampuni yoyote moja kabla hujatazama kampuni yoyote, na uliandike. Kuamua kikomo huku ukitazama umiliki mahususi unaoufurahia si kuamua kikomo.

8636aac3ba8b.en: UST was intended to be worth one dollar. Whenever it traded below a dollar, anyone could exchange one UST for a dollar's worth of newly created LUNA, and sell that LUNA. The buying pressure this created was supposed to restore the peg. In calm conditions it worked, and it worked for long enough that a great many careful people concluded it was sound.

Wakati wowote ilipofanyiwa biashara chini ya dola, yeyote angeweza kubadilisha UST moja kwa thamani ya dola ya LUNA iliyoundwa upya, na kuuza LUNA hiyo. Shinikizo la ununuzi lililoundwa na hili lilipaswa kurejesha pegi. Katika hali tulivu lilifanya kazi, nalo lilifanya kazi kwa muda wa kutosha hivi kwamba watu makini wengi walihitimisha kwamba ulikuwa imara.

8650ad7b6296.en: As you apply MTFA: always start on the highest timeframe, and if you catch yourself opening the 5-minute chart first, stop and go back up; if the higher timeframe disagrees with the trade you want, the correct action is no trade, not a smaller timeframe; fix your three timeframes before you start looking and don't change them mid-analysis to justify an entry; and notice that a better entry shrinks your stop distance — a direct, quantifiable benefit, not just a feeling.
8650ad7b6296.sw: Unapotumia MTFA: daima anza kwenye kipindi cha juu zaidi, na ukijikuta unafungua chati ya dakika 5 kwanza, simama na urudi juu; kama kipindi cha juu zaidi hakikubaliani na biashara unayoitaka, hatua sahihi ni kutokufanya biashara, si kipindi kidogo zaidi; weka vipindi vyako vitatu kabla hujaanza kutazama na usivibadilishe katikati ya uchambuzi ili kuhalalisha kuingia; na tambua kwamba kuingia bora hupunguza umbali wako wa stop — manufaa ya moja kwa moja yanayopimika, si hisia tu.

8666c29c6f7a.en: Bitcoin uses a specific, public, heavily studied hash function called SHA-256. It was designed by the US National Security Agency and first published in 2001 in a draft US federal standard (FIPS 180-2, finalized in 2002), part of the SHA-2 family. Nothing about it is secret or crypto-specific — your bank and your web browser use the same family of functions every day. Whatever you feed it, SHA-256 outputs 256 bits, usually written as 64 hexadecimal characters.
8666c29c6f7a.sw: Bitcoin hutumia kitendakazi maalum cha heshi, cha umma, kilichochunguzwa sana kiitwacho SHA-256. Kiliundwa na US National Security Agency na kuchapishwa kwa mara ya kwanza mwaka 2001 katika rasimu ya kiwango cha shirikisho cha Marekani (FIPS 180-2, iliyokamilishwa mwaka 2002), sehemu ya familia ya SHA-2. Hakuna chochote kukihusu kilicho siri au maalum kwa kripto — benki yako na kivinjari chako hutumia familia ileile ya vitendakazi kila siku. Chochote unachokilisha, SHA-256 hutoa biti 256, kwa kawaida zikiandikwa kama herufi 64 za hexadesimali.

86e48a31de57.en: Set out what the evidence in this track actually said. An estimated 73 to 81% of retail investors in the BIS data had likely lost money, arriving after prices rose while the largest holders sold. Roughly half the tokens listed on a major decentralised exchange were found to be scam tokens. Three of the largest venues and protocols in the industry's history failed completely, one through incompetence, one through a mechanism working as designed, and one at the institution everybody considered the responsible choice. Diversification within the asset class does not work in the falls, and the asset class as a whole did not diversify a portfolio when it was needed.

Takriban nusu ya tokeni zilizoorodheshwa katika soko kuu lisilo na kituo kikuu zilibainika kuwa tokeni za ulaghai. Viwanja na itifaki tatu kubwa zaidi katika historia ya tasnia vilishindwa kabisa, kimoja kwa kutokuwa na uwezo, kimoja kwa utaratibu ukifanya kazi kama ulivyoundwa, na kimoja katika taasisi ambayo kila mtu aliizingatia kuwa chaguo linalowajibika. 87ee75ee581b.en: As you apply these tools, keep four checks in mind: Is the instrument actually ranging, or trending? The same signal means opposite things in the two regimes. When any tool invokes probability ("95% of price action stays inside the bands"), remember fat tails — markets break statistical containment far more often than the bell curve promises. With RSI, the signal isn't entering the extreme zone, it's exiting it. And when a level "works," ask why: genuine market structure, or many traders watching the same line? Both are tradeable, but the second can evaporate.

Zana yoyote inapoita uwezekano ("95% ya shughuli ya bei hukaa ndani ya kanda"), kumbuka mikia minene — masoko huvunja kubebwa kwa takwimu mara nyingi zaidi kuliko mkunjo wa kengele unavyoahidi. 894e7f1498da.en: Decentralization. Here both sides prefer to talk about the other. In Bitcoin mining, individual miners join mining pools to smooth their income, and pool concentration is persistent: through the mid-2020s, the two largest pools alone have repeatedly coordinated well over 40% of the network's total hashpower between them. In Ethereum staking, the mirror image: most holders stake through intermediaries, and the largest liquid-staking protocol, Lido, has held roughly a quarter of all staked ETH in recent years — peaking above 30% in 2023, high enough that prominent Ethereum researchers publicly argued for self-limiting. Concentration is not a PoW problem or a PoS problem. It is a gravity problem: economies of scale pull both systems toward fewer, bigger operators, and both communities actively worry about it.
894e7f1498da.sw: Kutokuwa na kituo kikuu. Hapa pande zote mbili hupendelea kuzungumzia mwingine. Katika uchimbaji wa Bitcoin, wachimbaji mmoja mmoja hujiunga na vikundi vya uchimbaji ili kulainisha mapato yao, na ukusanyikaji wa vikundi ni wa kudumu: katikati ya miaka ya 2020, vikundi viwili vikubwa zaidi peke yake vimeratibu mara kwa mara zaidi ya 40% ya nguvu jumla ya heshi ya mtandao kati yao. Katika uwekaji hisa wa Ethereum, kioo chake: wamiliki wengi huweka hisa kupitia wapatanishi, na itifaki kubwa zaidi ya uwekaji hisa wa kimiminika, Lido, imeshikilia takriban robo ya ETH yote iliyowekwa kama hisa katika miaka ya hivi karibuni — ikifikia kilele juu ya 30% mwaka 2023, juu vya kutosha hivi kwamba watafiti mashuhuri wa Ethereum walitetea hadharani kujiwekea kikomo. Ukusanyikaji si tatizo la PoW wala tatizo la PoS. Ni tatizo la mvuto: uchumi wa ukubwa huvuta mifumo yote miwili kuelekea waendeshaji wachache, wakubwa zaidi, na jamii zote mbili hujali kuhusu hilo kwa bidii.

"Mawazo bora" inamaanisha yaliyochambuliwa vizuri zaidi, si yanayohisiwa kwa nguvu zaidi — hizo mbili ni rahisi kuzichanganya na ni mkanganyiko huo ambao somo hili lote lipo kulivunja. Vipengele vinavyoungwa mkono na ushahidi pia si uhakika; vina vipindi virefu vya utendaji duni, ambayo ndiyo hasa sababu unahitaji nguzo kadhaa na, bado, udhibiti wa hatari wa Sura ya 3. 8a04bece32fc.en: Technology moves. A wallet application you use today may be abandoned in five years. A hardware device will eventually fail or become unsupported. A chain you hold assets on may lose the developer attention that keeps its tools working.

8a239e4311bf.en: Correct — no exchange label exists on the ledger. Each provider builds its own label set from verified addresses, third-party sources, and clustering heuristics, and revises it over time. Glassnode's own transparency notice states that complete accuracy is out of reach and that recent data points can be revised.

8a2d669798d4.en: Correct — proof-of-work finality is probabilistic: reversal is never impossible, only increasingly uneconomic with depth. Six confirmations is a convention traceable to the 2008 paper's attacker math, not a rule in the software — which is why different exchanges choose different thresholds.
8a2d669798d4.sw: Sahihi — umalizio wa uthibitisho-wa-kazi ni wa uwezekano: kutendua si kutowezekana kamwe, ni kutokuwa na faida kiuchumi kwa kuongezeka kadiri kina kinavyoongezeka. Uthibitisho sita ni desturi inayoweza kufuatiliwa hadi hesabu ya mshambuliaji ya karatasi ya 2008, si kanuni katika programu — ndiyo maana masoko tofauti huchagua vizingiti tofauti.

8a3ed4daf6db.en: Watch the grammar of cycle claims. The cycle says the top comes 18 months after the halving is not a description of a pattern. It is a prediction, wearing the clothing of an observed regularity. Patterns describe what happened. Predictions claim what will happen. Anyone sliding from one to the other, in a single sentence, without naming the sample size, is doing exactly what Foundations Chapter 3 trained you to catch.

Miundo huelezea kilichotokea. Utabiri hudai kitakachotokea. Yeyote anayeteleza kutoka moja hadi nyingine, katika sentensi moja, bila kutaja ukubwa wa sampuli, anafanya hasa kile ambacho Misingi Sura ya 3 lilikuzoeza kukigundua.

8a463604f68b.en: Running the six-pillar process properly on individual companies is genuinely time-consuming, and many people who understand it completely will still decide they would rather not do it themselves. Scere Training sells completed trade theses built with this framework for readers in that position. That is the only mention it gets, and the reason the framework is taught in full here is that you should be able to judge such a thesis — including one of ours — rather than take it on trust.
8a463604f68b.sw: Kuendesha mchakato wa nguzo sita ipasavyo kwa kampuni mmoja mmoja huchukua muda mwingi kweli, na watu wengi wanaouelewa kabisa bado wataamua wangependelea wasiufanye wenyewe. Scere Training huuza nadharia kamili za biashara zilizojengwa kwa mfumo huu kwa wasomaji walio katika msimamo huo. Hilo ndilo tajo pekee linalopata, na sababu ya mfumo kufundishwa kikamilifu hapa ni kwamba unapaswa kuweza kuhukumu nadharia kama hiyo — ikiwa ni pamoja na yetu — badala ya kuichukua kwa imani.

8bebd3b98bae.en: A portfolio holds 5% crypto and 95% everything else. Crypto rises fourfold while the rest is flat. The crypto slice is now about 17.4% of the portfolio, and nobody decided that. If it then falls 80% — an ordinary crypto drawdown, not a catastrophe — the portfolio ends at about 99% of where it peaked, having given back essentially the entire gain. A band that restored 5% at the top would have taken about 14 of those units off the table as a rule rather than as a forecast.
8bebd3b98bae.sw: Kasha lina 5% ya kripto na 95% ya kila kitu kingine. Kripto hupanda mara nne huku kilichobaki kikiwa tuli. Kipande cha kripto sasa ni takriban 17.4% ya kasha, na hakuna aliyeamua hivyo. Kisha ikishuka 80% — kushuka kwa kawaida kwa kripto, si maafa — kasha huishia katika takriban 99% ya kilipofikia kilele, likiwa limerudisha kimsingi faida yote. Ukanda ambao ungerejesha 5% kileleni ungeondoa takriban vipimo 14 kati ya hivyo mezani kama kanuni badala ya kama utabiri.

8c19b16099a3.en: Leverage does not increase your edge. If you have no edge, leverage multiplies zero. If you have a small edge, leverage does not enlarge it - it enlarges the variance around it, so the edge has less time to express itself before an unlucky stretch removes your capital. What leverage buys is speed: the same distribution of outcomes, resolved faster and with a hard floor at zero. Speed is not an advantage when one of the outcomes is elimination.
8c19b16099a3.sw: Mzingo hauongezi ubora wako. Ikiwa huna ubora, mzingo huzidisha sifuri. Ikiwa una ubora mdogo, mzingo hauukuzi - hukuza tofauti inayouzunguka, kwa hivyo ubora una muda mfupi zaidi kujieleza kabla kipindi cha bahati mbaya kimeondoa mtaji wako. Kile ambacho mzingo hununua ni kasi: mgawanyo uleule wa matokeo, ukitatuliwa kwa kasi zaidi na ukiwa na sakafu ngumu katika sifuri. Kasi si faida wakati mojawapo ya matokeo ni kuondolewa.

8c27ae163883.en: Security assumptions. Attacking PoW means assembling a majority of physical hashpower: hardware plus electricity, sustained for as long as the attack runs. Attacking PoS means acquiring and staking a dominant share of the token itself. Each side calls its own cost profile the strength. PoW advocates note that its cost is external and physical — you cannot print hashpower. PoS advocates note that acquiring a huge stake drives the token's price up against you, and that the attacker's own locked capital gets destroyed by slashing when the attack is detected. Neither argument fully settles it. Both systems have secured very large networks for years, and both rest on the same honest assumption Lesson 1 flagged in the 2008 paper itself: security holds while a majority of the deciding resource is honest.
8c27ae163883.sw: Dhana za usalama. Kushambulia PoW humaanisha kukusanya wingi wa nguvu halisi ya heshi: maunzi pamoja na umeme, ukiendelezwa kwa muda wote shambulizi linaendeshwa. Kushambulia PoS humaanisha kupata na kuweka kama hisa sehemu kubwa ya tokeni yenyewe. Kila upande huita mchoro wake wa gharama kuwa nguvu. Watetezi wa PoW hubainisha kwamba gharama yake ni ya nje na ya kimwili — huwezi kuchapisha nguvu ya heshi. Watetezi wa PoS hubainisha kwamba kupata hisa kubwa mno husukuma bei ya tokeni juu dhidi yako, na kwamba mtaji uliofungiwa wa mshambuliaji mwenyewe huharibiwa kwa kukatwa shambulizi linapogunduliwa. Hakuna hoja inayolitatua kabisa. Mifumo yote miwili imelinda mitandao mikubwa mno kwa miaka, na yote miwili hutegemea dhana ileile ya uaminifu ambayo Somo la 1 liliiashiria katika karatasi ya 2008 yenyewe: usalama hushikilia wakati wingi wa rasilimali inayoamua ni mwaminifu.

8c3cbab8999d.en: Not quite. It is not about speed or about how risky it feels, and share prices certainly can fall to zero. The difference is that productive businesses create value outside the transactions, so ownership is positive-sum, whereas a casino game only redistributes what players bring, minus the house edge.
8c3cbab8999d.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Haihusu kasi wala jinsi inavyohisi hatari, na bei za hisa zinaweza kushuka hadi sifuri kwa hakika. Tofauti ni kwamba biashara zenye tija huunda thamani nje ya miamala, hivyo umiliki ni jumla-chanya, ilhali mchezo wa kasino hugawanya upya tu kile wachezaji huleta, kutoa faida ya kasino.

Nothing here identifies a sound institution reliably, which is exactly why it sits under a cap rather than replacing one.

8ca718bcdc0d.en: Correct — volume is self-reported by a venue that benefits from it looking high, and wash trading manufactures it with no real change in ownership. Cong, Li, Tang and Yang estimated wash trading averaged 77.5% of reported volume on unregulated exchanges; Bitwise put fake bitcoin spot volume near 95% in 2019; Forbes put it near 51% in 2022. Depth is harder to fake, because resting orders can actually be traded against.
8ca718bcdc0d.sw: Sahihi — ujazo huripotiwa na uwanja wenyewe unaonufaika na kuonekana kwake juu, na biashara ya kujiosha huutengeneza bila mabadiliko yoyote halisi ya umiliki. Kina ni kigumu zaidi kughushi, kwa sababu maagizo yaliyopumzika yanaweza kufanyiwa biashara kweli.

8cac4b1ecf3b.en: Two people put 1,000 into the same company on the same day. One buys shares. One lends the company 1,000 at 6% interest. Over five years the company does extremely well. The lender receives 60 a year and their 1,000 back — exactly what was agreed, and not a unit more. The shareholder receives whatever the residual has become, which may be far more, or nothing.

Katika miaka mitano kampuni hufanya vizuri sana. Mkopeshaji hupokea 60 kwa mwaka na 1,000 yake kurudi — hasa kile kilichokubaliwa, na si kipimo zaidi. Mwanahisa hupokea chochote mabaki yamekuwa, ambacho kinaweza kuwa zaidi mno, au bila kitu.

8cdd71915972.en: An investor has 12,000 and spreads it over twelve monthly purchases of 1,000. Suppose the price starts at 100, falls to 75 by month six, and recovers to 105 by month twelve. The schedule buys about 134.7 units at an average price of about 89.11, worth about 14,139 at the end. Investing all 12,000 at the start buys 120 units, worth 12,600. Averaging in won, because the low prices arrived while money was still being deployed.
8cdd71915972.sw: Mwekezaji ana 12,000 na anaieneza katika ununuzi kumi na mbili wa kila mwezi wa 1,000. Tuseme bei huanza kwa 100, hushuka hadi 75 kufikia mwezi wa sita, na hupona hadi 105 kufikia mwezi wa kumi na mbili. Ratiba hununua takriban vipimo 134.7 kwa bei ya wastani ya takriban 89.11, vyenye thamani ya takriban 14,139 mwishoni. Kuwekeza 12,000 zote mwanzoni hununua vipimo 120, vyenye thamani ya 12,600. Kupunguza wastani wa bei kulishinda, kwa sababu bei za chini zilifika huku pesa zikiwa bado zinapelekwa.

8d6a70827f8f.en: Here is the avalanche effect on real SHA-256 output. Hash the sentence "Alice pays Bob 10 coins" and the result begins 489cdba1288d6741... Now change one single character — "Alice pays Bob 70 coins" — and the result begins 5309adf6517ce2c5... One character changed in the input; the two fingerprints share nothing. You can verify this yourself with any online SHA-256 calculator, and you should — this course keeps telling you to check claims, including ours.
8d6a70827f8f.sw: Hii hapa athari ya poromoko katika toleo halisi la SHA-256. Fanya heshi ya sentensi "Alice pays Bob 10 coins" na matokeo huanza 489cdba1288d6741... Sasa badilisha herufi moja tu — "Alice pays Bob 70 coins" — na matokeo huanza 5309adf6517ce2c5... Herufi moja ilibadilishwa katika ingizo; alama hizo mbili za vidole hazishiriki chochote. Unaweza kuthibitisha hili mwenyewe kwa kikokotoo chochote cha SHA-256 cha mtandaoni, nawe unapaswa — kozi hii huendelea kukuambia ukague madai, ikiwa ni pamoja na yetu.

8de8169aa762.en: Look back at the list and a single pattern appears. Almost every mistake is the same failure wearing different clothes: acting on feeling or hope instead of a pre-decided, evidence-checked rule. That is precisely the spine this whole course was built on — risk management ahead of prediction, verifying a claim before trusting it, remembering that a textbook rule is an instinct rather than a law, and sizing so that fat-tailed surprises cannot end you. The common mistakes are just those four principles, violated.

Hiyo ndiyo hasa mgongo ambao kozi hii nzima ilijengwa juu yake — usimamizi wa hatari mbele ya utabiri, kuthibitisha dai kabla ya kuliamini, kukumbuka kwamba kanuni ya kitabu ni silika badala ya sheria, na kupima ili mishangao ya mikia minene isiweze kukumaliza. Makosa ya kawaida ni kanuni hizo nne tu, zikivunjwa.

8e671d97899c.en: One more mechanical point. Exchanges do not liquidate positions off the last traded price on their own order book, because a single large order on a thin book can push that price around. They liquidate off a mark price, typically built from an index of several spot venues plus a funding adjustment. This is a genuine protection and it is not a complete one - the mark price still follows the market down in a real move, and a wick on one venue's own book can still fill orders at prices the mark price never reached.

Hufilisi kwa bei ya alama, kwa kawaida iliyojengwa kutoka faharasa ya viwanja kadhaa vya papo hapo pamoja na marekebisho ya ufadhili. Huu ni ulinzi halisi nao si kamili - bei ya alama bado hufuata soko chini katika msogeo halisi, na kilele katika kitabu cha uwanja mmoja bado kinaweza kujaza maagizo katika bei ambazo bei ya alama haikuzifikia kamwe.

8fcd712a24fe.en: Securities lending income can offset a fund's costs, which sounds purely good. It introduces a counterparty relationship the fund did not otherwise have, and the borrower is frequently a short seller. The relevant questions are what proportion of the fund can be lent, how much of the fee is returned to investors rather than kept by the manager, and what collateral is held. All three are in the documentation and none are in the advertisement.

Maswali yanayohusika ni sehemu gani ya fund inaweza kukopeshwa, kiasi gani cha ada hurudishwa kwa wawekezaji badala ya kuwekwa na msimamizi, na dhamana gani inashikiliwa. Vyote vitatu viko katika nyaraka na hakuna kilicho katika tangazo.

8ff7c031d75e.en: Consider a large outflow from an exchange address. It could be a long-term holder withdrawing to cold storage. It could be the exchange itself rotating coins from a hot wallet to a cold wallet, which is an internal operation with no owner change at all. It could be a custody migration, where an institution moves coins to a different custodian. It could be the exchange's side of an over-the-counter deal that was already agreed and priced off-chain. It could be a provider re-labelling an address that was always the exchange's. Only the first of those is the accumulation story. All five produce the same on-chain measurement.
8ff7c031d75e.sw: Fikiria mtoko mkubwa kutoka anwani ya soko la kubadilisha. Unaweza kuwa mmiliki wa muda mrefu akitoa kwenda hifadhi baridi. Unaweza kuwa soko lenyewe likizungusha sarafu kutoka pochi ya moto kwenda pochi baridi, ambayo ni shughuli ya ndani isiyo na mabadiliko ya mmiliki kabisa. Unaweza kuwa uhamiaji wa utunzaji, ambapo taasisi husogeza sarafu kwenda mtunzaji tofauti. Unaweza kuwa upande wa soko wa mkataba wa nje ya soko ambao tayari ulikubaliwa na kupangiwa bei nje ya mnyororo. Unaweza kuwa mtoa data akiweka upya lebo kwa anwani ambayo daima ilikuwa ya soko. Ni la kwanza pekee kati ya hayo ndilo hadithi ya ukusanyaji. Yote matano huzalisha kipimo kilekile cha kwenye mnyororo.

8ff7c82e25fe.en: Correct. An index is continuously reconstituted, so companies that failed left it and were replaced. A holder of the original 2000 constituents had no such mechanism. Huu ni unusurikaji katika ngazi ya faharasa, nayo ndiyo sababu "soko daima hupona" ni dai dhaifu zaidi kuliko linavyosikika.

8ff94cbda616.en: On a four-decimal pair, one pip is 0.0001. A standard lot is 100,000 units. So 0.0001 x 100,000 = 10 units of the quote currency per pip. On a yen pair, one pip is 0.01, so 0.01 x 100,000 = 1,000 units of the quote currency (yen) per pip. Notice this is denominated in the quote currency, not dollars.
8ff94cbda616.sw: Kwenye jozi la desimali nne, pip moja ni 0.0001. Lot sanifu ni vipimo 100,000. Hivyo 0.0001 x 100,000 = vipimo 10 vya sarafu ya bei kwa kila pip. Kwenye jozi la yen, pip moja ni 0.01, hivyo 0.01 x 100,000 = vipimo 1,000 vya sarafu ya bei (yen) kwa kila pip. Tambua hii imeelezwa kwa sarafu ya bei, si dola.

900c20143750.en: Now run the same schedule in a market that rises steadily from 100 to 122. The monthly purchases buy about 108.5 units, worth about 13,241 at the end. The lump sum buys 120 units, worth 14,640. Averaging in lost, by more than it won in the first example, because the money not yet invested missed a rise that was happening the whole time.
900c20143750.sw: Sasa endesha ratiba ile ile katika soko linalopanda kwa uthabiti kutoka 100 hadi 122. Ununuzi wa kila mwezi hununua takriban vipimo 108.5, vyenye thamani ya takriban 13,241 mwishoni. Kiasi kamili hununua vipimo 120, vyenye thamani ya 14,640. Kupunguza wastani wa bei kulipoteza, kwa zaidi ya kulivyoshinda katika mfano wa kwanza, kwa sababu pesa ambazo hazikuwa zimewekezwa bado zilikosa kupanda kulikokuwa kukitokea muda wote.

900c349bfb66.en: Peer-reviewed research has since produced its own estimates using a different method. Lin William Cong, Xi Li, Ke Tang and Yang Yang published Crypto Wash Trading in Management Science, Volume 69, Issue 11, in 2023, pages 6427 to 6454. It circulated earlier as National Bureau of Economic Research Working Paper 30783. Rather than auditing exchanges, they detected fake trades statistically: real trading obeys certain regularities, including a characteristic distribution of leading digits and a characteristic pattern of round-number trade sizes, and manipulated volume does not. Across 29 centralized exchanges, they found regulated exchanges behaved normally while unregulated ones did not. Their estimate for wash trading on unregulated exchanges averaged 77.5% of reported volume, with a median of 79.1%. Scaled against reported volumes, that implied over 4.5 trillion dollars of wash trading in spot markets in the first quarter of 2020 alone.
900c349bfb66.sw: Utafiti uliopitiwa na wenzao tangu wakati huo umezalisha makadirio yake mwenyewe ukitumia mbinu tofauti. Lin William Cong, Xi Li, Ke Tang na Yang Yang walichapisha Crypto Wash Trading katika Management Science, Juzuu 69, Toleo la 11, mwaka 2023, kurasa 6427 hadi 6454. Ilizunguka mapema kama National Bureau of Economic Research Working Paper 30783. Badala ya kukagua masoko ya kubadilisha, waligundua biashara bandia kwa takwimu: biashara halisi hutii ukawaida fulani, ikiwa ni pamoja na mgawanyo maalum wa tarakimu za mwanzo na muundo maalum wa ukubwa wa biashara wa namba za duara, na ujazo uliopotoshwa hautii. Katika masoko 29 ya kubadilisha yenye kituo kikuu, walibaini masoko yanayodhibitiwa yalitenda kwa kawaida huku yasiyodhibitiwa hayakutenda hivyo. Makadirio yao ya biashara ya kujiosha katika masoko yasiyodhibitiwa yalikuwa wastani wa 77.5% ya ujazo unaoripotiwa, yakiwa na wastani wa kati wa 79.1%. Yakipimwa dhidi ya ujazo unaoripotiwa, hiyo iliashiria zaidi ya dola trilioni 4.5 za biashara ya kujiosha katika masoko ya papo hapo katika robo ya kwanza ya 2020 pekee.

9015a03fb682.en: Two price paths and four result bars comparing 12,000 invested at once against twelve monthly instalments. In a market that falls to 75 and recovers to 105, averaging in finishes at about 14,139 against 12,600. In a market rising steadily to 122 it finishes at about 13,241 against 14,640.
9015a03fb682.sw: Njia mbili za bei na vipau vinne vya matokeo vikilinganisha 12,000 zilizowekezwa mara moja dhidi ya awamu kumi na mbili za kila mwezi. Katika soko linaloshuka hadi 75 na kupona hadi 105, kupunguza wastani wa bei humalizia kwa takriban 14,139 dhidi ya 12,600. Katika soko linalopanda kwa uthabiti hadi 122 humalizia kwa takriban 13,241 dhidi ya 14,640.

902cff0dfec3.en: Be sceptical of any product marketed on its diversification benefits using a correlation figure measured over a full sample. The number you need is the correlation during the worst 5% of months, and it is almost never the number in the advertisement. Longin and Solnik's contribution was precisely to measure the tail rather than the average.
902cff0dfec3.sw: Kuwa na shaka na bidhaa yoyote inayotangazwa kwa faida zake za mtawanyiko ukitumia takwimu ya uhusiano iliyopimwa katika sampuli kamili. Namba unayoihitaji ni uhusiano wakati wa miezi mibaya zaidi 5%, nayo karibu kamwe si namba iliyo katika tangazo. Mchango wa Longin na Solnik ulikuwa hasa kupima mkia badala ya wastani.
