904bbef454ee.en: One practical note, stated plainly and only once. Running this full six-pillar process on a live trade — researching each pillar, verifying the evidence, sizing and reviewing — takes hours and a skill built over time. For someone who wants the output of this framework on a specific trade without building that skill themselves, a completed trade thesis is something the Scere Training platform offers as a service. The framework above is taught here in full and holds nothing back; the service simply exists for people who want the result without the hours. Everything you need to do it yourself is in this course.
904bbef454ee.sw: Dokezo moja la kivitendo, likielezwa wazi na mara moja tu. Kuendesha mchakato huu kamili wa nguzo sita kwenye biashara hai — kutafiti kila nguzo, kuthibitisha ushahidi, kupima na kupitia — huchukua saa nyingi na ustadi uliojengwa kwa muda. Kwa mtu anayetaka tokeo la mfumo huu kwenye biashara mahususi bila kujenga ustadi huo mwenyewe, nadharia ya biashara iliyokamilika ni kitu ambacho jukwaa la Scere Training hutoa kama huduma. Mfumo hapo juu unafundishwa hapa kikamilifu na hauzuii chochote; huduma ipo tu kwa watu wanaotaka tokeo bila saa nyingi. Kila unachohitaji kufanya mwenyewe kiko katika kozi hii.

9053127dd66a.en: A trade's result expressed as a multiple of the amount risked on it. A trade that makes twice its risk is +2R; a trade stopped out for its full risk is -1R. Every trade, on any pair, in any size, collapses to a single R number.
9053127dd66a.sw: Tokeo la biashara likielezwa kama kizidishi cha kiasi kilichohatarishwa juu yake. Biashara inayopata mara mbili ya hatari yake ni +2R; biashara iliyosimamishwa kwa hatari yake yote ni -1R. Kila biashara, kwenye jozi lolote, kwa ukubwa wowote, huanguka kuwa namba moja ya R.

907a5548a07a.en: That lesson deliberately taught not your keys, not your coins as a trade-off rather than a commandment, because self-custody has real costs and real failure modes — as Chapter 4 Lesson 3 set out at length. Nothing here changes that. What changes is the weight on one side: the counterparty failure it protects against is not hypothetical, it arrives without warning, and it has now happened at both the chaotic venue and the respectable one.
907a5548a07a.sw: Somo hilo lilifundisha kwa makusudi si funguo zako, si sarafu zako kama maafikiano badala ya amri, kwa sababu utunzaji binafsi una gharama halisi na namna halisi za kushindwa — kama Sura ya 4 Somo la 3 lilivyoeleza kwa urefu. Hakuna kilicho hapa kinachobadilisha hilo. Kinachobadilika ni uzito upande mmoja: kushindwa kwa mshirika ambako hulinda dhidi yake si kwa kudhania, hufika bila onyo, na sasa kumetokea katika uwanja wenye machafuko na ule wenye heshima.

908937c7951d.en: People tried to build digital cash within that model long before Bitcoin. The cryptographer David Chaum published the key idea — blind signatures, which let a bank validate digital coins without seeing who spends them — in a 1983 paper, "Blind Signatures for Untraceable Payments." He founded a company, DigiCash, in 1989 to sell exactly this: private digital cash. It still needed the central bank-like issuer at the middle, and the company went bankrupt in 1998.
908937c7951d.sw: Watu walijaribu kujenga fedha taslimu ya kidijitali ndani ya mfumo huo muda mrefu kabla ya Bitcoin. Mtaalamu wa kriptografia David Chaum alichapisha wazo kuu — sahihi vipofu, zinazoruhusu benki kuthibitisha sarafu za kidijitali bila kuona ni nani anazitumia — katika karatasi ya 1983, "Blind Signatures for Untraceable Payments." Alianzisha kampuni, DigiCash, mwaka 1989 ili kuuza hasa hili: fedha taslimu ya kidijitali ya faragha. Bado ilihitaji mtoaji kama benki kuu katikati, na kampuni ilifilisika mwaka 1998.

90a77eefe2ee.en: Ask what four matching observations would prove in any other setting. Flip a coin four times and get four heads, and nobody concludes the coin is loaded, because four heads happens by chance about one time in sixteen with a perfectly fair coin. Foundations Chapter 3 taught you to interrogate a pattern statistic before believing it. The Bulkowski chart-pattern numbers failed that test because they came from one unreplicated dataset. The four-year cycle fails a harsher version of it: there is barely a dataset at all.
90a77eefe2ee.sw: Uliza uchunguzi manne yanayolingana yangethibitisha nini katika mazingira mengine yoyote. Rusha sarafu mara nne na upate vichwa vinne, na hakuna anayehitimisha sarafu imepakwa uzito, kwa sababu vichwa vinne hutokea kwa bahati takriban mara moja katika kumi na sita kwa sarafu iliyo ya haki kikamilifu. Misingi Sura ya 3 lilikufundisha kuhoji takwimu ya muundo kabla ya kuiamini. Namba za muundo wa chati za Bulkowski zilishindwa mtihani huo kwa sababu zilitoka seti moja ya data isiyorudiwa. Mzunguko wa miaka minne hushindwa toleo kali zaidi lake: kwa shida kuna seti ya data kabisa.

90ab3ef1be87.en: The measured scale is large, and different studies disagree about how large. That disagreement is worth showing you rather than smoothing over. In March 2019, the asset manager Bitwise presented research to United States Securities and Exchange Commission staff as part of the review of a proposed bitcoin exchange-traded fund. The presentation, filed publicly on the SEC website under File No. SR-NYSEArca-2019-01, argued that roughly 95% of reported bitcoin spot volume was fake or non-economic. Bitwise analysed 81 exchanges reporting more than 1 million dollars of daily volume and concluded that the data from 71 of them was fake or wash traded. Against roughly 6 billion dollars of reported daily volume, they estimated the real figure at roughly 273 million dollars, concentrated on 10 exchanges.
90ab3ef1be87.sw: Kiwango kilichopimwa ni kikubwa, na tafiti tofauti hazikubaliani kuhusu kikubwa kiasi gani. Kutokubaliana huko kunastahili kukuonyeshwa badala ya kulainishwa. Mwezi Machi 2019, meneja wa rasilimali Bitwise aliwasilisha utafiti kwa wafanyakazi wa United States Securities and Exchange Commission kama sehemu ya mapitio ya mfuko wa biashara wa bitcoin uliopendekezwa. Wasilisho, lililowasilishwa hadharani katika tovuti ya SEC chini ya File No. SR-NYSEArca-2019-01, lilidai kwamba takriban 95% ya ujazo wa papo hapo wa bitcoin unaoripotiwa ulikuwa bandia au usio wa kiuchumi. Bitwise ilichambua masoko 81 ya kubadilisha yanayoripoti zaidi ya dola milioni 1 ya ujazo wa kila siku na kuhitimisha kwamba data kutoka 71 kati yao ilikuwa bandia au ya biashara ya kujiosha. Dhidi ya takriban dola bilioni 6 za ujazo wa kila siku unaoripotiwa, walikadiria takwimu halisi katika takriban dola milioni 273, iliyokusanyika katika masoko 10.

90b57e50973d.en: A holding that has fallen is already a smaller share of the portfolio, so adding to it feels like restoring the intended size. It is not the same thing. Restoring a weight is a rule applied to everything you own; adding to one falling company because it fell is a decision about that company, and it needs the same evidence any new purchase would need.
90b57e50973d.sw: Umiliki uliyoshuka tayari ni sehemu ndogo ya mkusanyiko, hivyo kuongeza kwake huhisi kama kurejesha ukubwa uliokusudiwa. Si kitu kile kile. Kurejesha uzito ni kanuni inayotumika kwa kila kitu unachomiliki; kuongeza kwa kampuni moja inayoshuka kwa sababu ilishuka ni uamuzi kuhusu kampuni hiyo, na unahitaji ushahidi ule ule ambao ununuzi wowote mpya ungeuhitaji.

90b6f4e8c4e1.en: Someone shows you this rule: Bitcoin bottoms about 12 months before each halving, so the pre-halving year is the best time to buy. Do not judge whether it is true. Instead, write down the evidence you would need to believe it. Aim for at least five items. Consider: how many independent observations exist; whether the rule was published before or after the data it describes; what else was happening in each of those pre-halving years; what result would prove the rule wrong; and whether the rule survives after transaction costs and a realistic account of the drawdowns you would have held through. Keep your list. It works on any cycle claim you meet in this market.
90b6f4e8c4e1.sw: Mtu anakuonyesha kanuni hii: Bitcoin hufikia bondeni takriban miezi 12 kabla ya kila kupunguzwa nusu, kwa hivyo mwaka wa kabla ya kupunguzwa nusu ndio wakati bora zaidi wa kununua. Usihukumu kama ni kweli. Badala yake, andika ushahidi ungeuhitaji kuamini hilo. Lenga angalau vitu vitano. Fikiria: kuna uchunguzi mangapi huru; kama kanuni ilichapishwa kabla au baada ya data inayoielezea; nini kingine kilikuwa kikitokea katika kila mmoja wa miaka hiyo ya kabla ya kupunguzwa nusu; matokeo yapi yangethibitisha kanuni si sahihi; na kama kanuni inanusurika baada ya gharama za muamala na hesabu halisi ya kushuka ambako ungeshikilia kupitia. Weka orodha yako. Inafanya kazi juu ya dai lolote la mzunguko unalokutana nalo katika soko hili.

90cace1fd1e2.en: You will hear this slogan constantly: "not your keys, not your coins" — coins on an exchange are not really yours, because the exchange holds the keys. Both halves of the honest version deserve a look.
90cace1fd1e2.sw: Utasikia kauli hii mara kwa mara: "si funguo zako, si sarafu zako" — sarafu zilizo katika soko la kubadilisha si zako kweli, kwa sababu soko hushikilia funguo. Nusu zote mbili za toleo la kweli zinastahili kutazamwa.

90d12334e1de.en: Narratives follow a recognisable structure, and the structure repeats even when the subject changes. First, a genuine development happens - a protocol ships something, a regulator says something, an institution buys something. Second, a simple story forms around it, compressing a complicated technical development into one sentence a newcomer can repeat. Third, prices rise and the story spreads, because rising prices attract attention and attention brings buyers.
90d12334e1de.sw: Simulizi hufuata muundo unaotambulika, na muundo hujirudia hata mada inapobadilika. Kwanza, maendeleo halisi hutokea - itifaki husafirisha kitu, mdhibiti husema kitu, taasisi hununua kitu. Pili, hadithi rahisi huundwa kuzunguka hilo, ikibana maendeleo changamano ya kiufundi kuwa sentensi moja ambayo mgeni anaweza kuirudia. Tatu, bei hupanda na hadithi huenea, kwa sababu bei zinazopanda huvutia uangalifu na uangalifu huleta wanunuzi.

90e317878c96.en: Your transaction is in a block. Is it settled now? On most chains, the honest answer is: increasingly, but never absolutely.
90e317878c96.sw: Muamala wako uko katika kitalu. Je, umetimizwa sasa? Katika minyororo mingi, jibu la kweli ni: kwa kuongezeka, lakini kamwe si kabisa.

90e3827e1cb9.en: Neither figure is the truth on its own. What you are looking for is whether they move together over time. Profit rising while operating cash flow stagnates, year after year, is the pattern worth understanding rather than dismissing.
90e3827e1cb9.sw: Hakuna takwimu iliyo ukweli peke yake. Unachotafuta ni kama zinasogea pamoja kwa muda. Faida ikipanda ilhali mtiririko wa fedha wa shughuli unasimama, mwaka baada ya mwaka, ndio mtindo unaostahili kueleweka badala ya kupuuzwa.

90f2de1e9b51.en: The allocation decision is the one that matters. The number of tokens inside it barely matters at all.

9108cd966d66.en: A stressed regime, with high volatility and falling risk appetite, is where correlations converge and diversification does least. Momentum reverses violently. Valuation begins to matter again, but only for someone with the time horizon to wait for it to be recognised.
9108cd966d66.sw: Utawala wa msongo, wenye mtikisiko mkubwa na hamu ya hatari inayoshuka, ndipo uhusiano hukusanyika pamoja na mtawanyiko hufanya kidogo zaidi. Kasi hugeuka kwa ukali. Tathmini huanza kuwa na maana tena, lakini kwa mtu mwenye upeo wa muda wa kusubiri itambuliwe pekee.

9118ea020037.en: The spread isn't only about adverse selection, though — the broader research on this (often traced to work by Hans Stoll and others) identifies a few real components stacked together: order-processing costs (the genuine overhead of running the infrastructure that executes trades), inventory risk (a market maker holding currency exposure they didn't necessarily want, and pricing in the risk of holding it), and adverse selection (the Glosten-Milgrom effect above). The spread you see quoted is these forces combined into one number.
9118ea020037.sw: Hata hivyo spread haihusu uteuzi mbaya peke yake — utafiti mpana juu ya hili (mara nyingi unaofuatiliwa hadi kazi ya Hans Stoll na wengine) hubainisha vipengele halisi vichache vilivyorundikwa pamoja: gharama za kushughulikia maagizo (gharama halisi ya kuendesha miundombinu inayotekeleza biashara), hatari ya hifadhi (mtengeneza-soko anayeshikilia uwazi wa sarafu ambao si lazima aliutaka, na kuweka bei ya hatari ya kuushikilia), na uteuzi mbaya (athari ya Glosten-Milgrom hapo juu). Spread unayoiona ikinukuliwa ni nguvu hizi zilizounganishwa kuwa namba moja.

912377c4480f.en: As you weigh a signal, run three checks: Is the market trending or ranging right now? Crossover signals earn their keep in trends and bleed in ranges. When one indicator "confirms" another, are they actually independent, or two calculations of the same thing (like MACD and an MA crossover)? And would you take this signal if the indicator weren't there — can you see the shift in raw price? If not, be suspicious.
912377c4480f.sw: Unapopima ishara, fanya ukaguzi mitatu: Je, soko lina mwelekeo au liko kwenye ukanda sasa hivi? Ishara za mkatizo hujilipia katika mielekeo na hupoteza katika kanda. Kiashiria kimoja kinapo"thibitisha" kingine, je, kwa kweli vinajitegemea, au ni hesabu mbili za kitu kile kile (kama MACD na mkatizo wa MA)? Na je, ungechukua ishara hii kama kiashiria kisingekuwepo — unaweza kuona mabadiliko katika bei ghafi? Kama sivyo, kuwa na shaka.

91533a101760.en: That losing trade in the middle is called a whipsaw, and it is not a malfunction — it's the known cost of the method. Crossovers work when price trends and bleed small losses when price moves sideways, because a flat market makes the two averages braid around each other, generating false signals. No setting eliminates this; risk management (Chapter 1, Lessons 5–7) is what makes the losses survivable and small relative to the trending wins.
91533a101760.sw: Biashara ile ya hasara katikati inaitwa whipsaw, na si hitilafu — ni gharama inayojulikana ya mbinu hiyo. Mikatizo hufanya kazi bei inapoelekea na hupoteza hasara ndogo bei inaposogea kando, kwa sababu soko tulivu hufanya wastani hizo mbili zisukane, zikizalisha ishara za uongo. Hakuna mpangilio unaoondoa hili; usimamizi wa hatari (Sura ya 1, Masomo 5–7) ndicho kinachofanya hasara ziweze kunusurika na ziwe ndogo ikilinganishwa na ushindi wa mwelekeo.

91608da8f9a0.sw: Faida kutoka mabadiliko ya bei na gawio kwa pamoja, gawio likidhaniwa limewekezwa tena. Faida ya bei huhesabu mabadiliko ya bei tu.

9172ccf70fff.en: Correct — this is the naive diversification trap. Highly correlated holdings can behave like one concentrated bet, no matter how many there are.
9172ccf70fff.sw: Sahihi — huu ndio mtego wa kusambaza kwa kijinga. Umiliki wenye uwiano mkubwa unaweza kutenda kama dau moja lililojikita, bila kujali ni mingapi.

9177377a212a.en: There is one further discipline that belongs here and nowhere else, because it only becomes visible over years.
9177377a212a.sw: Kuna nidhamu moja zaidi inayostahili kuwa hapa na si mahali pengine, kwa sababu huonekana tu baada ya miaka.

917a41b464c4.en: Correct. The average return is about 0.973 units for every unit staked, a loss of roughly 2.7% per spin. It is a property of the wheel, not of the player, which is why no amount of skill or discipline changes it.

91a1f065fa1f.en: This chapter's roadmap entry carries a headline: crypto volatility is about 5 times forex. That claim deserves the same treatment this course gives every other claim, which is to go and check it rather than repeat it. First, the term itself.
91a1f065fa1f.sw: Kiingizo cha ramani ya sura hii hubeba kichwa cha habari: mtikisiko wa kripto ni takriban mara 5 ya forex. Dai hilo linastahili matibabu yaleyale ambayo kozi hii huyatoa kwa kila dai lingine, ambako ni kwenda kukagua badala ya kurudia. Kwanza, neno lenyewe.

91a54ee7e0a5.en: Positioning and sentiment — is everyone already on your side? A trade the whole market has piled into is crowded, and crowded trades unwind violently (the 2008 carry unwind, Chapter 5, Lesson 2). Extreme positioning is a reason for caution, sometimes a reason to fade the crowd.
91a54ee7e0a5.sw: Nafasi za soko na hisia — je, kila mtu tayari yuko upande wako? Biashara ambayo soko zima limerundikana ndani yake ina msongamano, na biashara zenye msongamano huvunjika kwa nguvu (kuvunjika kwa carry kwa mwaka 2008, Sura ya 5, Somo la 2). Nafasi za soko za kupindukia ni sababu ya tahadhari, wakati mwingine sababu ya kwenda kinyume na umati.

91a5634c1760.en: A thesis you cannot disprove is not a thesis — it is a belief. The professional's first move after building the six-pillar case (Lesson 1) is to ask the opposite question: what would have to happen for this to be wrong?
91a5634c1760.sw: Nadharia usiyoweza kuithibitisha kuwa batili si nadharia — ni imani. Hatua ya kwanza ya mtaalamu baada ya kujenga hoja ya nguzo sita (Somo la 1) ni kuuliza swali la kinyume: ni nini kingelazimika kutokea ili hii iwe batili?

91abc26c1d77.en: There is one category of genuinely reliable edge, and it is worth naming precisely so that it can be dismissed properly.
91abc26c1d77.sw: Kuna daraja moja la faida ya kutegemewa kweli, na linastahili kutajwa kwa usahihi ili liweze kukataliwa ipasavyo.

91d7397faf42.en: The same tension keeps showing up: a disciplined system builds trust, but that discipline can be too rigid in a crisis. You'll see this exact trade-off again with the gold standard itself in the next lesson.
91d7397faf42.sw: Mvutano ule ule unaendelea kujitokeza: mfumo wenye nidhamu hujenga imani, lakini nidhamu hiyo inaweza kuwa ngumu mno wakati wa janga. Utaona mchanganyiko huu hasa tena na kiwango cha dhahabu chenyewe katika somo lijalo.

91d7b4d32bac.en: A statistical measure of how widely returns have varied around their average. The usual industry shorthand for risk.
91d7b4d32bac.sw: Kipimo cha kitakwimu cha jinsi faida zilivyotofautiana kwa upana kuzunguka wastani wao. Ufupisho wa kawaida wa sekta kwa hatari.

91e0e60cedf6.en: A technical indicator is computed entirely from price, so it can only make a pattern already in the chart easier to see — never reveal something the price doesn't already contain.
91e0e60cedf6.sw: Kiashiria cha kiufundi hukokotolewa kabisa kutoka bei, hivyo kinaweza tu kurahisisha kuona mtindo ambao tayari uko kwenye chati — kamwe hakiwezi kufichua kitu ambacho bei haina tayari.

91e8b50749a5.en: Enter it — support agents need the phrase to fix wallet problems
91e8b50749a5.sw: Kiweke — mawakala wa huduma huhitaji kifungu ili kurekebisha matatizo ya pochi

91fc13e50054.en: One more honest-history note, in the Lesson 1 spirit of checking what people attribute to Bitcoin. The chained-hash idea is not from 2008. Stuart Haber and W. Scott Stornetta published "How to Time-Stamp a Digital Document" in the Journal of Cryptology in 1991 — seventeen years before Bitcoin — proposing linked cryptographic timestamps so that no record could be quietly back-dated. Nakamoto knew it and said so: the 2008 paper's reference list has eight entries, and three of them are Haber-Stornetta papers, including this one. Bitcoin's genuinely new contribution was not the chain of hashes. It was combining that older idea with proof-of-work and a peer-to-peer network so that no trusted timestamping company was needed at all — the same referee-removal move from Lesson 1.
91fc13e50054.sw: Kumbuka moja zaidi ya historia ya kweli, katika roho ya Somo la 1 ya kukagua kile ambacho watu huhusisha na Bitcoin. Wazo la heshi zilizounganishwa si la 2008. Stuart Haber na W. Scott Stornetta walichapisha "How to Time-Stamp a Digital Document" katika Journal of Cryptology mwaka 1991 — miaka kumi na saba kabla ya Bitcoin — wakipendekeza alama za muda za kikriptografia zilizounganishwa ili hakuna rekodi ingeweza kupewa tarehe ya nyuma kimya kimya. Nakamoto alilijua na akasema hivyo: orodha ya marejeleo ya karatasi ya 2008 ina maingizo nane, na matatu kati yake ni karatasi za Haber-Stornetta, ikiwa ni pamoja na hii. Mchango mpya kweli wa Bitcoin haukuwa mnyororo wa heshi. Ulikuwa kuunganisha wazo hilo la zamani na uthibitisho-wa-kazi na mtandao wa rika-kwa-rika ili kampuni inayoaminika ya kuweka alama za muda isihitajike kabisa — hatua ileile ya kuondoa mwamuzi kutoka Somo la 1.

9209555210b0.en: Not quite. The asymmetry follows from the clearing mechanism rather than from any instruction. Pending purchases created obligations the broker had to collateralise within hours; sales did not create the same demand, so only one direction was restricted.
9209555210b0.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ukosefu wa ulinganifu hufuata kutoka utaratibu wa utimizaji badala ya kutoka agizo lolote. Manunuzi yanayosubiri yaliunda majukumu ambayo dalali alilazimika kuyawekea dhamana ndani ya masaa; mauzo hayakuunda dai lilelile, kwa hivyo mwelekeo mmoja pekee ulizuiwa.

920ff9cd98e3.en: This is the sign flip that defines the carry trade: the position pays small, steady, positive returns for a long time, then delivers a large, sudden, correlated loss. And the losses hit everyone in the trade at once, because they are all forced to unwind together — precisely when markets are already in crisis and least forgiving.
920ff9cd98e3.sw: Hii ndiyo mabadiliko ya ishara yanayofafanua carry trade: nafasi hulipa faida ndogo, thabiti, chanya kwa muda mrefu, kisha hutoa hasara kubwa, ya ghafla, yenye uwiano. Na hasara hugonga kila mtu aliye katika biashara kwa pamoja, kwa sababu wote wanalazimika kuvunja kwa pamoja — hasa wakati masoko tayari yako kwenye janga na hayasamehe hata kidogo.

9216a649fed8.en: To assume the trade has already failed and generate the reasons, surfacing risks that optimism hides
9216a649fed8.sw: Kudhania biashara tayari imeshindwa na kuzalisha sababu, ikifichua hatari ambazo matumaini huzificha

921f8b985d8d.en: An activity where all participants can gain together, because value is created outside the transactions.
921f8b985d8d.sw: Shughuli ambapo washiriki wote wanaweza kupata faida pamoja, kwa sababu thamani inaundwa nje ya miamala.

923210e77694.en: The phrase at that earnings level is where the whole difficulty lives. Nobody buys a company expecting earnings to stay exactly where they are. The P/E is therefore not a measure of value; it is a measure of what the market expects, expressed through a number about the past.
923210e77694.sw: Msemo kwa kiwango hicho cha mapato ndipo ugumu wote unapoishi. Hakuna anayenunua kampuni akitarajia mapato yatabaki hasa yalipo. P/E kwa hivyo si kipimo cha thamani; ni kipimo cha kile soko linachotarajia, kikielezwa kupitia namba kuhusu ya nyuma.

92384dce49a8.en: Three overlapping circles labelled book to market, earnings and cash flow, showing that different definitions of cheapness select overlapping but genuinely different sets of companies, alongside notes on book value describing factories better than software and on implementation costs.
92384dce49a8.sw: Miduara mitatu inayoingiliana iliyoitwa kitabu kwa soko, mapato na mtiririko wa fedha, ikionyesha kwamba maana tofauti za unafuu huchagua seti zinazoingiliana lakini tofauti kweli za kampuni, pamoja na maelezo kuhusu thamani ya kitabu kuelezea viwanda vizuri kuliko programu na kuhusu gharama za utekelezaji.

92407082391f.en: Correlation rises in both rising and falling markets equally
92407082391f.sw: Uhusiano hupanda katika masoko yanayopanda na yanayoshuka kwa usawa

92471ca69388.en: A single timeframe gives you an incomplete picture by construction. A 5-minute chart cannot show you a three-month trend, and a weekly chart cannot show you a good entry price. These aren't competing views to pick between — they're different questions, and you need all of them answered in the right order.
92471ca69388.sw: Kipindi kimoja hukupa picha isiyokamilika kwa muundo wake. Chati ya dakika 5 haiwezi kukuonyesha mwelekeo wa miezi mitatu, na chati ya wiki haiwezi kukuonyesha bei nzuri ya kuingia. Hizi si mitazamo inayoshindana ya kuchagua kati yake — ni maswali tofauti, na unahitaji yote yajibiwe kwa mpangilio sahihi.

92683b9e0906.en: The thin book. Same token, same market cap, same order. But the bids look like this: 4,000 tokens at 9.90, then 6,000 at 9.50, then 10,000 at 9.00, then 20,000 at 8.00, then 60,000 at 7.00. The entire bid side, all the way down to 7.00 dollars, is worth 766,600 dollars. Your sell order eats every level: 4,000 at 9.90 for 39,600 dollars, 6,000 at 9.50 for 57,000 dollars, 10,000 at 9.00 for 90,000 dollars, 20,000 at 8.00 for 160,000 dollars, and 60,000 at 7.00 for 420,000 dollars. You receive 766,600 dollars and your average fill price is 7.6660. Against the 1,000,000 dollars the screen implied, the trade cost you 233,400 dollars, or 23.34%. The new last price is 7.00, down 30.00%. Market cap is now 140,000,000 dollars.
92683b9e0906.sw: Kitabu chembamba. Tokeni ileile, kiasi kilekile cha soko, agizo lilelile. Lakini zabuni zinaonekana hivi: tokeni 4,000 katika 9.90, kisha 6,000 katika 9.50, kisha 10,000 katika 9.00, kisha 20,000 katika 8.00, kisha 60,000 katika 7.00. Upande mzima wa zabuni, hadi chini kabisa katika dola 7.00, una thamani ya dola 766,600. Agizo lako la kuuza hula kila kiwango: 4,000 katika 9.90 kwa dola 39,600, 6,000 katika 9.50 kwa dola 57,000, 10,000 katika 9.00 kwa dola 90,000, 20,000 katika 8.00 kwa dola 160,000, na 60,000 katika 7.00 kwa dola 420,000. Unapokea dola 766,600 na bei yako ya wastani ya ujazwaji ni 7.6660. Dhidi ya dola 1,000,000 ambazo skrini iliashiria, biashara ilikugharimu dola 233,400, au 23.34%. Bei mpya ya mwisho ni 7.00, chini kwa 30.00%. Kiasi cha soko sasa ni dola 140,000,000.

9298fbe2038e.sw: Tathmini haihusiki na hisa kabisa, ni ya sarafu pekee

92a05d674f13.sw: Kwa mujibu wa ripoti ya BIS, ni nini kinachoeleza vizuri zaidi ukali wa anguko la ghafla la pauni la mwaka 2016?

92a30e04645f.sw: Unapoteza 0.20 kwa kila hisa — ulinunua kwa ask na kuuza kwa bid

92a3638389ad.en: A balance sheet showing 9 billion in liabilities against 900 million in assets was published by a journalist. Nine days later the exchange was in bankruptcy, and "not your keys, not your coins" stopped being a slogan.
92a3638389ad.sw: Karatasi ya salio ikionyesha bilioni 9 za madeni dhidi ya milioni 900 za rasilimali ilichapishwa na mwandishi wa habari. Siku tisa baadaye soko la kubadilisha lilikuwa katika kufilisika, na "si funguo zako, si sarafu zako" likaacha kuwa kauli.

92a8f859d77f.sw: Benki hutoza ada kwa miamala ya kidijitali

92c1071b495b.sw: Kushikilia sehemu kubwa katika kampuni moja, sekta moja au nchi moja.

92c7c849cc3d.en: By 2013 Mt. Gox was handling a very large share of global Bitcoin trading. It was the venue most people used, and for many it was the only one they had ever used. Then, over three weeks in early 2014, it stopped.
92c7c849cc3d.sw: Kufikia 2013 Mt. Gox ilikuwa ikishughulikia sehemu kubwa sana ya biashara ya kimataifa ya Bitcoin. Ilikuwa uwanja ambao watu wengi waliutumia, na kwa wengi ndilo soko pekee walilowahi kulitumia. Kisha, katika wiki tatu mwanzoni mwa 2014, likaacha.

92e32bf741aa.en: You size a EUR/GBP trade using a 10-dollar pip value, but the true pip value is 12.70 dollars. Compared with your intended 1% risk, what actually happens?
92e32bf741aa.sw: Unapima biashara ya EUR/GBP ukitumia thamani ya pip ya dola 10, lakini thamani halisi ya pip ni dola 12.70. Ikilinganishwa na hatari yako uliyokusudia ya 1%, kinatokea nini hasa?

92eb39b11dd6.en: Correct — same market and period, yet the most active traders underperformed by more than six percentage points a year. The study attributes the excessive trading to overconfidence.
92eb39b11dd6.sw: Sahihi — soko lile lile na kipindi kile kile, hata hivyo wafanyabiashara wenye shughuli zaidi walifanya vibaya kwa zaidi ya pointi sita za asilimia kwa mwaka. Utafiti unahusisha biashara ya kupita kiasi na kujiamini kupita kiasi.

92f55bc01c77.en: Correct. The same sequence of returns helps someone buying and harms someone selling. Units sold at depressed prices between 2008 and 2011 were not there for the recovery, while units bought in the same period were. Neither investor made an error, which is what makes sequence risk a structural rather than a behavioural problem.
92f55bc01c77.sw: Sahihi. Mfuatano uleule wa faida humsaidia anayenunua na kumdhuru anayeuza. Vipimo vilivyouzwa kwa bei zilizoshuka kati ya 2008 na 2011 havikuwepo kwa ajili ya kupona, huku vipimo vilivyonunuliwa katika kipindi kilekile vilikuwepo. Hakuna mwekezaji aliyefanya kosa, jambo linalofanya hatari ya mfuatano kuwa tatizo la kimuundo badala ya la kitabia.

92ffcc9032ea.en: For any asset paying you a staking reward, find out what proportion of that reward comes from fees paid by users and what proportion from newly issued supply. Both figures are normally published. If the answer is mostly issuance, write down what your holding is as a percentage of total supply before and after a year of rewards, and note whether it actually rose.
92ffcc9032ea.sw: Kwa rasilimali yoyote inayokulipa zawadi ya kuweka hisa, bainisha ni sehemu gani ya zawadi hiyo hutoka ada zinazolipwa na watumiaji na ni sehemu gani hutoka usambazaji uliotolewa upya. Takwimu zote mbili kwa kawaida huchapishwa. Ikiwa jibu ni hasa utoaji, andika umiliki wako ni asilimia ngapi ya usambazaji jumla kabla na baada ya mwaka wa zawadi, na utambue kama kweli ulipanda.

930e271f2a67.en: The same applies across countries. Holding only companies from your own country is called home bias, and it is close to universal — investors everywhere hold far more domestic equity than the size of their market would justify.
930e271f2a67.sw: Vivyo hivyo katika nchi mbalimbali. Kushikilia kampuni za nchi yako mwenyewe tu huitwa upendeleo wa nyumbani, na ni karibu wa wote — wawekezaji kila mahali hushikilia hisa nyingi mno za ndani kuliko ukubwa wa soko lao ungehalalisha.

9329dae88133.en: Not quite. Paying out more than you earn is not a sign of strength. The shortfall must be funded from cash reserves, borrowing or asset sales, and each of those has a limit — which is why a very high yield is often a forecast of a cut.
9329dae88133.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kulipa zaidi ya unavyopata si ishara ya nguvu. Upungufu lazima ufadhiliwe kutoka akiba za fedha, kukopa au kuuza mali, na kila kimoja kina kikomo — ndiyo sababu mavuno makubwa mno mara nyingi ni utabiri wa kupunguzwa.

932b320bedef.sw: Mfumo hushinda 60% ya biashara, lakini ushindi wake wa wastani ni dola 80 na hasara yake ya wastani ni dola 150. Matarajio yake kwa kila biashara ni yapi?

93648cafcc2e.en: A wallet whose keys live on an internet-connected device; convenient, and exposed to malware and phishing.
93648cafcc2e.sw: Pochi ambayo funguo zake huishi katika kifaa kilichounganishwa na mtandao; rahisi, na imefunuliwa kwa programu hasidi na uvuvi.

936cb39b4106.en: Correct — the move was nearly unpredictable, so ruin was not about direction. It was about size: over-leveraged accounts had no cushion for a gap that large, and some went negative.
936cb39b4106.sw: Sahihi — msogeo ulikuwa karibu hautabiriki, hivyo uharibifu haukuhusu mwelekeo. Ulihusu ukubwa: akaunti zenye leverage kubwa mno hazikuwa na mto wa kuruka kukubwa hivyo, na baadhi zikawa hasi.

937113566aac.en: There is a second way to see the same number, and it is the one worth remembering. A 1% fee on a portfolio expected to return 7% is not one percent of anything meaningful — it is about 14% of your expected return, handed over annually regardless of whether the return arrives.
937113566aac.sw: Kuna njia ya pili ya kuona namba hiyohiyo, nayo ndiyo inayostahili kukumbukwa. Ada ya 1% juu ya kasha linalotarajiwa kurudisha 7% si asilimia moja ya kitu chenye maana — ni takriban 14% ya faida yako inayotarajiwa, ikikabidhiwa kila mwaka bila kujali kama faida inafika au la.

9375530bd468.sw: Kwamba utoaji utafanikiwa mara kodi itakapolipwa

93b303548827.en: A strategy of borrowing (or selling) a low-interest-rate currency to buy a high-interest-rate one, aiming to pocket the interest rate difference — provided the exchange rate doesn't move enough to wipe out that gain.
93b303548827.sw: Mkakati wa kukopa (au kuuza) sarafu ya kiwango cha chini cha riba ili kununua ya kiwango cha juu, ukilenga kuweka mfukoni tofauti ya kiwango cha riba — mradi kiwango cha ubadilishaji hakisogei vya kutosha kufuta faida hiyo.

93c139dc891f.en: Be careful not to accept that as settled either, because the literature genuinely disagrees. Cavalheiro, Vieira and Thue (2024), in Review of Behavioral Finance, applied Granger causality and smooth quantile regression to weekly Bitcoin and Ethereum data from July 2022 to June 2023, and reported that the index did predict returns. Gaies, Nakhli, Sahut and Schweizer (2023), in The North American Journal of Economics and Finance, used a rolling-window bootstrap causality test over May 2018 to December 2020 and found something more interesting than either result: the causality between fear sentiment and Bitcoin prices was not constant. It appeared, disappeared, and changed sign across subperiods, and shifted again around the pandemic.
93c139dc891f.sw: Kuwa makini usikubali hilo kama lililotatuliwa pia, kwa sababu fasihi hutokubaliana kweli. Cavalheiro, Vieira na Thue (2024), katika Review of Behavioral Finance, walitumia usababishi wa Granger na urejeshaji laini wa kwantaili katika data ya kila wiki ya Bitcoin na Ethereum kuanzia Julai 2022 hadi Juni 2023, na wakaripoti kwamba faharasa ilitabiri faida. Gaies, Nakhli, Sahut na Schweizer (2023), katika The North American Journal of Economics and Finance, walitumia mtihani wa usababishi wa bootstrap wa dirisha linalozunguka katika Mei 2018 hadi Desemba 2020 na wakapata kitu cha kuvutia zaidi ya matokeo yoyote: usababishi kati ya hisia za hofu na bei za Bitcoin haukuwa thabiti. Ulijitokeza, ukatoweka, na ukabadilisha alama katika vipindi vidogo, na ukahama tena kuzunguka janga.

93c28e55ff32.en: It is not - the second factor means the password alone is useless
93c28e55ff32.sw: Si tatizo - kipengele cha pili humaanisha nenosiri peke yake hakina maana

93c9db357353.en: Never type your seed phrase into anything. Not a website, not an app, not a form, not a chat, not a support ticket, not a spreadsheet, not a photo. No legitimate service will ever ask for it, because no legitimate technical operation requires it. There is no exception for an official-looking page, a padlock icon, an urgent security alert, or a person who has been helpful for an hour. The request itself is the proof of the attack. Your seed phrase is only ever typed into a wallet you are deliberately restoring, on a device you control, and never in response to anyone contacting you.
93c9db357353.sw: Usiandike kamwe kifungu chako cha mbegu katika chochote. Si tovuti, si programu, si fomu, si gumzo, si tikiti ya msaada, si lahajedwali, si picha. Hakuna huduma halali itakayowahi kukiomba, kwa sababu hakuna shughuli halali ya kiufundi inayokihitaji. Hakuna ubaguzi kwa ukurasa unaoonekana rasmi, alama ya kufuli, tahadhari ya dharura ya usalama, au mtu ambaye amekuwa akisaidia kwa saa moja. Ombi lenyewe ndilo uthibitisho wa shambulizi. Kifungu chako cha mbegu huandikwa tu katika pochi unayoirejesha kwa makusudi, katika kifaa unachokidhibiti, na kamwe si kujibu yeyote anayekufikia.

93d9b42be632.en: Allocation: crypto is at most 5% of total wealth. Sizing: no single asset above 1% of total wealth; largest two together no more than 3%. Leverage: none. Entry: purchases on the first of the month, fixed amount, regardless of price. Exit: sell only to restore the 5% band, or if the reason recorded for holding an asset no longer applies. Custody map: at most 500 on any exchange at any time, everything else in a hardware wallet within seven days of purchase. Recovery: two paper copies of the phrase, one at home and one at a named relative's house, never photographed and never typed into a connected device. Succession: a sealed letter with my will, and one named person who knows it exists. Reviewed on the first Saturday of each quarter.
93d9b42be632.sw: Mgawanyo: kripto ni kiwango cha juu cha 5% ya utajiri jumla. Kupanga ukubwa: hakuna rasilimali moja juu ya 1% ya utajiri jumla; kubwa mbili pamoja si zaidi ya 3%. Mzingo: hakuna. Kuingia: manunuzi tarehe ya kwanza ya mwezi, kiasi kisichobadilika, bila kujali bei. Kutoka: uza tu kurejesha ukanda wa 5%, au ikiwa sababu iliyoandikwa ya kushikilia rasilimali haitumiki tena. Ramani ya utunzaji: kiwango cha juu cha 500 katika soko lolote la kubadilisha wakati wowote, kila kitu kingine katika pochi ya maunzi ndani ya siku saba za ununuzi. Urejeshaji: nakala mbili za karatasi za kifungu, moja nyumbani na moja katika nyumba ya jamaa aliyetajwa, kisipigwe picha kamwe na kisiandikwe kamwe katika kifaa kilichounganishwa. Urithi: barua iliyofungwa pamoja na wosia wangu, na mtu mmoja aliyetajwa anayejua ipo. Hukaguliwa Jumamosi ya kwanza ya kila robo mwaka.

93da7f3bcb45.en: Correct — under fixed pegs there wasn't much to actively trade. Once rates floated freely after 1973, currency values became a live, moving target — which is exactly what created the modern forex market.
93da7f3bcb45.sw: Sahihi — chini ya vifungo thabiti hakukuwa na kitu kingi cha kufanyia biashara kwa bidii. Mara viwango vilipoelea kwa uhuru baada ya 1973, thamani za sarafu zikawa lengo hai, linalosogea — ambalo ndilo hasa lililounda soko la kisasa la forex.

93f05db43b9a.en: Correct — that's all a crossover is: recent average prices underperforming the longer-window average. It's read as a bearish shift, but it guarantees nothing.
93f05db43b9a.sw: Sahihi — hicho ndicho tu mkatizo ulivyo: bei za wastani za hivi karibuni kufanya vibaya kuliko wastani wa dirisha refu zaidi. Husomwa kama mabadiliko ya kushuka, lakini haihakikishi chochote.

94073a3545b6.en: One element of the chain matters more to readers outside the largest markets than to anyone inside them.
94073a3545b6.sw: Kipengele kimoja cha mnyororo kina maana zaidi kwa wasomaji walio nje ya masoko makubwa zaidi kuliko kwa yeyote aliye ndani yake.

940f8c28654d.en: That study is on stock investors, and it is worth being honest about that — but the mechanism transfers directly, and forex makes it worse. Every trade pays the bid-ask spread (Chapter 1, Lesson 4), so more trades means more guaranteed cost before you are even right or wrong. Add leverage (Chapter 3, Lesson 2), and the damage from acting too often compounds faster than it would in a plain stock account.
940f8c28654d.sw: Utafiti huo ni juu ya wawekezaji wa hisa, na inastahili kuwa mwaminifu kuhusu hilo — lakini utaratibu huhamishika moja kwa moja, na forex huufanya kuwa mbaya zaidi. Kila biashara hulipa spread ya bid-ask (Sura ya 1, Somo la 4), hivyo biashara nyingi zaidi inamaanisha gharama zaidi ya uhakika kabla hata hujawa sahihi au si sahihi. Ongeza leverage (Sura ya 3, Somo la 2), na madhara ya kutenda mara nyingi mno hujikusanya kwa kasi zaidi kuliko yangefanya katika akaunti ya kawaida ya hisa.

941020b5475a.en: Not quite — a pre-mortem assumes the trade already failed and lists why, surfacing risks that optimism about your own idea hides.
941020b5475a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — pre-mortem hudhania biashara tayari imeshindwa na huorodhesha kwa nini, ikifichua hatari ambazo matumaini kuhusu wazo lako mwenyewe huzificha.

94155c0cac88.en: Not quite. The rate was not concealed and was not funded by borrowers or fees. It was paid from a reserve that had to be replenished, which is a rate paid out of capital — sustainable precisely until the capital runs out.
94155c0cac88.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kiwango hakikufichwa wala hakikufadhiliwa na wakopaji au ada. Kililipwa kutoka akiba iliyopaswa kujazwa tena, ambacho ni kiwango kinacholipwa kutoka mtaji — kinachodumu hasa hadi mtaji utakapoisha.

942ca6366812.en: Carry. In currencies, carry is the interest rate differential. In equities the nearest equivalent is what the holding pays you while you wait: the dividend yield, or more completely the shareholder yield including buybacks. Chapter 1 Lesson 6 established that a dividend is not free money, since the price drops by roughly the payment. Carry here means the return that does not require the market to agree with you, which is a different and more modest claim.
942ca6366812.sw: Kubeba. Katika sarafu, kubeba ni tofauti ya viwango vya riba. Katika hisa kinachokaribia zaidi ni kile ambacho umiliki hukulipa unaposubiri: mavuno ya gawio, au kikamilifu zaidi mavuno ya mwenyehisa ikijumuisha ununuzi wa hisa. Sura ya 1 Somo la 6 lilithibitisha kwamba gawio si pesa ya bure, kwa kuwa bei hushuka kwa takriban kiasi cha malipo. Kubeba hapa humaanisha faida isiyohitaji soko likubaliane nawe, ambalo ni dai tofauti na la wastani zaidi.

943e73ab7573.en: True or False: Anton, Cohen and Polk's "best ideas" finding shows that traders should simply act more confidently.
943e73ab7573.sw: Kweli au Uongo: tokeo la "mawazo bora" la Anton, Cohen na Polk linaonyesha kwamba wafanyabiashara wanapaswa kutenda kwa kujiamini zaidi tu.

9440c90feb1f.en: The dividend divided by the share price. Rises when the price falls, which is often why it is high.
9440c90feb1f.sw: Gawio kugawanywa kwa bei ya hisa. Hupanda bei inaposhuka, ambayo mara nyingi ndiyo sababu yako makubwa.

9443c1639ff4.en: The exchange of shares for money after a trade is agreed — T+1 in the United States since 28 May 2024.
9443c1639ff4.sw: Kubadilishana hisa kwa pesa baada ya biashara kukubaliwa — T+1 nchini Marekani tangu 28 Mei 2024.

94597b958bee.en: Take the same 50,000 dollar position, at the same 50:1 broker leverage, on two different accounts. On the 2,000 dollar account above, effective leverage is 50,000 / 2,000 = 25:1, and you saw the margin call arrive after just 200 pips. On a 10,000 dollar account, the identical position is only 50,000 / 10,000 = 5:1 effective leverage — and now the margin call does not arrive until a floating loss of 9,000 dollars, an 18% move of about 1,800 pips. Same broker, same leverage cap, same trade. One account dies at 200 pips; the other survives to 1,800. The only difference is how much of the account was committed.
94597b958bee.sw: Chukua nafasi ile ile ya dola 50,000, kwa leverage ile ile ya broker ya 50:1, kwenye akaunti mbili tofauti. Kwenye akaunti ya dola 2,000 hapo juu, leverage halisi ni 50,000 / 2,000 = 25:1, na uliona wito wa margin ukifika baada ya pip 200 tu. Kwenye akaunti ya dola 10,000, nafasi ile ile ni leverage halisi ya 50,000 / 10,000 = 5:1 tu — na sasa wito wa margin haufiki hadi hasara inayoelea ya dola 9,000, msogeo wa 18% wa takriban pip 1,800. Broker yule yule, kikomo kile kile cha leverage, biashara ile ile. Akaunti moja hufa kwa pip 200; nyingine hunusurika hadi 1,800. Tofauti pekee ni kiasi gani cha akaunti kilichojitolewa.

94607c525a85.en: True or False: the broker's stop-out level is a guaranteed floor, so your account can never go below it.
94607c525a85.sw: Kweli au Uongo: kiwango cha stop-out cha broker ni sakafu ya uhakika, hivyo akaunti yako haiwezi kamwe kwenda chini yake.

9465aa238a0c.en: A 33% fall is common. It is smaller than the fall in either case study in Chapter 5, and smaller than several ordinary corrections. Leverage does not create a distant catastrophic scenario; it converts an unremarkable market event into a forced sale at the worst available price.
9465aa238a0c.sw: Kushuka kwa 33% ni kwa kawaida. Ni kudogo kuliko kushuka katika uchunguzi wowote wa matukio katika Sura ya 5, na kudogo kuliko marekebisho kadhaa ya kawaida. Leverage haizalishi hali ya maafa ya mbali; hugeuza tukio la soko lisilo la kawaida kuwa uuzaji wa lazima kwa bei mbaya zaidi inayopatikana.

9467191e5fea.en: Receivables growing considerably faster than revenue is one of the oldest warning signs in company analysis. It can be ordinary growth in a business that bills before it collects. It can also mean the company is booking sales to customers who will not pay, or offering unusually generous terms to keep revenue rising. The statements will not tell you which, but they will tell you to ask.
9467191e5fea.sw: Madeni ya wateja yanayokua kwa kasi zaidi mno kuliko mapato ni mojawapo ya ishara za onyo za zamani zaidi katika uchambuzi wa kampuni. Kunaweza kuwa ukuaji wa kawaida katika biashara inayotuma bili kabla ya kukusanya. Kunaweza pia kumaanisha kampuni inarekodi mauzo kwa wateja wasiolipa, au inatoa masharti ya ukarimu isivyo kawaida ili kuweka mapato yakipanda. Taarifa hazitakuambia ni ipi, lakini zitakuambia uulize.

9469acdc5be3.en: A daily 0 to 100 composite sentiment score built by weighting several market and attention measures.
9469acdc5be3.sw: Alama jumuishi ya hisia ya kila siku ya 0 hadi 100 iliyojengwa kwa kupima uzito wa vipimo kadhaa vya soko na uangalifu.

94831bf7817b.en: End on an honest note, because the course would not be worth much otherwise. Even doing all of this correctly, most retail accounts still lose money — trading is difficult, and nothing here guarantees a profit. What a disciplined process can do is remove the self-inflicted losses: the blown accounts from over-leverage, the giving-back from the disposition effect, the bleed from overtrading, the scams. Take those away, and you are left facing only the market's real difficulty, instead of your own avoidable errors. That is a far better place to stand than where most beginners start.
94831bf7817b.sw: Malizia kwa dokezo la uaminifu, kwa sababu kozi isingekuwa na thamani kubwa vinginevyo. Hata ukifanya haya yote kwa usahihi, akaunti nyingi za rejareja bado hupoteza pesa — biashara ni ngumu, na hakuna kilicho hapa kinachohakikisha faida. Kile ambacho mchakato wenye nidhamu unaweza kufanya ni kuondoa hasara ulizojiletea: akaunti zilizolipuka kutokana na leverage kupita kiasi, kurudisha kutoka athari ya kuachana na nafasi, kumwagika kutokana na kufanya biashara kupita kiasi, ulaghai. Ondoa hizo, na unabaki ukikabiliana na ugumu halisi wa soko tu, badala ya makosa yako mwenyewe yanayoepukika. Hiyo ni sehemu bora mno ya kusimama kuliko pale wanaoanza wengi wanapoanzia.

94a1d07fd2f4.en: The general rule takes one multiplication. Funding cost as a percentage of your margin, per day, equals the daily funding rate on notional multiplied by your leverage. At 10x, funding of 0.01% per 8 hours costs 0.3% of margin per day. At 50x the same funding costs 1.5% of margin per day. At 100x it costs 3.0% of margin per day.
94a1d07fd2f4.sw: Kanuni ya jumla huchukua kuzidisha kumoja. Gharama ya ufadhili kama asilimia ya mkopo wako, kwa siku, ni sawa na kiwango cha ufadhili cha kila siku juu ya ya kinadharia kikizidishwa na mzingo wako. Katika 10x, ufadhili wa 0.01% kwa masaa 8 hugharimu 0.3% ya mkopo kwa siku. Katika 50x ufadhili uleule hugharimu 1.5% ya mkopo kwa siku. Katika 100x hugharimu 3.0% ya mkopo kwa siku.

94a597d46b22.en: Correct — medium of exchange, store of value, and unit of account are the three real functions. "Store of physical weight" isn't one of them.
94a597d46b22.sw: Sahihi — njia ya kubadilishana, hifadhi ya thamani, na kipimo cha hesabu ndizo kazi tatu halisi. "Hifadhi ya uzito wa kimwili" si mojawapo yao.

94bce98afb42.en: This week, apply four checks. When a wallet or person says a payment was "sent," ask: broadcast, in a block, or buried? Before sending during a busy period, check the current fee level — the same transaction can cost 10 times more during congestion, and fees never price the amount moved. When an exchange says "credited after N confirmations," read N as that exchange's risk judgment, not a law of the protocol. And when someone quotes an exact historical fee record, check it against at least two data sources — reputable providers disagreed by some 20 dollars on Ethereum's May 2021 peak.
94bce98afb42.sw: Wiki hii, tumia ukaguzi nne. Pochi au mtu anaposema malipo "yametumwa," uliza: yametangazwa, yako katika kitalu, au yamezikwa? Kabla ya kutuma wakati wa kipindi chenye shughuli, kagua kiwango cha sasa cha ada — muamala uleule unaweza kugharimu mara 10 zaidi wakati wa msongamano, na ada hazipangi bei ya kiasi kilichohamishwa kamwe. Soko la kubadilisha linaposema "kimewekwa baada ya uthibitisho N," soma N kama hukumu ya hatari ya soko hilo, si sheria ya itifaki. Na mtu anaponukuu rekodi hasa ya ada ya kihistoria, ikague dhidi ya angalau vyanzo viwili vya data — watoa data wenye sifa nzuri walitofautiana kwa takriban dola 20 kuhusu kilele cha Mei 2021 cha Ethereum.

94d616bd89f5.sw: Kukosekana kwa kufunga kuna manufaa kweli kwa mtu mwenye mpango na kuna hatari kweli kwa mtu asiye na mpango. Huondoa kipande kimoja cha msuguano kilichokuwa kikiwalinda watu dhidi yao wenyewe.

94e93d3d2e4b.en: The fraction of trades you must win, at a given risk-to-reward ratio, simply to end up flat. It equals 1 divided by (1 + R), where R is the reward as a multiple of the risk.
94e93d3d2e4b.sw: Sehemu ya biashara lazima ushinde, kwa uwiano fulani wa hatari-kwa-tuzo, ili tu kuishia sawa. Ni sawa na 1 kugawanywa kwa (1 + R), ambapo R ni tuzo kama kizidishi cha hatari.

9528de24a5f9.en: A company reports three financial statements, and beginners usually read one of them. Reading all three is what separates a view of a business from a view of a headline.

952d2322d480.en: Malicious software that watches your device's clipboard for anything shaped like a crypto address, and silently replaces it with the attacker's address at the moment you paste. You copy the correct address. Something else arrives in the field.

9538f6260149.en: There is one more piece, and it is the one this course has cited before. Forex Chapter 6, Lesson 3 introduced Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu (2022), "Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency," published in The Journal of Finance, volume 77, issue 2. The authors show that three factors — a cryptocurrency market factor, size, and momentum — capture the cross-section of expected crypto returns. The point that lesson drew, and this one repeats, is structural: crypto returns are organised by the same kind of factor logic that organises ordinary asset markets, rather than escaping it.
9538f6260149.sw: Kuna kipande kimoja zaidi, nacho ndicho kozi hii imekwisha kukinukuu. Forex Sura ya 6, Somo la 3 lilianzisha Liu, Tsyvinski na Wu (2022), "Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency," iliyochapishwa katika The Journal of Finance, juzuu 77, toleo la 2. Waandishi huonyesha kwamba vipengele vitatu — kipengele cha soko la sarafu ya kripto, ukubwa, na kasi — hushika sehemu-mtambuka ya faida za kripto zinazotarajiwa. Jambo ambalo somo hilo lilitoa, na hili hulirudia, ni la kimuundo: faida za kripto hupangwa na aina ileile ya mantiki ya vipengele inayopanga masoko ya kawaida ya rasilimali, badala ya kuikwepa.

9557464839d9.en: Recurring practices keeping self-custodied assets reachable by you and nobody else.
9557464839d9.sw: Mazoea yanayojirudia yanayoweka rasilimali zilizo katika utunzaji binafsi zikifikika na wewe na hakuna mwingine.

9557e5be63d9.en: This means a cap-weighted index concentrates on its own. Nobody decides to increase the weighting of the most expensive part of the market; the rule does it automatically as prices rise. An index of 500 companies can quietly become a bet on a handful of them. Chapter 5 looks at what that produced in 1999, and it is the strongest honest caveat against treating a broad index fund as risk-free diversification.
9557e5be63d9.sw: Hii inamaanisha index yenye uzito wa mtaji hujikita yenyewe. Hakuna anayeamua kuongeza uzito wa sehemu ghali zaidi ya soko; kanuni hufanya hivyo kiotomatiki bei zinapopanda. Index ya kampuni 500 inaweza kimyakimya kuwa dau juu ya chache kati yao. Sura ya 5 inatazama hilo lilizalisha nini mwaka 1999, na ndilo onyo imara zaidi la uaminifu dhidi ya kuchukulia index fund pana kama usambazaji usio na hatari.

955d88c2f500.en: Correlation is not causation, and short windows manufacture both. Two series can move together for months because a third thing is driving both, or because of nothing at all. Longin and Solnik, writing in The Journal of Finance in 2001, made this warning explicit for exactly this kind of study: naive comparisons of correlation across calm and volatile periods produce a spurious relationship between correlation and volatility, because volatility itself changes the measurement. That is why they built a method around extreme returns rather than trusting the raw comparison. Apply the same suspicion to any 30-day crypto correlation chart you see on social media.
955d88c2f500.sw: Uhusiano si usababishi, na madirisha mafupi hutengeneza vyote viwili. Misururu miwili inaweza kusogea pamoja kwa miezi kwa sababu kitu cha tatu kinaendesha vyote, au kwa sababu ya lolote. Longin na Solnik, wakiandika katika The Journal of Finance mwaka 2001, walitoa onyo hili wazi kwa aina hiyo hasa ya utafiti: ulinganisho wa kijinga wa uhusiano katika vipindi tulivu na vyenye mtikisiko huzalisha uhusiano wa uongo kati ya uhusiano na mtikisiko, kwa sababu mtikisiko wenyewe hubadilisha kipimo. Ndiyo maana walijenga mbinu kuzunguka faida kali badala ya kuamini ulinganisho ghafi. Tumia mashaka yaleyale kwa chati yoyote ya uhusiano wa kripto ya siku 30 unayoiona katika mitandao ya kijamii.

9565bffc4ed5.en: The reason the effect is so much larger than the headline number is that the fee is charged on the whole balance every year, including on the gains that previous years' fees have already reduced. Compounding works on costs exactly as it works on returns, and in the same direction — away from you.
9565bffc4ed5.sw: Sababu athari ni kubwa mno kuliko namba ya kichwa cha habari ni kwamba ada hutozwa juu ya salio lote kila mwaka, ikiwemo juu ya faida ambazo ada za miaka iliyotangulia tayari zimezipunguza. Kujikusanya hufanya kazi juu ya gharama hasa kama inavyofanya juu ya faida, na kwa mwelekeo ule ule — mbali nawe.

957d5dae93fe.en: Pick one broad index ETF and find four numbers in its official documentation: the ongoing charge, the fund size, the tracking difference over three years, and whether it is physical or synthetic. If you cannot find any of the four within ten minutes, that is itself informative — the documents you cannot navigate are the ones you should not buy.
957d5dae93fe.sw: Chagua ETF moja pana ya index na upate namba nne katika nyaraka zake rasmi: malipo ya kudumu, ukubwa wa fund, tofauti ya kufuatilia katika miaka mitatu, na kama ni ya kimwili au ya bandia. Kama huwezi kupata yoyote kati ya nne ndani ya dakika kumi, hilo lenyewe lina taarifa — nyaraka usizoweza kuzipitia ndizo usizopaswa kununua.

958a3de9bc9a.en: Because the premium is measured after all costs by convention
958a3de9bc9a.sw: Kwa sababu malipo ya ziada hupimwa baada ya gharama zote kwa desturi

958cb33196e4.sw: Upotoshaji mwingine miwili unastahili kutajwa kwa sababu hutenda baada ya kumiliki kitu badala ya kabla.

9597b209e4e8.en: One qualification to the general rule that cheaper is better, because the previous lesson's finding cuts both ways.
9597b209e4e8.sw: Sifa moja ya kanuni ya jumla kwamba nafuu ni bora, kwa sababu tokeo la somo lililotangulia hukata pande zote mbili.

95aa2cd6e385.en: Chapter 1 Lesson 5 already showed you this on the other kind of venue. On a decentralized exchange using an automated market maker, your own trade moves the price along a formula, and it moves it more the larger your trade is relative to the pool. On a centralized exchange with an order book, the same thing happens for a different mechanical reason: you eat through resting bids one price level at a time. Both produce slippage, which the Forex track defines in Chapter 1 Lesson 7 as the gap between the price you expected and the price you got.
95aa2cd6e385.sw: Sura ya 1 Somo la 5 tayari lilikuonyesha hili katika aina nyingine ya uwanja. Katika soko la kubadilisha lisilo na kituo kikuu linalotumia mtengeneza-soko wa kiotomatiki, biashara yako mwenyewe husogeza bei kwa mujibu wa fomula, nayo huisogeza zaidi kadiri biashara yako inavyokuwa kubwa ikilinganishwa na bwawa. Katika soko la kubadilisha lenye kituo kikuu chenye kitabu cha maagizo, jambo lilelile hutokea kwa sababu tofauti ya kimitambo: unakula zabuni zilizopumzika kiwango kimoja cha bei baada ya kingine. Vyote hutoa mtelezo, ambao njia ya Forex huufafanua katika Sura ya 1 Somo la 7 kama pengo kati ya bei uliyotarajia na bei uliyoipata.

96116351ae2d.sw: Pengo kati ya faida ya fund na faida ya index yake katika kipindi. Kosa la kufuatilia ni kutofautiana kwa pengo hilo.

962a295b81a9.en: Multiply the target price by the supply to see what market capitalisation the claim implies — with a trillion units in supply, one dollar means a one trillion dollar valuation
962a295b81a9.sw: Zidisha bei lengwa na usambazaji ili kuona dai linaashiria kiasi gani cha soko — kwa vipimo trilioni katika usambazaji, dola moja humaanisha tathmini ya dola trilioni moja

964d64eecd19.en: A company holds 500 million of assets and owes 400 million. Equity is 100 million. If the assets turn out to be worth 380 million — a factory worth less than its book value, stock that will not sell — the liabilities do not shrink. Equity absorbs all of it and goes negative. The shareholders were wiped out while the lenders were merely worried.
964d64eecd19.sw: Kampuni hushikilia mali ya milioni 500 na inadaiwa milioni 400. Usawa ni milioni 100. Kama mali zitaonekana zina thamani ya milioni 380 — kiwanda chenye thamani ndogo kuliko thamani yake ya kitabu, bidhaa zisizoweza kuuzwa — madeni hayapungui. Usawa hufyonza yote na huwa hasi. Wanahisa walifutwa ilhali wakopeshaji walikuwa na wasiwasi tu.

96607df40297.sw: Jina la soko la kubadilisha ambalo mchambuzi hulitumia

99906793b9b2.en: Convert it to a single day. Crypto trades every day, so divide by the square root of 365. 46 divided by 19.105 = 2.41% per day. So a typical, unremarkable, no-news day in bitcoin has a standard deviation of about 2.41%. The full high-to-low range of a day is wider still: Lesson 1's worked average true range was 1,900 dollars on a 60,000 dollar price, which is 3.17% of price covered by the average daily bar. Now set both figures beside the liquidation distances. At 10x, liquidation is 9.6% away, about 4.0 daily standard deviations or about 3.0 average daily ranges. At 25x it is 3.6% away, about 1.5 standard deviations or about 1.1 average daily ranges. At 50x it is 1.6% away, about 0.66 standard deviations, or about half of one average daily range. At 100x it is 0.6% away, about 0.25 standard deviations of a day, which is roughly one and a quarter hours of typical movement.
99906793b9b2.sw: Ibadilishe kuwa siku moja. Kripto hufanyiwa biashara kila siku, kwa hivyo gawanya kwa mzizi wa mraba wa 365. 46 ikigawanywa na 19.105 = 2.41% kwa siku. Kwa hivyo siku ya kawaida, isiyoshangaza, isiyo na habari katika bitcoin ina mkengeuko wa kawaida wa takriban 2.41%. Kiwango kamili cha kilele-hadi-bonde cha siku ni pana zaidi: wastani wa kiwango halisi uliofanyiwa kazi wa Somo la 1 ulikuwa dola 1,900 katika bei ya dola 60,000, ambayo ni 3.17% ya bei inayofunikwa na mstari wa wastani wa kila siku. Sasa weka takwimu zote mbili kando ya umbali wa ufilisi. Katika 10x, ufilisi ni 9.6% mbali, takriban mikengeuko 4.0 ya kawaida ya kila siku au takriban viwango 3.0 vya wastani vya kila siku. Katika 25x ni 3.6% mbali, takriban mikengeuko 1.5 ya kawaida au takriban viwango 1.1 vya wastani vya kila siku. Katika 50x ni 1.6% mbali, takriban mikengeuko 0.66 ya kawaida, au takriban nusu ya kiwango kimoja cha wastani cha kila siku. Katika 100x ni 0.6% mbali, takriban mikengeuko 0.25 ya kawaida ya siku, ambayo ni takriban saa moja na robo ya msogeo wa kawaida.

99e4d1f6586c.en: For crypto specifically, the closest measurement is about spot buying rather than leverage, and it is worth quoting with that limitation attached. In Bank for International Settlements Working Paper No 1049, "Crypto trading and Bitcoin prices: evidence from a new database of retail adoption," published in November 2022 and later in the IMF Economic Review, the authors used daily crypto-app usage data across 95 countries from 2015 to 2022. Under the assumption that each new user bought 100 dollars of bitcoin in the month they downloaded the app and in every month after, 81% would have lost money; across their range of assumptions, an estimated 73% to 81% of retail investors likely lost money on their investment. That study used no leverage at all. It measures what buying spot at the times retail typically buys produced. Adding a liquidation price to that behaviour does not improve it.
99e4d1f6586c.sw: Kwa kripto hasa, kipimo cha karibu zaidi kinahusu kununua papo hapo badala ya mzingo, nacho kinastahili kunukuliwa kikiwa na kikomo hicho kimeambatishwa. Katika Bank for International Settlements Working Paper No 1049, "Crypto trading and Bitcoin prices: evidence from a new database of retail adoption," iliyochapishwa mwezi Novemba 2022 na baadaye katika IMF Economic Review, waandishi walitumia data ya matumizi ya programu za kripto ya kila siku katika nchi 95 kuanzia 2015 hadi 2022. Chini ya dhana kwamba kila mtumiaji mpya alinunua dola 100 za bitcoin katika mwezi aliopakua programu na katika kila mwezi baada ya hapo, 81% wangepoteza pesa; katika kiwango chao cha dhana, makadirio ya 73% hadi 81% ya wawekezaji wa rejareja pengine walipoteza pesa katika uwekezaji wao. Utafiti huo haukutumia mzingo kabisa. Hupima kile ambacho kununua papo hapo katika nyakati ambazo rejareja kwa kawaida hununua kilizalisha. Kuongeza bei ya ufilisi katika tabia hiyo hakuiboreshi.

99e528487be8.en: Test this rather than assume it. It is the same argument as the withdrawal test for exchanges: verify the exit path while nothing is wrong, because that is the only time it can be verified calmly.
99e528487be8.sw: Pima hili badala ya kulidhania. Kurejesha pochi katika programu ya pili, tofauti, kuthibitisha anwani zilezile zinajitokeza, kisha kurudisha kila kitu ni zoezi la nusu saa linalogeuza dhana kuwa ukweli. Ni hoja ileile kama mtihani wa utoaji kwa masoko ya kubadilisha: thibitisha njia ya kutoka wakati hakuna kilicho kibaya, kwa sababu huo ndio wakati pekee inapoweza kuthibitishwa kwa utulivu.

99f17ae486fb.en: Why do exchanges wait for several confirmations before crediting a Bitcoin deposit?
99f17ae486fb.sw: Kwa nini masoko ya kubadilisha husubiri uthibitisho kadhaa kabla ya kuweka amana ya Bitcoin katika akaunti?

99f1ca9e66c1.en: One company trades at 300 a share, another at 100. In a price-weighted index the first has three times the influence of the second — even if the second company is worth far more in total, because it has issued many more shares. A 1% move in the 300 share moves the index three times as much as a 1% move in the 100 share.
99f1ca9e66c1.sw: Kampuni moja hufanyiwa biashara kwa 300 kwa hisa, nyingine kwa 100. Katika index yenye uzito wa bei ya kwanza ina ushawishi mara tatu ya ya pili — hata kama kampuni ya pili ina thamani kubwa mno kwa jumla, kwa sababu imetoa hisa nyingi zaidi. Msogeo wa 1% kwenye hisa ya 300 husogeza index mara tatu zaidi ya msogeo wa 1% kwenye hisa ya 100.

99f2d1568dd0.en: Diagram showing the two-step pip value calculation and the three cases: quote currency equals account currency (exactly 10 dollars), base currency equals account currency (convert, about 6.67), and a cross pair (convert, about 12.70), then the effect on position size
99f2d1568dd0.sw: Mchoro unaoonyesha hesabu ya hatua mbili ya thamani ya pip na kesi tatu: sarafu ya bei sawa na sarafu ya akaunti (dola 10 hasa), sarafu ya msingi sawa na sarafu ya akaunti (badilisha, takriban 6.67), na jozi la kuvuka (badilisha, takriban 12.70), kisha athari kwenye ukubwa wa nafasi

99ffc3899334.en: Mandatory identity checks at regulated financial firms, including centralized exchanges.
99ffc3899334.sw: Ukaguzi wa lazima wa utambulisho katika kampuni za kifedha zinazodhibitiwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na masoko ya kubadilisha yenye kituo kikuu.

9a02a6508f5a.en: That ranking shifts over time — the yuan's rise from 0.8% to 8.1% in fifteen years is proof of that. Don't treat any pair ranking as permanent; check current data rather than relying on a number that may be years out of date.
9a02a6508f5a.sw: Daraja hilo hubadilika kwa muda — kupanda kwa yuan kutoka 0.8% hadi 8.1% katika miaka kumi na tano ni ushahidi wa hilo. Usichukulie daraja lolote la jozi kama la kudumu; kagua data ya sasa badala ya kutegemea namba inayoweza kuwa ya miaka iliyopita.

9a064f516850.en: A product offering a fixed, high and supposedly reliable return on deposits, funded not by any activity that produces a return but by the deposits of later participants.
9a064f516850.sw: Bidhaa inayotoa faida isiyobadilika, kubwa na inayodaiwa kuaminika juu ya amana, isiyofadhiliwa na shughuli yoyote inayozalisha faida bali na amana za washiriki wa baadaye.

9a0e327440fc.en: There is a further part of this story that belongs in a course about verifying claims, because the exchange offered an explanation and researchers checked it.
9a0e327440fc.sw: Kuna sehemu zaidi ya hadithi hii inayostahili kuwa katika kozi kuhusu kuthibitisha madai, kwa sababu soko la kubadilisha lilitoa maelezo na watafiti wakayakagua.

9a1e9c768b10.en: A smart contract that prices trades with a formula instead of an order book.
9a1e9c768b10.sw: Mkataba mahiri unaopanga bei za biashara kwa fomula badala ya kitabu cha maagizo.

9a214afc7f07.en: What exists instead is on-chain activity, and Chapter 2 Lesson 4 was deliberately careful about its limits. Active addresses, transaction counts and exchange flows are real measurements of real things, and they are not accounting. An address is not a person. A transaction is not a sale. The measurement can be inflated deliberately and often is.
9a214afc7f07.sw: Kilichopo badala yake ni shughuli ya kwenye mnyororo, na Sura ya 2 Somo la 4 lilikuwa makini kwa makusudi kuhusu vikomo vyake. Anwani hai, hesabu za miamala na mitiririko ya masoko ya kubadilisha ni vipimo halisi vya vitu halisi, navyo si uhasibu. Anwani si mtu. Muamala si uuzaji. Kipimo kinaweza kukuzwa kwa makusudi na mara nyingi hukuzwa.

9a40b5ed1207.en: The landmark study is Fama and French, in the Journal of Finance in 1992 (volume 47, issue 2, pages 427 to 465). They examined which characteristics actually explained differences in average share returns, and found that two easily measured variables did most of the work: company size, and book-to-market equity — the accounting value of a company against its market price.
9a40b5ed1207.sw: Utafiti muhimu ni Fama na French, katika Journal of Finance mwaka 1992 (juzuu 47, toleo 2, kurasa 427 hadi 465). Walichunguza ni sifa zipi zilizoeleza hasa tofauti za faida za wastani za hisa, na wakagundua kwamba vigezo viwili vinavyopimika kwa urahisi vilifanya kazi nyingi: ukubwa wa kampuni, na usawa wa kitabu-kwa-soko — thamani ya kihasibu ya kampuni dhidi ya bei yake ya soko.

9a5af400fcf9.en: Two honest limits on all of this, because the course does not sell certainty.
9a5af400fcf9.sw: Vikomo viwili vya kweli juu ya haya yote, kwa sababu kozi haiuzi uhakika.

9a60efe9b0c8.en: True or False: discipline in trading means staying calm and unemotional while you decide what to do in a live trade.
9a60efe9b0c8.sw: Kweli au Uongo: nidhamu katika biashara inamaanisha kubaki mtulivu na bila hisia unapoamua cha kufanya katika biashara hai.

9a6880d1fc35.en: Each node's pool of valid transactions that have been broadcast but not yet included in a block. Think of it as the queue outside the ledger. A transaction in the mempool has been seen; it has not been recorded.
9a6880d1fc35.sw: Bwawa la kila nodi la miamala halali iliyotangazwa lakini bado haijajumuishwa katika kitalu. Ifikirie kama foleni iliyo nje ya leja. Muamala ulio katika mempool umeonekana; haujaandikwa.

9a6f15d38e74.en: Money isn't defined by what it's made of — it's defined by what it does.
9a6f15d38e74.sw: Pesa haifafanuliwi kwa kile iliyotengenezwa nacho — inafafanuliwa kwa kile inachofanya.

9a704eaa92e7.en: Leverage cuts identically in both directions. It doesn't just amplify potential gains — it amplifies losses by exactly the same factor. A 2% adverse move against a fully leveraged 50:1 position wipes out 100% of the margin backing it. This is the single most important thing to understand about leverage before using it.
9a704eaa92e7.sw: Leverage hukata vivyo hivyo pande zote mbili. Haiongezi tu faida zinazowezekana — huongeza hasara kwa kipimo kile kile hasa. Msogeo mbaya wa 2% dhidi ya nafasi ya leverage kamili ya 50:1 hufuta 100% ya margin inayoiunga mkono. Hili ndilo jambo muhimu kuliko yote kuelewa kuhusu leverage kabla ya kuitumia.

9a8c63bfd101.en: Not quite — the research had already described this shape of steady gains and sudden correlated crashes. The unwind was a known risk arriving, not unforeseeable.
9a8c63bfd101.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — utafiti ulikuwa tayari umeelezea umbo hili la faida thabiti na maanguko ya ghafla yenye uwiano. Kuvunjika kulikuwa hatari inayojulikana ikifika, si isiyotabirika.

9a8ff5a84d67.en: A measure of how spread out values are around their average.
9a8ff5a84d67.sw: Kipimo cha jinsi thamani zilivyotawanyika kuzunguka wastani wao.

9a918fd076c0.en: Foundations Chapter 2 established that being right often is not the same as trading well. The Forex track showed what that costs in a market that closes every Friday. This chapter covers what it costs in a market that never closes, where the asset has no cash flows to anchor it and the counterparty is sometimes the risk.
9a918fd076c0.sw: Misingi Sura ya 2 lilithibitisha kwamba kuwa sahihi mara nyingi si sawa na kufanya biashara vizuri. Njia ya Forex ilionyesha hilo hugharimu nini katika soko linalofunga kila Ijumaa. Sura hii hushughulikia hugharimu nini katika soko lisilofunga kamwe, ambapo rasilimali haina mitiririko ya fedha ya kuitia nanga na mshirika wakati mwingine ndiye hatari.

9aa47045456c.en: How far your own order moves the price, because it consumes the resting orders on the other side. Price impact grows with the size of your order relative to the depth available. It is the reason large orders receive a worse average price than small ones.
9aa47045456c.sw: Agizo lako mwenyewe husogeza bei kwa kiasi gani, kwa sababu hutumia maagizo yaliyopumzika upande wa pili. Athari ya bei hukua na ukubwa wa agizo lako ikilinganishwa na kina kinachopatikana. Ndiyo sababu maagizo makubwa hupokea bei ya wastani mbaya zaidi kuliko madogo.

9ab7049fd6c0.en: A token holding a fixed value without reserves, maintained by exchange with a second floating token.
9ab7049fd6c0.sw: Tokeni inayoshikilia thamani isiyobadilika bila akiba, ikidumishwa kwa kubadilishana na tokeni ya pili inayoelea.

9ab7cf34d21c.en: A fund holding a basket of assets whose shares trade on an exchange like a share.
9ab7cf34d21c.sw: Fund inayoshikilia kikapu cha mali ambazo hisa zake hufanyiwa biashara sokoni kama hisa.

9abfda779f5a.en: Not quite. There was no regulatory instruction, no fee change and no priority queue. The dynamic is structural — withdrawing is free if you are wrong about the firm and decisive if you are right, so everyone withdraws.
9abfda779f5a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Hakukuwa na maagizo ya udhibiti, hakuna mabadiliko ya ada wala foleni ya kipaumbele. Mienendo ni ya kimuundo — kutoa ni bure ikiwa umekosea kuhusu kampuni na ni kwa maamuzi ikiwa uko sahihi, kwa hivyo kila mtu hutoa.

9adeb08b79b6.en: You believe a pair is about to fall, so you short at 1.36. Your take-profit sits below your entry. Your stop-loss sits above your entry — if price rises instead of falling, that proves you wrong, and you exit there.
9adeb08b79b6.sw: Unaamini jozi fulani inakaribia kushuka, hivyo unafanya short kwa 1.36. Take-profit yako iko chini ya kiingilio chako. Stop-loss yako iko juu ya kiingilio chako — kama bei itapanda badala ya kushuka, hilo linathibitisha umekosea, na unatoka hapo.

9b035d620e87.en: Short selling inverts the position entirely.
9b035d620e87.sw: Kuuza kwa short hugeuza nafasi kabisa.

9b0bcc874b53.en: A risk-to-reward ratio is only real if both prices in it are real. It is easy to draw a target three times as far as your stop and announce a 1:3 trade — but if price has almost no chance of travelling that far before turning, the ratio is a fiction.
9b0bcc874b53.sw: Uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo ni halisi tu kama bei zote mbili ndani yake ni halisi. Ni rahisi kuchora lengo mbali mara tatu ya stop yako na kutangaza biashara ya 1:3 — lakini kama bei haina karibu nafasi yoyote ya kusafiri mbali hivyo kabla ya kugeuka, uwiano ni hadithi.

9b0f7250facb.en: Not quite — support reflects historical buyer behavior, not a guarantee. It can and does break.
9b0f7250facb.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — msaada huonyesha tabia ya kihistoria ya wanunuzi, si uhakika. Unaweza kuvunjika na huvunjika.

9b290aaadc64.sw: Fund mbili zinashikilia mali zinazokaribia kufanana. Moja hutoza 0.05% kwa mwaka, nyingine 1.50%. Katika miaka 30 kwa faida ya msingi ya 7%, kinatokea nini kwa ujumla?

9b29fdb07bd1.en: Tax rules differ by country, and this course will not pretend otherwise or invent a rate to make a tidier example. What transfers everywhere is the structure, and the structure has three parts.
9b29fdb07bd1.sw: Sheria za kodi hutofautiana kwa nchi, na kozi hii haitajifanya vinginevyo wala kuvumbua kiwango ili kutengeneza mfano nadhifu zaidi. Kinachohamishika kila mahali ni muundo, na muundo una sehemu tatu.

9b3349c76d98.en: The Bank of England raising interest rates
9b3349c76d98.sw: Benki ya Uingereza kupandisha viwango vya riba
