9b442d447840.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — peso iliimarika, hivyo peso zile zile 2,000 zinabadilishwa kuwa dola nyingi zaidi kuliko ulizoanza nazo.

9b685ef7a947.en: This is the equity version of the invalidation level from Forex Chapter 6 Lesson 2. There, a trade had a price at which the thesis was proven wrong. Here, a holding has a condition — and the condition is almost never a price.
9b685ef7a947.sw: Hii ni toleo la hisa la kiwango cha kubatilisha kutoka Forex Sura ya 6 Somo la 2. Pale, biashara ilikuwa na bei ambayo kwayo nadharia ilithibitishwa kuwa si sahihi. Hapa, umiliki una sharti — na sharti karibu kamwe si bei.

9b6aff66a042.en: Not quite — a bank run can happen even when the bank hasn't changed anything. It's about many people demanding withdrawal at the same time, not a specific mistake that day.
9b6aff66a042.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kukimbilia benki kunaweza kutokea hata benki isipobadilisha chochote. Inahusu watu wengi kudai kutoa fedha kwa wakati mmoja, si kosa mahususi la siku hiyo.

9b6b4874d5b2.en: Read that definition again slowly, because it is the most practically important sentence in this chapter. The seed phrase is not a password to the money. It is the money. A password unlocks an account that a company controls, and the company can reset it. A seed phrase regenerates the keys themselves. There is no reset. There is no customer support line. If the phrase is lost, nobody on Earth can recover the keys. If the phrase is copied — photographed, typed into the wrong website, read off the note on your desk — the copier does not need your phone, your fingerprint, or your permission. They already have everything.
9b6b4874d5b2.sw: Soma ufafanuzi huo tena polepole, kwa sababu ni sentensi muhimu zaidi kivitendo katika sura hii. Kifungu cha mbegu si nenosiri la kufikia pesa. Ni pesa yenyewe. Nenosiri hufungua akaunti ambayo kampuni huidhibiti, na kampuni inaweza kuliweka upya. Kifungu cha mbegu huzalisha upya funguo zenyewe. Hakuna kuweka upya. Hakuna laini ya huduma kwa wateja. Ikiwa kifungu kimepotea, hakuna mtu duniani anayeweza kurejesha funguo. Ikiwa kifungu kimenakiliwa — kupigwa picha, kuandikwa katika tovuti isiyo sahihi, kusomwa kutoka noti iliyo mezani kwako — mnakili hahitaji simu yako, alama yako ya kidole, wala ruhusa yako. Tayari ana kila kitu.

9b8e7e62be7d.en: Leverage and margin are two sides of the same relationship: margin is expressed as a percentage of the full position size, and leverage is simply the inverse of that percentage.
9b8e7e62be7d.sw: Leverage na margin ni pande mbili za uhusiano ule ule: margin huelezwa kama asilimia ya ukubwa kamili wa nafasi, na leverage ni kinyume tu cha asilimia hiyo.

9b9aa072a26a.en: Chapters 1 through 3 gave you the mechanics and the mathematics: pairs and pips, position sizing, margin, the risk-to-reward ratio. If trading were only those things, a careful beginner would do fine. Most accounts are not lost to bad arithmetic, though. They are lost to good rules abandoned under emotion.
9b9aa072a26a.sw: Sura ya 1 hadi 3 zilikupa utaratibu na hisabati: jozi na pip, upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi, margin, uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo. Kama biashara ingekuwa mambo hayo tu, anayeanza kwa makini angefanya vizuri. Hata hivyo akaunti nyingi hazipotei kwa hesabu mbaya. Zinapotea kwa kanuni nzuri zilizoachwa chini ya hisia.

9ba6631efc28.en: The price is about to fall, so you should open a short position
9ba6631efc28.sw: Bei iko karibu kushuka, kwa hivyo unapaswa kufungua nafasi fupi

9ba84f70cfed.en: According to the RSI discipline in this lesson, when is the higher-quality moment to buy an oversold currency?
9ba84f70cfed.sw: Kwa mujibu wa nidhamu ya RSI katika somo hili, ni wakati gani wenye ubora zaidi wa kununua sarafu iliyouzwa kupita kiasi?

9be60faa3765.en: Half is not a rate you can manage by being careful. If roughly one in two listings on a venue is a scam, then browsing new listings on that venue is not investing with some risk attached. It is a game whose base rate you already know, and the correct response to a base rate that bad is usually to stop playing rather than to play more attentively.
9be60faa3765.sw: Nusu si kiwango unachoweza kukisimamia kwa kuwa makini. Ikiwa takriban moja kati ya mawili ya uorodheshaji katika uwanja ni ulaghai, basi kuvinjari uorodheshaji mpya katika uwanja huo si kuwekeza kukiwa na hatari fulani iliyoambatishwa. Ni mchezo ambao kiwango chake cha msingi tayari unakijua, na jibu sahihi kwa kiwango cha msingi kibaya hivyo kwa kawaida ni kuacha kucheza badala ya kucheza kwa uangalifu zaidi.

9be814ebd9ae.en: Investing the whole amount at once.

9bf5a1f2b3df.en: A mode where only the margin assigned to a position backs it - loss is capped, liquidation comes sooner.
9bf5a1f2b3df.sw: Hali ambapo ni mkopo uliopangiwa nafasi pekee unaoiunga mkono - hasara ina kikomo, ufilisi huja mapema.

9c11746981c0.en: A broker's demand for additional funds, or automatic closure of positions, when a losing trade pushes margin level down to a critical threshold.
9c11746981c0.sw: Dai la broker la fedha za ziada, au kufungwa kwa nafasi kiotomatiki, biashara ya hasara inaposukuma kiwango cha margin chini hadi kizingiti muhimu.

9c19b5198890.en: Making a decision in advance, in a form that is hard to reverse later, so that a future version of you with worse judgement has fewer options.
9c19b5198890.sw: Kufanya uamuzi mapema, katika namna ambayo ni ngumu kuitendua baadaye, ili toleo lako la baadaye lenye hukumu mbaya zaidi liwe na chaguo chache.

9c36ea848228.en: Everything in this chapter so far — moving averages, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Fibonacci — has been technical analysis: reading price itself. This lesson introduces the opposite lens.
9c36ea848228.sw: Kila kitu katika sura hii hadi sasa — wastani unaosogea, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Fibonacci — kimekuwa uchambuzi wa kiufundi: kusoma bei yenyewe. Somo hili linaanzisha lenzi ya kinyume.

9c3937eb59ec.en: The order is cancelled because 45 never traded
9c3937eb59ec.sw: Agizo hufutwa kwa sababu 45 haikufanyiwa biashara kamwe

9c451122e3f6.en: Now the record. Bitcoin did trade above 55,000 dollars in early 2021. It did not reach the later targets. The cycle peaked near 69,000 dollars in November 2021, against a floor-model figure of 135,000 for that December, and closed 2021 near 47,000. PlanB had publicly said in mid-2021 that he would call the model invalidated if Bitcoin had not reached 100,000 dollars by December. When it did not, he attributed the miss to the floor model rather than to stock-to-flow itself, and continued to publish stock-to-flow targets.
9c451122e3f6.sw: Sasa rekodi. Bitcoin ilifanyiwa biashara juu ya dola 55,000 mwanzoni mwa 2021. Haikufikia malengo ya baadaye. Mzunguko ulifikia kilele karibu na dola 69,000 mwezi Novemba 2021, dhidi ya takwimu ya mfano wa sakafu ya 135,000 kwa Desemba huo, na ulifunga 2021 karibu na 47,000. PlanB alikuwa amesema hadharani katikati ya 2021 kwamba angeuita mfano kuwa umebatilishwa ikiwa Bitcoin isingefikia dola 100,000 kufikia Desemba. Isipofikia, alihusisha kukosa na mfano wa sakafu badala ya hisa-kwa-mtiririko yenyewe, na akaendelea kuchapisha malengo ya hisa-kwa-mtiririko.

9c478e28d1e1.en: Profit is an opinion shaped by accounting choices. Cash is a fact. That is why there are three statements.
9c478e28d1e1.sw: Faida ni maoni yaliyoumbwa na chaguo za uhasibu. Fedha ni ukweli. Ndiyo sababu kuna taarifa tatu.

9c49e7ac5356.en: It falls by more than 10%, because the residual absorbs the whole shortfall
9c49e7ac5356.sw: Hushuka kwa zaidi ya 10%, kwa sababu mabaki hufyonza upungufu wote

9c4e470b7786.en: Tightening the stop to justify a bigger position does not reduce risk. It relocates it. You have kept the 50 dollars of stated risk per trade and multiplied the number of times you will lose it, because you have placed the exit inside the range the price covers routinely, in both directions, for no reason at all. Forex Chapter 3, Lesson 3 gives the arithmetic that finishes this off: break-even win rate is 1 / (1 + R), so at a 1-to-2 risk-to-reward ratio you must win a third of your trades just to stay level. A stop that ordinary noise reaches several times a day will not deliver that win rate. It will deliver a slow, orderly transfer of your account into spread and fees.
9c4e470b7786.sw: Kubana kusimamisha ili kuhalalisha nafasi kubwa zaidi hakupunguzi hatari. Huihamisha. Umebakiza dola 50 za hatari iliyotajwa kwa kila biashara na umezidisha idadi ya mara utakazoipoteza, kwa sababu umeweka mlango wa kutoka ndani ya kiwango ambacho bei hufunika kwa kawaida, pande zote mbili, bila sababu yoyote. Forex Sura ya 3, Somo la 3 hutoa hesabu inayolimaliza hili: kiwango cha kushinda cha kufikia usawa ni 1 / (1 + R), kwa hivyo katika uwiano wa hatari-kwa-tuzo wa 1-kwa-2 lazima ushinde theluthi ya biashara zako ili tu ubaki kiwangoni. Kusimamisha ambako kelele za kawaida hukufikia mara kadhaa kwa siku hakutatoa kiwango hicho cha kushinda. Kutatoa uhamisho wa polepole, wenye utaratibu wa akaunti yako kuingia katika mwanya na ada.

9ca1bbb4307d.en: Then it said this: the rest of the machinery would be covered in Chapter 3, Lesson 3, as a risk topic. This is that lesson. Both terms stay exactly as Chapter 2 defined them. Nothing here redefines them. What changes is the question being asked. Chapter 2 asked what the funding rate tells you about other people. This lesson asks what the whole instrument does to you.
9ca1bbb4307d.sw: Kisha likasema hivi: mitambo iliyobaki ingefunikwa katika Sura ya 3, Somo la 3, kama mada ya hatari. Hili ndilo somo hilo. Maneno yote mawili yabaki hasa kama Sura ya 2 ilivyoyafafanua. Hakuna kilicho hapa kinachoyafafanua upya. Kinachobadilika ni swali linaloulizwa. Sura ya 2 iliuliza kiwango cha ufadhili kinakuambia nini kuhusu watu wengine. Somo hili huuliza chombo kizima kinakufanyia nini wewe.

9cb228d1f3fa.en: True or False: the best traders are the ones who predict market direction correctly most often.
9cb228d1f3fa.sw: Kweli au Uongo: wafanyabiashara bora ni wale wanaotabiri mwelekeo wa soko kwa usahihi mara nyingi zaidi.

9cb4574e6dd1.en: You are still not ready to place a trade. The single most important topic in this course is risk management. Skilled analysis without risk management doesn't produce a successful trader — it produces someone who is right sometimes and wiped out eventually.

9e1fcc44b213.en: The logic is a pressure valve. If crowds of buyers push the perpetual above spot, holding a long position starts costing money every few hours and holding a short starts earning it. That cost discourages more longs and attracts shorts, which pulls the perpetual back toward spot. The exchange does not take this money - on major venues it moves between traders, so it is a transfer, not a fee.

9ee732a7e800.en: The Bank for International Settlements — the same body behind the currency-turnover survey you met in Chapter 1 — convened its Markets Committee to study the event. Its report concluded that a range of factors, not one trigger, combined to cause the crash. The time of day made the sterling market unusually thin, so order flow was easily overwhelmed. On top of that came genuine selling pressure — including demand to sell pounds to hedge options positions — and, critically, the execution of stop-loss orders, with algorithmic systems adding to the selling into a market with almost no one on the other side.

9f9dfc0f8742.en: The European Securities and Markets Authority restricted contracts for difference sold to retail investors in 2018 and published the analysis behind it. Drawing on data collected by national regulators across the European Union, ESMA reported that 74% to 89% of retail CFD accounts typically lose money, with average losses per client ranging from 1,600 to 29,000 euros. The measures were agreed on 23 March 2018 and applied to CFDs from 1 August 2018. The leverage caps ESMA imposed were graded by the volatility of the underlying: 30 to 1 for major currency pairs, 20 to 1 for non-major pairs, gold and major indices, and, at the bottom of the scale, 2 to 1 for cryptocurrencies. The United Kingdom's Financial Conduct Authority separately requires CFD firms to display the percentage of their own retail accounts that lost money over the previous 12 months, and its own sampling put that figure above 80%.
9f9dfc0f8742.sw: Mamlaka ya Dhamana na Masoko ya Ulaya ilizuia mikataba ya tofauti inayouzwa kwa wawekezaji wa rejareja mwaka 2018 na ikachapisha uchambuzi ulio nyuma yake. Ikitegemea data iliyokusanywa na wadhibiti wa kitaifa katika Umoja wa Ulaya, ESMA iliripoti kwamba 74% hadi 89% ya akaunti za CFD za rejareja kwa kawaida hupoteza pesa, huku hasara za wastani kwa kila mteja zikienea kutoka yuro 1,600 hadi 29,000. Hatua zilikubaliwa tarehe 23 Machi 2018 na zilitumika kwa CFD kuanzia 1 Agosti 2018. Dari za mzingo ambazo ESMA iliziweka zilipangwa daraja kwa mtikisiko wa rasilimali ya msingi: 30 kwa 1 kwa jozi kuu za sarafu, 20 kwa 1 kwa jozi zisizo kuu, dhahabu na faharasa kuu, na, chini ya mizani, 2 kwa 1 kwa sarafu za kripto. Mamlaka ya Uendeshaji wa Fedha ya Uingereza kando huhitaji kampuni za CFD kuonyesha asilimia ya akaunti zao wenyewe za rejareja zilizopoteza pesa katika miezi 12 iliyopita, na sampuli yake yenyewe iliweka takwimu hiyo juu ya 80%.

9fd017ee1828.en: Osler (2000), published in the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's Economic Policy Review, tested the support and resistance levels that six real forex firms published to their customers. The finding was positive: the levels genuinely helped predict where intraday exchange-rate trends would be interrupted. The predictive power was not uniform — it was stronger for dollar-yen and dollar-pound than for dollar-mark, and it varied by firm — but for most firms it lasted at least five business days after the levels were published.
9fd017ee1828.sw: Osler (2000), aliyechapisha katika Economic Policy Review ya Federal Reserve Bank of New York, alijaribu viwango vya msaada na upinzani ambavyo kampuni sita halisi za forex zilichapisha kwa wateja wao. Tokeo lilikuwa chanya: viwango hivyo vilisaidia kweli kutabiri mahali mielekeo ya viwango vya ubadilishaji vya ndani ya siku ingekatizwa. Nguvu ya kutabiri haikuwa sawa — ilikuwa imara zaidi kwa dola-yen na dola-pauni kuliko dola-alama, na ilitofautiana kwa kampuni — lakini kwa kampuni nyingi ilidumu angalau siku tano za kazi baada ya viwango kuchapishwa.

9fd68d2f105b.en: Suppose you hold a long perpetual position with 10,000 dollars of notional exposure, and funding is +0.01% per 8-hour period. You pay 10,000 x 0.0001 = 1 dollar at each settlement. There are three settlements a day, so that is 3 dollars a day, or 0.03% of your notional daily. Held for 30 days at the same rate, that is 90 dollars. Annualised without compounding, 0.03% a day is 10.95% a year. Now suppose funding rises to +0.1% per period, which happens in strongly one-sided markets. The same position pays 30 dollars a day - an annualised 109.5%. The price has not moved at all in either case.
9fd68d2f105b.sw: Tuseme unashikilia nafasi ndefu ya kudumu yenye kufunuliwa kwa kinadharia kwa dola 10,000, na ufadhili ni +0.01% kwa kipindi cha masaa 8. Unalipa 10,000 x 0.0001 = dola 1 katika kila utimizaji. Kuna utimizaji tatu kwa siku, kwa hivyo hiyo ni dola 3 kwa siku, au 0.03% ya kinadharia chako kila siku. Ikishikiliwa kwa siku 30 katika kiwango kilekile, hiyo ni dola 90. Ikipimwa kwa mwaka bila kujilimbikiza, 0.03% kwa siku ni 10.95% kwa mwaka. Sasa tuseme ufadhili unapanda hadi +0.1% kwa kipindi, jambo linalotokea katika masoko yenye upande mmoja mkali. Nafasi ileile hulipa dola 30 kwa siku - 109.5% kwa mwaka. Bei haijasogea kabisa katika kesi yoyote.

9fd76b12fb89.en: Six pillars shown with their crypto adaptation: fundamentals become on-chain activity with stated limits, valuation is marked as not transferring because there are no cash flows and is replaced by supply arithmetic, catalyst transfers with a warning about scheduled events, positioning is strengthened by funding rates, momentum is supported by the Liu Tsyvinski and Wu three-factor finding but decays in weeks, and carry is qualified because staking rewards are often paid in the same falling token and funded by new issuance.

a02179f8182a.en: That is why this is not a lesson about spotting bubbles. Anyone who exited in 1997 on valuation grounds was right about the valuation and missed three more years of gains, and anyone who dismissed the entire sector missed the companies that went on to dominate the following two decades. The defence being taught here is position sizing and diversification, which work without requiring you to call the top.

a05d79559ce5.en: Put the sizing discipline into practice: before entering any trade, can you state the exact lot size the formula produces — not a round number you picked by feel? Does your position size actually make your maximum loss equal your intended risk percentage, or just approximately? And stay skeptical of any sizing approach — including "optimal" formulas — that requires knowing numbers, like your true win rate, that you can't actually know in advance with real confidence.

a0d72ecc9c76.en: "PoS is strictly better — it does the same job without the energy" and "PoW is the only real security — PoS is a circular system securing itself with its own token" are both partisan claims, and you will hear both stated as fact. Each contains a true observation and omits the counterargument. The honest position is that these are different trade-offs — external physical cost versus confiscatable internal capital — with different failure modes, and that anyone telling you the question is settled is usually holding the asset they are defending.
a0d72ecc9c76.sw: "PoS ni bora kabisa — hufanya kazi ileile bila nishati" na "PoW ndio usalama halisi pekee — PoS ni mfumo wa mzunguko unaojilinda kwa tokeni yake mwenyewe" yote ni madai ya kiupande, nawe utasikia yote mawili yakitajwa kama ukweli. Kila moja lina uchunguzi wa kweli na huacha hoja pinzani. Msimamo wa kweli ni kwamba hizi ni maafikiano tofauti — gharama halisi ya nje dhidi ya mtaji wa ndani unaoweza kutaifishwa — zenye namna tofauti za kushindwa, na kwamba yeyote anayekuambia swali limetatuliwa kwa kawaida anashikilia rasilimali anayoitetea.

a13c4951b12e.en: Two users each held the equivalent of 50,000. One kept it all on FTX because it was reputable and convenient. Mwingine aliweka 5,000 hapo kwa biashara na 45,000 katika pochi aliyoidhibiti. Wa kwanza akawa mdai asiye na dhamana katika kufilisika ambako kungechukua miaka. Wa pili alipoteza 10% na bado alikuwa na 45,000 asubuhi iliyofuata. Hakuna kati yao aliyetabiri chochote.

a185ef938fca.en: Now run the loop under stress. Every UST redeemed mints new LUNA — supply that someone must buy. If many holders redeem at once, LUNA's supply explodes and its price falls. But LUNA's price is the only thing backing UST. So a falling LUNA makes UST holders more scared, which causes more redemptions, which mints more LUNA, which falls further. The mechanism designed to restore the peg becomes the engine that destroys it. This is a reflexive design: it converts fear into more of the thing that caused the fear. In May 2022, exactly this happened — UST lost its peg, the loop went into a death spiral, and roughly 40 billion dollars of value in UST and LUNA was destroyed within about a week. Chapter 5, Lesson 2 dissects the Terra collapse step by step; what you take from this lesson is only the mechanism, so that when you meet the case study, the failure will look inevitable rather than surprising.
a185ef938fca.sw: Sasa endesha kitanzi chini ya msongo. Kila UST inayokombolewa hutengeneza LUNA mpya — usambazaji ambao mtu lazima aununue. Ikiwa wamiliki wengi watakomboa kwa wakati mmoja, usambazaji wa LUNA hulipuka na bei yake hushuka. Lakini bei ya LUNA ndicho kitu pekee kinachounga mkono UST. Kwa hivyo LUNA inayoshuka huwafanya wamiliki wa UST kuogopa zaidi, jambo linalosababisha ukombozi zaidi, unaotengeneza LUNA zaidi, inayoshuka zaidi. Utaratibu ulioundwa kurejesha pegi huwa injini inayoiharibu. Huu ni muundo wa kujiakisi: hugeuza hofu kuwa zaidi ya kitu kilichosababisha hofu. Mwezi Mei 2022, hasa hili lilitokea — UST ilipoteza pegi yake, kitanzi kikaingia katika mzunguko wa kifo, na takriban dola bilioni 40 za thamani katika UST na LUNA ziliharibiwa ndani ya takriban wiki moja. Sura ya 5, Somo la 2 huchambua kuanguka kwa Terra hatua kwa hatua; unachochukua kutoka somo hili ni utaratibu pekee, ili ukikutana na uchunguzi wa tukio, kushindwa kutaonekana kama kuepukika badala ya kushangaza.

a190016f876f.en: Glosten & Milgrom (1985), published in the Journal of Financial Economics, proved something genuinely counterintuitive: a positive bid-ask spread emerges even when the market maker is making zero expected profit on average. The reason is adverse selection. A market maker quoting prices to a stream of traders can't tell in advance who's trading on real information (an "informed" trader who knows something about where the price is headed) and who's just trading for ordinary reasons (an "uninformed" trader). Since informed traders systematically win at the market maker's expense, the market maker must widen the spread just to break even against that risk — even with no profit motive at all. This paper remains foundational; researchers were still directly building on and citing it in market microstructure papers as recently as 2026.
a190016f876f.sw: Glosten & Milgrom (1985), waliochapisha katika Journal of Financial Economics, walithibitisha jambo lisilotarajiwa kweli: spread chanya ya bid-ask hujitokeza hata mtengeneza-soko akiwa hapati faida yoyote inayotarajiwa kwa wastani. Sababu ni uteuzi mbaya. Mtengeneza-soko anayenukuu bei kwa mkondo wa wafanyabiashara hawezi kutambua mapema ni nani anayefanya biashara kwa taarifa halisi (mfanyabiashara "mwenye taarifa" anayejua kitu kuhusu bei inakoelekea) na ni nani anayefanya biashara kwa sababu za kawaida tu (mfanyabiashara "asiye na taarifa"). Kwa kuwa wafanyabiashara wenye taarifa hushinda kwa utaratibu kwa gharama ya mtengeneza-soko, mtengeneza-soko lazima apanue spread ili tu alingane dhidi ya hatari hiyo — hata bila lengo lolote la faida. Karatasi hii inabaki ya msingi; watafiti walikuwa bado wakijenga juu yake na kuinukuu moja kwa moja katika karatasi za muundo mdogo wa soko hivi karibuni kama mwaka 2026.

a1ee9ae43688.en: What to look for, applied to any activity someone describes as investing. Ask where the money comes from if you win. If the answer is that a business produced it, the activity is ownership. If the answer is that another participant lost it, the activity is a wager however respectable its packaging. And if the answer is that later entrants pay earlier ones, the activity is neither and you should leave.
a1ee9ae43688.sw: Cha kutazama, kikitumika kwa shughuli yoyote ambayo mtu huiita kuwekeza. Uliza pesa hutoka wapi kama utashinda. Kama jibu ni kwamba biashara ilizizalisha, shughuli ni umiliki. Kama jibu ni kwamba mshiriki mwingine alizipoteza, shughuli ni dau bila kujali ufungashaji wake unavyoheshimika. Na kama jibu ni kwamba wanaoingia baadaye hulipa wa awali, shughuli si yoyote kati yao na unapaswa kuondoka.

a2a8d55efac9.en: The intuition: if recent up-candles are much larger than recent down-candles, buyers are dominating and RSI pushes toward 100. If down-candles dominate, RSI falls toward 0. (The precise formula averages the gains and losses of closing prices over 14 periods, but the candle intuition is faithful to what it measures.)
a2a8d55efac9.sw: Ufahamu: kama mishumaa ya juu ya hivi karibuni ni mikubwa zaidi kuliko mishumaa ya chini ya hivi karibuni, wanunuzi wanatawala na RSI husukuma kuelekea 100. Kama mishumaa ya chini itatawala, RSI hushuka kuelekea 0. (Fomula kamili huwastani faida na hasara za bei za kufunga katika vipindi 14, lakini ufahamu wa mshumaa ni mwaminifu kwa kile inachopima.)

a2f6a233d80e.en: Treat "500:1 leverage available" as marketing, not a feature. The number tells you the most rope the broker will hand you; it says nothing about how much you should take. Your effective leverage, set by your position size, is the figure to watch — and to keep small.

Namba inakuambia kamba ndefu zaidi ambayo broker atakukabidhi; haisemi chochote kuhusu kiasi unachopaswa kuchukua. Leverage yako halisi, iliyowekwa na ukubwa wa nafasi yako, ndiyo takwimu ya kutazama — na kuiweka ndogo.

a30a4aba717f.en: The distortion created when successful outcomes are shared far more often than unsuccessful ones, so that the visible sample stops resembling the real one.
a30a4aba717f.sw: Upotoshaji unaoundwa wakati matokeo yaliyofanikiwa yanashirikiwa mara nyingi zaidi kuliko yale yasiyofanikiwa, ili sampuli inayoonekana iache kufanana na ile halisi.

a3167ee50057.en: Early wallets made users back up each private key separately — lose one, lose that money. Modern wallets fix this by generating every key you will ever need from a single master secret. A widely adopted standard called BIP-39 encodes that master secret as a short list of ordinary words — usually 12 or 24 — drawn from a fixed list of 2,048 words.
a3167ee50057.sw: Pochi za awali ziliwafanya watumiaji kuhifadhi kila ufunguo wa faragha kando — poteza mmoja, poteza pesa hiyo. Pochi za kisasa hurekebisha hili kwa kuzalisha kila ufunguo utakaowahi kuuhitaji kutoka siri moja kuu. Kiwango kinachotumika sana kiitwacho BIP-39 husimba siri hiyo kuu kama orodha fupi ya maneno ya kawaida — kwa kawaida 12 au 24 — yaliyochukuliwa kutoka orodha isiyobadilika ya maneno 2,048.

a3215e38bc6d.en: A cap-weighted index of the same 500 companies concentrates: if the largest handful grow to a third of the total value, a third of your return depends on those few. An equal-weighted version of the identical list gives each company the same share, so it leans more on the smaller members. Same companies, same day, different number.
a3215e38bc6d.sw: Index yenye uzito wa mtaji ya kampuni zile zile 500 hujikita: kama chache kubwa zaidi zitakua hadi theluthi moja ya thamani ya jumla, theluthi moja ya faida yako hutegemea hizo chache. Toleo lenye uzito sawa la orodha ile ile hutoa kila kampuni sehemu ile ile, hivyo hutegemea zaidi wanachama wadogo. Kampuni zile zile, siku ile ile, namba tofauti.

a32957e79422.en:
The Nasdaq Composite closed at its peak of 5,048.62 on 10 March 2000.
It reached its trough at 1,114.11 on 9 October 2002.
That is a fall of 77.9%.
It next closed above the 2000 peak on 23 April 2015, at 5,056.06.
The round trip took 15 years, 1 month and 13 days.
a32957e79422.sw:
Nasdaq Composite ilifungwa katika kilele chake cha 5,048.62 tarehe 10 Machi 2000.
Ilifikia bonde lake katika 1,114.11 tarehe 9 Oktoba 2002.
Hiyo ni kushuka kwa 77.9%.
Ilifungwa tena juu ya kilele cha 2000 tarehe 23 Aprili 2015, katika 5,056.06.
Safari ya kwenda na kurudi ilichukua miaka 15, mwezi 1 na siku 13.

a3302ab9b98d.en: Correct. The return from owning productive businesses comes from value created outside the transactions themselves, so all holders can gain together. A casino game creates nothing, so one player's gain is another's loss minus the house edge. Note that this defence applies to long-term ownership — short-term trading in the same shares is close to zero-sum before costs.
a3302ab9b98d.sw: Sahihi. Faida kutoka kumiliki biashara zenye tija hutoka kwa thamani inayoundwa nje ya miamala yenyewe, hivyo wote wanaoshikilia wanaweza kupata faida pamoja. Mchezo wa kasino hauundi chochote, hivyo faida ya mchezaji mmoja ni hasara ya mwingine kutoa faida ya kasino. Tambua kwamba utetezi huu unahusu umiliki wa muda mrefu — biashara ya muda mfupi ya hisa zile zile iko karibu jumla-sifuri kabla ya gharama.

a331e68d46a3.en: A portfolio split evenly across ten tech stocks looks diversified by holding count — but if all ten tend to rise and fall together, it behaves like one large bet, not ten independent ones. This is naive diversification: mistaking the number of holdings for actual risk reduction.
a331e68d46a3.sw: Mkusanyiko uliogawanywa sawasawa katika hisa kumi za teknolojia unaonekana umesambazwa kwa idadi ya umiliki — lakini kama zote kumi zinaelekea kupanda na kushuka pamoja, unatenda kama dau moja kubwa, si kumi yaliyo huru. Huku ndiko kusambaza kwa kijinga: kudhania kwamba idadi ya umiliki ni sawa na kupunguza hatari halisi.

a36170991314.en: No other track in this course needs a lesson like this one. In equities and currencies the instrument is regulated, the venue is supervised, and the main way to lose money is to be wrong. In crypto you can be entirely right about the asset and lose everything to the person or contract standing between you and it.
a36170991314.sw: Hakuna njia nyingine katika kozi hii inayohitaji somo kama hili. Katika hisa na sarafu chombo hudhibitiwa, uwanja husimamiwa, na njia kuu ya kupoteza pesa ni kukosea. Katika kripto unaweza kuwa sahihi kabisa kuhusu rasilimali na ukapoteza kila kitu kwa mtu au mkataba unaosimama kati yako nayo.

a36a22c6d6f2.en: A short of 5,000 with a borrow fee of 20% a year costs 500 to hold for six months, before any price movement. If the shares are unchanged after six months, the position has lost 10% of its value doing nothing at all. On a heavily shorted company the rate can be far higher.
a36a22c6d6f2.sw: Short ya 5,000 yenye ada ya kukopa ya 20% kwa mwaka hugharimu 500 kuishikilia kwa miezi sita, kabla ya msogeo wowote wa bei. Kama hisa hazijabadilika baada ya miezi sita, nafasi imepoteza 10% ya thamani yake ikifanya chochote kabisa. Kwenye kampuni inayofanyiwa short sana kiwango kinaweza kuwa juu zaidi mno.

a392b6f94b88.en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average works this way. It adds the share prices of its 30 companies and divides by its own divisor. The consequence is that influence tracks the price per share and not the size of the business.

a3b74fb47077.en: An ETF is trading at 100.40 while the basket it holds is worth 100.00 a share. An authorised participant buys the underlying shares for 100.00, delivers them to the fund, receives new ETF shares, and sells them at 100.40. Doing this adds supply to the ETF and demand to the underlying, pushing the two prices together. The profit exists only while the gap does.
a3b74fb47077.sw: ETF inafanyiwa biashara kwa 100.40 ilhali kikapu inachoshikilia kina thamani ya 100.00 kwa hisa. Mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa hununua hisa za msingi kwa 100.00, huziwasilisha kwa fund, hupokea hisa mpya za ETF, na huziuza kwa 100.40. Kufanya hivi huongeza ugavi kwa ETF na mahitaji kwa msingi, zikisukuma bei hizo mbili pamoja. Faida ipo tu wakati pengo lipo.

a3c9f277b7e3.en: The theory here is real and recent. Ackerer, Hugonnier and Jermann's "Perpetual Futures Pricing" - NBER working paper 32936 (2024), subsequently published in Mathematical Finance - derives no-arbitrage prices for perpetual contracts and shows how the funding payment anchors the perpetual to spot. A separate working paper, He, Manela, Ross and von Wachter's "Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures" (arXiv 2212.06888, also on SSRN), derives the same no-arbitrage relationship and measures the deviations empirically, reporting that crypto perpetuals deviate from no-arbitrage prices more than traditional currency markets do, that the deviations move together across currencies, and that they have shrunk over time. Note that this second paper was still circulating as a working paper, not a peer-reviewed journal article, when this lesson was written.
a3c9f277b7e3.sw: Nadharia hapa ni halisi na ya hivi karibuni. "Perpetual Futures Pricing" ya Ackerer, Hugonnier na Jermann - karatasi ya kazi ya NBER 32936 (2024), iliyochapishwa baadaye katika Mathematical Finance - hutoa bei zisizo na arbitraji kwa mikataba ya kudumu na huonyesha jinsi malipo ya ufadhili yanavyotia nanga ya kudumu kwenye papo hapo. Karatasi tofauti ya kazi, "Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures" ya He, Manela, Ross na von Wachter (arXiv 2212.06888, pia katika SSRN), hutoa uhusiano uleule usio na arbitraji na hupima mikengeuko kwa uzoefu, ikiripoti kwamba za kudumu za kripto hukengeuka kutoka bei zisizo na arbitraji zaidi ya masoko ya kimapokeo ya sarafu, kwamba mikengeuko husogea pamoja katika sarafu, na kwamba imepungua kwa muda. Tambua kwamba karatasi hii ya pili bado ilikuwa ikizunguka kama karatasi ya kazi, si makala ya jarida iliyopitiwa na wenzao, wakati somo hili lilipoandikwa.

a3cb63763f07.en: Here's the real, current ranking by share of global turnover, from the same 2025 BIS survey: EUR/USD leads at 21.2%, followed by USD/JPY at 14.3%. The genuinely interesting shift: USD/CNY (the Chinese yuan) has climbed to third place at 8.1%, overtaking GBP/USD (now fourth, at 7.6%) — a dramatic rise from just 0.8% in 2010. USD/CAD, AUD/USD, and USD/CHF round out the majors, each in the 4–5% range.
a3cb63763f07.sw: Hili hapa daraja halisi la sasa kwa sehemu ya mzunguko wa biashara duniani, kutoka utafiti ule ule wa BIS wa mwaka 2025: EUR/USD linaongoza kwa 21.2%, likifuatiwa na USD/JPY kwa 14.3%. Mabadiliko yenye kuvutia kweli: USD/CNY (yuan ya China) limepanda hadi nafasi ya tatu kwa 8.1%, likipita GBP/USD (sasa la nne, kwa 7.6%) — kupanda kwa kushangaza kutoka 0.8% tu mwaka 2010. USD/CAD, AUD/USD, na USD/CHF yanakamilisha jozi kuu, kila moja likiwa katika kiwango cha 4–5%.

a3edd43c560a.en: Rebalancing is not a forecast. It does not claim the asset you are buying will now outperform. It is a rule that holds your risk where you decided it should be, and its main effect is on the risk you carry rather than on the return you earn. Whether it adds return depends on the period, and anyone quoting a rebalancing bonus as a reliable figure is extrapolating from a sample.
a3edd43c560a.sw: Kusawazisha upya si utabiri. Hakudai rasilimali unayonunua sasa itafanya vizuri zaidi. Kama kunaongeza faida hutegemea kipindi, na yeyote anayenukuu bonasi ya kusawazisha upya kama takwimu ya kuaminika anakadiria kutoka sampuli.

a48a96634cde.en: A 20% fall needs a 25% gain to get back to even. A 30% fall needs 42.9%. A 50% fall needs 100%. A 78% fall — the Nasdaq between 2000 and 2002 — needs 354.5%. The gain required grows far faster than the loss that caused it, because it is calculated on the smaller amount that remains.
a48a96634cde.sw: Kushuka kwa 20% kunahitaji faida ya 25% kurudi sawa. Kushuka kwa 30% kunahitaji 42.9%. Kushuka kwa 50% kunahitaji 100%. Kushuka kwa 78% — Nasdaq kati ya 2000 na 2002 — kunahitaji 354.5%. Faida inayohitajika hukua kwa kasi zaidi mno kuliko hasara iliyoisababisha, kwa sababu hukokotolewa juu ya kiasi kidogo kilichobaki.

a498b49e8434.en: Practical forms of precommitment that cost nothing. A fixed maximum position size written down before you look at any asset. A rule that no new position is opened within some hours of first hearing about it. A standing decision that purchases happen on a schedule rather than in response to a move. None of these require willpower at the moment of temptation, which is the point — they require it once, in advance, when it is cheap.
a498b49e8434.sw: Namna za kivitendo za kujitolea mapema zisizogharimu chochote. Ukubwa wa juu kabisa wa nafasi ulioandikwa kabla ya kuangalia rasilimali yoyote. Kanuni kwamba hakuna nafasi mpya inayofunguliwa ndani ya masaa fulani ya kusikia kuihusu kwa mara ya kwanza. Uamuzi wa kudumu kwamba manunuzi hutokea kwa ratiba badala ya kujibu msogeo. Hakuna kati ya haya kinachohitaji utashi wakati wa kishawishi, ambalo ndilo lengo — huhitaji mara moja, mapema, ilipo nafuu.

a518d4dfda35.en: The heuristics have known failure modes, and later academic work measured them. Möser and Narayanan's "Resurrecting Address Clustering in Bitcoin," presented at Financial Cryptography and Data Security in 2022, examined change-address detection against a constructed ground-truth set and developed methods to detect and prevent cluster collapse — the failure in which a single bad link merges two unrelated clusters, then merges their neighbours, until one enormous cluster absorbs entities that have nothing to do with each other. Meanwhile the input-sharing rule is broken deliberately by mixing protocols such as CoinJoin, where unrelated users combine inputs on purpose, and the rule then reports them as one owner.
a518d4dfda35.sw: Kanuni za jumla zina namna zinazojulikana za kushindwa, na kazi ya kitaaluma ya baadaye iliyapima. "Resurrecting Address Clustering in Bitcoin" ya Möser na Narayanan, iliyowasilishwa katika Financial Cryptography and Data Security mwaka 2022, ilichunguza ugunduzi wa anwani za kibaki dhidi ya seti ya ukweli-msingi iliyoundwa na kubuni mbinu za kugundua na kuzuia kuporomoka kwa makundi — kushindwa ambapo kiungo kimoja kibaya huunganisha makundi mawili yasiyohusiana, kisha huunganisha majirani zao, hadi kundi moja kubwa mno linafyonza vyombo visivyohusiana kabisa. Wakati huohuo kanuni ya kushiriki viingizo huvunjwa kwa makusudi na itifaki za kuchanganya kama CoinJoin, ambapo watumiaji wasiohusiana huchanganya viingizo kwa makusudi, na kanuni kisha huwaripoti kama mmiliki mmoja.

a5b324651e02.en: A transaction lives through five stages. First, signed: your wallet builds the instruction and signs it with your private key (Lesson 4) — change one character and the signature no longer matches. Second, broadcast: your wallet hands the signed transaction to the peer-to-peer network, and nodes pass it to each other until, within seconds, most of the network has seen it. Third, waiting in the mempool: the transaction is now visible but not in the ledger.
a5b324651e02.sw: Muamala huishi kupitia hatua tano. Kwanza, umetiwa sahihi: pochi yako hujenga maagizo na kuyatia sahihi kwa ufunguo wako wa faragha (Somo la 4) — badilisha herufi moja na sahihi hailingani tena. Pili, umetangazwa: pochi yako hukabidhi muamala uliotiwa sahihi kwa mtandao wa rika-kwa-rika, na nodi hupitishana hadi, ndani ya sekunde, sehemu kubwa ya mtandao imeuona. Tatu, kusubiri katika mempool: muamala sasa unaonekana lakini hauko katika leja.

a6ae0ac3559b.en: Start by separating two claims. A descriptive claim says what happened: coins moved, addresses transacted, supply distribution shifted. a710b1be780c.en: A system wins 40% of trades with an average win of 2R. Expectancy = (0.40 times 2) minus (0.60 times 1) = 0.80 minus 0.60 = +0.20R per trade. Over 100 trades that is +20R. If 1R is 1% of a 10,000 dollar account — 100 dollars — that is +2,000 dollars, produced by a system that is wrong 60% of the time. Because R strips out account and position size, two completely different systems can be compared directly by their expectancy in R alone.
a710b1be780c.sw: Mfumo hushinda 40% ya biashara wenye ushindi wa wastani wa 2R. Matarajio = (0.40 mara 2) toa (0.60 mara 1) = 0.80 toa 0.60 = +0.20R kwa kila biashara. Katika biashara 100 hiyo ni +20R. Kama 1R ni 1% ya akaunti ya dola 10,000 — dola 100 — hiyo ni +dola 2,000, iliyozalishwa na mfumo unaokosea 60% ya muda. Kwa sababu R huondoa ukubwa wa akaunti na nafasi, mifumo miwili tofauti kabisa inaweza kulinganishwa moja kwa moja kwa matarajio yao kwa R peke yake.

a7468b0a6f7a.en: Averaging down is defensible when the reason for owning the asset is unchanged and the position stays within its written size limit. It is not defensible as a way to recover a loss, and from the inside the two feel identical. The test that separates them: would you open this position, at this size, today, knowing nothing about what you paid before? If the honest answer is no, the purchase is about the loss rather than about the asset.

a7641eea7b01.en: As you look at any quote, ask yourself: can you immediately identify which side is the base and which is the quote, and what that means for the price shown? If a currency code looks unfamiliar, check it against the ISO 4217 standard rather than guessing from the currency's common name. If a quote looks "backwards," check the convention before assuming an error. And when citing FX statistics like total volume or which pairs dominate, is the source authoritative like the BIS survey, or an unsourced blog claim?

a85465757acd.en: Pick any token outside the ten largest by market cap. Open its order book on a large exchange. a86bd7df4978.en: The mechanism needs Chapter 2, Lesson 1. That lesson taught order book depth and price impact: a market order eats resting orders one price level at a time, and in a thin book the same order that costs 0.18% in a deep book costs 23% instead. A liquidation is a market order. It is an unusually urgent, price-insensitive market order, placed by a bot with no discretion about whether to place it. So the loop runs: price falls enough to reach a cluster of long liquidation levels; the exchange sends market sell orders for those positions; those orders consume the resting bids and price falls further; the lower price reaches the next cluster; repeat. The loop is worst exactly when the book is thinnest, and the book is thinnest exactly when volatility spikes, because market makers widen their quotes or withdraw entirely when they cannot price risk. The two effects arrive together.
a86bd7df4978.sw: Utaratibu unahitaji Sura ya 2, Somo la 1. Somo hilo lilifundisha kina cha kitabu cha maagizo na athari ya bei: agizo la soko hula maagizo yaliyopumzika kiwango kimoja cha bei baada ya kingine, na katika kitabu chembamba agizo lilelile linalogharimu 0.18% katika kitabu chenye kina hugharimu 23% badala yake. Ufilisi ni agizo la soko. Ni agizo la soko lenye dharura isiyo ya kawaida, lisilojali bei, lililowekwa na roboti isiyo na hiari kuhusu kama liliweke. Kwa hivyo kitanzi hukimbia: bei hushuka vya kutosha kufikia kundi la viwango vya ufilisi vya warefu; soko la kubadilisha hutuma maagizo ya kuuza sokoni kwa nafasi hizo; maagizo hayo hula zabuni zilizopumzika na bei hushuka zaidi; bei ya chini hufikia kundi linalofuata; rudia. a95b7a786097.en: A worked example, so the units stop being abstract. You send a simple ETH transfer: 21,000 gas. The base fee is 18 gwei and you add a 2 gwei tip, so you pay 20 gwei per gas unit. Total: 21,000 times 20 = 420,000 gwei, which is 0.00042 ETH. At an illustrative price of 2,500 dollars per ETH — a made-up round number for arithmetic, not a price forecast — that is about 1.05 dollars. Of that, 0.000378 ETH (the base-fee part) is burned and 0.000042 ETH (the tip) goes to the validator. Now rerun it during congestion at 200 gwei total: the same transfer costs 0.0042 ETH, about 10.50 dollars — ten times the fee for the identical transaction, because the auction got crowded. And notice what gas does not depend on: the amount you send.
a95b7a786097.sw: Mfano uliofanyiwa kazi, ili vipimo viache kuwa vya kufikirika. Unatuma uhamisho rahisi wa ETH: gesi 21,000. Ada ya msingi ni gwei 18 nawe unaongeza bakshishi ya gwei 2, kwa hivyo unalipa gwei 20 kwa kila kipimo cha gesi. Jumla: 21,000 mara 20 = gwei 420,000, ambayo ni ETH 0.00042. Kwa bei ya kielelezo ya dola 2,500 kwa ETH — namba ya duara iliyobuniwa kwa hesabu, si utabiri wa bei — hiyo ni takriban dola 1.05. Kati ya hiyo, ETH 0.000378 (sehemu ya ada ya msingi) huchomwa na ETH 0.000042 (bakshishi) huenda kwa mthibitishaji. Sasa iendeshe tena wakati wa msongamano katika gwei 200 jumla: uhamisho uleule hugharimu ETH 0.0042, takriban dola 10.50 — mara kumi ya ada kwa muamala unaofanana, kwa sababu mnada ulijaa. a99bba244397.en: Trading with yourself. The same party, or parties acting together, buys and sells the same asset so that a transaction is recorded without any real change in ownership or economic risk. It manufactures volume, and it can manufacture price. In US futures markets it is explicitly unlawful: Section 4c(a) of the Commodity Exchange Act bans entering into any transaction that is commonly known to the trade as a wash sale or fictitious sale, and the CFTC brings enforcement actions over it. On unregulated crypto venues, nobody is stopping it.

Katika masoko ya mikataba ya baadaye ya Marekani ni kinyume cha sheria waziwazi: Kifungu 4c(a) cha Commodity Exchange Act hupiga marufuku kuingia katika muamala wowote unaojulikana kwa kawaida katika biashara kama uuzaji wa kujiosha au uuzaji wa uongo, na CFTC huleta hatua za utekelezaji juu yake. ab23323c8cab.en: The defences are concrete. Review and revoke: approval-checking tools exist for every major chain, including one built into most block explorers, and wallet software increasingly lists your permissions directly; open the list and remove every approval belonging to a site you are not actively using. Revoking costs a small network fee and is otherwise harmless, since you can always re-approve later. Set a limit rather than accepting unlimited, because most wallets let you edit the approval amount at the moment you grant it. Separate your wallets: keep one for interacting with new applications, funded with only what you are willing to lose, and keep your main holdings in a wallet that never connects to a site at all, since a permission can only reach the wallet that granted it. And put the review on a schedule, once a month, not when you remember. Chapter 4 Lesson 3 will build this into a written custody plan.

ab76bf78dd4d.en: A payout ratio comfortably below 100% means the payment is covered by what the business earns and has room to survive a bad year. None of those can continue indefinitely, and the market usually works this out before the announcement.

Hakuna kati ya hizo kinachoweza kuendelea milele, na soko kwa kawaida hulibaini hili kabla ya tangazo.

On 19 May 2021, after a Chinese regulatory announcement, bitcoin fell from roughly 43,000 dollars to below 31,000 dollars intraday, with roughly 8 billion dollars liquidated across venues.

ad80068d2a5a.en: An inflation-hedge claim has to survive an actual inflation episode. 2021 to 2022 was the first serious test of the modern crypto era, and the claim failed it. State that plainly. The honest version of the academic picture is that it is contested and period-dependent, not uniformly negative. Choi and Shin, in Finance Research Letters, volume 46, 2022, found Bitcoin does appreciate against inflation shocks — while separately rejecting the safe-haven claim, because Bitcoin fell in response to financial uncertainty shocks. Rodriguez and Colombo, in the Journal of Economics and Business, volume 133, examined data from August 2010 to January 2023 and also found a positive response to inflation shocks, but reported two important limits: the effect holds for consumer-price shocks specifically, and it comes mainly from the sample period before large institutional participation. That last finding matches the co-movement evidence. The property people are selling belongs to an earlier, smaller, more isolated market than the one you would be buying into.
ad80068d2a5a.sw: Dai la kinga dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei lazima linusurike tukio halisi la mfumuko wa bei. 2021 hadi 2022 ilikuwa mtihani mzito wa kwanza wa enzi ya kisasa ya kripto, na dai lilishindwa. Taja hilo wazi. Toleo la kweli la picha ya kitaaluma ni kwamba inapingwa na inategemea kipindi, si hasi kwa usawa. Choi na Shin, katika Finance Research Letters, juzuu 46, 2022, walibaini Bitcoin hupanda thamani dhidi ya mishtuko ya mfumuko wa bei — huku wakikataa kando dai la kimbilio salama, kwa sababu Bitcoin ilishuka kujibu mishtuko ya kutokuwa na uhakika wa kifedha. Rodriguez na Colombo, katika Journal of Economics and Business, juzuu 133, walichunguza data kutoka Agosti 2010 hadi Januari 2023 na pia walibaini mwitikio chanya kwa mishtuko ya mfumuko wa bei, lakini waliripoti vikomo viwili muhimu: athari hushikilia kwa mishtuko ya bei za watumiaji hasa, nayo hutoka hasa katika kipindi cha sampuli kabla ya ushiriki mkubwa wa kitaasisi.
