ae768b9124bc.en: A demand from the broker for more money when the collateral value falls too far. If it is not met, the broker sells your holdings to repay the loan.
ae768b9124bc.sw: Dai kutoka kwa broker la pesa zaidi thamani ya dhamana inaposhuka mbali mno. Kama halitatimizwa, broker huuza umiliki wako kulipa mkopo.

ae76e0c427e2.en: A share priced at 40.00 the day before a 1.00 dividend, and on the ex-dividend date shown as a 39.00 share price plus 1.00 of cash. The total held is 40.00 in both cases.
ae76e0c427e2.sw: Hisa yenye bei ya 40.00 siku moja kabla ya gawio la 1.00, na katika tarehe ya bila-gawio ikionyeshwa kama bei ya hisa ya 39.00 pamoja na 1.00 ya fedha taslimu. Jumla iliyoshikiliwa ni 40.00 katika kesi zote mbili.

ae82bf942353.en: FTX was not an unregulated shadow operation, and it was not a fully supervised one either. It held licences in several jurisdictions, and the entity most customers dealt with was structured offshore. The failure was not caused by an absence of rules in the abstract; it was caused by customer assets being spent, which is prohibited essentially everywhere and was concealed.
ae82bf942353.sw: FTX halikuwa shughuli ya kivuli isiyodhibitiwa, wala halikuwa lililosimamiwa kikamilifu. Lilishikilia leseni katika mamlaka kadhaa, na taasisi ambayo wateja wengi walishughulika nayo ilikuwa imeundwa nje ya nchi. Kushindwa hakukusababishwa na kukosekana kwa kanuni kinadharia; kulisababishwa na rasilimali za wateja kutumika, jambo lililokatazwa kimsingi kila mahali nalo lilifichwa.

aeac76b650c4.en: The yield question from Chapter 4 Lesson 2 answered this one before the collapse. The chain of answers ran out at a reserve, and a reserve is not an activity. That single test did not require knowing when, and it did not require being right about the mechanism's design.
aeac76b650c4.sw: Swali la mavuno kutoka Sura ya 4 Somo la 2 lilijibu hili kabla ya kuanguka. Mnyororo wa majibu uliishia katika akiba, na akiba si shughuli. Mtihani huo mmoja haukuhitaji kujua lini, wala haukuhitaji kuwa sahihi kuhusu muundo wa utaratibu.

aeb0ae1fec09.en: This is the tell that ends the ambiguity. A genuine platform deducts fees from the balance it holds. A fraudulent one requires new money from outside to release money it claims to be holding, because the balance it is showing you does not exist.
aeb0ae1fec09.sw: Hii ndiyo alama inayomaliza utata. Jukwaa halisi hukata ada kutoka salio linaloshikilia. Lenye udanganyifu huhitaji pesa mpya kutoka nje ili kutoa pesa linalodai kuishikilia, kwa sababu salio linalokuonyesha halipo.

aebecb838af6.en: Searching charts until one agrees with a trade you already wanted — a bias, not a method.
aebecb838af6.sw: Kutafuta chati hadi moja ikubaliane na biashara uliyoitaka tayari — upendeleo, si mbinu.

aeca57bafe9b.en: Crowded positioning tells you what could unwind violently. It does not tell you when. Funding can stay extremely positive for weeks while price keeps rising, and traders who shorted "because funding was too high" get carried out well before any reversal arrives. Every crowded trade looks obvious afterwards and pays nothing for being early. Treat elevated funding as a statement about fragility, never as an entry trigger.
aeca57bafe9b.sw: Msimamo uliojaa hukuambia kinachoweza kufunguka kwa nguvu. Haikuambii lini. Ufadhili unaweza kubaki chanya mno kwa wiki huku bei ikiendelea kupanda, na wafanyabiashara waliouza-mkopo "kwa sababu ufadhili ulikuwa juu mno" hutolewa nje muda mrefu kabla kugeuka kokote hakujafika. Kila biashara iliyojaa huonekana dhahiri baadaye na hailipi chochote kwa kuwa mapema. Chukulia ufadhili ulioinuka kama kauli kuhusu udhaifu, kamwe si kama kichocheo cha kuingia.

aed11a03c147.en: Because 6% is too small to matter
aed11a03c147.sw: Kwa sababu 6% ni ndogo mno kuwa na maana

aed8142fa7c4.en: Judge the decision, not just the result. A trade that won because the market bailed out a sloppy thesis is a warning, not a success; a well-built thesis that lost to a genuine surprise may have been exactly right to take. Rewarding yourself for luck and punishing yourself for variance trains the wrong habits.
aed8142fa7c4.sw: Hukumu uamuzi, si tokeo tu. Biashara iliyoshinda kwa sababu soko liliokoa nadharia iliyoachwa ovyo ni onyo, si mafanikio; nadharia iliyojengwa vizuri iliyopoteza kwa mshangao halisi huenda ilikuwa sahihi kabisa kuchukuliwa. Kujizawadia kwa bahati na kujiadhibu kwa utofauti hukufundisha tabia zisizo sahihi.

aee9f4195644.en: Two panels showing five markets as separated circles during ordinary and rising months, and as overlapping circles during the worst months, illustrating the Longin and Solnik 2001 finding that correlation rises in the negative tail but not the positive one.
aee9f4195644.sw: Paneli mbili zikionyesha masoko matano kama miduara iliyotenganishwa wakati wa miezi ya kawaida na inayopanda, na kama miduara inayoingiliana wakati wa miezi mibaya zaidi, zikionyesha matokeo ya Longin na Solnik ya 2001 kwamba uhusiano hupanda katika mkia hasi lakini si katika chanya.

aeebe36256fb.en: The order sells near 38, because a stop becomes a market order once triggered and fills at whatever is available
aeebe36256fb.sw: Agizo huuza karibu na 38, kwa sababu stop hukuwa agizo la soko mara linapoanzishwa na hutimizwa kwa chochote kinachopatikana

aef53c3a3c57.en: A currency held in significant quantities by governments and institutions worldwide for trade and finance — the U.S. dollar has held this role since Bretton Woods.
aef53c3a3c57.sw: Sarafu inayoshikiliwa kwa wingi mkubwa na serikali na taasisi duniani kote kwa biashara na fedha — dola ya Marekani imeshikilia nafasi hii tangu Bretton Woods.

af0a530145b8.en: The idea is usually split into three strengths, which is more useful than treating it as one claim.
af0a530145b8.sw: Wazo kwa kawaida hugawanywa katika nguvu tatu, jambo lenye manufaa zaidi kuliko kulichukulia kama dai moja.

af14d5cc1902.en: Diversification reduces risk. It does not remove it. During a genuine broad market shock, correlations across many assets tend to rise together — the calm-market relationships you diversified around can break down exactly when you need them most.
af14d5cc1902.sw: Kusambaza uwekezaji hupunguza hatari. Hakuiondoi. Wakati wa mshtuko halisi mpana wa soko, uwiano katika mali nyingi huelekea kupanda pamoja — mahusiano ya soko tulivu uliyoyasambazia yanaweza kuvunjika hasa wakati unapoyahitaji zaidi.

af387d0614d2.en: A token is created and promoted, buyers provide liquidity, and the creators then withdraw that liquidity or dump their holdings, leaving a token that cannot be sold at any meaningful price.
af387d0614d2.sw: Tokeni huundwa na kutangazwa, wanunuzi hutoa ukwasi, kisha waundaji huutoa ukwasi huo au kumwaga umiliki wao, wakiacha tokeni isiyoweza kuuzwa kwa bei yoyote yenye maana.

af4bb473d726.en: Correct. Your equity is the position value less the 10,000 loan, so it hits 25% of the position when the position is worth about 13,333 — a fall of roughly 33%. Your own 10,000 is then down to about 3,333, and the broker can sell without waiting for you.
af4bb473d726.sw: Sahihi. Usawa wako ni thamani ya nafasi kutoa mkopo wa 10,000, hivyo hufikia 25% ya nafasi nafasi inapokuwa na thamani ya takriban 13,333 — kushuka kwa takriban 33%. Zile 10,000 zako mwenyewe basi zimeshuka hadi takriban 3,333, na broker anaweza kuuza bila kukusubiri.

af5a94595ef8.en: Every failure in this lesson ends the same way: an irreversible transfer. Chapter 1 Lesson 6 established when gone becomes true. Once a transaction is buried under enough proof-of-work or finalized by proof-of-stake, no bank, no support ticket and no court order can rewrite the ledger. There is no chargeback in crypto. There is no fraud department to call. Card networks let you dispute a payment because a referee keeps the ledger, and this system removed the referee on purpose. Security in crypto is entirely preventive, because there is no cure.
af5a94595ef8.sw: Kila kushindwa katika somo hili huishia kwa njia ileile: uhamisho usioweza kutenduliwa. Sura ya 1 Somo la 6 lilithibitisha lini imeenda huwa kweli. Mara muamala unapozikwa chini ya uthibitisho-wa-kazi wa kutosha au kukamilishwa na uthibitisho-wa-hisa, hakuna benki, hakuna tikiti ya msaada wala amri ya mahakama inayoweza kuandika upya leja. Hakuna kurudishwa kwa malipo katika kripto. Hakuna idara ya udanganyifu ya kupiga simu. Mitandao ya kadi hukuruhusu kupinga malipo kwa sababu mwamuzi hutunza leja, na mfumo huu uliondoa mwamuzi kwa makusudi. Usalama katika kripto ni wa kuzuia kabisa, kwa sababu hakuna tiba.

af72d86de9a2.en: You gain 0.20 per share, because you captured the spread
af72d86de9a2.sw: Unapata 0.20 kwa kila hisa, kwa sababu ulinasa spread

af79536b0c08.en: Correct — rates reprice currencies and bonds first, then flow to credit and equities, then commodities, then the most risk-sensitive assets like crypto.
af79536b0c08.sw: Sahihi — viwango hupanga upya bei za sarafu na hatifungani kwanza, kisha hupenya hadi mikopo na hisa, kisha bidhaa, kisha mali nyeti zaidi kwa hatari kama crypto.

af7e0278a1de.en: A major currency paired with an emerging-market currency.
af7e0278a1de.sw: Sarafu kuu iliyowekwa pamoja na sarafu ya soko linaloibukia.

af7fe17cbc1a.en: Weight capital toward your best-analysed theses (which outperform), while still sizing every trade to the fixed-fractional rule — concentrate conviction, not risk — and review closed trades for the quality of the decision, not just the result.
af7fe17cbc1a.sw: Elekeza mtaji zaidi kwenye nadharia zako zilizochambuliwa vizuri zaidi (ambazo hufanya vizuri zaidi), huku bado ukipima kila biashara kwa kanuni ya sehemu thabiti — jikite kwenye uhakika, si hatari — na pitia biashara zilizofungwa kwa ubora wa uamuzi, si tokeo tu.

af8964494bd2.en: A short note on how this differs from what most crypto commentary offers, since the vocabulary overlaps and the substance does not.
af8964494bd2.sw: Noti fupi kuhusu jinsi hii inavyotofautiana na kile ambacho maoni mengi ya kripto hutoa, kwa kuwa msamiati huingiliana na maudhui hayaingiliani.

af9a39d6c48c.en: An asset with a persistently high beta, which magnifies the reference market's moves in both directions.
af9a39d6c48c.sw: Rasilimali yenye beta kubwa kwa kudumu, inayokuza misogeo ya soko la rejeleo pande zote mbili.

af9b67669b60.en: Step back from the individual tools and the deeper pattern of this chapter emerges:
af9b67669b60.sw: Rudi nyuma kutoka zana binafsi na mtindo wa kina zaidi wa sura hii unajitokeza:

afc7317b1ba9.en: Holding only companies with low P/E ratios
afc7317b1ba9.sw: Kushikilia tu kampuni zenye uwiano mdogo wa P/E

afd888fa3248.en: Rebalancing feels wrong every single time. It requires selling what has done well to buy what has done badly, which is the opposite of what the recent past appears to recommend. That discomfort is the mechanism working, not a signal that the rule is broken. If it felt comfortable it would not be doing anything.
afd888fa3248.sw: Kusawazisha upya huhisi vibaya kila mara. Kunahitaji kuuza kilichofanya vizuri ili kununua kilichofanya vibaya, jambo lililo kinyume na kile ambacho siku za hivi karibuni zinaonekana kushauri. Usumbufu huo ni utaratibu ukifanya kazi, si ishara kwamba kanuni imevunjika. Kama ungehisi vizuri usingekuwa unafanya lolote.

afed7ef38265.en: The important detail is what happens to the share price when the dividend is paid. The cash leaves the company. A company holding one unit less cash is worth one unit less, and the share price reflects that.
afed7ef38265.sw: Kipengele muhimu ni kinachotokea kwa bei ya hisa gawio linapolipwa. Fedha huondoka kampunini. Kampuni inayoshikilia kipimo kimoja pungufu cha fedha ina thamani ya kipimo kimoja pungufu, na bei ya hisa huakisi hilo.

aff96a136547.en: Point out that tokens under one cent are always scams
aff96a136547.sw: Onyesha kwamba tokeni chini ya senti moja daima ni ulaghai

b03360f95b27.en: The reported volume may be wash trading, and the depth is the number to trust
b03360f95b27.sw: Ujazo unaoripotiwa unaweza kuwa biashara ya kujiosha, na kina ndiyo namba ya kuamini

b04d2ff3288b.en: That $35-per-ounce rate is not a random number — it is exactly the rate Bretton Woods would formalize internationally ten years later, in 1944. Keep it in mind for the next lesson.
b04d2ff3288b.sw: Kiwango hicho cha $35 kwa wakia si namba ya bahati nasibu — ni hasa kiwango ambacho Bretton Woods ingekirasimisha kimataifa miaka kumi baadaye, mwaka 1944. Kikumbuke kwa somo lijalo.

b05443038eca.en: Because the figure only applies to professional investors
b05443038eca.sw: Kwa sababu takwimu inahusu wawekezaji wa kitaalamu pekee

b06b0fd54646.en: The price is guaranteed to fall

b0850360d562.en: Which holdings sit on an exchange, which in self-custody, and the threshold between them.
b0850360d562.sw: Umiliki upi hukaa katika soko la kubadilisha, upi katika utunzaji binafsi, na kizingiti kati yao.

b0a89189ea61.en: The Bitcoin price at the time of the statement
b0a89189ea61.sw: Bei ya Bitcoin wakati wa kauli

b105008640ac.en: A published premium is measured on paper portfolios, rebalanced without cost. A fund reproducing it pays spreads on every trade, a management fee every year, and tax where it applies. A premium of two percentage points on paper can be most of the way to nothing after the costs of capturing it, and Chapter 1 Lesson 7 showed how quickly annual charges compound.
b105008640ac.sw: Malipo ya ziada yaliyochapishwa hupimwa juu ya mikusanyiko ya karatasi, ikisawazishwa bila gharama. Fund inayoyazalisha tena hulipa spread kwa kila biashara, ada ya usimamizi kila mwaka, na kodi pale inapotumika. Malipo ya ziada ya pointi mbili za asilimia kwenye karatasi yanaweza kuwa karibu na chochote baada ya gharama za kuyanasa, na Sura ya 1 Somo la 7 lilionyesha kasi ya malipo ya kila mwaka kujikusanya.

b112b62bae82.en: Not quite — the stored hash is a fingerprint of the previous block, so any edit to an old block changes its hash and breaks the recorded link. Hashing is not encryption, and it neither compresses the ledger nor speeds it up.
b112b62bae82.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — heshi iliyohifadhiwa ni alama ya vidole ya kitalu kilichotangulia, kwa hivyo uhariri wowote wa kitalu cha zamani hubadilisha heshi yake na kuvunja kiungo kilichoandikwa. Kufanya heshi si kusimba, wala haibani leja wala haiiharakishi.

b127886f12a5.en: Two users each held 20 bitcoin. One kept 2 on Mt. Gox and 18 in self-custody; the other kept all 20 on the exchange. What separated them?
b127886f12a5.sw: Watumiaji wawili kila mmoja alishikilia bitcoin 20. Mmoja aliweka 2 katika Mt. Gox na 18 katika utunzaji binafsi; mwingine aliweka zote 20 katika soko la kubadilisha. Nini kiliwatenganisha?

b12de9fdb285.en: The finding that the 200,000 were sitting in a wallet nobody had checked since 2011 deserves its own moment.
b12de9fdb285.sw: Tokeo kwamba 200,000 zilikuwa zimeketi katika pochi ambayo hakuna aliyeikagua tangu 2011 linastahili wakati wake.

b13281038c88.en: Share ownership is positive-sum — the businesses underneath produce value — while the casino game only redistributes what players bring
b13281038c88.sw: Umiliki wa hisa ni jumla-chanya — biashara zilizo chini huzalisha thamani — ilhali mchezo wa kasino hugawanya upya tu kile wachezaji huleta

b1347be7001c.en: That crypto should be a core holding because of its long-run returns
b1347be7001c.sw: Kwamba kripto inapaswa kuwa umiliki mkuu kwa sababu ya faida zake za muda mrefu

b149117c8e1b.en: That a portfolio of several clever-sounding crypto strategies is probably one exposure wearing several names — though the finding describes a sample period and says nothing about any individual token
b149117c8e1b.sw: Kwamba kasha la mikakati kadhaa ya kripto inayosikika ya werevu pengine ni kufunuliwa kumoja kukivaa majina kadhaa — ingawa tokeo huelezea kipindi cha sampuli na halisemi lolote kuhusu tokeni yoyote binafsi

b14e089cccd5.en: What to look for when a similar argument appears, as it does regularly. Notice when valuation is being dismissed rather than argued — the phrase this time the old measures do not apply is the specific signal, and it is not always wrong, which is what makes it dangerous. Notice when an index's top ten holdings become an unusually large share of the whole. Notice when the case for owning something rests entirely on what it might become. And check what proportion of your own portfolio depends on the same story being true.
b14e089cccd5.sw: Cha kuangalia hoja kama hiyo inapojitokeza, kama inavyotokea mara kwa mara. Tambua wakati tathmini inakataliwa badala ya kujadiliwa — msemo safari hii vipimo vya zamani havitumiki ndiyo ishara maalum, nayo si kosa kila mara, jambo linalofanya iwe hatari. Tambua wakati umiliki kumi bora wa faharasa unakuwa sehemu kubwa isiyo ya kawaida ya jumla. Tambua wakati hoja ya kumiliki kitu inategemea kabisa kile kinachoweza kuwa. Na kagua ni sehemu gani ya kasha lako mwenyewe inategemea hadithi hiyohiyo kuwa kweli.

b151383e8180.en: The honest, uncomfortable takeaway: you cannot reliably predict a black swan, and you cannot count on your stop filling where you set it. The only defence that works is structural — being small enough, and unleveraged enough, that even a failed stop cannot end you. Survival is not built on being right. It is built on being sized to be wrong.
b151383e8180.sw: Fundisho la uaminifu na lisilostarehesha: huwezi kutabiri black swan kwa kutegemewa, na huwezi kutegemea stop yako itimizwe pale uliipoiweka. Kinga pekee inayofanya kazi ni ya kimuundo — kuwa mdogo vya kutosha, na bila leverage vya kutosha, kiasi kwamba hata stop iliyoshindwa haiwezi kukumaliza. Kunusurika hakujengwi juu ya kuwa sahihi. Kunajengwa juu ya kupimwa ili ukosee.

b18703be531f.en: A ready-made toolkit that produces the malicious page and transaction request used to empty a wallet once the victim signs.
b18703be531f.sw: Kifaa kilichotayarishwa kinachozalisha ukurasa hasidi na ombi la muamala linalotumika kumwaga pochi mara mwathiriwa anapotia sahihi.

b18b55d8f7e6.en: Correct. An 80% crypto drawdown is ordinary rather than catastrophic, and by the time it arrives the position has grown to more than three times its intended weight without anyone deciding that. The band is not a forecast that crypto will fall — it is a rule keeping the risk where you chose to put it.
b18b55d8f7e6.sw: Sahihi. Kushuka kwa kripto kwa 80% ni kwa kawaida badala ya maafa, na kufikia wakati kunapofika nafasi imekua hadi zaidi ya mara tatu ya uzito wake uliokusudiwa bila mtu kuamua hivyo. Ukanda si utabiri kwamba kripto itashuka — ni kanuni inayoweka hatari pale ulipochagua kuiweka.

b18fef0804a4.en: And the honest close the course has earned the right to make: doing all of this well is genuinely hard and takes real time to build. It is not a shortcut to guaranteed profit — nothing is, and most retail accounts still lose (Chapter 4, Lesson 3). What this process does is put the odds, and your own behaviour, on the right side, which is the most any method honestly can.
b18fef0804a4.sw: Na mwisho wa uaminifu ambao kozi imepata haki ya kuufanya: kufanya haya yote vizuri ni kugumu kweli na huchukua muda halisi kujenga. Si njia ya mkato kwa faida ya uhakika — hakuna kitu kilicho hivyo, na akaunti nyingi za rejareja bado hupoteza (Sura ya 4, Somo la 3). Kile ambacho mchakato huu hufanya ni kuweka uwezekano, na tabia yako mwenyewe, upande sahihi, ambacho ndicho kingi zaidi ambacho njia yoyote inaweza kufanya kwa uaminifu.

b19b464daf6e.en: Parts of it were genuinely predictable, and this course should say which parts rather than claiming hindsight as foresight.
b19b464daf6e.sw: Sehemu zake zilitabirika kweli, na kozi hii inapaswa kusema ni sehemu zipi badala ya kudai kutazama nyuma kama utabiri.

b1a0c0f5474a.en: The fee is what you are charged. The tracking difference is what you actually lost against the index, and it includes the fee plus everything else. Choosing purely on the advertised number can occasionally pick the fund that delivered less of the index. The correct comparison is the shortfall over several years, and the fee is the best single predictor of it rather than a substitute for it.
b1a0c0f5474a.sw: Ada ni unachotozwa. Tofauti ya kufuatilia ni ulichopoteza hasa dhidi ya index, na inajumuisha ada pamoja na kila kitu kingine. Kuchagua kwa namba iliyotangazwa peke yake kunaweza mara chache kuchagua fund iliyotoa sehemu ndogo ya index. Ulinganisho sahihi ni upungufu katika miaka kadhaa, na ada ndiyo kitabiri kimoja bora chake badala ya mbadala wake.

b1a16dc3410f.en: What to look for when you review the plan, which should be a fixed date rather than a reaction. Check whether the exchange balance has crept above the cap, because it always creeps. Check whether the allocation has drifted past the band. Check that you can still access every wallet you own, by actually accessing it rather than by assuming. Confirm the recovery material is where the document says it is.
b1a16dc3410f.sw: Cha kuangalia unapokagua mpango, ambako kunapaswa kuwa tarehe isiyobadilika badala ya mwitikio. Kagua kama salio la soko la kubadilisha limepanda taratibu juu ya dari, kwa sababu daima hupanda taratibu. Kagua kama mgawanyo umetelezea kupita ukanda. Kagua kwamba bado unaweza kufikia kila pochi unayoimiliki, kwa kuifikia hasa badala ya kwa kudhania. Thibitisha nyenzo za urejeshaji ziko pale hati inaposema ziko.

b1b91d7d8a52.en: Position sizing turns your stop-loss distance and risk percentage into an exact trade size, so a losing trade costs exactly what you decided in advance.
b1b91d7d8a52.sw: Upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi hugeuza umbali wa stop-loss yako na asilimia yako ya hatari kuwa ukubwa kamili wa biashara, ili biashara ya hasara igharimu hasa kile ulichoamua mapema.

b1beed4add95.en: Not quite. There was no bug, no halt and no regulatory trigger. The mechanism operated correctly throughout, which is precisely what makes the case instructive: correct execution and catastrophe are not mutually exclusive.
b1beed4add95.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Hakukuwa na hitilafu, hakuna kusimamishwa wala kichocheo cha udhibiti. Utaratibu ulifanya kazi kwa usahihi muda wote, ambacho ndicho hasa kinachofanya kesi kuwa na mafunzo: utekelezaji sahihi na maafa si vitu vinavyotenganishana.

b1bf770271fd.en: The 1971 suspension of the dollar's convertibility to gold.
b1bf770271fd.sw: Kusimamishwa kwa mwaka 1971 kwa ubadilishaji wa dola kuwa dhahabu.

b1c889b68545.en: Two funds both call themselves value funds. Why might their holdings and returns differ substantially?
b1c889b68545.sw: Fund mbili zote hujiita fund za thamani. Kwa nini umiliki na faida zao zinaweza kutofautiana kwa kiasi kikubwa?

b204f9db4bea.en: That 0.16% is the entry fee for a round trip. Pay it once a decade and it is irrelevant. Pay it forty times a year, as the active trader in the previous lesson did, and it becomes one of the largest costs you face — which is exactly why the arithmetic there was so unforgiving.
b204f9db4bea.sw: Hiyo 0.16% ni ada ya kuingia kwa safari ya kwenda na kurudi. Ilipe mara moja kwa muongo na haihusiki. Ilipe mara arobaini kwa mwaka, kama mfanyabiashara wa bidii katika somo lililotangulia alivyofanya, na inakuwa mojawapo ya gharama kubwa zaidi unazokabiliana nazo — ambako ndiyo hasa sababu hesabu hapo ilikuwa haisamehe hivyo.

b214feda40ae.en: It is one hypothesis among several — the same measurement is equally consistent with wallet rotation, custody migration, or an over-the-counter settlement
b214feda40ae.sw: Ni nadharia tete moja kati ya kadhaa — kipimo kilekile kinaendana kwa usawa na kuzungusha pochi, uhamiaji wa utunzaji, au utimizaji wa nje ya soko

b23f9a1f1c58.en: Drawdown is the number people actually live through, and the arithmetic of recovering from one is unintuitive in a specific direction: losses and gains are not symmetrical.
b23f9a1f1c58.sw: Kushuka ndiyo namba ambayo watu huiishi hasa, na hesabu ya kupona kutoka kwake haieleweki kwa mwelekeo mahususi: hasara na faida hazina usawa.

b24b0f59b424.en: What Is Risk, and How Do You Manage It?

b24c95c91ccd.en: Before adapting anything, it is worth knowing what the evidence says actually explains crypto returns, because the answer is narrower than most commentary implies.
b24c95c91ccd.sw: Kabla ya kurekebisha lolote, inastahili kujua ushahidi husema nini kinachoeleza hasa faida za kripto, kwa sababu jibu ni finyu zaidi kuliko maoni mengi yanavyodokeza.

b28a04f1a7bb.en: List every institution that currently holds any of your crypto, and beside each the amount. Then write one sentence per institution answering: what evidence do I have that this entity holds what it says it holds, and would that evidence have distinguished FTX from a sound exchange in October 2022? For almost everyone the honest answer is that it would not, which is why the cap exists rather than the assessment.
b28a04f1a7bb.sw: Orodhesha kila taasisi inayoshikilia sasa kripto yako yoyote, na kando ya kila moja kiasi. Kisha andika sentensi moja kwa kila taasisi ukijibu: nina ushahidi gani kwamba taasisi hii inashikilia kile inachosema inashikilia, na je, ushahidi huo ungetofautisha FTX na soko imara la kubadilisha mwezi Oktoba 2022? Kwa karibu kila mtu jibu la kweli ni kwamba usingetofautisha, ndiyo maana dari ipo badala ya tathmini.

b290bb061a0d.sw: Kiasi cha soko dola 2,000,000,000; FDV dola 200,000,000

b2b499a22dde.en: Value moving into or out of addresses an analyst has labelled as belonging to an exchange.
b2b499a22dde.sw: Thamani inayoingia au kutoka katika anwani ambazo mchambuzi amewekea lebo kama za soko la kubadilisha.

b2b5fafb458a.en: Risk isn't unique to trading — it's in everything. Skydiving carries risk. Flying to a vacation destination carries risk. Driving to work carries risk. The actual skill isn't avoiding risk altogether — that's impossible. It's judging whether a given risk is worth taking, and controlling it wherever you can.
b2b5fafb458a.sw: Hatari si ya kipekee kwa biashara — ipo katika kila kitu. Kuruka kwa parachuti kuna hatari. Kusafiri kwa ndege kwenda likizo kuna hatari. Kuendesha gari kwenda kazini kuna hatari. Ustadi halisi si kuepuka hatari kabisa — hilo haliwezekani. Ni kuhukumu kama hatari fulani inastahili kuchukuliwa, na kuidhibiti pale unapoweza.

b2ce1131cdb9.en: A single indicator giving a clear signal

b2d0fad7d9ad.en: Not quite. More holdings do not increase risk, and diversification applies at every level. The point is that holdings which move together provide little protection regardless of how many there are — correlation is what does the work.
b2d0fad7d9ad.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Umiliki mwingi hauongezi hatari, na kusambaza hutumika katika kila kiwango. Pointi ni kwamba umiliki unaosogea pamoja hutoa ulinzi mdogo bila kujali ni mingapi — uwiano ndio hufanya kazi.

b2dcb453f9df.en: Start with the property of crypto diversification that Chapter 2 Lesson 3 established and this lesson has to finish.
b2dcb453f9df.sw: Anza na sifa ya mtawanyiko wa kripto ambayo Sura ya 2 Somo la 3 lilithibitisha na somo hili lazima limalize.

b2f29bdd12cf.en: The EU's cap wasn't a guess. ESMA published its actual reasoning:
b2f29bdd12cf.sw: Kikomo cha Umoja wa Ulaya hakikuwa kisio. ESMA ilichapisha hoja yake halisi:

b2f85b4cb469.en: Pricing an asset on a story about its future rather than on observable cash flows. Not always wrong, but unfalsifiable while the story lasts.
b2f85b4cb469.sw: Kupanga bei ya rasilimali kwa hadithi kuhusu mustakabali wake badala ya mitiririko ya fedha inayoonekana. Si kosa kila mara, lakini haiwezi kukanushwa maadamu hadithi inaendelea.

b2fb7b26505c.en: The May 2020 halving arrived eight weeks after the Federal Reserve cut its policy rate to a range of 0 to 0.25% on 15 March 2020 and launched a 700 billion dollar asset-purchase program, expanded to open-ended purchases on 23 March. Nearly every risk asset on earth rose from that point. The 2022 crash coincided with the Fed reversing course, lifting rates from near zero to 5.25 to 5.50% between March 2022 and July 2023. The 2024 halving came just over three months after the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approved 11 spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds on 10 January 2024, which opened a distribution channel Bitcoin had never had.
b2fb7b26505c.sw: Kupunguzwa nusu kwa Mei 2020 kulifika wiki nane baada ya Hifadhi ya Shirikisho kupunguza kiwango chake cha sera hadi kiwango cha 0 hadi 0.25% tarehe 15 Machi 2020 na kuzindua programu ya ununuzi wa rasilimali ya dola bilioni 700, iliyopanuliwa kuwa ununuzi usio na kikomo tarehe 23 Machi. Karibu kila rasilimali ya hatari duniani ilipanda kutoka wakati huo. Mporomoko wa 2022 uliambatana na Fed kugeuza mwelekeo, ikipandisha viwango kutoka karibu sifuri hadi 5.25 hadi 5.50% kati ya Machi 2022 na Julai 2023. Kupunguzwa nusu kwa 2024 kulikuja zaidi kidogo ya miezi mitatu baada ya U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission kuidhinisha mifuko 11 ya biashara ya Bitcoin ya papo hapo tarehe 10 Januari 2024, jambo lililofungua njia ya usambazaji ambayo Bitcoin haikuwahi kuwa nayo.

b2fd0dc97ec7.en: The forced closure of a leveraged position by the exchange when equity falls to the maintenance margin.
b2fd0dc97ec7.sw: Kufungwa kwa lazima kwa nafasi yenye mzingo na soko la kubadilisha wakati usawa unaposhuka hadi mkopo wa kudumisha.

b300d50bb839.en: The cumulative effect of annual charges on a compounding balance. It grows with both the rate charged and the length of time held.
b300d50bb839.sw: Athari jumlifu ya malipo ya kila mwaka juu ya salio linalojilimbikiza. Hukua kwa kiwango kinachotozwa na kwa urefu wa muda wa kushikilia.

b30655f81821.en: Not quite. All three are recurring annual charges on the full balance, so they compound together rather than separately or in place of one another. The total of 1.30% is what matters, and over thirty years it takes a large share of the outcome.
b30655f81821.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Yote matatu ni malipo ya mara kwa mara ya kila mwaka juu ya salio lote, kwa hivyo hujilimbikiza pamoja badala ya kando au kimoja badala ya kingine. Jumla ya 1.30% ndiyo yenye maana, na kwa miaka thelathini huchukua sehemu kubwa ya matokeo.

b307c8cc8166.en: That the yield was fraudulent and hidden from users
b307c8cc8166.sw: Kwamba mavuno yalikuwa ya udanganyifu na yalifichwa kutoka watumiaji

b31efcf93d87.en: Scoring the pillars is what turns the framework from a checklist into a decision, and the scoring has to be honest about independence.
b31efcf93d87.sw: Kupima nguzo ndicho kinachogeuza mfumo kutoka orodha ya kukagua kuwa uamuzi, na upimaji lazima uwe wa kweli kuhusu uhuru.

b3233e86d15b.en: Take any leveraged position you have seen described online, or invent one. Write down four numbers before anything else: the notional value, the margin posted, the liquidation price computed from the formula in this lesson, and the adverse move that reaches it as a percentage. Then look up the asset's largest single-day move over the past 12 months and write that down as a fifth number. If number five is larger than number four, the position was already decided before it was opened. Do this for 5x, 25x and 100x on the same asset and keep the sheet.
b3233e86d15b.sw: Chukua nafasi yoyote yenye mzingo uliyoiona ikielezwa mtandaoni, au ubuni moja. Andika namba nne kabla ya lolote: thamani ya kinadharia, mkopo ulioweka, bei ya ufilisi iliyohesabiwa kutoka fomula katika somo hili, na msogeo mbaya unaoifikia kama asilimia. Kisha tafuta msogeo mkubwa zaidi wa siku moja wa rasilimali katika miezi 12 iliyopita na uandike hiyo kama namba ya tano. Ikiwa namba ya tano ni kubwa kuliko namba ya nne, nafasi ilikuwa tayari imeamuliwa kabla haijafunguliwa. Fanya hivi kwa 5x, 25x na 100x katika rasilimali ileile na uweke karatasi.

b3431e080774.en: An investor holds twenty companies, all of them banks. What has diversification achieved?
b3431e080774.sw: Mwekezaji anashikilia kampuni ishirini, zote ni benki. Kusambaza kumefanikisha nini?

b354b40f75e4.en: You place a stop order to sell at 45. Overnight news causes the share to open at 38. What happens?
b354b40f75e4.sw: Unaweka agizo la stop la kuuza kwa 45. Habari za usiku husababisha hisa kufunguliwa kwa 38. Kinatokea nini?

b366d15b8f4a.en: The stop-out closes your position at the best price available when it fires — and in a violent gap, there may be no price nearby, exactly as you saw with stop-loss orders in Chapter 1, Lesson 7. When the Swiss National Bank floor broke in 2015, stop-outs triggered correctly but filled far below their levels, and many accounts went negative — traders ended up owing money they never deposited. This is precisely why negative balance protection exists as a rule in the EU, UK, and Australia (Chapter 1, Lesson 6).
b366d15b8f4a.sw: Stop-out hufunga nafasi yako kwa bei bora inayopatikana inapowaka — na katika kuruka kwa nguvu, huenda kusiwe na bei karibu, hasa kama ulivyoona na maagizo ya stop-loss katika Sura ya 1, Somo la 7. Sakafu ya Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilipovunjika mwaka 2015, stop-out zilianzishwa kwa usahihi lakini zilitimizwa chini mno ya viwango vyao, na akaunti nyingi zikawa hasi — wafanyabiashara waliishia kudaiwa pesa ambazo hawakuwahi kuziweka. Ndiyo sababu hasa ulinzi wa salio hasi upo kama kanuni katika Umoja wa Ulaya, Uingereza, na Australia (Sura ya 1, Somo la 6).

b381ff8f06ba.en: The same six pillars transfer from currencies to shares, but a share has cash flows, so valuation stops being relative and becomes an estimate you can be wrong about in a specific way.
b381ff8f06ba.sw: Nguzo sita zilezile huhamishwa kutoka sarafu hadi hisa, lakini hisa ina mitiririko ya fedha, kwa hivyo tathmini huacha kuwa ya kulinganisha na kuwa makadirio ambayo unaweza kukosea kuyahusu kwa namna maalum.

b3c363a1660d.en: Lesson 1 ended with Nakamoto's 2008 proposal: replace the bank's referee with a shared ledger that thousands of computers keep in sync, so a double-spend is visible to everyone and rejected by everyone.
b3c363a1660d.sw: Somo la 1 lilimalizika na pendekezo la Nakamoto la 2008: badilisha mwamuzi wa benki na leja inayoshirikiwa ambayo maelfu ya kompyuta huitunza sambamba, ili matumizi-mara-mbili yaonekane kwa kila mtu na yakataliwe na kila mtu.

b3fe9b4ce699.en: First, a distinction that causes most of the confusion. Someone investing 200 a month from their salary is not choosing a strategy — they are investing money as it arrives, which is the only option available. The debate applies only to someone holding a sum now and deciding how quickly to deploy it.
b3fe9b4ce699.sw: Kwanza, tofauti inayosababisha mkanganyiko mwingi. Mtu anayewekeza 200 kwa mwezi kutoka mshahara wake hachagui mkakati — anawekeza pesa zinapofika, ambako ndilo chaguo pekee linalopatikana. Mjadala hutumika kwa mtu anayeshikilia kiasi sasa na kuamua kwa kasi gani kukipeleka tu.

b40a4afe700e.en: A dividend is not free money. The share price drops by roughly the payment — what matters is total return, not the yield.
b40a4afe700e.sw: Gawio si pesa za bure. Bei ya hisa hushuka kwa takriban malipo — kinachohusika ni faida ya jumla, si mavuno.

b41b2fffb2e1.en: The economic theory that a currency with higher interest rates should depreciate over time by exactly enough to cancel out its interest advantage — so that, in theory, there's no free profit in simply chasing high-rate currencies.
b41b2fffb2e1.sw: Nadharia ya kiuchumi kwamba sarafu yenye viwango vya juu vya riba inapaswa kudhoofika kwa muda kwa kiasi hasa cha kufuta faida yake ya riba — ili, kinadharia, kusiwe na faida ya bure katika kufukuza tu sarafu za viwango vya juu.

b41e9618582e.en: What it does show, unambiguously, is that the story that reaches you and the story in the data can be different, and that almost nobody checks. The SEC report has been publicly available since October 2021. The explanation it does not support remains the one most commonly repeated, five years later, including by people who are certain about it.
b41e9618582e.sw: Linachoonyesha, bila utata, ni kwamba hadithi inayokufikia na hadithi iliyo katika data zinaweza kuwa tofauti, na kwamba karibu hakuna anayekagua. Ripoti ya SEC imekuwa inapatikana hadharani tangu Oktoba 2021. Maelezo ambayo hairaungi mkono bado ndiyo yanayorudiwa zaidi, miaka mitano baadaye, ikiwa ni pamoja na na watu wenye uhakika kuyahusu.

b42e6c0e9684.en: For the arithmetic in the rest of this lesson, this course uses roughly 46% annualized for Bitcoin and roughly 7% for a major currency pair, and states that choice openly so you can redo the sums with your own figures.
b42e6c0e9684.sw: Kwa hesabu katika somo lililobaki, kozi hii hutumia takriban 46% kwa mwaka kwa Bitcoin na takriban 7% kwa jozi kuu ya sarafu, na hutaja chaguo hilo wazi ili uweze kufanya upya hesabu kwa takwimu zako mwenyewe.

b4432d02745f.en: Because it proves that crypto prices are manipulated
b4432d02745f.sw: Kwa sababu huthibitisha kwamba bei za kripto hupotoshwa

b455aaa3658b.en: Not quite — taking the long there is timeframe-shopping. The higher timeframe sets the permitted direction; the short-term chart only times the entry.
b455aaa3658b.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kuchukua long hapo ni kutafuta vipindi. Kipindi cha juu zaidi huweka mwelekeo unaoruhusiwa; chati ya muda mfupi hupanga wakati wa kuingia tu.

b45c19fa2f18.en: The practical conclusion survives all three studies intact. Automatic contributions into broad funds produce almost no gap. Discretionary trading in narrow funds produces a large one. What you hold matters less here than how often you touch it.
b45c19fa2f18.sw: Hitimisho la vitendo linanusurika tafiti zote tatu likiwa kamili. Michango ya kiotomatiki katika mifuko mipana hutoa pengo dogo mno. Biashara ya hiari katika mifuko finyu hutoa pengo kubwa. Unachoshikilia kina maana ndogo hapa kuliko mara ngapi unakigusa.

b471dde68778.en: Correct — entering the oversold zone shows one-sided selling; exiting it shows that pressure has actually broken. Waiting for the exit trades a little upside for real confirmation — markets can stay oversold far longer than your account can stay solvent.
b471dde68778.sw: Sahihi — kuingia kwenye kanda ya kuuzwa kupita kiasi kunaonyesha uuzaji wa upande mmoja; kutoka ndani yake kunaonyesha kwamba shinikizo hilo limevunjika hasa. Kusubiri kutoka kunabadilisha faida kidogo kwa uthibitisho halisi — masoko yanaweza kubaki yameuzwa kupita kiasi kwa muda mrefu zaidi kuliko akaunti yako inavyoweza kubaki na uwezo wa kulipa.

b4b98ac014ff.en: An accountant's confirmation that stated reserves existed at one moment — a snapshot, not a full audit.
b4b98ac014ff.sw: Uthibitisho wa mhasibu kwamba akiba zilizotajwa zilikuwepo katika wakati mmoja — picha ya wakati, si ukaguzi kamili.

b4bc4cd08573.en: The portfolio keeps most of the gain, and rebalancing would have made no difference
b4bc4cd08573.sw: Kasha hubakiza sehemu kubwa ya faida, na kusawazisha upya kusingefanya tofauti

b4cf610373ea.en: Risk limitation is the technique you'll use the most. This lesson makes it concrete: every time you enter a position, there are three prices to think through.
b4cf610373ea.sw: Kupunguza hatari ndiyo mbinu utakayoitumia zaidi. Somo hili linaifanya iwe halisi: kila unapoingia katika nafasi, kuna bei tatu za kufikiria.

b4ddd0eedd16.en: Not quite. The recovery was not an accounting adjustment or a change of weighting method. The index replaced its failures with survivors over the intervening years — something an unchanged portfolio of the original companies could not do.
b4ddd0eedd16.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kupona hakukuwa marekebisho ya kihasibu wala mabadiliko ya mbinu ya uzani. Faharasa ilibadilisha zilizoshindwa kwa walionusurika katika miaka iliyopita — jambo ambalo kasha lisilobadilika la kampuni za awali lisingeweza kufanya.

b4f93521aa01.en: A central bank signals higher rates for longer. Government bond yields move first. Currencies adjust. Corporate credit spreads widen as borrowing becomes more expensive. Only then do equity prices reflect it — through two separate channels, since higher rates raise the discount applied to future cash flows and also slow the economy those cash flows come from.
b4f93521aa01.sw: Benki kuu inaashiria viwango vya juu zaidi kwa muda mrefu zaidi. Mavuno ya hatifungani za serikali husonga kwanza. Sarafu hujirekebisha. Mianya ya mikopo ya makampuni hupanuka kadiri kukopa kunavyokuwa ghali zaidi. Ndipo tu bei za hisa huakisi hilo — kupitia njia mbili tofauti, kwa kuwa viwango vya juu vya riba hupandisha punguzo linalotumika kwa mitiririko ya fedha ya baadaye na pia hupunguza kasi ya uchumi ambao mitiririko hiyo hutoka.

b4fc6a7fc7d5.en: Write out, in two sentences, what any stablecoin you hold is actually backed by, and where you verified it. If the answer is a reserve, note who attests to that reserve and how often. If the answer is a mechanism involving a second token, you are holding the structure in this lesson, and the position deserves the size that implies.
b4fc6a7fc7d5.sw: Andika, katika sentensi mbili, sarafu imara yoyote unayoishikilia inaungwa mkono na nini hasa, na ulithibitisha wapi. Ikiwa jibu ni akiba, tambua nani hushuhudia akiba hiyo na mara ngapi. Ikiwa jibu ni utaratibu unaohusisha tokeni ya pili, unashikilia muundo ulio katika somo hili, na nafasi inastahili ukubwa ambao hilo linadokeza.

b51565b6141e.en: They will receive a smaller share of any dividend
b51565b6141e.sw: Watapokea sehemu ndogo ya gawio lolote

b515faa053dd.en: Because the halving reduces supply, which should lower the price, not raise it
b515faa053dd.sw: Kwa sababu kupunguzwa nusu hupunguza usambazaji, jambo linalopaswa kushusha bei, si kuipandisha

b52956dc1d9a.en: An exchange listing is a commercial decision, and on some venues a token can be listed by anyone who creates a market for it — which is precisely the Uniswap finding above. A named team with real photographs establishes that people exist, not that they are honest, and impersonated identities are common. Total value locked measures deposits, which rise fastest during exactly the schemes that are attracting deposits fastest. Institutional investment establishes that other people also made a judgement, which the previous lesson's case studies show is not much.
b52956dc1d9a.sw: Uorodheshaji katika soko la kubadilisha ni uamuzi wa kibiashara, na katika viwanja baadhi tokeni inaweza kuorodheshwa na yeyote anayeunda soko lake — jambo ambalo ndilo hasa tokeo la Uniswap hapo juu. Timu iliyotajwa yenye picha halisi huthibitisha kwamba watu wapo, si kwamba ni waaminifu, na vitambulisho vilivyoigwa ni vya kawaida. Thamani jumla iliyofungiwa hupima amana, ambazo hupanda kwa kasi zaidi wakati hasa wa mipango inayovutia amana kwa kasi zaidi. Uwekezaji wa kitaasisi huthibitisha kwamba watu wengine pia walifanya hukumu, jambo ambalo uchunguzi wa matukio wa somo lililotangulia huonyesha si kingi.

b53937afcdb5.en: Not quite — Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003) found an asymmetry: bad news moves prices more than equally-sized good news.
b53937afcdb5.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold & Vega (2003) waligundua kutokuwa na usawa: habari mbaya husogeza bei zaidi kuliko habari njema ya ukubwa sawa.

b53e3f8c2a35.en: The United States formally adopted the gold standard in 1879 — every dollar in circulation became directly redeemable for a fixed amount of gold, for ordinary citizens, not just foreign governments. Britain had done the same decades earlier, in 1821.
b53e3f8c2a35.sw: Marekani ilikubali rasmi kiwango cha dhahabu mwaka 1879 — kila dola iliyokuwa katika mzunguko ikawa inaweza kukombolewa moja kwa moja kwa kiasi thabiti cha dhahabu, kwa raia wa kawaida, si serikali za kigeni tu. Uingereza ilikuwa imefanya hivyo miongo kadhaa mapema, mwaka 1821.

b5537689b8d0.en: A fund holding a basket of assets, whose own shares trade on an exchange throughout the day like an ordinary share.
b5537689b8d0.sw: Fund inayoshikilia kikapu cha mali, ambayo hisa zake zenyewe hufanyiwa biashara sokoni mchana kutwa kama hisa ya kawaida.

b553b8153560.en: Account equity relative to margin in use, as a percentage.
b553b8153560.sw: Usawa wa akaunti ikilinganishwa na margin inayotumika, kama asilimia.

b56654a0d208.en: What is the core difference in how PoW and PoS make dishonesty expensive?
b56654a0d208.sw: Tofauti kuu katika jinsi PoW na PoS hufanya udanganyifu kuwa ghali ni ipi?

b571d82182a2.en: The mechanism did not stop working. It worked exactly as specified, all the way down. Every redemption did what the documentation said it would do. The design was not defeated by an attack or a bug — it was executing correctly while destroying the thing it was executing on. A system can be functioning perfectly and be catastrophic, and those are not contradictory statements.
b571d82182a2.sw: Utaratibu haukuacha kufanya kazi. Ulifanya kazi hasa kama ulivyoainishwa, hadi chini kabisa. Kila ukombozi ulifanya kile nyaraka zilisema utafanya. Muundo haukushindwa na shambulizi wala hitilafu — ulikuwa ukitekelezwa kwa usahihi huku ukiharibu kitu kilichokuwa ukitekelezwa juu yake. Mfumo unaweza kuwa unafanya kazi kikamilifu na ukawa wa maafa, na hizo si kauli zinazopingana.

b573c81b0838.en: The expensive fund ends up about 1.45% behind, matching the fee difference
b573c81b0838.sw: Fund ghali humalizia takriban 1.45% nyuma, ikilingana na tofauti ya ada

b5935331b5b0.en: Not quite — dropping below 30 only shows one-sided selling. The higher-quality signal is RSI crossing back above 30, confirming the selling pressure has actually broken.
b5935331b5b0.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kushuka chini ya 30 kunaonyesha tu uuzaji wa upande mmoja. Ishara yenye ubora zaidi ni RSI kukatiza tena juu ya 30, ikithibitisha shinikizo la kuuza limevunjika hasa.

b5a88548d631.en: Why is the advertised fee not always sufficient to choose between two funds tracking the same index?
b5a88548d631.sw: Kwa nini ada iliyotangazwa haitoshi daima kuchagua kati ya fund mbili zinazofuatilia index ile ile?

b5aecc571fb9.en: Catalyst. Currencies wait on policy meetings and data releases. Equities have a denser and more predictable calendar: results dates, index inclusions, regulatory decisions, contract awards, product launches. The advantage is that the date is often known in advance. The trap is the same as in Forex — a thesis with no reason to move now is a reason to wait, not to buy.
b5aecc571fb9.sw: Kichocheo. Sarafu husubiri mikutano ya sera na matoleo ya data. Hisa zina kalenda nzito zaidi na inayotabirika zaidi: tarehe za matokeo, kuingizwa katika faharasa, maamuzi ya udhibiti, zabuni za mikataba, uzinduzi wa bidhaa. Faida ni kwamba tarehe mara nyingi hujulikana mapema. Mtego ni uleule kama katika Forex — nadharia isiyo na sababu ya kusonga sasa ni sababu ya kusubiri, si ya kununua.

b5b0b6f228db.en: Proof of reserves is a genuine improvement over nothing, and it is much weaker than it sounds. It typically shows assets and not liabilities, which means an exchange can display holdings while owing far more than it holds. It is a snapshot, so assets can be borrowed for the measurement date. And it says nothing about whether those assets are encumbered. It raises the cost of one specific deception; it does not make an exchange safe, and it is not a substitute for the cap.
b5b0b6f228db.sw: Uthibitisho wa akiba ni maboresho halisi juu ya kutokuwa na kitu, nao ni dhaifu zaidi kuliko unavyosikika. Kwa kawaida huonyesha rasilimali na si madeni, jambo linalomaanisha soko linaweza kuonyesha umiliki huku likidaiwa zaidi sana kuliko linavyoshikilia. Ni picha ya wakati, kwa hivyo rasilimali zinaweza kukopwa kwa tarehe ya kipimo. Nao hausemi lolote kuhusu kama rasilimali hizo zimewekwa dhamana. Hupandisha gharama ya udanganyifu mmoja maalum; haufanyi soko la kubadilisha kuwa salama, wala si mbadala wa dari.

b5d48b2d0b08.en: If the ledger does not say which addresses belong to an exchange, or to one owner, how does any provider publish exchange balances and whale counts? They infer it, using heuristics — rules of thumb that are usually right.
b5d48b2d0b08.sw: Ikiwa leja haisemi ni anwani zipi ni za soko la kubadilisha, au za mmiliki mmoja, mtoa data yeyote huchapishaje salio za masoko ya kubadilisha na hesabu za nyangumi? Huyakisia, wakitumia kanuni za jumla — kanuni za kawaida ambazo kwa kawaida ni sahihi.

b5d5dec0ccef.en: Correlation recalculated repeatedly over a moving window of recent data, for example the last 90 days, and then plotted through time. It shows how the relationship between two assets changes, instead of collapsing it into one average number.
b5d5dec0ccef.sw: Uhusiano unaohesabiwa upya mara kwa mara katika dirisha linalosogea la data ya hivi karibuni, kwa mfano siku 90 zilizopita, kisha kuchorwa kupitia wakati. Huonyesha jinsi uhusiano kati ya rasilimali mbili unavyobadilika, badala ya kuuponda kuwa namba moja ya wastani.

b5d8f0b6be4a.en: Correct. Yield is the dividend divided by the price, so a falling price raises it mechanically. The screen therefore over-represents companies the market has marked down, and it misses companies returning large amounts of cash through buybacks, which show up in per-share figures rather than in yield.

b5f2dc080471.en: What should a reader do with this? Not much, directly — and that is the point. The practical value is not a strategy. It is calibration: an effect real enough to reshape academic finance still spent years failing to appear. Any claim that some rule reliably beats the market should be measured against that.

Dai lolote kwamba kanuni fulani hushinda soko kwa kutegemewa linapaswa kupimwa dhidi ya hilo.

b6217c2fdec9.en: A note on the exponential moving average (EMA): it's a variant that weights recent prices more heavily. Some traders prefer it; the simple version teaches the same concepts and is what this course uses. MACD (below) is built from EMAs — worth knowing the term exists.

That lesson ended with a promise, that how deep those books really are and why reported volume can mislead would be covered here. This is that lesson.

Somo hilo lilimalizika na ahadi, kwamba vitabu hivyo vina kina kiasi gani hasa na kwa nini ujazo unaoripotiwa unaweza kupotosha vingefunikwa hapa. Hili ndilo somo hilo.

Almost everything that can be known here concerns how the machine works and how to survive it. Almost nothing that can be known concerns what happens next. Any source that inverts that ratio — long on what happens next, short on mechanics and survival — is telling you about its business model rather than about the market.

Chanzo chochote kinachogeuza uwiano huo — kirefu juu ya kinachotokea baadaye, kifupi juu ya mitambo na kunusurika — kinakuambia kuhusu mfumo wake wa mapato badala ya kuhusu soko.

b6b3d07debca.en: Buying call options gives leveraged exposure to a rise for a small outlay, with the loss capped at the premium paid. That capped loss makes it feel safer than margin, and in one narrow sense it is. What it hides is that the option expires: the position can be entirely correct about the direction and still expire worthless because the move happened a week late.

Hasara hiyo yenye kikomo huifanya ihisi salama kuliko mkopo, na kwa maana moja finyu ni hivyo. Kinachoifichwa ni kwamba chaguo hukwisha muda: nafasi inaweza kuwa sahihi kabisa kuhusu mwelekeo na bado ikaisha muda bila thamani kwa sababu msogeo ulitokea wiki moja baadaye.

b71237885e02.en: Every entry gives you the same core fields. Time — when the data drops, usually to the minute; currency pairs can move within seconds of it. Currency — which currency the event affects; critically, check both sides of your pair, because a EUR event moves EUR/USD just as surely as a USD event does. Impact — a colour-coded severity rating (typically yellow = low, orange = medium, red = high). Actual / Forecast / Previous — the released number, what analysts expected, and last period's reading.
b71237885e02.sw: Kila kiingilio hukupa sehemu zile zile za msingi. Muda — data inapoanguka, kwa kawaida hadi dakika; jozi za sarafu zinaweza kusogea ndani ya sekunde chache baada yake. Sarafu — ni sarafu ipi tukio linaloathiri; muhimu, kagua pande zote mbili za jozi lako, kwa sababu tukio la EUR husogeza EUR/USD kwa uhakika kama tukio la USD linavyofanya. Athari — daraja la ukali lenye mfumo wa rangi (kwa kawaida njano = ndogo, chungwa = ya kati, nyekundu = kubwa). Halisi / Utabiri / Iliyopita — namba iliyotolewa, kile wachambuzi walitarajia, na usomaji wa kipindi kilichopita.

b7294a4a5a9b.sw: Sahihi — broker anakupa uwazi ule ule kwa msogeo wa kiwango cha ubadilishaji bila safari yoyote ya kimwili wala ubadilishanaji wa fedha taslimu — hiyo ndiyo sababu yote ya kuwepo kwa biashara ya forex ya rejareja.

b72c73b0aefb.en: Academics measure crypto liquidity the same way they measure it in other markets, and they do not use volume to do it. Brauneis, Mestel, Riordan and Theissen tested how well low-frequency, easily computed liquidity measures track actual high-frequency liquidity in cryptocurrency markets, in a paper published in the Journal of Banking and Finance, Volume 124, in 2021. Their measures are built from spreads and price impact, not from reported trade counts. When researchers want to know how liquid a crypto market is, they look at what it costs to trade, not at how much volume an exchange claims.
b72c73b0aefb.sw: Wataalamu hupima ukwasi wa kripto kwa njia ileile wanavyoupima katika masoko mengine, nao hawatumii ujazo kufanya hivyo. Brauneis, Mestel, Riordan na Theissen walipima jinsi vipimo vya ukwasi vya masafa ya chini, vinavyohesabika kwa urahisi vinavyofuatilia vizuri ukwasi halisi wa masafa ya juu katika masoko ya sarafu ya kripto, katika karatasi iliyochapishwa katika Journal of Banking and Finance, Juzuu 124, mwaka 2021. Vipimo vyao vimejengwa kutoka mianya na athari ya bei, si kutoka idadi ya biashara zinazoripotiwa. Watafiti wanapotaka kujua soko la kripto lina ukwasi kiasi gani, huangalia inagharimu nini kufanya biashara, si ujazo ambao soko la kubadilisha hudai.

b77646e05851.en: This is the core argument of Nakamoto's 2008 paper, which you read honestly in Lesson 1: the chain forms "a record that cannot be changed without redoing the proof-of-work," and an attacker rewriting history must outpace the entire honest network while doing it. The deeper the block, the more work sits on top of it, and the safer it is. This is why exchanges wait for "confirmations" — blocks stacked on top of your transaction — before treating a deposit as final. Lesson 6 returns to that.
b77646e05851.sw: Hii ndiyo hoja kuu ya karatasi ya Nakamoto ya 2008, uliyoisoma kwa ukweli katika Somo la 1: mnyororo huunda "a record that cannot be changed without redoing the proof-of-work," na mshambuliaji anayeandika upya historia lazima ampite mtandao mzima mwaminifu huku akifanya hivyo. Kadiri kitalu kinavyokuwa kirefu ndani, ndivyo kazi nyingi zaidi zinavyokaa juu yake, na ndivyo kilivyo salama zaidi. Ndiyo maana masoko ya kubadilisha husubiri "uthibitisho" — vitalu vilivyorundikwa juu ya muamala wako — kabla ya kuchukulia amana kama ya mwisho. Somo la 6 hurudi kwenye hilo.

b796a75b5f7f.en: The practical version is short. Spread across industries and countries, not just across names. Expect it to reduce the risk of one company failing, not the risk of a bad decade. And treat any confident number of holdings as a rule of thumb whose own literature has argued about it for fifty years.
b796a75b5f7f.sw: Toleo la kivitendo ni fupi. Sambaza katika sekta na nchi, si katika majina tu. Tarajia lipunguze hatari ya kampuni moja kushindwa, si hatari ya muongo mbaya. Na chukulia namba yoyote ya uhakika ya umiliki kama kanuni ya kidole gumba ambayo fasihi yake yenyewe imeibishania kwa miaka hamsini.

b7ab2fc73081.en: You put in 10,000, borrow 10,000, and hold 20,000 of shares. The maintenance requirement is 25%. Your equity is the value of the shares less the 10,000 loan, so the call arrives when the position is worth about 13,333 — a fall of just 33% in the shares. At that point your own money is down to about 3,333, a loss of two thirds, and the broker can sell without waiting for you.
b7ab2fc73081.sw: Unaweka 10,000, unakopa 10,000, na unashikilia hisa za 20,000. Hitaji la kudumisha ni 25%. Usawa wako ni thamani ya hisa kutoa mkopo wa 10,000, hivyo wito hufika nafasi inapokuwa na thamani ya takriban 13,333 — kushuka kwa 33% tu katika hisa. Wakati huo pesa zako mwenyewe zimeshuka hadi takriban 3,333, hasara ya theluthi mbili, na broker anaweza kuuza bila kukusubiri.

b7b41711cf6d.en: A mode in which only the margin explicitly assigned to a position can be used to support it. If the position is liquidated, the loss is capped at that assigned margin and the rest of the account is untouched. The position is also easier to liquidate, because it cannot draw on the rest of your balance to survive.
b7b41711cf6d.sw: Hali ambapo ni mkopo uliopangiwa nafasi waziwazi pekee unaoweza kutumika kuiunga mkono. Ikiwa nafasi itafilisiwa, hasara ina kikomo cha mkopo uliopangiwa na akaunti iliyobaki haiguswi. Nafasi pia ni rahisi zaidi kufilisiwa, kwa sababu haiwezi kuchota kutoka salio lako lililobaki ili kunusurika.

b7f0ccc7c0f7.en: Selling winners too early and holding losers too long. Documented by Odean in 1998.
b7f0ccc7c0f7.sw: Kuuza washindi mapema mno na kushikilia wapotezaji muda mrefu mno. Iliandikwa na Odean mwaka 1998.

b7f76ed13e44.sw: Zinafanana, kwa sababu ada ndicho wawekezaji hulipa

b7fe68d4dca9.en: Not quite — widening the stop for comfort destroys the planned reward-to-risk. You may exit if the thesis breaks, but not move the stop for comfort.
b7fe68d4dca9.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kupanua stop kwa faraja huharibu tuzo-kwa-hatari iliyopangwa. Unaweza kutoka kama nadharia itavunjika, lakini si kusogeza stop kwa faraja.

b807659acdb0.en: You have a 2,000 dollar account and open a 50,000 dollar EUR/USD position at 50:1 leverage. Used margin is 50,000 / 50 = 1,000 dollars, leaving 1,000 dollars of free margin, and your margin level starts at 2,000 / 1,000 = 200%. Now price moves against you. A 1,000 dollar floating loss — a 2% move, about 200 pips — drops equity to 1,000 dollars, so margin level hits 100%: the margin call. If the loss reaches 1,500 dollars — a 3% move, about 300 pips — equity is 500 dollars, margin level is 50%, and the stop-out closes the trade for you. A 300-pip move has ended this position, whatever you wanted.
b807659acdb0.sw: Una akaunti ya dola 2,000 na unafungua nafasi ya EUR/USD ya dola 50,000 kwa leverage ya 50:1. Margin iliyotumika ni 50,000 / 50 = dola 1,000, ikiacha dola 1,000 za margin huru, na kiwango chako cha margin huanza kwa 2,000 / 1,000 = 200%. Sasa bei inasogea dhidi yako. Hasara inayoelea ya dola 1,000 — msogeo wa 2%, takriban pip 200 — hushusha usawa hadi dola 1,000, hivyo kiwango cha margin hufikia 100%: wito wa margin. Kama hasara itafikia dola 1,500 — msogeo wa 3%, takriban pip 300 — usawa ni dola 500, kiwango cha margin ni 50%, na stop-out hufunga biashara kwa niaba yako. Msogeo wa pip 300 umeimaliza nafasi hii, chochote ulichotaka.

b8086696b628.en: None of this makes dividend-paying shares bad, and dividend-focused funds are a legitimate holding. The point is narrower: judge a holding on total return and on why the company pays what it pays. Treat the yield as one input, not as the answer.
b8086696b628.sw: Hakuna kati ya haya kinachofanya hisa zinazolipa gawio kuwa mbaya, na fund zinazolenga gawio ni umiliki halali. Pointi ni finyu zaidi: hukumu umiliki kwa faida ya jumla na kwa nini kampuni hulipa inavyolipa. Chukulia mavuno kama pembejeo moja, si jibu.

First, Bitwise had a direct commercial interest in the conclusion: its argument was that the real bitcoin market is small, orderly and therefore suitable for an ETF. Second, the SEC did not accept the overall case. On 9 October 2019 it issued an order disapproving the proposed rule change, finding the applicant had not met its burden to show the market was resistant to fraud and manipulation. The wash-trading research was serious work. The conclusion drawn from it was contested by the regulator it was presented to.

b8fd232a63f1.en: That composition predicts exactly the criticism the index has attracted, and the research has found it. A 2026 study in the Elsevier journal Finance Research Open, titled "Do bitcoin returns move sentiment? Evidence from the crypto fear & greed index," ran a vector autoregression on daily data from 2018 to 2025. It reported that changes in the index did not Granger-cause Bitcoin returns and gave no out-of-sample forecasting gain - but that returns did Granger-cause changes in the index. A return shock produced a sharp, short-lived swing in the sentiment score, while a sentiment shock had negligible effect on returns. In that data, the arrow runs from price to sentiment, not the other way.
b8fd232a63f1.sw: Muundo huo hutabiri hasa ukosoaji ambao faharasa imevutia, na utafiti umeupata. Evidence from the crypto fear & greed index," uliendesha urejeshaji wa vekta wa kiotomatiki katika data ya kila siku kuanzia 2018 hadi 2025. Uliripoti kwamba mabadiliko katika faharasa hayakusababisha kwa Granger faida za Bitcoin na hayakutoa faida ya utabiri nje ya sampuli - lakini kwamba faida zilisababisha kwa Granger mabadiliko katika faharasa. Mshtuko wa faida ulizalisha msogeo mkali, wa muda mfupi katika alama ya hisia, huku mshtuko wa hisia ukiwa na athari isiyo na maana kwa faida. b9274f362328.en: For your largest holding, find the worst peak-to-trough fall it has experienced and how long it took to recover. Then write down what your monthly costs would be if your income stopped, and how many months you could cover without selling. Compare the two answers. If the recovery took longer than your reserve would last, you have found the actual risk in your position, and it is not in the price history.

b9a96056a5d4.en: The argument is arithmetic, not empirical, which is what makes it strong. All the shares in a market are held by someone. The passively managed money holds the market in proportion, so it earns the market return before costs. The remaining money is actively managed and, taken together, must therefore also hold the rest of the market in proportion — so it too earns the market return before costs. Active management as a whole cannot beat the market before costs, because in aggregate it is the market. After costs, and active costs are higher, it must on average do worse.
b9a96056a5d4.sw: Hoja ni ya kihesabu, si ya kimajaribio, ambacho ndicho kinachoifanya iwe imara. Hisa zote katika soko hushikiliwa na mtu. Pesa zinazosimamiwa kwa upole hushikilia soko kwa uwiano, hivyo hupata faida ya soko kabla ya gharama. Pesa zilizobaki husimamiwa kwa bidii na, kwa pamoja, lazima kwa hivyo pia zishikilie soko lililobaki kwa uwiano — hivyo nazo hupata faida ya soko kabla ya gharama. Usimamizi wa bidii kwa ujumla hauwezi kushinda soko kabla ya gharama, kwa sababu kwa jumla ndio soko. Baada ya gharama, na gharama za bidii ziko juu zaidi, lazima kwa wastani ufanye vibaya zaidi.

b9c328052bde.en: Attestation is not audit. As of this writing, no major stablecoin issuer publishes a full financial audit. Circle (USDC) publishes monthly reserve attestations by Deloitte; Tether publishes quarterly attestations by BDO. An attestation is real evidence — but it tells you the reserves existed on the report date, not that they exist today, and not that the business around them is sound. When marketing says "audited," check which of the two it actually is. Usually it is not an audit.
b9c328052bde.sw: Ushuhuda si ukaguzi. Hadi wakati wa kuandika, hakuna mtoaji mkuu wa sarafu imara anayechapisha ukaguzi kamili wa kifedha. Circle (USDC) huchapisha ushuhuda wa akiba wa kila mwezi na Deloitte; Tether huchapisha ushuhuda wa kila robo na BDO. Ushuhuda ni ushahidi halisi — lakini hukuambia akiba zilikuwepo tarehe ya ripoti, si kwamba zipo leo, wala si kwamba biashara inayozizunguka ni nzuri. Utangazaji unaposema "imekaguliwa," kagua ni ipi kati ya hizo mbili hasa. Kwa kawaida si ukaguzi.

ba21401734a9.en: Longin and Solnik studied this directly in "Extreme Correlation of International Equity Markets," The Journal of Finance, volume 56, issue 2, 2001, pages 649 to 676. Using extreme value theory on the tails of the return distribution, they found the effect is not symmetric. They rejected the assumption of normal joint behaviour for the negative tail, but not for the positive tail. In plain terms: markets get much more tightly linked in extreme falls than in extreme rises.
ba21401734a9.sw: Longin na Solnik walichunguza hili moja kwa moja katika "Extreme Correlation of International Equity Markets," The Journal of Finance, juzuu 56, toleo la 2, 2001, kurasa 649 hadi 676. Wakitumia nadharia ya thamani kali juu ya mikia ya mgawanyo wa faida, walibaini athari si ya ulinganifu. Walikataa dhana ya tabia ya pamoja ya kawaida kwa mkia hasi, lakini si kwa mkia chanya. Kwa maneno rahisi: masoko huunganishwa kwa ukaribu zaidi katika kushuka kali kuliko katika kupanda kali.

ba5f28a015be.en: Be precise about what that paper does and does not say. Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu measure crypto's own internal factor structure. They do not publish a beta of Bitcoin against the S&P 500. Anyone who cites them as direct proof that "crypto is high-beta to equities" is stretching the paper past its actual result. The equity co-movement evidence comes from the IMF work above. The factor paper tells you something different and still useful: crypto is not a separate financial universe with its own physics.
ba5f28a015be.sw: Kuwa sahihi kuhusu kile ambacho karatasi hiyo husema na haisemi. Liu, Tsyvinski na Wu hupima muundo wa vipengele wa ndani wa kripto yenyewe. Hawachapishi beta ya Bitcoin dhidi ya S&P 500. Yeyote anayewanukuu kama uthibitisho wa moja kwa moja kwamba "kripto ina beta kubwa dhidi ya hisa" anainyoosha karatasi zaidi ya matokeo yake halisi. Ushahidi wa kusogea pamoja na hisa hutoka kazi ya IMF hapo juu. Karatasi ya vipengele hukuambia kitu tofauti na bado chenye manufaa: kripto si ulimwengu tofauti wa kifedha wenye fizikia yake mwenyewe.

ba666fe2d35b.en: At 50x and 100x you are not trading a view. The liquidation level sits inside the range that ordinary noise covers within hours, so the outcome is decided by which direction the noise happens to wander first. That is a lottery ticket with a near-certain expiry date, priced in funding payments. Calling it a trade does not change what it is.
ba666fe2d35b.sw: Katika 50x na 100x hufanyi biashara ya mtazamo. Kiwango cha ufilisi hukaa ndani ya kiwango ambacho kelele za kawaida hukifunika ndani ya masaa, kwa hivyo matokeo huamuliwa na mwelekeo ambao kelele hubahatika kutangatanga kwanza. Hilo ni tikiti ya bahati nasibu yenye tarehe ya kukwisha muda ya karibu-hakika, iliyopangiwa bei katika malipo ya ufadhili. Kuiita biashara hakubadilishi ilivyo.

ba8b3ef4ebe5.en: Model two: crypto-collateralized. The second design removes the company and the bank account. DAI, run by the MakerDAO protocol, is the canonical example: the reserve is cryptocurrency locked in smart contracts, visible on-chain by anyone. But if 1 dollar of DAI were backed by 1 dollar of ETH, a 10 percent drop in ETH would leave every DAI under-backed. The fix is to demand more collateral than the debt.
ba8b3ef4ebe5.sw: Mfumo wa pili: wenye dhamana ya kripto. Muundo wa pili huondoa kampuni na akaunti ya benki. DAI, inayoendeshwa na itifaki ya MakerDAO, ndiyo mfano wa kawaida: akiba ni sarafu ya kripto iliyofungiwa katika mikataba mahiri, inayoonekana kwenye mnyororo na yeyote. Lakini ikiwa dola 1 ya DAI ingeungwa mkono na dola 1 ya ETH, kushuka kwa asilimia 10 kwa ETH kungeacha kila DAI ikiwa haiungwi mkono vya kutosha. Suluhisho ni kudai dhamana zaidi ya deni.

baabeb0742dd.en: Start with what the venues offer, because the gap between that and what regulators permit is the single most useful fact in this section. At the time of writing, the largest crypto derivatives venues advertise maximum leverage roughly as follows. Binance lists up to 125x on its bitcoin perpetual, but only for small position sizes, with the maximum falling as notional rises; new futures accounts are also capped lower, around 20x, until the account has aged. OKX advertises up to 125x on some derivatives products and lower ceilings on others. Bybit lists up to 100x on selected pairs. Hyperliquid, a decentralised venue, caps at roughly 40x to 50x.
baabeb0742dd.sw: Anza na kile ambacho viwanja hutoa, kwa sababu pengo kati ya hicho na kile ambacho wadhibiti huruhusu ndio ukweli mmoja wenye manufaa zaidi katika sehemu hii. Wakati wa kuandika, viwanja vikubwa zaidi vya viderivativi vya kripto hutangaza mzingo wa juu kabisa takriban hivi. Binance huorodhesha hadi 125x katika ya kudumu yake ya bitcoin, lakini kwa ukubwa mdogo wa nafasi pekee, huku kiwango cha juu kikishuka kadiri ya kinadharia inavyopanda; akaunti mpya za mikataba ya baadaye pia huwekewa kikomo cha chini, takriban 20x, hadi akaunti iwe imezeeka. OKX hutangaza hadi 125x katika bidhaa baadhi za viderivativi na dari za chini katika nyingine. Bybit huorodhesha hadi 100x katika jozi zilizochaguliwa. Hyperliquid, uwanja usio na kituo kikuu, huweka dari katika takriban 40x hadi 50x.

bbe41bebd8f9.en: What to look for before placing any order. Convert the spread to a percentage of the price, because a 4 cent spread means one thing on a 25 share and something very different on a 2 share. Check the average daily volume against the size you intend to trade. Avoid the first and last few minutes of the trading session, when spreads are widest. And use a limit order by default, accepting that it may not execute.

Kagua kiasi cha wastani cha kila siku dhidi ya ukubwa unaokusudia kufanyia biashara. Epuka dakika chache za kwanza na za mwisho za kipindi cha biashara, wakati spread ziko pana zaidi. bced06401b34.en: Now put a familiar forex stop next to that. A 50-pip stop on EUR/USD at 1.0800 is a distance of 0.0050 / 1.0800 = 0.463% of the price. Against a daily move of 0.44%, that stop sits at about 1.05 days of typical movement. It is a normal, workable forex stop. Move the same 0.463% stop onto Bitcoin at 60,000 dollars and it becomes a distance of 278 dollars. Bitcoin's typical daily move on these inputs is 2.41% of 60,000, which is about 1,445 dollars. The stop is now at 0.19 days of typical movement.
bced06401b34.sw: Sasa weka kusimamisha kunakojulikana kwa forex kando ya hiyo. Kusimamisha kwa pipi 50 katika EUR/USD katika 1.0800 ni umbali wa 0.0050 / 1.0800 = 0.463% ya bei. Dhidi ya msogeo wa kila siku wa 0.44%, kusimamisha huko hukaa katika takriban siku 1.05 za msogeo wa kawaida. Ni kusimamisha kwa forex kwa kawaida, kunakofanya kazi. Sogeza kusimamisha kwa 0.463% kuleko juu ya Bitcoin katika dola 60,000 nako huwa umbali wa dola 278. Msogeo wa kawaida wa kila siku wa Bitcoin katika viingizo hivi ni 2.41% ya 60,000, ambayo ni takriban dola 1,445. Kusimamisha sasa kuko katika siku 0.19 za msogeo wa kawaida.

bd291bd5f8c2.en: Deep drawdowns are mathematically punishing, and the arithmetic is worth doing once by hand. A 36.4% fall requires a 57.2% gain to get back to level. A 64.3% fall requires a 180.1% gain. A 77.6% fall requires a 346.4% gain. The recovery required grows much faster than the loss.

Kushuka kwa 64.3% kunahitaji ongezeko la 180.1%. Kushuka kwa 77.6% kunahitaji ongezeko la 346.4%. Kupona kunakohitajika hukua kwa kasi zaidi kuliko hasara.

bd56e2cdbd5c.en: Read that example for what it proves. The victim was a national securities regulator. The account was high-profile. The attack still worked, because the security of the account had been reduced to the security of a phone number. The same mechanism has taken individual crypto holdings. In one of the most-litigated cases, investor Michael Terpin lost roughly 24 million dollars in tokens in 2018 after a SIM swap defeated the two-factor authentication protecting an account; a teenager and an accomplice obtained the swap through an employee at his carrier. Terpin's litigation against the carrier was still moving through the United States appeal courts years later. The relevant detail for you is not the lawsuit. It is that his second factor was a text message.

bf94f292a3fb.en: Now the evidence — because Fibonacci retracements are exactly the kind of widely-repeated claim this course has taught you to check. The research is genuinely mixed, and knowing the shape of that disagreement is more useful than either blind faith or blanket dismissal. As early as 1977, Arthur Merrill's systematic study of market swings found no reliably standard retracement level. A rigorous 2021 study in Expert Systems with Applications built an algorithm to detect retracements objectively across Dow Jones, NASDAQ, and DAX stocks and found prices do bounce at Fibonacci levels somewhat more often than at arbitrary levels — but the authors explicitly note this doesn't necessarily translate into a profitable trading strategy. And multiple reviews find that standalone Fibonacci levels perform about as well as random levels, improving only when combined with independent evidence like support/resistance or trend. The most defensible reading: Fibonacci levels work partly because thousands of traders watch the same levels and place orders there — a self-fulfilling coordination point, not market magic. Treat them as zones where a reaction is plausible and other traders are paying attention — never as a guarantee, and never as a standalone system.
bf94f292a3fb.sw: Sasa ushahidi — kwa sababu kurudi nyuma kwa Fibonacci ni hasa aina ya dai linalorudiwa kwa upana ambalo kozi hii imekufundisha kulikagua. Utafiti umechanganyika kweli, na kujua umbo la mgogoro huo ni la manufaa zaidi kuliko imani ya kipofu au kukataa kwa jumla. Mapema kama mwaka 1977, utafiti wa kimfumo wa Arthur Merrill wa mizunguko ya soko haukupata kiwango chochote sanifu cha kutegemewa cha kurudi nyuma. Utafiti makini wa mwaka 2021 katika Expert Systems with Applications ulijenga algoriti ya kubaini kurudi nyuma kwa lengo katika hisa za Dow Jones, NASDAQ, na DAX na ukagundua bei huruka kwenye viwango vya Fibonacci mara nyingi kidogo zaidi kuliko kwenye viwango vya bahati nasibu — lakini waandishi wanabainisha wazi kwamba hili si lazima litafsirike kuwa mkakati wa biashara wenye faida. Na mapitio kadhaa hugundua kwamba viwango vya Fibonacci vinavyosimama peke yake hufanya kazi karibu sawa na viwango vya bahati nasibu, vikiboreka tu vinapounganishwa na ushahidi huru kama msaada/upinzani au mwelekeo. Usomaji unaotetewa zaidi: viwango vya Fibonacci hufanya kazi kwa sehemu kwa sababu maelfu ya wafanyabiashara hutazama viwango vile vile na kuweka maagizo hapo — mahali pa kuratibu panapojitimiza penyewe, si uchawi wa soko. Vichukulie kama kanda ambapo mwitikio unawezekana na wafanyabiashara wengine wanazingatia — kamwe si uhakika, na kamwe si mfumo unaosimama peke yake.
