Umiliki: mfuko mmoja wa faharasa ya hisa za kimataifa, 90%; fedha taslimu inayoshikiliwa kando, 10%, ikigharamia miezi sita ya gharama. Michango: 300 kwa mwezi, kiotomatiki, siku ya kwanza ya kazi. Kikomo cha kampuni moja: hakuna, kwa sababu sishikilii kampuni yoyote moja. Kusawazisha upya: kila mwaka mwezi Januari, au wakati wowote fedha taslimu inaposhuka chini ya 5% au kupanda juu ya 15%. Masharti ya kuuza: pesa inahitajika kwa kustaafu; mfuko unapandisha malipo yake yanayoendelea juu ya 0.30%; mfuko unafungwa au kuunganishwa. Hukaguliwa kila Januari bila mabadiliko isipokuwa mojawapo ya hayo hapo juu litumike.

c070af460d88.en: Correct — they documented a sign effect: bad news has a greater impact than good news of comparable magnitude.
c070af460d88.sw: Sahihi — waliandika athari ya ishara: habari mbaya ina athari kubwa zaidi kuliko habari njema ya ukubwa unaolingana.

c07ce0ccd146.en: The record shows why these questions are not paranoia. Two regulatory actions against Tether are established fact, stated here neutrally. In February 2021, Tether and its affiliated exchange Bitfinex settled with the New York Attorney General for 18.5 million dollars and were barred from doing business with New York residents; the investigation concerned an unreported loss of about 850 million dollars in commingled funds and statements that every tether was backed 1-to-1 by dollars. The companies admitted no wrongdoing. In October 2021, the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission fined Tether 41 million dollars over its "fully backed" claims — the CFTC's order found that during a 26-month sample period from 2016 to 2018, Tether actually held sufficient fiat reserves for only 27.6 percent of the days.
c07ce0ccd146.sw: Rekodi huonyesha kwa nini maswali haya si wasiwasi wa kupindukia. Hatua mbili za udhibiti dhidi ya Tether ni ukweli uliothibitishwa, ukitajwa hapa bila upande. Mwezi Februari 2021, Tether na soko lake shirika Bitfinex walimaliza kesi na Mwanasheria Mkuu wa New York kwa dola milioni 18.5 na wakazuiwa kufanya biashara na wakazi wa New York; uchunguzi ulihusu hasara isiyoripotiwa ya takriban dola milioni 850 katika fedha zilizochanganywa na kauli kwamba kila tether iliungwa mkono 1-kwa-1 na dola. Kampuni hazikukiri kosa lolote. Mwezi Oktoba 2021, Tume ya Biashara ya Mikataba ya Baadaye ya Bidhaa ya Marekani ilitoza Tether faini ya dola milioni 41 kuhusu madai yake ya "kuungwa mkono kikamilifu" — amri ya CFTC ilibaini kwamba wakati wa kipindi cha sampuli cha miezi 26 kuanzia 2016 hadi 2018, Tether kwa kweli ilishikilia akiba za kutosha za fedha za amri kwa asilimia 27.6 ya siku pekee.

c0a1786d72ae.en: The risk a market maker faces from trading against better-informed counterparties.
c0a1786d72ae.sw: Hatari ambayo mtengeneza-soko anakabiliana nayo kutokana na kufanya biashara dhidi ya wenzake wenye taarifa bora zaidi.

c0b4d1efce8a.en: The price at which you plan to exit if the position moves against you, capping your loss at a known, fixed amount.
c0b4d1efce8a.sw: Bei ambayo kwayo unapanga kutoka kama nafasi itasogea dhidi yako, ikiweka kikomo cha hasara yako kwa kiasi kinachojulikana na thabiti.

c0c825754811.en: Not quite — discipline is following a pre-committed plan so the key decisions are not made live. It is a system, not a calm feeling you have to summon.
c0c825754811.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — nidhamu ni kufuata mpango uliojitolewa mapema ili maamuzi muhimu yasifanywe hai. Ni mfumo, si hisia ya utulivu unayolazimika kuiita.

c0ca2547e45c.en: UST's stability required LUNA to be valuable, while LUNA was valuable largely because it underpinned UST — so confidence was a component of the system rather than a response to it
c0ca2547e45c.sw: Uimara wa UST ulihitaji LUNA iwe na thamani, huku LUNA ikiwa na thamani kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa sababu iliunga mkono UST — kwa hivyo ujasiri ulikuwa kipengele cha mfumo badala ya mwitikio kwake

c0d3e0afe688.en: Before your next interaction with any exchange, run the checklist: Who holds the keys? If an exchange advertises "proof of reserves," does the report say anything about liabilities? On a DEX, what price impact does the interface show for your trade size, and does the token's contract address match the project's official source? Keep only what you are actively trading on an exchange — Lesson 4's custody plan starts from that rule.
c0d3e0afe688.sw: Kabla ya mwingiliano wako ujao na soko lolote la kubadilisha, endesha orodha ya kukagua: Nani anashikilia funguo? Ikiwa soko linatangaza "uthibitisho wa akiba," je, ripoti inasema lolote kuhusu madeni? Katika DEX, ni athari gani ya bei ambayo kiolesura huonyesha kwa ukubwa wa biashara yako, na je, anwani ya mkataba wa tokeni inalingana na chanzo rasmi cha mradi? Weka katika soko la kubadilisha kile tu unachokifanyia biashara kwa bidii — mpango wa utunzaji wa Somo la 4 huanza kutoka kanuni hiyo.

c0db0e76757b.en: The margin level at which the broker forcibly closes positions, below the margin call level.
c0db0e76757b.sw: Kiwango cha margin ambapo broker hufunga nafasi kwa lazima, chini ya kiwango cha wito wa margin.

c0f079b01c4f.en: The index level is then the total float-adjusted market value of the constituents, divided by a number called the divisor. The divisor exists so that mechanical events — a stock split, a company joining or leaving — do not make the index jump when nothing real has happened. S&P Dow Jones Indices publishes both the index-mathematics and float-adjustment methodologies openly, which is worth knowing: the rule is not a secret, and you can read it.
c0f079b01c4f.sw: Kiwango cha index kisha ni thamani ya jumla ya soko iliyorekebishwa kwa float ya washiriki, kugawanywa kwa namba inayoitwa kigawanyaji. Kigawanyaji kipo ili matukio ya kimitambo — kugawanywa kwa hisa, kampuni kujiunga au kuondoka — yasifanye index iruke wakati hakuna kilichotokea halisi. S&P Dow Jones Indices huchapisha mbinu zote za hisabati ya index na marekebisho ya float waziwazi, jambo linalostahili kujulikana: kanuni si siri, na unaweza kuisoma.

c0f1ff2cf713.en: Currency pairs pairing the U.S. dollar with another major currency. These are the most liquid, most widely traded pairs in the market.
c0f1ff2cf713.sw: Jozi za sarafu zinazoweka pamoja dola ya Marekani na sarafu nyingine kuu. Haya ndiyo jozi yenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi na yanayofanyiwa biashara kwa upana zaidi sokoni.

c0fefdc76e92.en: In Cases B and C, pip value is not fixed — it floats with the exchange rate you convert through. As USD/JPY moves, the dollar value of a pip on that pair moves too. This means your dollar risk drifts slightly as rates change, so recompute pip value at the current rate rather than reusing a number from last week. This is a genuine, if small, way that "fixed" risk in forex is never perfectly fixed.
c0fefdc76e92.sw: Katika Kesi B na C, thamani ya pip si thabiti — huelea pamoja na kiwango cha ubadilishaji unachobadilisha kupitia. USD/JPY inaposogea, thamani ya dola ya pip kwenye jozi hilo husogea pia. Hii inamaanisha hatari yako ya dola husogea kidogo viwango vinapobadilika, hivyo kokotoa upya thamani ya pip kwa kiwango cha sasa badala ya kutumia tena namba ya wiki iliyopita. Hii ni njia halisi, ingawa ndogo, ambayo hatari "thabiti" katika forex si thabiti kikamilifu kamwe.

c1106ca6f93f.en: The loss if a trade hits its stop versus the gain if it hits its target (e.g., 1:2).
c1106ca6f93f.sw: Hasara kama biashara itagonga stop yake dhidi ya faida kama itagonga lengo lake (mfano, 1:2).

c11fe320073a.en: Withdraw a small amount from every exchange where you hold funds, today, and note how long each takes to arrive. You are not testing whether you can withdraw your whole balance — you cannot test that without doing it. You are establishing a baseline for normal, so that abnormal is something you can recognise later rather than rationalise.
c11fe320073a.sw: Toa kiasi kidogo kutoka kila soko la kubadilisha ambapo unashikilia fedha, leo, na utambue kila moja huchukua muda gani kufika. Hupimi kama unaweza kutoa salio lako lote — huwezi kupima hilo bila kulifanya. Unaweka msingi wa kawaida, ili isiyo ya kawaida iwe kitu unachoweza kukitambua baadaye badala ya kukihalalisha.

c123e01d5c58.en: The halving is a certain, pre-announced supply schedule; the four-year price cycle built on top of it rests on four events, a window fitted after the fact, and causes that cannot be separated.
c123e01d5c58.sw: Kupunguzwa nusu ni ratiba ya usambazaji yenye uhakika, iliyotangazwa mapema; mzunguko wa bei wa miaka minne uliojengwa juu yake hutegemea matukio manne, dirisha lililowekwa baada ya tukio, na visababishi visivyoweza kutenganishwa.

c125942ebe38.en: Behind both modes sit two exchange mechanisms most people meet only when they are on the wrong end of them. When a position is liquidated, the exchange tries to close it in the market. If the fill is worse than the bankruptcy price, which is the price at which the position's margin is exactly exhausted, the position has produced a loss with no capital behind it, and someone has to absorb it. The venue's insurance fund is the first line: a reserve built up from liquidations that closed better than their bankruptcy price, used to cover the ones that close worse. When the insurance fund cannot cover the shortfall, exchanges use auto-deleveraging.
c125942ebe38.sw: Nyuma ya hali zote mbili hukaa taratibu mbili za soko la kubadilisha ambazo watu wengi hukutana nazo tu wanapokuwa upande usio sahihi wake. Nafasi inapofilisiwa, soko la kubadilisha hujaribu kuifunga sokoni. Ikiwa ujazwaji ni mbaya kuliko bei ya kufilisika, ambayo ni bei ambapo mkopo wa nafasi umeisha hasa, nafasi imezalisha hasara isiyo na mtaji nyuma yake, na mtu lazima aifyonze. Mfuko wa bima wa uwanja ndiyo mstari wa kwanza: akiba iliyojengwa kutoka ufilisi uliofungwa vizuri kuliko bei yao ya kufilisika, unaotumika kufunika ule unaofungwa vibaya zaidi. Mfuko wa bima usipoweza kufunika upungufu, masoko ya kubadilisha hutumia kupunguza mzingo kiotomatiki.

c138a4dca350.en: The first currency in a pair — the one being measured as "1."
c138a4dca350.sw: Sarafu ya kwanza katika jozi — ile inayopimwa kama "1."

c13da41acf61.en: The number of shares the company has issued. Earnings per share, book value per share and dividends per share are all divided by it.
c13da41acf61.sw: Idadi ya hisa ambazo kampuni imezitoa. Mapato kwa kila hisa, thamani ya kitabu kwa kila hisa na gawio kwa kila hisa vyote hugawanywa kwayo.

c14ebc54c989.en: A stablecoin with no reserve, whose peg depends on a swap loop with a sister token.
c14ebc54c989.sw: Sarafu imara isiyo na akiba, ambayo pegi yake hutegemea kitanzi cha ubadilishaji na tokeni dada.

c15500b506fe.en: A naked-chart trade reads like this. On the 4-hour EUR/USD chart, price has twice reversed upward near 1.0975 — that is support. Price falls to it a third time and forms a bullish reversal candle. A price-action trader enters long at 1.1005 with a stop just below the level at 1.0975 — a distance of 30 pips (1.1005 − 1.0975 = 0.0030). No indicator was used; the decision came from the level and the candle alone. Whether that decision has an edge is the question the evidence has to answer.
c15500b506fe.sw: Biashara ya chati tupu husomeka hivi. Kwenye chati ya EUR/USD ya saa 4, bei imegeuka juu mara mbili karibu na 1.0975 — huo ni msaada. Bei inashuka kwake mara ya tatu na kuunda mshumaa wa mgeuko wa kupanda. Mfanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei anaingia long kwa 1.1005 akiwa na stop chini kidogo ya kiwango kwa 1.0975 — umbali wa pip 30 (1.1005 − 1.0975 = 0.0030). Hakuna kiashiria kilichotumika; uamuzi ulitoka kwenye kiwango na mshumaa peke yake. Kama uamuzi huo una faida ndilo swali ambalo ushahidi lazima ulijibu.

c1682dec2315.en: The most heavily traded currencies globally (USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, AUD, CAD, CHF).
c1682dec2315.sw: Sarafu zinazofanyiwa biashara kwa wingi zaidi duniani (USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, AUD, CAD, CHF).

c18647723535.en: There is even evidence that conviction, defined properly, pays. Anton, Cohen and Polk, in their study "Best Ideas," found that the single stocks in which professional managers show the most ex-ante conviction outperform both the market and the managers' own other holdings by roughly 2.8 to 4.5% per year — while the rest of what those managers hold does not beat the market at all. The lesson is not "be confident." It is that a manager's best-analysed idea, the one where the case is strongest, is where the edge lives — and the six pillars are how you find which idea that is.
c18647723535.sw: Kuna hata ushahidi kwamba uhakika, ukifafanuliwa ipasavyo, hulipa. Anton, Cohen na Polk, katika utafiti wao "Best Ideas," waligundua kwamba hisa moja moja ambazo wasimamizi wa kitaaluma huonyesha uhakika mkubwa zaidi mapema hufanya vizuri kuliko soko na kuliko umiliki mwingine wa wasimamizi wenyewe kwa takriban 2.8 hadi 4.5% kwa mwaka — ilhali kilichobaki wanachoshikilia wasimamizi hao hakishindi soko kabisa. Fundisho si "jiamini." Ni kwamba wazo lililochambuliwa vizuri zaidi la msimamizi, lile ambalo hoja yake ni imara zaidi, ndipo faida inapoishi — na nguzo sita ndio jinsi unavyopata ni wazo lipi hilo.

c18ba6e0723e.en: Steinert and Herff (2018), in PLOS ONE, went further and reported that short-term altcoin returns could be predicted from Twitter activity and sentiment across 181 altcoins. Treat that as suggestive rather than as a tool. The samples in this literature are short, the platforms have changed enormously since, and social data has a specific contamination problem.
c18ba6e0723e.sw: Steinert na Herff (2018), katika PLOS ONE, walikwenda mbali zaidi na wakaripoti kwamba faida za muda mfupi za altcoin zingeweza kutabiriwa kutoka shughuli na hisia za Twitter katika altcoin 181. Chukulia hiyo kama ya kudokeza badala ya kama zana. Sampuli katika fasihi hii ni fupi, majukwaa yamebadilika kwa kiasi kikubwa tangu wakati huo, na data ya kijamii ina tatizo maalum la kuchafuliwa.

c1a37ff64a49.en: Correct. Carry is meant to be a return that does not require the market to agree with you. More units of something worth less is not that, and if the units come from new issuance rather than from fees users actually pay, your proportional ownership may not have risen at all. The test is which activity funds the reward.
c1a37ff64a49.sw: Sahihi. Kubeba kunakusudiwa kuwa faida isiyohitaji soko likubaliane nawe. Vipimo zaidi vya kitu chenye thamani ndogo zaidi si hivyo, na ikiwa vipimo hutoka utoaji mpya badala ya ada ambazo watumiaji hulipa hasa, umiliki wako wa uwiano huenda haukupanda kabisa. Mtihani ni ni shughuli ipi inayofadhili zawadi.

c1acf4e456e7.sw: Zana kuu ya sera ya benki kuu — kwa hakika bei ya pesa.

c1b00bd3240e.en: Evans and Archer, in the Journal of Finance in 1968 (volume 23, pages 761 to 767), found that the reduction in variability flattened out quickly — around ten stocks captured most of the available benefit. That produced the rule of thumb, still widely repeated, that eight to ten holdings is enough.
c1b00bd3240e.sw: Evans na Archer, katika Journal of Finance mwaka 1968 (juzuu 23, kurasa 761 hadi 767), waligundua kwamba kupungua kwa kutofautiana kulisawazika kwa haraka — takriban hisa kumi zilinasa sehemu kubwa ya manufaa yanayopatikana. Hilo lilizalisha kanuni ya kidole gumba, bado inayorudiwa kwa upana, kwamba umiliki nane hadi kumi unatosha.

c1c06b5c653b.sw: Akaunti ya dola 2,000, kwa sababu leverage yake halisi (25:1) iko juu zaidi mno

c1c5442c3af2.sw: Limethibitishwa, kwa sababu mnyororo wa vitalu ni rekodi ya umma na sahihi

c1c553d2da52.sw: Sahihi — hili ndilo tokeo sahihi na lenye upambanuzi: ishara halisi, si uhakika wa faida.

c1cd2f2c1d53.en: An authorised participant can do something you cannot. It can deliver the underlying basket of shares to the fund and receive newly created ETF shares in return, or hand back a block of ETF shares and receive the underlying basket. The US Securities and Exchange Commission describes this creation and redemption process in its investor bulletin on ETFs, and it is the structural feature that makes the whole thing work.
c1cd2f2c1d53.sw: Mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa anaweza kufanya kitu ambacho huwezi. Anaweza kuwasilisha kikapu cha msingi cha hisa kwa fund na kupokea hisa mpya za ETF zilizoundwa badala yake, au kurudisha kifurushi cha hisa za ETF na kupokea kikapu cha msingi. Tume ya Usalama na Ubadilishaji ya Marekani inaelezea mchakato huu wa kuunda na kukomboa katika taarifa yake kwa wawekezaji kuhusu ETF, na ni sifa ya kimuundo inayofanya kila kitu kifanye kazi.

c1cd701b6964.en: The assumptions are obviously not the real world, and that is the point of the result rather than a flaw in it. It tells you where to look. If dividend policy matters in practice, it must matter because of one of the things the model assumed away: tax, costs, or what the payment reveals about management's intentions. It is not because cash paid out is inherently superior to value retained.
c1cd701b6964.sw: Dhana wazi si dunia halisi, na hiyo ndiyo pointi ya tokeo badala ya udhaifu ndani yake. Hukuambia mahali pa kutazama. Kama sera ya gawio inahusika kivitendo, lazima ihusike kwa sababu ya mojawapo ya vitu ambavyo muundo uliviondoa: kodi, gharama, au kile ambacho malipo hufichua kuhusu nia za usimamizi. Si kwa sababu fedha zilizolipwa nje ni bora kimsingi kuliko thamani iliyohifadhiwa.

c212a501e94e.en: Now here is the honest part, and it runs through the rest of the lesson. The ledger records addresses moving amounts. It does not record people, intentions, ownership, or reasons. Everything a headline on-chain metric claims about people is added afterwards by an analyst, using assumptions. The raw data is precise. The interpretation is not.
c212a501e94e.sw: Sasa hii hapa sehemu ya kweli, nayo hupitia somo lililobaki. Leja huandika anwani zikisogeza viasi. Haiandiki watu, nia, umiliki, wala sababu. Kila kitu ambacho kipimo cha kichwa cha habari cha kwenye mnyororo hudai kuhusu watu huongezwa baadaye na mchambuzi, akitumia dhana. Data ghafi ni sahihi. Tafsiri si sahihi.

c21315bfc879.en: Chapter 1 Lesson 7 distinguished a stablecoin backed by reserves from one held to its peg by an algorithm and a second token. It ended by noting that the algorithmic design has a specific failure mode, and promised the case study. This is it.
c21315bfc879.sw: Sura ya 1 Somo la 7 lilitofautisha sarafu imara inayoungwa mkono na akiba na ile inayoshikiliwa kwenye pegi yake na algoriti na tokeni ya pili. Lilimalizika kwa kubainisha kwamba muundo wa kialgoriti una namna maalum ya kushindwa, na kuahidi uchunguzi wa tukio. Huu hapa.

c22510efbdac.en: Why does crypto typically fall further than equities when a central bank signals tighter policy?
c22510efbdac.sw: Kwa nini kripto kwa kawaida hushuka zaidi ya hisa wakati benki kuu inapoashiria sera kali zaidi?

c23a453d0ca9.en: The slogan is pointing at something real. An exchange balance is not coins on the ledger under your key — it is the exchange's promise to pay you, an IOU on the exchange's internal books, exactly like the bank ledger from Lesson 1. If the exchange fails, the promise fails with it. This has happened at scale. In February 2014, Mt. Gox — then the largest bitcoin exchange — collapsed with roughly 850,000 bitcoins missing, about 750,000 of them belonging to customers (around 200,000 were later found). In November 2022, the exchange FTX failed with an estimated 8 billion dollars of customer funds missing. One sentence each is all they get here, because Chapter 5 takes both apart as full case studies. For now, the point stands: counterparty risk in crypto custody is not hypothetical.
c23a453d0ca9.sw: Kauli hiyo inaelekeza kwa kitu halisi. Salio la soko la kubadilisha si sarafu kwenye leja chini ya ufunguo wako — ni ahadi ya soko ya kukulipa, deni katika vitabu vya ndani vya soko, hasa kama leja ya benki kutoka Somo la 1. Ikiwa soko litashindwa, ahadi hushindwa nalo. Hili limetokea kwa kiwango kikubwa. Mwezi Februari 2014, Mt. Gox — wakati huo soko kubwa zaidi la bitcoin — lilianguka na takriban bitcoin 850,000 zikikosekana, takriban 750,000 kati yake zikiwa za wateja (takriban 200,000 zilipatikana baadaye). Mwezi Novemba 2022, soko la FTX lilishindwa na makadirio ya dola bilioni 8 za fedha za wateja zikikosekana. Sentensi moja kila moja ndiyo yote wanayopata hapa, kwa sababu Sura ya 5 huyachambua yote mawili kama uchunguzi kamili wa matukio. Kwa sasa, jambo linasimama: hatari ya mshirika katika utunzaji wa kripto si ya kudhania.

c23b46e36aaa.en: The canonical AMM design comes from Uniswap, and its pricing rule fits in one line. Take the two reserves in the pool — call them x and y — and multiply them. Every trade must leave that product, k, unchanged. This is the constant-product formula, described in the Uniswap v2 whitepaper (Adams, Zinsmeister and Robinson, March 2020) and analysed formally in a 2019 paper by Angeris, Kao, Chiang, Noyes and Chitra, which showed that under ordinary conditions arbitrage traders keep the pool's price tracking the wider market.
c23b46e36aaa.sw: Muundo wa kawaida wa AMM hutoka Uniswap, na kanuni yake ya bei hutosha katika mstari mmoja. Chukua akiba mbili katika bwawa — ziite x na y — na uzizidishe. Kila biashara lazima iache bidhaa hiyo, k, bila kubadilika. Hii ni fomula ya bidhaa-isiyobadilika, iliyoelezwa katika karatasi nyeupe ya Uniswap v2 (Adams, Zinsmeister na Robinson, Machi 2020) na kuchambuliwa rasmi katika karatasi ya 2019 ya Angeris, Kao, Chiang, Noyes na Chitra, iliyoonyesha kwamba chini ya hali za kawaida wafanyabiashara wa arbitraji huweka bei ya bwawa ikifuatilia soko pana.

c2414801724f.en: A false crossover signal in a sideways market producing a quick small loss.
c2414801724f.sw: Ishara ya uongo ya mkatizo katika soko la kando inayozalisha hasara ndogo ya haraka.

c2481f48aa87.en: Three studies, three numbers: roughly 95%, roughly 77.5%, roughly 51%. They used different methods, different years and different sets of exchanges, so they are not directly comparable and should not be averaged into a single tidy figure. What they agree on is the direction and the order of magnitude: on unregulated venues, a large fraction of reported volume is not real, and the honest range is most of it rather than a bit of it.
c2481f48aa87.sw: Tafiti tatu, namba tatu: takriban 95%, takriban 77.5%, takriban 51%. Zilitumia mbinu tofauti, miaka tofauti na seti tofauti za masoko ya kubadilisha, kwa hivyo hazilinganishiki moja kwa moja na hazipaswi kuchukuliwa wastani kuwa takwimu moja nadhifu. Zinachokubaliana ni mwelekeo na daraja la ukubwa: katika viwanja visivyodhibitiwa, sehemu kubwa ya ujazo unaoripotiwa si halisi, na kiwango cha kweli ni sehemu kubwa yake badala ya kidogo chake.

c25b8ff52297.sw: Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni ishara ya onyo iliyo wazi zaidi ya ulaghai badala ya hatari ya kawaida ya biashara?

c268394c5660.en: True or False: if your daily chart shows a downtrend but the 15-minute shows an uptrend, the correct move is to take the long trade because the shorter timeframe is more current.

c269267f8498.en: The second investor did not sell. That is the point worth sitting with. They simply stopped buying, which felt like caution rather than a transaction, and it cost them the best purchase prices in a decade. A pause in contributions is a decision with the same consequences as a sale of the amount you would have bought — it just does not feel like one, because nothing appears on the statement.

Aliacha tu kununua, jambo lililohisi kama tahadhari badala ya muamala, nalo lilimgharimu bei bora zaidi za ununuzi katika muongo mmoja. Kusimamisha michango ni uamuzi wenye matokeo sawa na kuuza kiasi ambacho ungenunua — ila tu haihisi hivyo, kwa sababu hakuna kinachoonekana kwenye taarifa.

c269f104ff2d.en: The two explanations make different predictions about what happens after a finding is published and becomes famous. If value pays for risk, publishing changes nothing. If value is a behavioural error, publishing should reduce it as money flows in to exploit it. Decades on, the argument about which happened is still live.
c269f104ff2d.sw: Maelezo hayo mawili hufanya utabiri tofauti kuhusu kinachotokea baada ya tokeo kuchapishwa na kuwa maarufu. Kama thamani hulipa kwa hatari, kuchapisha hakubadilishi chochote. Kama thamani ni kosa la kitabia, kuchapisha kunapaswa kuipunguza pesa zinapotiririka kuitumia. Miongo baadaye, mabishano kuhusu ni lipi lililotokea bado ni hai.

c274de2de9d8.en: One block added to the chain at or after the block containing your transaction. A transaction "with 3 confirmations" is in a block that has two more blocks built on top of it. Each confirmation buries the transaction deeper.

c294f152c6d0.en: An instruction to buy or sell immediately at the best available current price. Guarantees execution. Does not guarantee price.

c2b585f463b1.en: Write down what you contributed, or withdrew, in each of the last three years. Then write what you would do if the market fell 40% next month and stayed down for three years. If your answer involves reducing contributions, note that this is the decision the second investor in this lesson made, and it cost them the cheapest prices of the decade.
c2b585f463b1.sw: Andika ulichochangia, au ulichotoa, katika kila mwaka kati ya miaka mitatu iliyopita. Kisha andika ungefanya nini ikiwa soko lingeshuka 40% mwezi ujao na kubaki chini kwa miaka mitatu. Ikiwa jibu lako linahusisha kupunguza michango, tambua kwamba huu ndio uamuzi ambao mwekezaji wa pili katika somo hili aliufanya, nao ulimgharimu bei nafuu zaidi za muongo huo.

c2c2098b1150.en: Put it into practice before using leverage: calculate your actual required margin and confirm your account can absorb realistic adverse moves without a margin call. Remember that leverage changes how much capital you need to open a position — it does not by itself determine how much you're risking; position sizing and stop-loss placement are what actually control that. And treat "maximum available leverage" marketing claims with real skepticism, since regulators cap leverage precisely because higher leverage is associated with worse trader outcomes, not better ones.
c2c2098b1150.sw: Iweke katika vitendo kabla ya kutumia leverage: kokotoa margin yako halisi inayohitajika na uthibitishe kwamba akaunti yako inaweza kufyonza misogeo mibaya halisi bila wito wa margin. Kumbuka kwamba leverage hubadilisha kiasi cha mtaji unaohitaji kufungua nafasi — haiamui yenyewe kiasi unachohatarisha; upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi na uwekaji wa stop-loss ndivyo vinavyodhibiti hilo hasa. Na chukulia madai ya matangazo ya "leverage ya juu zaidi inayopatikana" kwa shaka halisi, kwa kuwa wadhibiti huweka kikomo cha leverage hasa kwa sababu leverage kubwa zaidi inahusishwa na matokeo mabaya zaidi ya wafanyabiashara, si bora zaidi.

c2ceb96f1893.en: That is four supportive pillars, one neutral, one against, and a dated catalyst. It is a genuine thesis. Note that momentum disagrees, which the previous section said to expect: cheap shares are usually cheap because they have been falling, and the two pillars are negatively correlated by construction.

c2e11f026fb0.en: Correct. The claim on profits is identical, so the two classes rise and fall broadly together. What differs is control, and control was never realistic for a small holder anyway. c3161f3733a2.en: The first is that prices reflect information. The second is that prices are correct. Efficiency in the technical sense means the first, not the second. A market can absorb every available fact promptly and still be wrong about the future, because the future is not currently available information. The dot-com case study in Chapter 5 is a market that priced known facts efficiently and valued them on a story that did not hold.
c3161f3733a2.sw: La kwanza ni kwamba bei huakisi taarifa. La pili ni kwamba bei ni sahihi. Ufanisi kwa maana ya kiufundi humaanisha la kwanza, si la pili. Soko linaweza kufyonza kila ukweli unaopatikana kwa haraka na bado likakosea kuhusu ya baadaye, kwa sababu ya baadaye si taarifa inayopatikana sasa. Uchunguzi wa dot-com katika Sura ya 5 ni soko lililoweka bei ya ukweli unaojulikana kwa ufanisi na kuithamini juu ya simulizi isiyoshikilia.

c3258d8fb2d6.en: Take any share with a yield above 6%. Find its payout ratio and its dividend history over the last five years. Then write one sentence explaining why the market is pricing that yield so high. If the honest sentence is that the market expects the payment to be cut, you have learned what the yield was actually telling you.
c3258d8fb2d6.sw: Chukua hisa yoyote yenye mavuno juu ya 6%. Pata uwiano wake wa malipo na historia yake ya gawio katika miaka mitano iliyopita. Kisha andika sentensi moja ikieleza kwa nini soko linaweka bei ya mavuno hayo juu hivyo. Kama sentensi ya uaminifu ni kwamba soko linatarajia malipo yatapunguzwa, umejifunza mavuno yalikuwa yakikuambia nini hasa.

c348e056a0b7.en: A holder with two assets, one hardware wallet and one exchange account can review everything in twenty minutes and will notice if something is wrong. A holder with fifteen tokens across four chains, six protocols, three wallets and two exchanges cannot, and in practice does not. The second holder is not more sophisticated. They have taken on an operational load that grows while their attention does not, and Chapter 3 Lesson 2 showed that custody failures come from exactly that gap.
c348e056a0b7.sw: Mmiliki mwenye rasilimali mbili, pochi moja ya maunzi na akaunti moja ya soko la kubadilisha anaweza kukagua kila kitu katika dakika ishirini naye atatambua ikiwa kitu ni kibaya. Mmiliki mwenye tokeni kumi na tano katika minyororo minne, itifaki sita, pochi tatu na masoko mawili ya kubadilisha hawezi, na kivitendo hafanyi. Mmiliki wa pili si mwenye ustadi zaidi. Amechukua mzigo wa kiuendeshaji unaokua huku uangalifu wake haukui, na Sura ya 3 Somo la 2 lilionyesha kwamba kushindwa kwa utunzaji hutoka pengo hilo hasa.

FTX failed at a venue widely regarded as the responsible one — regulated-adjacent, institutionally backed, and run by a founder who was a fixture of financial media. That difference is the entire reason this case study exists.

FTX ilishindwa katika uwanja uliozingatiwa sana kuwa unaowajibika — karibu na udhibiti, uliopewa msaada wa kitaasisi, na ulioendeshwa na mwanzilishi aliyekuwa kipengele cha kudumu cha vyombo vya habari vya kifedha. Tofauti hiyo ndiyo sababu nzima ya uchunguzi huu wa tukio kuwepo.

Michango iliyopangwa si nafasi iliyochukuliwa juu ya utawala, na kuisimamisha kwa sababu hali zinaonekana mbaya ni kosa ambalo Sura ya 4 Somo la 1 lilikuandika — viingilio vya rejareja vikikusanyika baada ya kupanda, ambayo ni tabia ileile ikionekana kutoka upande mwingine.

c4746ae21615.en:
On 7 May 2022, two large addresses withdrew 375 million UST from Anchor, and UST traded below one dollar that evening.
The redemption mechanism worked as designed: UST was exchanged for newly minted LUNA, which was sold.
That selling drove LUNA down, which meant each UST redemption required minting more LUNA, which drove it down further.
By 13 May 2022 LUNA had gone from about 87 dollars on 5 May to below 0.00005 dollars, and UST was trading around 20 cents.
Roughly 60 billion dollars of value was gone inside a week.
c4746ae21615.sw:
Tarehe 7 Mei 2022, anwani mbili kubwa zilitoa UST milioni 375 kutoka Anchor, na UST ilifanyiwa biashara chini ya dola moja jioni hiyo.
Utaratibu wa ukombozi ulifanya kazi kama ulivyoundwa: UST ilibadilishwa kwa LUNA iliyotengenezwa upya, ambayo iliuzwa.
Uuzaji huo uliendesha LUNA chini, jambo lililomaanisha kila ukombozi wa UST ulihitaji kutengeneza LUNA zaidi, jambo lililoiendesha chini zaidi.
Kufikia 13 Mei 2022 LUNA ilikuwa imetoka takriban dola 87 tarehe 5 Mei hadi chini ya dola 0.00005, na UST ilikuwa ikifanyiwa biashara karibu na senti 20.
Takriban dola bilioni 60 za thamani ziliondoka ndani ya wiki moja.

c4778858d2b7.en: A calculation derived entirely from an instrument's price history and/or trading volume, plotted on or below a chart. It uses nothing else: no news, no economic data, no opinion — only the chart in front of you.
c4778858d2b7.sw: Hesabu inayotokana kabisa na historia ya bei ya chombo na/au kiasi cha biashara, ikichorwa juu au chini ya chati. Haitumii kitu kingine chochote: hakuna habari, hakuna data ya kiuchumi, hakuna maoni — chati iliyo mbele yako tu.

c486fad8a74f.en: Tether has since published quarterly attestations showing reserves held mostly in short-term US Treasury debt, and its tokens have kept their peg through several market crises. Both parts of that sentence are true. The lesson is not "Tether is doomed" or "Tether is fine" — it is that the "backed" claim had to be forced into the open by regulators, and that you should read reserve reports yourself rather than trust the word "backed." None of this is new in monetary history: economists Gary Gorton and Jeffery Zhang, in a widely cited 2021 paper, "Taming Wildcat Stablecoins," compare stablecoins to the private banknotes of the 19th-century US Free Banking Era — privately issued money that did not always trade at face value and was periodically hit by runs. A stablecoin run is the bank run you met in Foundations, on faster rails.
c486fad8a74f.sw: Tether tangu wakati huo imechapisha ushuhuda wa kila robo ukionyesha akiba zilizoshikiliwa hasa katika deni la muda mfupi la Hazina ya Marekani, na tokeni zake zimeshikilia pegi yake kupitia migogoro kadhaa ya soko. Sehemu zote mbili za sentensi hiyo ni kweli. Somo si "Tether imeangamia" wala "Tether iko sawa" — ni kwamba dai la "kuungwa mkono" lililazimika kulazimishwa hadharani na wadhibiti, na kwamba unapaswa kusoma ripoti za akiba mwenyewe badala ya kuamini neno "inaungwa mkono." Hakuna kati ya haya ni kipya katika historia ya fedha: wachumi Gary Gorton na Jeffery Zhang, katika karatasi yao ya 2021 inayonukuliwa sana, "Taming Wildcat Stablecoins," hulinganisha sarafu imara na noti binafsi za benki za Enzi ya Benki Huria ya Marekani ya karne ya 19 — pesa iliyotolewa kibinafsi ambayo haikufanyiwa biashara daima kwa thamani yake ya uso na ilipigwa mara kwa mara na mikimbio. Mkimbio wa sarafu imara ni mkimbio wa benki uliokutana nao katika Misingi, katika reli za haraka zaidi.

c499c5711096.en: The tendency to sell winning positions too early, to lock in a sure gain, while holding losing positions too long, hoping they recover. The term was coined by Shefrin and Statman (1985).

c4c00e9b7859.en: One more metric is worth naming because it appears constantly in cycle commentary. Realized capitalization values every coin not at today's price but at the price it last moved at on-chain, then adds those values together. It is a rough estimate of what the market collectively paid for its coins. The idea was introduced in 2018 by Nic Carter and Antoine Le Calvez, and Coin Metrics publishes it as one of its flagship metrics. Its original purpose was modest and sensible: to stop coins that have not moved since 2010, and are probably lost forever, from being valued at today's price.
c4c00e9b7859.sw: Kipimo kimoja zaidi kinastahili kutajwa kwa sababu hujitokeza mara kwa mara katika maoni ya mzunguko. Kiasi cha soko kilichotimizwa hutathmini kila sarafu si kwa bei ya leo bali kwa bei iliyosogea nayo mwisho kwenye mnyororo, kisha huongeza thamani hizo pamoja. Ni makadirio mabaya ya kile ambacho soko kwa pamoja lililipa kwa sarafu zake. Wazo lilianzishwa mwaka 2018 na Nic Carter na Antoine Le Calvez, na Coin Metrics huichapisha kama mojawapo ya vipimo vyake vikuu. Madhumuni yake ya awali yalikuwa ya wastani na yenye maana: kuzuia sarafu ambazo hazijasogea tangu 2010, na pengine zimepotea milele, zisitathminiwe kwa bei ya leo.

c4ca37c98554.en: What to look for, given all three. Ask what proportion of your crypto could be destroyed by a single institution failing overnight, and answer as a number. c4cf4a455967.en: The deep book. Bids are resting in size close to the price: 40,000 tokens wanted at 9.99, another 40,000 at 9.98, another 40,000 at 9.97, another 40,000 at 9.96. That is 1,596,000 dollars of buying interest within 0.4% of the last price. Your sell order fills 40,000 at 9.99 for 399,600 dollars, 40,000 at 9.98 for 399,200 dollars, and 20,000 at 9.97 for 199,400 dollars. You receive 998,200 dollars and your average fill price is 9.9820. At 10.00 dollars you would have received 1,000,000 dollars, so the trade cost you 1,800 dollars, or 0.18%. The new last price is 9.97, down 0.30%. Market cap is now 199,400,000 dollars.
c4cf4a455967.sw: Kitabu chenye kina. Zabuni zimepumzika kwa ukubwa karibu na bei: tokeni 40,000 zinatakiwa katika 9.99, nyingine 40,000 katika 9.98, nyingine 40,000 katika 9.97, nyingine 40,000 katika 9.96. Hiyo ni dola 1,596,000 za nia ya kununua ndani ya 0.4% ya bei ya mwisho. Agizo lako la kuuza hujaza 40,000 katika 9.99 kwa dola 399,600, 40,000 katika 9.98 kwa dola 399,200, na 20,000 katika 9.97 kwa dola 199,400. Unapokea dola 998,200 na bei yako ya wastani ya ujazwaji ni 9.9820. Katika dola 10.00 ungepokea dola 1,000,000, kwa hivyo biashara ilikugharimu dola 1,800, au 0.18%. Bei mpya ya mwisho ni 9.97, chini kwa 0.30%. Kiasi cha soko sasa ni dola 199,400,000.

c7756dc836c0.en: Calendar year 2022 returns, from close to close: the S&P 500 fell about 19.4%; the Nasdaq Composite fell about 33.1%; Bitcoin fell about 64%, from roughly 46,300 dollars to roughly 16,500 dollars; and Ether fell roughly 67% to 68%, from roughly 3,700 dollars to roughly 1,200 dollars. Bitcoin's calendar-year fall was roughly 1.9 times the Nasdaq's and roughly 3.3 times the S&P 500's. Sources differ by one or two percentage points on the crypto figures depending on which exchange price feed and which cut-off time they use, so treat these as close ranges rather than exact constants. Measured peak to trough instead of calendar year, the gap is wider. The Nasdaq Composite fell about 36.4% from its record close of 16,057.44 on 19 November 2021 to its cycle closing low of 10,213.29 on 28 December 2022. Bitcoin fell about 77% to 78% from roughly 69,000 dollars in November 2021 to roughly 15,500 dollars on 21 November 2022.

c832b6579b3b.en: A European roulette wheel has 37 pockets. A bet on a single number pays 35 to 1. Multiply the outcomes by their probabilities and the expected value of every unit staked is about 0.973 units returned — a loss of 2.7% per spin, on average, forever. Nothing about the player changes that figure. It is a property of the wheel.
c832b6579b3b.sw: Gurudumu la roulette la Ulaya lina mifuko 37. Dau juu ya namba moja hulipa 35 kwa 1. Hakuna kuhusu mchezaji kinachobadilisha takwimu hiyo. Ni sifa ya gurudumu.

c8a6901f6a79.en: Before taking a price-action trade, check: is the level a genuine round number or repeatedly-tested price, where orders actually cluster — or a line you drew after the fact to fit what already happened? Are you treating support or resistance as raising the odds of a reversal, not as a guarantee? For a candlestick pattern, ask what happens to its edge if you change the exit rule, and be skeptical if it's fragile to that. And have you set your stop and size for the case where the level simply breaks — including a violent gap that no chart could have flagged?

c8a8ba4d2546.en: One correction worth making carefully: China's currency is officially called the renminbi (RMB), meaning "the people's currency" — the yuan is the base unit of the renminbi, the same relationship as "sterling" and "pound" in the UK. The ISO code CNY refers specifically to the yuan unit. In practice, "yuan" and "renminbi" are used almost interchangeably in everyday conversation, but the formal distinction is: renminbi is the currency, yuan is the unit it's counted in.
c8a8ba4d2546.sw: Marekebisho moja yanayostahili kufanywa kwa makini: sarafu ya China rasmi inaitwa renminbi (RMB), ikimaanisha "sarafu ya watu" — yuan ni kipimo cha msingi cha renminbi, uhusiano ule ule wa "sterling" na "pound" nchini Uingereza. Msimbo wa ISO CNY unarejelea mahususi kipimo cha yuan. Kivitendo, "yuan" na "renminbi" hutumiwa karibu kwa kubadilishana katika mazungumzo ya kila siku, lakini tofauti rasmi ni: renminbi ni sarafu, yuan ni kipimo kinachohesabiwa kwacho.

c8bf6ff742ff.en: The peer-reviewed evidence is unusually clear here. Morillon and Chacon (2022), in Studies in Economics and Finance, volume 39 issue 3, built a version of the stock-to-flow model free of look-ahead bias and tested trading on it. A strategy that went long when the model said Bitcoin was undervalued and short when it said overvalued was far less profitable than simply buying and holding. Shelton (2024), in the Journal of Risk and Financial Management, volume 17 issue 10, article 443, tested stock-to-flow alongside Metcalfe's Law, technical analysis and market sentiment. Stock-to-flow helped explain Bitcoin's returns in-sample but had limited to no ability to predict returns out-of-sample.
c8bf6ff742ff.sw: Ushahidi uliopitiwa na wenzao ni wazi isivyo kawaida hapa. Morillon na Chacon (2022), katika Studies in Economics and Finance, juzuu 39 toleo la 3, walijenga toleo la mfano wa hisa-kwa-mtiririko lisilo na upendeleo wa kuangalia mbele na wakapima kufanya biashara juu yake. Mkakati uliokwenda mrefu wakati mfano uliposema Bitcoin ilikuwa chini ya thamani na mfupi uliposema ilikuwa juu ya thamani ulikuwa na faida ndogo zaidi kuliko kununua tu na kushikilia. Shelton (2024), katika Journal of Risk and Financial Management, juzuu 17 toleo la 10, makala 443, alipima hisa-kwa-mtiririko sambamba na Sheria ya Metcalfe, uchambuzi wa kiufundi na hisia za soko. Hisa-kwa-mtiririko ilisaidia kueleza faida za Bitcoin ndani ya sampuli lakini ilikuwa na uwezo mdogo hadi hakuna wa kutabiri faida nje ya sampuli.

c8fde828e288.en: Put those three findings together and the honest summary is this: the relationship between this index and future returns is unstable across samples, frequencies and periods. That is precisely the condition under which a fixed rule such as "extreme fear means buy" cannot be trusted. The contrarian rule is repeated constantly in crypto media. Searching for evidence behind it turns up confident blog claims of large outperformance with no methodology attached, alongside peer-reviewed work that contradicts them. Weak evidence, loudly repeated, is the exact pattern this course teaches you to distrust.

c95db9d6f0c8.en: Here's the honest problem, and it's a big one: financial prices do not actually follow a bell curve. This isn't a technicality — it's one of the most important findings in the history of finance. Benoit Mandelbrot demonstrated it in 1963 ("The Variation of Certain Speculative Prices," Journal of Business 36, 394–419): real price changes have fat tails — extreme moves occur far, far more often than the normal distribution predicts. Moves the bell curve calls once-in-thousands-of-years events happen every few years. You've already met the perfect example: the 2015 EUR/CHF collapse from Chapter 1, Lesson 7 — a move so far outside the bands that the clean "95% containment" math becomes meaningless. Practical consequence: price will pierce your bands more often than the statistics imply, sometimes violently. Bollinger Bands remain a genuinely useful volatility-adaptive tool — but never size a position as if the 95% figure were literally true.
c95db9d6f0c8.sw: Hili hapa tatizo la uaminifu, na ni kubwa: bei za kifedha kwa kweli hazifuati mkunjo wa kengele. Hii si suala la kiufundi — ni mojawapo ya matokeo muhimu zaidi katika historia ya fedha. Benoit Mandelbrot alilionyesha mwaka 1963 ("The Variation of Certain Speculative Prices," Journal of Business 36, 394–419): mabadiliko halisi ya bei yana mikia minene — misogeo ya kupindukia hutokea mara nyingi zaidi, zaidi sana, kuliko mtawanyiko wa kawaida unavyotabiri. Misogeo ambayo mkunjo wa kengele huiita matukio ya mara moja katika maelfu ya miaka hutokea kila baada ya miaka michache. Tayari umekutana na mfano kamili: kuanguka kwa EUR/CHF kwa mwaka 2015 kutoka Sura ya 1, Somo la 7 — msogeo ulio nje mno ya kanda kiasi kwamba hisabati safi ya "kubeba 95%" inakuwa isiyo na maana. Matokeo ya kivitendo: bei itapenya kanda zako mara nyingi zaidi kuliko takwimu zinavyodokeza, wakati mwingine kwa nguvu. Bollinger Bands zinabaki zana yenye manufaa kweli inayojirekebisha kwa mtikisiko — lakini kamwe usipime nafasi kana kwamba takwimu ya 95% ni kweli kihalisi.

c9fd7bd087a7.en: An IMF working paper from August 2023 — WP/23/163, "The Crypto Cycle and US Monetary Policy" by Natasha Che, Alexander Copestake, Davide Furceri and Tammaro Terracciano — put a number on the sensitivity. The authors extract a single common price component, which they call the crypto factor, that explains about 80% of the variation in crypto prices. They then measure what United States monetary tightening does to it. The crypto factor falls by about 0.15 standard deviations after a tightening shock, while the equity factor falls by about 0.1 standard deviations. Crypto did not sit outside the monetary cycle. It responded to it more strongly than equities did — which is what high-beta means in practice.
c9fd7bd087a7.sw: Karatasi ya kazi ya IMF ya Agosti 2023 — WP/23/163, "The Crypto Cycle and US Monetary Policy" ya Natasha Che, Alexander Copestake, Davide Furceri na Tammaro Terracciano — iliweka namba juu ya usikivu. Waandishi hutoa kipengele kimoja cha bei cha pamoja, wanachokiita kipengele cha kripto, kinachoeleza takriban 80% ya tofauti katika bei za kripto. Kisha hupima kubana kwa fedha kwa Marekani hufanya nini kwake. Kipengele cha kripto hushuka kwa takriban mikengeuko 0.15 ya kawaida baada ya mshtuko wa kubana, huku kipengele cha hisa kikishuka kwa takriban mikengeuko 0.1 ya kawaida. Kripto haikukaa nje ya mzunguko wa fedha. Iliuitikia kwa nguvu zaidi kuliko hisa zilivyofanya — ambacho ndicho beta kubwa humaanisha kivitendo.

ca06879112d8.en: The construction borrows a famous idea from statistics: in a normal distribution (the "bell curve"), about 68% of values fall within one standard deviation of the average, about 95% within two, and about 99.7% within three. Apply that to the last 20 closing prices, and bands at ±2 standard deviations "should" contain roughly 95% of price action — so a touch of the outer band suggests price is statistically stretched.
ca06879112d8.sw: Ujenzi hukopa wazo maarufu kutoka takwimu: katika mtawanyiko wa kawaida ("mkunjo wa kengele"), takriban 68% ya thamani huanguka ndani ya mkengeuko sanifu mmoja wa wastani, takriban 95% ndani ya miwili, na takriban 99.7% ndani ya mitatu. Tumia hilo kwa bei 20 za mwisho za kufunga, na kanda kwa ±2 za mkengeuko sanifu "zinapaswa" kubeba takriban 95% ya shughuli ya bei — hivyo kugusa kanda ya nje kunaashiria bei imenyooshwa kitakwimu.

ca0eb063bab4.en: Blockchain transactions do not reverse. There is no chargeback, no fraud department, no undo. Send coins to a mistyped address, and they are gone — the ledger did exactly what a valid signature told it to do. Send coins to a scammer, and the network cannot tell theft-by-trickery from a gift. Every protection you are used to from card payments lives in the referee — and the referee is the thing this system removed. Verify addresses before sending, every time.
ca0eb063bab4.sw: Miamala ya mnyororo wa vitalu haitenduliwi. Hakuna kurudishwa kwa malipo, hakuna idara ya udanganyifu, hakuna kutendua. Tuma sarafu kwa anwani iliyoandikwa vibaya, nazo zimeenda — leja ilifanya hasa kile sahihi halali iliyoiambia ifanye. Tuma sarafu kwa mlaghai, na mtandao hauwezi kutofautisha wizi-kwa-hila na zawadi. Kila ulinzi uliozoea kutoka malipo ya kadi huishi katika mwamuzi — na mwamuzi ndicho kitu ambacho mfumo huu ulikiondoa. Thibitisha anwani kabla ya kutuma, kila mara.

ca30bc1d6430.en: Compare the two positions. The forex trade carries 10,800 dollars of exposure. The Bitcoin trade carries 789 dollars. That is a factor of 13.7, and it is an order of magnitude apart. Notice where the 13.7 came from, because it is not mysterious. The Bitcoin stop is 6.33% of price and the forex stop is 0.463% of price, and 6.33 / 0.463 = 13.7. The position ratio is the stop ratio, inverted. Nothing else in the formula moved.
ca30bc1d6430.sw: Linganisha nafasi hizo mbili. Biashara ya forex hubeba dola 10,800 za kufunuliwa. Biashara ya Bitcoin hubeba dola 789. Hicho ni kipengele cha 13.7, nazo ziko daraja moja la ukubwa mbali. Tambua 13.7 ilitoka wapi, kwa sababu si ya kificho. Kusimamisha kwa Bitcoin ni 6.33% ya bei na kusimamisha kwa forex ni 0.463% ya bei, na 6.33 / 0.463 = 13.7. Uwiano wa nafasi ni uwiano wa kusimamisha, ukigeuzwa. Hakuna kingine katika fomula kilichosogea.

ca368dc51668.en: Odean (1998), in The Journal of Finance, examined the trading records of 10,000 real discount-brokerage accounts. Investors were 1.5 to 2 times more likely to sell a winning stock than a losing one, even after accounting for taxes and portfolio rebalancing. And it was not shrewd: the winning stocks they sold went on to outperform the losing stocks they held. The instinct to bank the sure profit and give the loser room to recover measurably cost these investors money.
ca368dc51668.sw: Odean (1998), katika The Journal of Finance, alichunguza rekodi za biashara za akaunti 10,000 halisi za udalali wa punguzo. Wawekezaji walikuwa na uwezekano wa mara 1.5 hadi 2 zaidi wa kuuza hisa yenye ushindi kuliko yenye hasara, hata baada ya kuzingatia kodi na kusawazisha mkusanyiko. Na haikuwa busara: hisa zenye ushindi walizoziuza ziliendelea kufanya vizuri kuliko hisa zenye hasara walizozishikilia. Silika ya kuweka benki faida ya uhakika na kumpa mpotezaji nafasi ya kupona iliwagharimu wawekezaji hawa pesa kwa kiasi kinachopimika.

ca56c5cfea15.en: Put it into practice: before placing an order, know exactly what it guarantees — execution, price, or neither absolutely. Recognize which pairs carry unusual gap risk, since a pair tied to a central bank policy peg (like EUR/CHF was) can behave very differently from a normal floating pair. Confirm whether your broker offers negative balance protection before trading with real leverage. And remember that a rare, catastrophic event doesn't invalidate a risk-management tool — it's a reason position sizing and broker protections matter as a second layer, not a substitute for the first.
ca56c5cfea15.sw: Iweke katika vitendo: kabla ya kuweka agizo, jua hasa linahakikisha nini — utekelezaji, bei, au hakuna kabisa. Tambua ni jozi yapi yanabeba hatari isiyo ya kawaida ya kuruka, kwa kuwa jozi lililofungwa kwenye sera ya benki kuu (kama EUR/CHF ilivyokuwa) linaweza kutenda tofauti sana na jozi la kawaida linaloelea. Thibitisha kama broker wako anatoa ulinzi wa salio hasi kabla ya kufanya biashara kwa leverage halisi. Na kumbuka kwamba tukio nadra la maafa halibatilishi zana ya usimamizi wa hatari — ni sababu ya upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi na ulinzi wa broker kuhusika kama safu ya pili, si mbadala wa ya kwanza.

cac8c26ade41.en: The proposal replaces the one referee with two ingredients. First: everyone keeps the ledger. Instead of one bank holding the record, every full participant in the network holds a complete copy of every transaction. A coin that was already spent is visible to everyone, so a second spend of it is rejected by everyone. Second: proof-of-work orders the history. With thousands of copies, the network needs one agreed ordering of transactions — otherwise "which spend came first?" has no answer. Nakamoto's paper proposes timestamping transactions into an ongoing chain secured by computational work, "forming a record that cannot be changed without redoing the proof-of-work."
cac8c26ade41.sw: Pendekezo hubadilisha mwamuzi mmoja na viungo viwili. Kwanza: kila mtu hutunza leja. Badala ya benki moja kushikilia rekodi, kila mshiriki kamili katika mtandao hushikilia nakala kamili ya kila muamala. Sarafu ambayo tayari ilitumika huonekana kwa kila mtu, kwa hivyo matumizi ya pili yake hukataliwa na kila mtu. Pili: uthibitisho-wa-kazi hupanga historia. Kwa nakala maelfu, mtandao unahitaji mpangilio mmoja uliokubaliwa wa miamala — la sivyo "matumizi yapi yalikuja kwanza?" halina jibu. Karatasi ya Nakamoto hupendekeza kuweka alama za muda kwa miamala katika mnyororo unaoendelea uliolindwa na kazi ya kihesabu, "forming a record that cannot be changed without redoing the proof-of-work."

cc46a3a5d01e.en: As you meet crypto claims this week, run four checks. When someone cites the 21 million cap, do they say anything about demand? When someone attributes a claim to "the whitepaper," is it actually in the nine pages? And when someone says crypto invented digital money, remember Chaum's ecash — digital cash existed in 1989 and died in 1998. The invention was removing the referee, not going digital.

Na mtu anaposema kripto ilivumbua pesa ya kidijitali, kumbuka ecash ya Chaum — fedha taslimu ya kidijitali ilikuwepo mwaka 1989 na ikafa mwaka 1998. Uvumbuzi ulikuwa kuondoa mwamuzi, si kuwa wa kidijitali.

cc5db920e540.en: The spread is not fixed. It widens when few people are trading — early morning, late afternoon, holidays, and above all during the sharp moves when you are most likely to want out. Forex Chapter 5's case studies are the extreme version of this: in a genuine liquidity vacuum the book can empty, and a market order fills at a price far from the last one quoted. A market order is a promise to execute, never a promise about the price.

Uchunguzi wa matukio wa Sura ya 5 ya Forex ni toleo la kupindukia la hili: katika ombwe halisi la ukwasi kitabu kinaweza kuwa tupu, na agizo la soko hutimizwa kwa bei mbali na iliyonukuliwa mwisho. What's better established: the word came into wide use among European forex traders in the 1970s and 80s, as electronic trading standardized currency quotes to four decimal places and traders needed a fast, unambiguous way to talk about tiny price changes.

Kilicho na msingi bora zaidi: neno lilianza kutumika kwa upana miongoni mwa wafanyabiashara wa forex wa Ulaya katika miaka ya 1970 na 80, biashara ya kielektroniki ilipoweka nukuu za sarafu kwa nafasi nne za desimali na wafanyabiashara wakahitaji njia ya haraka na isiyo na utata ya kuzungumzia mabadiliko madogo ya bei.

A physical security key blocked 100% of all three categories in the same study.

cfd5d99a6a0f.en: You post 200 dollars of margin and open a long perpetual at 50x. Notional is 200 x 50 = 10,000 dollars. Funding is plus 0.01% per 8-hour period, which is the ordinary, unremarkable level. Cost per day = 10,000 x 0.0001 x 3 = 3 dollars. Against notional that is 0.03% a day, which is trivial. Against your 200 dollars of margin it is 1.5% a day. Nothing has happened to the price. You are simply paying 1.5% of your posted capital every day to keep the position open. Now raise funding to plus 0.1% per period, which occurs in strongly one-sided markets. Cost per day = 10,000 x 0.001 x 3 = 30 dollars. That is 15% of your margin, per day, with the price completely unchanged.
cfd5d99a6a0f.sw: Unaweka dola 200 za mkopo na kufungua nafasi ndefu ya kudumu katika 50x. Ya kinadharia ni 200 x 50 = dola 10,000. Ufadhili ni ongeza 0.01% kwa kipindi cha masaa 8, ambalo ni kiwango cha kawaida, kisichoshangaza. Gharama kwa siku = 10,000 x 0.0001 x 3 = dola 3. Dhidi ya ya kinadharia hiyo ni 0.03% kwa siku, ambayo ni ndogo mno. Dhidi ya dola 200 zako za mkopo ni 1.5% kwa siku. Hakuna kilichotokea kwa bei. Unalipa tu 1.5% ya mtaji wako uliouweka kila siku ili kuweka nafasi wazi. Sasa pandisha ufadhili hadi ongeza 0.1% kwa kipindi, kinachotokea katika masoko yenye upande mmoja mkali. Gharama kwa siku = 10,000 x 0.001 x 3 = dola 30. Hiyo ni 15% ya mkopo wako, kwa siku, huku bei haijabadilika kabisa.

d0d5dce28fe9.en: Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu published Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency in the Journal of Finance in 2022, volume 77, issue 2, pages 1133 to 1177. They examined the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns and found that three factors — the crypto market itself, size, and momentum — captured expected returns across the assets they studied. They tested ten characteristics that formed profitable long-short strategies, and found all of them accounted for by that three-factor model.
d0d5dce28fe9.sw: Liu, Tsyvinski na Wu walichapisha Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency katika Journal of Finance mwaka 2022, juzuu 77, toleo la 2, kurasa 1133 hadi 1177. Walichunguza sehemu-mtambuka ya faida za sarafu ya kripto na wakabaini kwamba vipengele vitatu — soko la kripto lenyewe, ukubwa, na kasi — vilishika faida zinazotarajiwa katika rasilimali walizozisoma. Walipima sifa kumi zilizounda mikakati yenye faida ya mrefu-mfupi, na wakabaini zote zikielezwa na mfano huo wa vipengele vitatu.

d0f30ab92f4b.en: A written plan pre-decides every recurring choice, and expectancy — (win rate x avg win) minus (loss rate x avg loss) — is the one number that says whether that plan actually makes money over time.

d15d2c5bd1e1.en: What to look for, applied to any exchange you currently use. Ask what the withdrawal experience has been recently, in practice rather than in principle, and treat delays as information. Ask what proportion of your total crypto sits at this one venue, and answer it as a percentage. Ask what would remain if this venue returned nothing, tomorrow, without warning.
d15d2c5bd1e1.sw: Cha kuangalia, kikitumika kwa soko lolote la kubadilisha unalolitumia sasa. Uliza uzoefu wa utoaji umekuwaje hivi karibuni, kivitendo badala ya kimsingi, na uchukulie ucheleweshaji kama taarifa. Uliza ni sehemu gani ya kripto yako jumla hukaa katika uwanja huu mmoja, na uijibu kama asilimia. Uliza nini kingebaki ikiwa uwanja huu haungerudisha chochote, kesho, bila onyo.

d17506974244.en: The return earned by the actual money invested, weighted by how much was present at each moment. Also called the money-weighted or internal rate of return.
d17506974244.sw: Faida iliyopatikana na pesa halisi iliyowekezwa, ikipimwa kwa kiasi kilichokuwepo kila wakati. Pia huitwa faida yenye uzito wa pesa au kiwango cha ndani cha faida.

d19535393c67.en: The disciplined sequence uses tools you already have. Put the stop where the trade idea is actually wrong — the invalidation level from Foundations Chapter 2 and the multi-timeframe method in Chapter 2, Lesson 5. Put the target at a genuine obstacle — a support or resistance level from Foundations Chapter 3 that price would realistically reach and stall at. Then read off the ratio those two honest prices produce, and only take the trade if that ratio clears your minimum given a win rate you can actually expect.
d19535393c67.sw: Mfululizo wenye nidhamu hutumia zana ambazo tayari unazo. Weka stop mahali ambapo wazo la biashara si sahihi hasa — kiwango cha kuvunjika kutoka Sura ya 2 ya Msingi na mbinu ya vipindi vingi katika Sura ya 2, Somo la 5. Weka lengo kwenye kizuizi halisi — kiwango cha msaada au upinzani kutoka Sura ya 3 ya Msingi ambacho bei ingekifikia kihalisia na kusimama hapo. Kisha soma uwiano ambao bei hizo mbili za uaminifu huzalisha, na uchukue biashara tu kama uwiano huo unapita kiwango chako cha chini kwa kuzingatia kiwango cha ushindi unachoweza kukitarajia hasa.

d197d108a0fc.en: A nine-day timeline from 2 November 2022, when CoinDesk published the Alameda balance sheet showing a large FTT position, through Binance announcing FTT sales on 6 November, roughly 5 billion dollars of withdrawal requests within 72 hours, the failed rescue on 8 and 9 November, to the Chapter 11 filing on 11 November — alongside a panel showing about 9 billion of liabilities against roughly 900 million of readily saleable assets.
d197d108a0fc.sw: Ratiba ya matukio ya siku tisa kuanzia 2 Novemba 2022, wakati CoinDesk ilipochapisha karatasi ya salio ya Alameda ikionyesha nafasi kubwa ya FTT, kupitia Binance kutangaza mauzo ya FTT tarehe 6 Novemba, takriban dola bilioni 5 za maombi ya utoaji ndani ya masaa 72, uokoaji ulioshindwa tarehe 8 na 9 Novemba, hadi kuwasilisha ombi la Chapter 11 tarehe 11 Novemba — sambamba na paneli ikionyesha takriban bilioni 9 za madeni dhidi ya takriban milioni 900 za rasilimali zinazoweza kuuzwa kwa urahisi.

The second, who was talked into it, sells and does not return for four years. The second investor's decision to invest at once was correct on the evidence and disastrous in practice.

Wa pili, aliyeshawishiwa, huuza na hairudi kwa miaka minne. Uamuzi wa mwekezaji wa pili wa kuwekeza mara moja ulikuwa sahihi kwa ushahidi na wa maafa kivitendo.

d1cf31ead324.en: Every pillar can be invalidated, and a real thesis names how. If your trade rests on a rate-hike catalyst and the central bank holds, the thesis is dead regardless of price — that is an invalidation too. Writing these down in advance is what stops you from inventing reasons to stay in a losing trade, the disposition effect from Chapter 4, Lesson 1.
d1cf31ead324.sw: Kila nguzo inaweza kuvunjwa, na nadharia halisi hutaja jinsi gani. Kama biashara yako inakaa juu ya kichocheo cha kupanda kwa kiwango na benki kuu ikashikilia, nadharia imekufa bila kujali bei — hiyo ni kuvunjika pia. d1d02d08d038.en: A transaction is signed, broadcast, waits in the mempool, gets selected into a block, and is buried under confirmations — fees are an auction for scarce block space, and "sent" is not "settled" until the transaction is buried (proof-of-work) or finalized (proof-of-stake).
d1d02d08d038.sw: Muamala hutiwa sahihi, hutangazwa, husubiri katika mempool, huchaguliwa kuingia katika kitalu, na huzikwa chini ya uthibitisho — ada ni mnada wa nafasi adimu ya kitalu, na "umetumwa" si "umetimizwa" hadi muamala uzikwe (uthibitisho-wa-kazi) au ukamilishwe (uthibitisho-wa-hisa).

d2040cda746f.en: Three habits do most of the remaining work. Reach sites through your own bookmarks, typed manually the first time and saved, never through a search advertisement, a message link, or a link in a social post. Treat all inbound contact as hostile by default, because real support does not message you first; if you need help, you go to the support channel yourself, from your own bookmark. And ignore unexpected tokens, because a token you did not buy that appears in your wallet is not a gift, and the site it points you to is not a claim page.
d2040cda746f.sw: Tabia tatu hufanya sehemu kubwa ya kazi iliyobaki. Fikia tovuti kupitia alamisho zako mwenyewe, zilizoandikwa kwa mkono mara ya kwanza na kuhifadhiwa, kamwe si kupitia tangazo la utafutaji, kiungo cha ujumbe, au kiungo katika chapisho la kijamii. Chukulia mawasiliano yote yanayoingia kama ya kiadui kwa msingi, kwa sababu huduma halisi haikutumii ujumbe kwanza; ikiwa unahitaji msaada, unakwenda kwenye njia ya msaada mwenyewe, kutoka alamisho yako mwenyewe. Na puuza tokeni zisizotarajiwa, kwa sababu tokeni usiyoinunua inayojitokeza katika pochi yako si zawadi, na tovuti inayokuelekeza si ukurasa wa kudai.

d207321c9bea.en: The secret half of the key pair: a very large number that acts as the only signature the network accepts for spending from your address. Whoever knows the private key controls the money. There is no "owner" on a blockchain other than this.
d207321c9bea.sw: Nusu ya siri ya jozi ya funguo: namba kubwa mno inayofanya kazi kama sahihi pekee ambayo mtandao huikubali kwa kutumia kutoka anwani yako. Yeyote anayejua ufunguo wa faragha hudhibiti pesa. Hakuna "mmiliki" katika mnyororo wa vitalu zaidi ya huyu.

d20c2a15b261.en: What is left for a private investor is not an information advantage but a structural one. You have no clients who can withdraw money, no quarterly performance to report, and no career risk from looking wrong for three years. A professional cannot always hold through a long drawdown even when the analysis says to. You can, and that is the only durable advantage most readers will ever have.
d20c2a15b261.sw: Kilichobaki kwa mwekezaji binafsi si faida ya taarifa bali ya kimuundo. Huna wateja wanaoweza kutoa pesa, hakuna utendaji wa robo mwaka wa kuripoti, na hakuna hatari ya kazi kutokana na kuonekana umekosea kwa miaka mitatu. Mtaalamu hawezi daima kushikilia kupitia kushuka kwa muda mrefu hata uchambuzi ukisema afanye hivyo. Wewe unaweza, na hiyo ndiyo faida pekee ya kudumu ambayo wasomaji wengi watawahi kuwa nayo.

d20ed73b667b.en: Not quite. The percentages are not symmetrical, because the gain is calculated on what is left rather than on what you started with. 100 falls to 50, and 50 must double to reach 100 again — a 100% gain to undo a 50% loss.
d20ed73b667b.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Asilimia hazina usawa, kwa sababu faida hukokotolewa juu ya kilichobaki badala ya ulichoanza nacho. 100 hushuka hadi 50, na 50 lazima iongezeke mara mbili kufikia 100 tena — faida ya 100% kubatilisha hasara ya 50%.

d21857aa93df.en: Correct — 15-minute and 4-hour. The short-term is roughly a quarter of the medium (60 ÷ 4 = 15) and the long-term roughly four times it (60 × 4 = 240 minutes = 4 hours).

d2aca7894391.en: The hype cycle — the curve running from a peak of inflated expectations, through a trough of disillusionment, to a plateau of productivity — is a model published by the consultancy Gartner. It is a useful shape for describing what enthusiasm does over time. It is not an empirical finding, it has no predictive precision, and it cannot tell you where on the curve you currently are. Anyone using it to argue that a fall is merely the trough before the plateau is using a diagram as a forecast.
d2aca7894391.sw: Mzunguko wa utangazaji — mkunjo unaokimbia kutoka kilele cha matarajio yaliyokuzwa, kupitia bonde la kukata tamaa, hadi uwanda wa uzalishaji — ni mfano uliochapishwa na kampuni ya ushauri Gartner. Ni umbo lenye manufaa kwa kuelezea shauku hufanya nini kwa muda. Si matokeo ya kimatendo, hauna usahihi wa kutabiri, na hauwezi kukuambia uko wapi katika mkunjo kwa sasa. Yeyote anayeutumia kudai kwamba kushuka ni bonde tu kabla ya uwanda anatumia mchoro kama utabiri.

d2caccd426b5.en: A perpetual has no expiry date. That removes the tether. So the venue installs a different one: a recurring cash payment between the two sides of the market, sized to punish whichever side has pushed the perpetual price away from spot. That payment is the funding rate. When the perpetual trades above spot, funding is positive and longs pay shorts. When it trades below spot, funding is negative and shorts pay longs. On Binance, Bybit and OKX the settlement interval is every 8 hours; some venues, including Hyperliquid, settle hourly. On major venues the money moves between traders, not to the exchange.
d2caccd426b5.sw: Ya kudumu haina tarehe ya kukwisha muda. Hilo huondoa kifungo. Kwa hivyo uwanja husakinisha kingine: malipo ya fedha yanayojirudia kati ya pande mbili za soko, yaliyopangwa ukubwa kuadhibu upande wowote ulioisukuma bei ya kudumu mbali na papo hapo. Malipo hayo ndio kiwango cha ufadhili. Ya kudumu inapofanyiwa biashara juu ya papo hapo, ufadhili ni chanya na warefu hulipa wafupi. Inapofanyiwa biashara chini ya papo hapo, ufadhili ni hasi na wafupi hulipa warefu. Katika Binance, Bybit na OKX kipindi cha utimizaji ni kila masaa 8; viwanja baadhi, ikiwa ni pamoja na Hyperliquid, hutimiza kila saa. Katika viwanja vikuu pesa husogea kati ya wafanyabiashara, si kwa soko la kubadilisha.

d31aef3058ac.en: Before your next discretionary crypto decision, write down three things: what government bond yields have done over the last month, what equity risk appetite has done, and what funding rates have been doing. Then write one sentence on whether your thesis needs any of those to be true. If it does and they are pointing the other way, you have learned something for the cost of ten minutes.
d31aef3058ac.sw: Kabla ya uamuzi wako ujao wa hiari wa kripto, andika mambo matatu: mavuno ya hatifungani za serikali yamefanya nini katika mwezi uliopita, hamu ya hatari ya hisa imefanya nini, na viwango vya ufadhili vimekuwa vikifanya nini. Kisha andika sentensi moja kuhusu kama nadharia yako inahitaji lolote kati ya hayo liwe kweli. Ikiwa inahitaji nayo yanaelekeza upande mwingine, umejifunza kitu kwa gharama ya dakika kumi.

d322118af227.en: In March you use a new exchange application to swap 200 dollars of a stablecoin. The interface asks you to approve the token. You click through, because the swap will not proceed otherwise, and the default is an unlimited allowance. You use the site twice more, then forget it exists. By November your wallet holds 6,000 dollars of that same stablecoin, accumulated for entirely different reasons. That month the application's contract is exploited. The attacker does not need your seed phrase, your password, or your device. The approval you granted in March authorizes the contract to move that token, in any amount, at any time. All 6,000 dollars leaves in one transaction. You are not online. You find out later.
d322118af227.sw: Mwezi Machi unatumia programu mpya ya soko la kubadilisha kubadilisha dola 200 za sarafu imara. Kiolesura kinakuomba uidhinishe tokeni. Unabonyeza, kwa sababu ubadilishaji hautaendelea vinginevyo, na chaguo-msingi ni posho isiyo na mpaka. Unatumia tovuti mara mbili zaidi, kisha unasahau ipo. Kufikia Novemba pochi yako inashikilia dola 6,000 za sarafu imara ileile, iliyojilimbikiza kwa sababu tofauti kabisa. Mwezi huo mkataba wa programu unavamiwa. Mshambuliaji hahitaji kifungu chako cha mbegu, nenosiri lako, wala kifaa chako. Idhini uliyoitoa mwezi Machi huidhinisha mkataba kusogeza tokeni hiyo, katika kiasi chochote, wakati wowote. Dola 6,000 zote zinaondoka katika muamala mmoja. Huko mtandaoni. Unagundua baadaye.

d341b8124a72.en: In the United States, the CFTC has capped retail forex leverage at 50:1 for major currency pairs (20:1 for others) since October 2010, under authority granted by the Dodd-Frank Act. In the European Union, ESMA capped retail leverage at 30:1 for major pairs in 2018 — a rule the UK's FCA kept in place independently after Brexit, and Australia's ASIC adopted a similar 30:1 cap in 2021.
d341b8124a72.sw: Nchini Marekani, CFTC imeweka kikomo cha leverage ya forex ya rejareja cha 50:1 kwa jozi kuu za sarafu (20:1 kwa nyingine) tangu Oktoba 2010, chini ya mamlaka iliyotolewa na Sheria ya Dodd-Frank. Katika Umoja wa Ulaya, ESMA iliweka kikomo cha leverage ya rejareja cha 30:1 kwa jozi kuu mwaka 2018 — kanuni ambayo FCA ya Uingereza iliiweka mahali pake kwa kujitegemea baada ya Brexit, na ASIC ya Australia ilikubali kikomo kinachofanana cha 30:1 mwaka 2021.

d358417e1af1.en: That gap is the central irony of the case and it recurs throughout this chapter. An asset class built specifically so that ownership could be verified without trusting an institution was, in practice, mostly held through institutions that had to be trusted. The technology worked exactly as designed. Almost nobody was using it.
d358417e1af1.sw: Pengo hilo ndilo kejeli kuu ya kesi nalo hujirudia katika sura hii yote. Aina ya rasilimali iliyojengwa hasa ili umiliki uweze kuthibitishwa bila kuamini taasisi ilikuwa, kivitendo, ikishikiliwa hasa kupitia taasisi ambazo zilipaswa kuaminiwa. Teknolojia ilifanya kazi hasa kama ilivyoundwa. Karibu hakuna aliyekuwa akiitumia.

d38887fd05a3.en: Accepting a risk exists, but capping how much it can cost you. This is what a stop-loss does mechanically — and it's the technique you'll use the most, by far.

d3b902f09adc.en: Wallet addresses are public. Anyone can see which addresses interacted with a given protocol, in what size, and when. That makes it straightforward to assemble a list of addresses holding meaningful balances and to target them — with tokens airdropped into the wallet that lead to a malicious site, or with messages elsewhere if the address can be linked to an identity.
d3b902f09adc.sw: Anwani za pochi ni za umma. Yeyote anaweza kuona ni anwani zipi ziliingiliana na itifaki fulani, kwa ukubwa gani, na lini. Hilo hufanya iwe rahisi kukusanya orodha ya anwani zinazoshikilia salio zenye maana na kuzilenga — kwa tokeni zilizoangushwa katika pochi zinazoelekeza kwenye tovuti hasidi, au kwa ujumbe mahali pengine ikiwa anwani inaweza kuunganishwa na utambulisho.

d400c9fa1f7d.en: Common practice places the stop at somewhere between 1.5 and 3 times ATR away from entry. There is no correct multiple, and this course will not pretend there is one. A smaller multiple gets you stopped out by noise more often; a larger one forces a smaller position for the same risk. The multiple is a choice you write into your plan and then apply consistently, so that your results measure your strategy rather than your improvisation. This lesson uses 2 times ATR. On the numbers above, that is a stop 2 x 1,900 = 3,800 dollars away, which is 3,800 / 60,000 = 6.33% of the price.
d400c9fa1f7d.sw: Mazoea ya kawaida huweka kusimamisha mahali fulani kati ya mara 1.5 na 3 za ATR mbali na kuingia. Hakuna kizidishi sahihi, na kozi hii haitajifanya kuna kimoja. Kizidishi kidogo hukufanya usimamishwe na kelele mara nyingi zaidi; kikubwa zaidi hulazimisha nafasi ndogo zaidi kwa hatari ileile. Kizidishi ni chaguo unaloandika katika mpango wako kisha kulitumia kwa uthabiti, ili matokeo yako yapime mkakati wako badala ya uboreshaji wako wa papo hapo. Somo hili hutumia mara 2 ya ATR. Katika namba zilizo hapo juu, hiyo ni kusimamisha 2 x 1,900 = dola 3,800 mbali, ambayo ni 3,800 / 60,000 = 6.33% ya bei.

d4087f38e205.en: Over the last two months, government bond yields have risen sharply, credit spreads have widened, and equity leadership has narrowed to a handful of very large companies. You are considering a position in a small token whose case rests entirely on adoption arriving over the next several years. The chain says every one of those observations works against a long-duration risk asset, and crypto is the longest-duration risk asset available. That does not mean the token is bad or that the price must fall. It means your thesis now owes an explanation for why this asset is an exception, and if you do not have one, you are trading against the regime without having noticed there was one.
d4087f38e205.sw: Katika miezi miwili iliyopita, mavuno ya hatifungani za serikali yamepanda kwa kasi, mianya ya mikopo imepanuka, na uongozi wa hisa umefinywa hadi kampuni chache kubwa mno. Unafikiria nafasi katika tokeni ndogo ambayo hoja yake inategemea kabisa matumizi kufika katika miaka kadhaa ijayo. Mnyororo unasema kila mmoja wa uchunguzi huo unafanya kazi dhidi ya rasilimali ya hatari ya muda mrefu, na kripto ndiyo rasilimali ya hatari ya muda mrefu zaidi inayopatikana. Hilo halimaanishi tokeni ni mbaya au kwamba bei lazima ishuke. Linamaanisha nadharia yako sasa inadaiwa maelezo ya kwa nini rasilimali hii ni ubaguzi, na ikiwa huna, unafanya biashara dhidi ya utawala bila kutambua kulikuwa na mmoja.

d4350dbb9d6e.en: Why do it? An exchange with high reported volume ranks higher on data sites, attracts listings, and can charge projects for them. A token project with high reported volume looks like it has demand. And a wash trader can push a price up on a thin book, precisely because the price-impact arithmetic above works in both directions.
d4350dbb9d6e.sw: Kwa nini kuifanya? Soko la kubadilisha lenye ujazo mkubwa unaoripotiwa hupanda juu zaidi katika tovuti za data, huvutia uorodheshaji, na linaweza kutoza miradi kwa ajili yake. Mradi wa tokeni wenye ujazo mkubwa unaoripotiwa huonekana kama una mahitaji. Na mfanyabiashara wa kujiosha anaweza kusukuma bei juu katika kitabu chembamba, hasa kwa sababu hesabu ya athari ya bei iliyo hapo juu hufanya kazi pande zote mbili.

d43b4537ec4f.en: The point at which a transaction can no longer be reversed. Proof-of-work offers probabilistic finality: reversal becomes rapidly more expensive with depth but never impossible. Some proof-of-stake systems add explicit finality: a point after which reversal would require breaking the protocol's economic rules at massive, visible cost.
d43b4537ec4f.sw: Nukta ambayo baada yake muamala hauwezi kutenduliwa tena. Uthibitisho-wa-kazi hutoa umalizio wa uwezekano: kutendua huwa ghali zaidi kwa kasi kadiri kina kinavyoongezeka lakini kamwe si kutowezekana. Mifumo baadhi ya uthibitisho-wa-hisa huongeza umalizio wa wazi: nukta ambayo baada yake kutendua kungehitaji kuvunja kanuni za kiuchumi za itifaki kwa gharama kubwa mno, inayoonekana.

d44a4a44dee6.en: You have seen this exact trap before. In Lesson 5, Sullivan, Timmermann and White showed that a trading rule can look profitable purely because it was the best-fitting choice among many — the data-snooping problem. Candlestick results that hinge on which exit rule you happen to pick are that same warning in a new place. If a strategy's profit appears or vanishes depending on an arbitrary exit choice, the profit was never solid ground.
d44a4a44dee6.sw: Umeuona mtego huu hasa awali. Katika Somo la 5, Sullivan, Timmermann na White walionyesha kwamba kanuni ya biashara inaweza kuonekana yenye faida kwa sababu tu ilikuwa chaguo lililolingana vizuri zaidi kati ya mengi — tatizo la kupekua data. Matokeo ya mishumaa yanayotegemea kanuni ipi ya kutoka unayochagua ni onyo lile lile katika mahali papya. Kama faida ya mkakati inajitokeza au inatoweka kutegemea chaguo la bahati nasibu la kutoka, faida haikuwa msingi imara kamwe.

d46b0fc2398c.en: Fifteen years is not an abstraction. Someone who bought the index in March 2000 at age 55 was 70 before the position was worth what they paid, in nominal terms and before inflation. The statement that the market recovered is true and was no help to them. Recovery is a property of the index; whether it reaches you depends on your time horizon, which is exactly the sequence-of-returns risk from Chapter 3 Lesson 1.
d46b0fc2398c.sw: Miaka kumi na mitano si dhana ya kufikirika. Mtu aliyenunua faharasa mwezi Machi 2000 akiwa na miaka 55 alikuwa na miaka 70 kabla nafasi hiyo haijafikia thamani aliyolipa, kwa maneno ya kawaida na kabla ya mfumuko wa bei. Kauli kwamba soko lilipona ni ya kweli na haikumsaidia kwa lolote. Kupona ni sifa ya faharasa; kama kunakufikia hutegemea upeo wako wa muda, ambayo ndiyo hasa hatari ya mfuatano wa faida kutoka Sura ya 3 Somo la 1.

d47099aaa634.en: Not quite — break-even win rate = 1 / (1 + R) = 1 / 4 = 25% at 1:3.
d47099aaa634.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kiwango cha ushindi cha kulingana = 1 / (1 + R) = 1 / 4 = 25% kwa 1:3.

d473b9e82629.en: Correct. The document only works if it is followed, so an unusable rule damages the whole plan by teaching you that its contents are optional. Rewrite it into something you will actually do. That is a different thing from abandoning a rule because the market moved against it.
