d527ffd4708c.en: Book value has also become a weaker measure of what a company is over the period since the original study. Accounting rules treat a factory as an asset and much research, software development and brand building as an expense. A company whose main assets are people and code can show very little book value while being extremely valuable, which distorts the measure rather than the companies.
d527ffd4708c.sw: Thamani ya kitabu pia imekuwa kipimo dhaifu zaidi cha kampuni ni nini katika kipindi tangu utafiti asilia. Kanuni za uhasibu huchukulia kiwanda kama mali na utafiti mwingi, uendelezaji wa programu na ujenzi wa chapa kama gharama. Kampuni ambayo mali zake kuu ni watu na msimbo inaweza kuonyesha thamani ndogo mno ya kitabu ikiwa na thamani kubwa mno, jambo linalopotosha kipimo badala ya kampuni.

d533b39aad07.en: What to look for whenever someone offers you an edge. Ask what specifically they know that the market does not, and how they came to know it. Ask why the information has not already moved the price if it is genuinely public. Ask how long they expect the advantage to survive being described to you. And treat any answer of the form the market has not noticed, about a widely followed company, as the least likely explanation available.
d533b39aad07.sw: Cha kutazama wakati wowote mtu anapokupa faida. Uliza wanajua nini mahususi ambacho soko halijui, na walijuaje. Uliza kwa nini taarifa hazijasogeza bei tayari kama ni za umma kweli. Uliza wanatarajia faida idumu muda gani baada ya kuelezwa kwako. Na chukulia jibu lolote la umbo la soko halijatambua, kuhusu kampuni inayofuatiliwa kwa upana, kama maelezo yasiyowezekana zaidi yanayopatikana.

d5961c9bc0a5.en: Ten people each buy the same token. Two do well and post screenshots. Six lose money and say nothing. Two lose a great deal and leave the group entirely. A newcomer reading that chat sees a two-out-of-two success rate on a position that actually went badly for eight people out of ten. Nothing in the chat was fabricated.

Mgeni anayesoma gumzo hilo huona kiwango cha mafanikio cha wawili-kati-ya-wawili katika nafasi ambayo kwa kweli ilikwenda vibaya kwa watu wanane kati ya kumi. d5b8f162f0af.en: The practical damage is that the anchor sets an exit condition nobody chose. People decide to sell when it gets back to 400, which is a decision made by a number on a chart rather than by any view of the asset, and it can keep a position open for years.
d5b8f162f0af.sw: Uharibifu wa kivitendo ni kwamba nanga huweka sharti la kutoka ambalo hakuna aliyelichagua. Watu huamua kuuza itakaporudi 400, ambako ni uamuzi uliofanywa na namba kwenye chati badala ya mtazamo wowote wa rasilimali, nao unaweza kuweka nafasi wazi kwa miaka.

d5c1ef122645.en: So the account splits cleanly: used margin (locked as collateral for your open positions) plus free margin (everything else) equals your equity. When a trade moves against you, its floating loss lowers your equity, which shrinks your free margin, which drives your margin level down. Watching that chain is the whole skill of this lesson.
d5c1ef122645.sw: Hivyo akaunti hugawanyika safi: margin iliyotumika (iliyofungwa kama dhamana ya nafasi zako zilizo wazi) pamoja na margin huru (kila kitu kingine) ni sawa na usawa wako. Biashara inaposogea dhidi yako, hasara yake inayoelea hushusha usawa wako, ambao hupunguza margin yako huru, ambayo husukuma kiwango chako cha margin chini. Kutazama mnyororo huo ndio ustadi wote wa somo hili.

d5d0292cb8e1.en: Two different pieces of information about the same day. Metric A: 950,000 unique Bitcoin addresses transacted. Metric B: 12,000 BTC moved into addresses labelled as exchanges. Metric A is a fact about the ledger and requires no assumptions. Metric B requires knowing which addresses belong to exchanges, which the ledger does not say. They look equally solid on a chart. They are not.
d5d0292cb8e1.sw: Vipande viwili tofauti vya taarifa kuhusu siku ileile. Kipimo A: anwani 950,000 za kipekee za Bitcoin zilifanya miamala. Kipimo B: BTC 12,000 zilisogea kuingia katika anwani zilizowekewa lebo kama masoko ya kubadilisha. Kipimo A ni ukweli kuhusu leja na hakihitaji dhana. Kipimo B kinahitaji kujua ni anwani zipi ni za masoko ya kubadilisha, jambo ambalo leja haisemi. Vinaonekana imara kwa usawa kwenye chati. Si hivyo.

d5fbb2104d78.en: The currency your trading account is denominated in. Every risk figure, in the end, has to be expressed in it, because that is the currency you actually win or lose.

d5fe92f81827.en: There are hundreds of indicators, and anyone can invent a new one — many are redundant or worthless. Piling many onto one chart doesn't add insight; it adds conflict. This mirrors a general principle from statistics: adding more and more weakly-informative variables to a prediction degrades it rather than improving it. Pick a small number of tools you genuinely understand. Fifteen out of twenty indicators "agreeing" means far less than it sounds like — many are computing near-identical things from the same prices.
d5fe92f81827.sw: Kuna mamia ya viashiria, na mtu yeyote anaweza kubuni kipya — vingi ni vya marudio au visivyo na thamani. Kurundika vingi kwenye chati moja hakuongezi ufahamu; kunaongeza mgongano. Hii inaakisi kanuni ya jumla kutoka takwimu: kuongeza vigezo vingi zaidi visivyo na taarifa nyingi kwenye utabiri hukudhoofisha badala ya kukuboresha. Chagua idadi ndogo ya zana unazozielewa kweli. Viashiria kumi na tano kati ya ishirini "kukubaliana" kunamaanisha kidogo mno kuliko inavyosikika — vingi vinakokotoa vitu vinavyokaribia kufanana kutoka bei zile zile.

d6176e2099f8.en: None of that means crypto is worthless or that owning it is irrational. It means the honest position for almost everyone is a small slice, sized so that a total loss is survivable, held with written rules, in custody you control, reviewed on a schedule rather than in reaction to news.
d6176e2099f8.sw: Hakuna kati ya hayo kinachomaanisha kripto haina thamani au kwamba kuimiliki hakuna mantiki. Kinamaanisha msimamo wa kweli kwa karibu kila mtu ni kipande kidogo, kilichopangwa ukubwa ili hasara ya jumla inusurike, kikishikiliwa kwa kanuni zilizoandikwa, katika utunzaji unaoudhibiti, kikikaguliwa kwa ratiba badala ya kwa mwitikio kwa habari.

d617c5105e6f.en: Correct. That is what makes an equity thesis falsifiable. Saying the shares are cheap is an opinion that cannot be wrong on a date. Saying the price implies a 5% annual earnings decline while I expect flat earnings is a claim the next set of results can contradict — and only that kind of claim teaches you anything.
d617c5105e6f.sw: Sahihi. Ndicho kinachofanya nadharia ya hisa iweze kukanushwa. Kusema hisa ni za bei nafuu ni maoni yasiyoweza kuwa si sahihi katika tarehe. Kusema bei huashiria kushuka kwa mapato kwa 5% kwa mwaka huku mimi natarajia mapato tuli ni dai ambalo seti ijayo ya matokeo inaweza kulipinga — na ni aina hiyo tu ya dai inayokufundisha kitu.

d61ff04ba512.en: The usual answer is that investing is sensible and gambling is reckless, or that investing is slow and gambling is fast. Neither survives contact with reality. Buying a single speculative company with your savings is investing by that definition, and it is plainly a gamble. A structured bet with a known edge is gambling by that definition, and it is plainly not reckless.
d61ff04ba512.sw: Jibu la kawaida ni kwamba kuwekeza ni jambo la busara na kamari ni uzembe, au kwamba kuwekeza ni polepole na kamari ni haraka. Hakuna kinachonusurika kukutana na uhalisia. Kununua kampuni moja ya kubahatisha kwa akiba yako ni kuwekeza kwa maana hiyo, na ni kamari waziwazi. Dau lililopangwa lenye faida inayojulikana ni kamari kwa maana hiyo, na si uzembe waziwazi.

d620da0bcb20.en: Correct — an attestation confirms the reserves existed on the report date. A full audit, which no major stablecoin issuer currently publishes, examines much more. And no report of either kind prevents a depeg — USDC held monthly attestations and still traded near 0.88 dollars in March 2023.

Na hakuna ripoti ya aina yoyote inayozuia kuvunjika kwa pegi — USDC ilikuwa na ushuhuda wa kila mwezi na bado ilifanyiwa biashara karibu na dola 0.88 mwezi Machi 2023.

d63581a0d1e2.en: Timeframe-shopping is cycling through charts until you find one that agrees with a trade you already want to make. If the daily says down, the 4-hour says down, and the 9-minute says up — and you take the long — you haven't done multi-timeframe analysis. You've searched a set of options for the answer you wanted. The direction of travel must be top-down, decided in sequence, and you have to accept the answer the higher timeframe gives you.
d63581a0d1e2.sw: Kutafuta vipindi ni kuzunguka chati hadi upate moja inayokubaliana na biashara ambayo tayari unataka kuifanya. Kama ya kila siku inasema chini, ya saa 4 inasema chini, na ya dakika 9 inasema juu — na unachukua long — hujafanya uchambuzi wa vipindi vingi. Umetafuta katika seti ya chaguo jibu ulilolitaka. Mwelekeo wa safari lazima uwe juu-kwenda-chini, ukiamuliwa kwa mfululizo, na lazima ukubali jibu ambalo kipindi cha juu zaidi kinakupa.

d6404e4f47a0.en: What to look for whenever a strategy is presented with historical evidence. Ask how cheapness or quality or momentum was defined, and whether the fund uses the same definition as the study. Ask over what period the result held, and whether the period included a long stretch where it did not work. Ask what it cost to implement. And ask what has happened since the finding was published, because a strategy known to everyone is a different proposition from one nobody had noticed.
d6404e4f47a0.sw: Cha kutazama wakati wowote mkakati unapowasilishwa na ushahidi wa kihistoria. Uliza unafuu au ubora au kasi ilifafanuliwaje, na kama fund inatumia maana ile ile kama utafiti. Uliza tokeo lilishikilia katika kipindi kipi, na kama kipindi kilijumuisha muda mrefu ambapo haukufanya kazi. Uliza iligharimu nini kuutekeleza. Na uliza kimetokea nini tangu tokeo lilipochapishwa, kwa sababu mkakati unaojulikana na kila mtu ni pendekezo tofauti na ule ambao hakuna aliyeugundua.

d662fbb04f61.en: Never move the target closer, or the stop wider, after entry to rescue a trade — that quietly destroys the ratio you planned. Widening a stop to avoid being closed turns a 1:2 trade into a 1:1 or worse, and the arithmetic above shows exactly what that does to the win rate you now need. The ratio is a decision made before the trade, and then defended.
d662fbb04f61.sw: Kamwe usisogeze lengo karibu, wala stop pana, baada ya kuingia ili kuokoa biashara — hilo huharibu kimyakimya uwiano uliopanga. Kupanua stop ili kuepuka kufungwa hugeuza biashara ya 1:2 kuwa 1:1 au mbaya zaidi, na hesabu hapo juu inaonyesha hasa hilo linafanya nini kwa kiwango cha ushindi unachohitaji sasa. Uwiano ni uamuzi unaofanywa kabla ya biashara, kisha kutetewa.

d66ba66403bd.sw: Ni nini hufuata kutokana na uchunguzi kwamba sehemu kubwa ya kupona baada ya 2009 kulikuja katika milipuko iliyokusanyika karibu na bonde?

d66eaa9f7690.sw: Kwamba Bitcoin ni hifadhi ya thamani inayoaminika

d693e07302a0.en: That pattern is common enough to have a name in the industry: low float, high FDV. Binance Research published a study in May 2024 finding that tokens launched in 2024 had an average market cap to FDV ratio of 12.3%, very close to the example above. The same report estimated roughly 155 billion dollars of tokens scheduled to unlock between 2024 and 2030. Treat the numbers as an industry estimate rather than peer-reviewed evidence: Binance is an exchange, and the report is written by an exchange's research arm. The measurement is still specific, dated and checkable, which is why it is worth quoting rather than a vague claim that float is low these days.
d693e07302a0.sw: Muundo huo ni wa kawaida vya kutosha kuwa na jina katika tasnia: uelezi mdogo, FDV kubwa. Binance Research ilichapisha utafiti mwezi Mei 2024 ikibaini kwamba tokeni zilizozinduliwa mwaka 2024 zilikuwa na uwiano wa wastani wa kiasi cha soko kwa FDV wa 12.3%, karibu sana na mfano ulio hapo juu. Ripoti ileile ilikadiria takriban dola bilioni 155 za tokeni zilizopangwa kufunguliwa kati ya 2024 na 2030. Chukulia namba kama makadirio ya tasnia badala ya ushahidi uliopitiwa na wenzao: Binance ni soko la kubadilisha, na ripoti imeandikwa na tawi la utafiti la soko la kubadilisha. Kipimo bado ni maalum, kina tarehe na kinaweza kukaguliwa, ndiyo maana kinastahili kunukuliwa badala ya dai lisilo wazi kwamba uelezi ni mdogo siku hizi.

d6b2d15e23cf.en: A measure of how much an asset moves for a given move in a reference market. A beta of 1 means the asset tends to move roughly one-for-one with that market. A beta above 1 means it tends to move more, in both directions. An asset with a persistently high beta is described as high-beta: it amplifies whatever the reference market does.
d6b2d15e23cf.sw: Kipimo cha kiasi gani rasilimali husogea kwa msogeo fulani wa soko la rejeleo. Beta ya 1 humaanisha rasilimali huelekea kusogea takriban moja-kwa-moja na soko hilo. Beta juu ya 1 humaanisha huelekea kusogea zaidi, pande zote mbili. Rasilimali yenye beta kubwa kwa kudumu huelezwa kama beta-kubwa: hukuza chochote soko la rejeleo linachofanya.

d6ce62e14a4d.en: Because annual moves are measured in multiples, so a reckless position can return several hundred percent while a disciplined one loses money — outcomes carry almost no information about decision quality over short periods
d6ce62e14a4d.sw: Kwa sababu misogeo ya kila mwaka hupimwa kwa vizidishi, kwa hivyo nafasi ya kizembe inaweza kurudisha mamia kadhaa ya asilimia huku yenye nidhamu ikipoteza pesa — matokeo hubeba taarifa ndogo mno kuhusu ubora wa uamuzi katika vipindi vifupi

d6d025ec1504.en: Gold was excellent as money for a long time — but as trade grew larger and more complex, it ran into four real problems: it could be secretly debased, its value could shift when new gold was discovered, it was heavy and risky to transport, and there was often not enough of it in circulation to match the pace of trade.
d6d025ec1504.sw: Dhahabu ilikuwa bora sana kama pesa kwa muda mrefu — lakini biashara ilipokua kubwa na tata zaidi, ilikumbana na matatizo manne halisi: ingeweza kupunguzwa ubora kwa siri, thamani yake ingeweza kubadilika dhahabu mpya ilipogunduliwa, ilikuwa nzito na hatari kusafirisha, na mara nyingi haikuwepo ya kutosha katika mzunguko kulingana na kasi ya biashara.

d71c053995e5.en: A written threshold stating how much stays on an exchange and the amount above which holdings move to self-custody
d71c053995e5.sw: Kizingiti kilichoandikwa kikitaja kiasi gani hubaki katika soko la kubadilisha na kiasi ambacho juu yake umiliki huhamia utunzaji binafsi

d72224043a9e.en: A permission recorded on-chain that authorizes a specific smart contract to move a specific token from your wallet, up to a stated limit. It is granted by its own transaction, it stays in force until you change or remove it, and it is completely independent of whether you are currently using the application.
d72224043a9e.sw: Ruhusa iliyoandikwa kwenye mnyororo inayoidhinisha mkataba mahiri maalum kusogeza tokeni maalum kutoka pochi yako, hadi kikomo kilichotajwa. Hutolewa na muamala wake mwenyewe, hubaki katika nguvu hadi uibadilishe au kuiondoa, nayo haitegemei kabisa kama unatumia programu kwa sasa.

d7284bc15e6e.en: Mixing customer assets with the firm's own assets, so that customer funds are available to the firm for its own purposes.
d7284bc15e6e.sw: Kuchanganya rasilimali za wateja na rasilimali za kampuni yenyewe, ili fedha za wateja zipatikane kwa kampuni kwa madhumuni yake yenyewe.

d72909d4aa7a.en: There is no fixed distance, because the exchange decides case by case
d72909d4aa7a.sw: Hakuna umbali usiobadilika, kwa sababu soko la kubadilisha huamua kesi kwa kesi

d734dc49cd05.en: Favouring higher rates (to fight inflation) / lower rates (to boost growth).
d734dc49cd05.sw: Kupendelea viwango vya juu (kupambana na mfumuko wa bei) / viwango vya chini (kukuza ukuaji).

d7355b6fa2ec.en: A price level where falling prices have repeatedly reversed upward.
d7355b6fa2ec.sw: Kiwango cha bei ambapo bei zinazoshuka zimegeuka kupanda mara kwa mara.

d747316e3751.en: Because market-moving events are scheduled, the economic calendar tells you in advance when a currency is likely to move — and price reacts to the gap between the forecast and the actual number, not to the event itself.
d747316e3751.sw: Kwa sababu matukio yanayosogeza soko yamepangwa, kalenda ya kiuchumi hukuambia mapema ni lini sarafu inawezekana kusogea — na bei huitikia pengo kati ya utabiri na namba halisi, si tukio lenyewe.

d74af4e01a7a.en: That is a real finding from a peer-reviewed journal, and this course does not dismiss findings it dislikes. But read the sample honestly. It covers three complete market cycles. Three cycles is three observations of the thing being predicted, however many daily data points sit between them. The indicator thresholds are evaluated over the same history that made those indicators famous in the first place. No independent replication on later, unseen data was found while preparing this lesson, because there is barely any later data to replicate on.
d74af4e01a7a.sw: Hayo ni matokeo halisi kutoka jarida lililopitiwa na wenzao, na kozi hii haitupi matokeo isiyoyapenda. Lakini soma sampuli kwa ukweli. Inafunika mizunguko mitatu kamili ya soko. Mizunguko mitatu ni uchunguzi matatu ya kile kinachotabiriwa, hata nukta ngapi za data za kila siku zikiwa kati yake. Vizingiti vya viashiria hupimwa katika historia ileile iliyofanya viashiria hivyo kuwa maarufu awali. Hakuna urudiaji huru katika data ya baadaye, isiyoonekana uliopatikana wakati wa kuandaa somo hili, kwa sababu kwa shida kuna data ya baadaye ya kurudia juu yake.

d7630c5c5a29.sw: Mwishowe, sehemu ambayo karibu hakuna nyenzo inayoifunika: la kufanya ikiwa tayari imetokea.

d77541fc30d8.sw: Kwamba bei ya Bitcoin lazima ipande kwa muda

d77984b9fc20.en: A blockchain is not immutable the way a law of physics is immutable. It is expensive to rewrite — that is all, and the protection is economic, not magical. Nakamoto's own paper states the assumption plainly: the system holds as long as a majority of the network's computing power is honest. On Bitcoin, outspending the honest majority would cost billions, so the protection is very strong. On small networks it is not: rented mining power has repeatedly rewritten real chains. Ethereum Classic was successfully attacked three times in August 2020 — one attack reorganized thousands of blocks, about two days of history — and Bitcoin Gold lost roughly 18 million dollars to double-spends in a 2018 rewrite. Same design as Bitcoin. Much less honest work protecting it. When someone says "the blockchain can't be changed," the honest translation is: "changing it costs more than attackers are willing to spend — on this chain, today." How these 51% attacks actually work is Lesson 3's subject.
d77984b9fc20.sw: Mnyororo wa vitalu haubadiliki kwa namna ambayo sheria ya fizikia haibadiliki. Ni ghali kuandika upya — hiyo ndiyo yote, na ulinzi ni wa kiuchumi, si wa kichawi. Karatasi ya Nakamoto yenyewe hutaja dhana wazi: mfumo hushikilia maadamu wingi wa nguvu ya kihesabu ya mtandao ni mwaminifu. Katika Bitcoin, kuwazidi matumizi wingi mwaminifu kungegharimu mabilioni, kwa hivyo ulinzi ni imara sana. Katika mitandao midogo si hivyo: nguvu ya uchimbaji iliyokodishwa imeandika upya minyororo halisi mara kwa mara. Ethereum Classic ilishambuliwa kwa mafanikio mara tatu mwezi Agosti 2020 — shambulizi moja lilipanga upya maelfu ya vitalu, takriban siku mbili za historia — na Bitcoin Gold ilipoteza takriban dola milioni 18 kwa matumizi-mara-mbili katika uandikaji upya wa 2018. Muundo uleule kama Bitcoin. Kazi ndogo zaidi ya waaminifu ikiilinda. Mtu anaposema "mnyororo wa vitalu hauwezi kubadilishwa," tafsiri ya kweli ni: "kuubadilisha hugharimu zaidi ya kile washambuliaji wako tayari kutumia — katika mnyororo huu, leo." Jinsi mashambulizi haya ya 51% yanavyofanya kazi hasa ni mada ya Somo la 3.

d7aadbcd7aeb.en: Not quite — with a poor risk-to-reward ratio, even a 70% win rate can barely break even or lose. Win rate alone does not decide profitability.
d7aadbcd7aeb.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kwa uwiano mbaya wa hatari-kwa-tuzo, hata kiwango cha ushindi cha 70% kinaweza kulingana kwa shida au kupoteza. Kiwango cha ushindi peke yake hakiamui faida.

d7ac981d51f9.en: Four: entry and exit conditions. What has to be true for you to buy, and what has to be true for you to sell. Chapter 6 gives the thesis framework that fills this section properly.
d7ac981d51f9.sw: Nne: masharti ya kuingia na kutoka. Nini lazima kiwe kweli ili ununue, na nini lazima kiwe kweli ili uuze. Sura ya 6 hutoa mfumo wa nadharia unaojaza sehemu hii ipasavyo.

d7aec54fb8a6.en: A safe haven is always gold

d7b3d24db8fd.en: Not quite — digital money existed for decades before Bitcoin. A trusted central party kept the ledger and rejected already-spent money. What was new in 2008 was removing that central party.
d7b3d24db8fd.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — pesa ya kidijitali ilikuwepo kwa miongo kabla ya Bitcoin. Upande mkuu unaoaminika ulitunza leja na kukataa pesa iliyokwisha kutumika. Kilichokuwa kipya mwaka 2008 ni kuondoa upande huo mkuu.

d7bcc18be17f.en: On 9 January 2024, a post appeared on the official X account of the United States Securities and Exchange Commission announcing approval of spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds. The announcement was false. Bitcoin jumped by more than 1,000 dollars, then fell back when the agency corrected the record. The agency later confirmed the account had been taken over through a SIM swap of the phone number attached to it. It also disclosed that multi-factor authentication on the account had been disabled some months earlier, at staff request, after access problems. In May 2025, Eric Council Jr. was sentenced to 14 months in prison for his role in the conspiracy, after pleading guilty in the United States District Court for the District of Columbia. Court filings put his earnings from SIM-swap work at around 50,000 dollars.
d7bcc18be17f.sw: Tarehe 9 Januari 2024, chapisho lilijitokeza katika akaunti rasmi ya X ya United States Securities and Exchange Commission likitangaza idhini ya mifuko ya biashara ya bitcoin ya papo hapo. Tangazo lilikuwa la uongo. Bitcoin iliruka kwa zaidi ya dola 1,000, kisha ikashuka wakala ulipoirekebisha rekodi. Wakala baadaye ulithibitisha akaunti ilikuwa imechukuliwa kupitia ubadilishaji wa SIM wa namba ya simu iliyoambatishwa nayo. Pia ulifichua kwamba uthibitishaji wa vipengele vingi katika akaunti ulikuwa umezimwa miezi kadhaa mapema, kwa ombi la wafanyakazi, baada ya matatizo ya kufikia. Mwezi Mei 2025, Eric Council Jr. alihukumiwa miezi 14 gerezani kwa nafasi yake katika njama, baada ya kukiri kosa katika United States District Court for the District of Columbia. Wasilisho la mahakama liliweka mapato yake kutoka kazi ya ubadilishaji wa SIM katika takriban dola 50,000.

d7e4815532e8.en: Not quite — at 1:2 break-even is 33.3% (A profits), but at 1:1 break-even is 50% (B loses at 40%). The ratio flips the outcome.
d7e4815532e8.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — kwa 1:2 kulingana ni 33.3% (A hupata faida), lakini kwa 1:1 kulingana ni 50% (B hupoteza kwa 40%). Uwiano hubadilisha tokeo.

d7e8d22a7469.sw: Kwa sababu kubeba hutumika kwa nafasi za sarafu pekee

d7f5d1a0c481.en: If you adopt a tilt, the commitment has to outlast the drought. A value tilt abandoned after five poor years captures the underperformance and none of the premium, which is a worse outcome than never tilting at all. That is a behavioural requirement rather than an analytical one, and it is the part most people fail.
d7f5d1a0c481.sw: Kama utakubali mwelekeo, ahadi lazima izidi ukame. Mwelekeo wa thamani ulioachwa baada ya miaka mitano mibaya hunasa utendaji duni na hakuna kati ya malipo ya ziada, ambalo ni tokeo baya zaidi kuliko kutokuwa na mwelekeo kabisa. Hilo ni hitaji la kitabia badala ya la kiuchambuzi, na ndiyo sehemu ambayo watu wengi hushindwa.

d7f72c783031.en: That distinction between in-sample and out-of-sample is the whole lesson in two words. A model can fit history beautifully and still tell you nothing about tomorrow. Practitioner critics reached the same place by a different route, arguing that the fit is largely an artefact of both variables rising with time, which makes the regression statistically spurious.
d7f72c783031.sw: Tofauti hiyo kati ya ndani ya sampuli na nje ya sampuli ndilo somo zima katika maneno mawili. Mfano unaweza kufaa historia kwa uzuri na bado usikuambie lolote kuhusu kesho. Wakosoaji watendaji walifikia mahali pale kwa njia tofauti, wakidai kwamba ufaafu kwa kiasi kikubwa ni matokeo ya vigezo vyote viwili kupanda na wakati, jambo linalofanya urejeshaji kuwa wa uongo kitakwimu.

d8058e6d0f62.en: Finality is the reason crypto has no undo button. In Lesson 4 you saw that a payment sent to a wrong address is gone — now you know precisely when "gone" becomes true: once the transaction is buried (proof-of-work) or finalized (proof-of-stake), no bank, no support ticket, and no court order can rewrite the ledger entry. Banks reverse mistaken transfers because a referee keeps their ledger. This track began, in Lesson 1, with the removal of that referee. Irreversibility is not a bug in that design — it is the design. Check the address, check the amount, check the fee, then send.
d8058e6d0f62.sw: Umalizio ndiyo sababu kripto haina kitufe cha kutendua. Katika Somo la 4 uliona kwamba malipo yaliyotumwa kwa anwani isiyo sahihi yameenda — sasa unajua hasa "yameenda" huwa kweli lini: mara muamala unapozikwa (uthibitisho-wa-kazi) au kukamilishwa (uthibitisho-wa-hisa), hakuna benki, hakuna tikiti ya msaada, wala amri ya mahakama inayoweza kuandika upya kiingizo cha leja. Benki hutendua uhamisho wa makosa kwa sababu mwamuzi hutunza leja yao. Njia hii ilianza, katika Somo la 1, kwa kuondoa mwamuzi huyo. Kutotenduka si hitilafu katika muundo huo — ndio muundo. Kagua anwani, kagua kiasi, kagua ada, kisha tuma.

d80eb00cc7d8.en: Medium = 1-hour → long = 4-hour, short = 15-minute. Medium = daily → long = weekly, short = 4-hour. The exact multiplier isn't sacred (some traders use six), but the principle is: each timeframe should be far enough apart to tell you something genuinely different.
d80eb00cc7d8.sw: Kati = saa 1 → mrefu = saa 4, mfupi = dakika 15. Kati = kila siku → mrefu = wiki, mfupi = saa 4. Kizidishi kamili si kitakatifu (baadhi ya wafanyabiashara hutumia sita), lakini kanuni ni: kila kipindi kinapaswa kuwa mbali vya kutosha na kingine ili kikuambie kitu tofauti kweli.

d82857bd4c4b.en: In March you approve a new exchange application to spend a stablecoin, accepting the default unlimited allowance for a 200 dollar swap. You use it twice, then never return. In November your wallet holds 6,000 dollars of that token and the application's contract is exploited. What is your exposure?
d82857bd4c4b.sw: Mwezi Machi unaidhinisha programu mpya ya soko la kubadilisha kutumia sarafu imara, ukikubali posho isiyo na mpaka ya chaguo-msingi kwa ubadilishaji wa dola 200. Unaitumia mara mbili, kisha hurudi kamwe. Mwezi Novemba pochi yako inashikilia dola 6,000 za tokeni hiyo na mkataba wa programu unavamiwa. Kufunuliwa kwako ni kupi?

d82be04c9a69.en: Not quite — the coin moved to a wallet the exchange controls, and the blockchain shows the exchange owning it. Your balance is an IOU in the company's internal ledger, so every trade there is a database entry and an exchange failure hits your claim, not the chain.
d82be04c9a69.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — sarafu ilisogea kwenda pochi ambayo soko huidhibiti, na mnyororo wa vitalu huonyesha soko likiimiliki. Salio lako ni deni katika leja ya ndani ya kampuni, kwa hivyo kila biashara hapo ni kiingizo cha hifadhidata na kushindwa kwa soko hugonga dai lako, si mnyororo.

d84e8644f541.en: From 2011 the Swiss National Bank — a money-printing central bank, the strongest peg-defender that can exist — held a floor under the euro against the Swiss franc and promised to defend it with "the utmost determination." Traders treated the floor as a law of nature. On 15 January 2015 the SNB abandoned it without warning, and the franc moved roughly 30 percent in minutes. Accounts were wiped out not because traders mispriced the odds, but because they had stopped treating the peg as a promise at all.
d84e8644f541.sw: Kuanzia 2011 Benki Kuu ya Uswisi — benki kuu inayochapisha pesa, mtetezi wa pegi mwenye nguvu zaidi anayeweza kuwepo — ilishikilia sakafu chini ya yuro dhidi ya faranga ya Uswisi na kuahidi kuitetea kwa "azimio la juu kabisa." Wafanyabiashara waliichukulia sakafu kama sheria ya asili. Tarehe 15 Januari 2015 SNB iliiacha bila onyo, na faranga ilisonga takriban asilimia 30 ndani ya dakika. Akaunti zilifutwa si kwa sababu wafanyabiashara walipanga bei ya uwezekano vibaya, bali kwa sababu walikuwa wameacha kuichukulia pegi kama ahadi kabisa.

d8753b280693.en: Now the nonce makes sense. A block's hash is computed over everything in it — transactions, previous-block hash, timestamp, and the nonce. Because of the avalanche effect, changing the nonce by 1 gives the block a completely new hash. The nonce is a dial you can turn to re-roll the block's fingerprint as many times as you like.
d8753b280693.sw: Sasa nonce ina maana. Heshi ya kitalu huhesabiwa juu ya kila kitu kilichomo — miamala, heshi ya kitalu kilichotangulia, alama ya muda, na nonce. Kwa sababu ya athari ya poromoko, kubadilisha nonce kwa 1 hukipa kitalu heshi mpya kabisa. Nonce ni kifundo unachoweza kukizungusha ili kurusha upya alama ya vidole ya kitalu mara nyingi kadiri unavyopenda.

d8822fab6cdc.en: Once the balance sheet was public, withdrawing was the correct decision for every individual customer regardless of what they believed about the firm. If it was fine, withdrawing cost nothing. If it was not, withdrawing was the only thing that helped. That asymmetry is why runs complete in days.
d8822fab6cdc.sw: Mara karatasi ya salio ilipokuwa ya umma, kutoa kulikuwa uamuzi sahihi kwa kila mteja binafsi bila kujali walichokiamini kuhusu kampuni. Ikiwa ilikuwa sawa, kutoa hakukugharimu chochote. Ikiwa haikuwa sawa, kutoa ndilo jambo pekee lililosaidia. Ukosefu huo wa ulinganifu ndiyo sababu mikimbio hukamilika ndani ya siku.

d8834f646479.en: Equity, used margin and free margin; the two thresholds; and how the same position calls a small account at 200 pips but a well-sized one only at 1,800.
d8834f646479.sw: Usawa, margin iliyotumika na margin huru; vizingiti viwili; na jinsi nafasi ile ile inavyoita akaunti ndogo kwa pip 200 lakini iliyopimwa vizuri kwa pip 1,800 tu.

d888e219983f.en: On 14 March 2021, the analytics firm CryptoQuant issued an alert reporting an aggregated inflow of 18,961 BTC — worth about 1.145 billion US dollars, implying a price near 60,400 dollars per coin — to the exchange Gemini, and warned of downside risk from whales selling. Bitcoin fell from roughly 60,500 dollars to roughly 54,000 dollars, a drop of about 11 percent, and many commentators blamed the alert for the panic. The following day the rival firm Glassnode publicly disputed the reading, saying the movement was internal to Gemini rather than a whale depositing. CryptoQuant then said the transfer had come from BlockFi and was technically external, defended its data, and announced it would remove definitive wording such as warnings about dumping from its alerts so users could draw their own conclusions.
d888e219983f.sw: Tarehe 14 Machi 2021, kampuni ya uchambuzi CryptoQuant ilitoa tahadhari ikiripoti mwingizo uliokusanywa wa BTC 18,961 — wenye thamani ya takriban dola bilioni 1.145 za Marekani, ukiashiria bei karibu na dola 60,400 kwa sarafu — kwa soko la kubadilisha Gemini, na kuonya kuhusu hatari ya kushuka kutokana na nyangumi kuuza. Bitcoin ilishuka kutoka takriban dola 60,500 hadi takriban dola 54,000, kushuka kwa takriban asilimia 11, na wachambuzi wengi walilaumu tahadhari kwa hofu. Siku iliyofuata kampuni pinzani Glassnode ilipinga usomaji hadharani, ikisema msogeo ulikuwa wa ndani wa Gemini badala ya nyangumi kuweka amana. CryptoQuant kisha ilisema uhamisho ulikuwa umetoka BlockFi na kiufundi ulikuwa wa nje, ikatetea data yake, na ikatangaza itaondoa maneno ya uhakika kama vile maonyo kuhusu kumwaga kutoka tahadhari zake ili watumiaji waweze kufikia hitimisho zao wenyewe.

d893daba20ab.en: Correct — the opposite. When nothing aligns, cash is the correct position. Forcing a trade in an all-quiet regime is overtrading, which gives edges back.
d893daba20ab.sw: Sahihi — ni kinyume. Hakuna kinapolingana, fedha taslimu ndiyo nafasi sahihi. Kulazimisha biashara katika hali ya utulivu kamili ni kufanya biashara kupita kiasi, ambako hurudisha faida.

d89db9fd9948.en: Terra was described as decentralised, and in a technical sense parts of it were. The observable behaviour during the collapse was that a foundation held a reserve, made a decision about when and how to deploy it, and executed that decision over a few days. d8dd81d293e0.en: Walk through what a would-be history editor faces. They edit an old transaction, so — avalanche effect — that block's hash is now completely different. The next block stored the old hash as its "previous block" link, so the chain is visibly broken, and every computer holding a copy can see it with a few instant hash checks. To hide the break, the attacker must redo the edited block's proof-of-work — which gives it a new hash, breaking the next link. So they must redo that block too. And the next. Every block after the edit, one by one. Meanwhile the honest network keeps adding new blocks roughly every ten minutes — the attacker is chasing a target that moves away at the full speed of the world's honest mining power.
d8dd81d293e0.sw: Pitia kile ambacho mhariri wa historia anayetaka hukabiliana nacho. Anahariri muamala wa zamani, kwa hivyo — athari ya poromoko — heshi ya kitalu hicho sasa ni tofauti kabisa. Kitalu kinachofuata kilihifadhi heshi ya zamani kama kiungo chake cha "kitalu kilichotangulia," kwa hivyo mnyororo umevunjika kwa kuonekana, na kila kompyuta inayoshikilia nakala inaweza kuiona kwa ukaguzi mchache wa papo hapo wa heshi. Kuficha uvunjifu, mshambuliaji lazima arudie uthibitisho-wa-kazi wa kitalu kilichohaririwa — jambo linalokipa heshi mpya, likivunja kiungo kinachofuata. Kwa hivyo lazima arudie kitalu hicho pia. Na kinachofuata. Kila kitalu baada ya uhariri, kimoja baada ya kingine. Wakati huohuo mtandao mwaminifu unaendelea kuongeza vitalu vipya takriban kila dakika kumi — mshambuliaji anakimbiza lengo linalojiondoa kwa kasi kamili ya nguvu ya uchimbaji ya waaminifu ya dunia nzima.

da268feb1c94.en: The checklist for this week. Work through these in order; most people can finish the first five in one evening. 1. Move your email account to app-based or hardware two-factor authentication, and remove your phone number as a recovery method if the provider allows it, because your email resets everything else. Save the backup codes offline. 2. Replace SMS two-factor authentication with an authenticator app on every exchange account you hold, or a hardware security key or passkey where supported. Save the backup codes offline. 3. Call your mobile carrier and add a port-out PIN or number lock to your account. 4. Open a token-approval checker for each chain you have used, and revoke every approval belonging to a site you are not actively using this week, including chains you used only once. Put a monthly reminder in your calendar to repeat this. 5. Decide what is on-exchange and write the number down: keep only what you are trading in the next few weeks, move the rest out, and turn on a withdrawal address allowlist where one is offered. 6. Check where your seed phrase currently lives. If it exists as a photo, a screenshot, a note in your phone, a password manager entry, a cloud document, or an email to yourself, it is already exposed to anything that reads those. Write it on paper or metal, store it offline, and delete every digital copy. 7. Create a second wallet for connecting to new applications, funded only with what you are willing to lose, and stop connecting your main wallet to sites entirely. 8. Do the restore drill from Chapter 1 Lesson 4 if you have never done it: send a small amount to a self-custody wallet, delete the wallet, and restore it from your written phrase on a different device. 9. Bookmark every crypto site you use, and reach them only from bookmarks from now on. 10. Write one sentence and keep it where you will see it: nobody legitimate will ever ask for my seed phrase, and I will never type it into anything I did not open myself.
da268feb1c94.sw: Orodha ya kukagua ya wiki hii. Pitia hizi kwa mpangilio; watu wengi wanaweza kumaliza tano za kwanza jioni moja. 1. Hamisha akaunti yako ya barua pepe kwenda uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili unaotegemea programu au maunzi, na uondoe namba yako ya simu kama njia ya urejeshaji ikiwa mtoa huduma ataruhusu, kwa sababu barua pepe yako huweka upya kila kitu kingine. Hifadhi misimbo ya akiba nje ya mtandao. 2. Badilisha uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili wa SMS na programu ya kuthibitisha katika kila akaunti ya soko la kubadilisha unayoshikilia, au ufunguo halisi wa usalama au passkey pale unapoungwa mkono. Hifadhi misimbo ya akiba nje ya mtandao. 3. Piga simu mtoa huduma wako wa simu na uongeze PIN ya kutoa namba au kufunga namba katika akaunti yako. 4. Fungua kikagua idhini za tokeni kwa kila mnyororo uliotumia, na ubatilishe kila idhini ya tovuti ambayo hutumii kwa bidii wiki hii, ikiwa ni pamoja na minyororo uliyoitumia mara moja tu. Weka kikumbusho cha kila mwezi katika kalenda yako kurudia hili. 5. Amua nini kiko katika soko la kubadilisha na uandike namba: weka kile tu unachokifanyia biashara katika wiki chache zijazo, sogeza kilichobaki nje, na uwashe orodha ya anwani zinazoruhusiwa za utoaji pale inapotolewa. 6. Kagua kifungu chako cha mbegu kinapoishi kwa sasa. Ikiwa kipo kama picha, picha ya skrini, noti katika simu yako, kiingizo cha meneja wa manenosiri, hati ya wingu, au barua pepe kwako mwenyewe, tayari kimefunuliwa kwa chochote kinachosoma hivyo. Kiandike katika karatasi au chuma, kihifadhi nje ya mtandao, na ufute kila nakala ya kidijitali. 7. Unda pochi ya pili ya kuunganisha na programu mpya, iliyofadhiliwa tu na kile ulicho tayari kupoteza, na uache kuunganisha pochi yako kuu na tovuti kabisa. 8. Fanya zoezi la kurejesha kutoka Sura ya 1 Somo la 4 ikiwa hujawahi kulifanya: tuma kiasi kidogo kwa pochi ya utunzaji binafsi, futa pochi, na uirejeshe kutoka kifungu chako kilichoandikwa katika kifaa tofauti. 9. Weka alamisho kwa kila tovuti ya kripto unayoitumia, na uzifikie kutoka alamisho pekee kuanzia sasa. 10. Andika sentensi moja na uiweke mahali utakapoiona: hakuna mtu halali atakayewahi kuomba kifungu changu cha mbegu, nami sitakiandika kamwe katika chochote ambacho sikukifungua mwenyewe.

da37d0ef7dd0.en: The single most important RSI discipline — and the mistake that costs beginners the most: do not buy simply because something is oversold, and do not short simply because it's overbought. Markets can stay overbought or oversold for a very long time while continuing in the same direction — an oversold currency can keep getting more oversold, day after day. Buying it on the way down is catching a falling knife with a statistics label on it.
da37d0ef7dd0.sw: Nidhamu muhimu kuliko zote ya RSI — na kosa linalowagharimu wanaoanza zaidi: usinunue tu kwa sababu kitu kimeuzwa kupita kiasi, na usifanye short tu kwa sababu kimenunuliwa kupita kiasi. Masoko yanaweza kubaki yamenunuliwa au kuuzwa kupita kiasi kwa muda mrefu sana huku yakiendelea kwa mwelekeo ule ule — sarafu iliyouzwa kupita kiasi inaweza kuendelea kuuzwa zaidi kupita kiasi, siku baada ya siku. Kuinunua ikishuka ni kukamata kisu kinachoanguka chenye lebo ya takwimu.

da3af895fe20.en: The formula the major venues publish reduces, for a simple single position in isolated margin, to this. Liquidation price for a long = entry price x (1 - 1 divided by leverage + maintenance margin rate). Which means the adverse move that liquidates you, as a percentage of entry, is approximately 1 divided by leverage, minus the maintenance margin rate. Read that carefully, because it is the whole lesson in one expression. The distance to your liquidation is set by your leverage and almost nothing else. It is not set by your skill, your analysis, your conviction, or how right you turn out to be three days later.
da3af895fe20.sw: Fomula ambayo viwanja vikuu huichapisha hupungua, kwa nafasi rahisi moja katika mkopo uliotengwa, kuwa hii. Bei ya ufilisi kwa nafasi ndefu = bei ya kuingia x (1 - 1 ikigawanywa na mzingo + kiwango cha mkopo wa kudumisha). Ambayo humaanisha msogeo mbaya unaokufilisi, kama asilimia ya kuingia, ni takriban 1 ikigawanywa na mzingo, ukiondoa kiwango cha mkopo wa kudumisha. Soma hilo kwa uangalifu, kwa sababu ni somo zima katika usemi mmoja. Umbali hadi ufilisi wako huwekwa na mzingo wako na karibu hakuna kingine. Hauwekwi na ujuzi wako, uchambuzi wako, msimamo wako thabiti, wala jinsi unavyojitokeza kuwa sahihi siku tatu baadaye.

da4830e12f62.en: Social volume is the sentiment measure that is easiest to fake. The metric cannot tell them apart, so you must.

Kipimo hakiwezi kuvitofautisha, kwa hivyo lazima wewe uvitofautishe.

db1f8f80820d.en: The mechanics, using Ethereum — the largest Proof of Stake network — as the example. First, you lock capital: a validator deposits 32 ETH into the protocol as collateral. Second, the protocol takes turns: for each slot it pseudo-randomly selects one validator to propose the block, and committees of other validators attest that the proposal is valid. No race, no puzzle — selection replaces competition, which is why the electricity bill collapses. Third, honesty is paid and provable cheating is punished: sign two conflicting blocks for the same slot, or two conflicting votes, and the protocol itself contains the proof of your dishonesty — any observer can submit those two signatures and trigger an automatic penalty.
db1f8f80820d.sw: Mitambo, ikitumia Ethereum — mtandao mkubwa zaidi wa Uthibitisho wa Hisa — kama mfano. Kwanza, unafungia mtaji: mthibitishaji huweka ETH 32 katika itifaki kama dhamana. Pili, itifaki hupokezana zamu: kwa kila nafasi huchagua kwa nasibu-bandia mthibitishaji mmoja kupendekeza kitalu, na kamati za wathibitishaji wengine hushuhudia kwamba pendekezo ni halali. Hakuna mashindano, hakuna kitendawili — uchaguzi hubadilisha ushindani, ndiyo maana bili ya umeme huporomoka. Tatu, uaminifu hulipwa na udanganyifu unaothibitishika huadhibiwa: tia sahihi vitalu viwili vinavyopingana kwa nafasi ileile, au kura mbili zinazopingana, na itifaki yenyewe ina uthibitisho wa ukosefu wako wa uaminifu — mtazamaji yeyote anaweza kuwasilisha sahihi hizo mbili na kuchochea adhabu ya kiotomatiki.

And the famous 21 million limit is not in the paper either — it appears in the software rules, not the whitepaper. Reading the actual nine pages, rather than what people say about them, is this track's first exercise in verifying the claim.

Na kikomo maarufu cha milioni 21 hakimo katika karatasi pia — kinajitokeza katika kanuni za programu, si katika karatasi nyeupe. Kusoma kurasa tisa halisi, badala ya kile watu wanachosema kuzihusu, ndilo zoezi la kwanza la njia hii la kuthibitisha dai.

dcb5f6b631e7.en: Asness, Moskowitz and Pedersen, in Value and Momentum Everywhere, published in the Journal of Finance in 2013, found both value and momentum premia across eight different markets and asset classes, and — the finding that matters for a thesis — that value and momentum are negatively correlated with each other. Two pillars that disagree are not a contradiction. They are the reason to hold both.

dcc0db8bf4ee.en: A short can also be closed against your will. The lender can recall the borrowed shares at any time, forcing you to buy back immediately whatever the price. If many shorts are forced to buy at once, their buying drives the price up, forcing more of them to buy — a short squeeze. Chapter 5 examines the most famous recent example, and finds the popular explanation of it does not survive contact with the regulator's own report.

Kama short nyingi zitalazimishwa kununua kwa wakati mmoja, ununuzi wao husukuma bei juu, ukilazimisha nyingi zaidi kununua — mnyanyaso wa short. Sura ya 5 huchunguza mfano maarufu zaidi wa hivi karibuni, na hugundua maelezo maarufu yake hayanusuriki kukutana na ripoti ya mdhibiti mwenyewe.

dcf1fd07d761.en: Energy. Proof of Work's consumption is real and large. The standard reference is the Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index; a 2025 Cambridge study built on industry survey data estimated Bitcoin mining at roughly 138 TWh per year — about 0.5% of global electricity consumption, in the range of a mid-sized country. (The index updates daily, so treat any single number as a snapshot, not a constant.) Proof of Stake removes almost all of this. When Ethereum switched from PoW to PoS on 15 September 2022 — the Merge — the Ethereum Foundation's estimate was that energy use fell by about 99.95%, and an independent assessment by the Crypto Carbon Ratings Institute measured the drop at over 99.98%. On energy, the difference is not close, and honest PoW advocates do not claim it is. The real dispute is whether the energy buys something PoS cannot replicate.
dcf1fd07d761.sw: Nishati. Matumizi ya Uthibitisho wa Kazi ni halisi na makubwa. Rejeleo la kawaida ni Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index; utafiti wa Cambridge wa 2025 uliojengwa juu ya data ya utafiti wa tasnia ulikadiria uchimbaji wa Bitcoin katika takriban TWh 138 kwa mwaka — takriban 0.5% ya matumizi ya umeme duniani, katika kiwango cha nchi ya kadiri. (Faharasa hujisasisha kila siku, kwa hivyo chukulia namba yoyote moja kama picha ya wakati, si kitu kisichobadilika.) Uthibitisho wa Hisa huondoa karibu yote haya. Ethereum ilipohama kutoka PoW hadi PoS tarehe 15 Septemba 2022 — the Merge — makadirio ya Ethereum Foundation yalikuwa kwamba matumizi ya nishati yalishuka kwa takriban 99.95%, na tathmini huru ya Crypto Carbon Ratings Institute ilipima kushuka kwa zaidi ya 99.98%. Kuhusu nishati, tofauti si karibu, na watetezi waaminifu wa PoW hawadai ni karibu. Mzozo halisi ni kama nishati inanunua kitu ambacho PoS haiwezi kukiiga.

de7637a77045.en: This closes the loop on everything Foundations has covered. A chart, a candlestick pattern, a support level — all of it is information. None of it is a decision by itself. Usimamizi wa hatari ndicho kinachogeuza taarifa kuwa uamuzi unaodhibitiwa. Usomaji kamili wa chati, ukiambatanishwa na kutokuwa na usimamizi wa hatari, bado ni mkakati wa hasara unaosubiri kutokea. Usomaji wa wastani, ukiambatanishwa na usimamizi halisi wa hatari, unaweza bado kubaki hai kufanya biashara siku nyingine.

de7aba45a353.en: Given everything in this lesson: for the pair GBP/JPY, which currency would you expect to be the base, and which the quote — based purely on the pecking order? Check your answer against the hierarchy diagram above.
de7aba45a353.sw: Kwa kuzingatia kila kitu katika somo hili: kwa jozi GBP/JPY, ungetarajia sarafu ipi iwe msingi, na ipi iwe bei — kwa msingi wa daraja tu? Kagua jibu lako dhidi ya mchoro wa daraja hapo juu.

de9800f605cd.en: Most calendars let you click through for detail: the source institution, what the indicator measures, why traders care, and the historical record of actual-vs-forecast. That history is genuinely useful — it shows you whether a given release tends to surprise or reliably lands on consensus.
de9800f605cd.sw: Kalenda nyingi hukuruhusu kubofya ndani kwa maelezo: taasisi ya chanzo, kiashiria kinachopima nini, kwa nini wafanyabiashara wanajali, na rekodi ya kihistoria ya halisi-dhidi-ya-utabiri. Historia hiyo ina manufaa kweli — inakuonyesha kama toleo fulani huelekea kushangaza au hutua kwa makubaliano kwa kutegemewa.

de9f70c3f7d2.en: A worked thesis. Fundamentals: fee revenue paid by users has risen for three consecutive quarters and is not attributable to a single application or an incentive programme — supportive, and checkable next quarter. Valuation: replaced by supply arithmetic — circulating supply is 60% of total, with the remainder unlocking over 24 months, so the effective supply grows about 2.7% a month while I hold — against. Catalyst: a protocol change with an uncertain outcome scheduled within two months — supportive, with a date. Positioning: funding has been mildly negative for three weeks, meaning leveraged positioning leans short rather than crowded long — supportive. Momentum: price below its level three months ago — against. Carry: staking pays 4%, of which the published split shows most comes from fees rather than issuance — mildly supportive.
de9f70c3f7d2.sw: Nadharia iliyofanyiwa kazi. Misingi: mapato ya ada yaliyolipwa na watumiaji yamepanda kwa robo tatu mfululizo nayo hayahusishwi na programu moja au mpango wa motisha — inaunga mkono, na inaweza kukaguliwa robo ijayo. Tathmini: imebadilishwa na hesabu ya usambazaji — usambazaji unaozunguka ni 60% ya jumla, huku kilichobaki kikifunguliwa katika miezi 24, kwa hivyo usambazaji halisi hukua takriban 2.7% kwa mwezi ninaposhikilia — inapinga. Kichocheo: mabadiliko ya itifaki yenye matokeo yasiyo na uhakika yaliyopangwa ndani ya miezi miwili — inaunga mkono, ikiwa na tarehe. Msimamo: ufadhili umekuwa hasi kidogo kwa wiki tatu, ukimaanisha msimamo wenye mzingo huegemea mfupi badala ya mrefu uliojaa — inaunga mkono. Kasi: bei iko chini ya kiwango chake cha miezi mitatu iliyopita — inapinga. Kubeba: kuweka hisa hulipa 4%, ambapo mgawanyo uliochapishwa huonyesha sehemu kubwa hutoka ada badala ya utoaji — inaunga mkono kidogo.

de9fcca37948.en: The tendency to hold a much larger share of domestic companies than their weight in the world market would suggest.
de9fcca37948.sw: Mwelekeo wa kushikilia sehemu kubwa mno ya kampuni za ndani kuliko uzito wao katika soko la dunia ungedokeza.

dec0ff102db7.en: Not quite. No one resets the price by hand and trading is not halted. An authorised participant can trade directly with the fund, so a gap between the ETF price and the value of its holdings becomes a profit opportunity — and acting on it is what pushes the two back together.
dec0ff102db7.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Hakuna anayeweka upya bei kwa mkono na biashara haisimamishwi. Mshiriki aliyeidhinishwa anaweza kufanya biashara moja kwa moja na fund, hivyo pengo kati ya bei ya ETF na thamani ya umiliki wake hukuwa fursa ya faida — na kutenda juu yake ndicho kinachozisukuma hizo mbili pamoja tena.

dec6a40ccda2.en: A digital currency whose ledger is maintained by a network of computers running shared software rules, secured by cryptography, instead of by a central institution. Bitcoin was the first working example.
dec6a40ccda2.sw: Sarafu ya kidijitali ambayo leja yake hutunzwa na mtandao wa kompyuta zinazoendesha kanuni za programu zinazoshirikiwa, ikilindwa na kriptografia, badala ya na taasisi kuu. Bitcoin ndiyo ilikuwa mfano wa kwanza uliofanya kazi.

ded5685209e5.en: What to look for before buying any fund. The ongoing charge in the official document rather than a comparison website. The platform or custody fee, which is charged separately and often quietly. The tracking difference over three years. And the total of all recurring charges written on one line, because no provider will ever present that total for you.
ded5685209e5.sw: Cha kutazama kabla ya kununua fund yoyote. Malipo ya kudumu katika hati rasmi badala ya tovuti ya kulinganisha. Ada ya jukwaa au ya uhifadhi, ambayo hutozwa tofauti na mara nyingi kimyakimya. Tofauti ya kufuatilia katika miaka mitatu. Na jumla ya malipo yote ya kudumu ikiandikwa kwenye mstari mmoja, kwa sababu hakuna mtoa huduma atakayewahi kukuwasilishia jumla hiyo.

dedb115f2c6a.en: Four pillars transfer intact. One has to be rebuilt because there are no cash flows to value, and one has to be replaced by something that only looks like carry.
dedb115f2c6a.sw: Nguzo nne huhamishika zikiwa kamili. Moja lazima ijengwe upya kwa sababu hakuna mitiririko ya fedha ya kutathmini, na moja lazima ibadilishwe na kitu kinachofanana tu na kubeba.

dee3d9f39de6.en: A deliberate reduction in a currency's official value, typically relative to another asset or currency.
dee3d9f39de6.sw: Kupunguza kwa makusudi thamani rasmi ya sarafu, kwa kawaida ikilinganishwa na mali au sarafu nyingine.

deedfc3c6ce8.en: Read the market regime first because it decides which pillar works; follow a policy shock along the transmission chain from rates to FX to credit/equities to commodities to crypto; and when nothing aligns, hold cash.
deedfc3c6ce8.sw: Soma hali ya soko kwanza kwa sababu huamua ni nguzo ipi inafanya kazi; fuata mshtuko wa sera kupitia mnyororo wa usambazaji kutoka viwango hadi FX hadi mikopo/hisa hadi bidhaa hadi crypto; na hakuna kinapolingana, shikilia fedha taslimu.

def63791252f.en: The forced closure of a leveraged position by the exchange when its equity falls to the maintenance margin. It is not a warning and not a request. It is the Forex track's stop-out level from Chapter 3, Lesson 2, with no margin call in front of it and no human in the loop.
def63791252f.sw: Kufungwa kwa lazima kwa nafasi yenye mzingo na soko la kubadilisha wakati usawa wake unaposhuka hadi mkopo wa kudumisha. Si onyo wala si ombi. Ni kiwango cha kutolewa nje cha njia ya Forex kutoka Sura ya 3, Somo la 2, bila wito wa mkopo mbele yake na bila binadamu katika mzunguko.

def6dd49909c.en: Because more holdings always means more risk
def6dd49909c.sw: Kwa sababu umiliki mwingi daima humaanisha hatari zaidi

deff3f7045a6.en: Selling 80,000 bitcoin into an already nervous market pushed the Bitcoin price down — it fell from around 39,000 to around 28,000 dollars over that week. Someone holding only Bitcoin, who had never touched Terra, had never heard of Anchor, and had made no error of any kind, was harmed by a mechanism failing in a system they had deliberately avoided.
deff3f7045a6.sw: Kuuza bitcoin 80,000 katika soko lililokuwa tayari na wasiwasi kulisukuma bei ya Bitcoin chini — ilishuka kutoka takriban dola 39,000 hadi takriban 28,000 katika wiki hiyo. Mtu anayeshikilia Bitcoin pekee, ambaye hakuwahi kugusa Terra, hakuwahi kusikia kuhusu Anchor, na hakufanya kosa la aina yoyote, alidhurika na utaratibu ukishindwa katika mfumo aliouepuka kwa makusudi.

df037c3510a4.en: Two fee mistakes cost beginners real money. First: sending with too low a fee. The network does not reject your transaction — it just never selects it, and your payment can sit in limbo for hours or days. Second: ignoring the fee-to-amount ratio. Fees price the size and complexity of the transaction, not its value — moving 20 dollars can cost exactly the same fee as moving 1 million dollars. During a fee spike, paying 50 dollars of fees to move 20 dollars of coins is not a rounding error; it is a 250 percent cost. Always check the fee against the amount before confirming.
df037c3510a4.sw: Makosa mawili ya ada huwagharimu waanzilishi pesa halisi. Kwanza: kutuma kwa ada ndogo mno. Mtandao haukatai muamala wako — huchagui tu, na malipo yako yanaweza kukaa mashakani kwa masaa au siku. Pili: kupuuza uwiano wa ada-kwa-kiasi. Ada hupanga bei ya ukubwa na uchangamano wa muamala, si thamani yake — kuhamisha dola 20 kunaweza kugharimu ada ileile hasa kama kuhamisha dola milioni 1. Wakati wa mlipuko wa ada, kulipa ada za dola 50 kuhamisha sarafu za dola 20 si kosa la kuzungusha namba; ni gharama ya asilimia 250. Daima kagua ada dhidi ya kiasi kabla ya kuthibitisha.

df0c1c66d508.en: That is the cleanest statement of the whole lesson. At high leverage there is no position size at which the risk budget and the liquidation level are compatible. The budget says you may lose 10 dollars. The instrument says the smallest unit of loss it can deliver is most of your margin.
df0c1c66d508.sw: Hiyo ndiyo kauli iliyo safi zaidi ya somo zima. Katika mzingo mkubwa hakuna ukubwa wa nafasi ambapo bajeti ya hatari na kiwango cha ufilisi vinaendana. Bajeti husema unaweza kupoteza dola 10. Chombo husema kipimo kidogo zaidi cha hasara kinachoweza kukitoa ni sehemu kubwa ya mkopo wako.

df4b98cebb87.en: A finding about one definition of value is not automatically a finding about the fund on your screen.
df4b98cebb87.sw: Tokeo kuhusu maana moja ya thamani si tokeo kiotomatiki kuhusu fund iliyo kwenye skrini yako.

df5cc46d93a6.en: Limited liability caps what you can lose on one company. It does not cap what you can lose overall, and it does not apply if you borrow to buy the shares. Money borrowed on margin is still owed after the shares are worthless — the loss stops at zero for the share, not for you. Chapter 3 covers this properly.
df5cc46d93a6.sw: Dhima yenye kikomo huweka kikomo cha unachoweza kupoteza kwenye kampuni moja. Haiwekei kikomo unachoweza kupoteza kwa ujumla, na haitumiki kama utakopa kununua hisa. Pesa iliyokopwa kwa margin bado inadaiwa baada ya hisa kuwa bila thamani — hasara husimama kwa sifuri kwa hisa, si kwako. Sura ya 3 inashughulikia hili ipasavyo.

df784fcfed33.en: Trusting unverified claims. Paying a signal group, following a tip, or believing a promise of guaranteed or unusually high returns. This one is the course's whole reason for existing: verify claims rather than accept them, and treat any guaranteed-return promise as the clearest warning sign there is.
df784fcfed33.sw: Kuamini madai yasiyothibitishwa. Kulipia kikundi cha ishara, kufuata dokezo, au kuamini ahadi ya faida ya uhakika au kubwa isivyo kawaida. Hili ndilo sababu yote ya kuwepo kwa kozi: thibitisha madai badala ya kuyakubali, na chukulia ahadi yoyote ya faida ya uhakika kama ishara ya onyo iliyo wazi zaidi iliyopo.

df7995bea761.sw: Mshambuliaji bado angehitaji kifungu chako cha mbegu kuingia

df9ae4fe3a7b.en: Not quite. Both are valued, and neither is purely objective. The difference is that a share has cash flows, so its price contains an implied forecast you can decompress and disagree with specifically. A currency has no cash flows, so its valuation can only ever be relative to another currency or to its own history.
df9ae4fe3a7b.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Vyote viwili hutathminiwa, na hakuna kilicho cha kiuhalisia kabisa. Tofauti ni kwamba hisa ina mitiririko ya fedha, kwa hivyo bei yake ina utabiri ulioashiriwa ambao unaweza kuufungua na kutokubaliana nao hasa. Sarafu haina mitiririko ya fedha, kwa hivyo tathmini yake inaweza tu kuwa ya kulinganishwa na sarafu nyingine au na historia yake.

df9cfcb0315c.en: The finding has been disproved and value investing does not work
df9cfcb0315c.sw: Tokeo limekanushwa na uwekezaji wa thamani haufanyi kazi

dfa12ec38026.en: Diversification also does the least when it is needed most. In a severe downturn, correlations across companies, sectors and countries rise together — the things that normally move independently start moving as one. The protection is real in ordinary conditions and weakest in the crisis it was bought for. Chapter 5 shows this happening.
dfa12ec38026.sw: Kusambaza pia hufanya kidogo zaidi kinapohitajika zaidi. Katika kushuka kali, uwiano katika kampuni, sekta na nchi hupanda pamoja — vitu vinavyosogea kwa kujitegemea kwa kawaida huanza kusogea kama kimoja. Ulinzi ni halisi katika hali za kawaida na dhaifu zaidi katika janga ambalo ulinunuliwa kwa ajili yake. Sura ya 5 huonyesha hili likitokea.

dfba223492eb.en: That last point is worth making explicit: a sharper entry doesn't just feel better — it mathematically reduces the distance to your stop, which is a direct input to how much you're risking. MTFA isn't just about being right more often; it's about being wrong more cheaply.
dfba223492eb.sw: Pointi hiyo ya mwisho inastahili kuelezwa wazi: kuingia kwa usahihi zaidi hakufanyi tu ujisikie vizuri — kunapunguza kihisabati umbali hadi stop yako, ambao ni pembejeo ya moja kwa moja ya kiasi unachohatarisha. MTFA si kuhusu kuwa sahihi mara nyingi zaidi tu; ni kuhusu kukosea kwa gharama ndogo zaidi.

dfd0e214ef9e.en: The average result of an activity if it were repeated many times: each possible outcome multiplied by its probability, all added together.
dfd0e214ef9e.sw: Tokeo la wastani la shughuli kama ingerudiwa mara nyingi: kila tokeo linalowezekana likizidishwa kwa uwezekano wake, yote yakiongezwa pamoja.

dfd948404a5a.en: Classify each of these: EUR/GBP, USD/ZAR, GBP/JPY, USD/CHF. Which are majors, which are minors (cross pairs), and which are exotics? Work through the definitions above before checking — the rule is simply whether USD is present, and if so, whether the other side is a major or an emerging-market currency.
dfd948404a5a.sw: Ainisha kila moja ya haya: EUR/GBP, USD/ZAR, GBP/JPY, USD/CHF. Ni yapi ni kuu, yapi ni ndogo (jozi za kuvuka), na yapi ni adimu? Pitia maana zilizo hapo juu kabla ya kukagua — kanuni ni kama USD ipo tu, na kama ndiyo, kama upande mwingine ni sarafu kuu au ya soko linaloibukia.

dfdee477f598.en: This is the number that actually describes what happened to your money, and it is why comparing two shares on dividend yield alone is a mistake. A high yield can mean a generous payment. It can equally mean a falling price, since yield is the dividend divided by the price — the denominator shrinking raises the yield just as reliably as the numerator growing.
dfdee477f598.sw: Hii ndiyo namba inayoeleza hasa kilichotokea kwa pesa zako, na ndiyo sababu kulinganisha hisa mbili kwa mavuno ya gawio peke yake ni kosa. Mavuno makubwa yanaweza kumaanisha malipo ya ukarimu. Yanaweza vivyo hivyo kumaanisha bei inayoshuka, kwa kuwa mavuno ni gawio kugawanywa kwa bei — kigawanyaji kinachopungua hupandisha mavuno kwa uhakika kama vile kizidishaji kinachokua.

dfdfb426d144.en: Find any article or video that says "there will only ever be 21 million bitcoin, so the price must rise." Write down, in one sentence each: (1) what the supply cap actually guarantees, and (2) what extra assumption about demand the "must rise" part quietly adds. You now read crypto marketing differently than most participants do.
dfdfb426d144.sw: Tafuta makala au video yoyote inayosema "kutakuwa na bitcoin milioni 21 pekee milele, kwa hivyo bei lazima ipande." Andika, kwa sentensi moja kila kimoja: (1) dari ya usambazaji huhakikisha nini hasa, na (2) ni dhana gani ya ziada kuhusu mahitaji ambayo sehemu ya "lazima ipande" huiongeza kimya kimya. Sasa unasoma masoko ya kripto tofauti na washiriki wengi.

dffee3a17576.en: An equal-weighted version of the same 500 companies gives the smallest constituent exactly the influence of the largest. It therefore tells you what the typical company did, while the cap-weighted version tells you what the typical unit of money did. Those two questions have different answers, and in a market led by a handful of very large companies they can differ substantially over a year.
dffee3a17576.sw: Toleo lenye uzito sawa la kampuni zile zile 500 hutoa mshiriki mdogo zaidi ushawishi hasa wa mkubwa zaidi. Kwa hivyo hukuambia kampuni ya kawaida ilifanya nini, ilhali toleo lenye uzito wa mtaji hukuambia kipimo cha kawaida cha pesa kilifanya nini. Maswali hayo mawili yana majibu tofauti, na katika soko linaloongozwa na kampuni chache kubwa mno yanaweza kutofautiana kwa kiasi kikubwa katika mwaka.

e00b45ed57a8.en: Forex Chapter 6 Lesson 4 made this point and it transfers without modification, but it bites harder here. In an asset class where annual moves are measured in multiples, outcomes carry almost no information about decision quality over any short period. A reckless position can return several hundred percent and a disciplined one can lose money over the same year. If you review only results you will systematically learn the wrong lesson, and you will learn it with great confidence.
e00b45ed57a8.sw: Forex Sura ya 6 Somo la 4 lilitoa hoja hii nayo huhamishika bila marekebisho, lakini huuma zaidi hapa. Katika aina ya rasilimali ambapo misogeo ya kila mwaka hupimwa kwa vizidishi, matokeo hubeba taarifa ndogo mno kuhusu ubora wa uamuzi katika kipindi chochote kifupi. Nafasi ya kizembe inaweza kurudisha mamia kadhaa ya asilimia na yenye nidhamu inaweza kupoteza pesa katika mwaka uleule. Ikiwa unakagua matokeo pekee utajifunza somo lisilo sahihi kwa utaratibu, nawe utalijifunza kwa ujasiri mkubwa.

e044c6551d8c.en: Averaging down is defensible when the reason for owning the company is unchanged and the position stays within its limit. It is not defensible as a way to recover a loss, and the two are almost impossible to tell apart from the inside. The distinguishing test is whether you would open the position at this size today, knowing nothing about what you paid before.
e044c6551d8c.sw: Kupunguza wastani wa bei kunatetewa sababu ya kumiliki kampuni ikiwa haijabadilika na nafasi ikibaki ndani ya kikomo chake. Hakutetewi kama njia ya kupona hasara, na hizo mbili ni karibu haziwezekani kuzitofautisha kutoka ndani. Jaribio la kutofautisha ni kama ungefungua nafasi kwa ukubwa huu leo, bila kujua chochote kuhusu ulicholipa awali.

e052595c9344.sw: Hisa ni nini hasa, inagharimu nini kuimiliki, na ushahidi unasema nini kuhusu kuzimiliki vizuri.

e0549e4a0921.en: Correct. The fee is one input to the shortfall, not the shortfall itself. Trading costs, dividend timing and lending income all contribute. Tracking difference measures the whole gap, and by that measure the more expensive fund delivered more of the index.
e0549e4a0921.sw: Sahihi. Ada ni pembejeo moja ya upungufu, si upungufu wenyewe. Gharama za biashara, muda wa gawio na mapato ya kukopesha vyote huchangia. Tofauti ya kufuatilia hupima pengo lote, na kwa kipimo hicho fund ghali zaidi ilitoa sehemu kubwa zaidi ya index.

e0b0161e5560.en: Jesse Livermore built his reputation on tape reading, starting as a teenager reading ticker tape in the 1890s. His core idea: the tape records actual transactions, not opinions — and actual transactions reflect real buying and selling pressure in a way a chart, updated only after the fact, cannot. Ticker tape disappeared decades ago, replaced by Level II data and order-flow software — but the underlying idea survives in those modern tools.
e0b0161e5560.sw: Jesse Livermore alijenga sifa yake kwa kusoma tepu, akianza akiwa kijana akisoma tepu ya bei katika miaka ya 1890. Wazo lake kuu: tepu hurekodi miamala halisi, si maoni — na miamala halisi huonyesha shinikizo halisi la kununua na kuuza kwa njia ambayo chati, inayosasishwa baada tu ya tukio, haiwezi. Tepu ya bei ilitoweka miongo iliyopita, ikibadilishwa na data ya Level II na programu ya mtiririko wa maagizo — lakini wazo la msingi linaendelea kuishi katika zana hizo za kisasa.

e0f66bc438e0.en: Not quite. The studies are not fabricated and the premia are generally reported before implementation costs, not after. The gap between paper and portfolio is spreads, fees and taxes — all of which come out of the premium itself.
e0f66bc438e0.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Tafiti hazitungwi na malipo ya ziada kwa kawaida huripotiwa kabla ya gharama za utekelezaji, si baada. Pengo kati ya karatasi na mkusanyiko ni spread, ada na kodi — vyote hutoka kwenye malipo ya ziada yenyewe.

e11bc7223c6d.en: What to look for when assessing the risk of any holding. Ask what its largest historical fall was, and how long that fall lasted before recovery. Ask what would make the loss permanent rather than temporary. Ask whether anything in your own circumstances would force a sale during exactly that period. And distrust any single number offered as the risk of an investment, because the three questions above cannot be compressed into one.
e11bc7223c6d.sw: Cha kutazama unapotathmini hatari ya umiliki wowote. Uliza kushuka kwake kukubwa zaidi kihistoria kulikuwa nini, na kushuka huko kulidumu muda gani kabla ya kupona. e1340777a04b.en: Gas prices are quoted in gwei — one gwei is one billionth of an ETH. Since August 2021, the price per unit has two parts, introduced by an upgrade called EIP-1559 (part of the "London" upgrade of 5 August 2021). The base fee is set automatically by the protocol, rising when blocks are full and falling when they are not — and here is the strange part: the base fee is not paid to anyone. It is burned — destroyed, removed from the ETH supply entirely. The priority fee, or tip, is an extra amount you add on top, paid to the validator, to encourage them to include your transaction sooner. When the network is quiet, a small tip is enough. When it is busy, the tip is where the auction lives on.
e1340777a04b.sw: Bei za gesi hunukuliwa katika gwei — gwei moja ni sehemu moja ya bilioni ya ETH. Tangu Agosti 2021, bei kwa kila kipimo ina sehemu mbili, zilizoanzishwa na uboreshaji uitwao EIP-1559 (sehemu ya uboreshaji wa "London" wa tarehe 5 Agosti 2021). Ada ya msingi huwekwa kiotomatiki na itifaki, ikipanda vitalu vinapojaa na kushuka visipojaa — na hii hapa sehemu ya ajabu: ada ya msingi hailipwi kwa yeyote. Huchomwa — huharibiwa, huondolewa katika usambazaji wa ETH kabisa. Ada ya kipaumbele, au bakshishi, ni kiasi cha ziada unachokiongeza juu, kinacholipwa kwa mthibitishaji, kumhamasisha ajumuishe muamala wako mapema. Mtandao unapokuwa tulivu, bakshishi ndogo inatosha. Unapokuwa na shughuli, bakshishi ndipo mnada unapoendelea kuishi.

e4577390b34c.en: Precision matters here, because this attack is constantly exaggerated in both directions. A majority attacker can: censor (refuse to include chosen transactions), reorganize recent history (privately mine an alternative chain and release it, replacing recently confirmed blocks), and double-spend (deposit coins on an exchange, trade and withdraw, then release a rewritten chain in which the original deposit never happened). A majority attacker cannot: steal coins from arbitrary wallets (spending your coins requires your cryptographic key, which no amount of hashpower conjures), mint coins beyond the schedule (every node independently checks the supply rules, so a rule-breaking block is rejected even with enormous work behind it), or change the network's rules.
e4577390b34c.sw: Usahihi una maana hapa, kwa sababu shambulizi hili hukuzwa mara kwa mara pande zote mbili. Mshambuliaji mwenye wingi anaweza: kuzuia (kukataa kujumuisha miamala aliyoichagua), kupanga upya historia ya hivi karibuni (kuchimba mnyororo mbadala kwa siri na kuutoa, ukibadilisha vitalu vilivyothibitishwa hivi karibuni), na kutumia-mara-mbili (kuweka sarafu katika soko la kubadilisha, kufanya biashara na kutoa, kisha kutoa mnyororo ulioandikwa upya ambapo amana ya awali haikutokea kamwe). Mshambuliaji mwenye wingi hawezi: kuiba sarafu kutoka pochi zozote (kutumia sarafu zako kunahitaji ufunguo wako wa kikriptografia, ambao hakuna kiasi cha nguvu ya heshi kinachouzalisha), kutengeneza sarafu zaidi ya ratiba (kila nodi hukagua kanuni za usambazaji kwa kujitegemea, kwa hivyo kitalu kinachovunja kanuni hukataliwa hata kikiwa na kazi kubwa mno nyuma yake), au kubadilisha kanuni za mtandao.

e484c2bc67ce.en: This single event is the real-world reason "negative balance protection" — mentioned in Lesson 6 as a regulatory requirement in the EU, UK, and Australia — exists as a rule at all. A stop-loss order is a real risk-management tool, not a guarantee. In a genuine liquidity gap, it can fail to protect you at exactly the moment you need it most.
e484c2bc67ce.sw: Tukio hili moja ndiyo sababu ya dunia halisi ya kuwepo kwa "ulinzi wa salio hasi" — lililotajwa katika Somo la 6 kama hitaji la udhibiti katika Umoja wa Ulaya, Uingereza, na Australia — kama kanuni kabisa. Agizo la stop-loss ni zana halisi ya usimamizi wa hatari, si uhakika. Katika pengo halisi la ukwasi, linaweza kushindwa kukulinda hasa wakati unapolihitaji zaidi.

e5062ab7a042.en: A number included in a block purely so it can be varied. Each new nonce value gives the block an entirely different hash. Lesson 3 covers it fully.

e553ec2d973b.en: Two honest caveats attach to that number. Chainalysis is a commercial firm selling blockchain-analytics products, not a peer-reviewed body, and its figures are estimates built from on-chain tracing. And other firms measuring the same year got different totals: CertiK reported roughly 3.35 billion dollars for 2025, while PeckShield, using a wider definition of what counts, reported roughly 4.04 billion. The disagreement is the useful part. Three serious measurement efforts land between 3.3 and 4.1 billion dollars for one year, which tells you the order of magnitude is real and the precision is not.
e553ec2d973b.sw: Tahadhari mbili za kweli huambatana na namba hiyo. Chainalysis ni kampuni ya kibiashara inayouza bidhaa za uchambuzi wa mnyororo wa vitalu, si chombo kilichopitiwa na wenzao, na takwimu zake ni makadirio yaliyojengwa kutoka ufuatiliaji wa kwenye mnyororo. Na kampuni nyingine zilizopima mwaka uleule zilipata jumla tofauti: CertiK iliripoti takriban dola bilioni 3.35 kwa 2025, huku PeckShield, ikitumia ufafanuzi mpana zaidi wa kinachohesabika, iliripoti takriban bilioni 4.04. Kutokubaliana ndiyo sehemu yenye manufaa. Juhudi tatu makini za kupima huanguka kati ya dola bilioni 3.3 na 4.1 kwa mwaka mmoja, jambo linalokuambia daraja la ukubwa ni halisi na usahihi si.

e55ec7707165.en: That is the counterintuitive part, and it is worth saying plainly before the arithmetic. Many beginners arrive at crypto expecting the higher volatility to justify a bigger, bolder position. The mathematics says the opposite. e579f3d7bd37.en: Here is the calculation on five daily Bitcoin bars, using a plain average of the five true ranges. The closing price before the first bar was 60,000 dollars. Day 1: high 61,200, low 59,400, close 60,800 — true range 1,800. Day 2: high 62,000, low 60,300, close 61,500 — true range 1,700. Day 3: high 61,800, low 59,900, close 60,200 — true range 1,900. Day 4: high 60,500, low 58,200, close 58,600 — true range 2,300. Day 5: high 59,900, low 58,100, close 59,700 — true range 1,800. Check day 3 by hand. High minus low is 61,800 - 59,900 = 1,900. High minus the previous close is 61,800 - 61,500 = 300. The previous close minus the low is 61,500 - 59,900 = 1,600. The largest is 1,900, so the true range is 1,900. The five true ranges add to 9,500. ATR = 9,500 / 5 = 1,900 dollars. At a price of 60,000 dollars, that is 1,900 / 60,000 = 3.17% of price per day.
e579f3d7bd37.sw: Hii hapa hesabu katika mistari mitano ya kila siku ya Bitcoin, ikitumia wastani rahisi wa viwango halisi vitano. Bei ya kufunga kabla ya mstari wa kwanza ilikuwa dola 60,000. Siku ya 1: kilele 61,200, bonde 59,400, kufunga 60,800 — kiwango halisi 1,800. Siku ya 2: kilele 62,000, bonde 60,300, kufunga 61,500 — kiwango halisi 1,700. Siku ya 3: kilele 61,800, bonde 59,900, kufunga 60,200 — kiwango halisi 1,900. Siku ya 4: kilele 60,500, bonde 58,200, kufunga 58,600 — kiwango halisi 2,300. Siku ya 5: kilele 59,900, bonde 58,100, kufunga 59,700 — kiwango halisi 1,800. Kagua siku ya 3 kwa mkono. Kilele ukiondoa bonde ni 61,800 - 59,900 = 1,900. Kilele ukiondoa kufunga kwa awali ni 61,800 - 61,500 = 300. Kufunga kwa awali ukiondoa bonde ni 61,500 - 59,900 = 1,600. Kikubwa zaidi ni 1,900, kwa hivyo kiwango halisi ni 1,900. Viwango halisi vitano hujumlika hadi 9,500. ATR = 9,500 / 5 = dola 1,900. Katika bei ya dola 60,000, hiyo ni 1,900 / 60,000 = 3.17% ya bei kwa siku.

e68dcd989cdd.en: A company announces disappointing results at 07:00. By the time the market opens the price has already moved. An investor who reads the announcement at 09:00 and sells is not acting on information — they are acting after the price has absorbed it. The information was public for two hours, which in this context is a long time.
e68dcd989cdd.sw: Kampuni hutangaza matokeo ya kukatisha tamaa saa 07:00. Kufikia soko linapofunguliwa bei tayari imesogea. Mwekezaji anayesoma tangazo saa 09:00 na kuuza hatendi juu ya taarifa — anatenda baada ya bei kuzifyonza. Taarifa zilikuwa za umma kwa saa mbili, ambao katika muktadha huu ni muda mrefu.

e6969c5c2c94.en: Before any trade, run the thesis check: Can you write down which of the six pillars support it, with a reason for each, not just a direction? Are the supporting pillars actually independent, or are you counting the same story twice? Is there a catalyst — a thesis with no reason to move now is a reason to wait, not to enter? And are you calling a trade high conviction because the analysis is strong, or only because the feeling is strong? Only the first is an edge.

e6d99cb79975.en: The emotional logic is easy to feel. A winning trade offers the pleasure of being right, available right now if you close it — so you do. A losing trade would force you to admit you were wrong, so you wait, and hope. Both impulses push directly against the risk-to-reward discipline from Chapter 3, Lesson 3: they shrink your winners and let your losers run — exactly backwards.

e70089c2ce46.en: Not quite — the problem is not the broker or the size. ATR measures how far price typically travels in a day, so a stop at one-seventh of an ATR is reached by ordinary noise. e775a549685d.en: Spreads are not fixed. They widen measurably during low-liquidity periods (the Asian trading session, for instance) and around major scheduled news events, exactly when uncertainty about the "true" price is highest — a direct, practical echo of the adverse-selection and inventory-risk theory above. A spread that looks tight on a demo account during the London session can widen noticeably at other times.
e775a549685d.sw: Spread si thabiti. Hupanuka kwa kiasi kinachopimika wakati wa vipindi vya ukwasi mdogo (kipindi cha biashara cha Asia, kwa mfano) na wakati wa matukio makubwa ya habari yaliyopangwa, hasa wakati kutokuwa na uhakika kuhusu bei "halisi" kuko juu zaidi — mwangwi wa moja kwa moja na wa kivitendo wa nadharia ya uteuzi mbaya na hatari ya hifadhi hapo juu. Spread inayoonekana finyu kwenye akaunti ya majaribio wakati wa kipindi cha London inaweza kupanuka kwa kiasi kinachoonekana nyakati nyingine.

e77ee8262c9b.en: The single most important nuance in this entire lesson: an expected rate move is usually "priced in" before it happens. If the whole market already expects a hike, the currency has largely already moved by the time the announcement lands. The big, violent moves come from surprises — when a central bank confounds expectations. This is why two traders can watch the same rate hike and see the currency fall: if the market expected an even larger hike, the "smaller than expected" hike is effectively dovish. You're not trading the rate. You're trading the gap between the decision and what was already expected.
e77ee8262c9b.sw: Upambanuzi muhimu kuliko wote katika somo hili lote: msogeo wa kiwango unaotarajiwa kwa kawaida huwa "umewekewa bei" kabla haujatokea. Kama soko lote tayari linatarajia kupanda, sarafu tayari imesogea kwa kiasi kikubwa wakati tangazo linapofika. Misogeo mikubwa na yenye nguvu hutoka kwenye mishangao — benki kuu inapokinzana na matarajio. Ndiyo sababu wafanyabiashara wawili wanaweza kutazama kupanda kwa kiwango kile kile na kuona sarafu ikishuka: kama soko lilitarajia kupanda kukubwa zaidi, kupanda "kudogo kuliko ilivyotarajiwa" kwa hakika ni dovish. Hufanyi biashara ya kiwango. Unafanya biashara ya pengo kati ya uamuzi na kile kilichotarajiwa tayari.
