e790e7d93daf.en: If you trade 1 standard lot of EUR/USD, you're controlling €100,000. A 1-pip move in your favor or against you is worth roughly $10. Trade 1 micro lot instead (1,000 units), and that same 1-pip move is worth $0.10 — a hundred times smaller.
e790e7d93daf.sw: Kama utafanya biashara ya lot 1 sanifu ya EUR/USD, unadhibiti €100,000. Msogeo wa pip 1 kwa manufaa yako au dhidi yako una thamani ya takriban $10. Fanya biashara ya lot 1 ndogo sana badala yake (vipimo 1,000), na msogeo ule ule wa pip 1 una thamani ya $0.10 — mara mia ndogo zaidi.

e79193106a95.en: The fallout was severe and specific. The retail broker FXCM saw its customers left with roughly 225 million dollars in negative balances — accounts that owed the broker more than they held — and FXCM needed an emergency infusion of about 300 million dollars from Leucadia to survive. The UK broker Alpari (UK) entered insolvency that same day. And it was not only amateurs: the hedge fund Everest Capital Global, which had bet against the franc, lost close to a billion dollars and was shut down. A Bank of England study later found that algorithmic traders pulling liquidity made the crash worse.
e79193106a95.sw: Matokeo yalikuwa makali na mahususi. Broker wa rejareja FXCM aliona wateja wake wakiachwa na takriban dola milioni 225 katika salio hasi — akaunti zilizodaiwa na broker zaidi ya walichoshikilia — na FXCM ilihitaji uingizaji wa dharura wa takriban dola milioni 300 kutoka Leucadia ili kuendelea kuishi. Broker wa Uingereza Alpari (UK) aliingia kufilisika siku hiyo hiyo. Na hawakuwa wanaoanza tu: hedge fund Everest Capital Global, iliyokuwa imebashiri dhidi ya faranga, ilipoteza karibu dola bilioni moja na ikafungwa. Utafiti wa Benki ya Uingereza baadaye uligundua kwamba wafanyabiashara wa algoriti waliovuta ukwasi walifanya anguko liwe baya zaidi.

e79a36738433.en: Not quite — the BIS found no single cause: thin overnight liquidity, options hedging, stop-loss execution and algorithms combined.
e79a36738433.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — BIS haikupata sababu moja: ukwasi mdogo wa usiku, kulinda options, utekelezaji wa stop-loss na algoriti viliungana.

e7ce4036b49b.en: The margin level at which the broker stops asking and starts acting: it automatically closes your positions, usually the largest loser first, to stop your equity falling below the margin backing them. It sits below the margin call level.

e7f1c01a4a7d.en: Given everything in this lesson: is the right response to this event "never use a stop-loss, since it might not work," or something more precise? What role does position sizing (Lesson 5) play in surviving an event like this even when a stop-loss doesn't fill where expected?

e81b2438b9f4.en: The relationship between money going in and market cap moving has been studied directly. Rodney Garratt and Maarten van Oordt developed what they call the crypto multiplier, a measure of how much a cryptocurrency's market capitalization moves in response to money flowing in or out. Their central result is that the multiplier is generally greater than 1: one dollar of net inflow moves market capitalization by more than one dollar. The multiplier is largest when most coins are held as an investment rather than spent, and they find the share of coins actually used for payments is small for the major cryptocurrencies. Their paper appeared as Bank for International Settlements Working Paper No. 1104 in June 2023 and was later published in the Journal of Corporate Finance.
e81b2438b9f4.sw: Uhusiano kati ya pesa inayoingia na kiasi cha soko kinachosogea umechunguzwa moja kwa moja. Rodney Garratt na Maarten van Oordt walibuni kile wanachokiita kizidishi cha kripto, kipimo cha kiasi gani kiasi cha soko cha sarafu ya kripto kinasogea kujibu pesa inayoingia au kutoka. Matokeo yao makuu ni kwamba kizidishi kwa kawaida ni kikubwa kuliko 1: dola moja ya uingiaji halisi husogeza kiasi cha soko kwa zaidi ya dola moja. Kizidishi ni kikubwa zaidi wakati sarafu nyingi zinashikiliwa kama uwekezaji badala ya kutumiwa, nao hubaini sehemu ya sarafu inayotumika hasa kwa malipo ni ndogo kwa sarafu kuu za kripto. Karatasi yao ilijitokeza kama Bank for International Settlements Working Paper No. 1104 mwezi Juni 2023 na baadaye ilichapishwa katika Journal of Corporate Finance.

e82aa4606b39.en: The other common family of sentiment tools is social-volume metrics - counts of how often an asset is mentioned, and automated scoring of whether those mentions are positive or negative. Attention does have a measurable relationship with crypto prices. Kristoufek (2013), in Scientific Reports, volume 3, article 3415, compared Bitcoin prices with Google Trends and Wikipedia search volumes and found a strong positive correlation on a log-log scale, roughly 0.88 for Google Trends and 0.83 for Wikipedia. The paper's sharper finding is an asymmetry: rising interest pushed prices further up when the price was already above its trend, and further down when it was below. Attention amplified the direction already in motion rather than pointing in one.
e82aa4606b39.sw: Familia nyingine ya kawaida ya zana za hisia ni vipimo vya ujazo wa kijamii - hesabu za mara ngapi rasilimali inatajwa, na upimaji wa kiotomatiki wa kama matajo hayo ni chanya au hasi. Uangalifu una uhusiano unaopimika na bei za kripto. Kristoufek (2013), katika Scientific Reports, juzuu 3, makala 3415, alilinganisha bei za Bitcoin na ujazo wa utafutaji wa Google Trends na Wikipedia na akabaini uhusiano chanya imara katika mizani ya logi-logi, takriban 0.88 kwa Google Trends na 0.83 kwa Wikipedia. Matokeo makali zaidi ya karatasi ni ukosefu wa ulinganifu: maslahi yanayopanda yalisukuma bei juu zaidi wakati bei ilikuwa tayari juu ya mwelekeo wake, na chini zaidi wakati ilikuwa chini yake. Uangalifu ulikuza mwelekeo uliokuwa tayari unaendelea badala ya kuelekeza kwenye mmoja.

e84327a72816.en: Notice that no option has an empty risk column. Moving along the spectrum does not remove risk — it swaps one kind for another. Exchange custody carries the risks of trusting a company. Self-custody carries the risks of being your own bank: nobody can freeze your money, and nobody can save it either.
e84327a72816.sw: Tambua kwamba hakuna chaguo lenye safu tupu ya hatari. Kusonga juu ya msururu hakuondoi hatari — hubadilisha aina moja kwa nyingine. Utunzaji wa soko la kubadilisha hubeba hatari za kuamini kampuni. Utunzaji binafsi hubeba hatari za kuwa benki yako mwenyewe: hakuna anayeweza kugandisha pesa yako, na hakuna anayeweza kuiokoa pia.

e87152f0c70c.en: This is why screening for high dividend yield is a weak filter. It excludes companies returning cash a different way, and it selects for companies whose price has fallen, since yield rises when price falls. A screen built on yield alone is partly a screen for recent disappointment.
e87152f0c70c.sw: Ndiyo sababu kuchuja kwa mavuno makubwa ya gawio ni chujio dhaifu. Hutenga kampuni zinazorudisha fedha kwa njia tofauti, na huchagua kampuni ambazo bei yake imeshuka, kwa kuwa mavuno hupanda bei inaposhuka. Chujio lililojengwa juu ya mavuno peke yake ni kwa sehemu chujio la kukatishwa tamaa kwa hivi karibuni.

e88192a84bce.en: Equity and currency markets close. The close is not a courtesy; it is a structural interruption that forces a pause between the impulse and the trade. Crypto has no close, no weekend and no holiday. Every hour is an hour in which you can act on a feeling, and the feeling is at its strongest at exactly the hours when your judgement is at its weakest.
e88192a84bce.sw: Masoko ya hisa na sarafu hufunga. Kufunga si adabu; ni ukatizaji wa kimuundo unaolazimisha kusimama kati ya msukumo na biashara. Kripto haina kufunga, wikendi wala likizo. Kila saa ni saa ambayo unaweza kutenda juu ya hisia, na hisia ni yenye nguvu zaidi katika saa hasa ambazo hukumu yako ni dhaifu zaidi.

e889ba41a01c.en: Gold solved barter — but its own weight and fixed supply created problems that paper money was invented to fix.
e889ba41a01c.sw: Dhahabu ilitatua tatizo la kubadilishana bidhaa — lakini uzito wake na ugavi wake thabiti vilizua matatizo ambayo pesa za karatasi zilivumbuliwa kuyatatua.

e89a705f8d57.en: This is not a licence to assume you are the one collecting that payment. The argument says the reward for information gathering must be positive in aggregate. It says nothing about who receives it, and the professionals doing it full time have better data, faster execution and more time than you do. "Markets are not perfectly efficient" and "I can beat them" are separated by a great deal.
e89a705f8d57.sw: Hii si leseni ya kudhania kwamba wewe ndiye unayekusanya malipo hayo. Hoja husema tuzo ya kukusanya taarifa lazima iwe chanya kwa jumla. Haisemi chochote kuhusu ni nani anayeipokea, na wataalamu wanaofanya hivyo muda wote wana data bora, utekelezaji wa haraka na muda zaidi kuliko wewe. "Masoko hayana ufanisi kamili" na "ninaweza kuyashinda" yametenganishwa kwa mengi mno.

e89b233d886a.en: Not quite. A price-weighted index adds share prices and divides — it never looks at how large the company is. Company A at 300 a share has six times the influence of Company B at 50, even though B is eight times the business. Size only drives the weighting in a market-capitalisation index.
e89b233d886a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Index yenye uzito wa bei huongeza bei za hisa na kugawanya — haitazami kamwe kampuni ni kubwa kiasi gani. Kampuni A kwa 300 kwa hisa ina ushawishi mara sita ya Kampuni B kwa 50, hata kama B ni biashara mara nane. Ukubwa huendesha uzito katika index ya mtaji-soko tu.

e8a6d25cf2eb.en: Separate markets moving together far more closely during sharp falls than during normal periods.
e8a6d25cf2eb.sw: Masoko tofauti kusonga pamoja kwa ukaribu zaidi wakati wa kushuka kwa kasi kuliko wakati wa vipindi vya kawaida.

e8ab3230ef19.en: In plain terms, the interest edge was real, but you were being paid to hold a currency position that could drop violently at the worst possible moment. That is not a flaw in the carry trade — it is what the carry trade fundamentally is. The steady income is the market paying you to insure everyone else against a crash, and 2008 was the year the insurance was called.
e8ab3230ef19.sw: Kwa lugha rahisi, faida ya riba ilikuwa halisi, lakini ulikuwa unalipwa kushikilia nafasi ya sarafu inayoweza kushuka kwa nguvu wakati mbaya zaidi unaowezekana. Huo si udhaifu katika carry trade — ndicho carry trade ilivyo kimsingi. Mapato thabiti ni soko likikulipa uwakatie kila mtu mwingine bima dhidi ya anguko, na 2008 ulikuwa mwaka bima ilipoitwa.

e8d2345c5f0d.sw: Mchoro wa msururu wa utunzaji kutoka utunzaji wa soko la kubadilisha upande wa moto, kupitia pochi za moto za simu na kivinjari, hadi hifadhi baridi ya maunzi upande wa baridi, huku hatari ya mshirika ikiwekewa lebo upande wa soko la kubadilisha na hatari ya hasara isiyoweza kutenduliwa ikiwekewa lebo upande wa baridi

e8d43abe68ec.en: Not quite. Presentation quality, documentation and unit price are all cheap to control and tell you very little in either direction. The durable markers are structural: an unexplained yield source, unsolicited contact, withdrawal friction, guaranteed returns on a volatile asset, and any request for a recovery phrase.
e8d43abe68ec.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Ubora wa uwasilishaji, nyaraka na bei ya kipimo vyote ni nafuu kudhibiti na hukuambia kidogo sana upande wowote. Alama za kudumu ni za kimuundo: chanzo cha mavuno kisichoelezwa, mawasiliano yasiyoombwa, msuguano wa kutoa, faida zilizohakikishwa katika rasilimali yenye mtikisiko, na ombi lolote la kifungu cha urejeshaji.

e8d4944789c4.en: The same reasoning gives an honest way to think about the home bias problem rather than simply naming it.
e8d4944789c4.sw: Hoja ile ile hutoa njia ya uaminifu ya kufikiri kuhusu tatizo la upendeleo wa nyumbani badala ya kulitaja tu.

e8db2cfece2c.en: You bring $100 USD to the exchange counter and convert it: 100 × 20 = 2,000 pesos. You spend the week in Mexico — but your friends cover everything. You don't spend a single peso. When you fly home, you still have all 2,000 pesos, and you convert them back to dollars. But the exchange rate has moved while you were away. It's no longer 20 — it's now 1 USD = 16 MXN. To convert back: 2,000 ÷ 16 = $125 USD. You left with $100. You came back with $125. You made $25 — without spending a cent, without working, and without any plan to trade at all. It happened purely because the exchange rate moved in your favor while you held pesos.
e8db2cfece2c.sw: Unaleta $100 USD kwenye kaunta ya ubadilishaji na kuzibadilisha: 100 × 20 = peso 2,000. Unatumia wiki nzima Mexico — lakini marafiki zako wanalipia kila kitu. Hutumii hata peso moja. Unaporudi nyumbani kwa ndege, bado una peso zote 2,000, na unazibadilisha tena kuwa dola. Lakini kiwango cha ubadilishaji kimesogea ulipokuwa mbali. Si tena 20 — sasa ni 1 USD = 16 MXN. Kubadilisha tena: 2,000 ÷ 16 = $125 USD. Uliondoka na $100. Umerudi na $125. Umepata $25 — bila kutumia senti moja, bila kufanya kazi, na bila mpango wowote wa kufanya biashara kabisa. Ilitokea kwa sababu tu kiwango cha ubadilishaji kilisogea kwa manufaa yako ulipokuwa unashikilia peso.

e8e9a9cfc268.sw: Chanzo cha mavuno kisichoelezwa — faida iliyoahidiwa ambayo mnyororo wake wa majibu haufikii kamwe shughuli inayozalisha thamani

e8ea1571abc7.en: Three properties make it useful here. Deterministic: the same input gives the same hash, every time, on every computer — if two people compute the same hash, they hold identical data. The avalanche effect: change the input by one character and the output does not change a little — it changes beyond recognition; there is no "close" in hashes. One-way: given a hash, there is no known practical way to work backwards to the input — the only way to find an input that hashes to something specific is to guess, over and over.
e8ea1571abc7.sw: Sifa tatu huifanya iwe na manufaa hapa. Ya kubainika: ingizo lilelile hutoa heshi ileile, kila mara, katika kila kompyuta — ikiwa watu wawili wanahesabu heshi ileile, wanashikilia data inayofanana. Athari ya poromoko: badilisha ingizo kwa herufi moja na toleo halibadiliki kidogo — hubadilika zaidi ya kutambulika; hakuna "karibu" katika heshi. Ya njia-moja: ukipewa heshi, hakuna njia ya kivitendo inayojulikana ya kufanya kazi kurudi nyuma hadi ingizo — njia pekee ya kupata ingizo linalotoa heshi maalum ni kubahatisha, tena na tena.

e8ea70972105.en: Correct. Conviction comes from independent evidence agreeing, not from restating one fact in three vocabularies. A falling price mechanically lowers the multiple and raises the yield, so all three readings carry the same information — and the thesis is weaker than the count suggests.
e8ea70972105.sw: Sahihi. Msimamo thabiti hutoka kwa ushahidi huru unaokubaliana, si kwa kurudia ukweli mmoja katika misamiati mitatu. Bei inayoshuka hupunguza kizidishi kimitambo na kupandisha mavuno, kwa hivyo usomaji wote mitatu hubeba taarifa ileile — na nadharia ni dhaifu zaidi kuliko hesabu inavyodokeza.

e8ea81e8e261.en: Correct — Asness, Moskowitz and Pedersen (2013) documented value and momentum across markets, and Koijen and colleagues (2018) documented carry across asset classes.
e8ea81e8e261.sw: Sahihi — Asness, Moskowitz na Pedersen (2013) waliandika thamani na kasi katika masoko yote, na Koijen na wenzake (2018) waliandika carry katika madaraja ya mali.

e915f6adc031.sw: Kila bei utakayoitazama inahitaji kipimo kidogo vya kutosha kuzungumzia kwa usahihi. Kipimo hicho ni pip.

e955f3ca4d9a.en: Not quite — a reserves snapshot shows assets at a point in time and typically nothing about liabilities, so it cannot establish solvency. The U.S. audit regulator warned in 2023 that such reports are not audits and provide no meaningful assurance.
e955f3ca4d9a.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — picha ya akiba huonyesha rasilimali katika wakati fulani na kwa kawaida hakuna lolote kuhusu madeni, kwa hivyo haiwezi kuthibitisha uwezo wa kulipa. Mdhibiti wa ukaguzi wa Marekani alionya mwaka 2023 kwamba ripoti kama hizo si ukaguzi na hazitoi uhakikisho wenye maana.

e97a3e26aff2.en: Catalyst. This transfers well and is often stronger here than in other markets, because so much of the calendar is known in advance: protocol upgrades, halvings, unlock dates, exchange listings, regulatory decisions with published timetables.
e97a3e26aff2.sw: Kichocheo. e9c2a91e822f.en: What to do instead, in order of strength. Use an authenticator app that generates codes on your device, because the code never travels over the phone network and a SIM swap does not reach it. Use a hardware security key or a passkey where the service supports it, because that is the option that scored 100% against targeted attacks in the Google study. Remove your phone number as a recovery method on any account that lets you, especially email, since your email account is usually the master key to everything else. And ask your mobile carrier for a port-out PIN or a number lock, which is a free phone call that adds a step the attacker has to defeat.

Tumia ufunguo halisi wa usalama au passkey pale huduma inapouunga mkono, kwa sababu hicho ndicho chaguo kilichopata 100% dhidi ya mashambulizi yaliyolengwa katika utafiti wa Google. Ondoa namba yako ya simu kama njia ya urejeshaji katika akaunti yoyote inayokuruhusu, hasa barua pepe, kwa kuwa akaunti yako ya barua pepe kwa kawaida ndio ufunguo mkuu wa kila kitu kingine. Na omba mtoa huduma wako wa simu PIN ya kutoa namba au kufunga namba, ambayo ni simu ya bure inayoongeza hatua ambayo mshambuliaji lazima aishinde.

e9c6ddc29e77.en: Work out what a crypto sleeve costs a portfolio in a repeat of 2022, using the 77.6% peak-to-trough fall. A 2% crypto allocation contributes 1.55 percentage points of portfolio drawdown. A 5% allocation contributes 3.88 percentage points. A 10% allocation contributes 7.76 percentage points. A 25% allocation contributes 19.4 percentage points on its own. Now add the correlation problem. Those crypto losses did not offset equity losses, because both fell in the same window. A portfolio holding 60% equities that fell 36.4%, plus a 10% crypto sleeve that fell 77.6%, took roughly 29.6 percentage points of drawdown from those two positions together. The crypto sleeve added to the loss instead of cushioning it.
e9c6ddc29e77.sw: Hesabu kipande cha kripto kinagharimu nini kwa kasha katika kurudia kwa 2022, ukitumia kushuka kwa 77.6% kutoka kileleni hadi bondeni. Mgawanyo wa kripto wa 2% huchangia pointi 1.55 za asilimia za kushuka kwa kasha. Mgawanyo wa 5% huchangia pointi 3.88 za asilimia. Mgawanyo wa 10% huchangia pointi 7.76 za asilimia. Mgawanyo wa 25% huchangia pointi 19.4 za asilimia peke yake. Sasa ongeza tatizo la uhusiano. Hasara hizo za kripto hazikufidia hasara za hisa, kwa sababu zote zilishuka katika dirisha lilelile. Kasha linaloshikilia 60% ya hisa lililoshuka 36.4%, pamoja na kipande cha kripto cha 10% kilichoshuka 77.6%, lilichukua takriban pointi 29.6 za asilimia za kushuka kutoka nafasi hizo mbili pamoja. Kipande cha kripto kiliongeza hasara badala ya kuipunguza.

ea9dd14fea5c.en: The rules that follow are short. Buy hardware wallets directly from the manufacturer's own website and from nowhere else: not a marketplace listing, not a classifieds site, not a discounted third-party seller, and never secondhand. Set the device up yourself and generate your own recovery phrase on it, never accepting a supplied one. Update firmware only through the manufacturer's official application, which verifies the update's signature. And accept that no device makes you immune to token approvals. The Ledger case and the Bybit case were both signed by hardware. A hardware wallet protects your key from being copied. It does not protect you from authorizing a transaction you did not understand.

Sanidi kifaa mwenyewe na uzalishe kifungu chako mwenyewe cha urejeshaji ndani yake, kamwe usikubali kilichotolewa. Sasisha firmware kupitia programu rasmi ya mtengenezaji pekee, ambayo huthibitisha sahihi ya sasisho. Na ukubali kwamba hakuna kifaa kinachokufanya usiathirike na idhini za tokeni. Kesi ya Ledger na kesi ya Bybit zote zilitiwa sahihi na maunzi. Pochi ya maunzi hulinda ufunguo wako usinakiliwe. Haikulindi usiidhinishe muamala usiouelewa.

eb12da40635e.en: "Sent" is not "settled." A transaction sitting in the mempool can still fail, be replaced by another transaction from the same sender, or simply never confirm if its fee is too low. Wallets and payment screens often say "sent" the moment the transaction is broadcast — stage 2 of 5. Nothing is settled until the transaction is in a block, and nothing is hard to reverse until that block is buried. Treat "sent" as "submitted an application," not "done."

Pochi na skrini za malipo mara nyingi husema "umetumwa" wakati muamala unapotangazwa — hatua ya 2 kati ya 5. Hakuna kinachotimizwa hadi muamala uwe katika kitalu, na hakuna kilicho kigumu kutendua hadi kitalu hicho kizikwe. Chukulia "umetumwa" kama "umewasilisha ombi," si "imekamilika."

eb72efb87073.en: Two people each put 5,000 into the market on the same morning. One buys a broad index fund and does not look at it again for a decade. The other trades it actively, in and out, forty times a year. Ignoring skill entirely, they face completely different structures: the first collects whatever the underlying businesses produced, minus a small fee. The second collects whatever the businesses produced, minus a small fee, minus forty rounds of spread and commission, plus or minus whatever they gained or lost against the other side of each trade.

Kwa kupuuza ustadi kabisa, wanakabiliwa na miundo tofauti kabisa: wa kwanza hukusanya chochote biashara zilizo chini zilizalisha, kutoa ada ndogo. Wa pili hukusanya chochote biashara zilizalisha, kutoa ada ndogo, kutoa raundi arobaini za spread na kamisheni, pamoja au kutoa chochote walichopata au kupoteza dhidi ya upande mwingine wa kila biashara.

eb9baa361d07.en: Start with the ordinary futures contract, because the perpetual is defined by what it removes. An ordinary futures contract has an expiry date. A written plan, a rebalancing band, a known total fee, an uninterrupted contribution schedule, and the habit of checking a confident claim against its source. None of it requires predicting anything, and every one of the three case studies in Chapter 5 would have been survived by someone doing only these things.

ec839d28f1fa.en: There is a further trap in the comparison itself. Comparing a low-float token's market cap to an established asset's market cap compares two different things, because one of them has 90% of its supply still to arrive. If you want the comparison to mean anything, compare FDV to FDV, and then check the unlock schedule that FDV is quietly assuming. None of this means small assets cannot rise. It means the sentence the cap is small is not a reason. The reason, if one exists, has to be an argument about demand, and Chapter 1 Lesson 1 already set that rule down: scarcity limits supply, value requires demand.

ecd280efac8d.en: Now the scale, stated as carefully as the sources allow. The blockchain-analytics firm Chainalysis publishes an annual Crypto Crime Report. Its 2026 edition, covering calendar year 2025, estimated that just over 3.4 billion dollars was stolen from crypto services and individuals in hacks during 2025. A single incident, the February 2025 breach of the exchange Bybit, accounted for roughly 1.5 billion dollars of that figure, the largest crypto theft recorded to date. The same report estimated that North Korea-linked actors were responsible for 2.02 billion dollars of the year's total.

Toleo lake la 2026, likifunika mwaka wa kalenda 2025, lilikadiria kwamba zaidi kidogo ya dola bilioni 3.4 ziliibiwa kutoka huduma za kripto na watu binafsi katika udukuzi wakati wa 2025. Tukio moja, uvunjaji wa Februari 2025 wa soko la kubadilisha Bybit, lilichukua takriban dola bilioni 1.5 za takwimu hiyo, wizi mkubwa zaidi wa kripto ulioandikwa hadi sasa. Ripoti ileile ilikadiria kwamba watendaji waliohusishwa na Korea Kaskazini walihusika na dola bilioni 2.02 za jumla ya mwaka.

eddefea6812d.en: What to look for from here on. Before sending any transaction, verify the address — check the first and last several characters at minimum, and send a small test amount first when the sum matters. Any person, site, or pop-up asking for your seed phrase is attempting theft — no exceptions, and "support agent" is the most common costume. When you see a balance on an exchange, name it correctly: it is the exchange's IOU to you, not coins under your key. And when either slogan appears — "not your keys, not your coins" or "self-custody is too risky" — ask what the speaker is selling. Each slogan is one true half of a two-sided trade-off.
eddefea6812d.sw: Cha kuangalia kuanzia sasa. Kabla ya kutuma muamala wowote, thibitisha anwani — kagua herufi kadhaa za kwanza na za mwisho angalau, na tuma kiasi kidogo cha majaribio kwanza jumla inapokuwa na maana. Mtu yeyote, tovuti, au dirisha ibukizi linaloomba kifungu chako cha mbegu linajaribu wizi — hakuna vighairi, na "wakala wa huduma" ndiyo vazi linalojitokeza zaidi. Unapoona salio katika soko la kubadilisha, liite kwa jina sahihi: ni deni la soko kwako, si sarafu chini ya ufunguo wako. Na kauli yoyote inapojitokeza — "si funguo zako, si sarafu zako" au "utunzaji binafsi una hatari mno" — uliza msemaji anauza nini. Kila kauli ni nusu moja ya kweli ya maafikiano yenye pande mbili.

edf8afdda0c1.en: Two further problems make the small sample worse than the raw count suggests. First, the window was chosen after seeing the data. Twelve to eighteen months is a six-month target inside a roughly four-year cycle. Nobody published that window before 2013 and then watched it succeed three more times. It was fitted to the observations it now claims to predict. A rule written after the fact is a description, not a forecast. Second, the four cycles are not independent trials. Each one shaped the next. The 2017 boom created the exchanges, the media coverage and the participant base that the 2021 boom ran on. In statistics, four dependent observations carry far less information than four independent ones.
edf8afdda0c1.sw: Matatizo mengine mawili hufanya sampuli ndogo kuwa mbaya zaidi kuliko hesabu ghafi inavyodokeza. Kwanza, dirisha lilichaguliwa baada ya kuona data. Miezi kumi na miwili hadi kumi na minane ni lengo la miezi sita ndani ya mzunguko wa takriban miaka minne. Hakuna aliyechapisha dirisha hilo kabla ya 2013 kisha akatazama likifanikiwa mara tatu zaidi. Liliwekwa kufaa uchunguzi ambao sasa hudai kuutabiri. Kanuni iliyoandikwa baada ya tukio ni maelezo, si utabiri. Pili, mizunguko minne si majaribio huru. Kila mmoja uliumba unaofuata. Ustawi wa 2017 uliunda masoko ya kubadilisha, ufunikaji wa vyombo vya habari na kundi la washiriki ambalo ustawi wa 2021 uliendeshwa juu yake. Katika takwimu, uchunguzi manne tegemezi hubeba taarifa kidogo zaidi kuliko manne huru.

eeb0470e0bbe.en: A 4-period SMA on a daily chart, with closes of 10, 11, 12, 14: the average is (10+11+12+14) ÷ 4 = 11.75. Next day the price drops to 9. The window slides: the oldest value (10) drops out, the new close (9) enters, and the new average is (11+12+14+9) ÷ 4 = 11.50. That sliding window is the entire mechanism — the average "moves" because its data window moves.
eeb0470e0bbe.sw: SMA ya vipindi 4 kwenye chati ya kila siku, yenye bei za kufunga za 10, 11, 12, 14: wastani ni (10+11+12+14) ÷ 4 = 11.75. Siku inayofuata bei inashuka hadi 9. Dirisha linateleza: thamani ya zamani zaidi (10) inatoka, bei mpya ya kufunga (9) inaingia, na wastani mpya ni (11+12+14+9) ÷ 4 = 11.50. Dirisha hilo linaloteleza ndio utaratibu mzima — wastani "unasogea" kwa sababu dirisha lake la data linasogea.

ef57fbd034a1.en: Crypto exhibits a harsher version of the same asymmetry, and it operates at two levels at once. Individual crypto assets converge toward each other in a sell-off, so holding twenty tokens is close to holding one position. And crypto as a whole converges toward equities in a risk-off event, which is what removed the diversification argument in 2022. A portfolio spread across many tokens is not diversified. It is one bet, expressed at length.

Rasilimali binafsi za kripto hukusanyika kuelekea kila mmoja katika uuzaji, kwa hivyo kushikilia tokeni ishirini ni karibu na kushikilia nafasi moja. Na kripto kwa ujumla hukusanyika kuelekea hisa katika tukio la kuepuka hatari, ambako ndiko kuliondoa hoja ya mtawanyiko mwaka 2022. Kasha lililotawanywa katika tokeni nyingi halina mtawanyiko. Ni dau moja, likielezwa kwa urefu.

f0df92b20cc5.en: If the reserve is real, liquid, and redeemable, the peg holds by simple arbitrage: nobody sells a redeemable-for-$1 token much below $1 for long. So three questions decide everything. One: what is actually in the reserve? "Backed by dollars" can mean cash in a bank, short-term US government debt, or riskier things — loans, other cryptocurrencies, IOUs from affiliated companies. Two: who checks, and is it an attestation or an audit? Three: can you actually redeem? Issuers can set minimum redemption sizes, fees, waiting periods, and the right to refuse.
f0df92b20cc5.sw: Ikiwa akiba ni halisi, ya kimiminika, na inayoweza kukombolewa, pegi hushikilia kwa arbitraji rahisi: hakuna anayeuza tokeni inayoweza kukombolewa kwa $1 chini sana ya $1 kwa muda mrefu. Kwa hivyo maswali matatu huamua kila kitu. Moja: nini hasa kiko katika akiba? "Inaungwa mkono na dola" kunaweza kumaanisha fedha taslimu benki, deni la muda mfupi la serikali ya Marekani, au vitu vyenye hatari zaidi — mikopo, sarafu nyingine za kripto, madeni kutoka kampuni shirika. Mbili: nani hukagua, na ni ushuhuda au ukaguzi? Tatu: je, unaweza kukomboa kweli? Watoaji wanaweza kuweka ukubwa wa chini kabisa wa ukombozi, ada, vipindi vya kusubiri, na haki ya kukataa.

f19c6b959fb4.en: A token trades at 2.00 dollars. 100,000,000 tokens circulate. Total supply is 1,000,000,000. Market cap = 2.00 x 100,000,000 = 200,000,000 dollars. FDV = 2.00 x 1,000,000,000 = 2,000,000,000 dollars. Market cap divided by FDV = 10%. So 90% of the supply has not reached the market yet, which is 900,000,000 tokens still to come. For the price to stay at 2.00 dollars once they all unlock, buyers must absorb 900,000,000 x 2.00 = 1,800,000,000 dollars of new supply. If instead the total money in the asset stays at 200,000,000 dollars while supply grows to 1,000,000,000 tokens, the price becomes 200,000,000 / 1,000,000,000 = 0.20 dollars. That is a 90% fall, with no change in the story, the technology, or the team.
f19c6b959fb4.sw: Tokeni hufanyiwa biashara katika dola 2.00. Tokeni 100,000,000 huzunguka. Usambazaji jumla ni 1,000,000,000. Kiasi cha soko = 2.00 x 100,000,000 = dola 200,000,000. FDV = 2.00 x 1,000,000,000 = dola 2,000,000,000. Kiasi cha soko kikigawanywa na FDV = 10%. Kwa hivyo 90% ya usambazaji haijafika sokoni bado, ambayo ni tokeni 900,000,000 bado zinazokuja. Ili bei ibaki katika dola 2.00 mara zote zitakapofunguliwa, wanunuzi lazima wafyonze 900,000,000 x 2.00 = dola 1,800,000,000 za usambazaji mpya. Ikiwa badala yake pesa jumla katika rasilimali ibaki katika dola 200,000,000 huku usambazaji ukikua hadi tokeni 1,000,000,000, bei huwa 200,000,000 / 1,000,000,000 = dola 0.20. Hiyo ni kushuka kwa 90%, bila mabadiliko katika hadithi, teknolojia, au timu.

f1c9c0f98d51.en: The ejection process takes weeks, and the penalty scales up if many validators are slashed at once — that scaling targets exactly the coordinated, many-validator behavior an attack would require. The design in one sentence: in Proof of Work, attacking is expensive because you must buy the effort; in Proof of Stake, attacking is expensive because the protocol can confiscate your bond.

Muundo katika sentensi moja: katika Uthibitisho wa Kazi, kushambulia ni ghali kwa sababu lazima ununue juhudi; katika Uthibitisho wa Hisa, kushambulia ni ghali kwa sababu itifaki inaweza kutaifisha dhamana yako.

f20899d41c28.en: That is the honest core of "leverage risk." The danger was never the broker's headline ratio on its own — it is how much of that ceiling you choose to use. And that choice is exactly position sizing from Lesson 1. A correctly sized position leaves a large free-margin cushion, which keeps effective leverage low and the margin call far away. A margin call is, almost always, a position-sizing mistake showing up one step later.
f20899d41c28.sw: Hicho ndicho kiini cha uaminifu cha "hatari ya leverage." Hatari haikuwa kamwe uwiano wa kichwa cha habari wa broker peke yake — ni kiasi gani cha dari hilo unachochagua kutumia. Na chaguo hilo ni hasa upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi kutoka Somo la 1. Nafasi iliyopimwa kwa usahihi huacha mto mkubwa wa margin huru, ambao huweka leverage halisi chini na wito wa margin mbali. Wito wa margin ni, karibu daima, kosa la upimaji wa ukubwa wa nafasi likijitokeza hatua moja baadaye.

f25a096b9e06.en: Here is the honest part, and it connects straight back to Lesson 1. You learned there that an indicator can only ever highlight something already visible in price, because every indicator is computed from price and nothing else. Price action traders take that same fact to its logical end: if the indicator only echoes the price, read the price directly and skip the echo. The philosophy is not mystical. It is the Lesson 1 principle, followed one step further.

Ulijifunza hapo kwamba kiashiria kinaweza tu kuangazia kitu ambacho tayari kinaonekana katika bei, kwa sababu kila kiashiria hukokotolewa kutoka bei na si kitu kingine. Wafanyabiashara wa shughuli ya bei huchukua ukweli huo huo hadi mwisho wake wa kimantiki: kama kiashiria kinarudia tu bei, soma bei moja kwa moja na uruke mwangwi. Falsafa si ya kifumbo. Ni kanuni ya Somo la 1, ikifuatwa hatua moja zaidi.

f29cb9a326cd.en: A portfolio of 50,000 with a maximum single position of 2% means 1,000 in any one company. If that company falls 60%, the loss is 600, or 1.2% of the portfolio. If it fails completely, the loss is 1,000, or 2%. Both are recoverable within an ordinary year, which is the test the limit exists to pass.
f29cb9a326cd.sw: Mkusanyiko wa 50,000 wenye nafasi moja ya juu zaidi ya 2% unamaanisha 1,000 katika kampuni yoyote moja. Kama kampuni hiyo itashuka 60%, hasara ni 600, au 1.2% ya mkusanyiko. Kama itashindwa kabisa, hasara ni 1,000, au 2%. Zote mbili zinaweza kuponeka ndani ya mwaka wa kawaida, ambalo ndilo jaribio ambalo kikomo lipo kulipita.

f2e10d365ebc.en: None of this means candlestick reading is worthless. It means the confident claims — "this three-candle shape predicts reversals" — rest on far thinner and more contested evidence than the support-and-resistance core. The wider technical-analysis literature is mixed in the same honest way: Brock, Lakonishok and LeBaron (Lesson 1) found real predictive ability in moving-average rules on a century of Dow data, while the forex-specific Ghanem et al. study you met in Foundations Chapter 3 found technical rules do predict currency moves. Support has a mechanism and forex-specific evidence; candlestick patterns have neither at the same strength. Weight them accordingly.
f2e10d365ebc.sw: Hakuna kati ya haya kinachomaanisha usomaji wa mishumaa hauna thamani. Kunamaanisha madai ya uhakika — "umbo hili la mishumaa mitatu hutabiri migeuko" — yanategemea ushahidi mwembamba zaidi na wenye mgogoro zaidi kuliko kiini cha msaada-na-upinzani. Fasihi pana ya uchambuzi wa kiufundi imechanganyika kwa njia ile ile ya uaminifu: Brock, Lakonishok na LeBaron (Somo la 1) walipata uwezo halisi wa kutabiri katika kanuni za wastani unaosogea kwenye karne moja ya data ya Dow, ilhali utafiti mahususi wa forex wa Ghanem et al. uliokutana nao katika Sura ya 3 ya Msingi uligundua kanuni za kiufundi hutabiri misogeo ya sarafu. Msaada una utaratibu na ushahidi mahususi wa forex; mitindo ya mishumaa haina wala kimoja kwa nguvu ile ile. Vipe uzito ipasavyo.

f32274b84c96.en: Look back at the last three sharp crypto falls you remember and find what the wider risk environment was doing on those same days. For most of them you will find the move was not crypto-specific at all, even though the reporting at the time named a crypto cause. That exercise is the fastest way to internalise where crypto sits on the chain.
f32274b84c96.sw: Angalia nyuma kushuka kutatu kwa kasi kwa kripto unakokumbuka na utafute mazingira mapana ya hatari yalikuwa yakifanya nini katika siku zilezile. Kwa mengi kati yake utabaini msogeo haukuwa maalum kwa kripto kabisa, hata ingawa kuripoti wakati huo kulitaja chanzo cha kripto. Zoezi hilo ndiyo njia ya haraka zaidi ya kuiweka ndani nafasi ambayo kripto hukaa katika mnyororo.

f324a8f1f8fd.en: But both lessons quietly assumed something. They assumed the network agrees on which block comes next. That agreement is the hard part. Thousands of computers hold copies of the ledger, and new transactions arrive at each of them in a slightly different order. If every computer just wrote its own next block, the copies would split apart immediately — and "which spend came first?" would again have no answer. That is the double-spend problem sneaking back in through the side door.
f324a8f1f8fd.sw: Lakini masomo yote mawili yalidhania kitu kimya kimya. Yalidhania mtandao unakubaliana kuhusu kitalu kipi kinafuata. Makubaliano hayo ndiyo sehemu ngumu. Maelfu ya kompyuta hushikilia nakala za leja, na miamala mipya hufika kwa kila moja katika mpangilio tofauti kidogo. Ikiwa kila kompyuta ingeandika tu kitalu chake kinachofuata, nakala zingegawanyika mara moja — na "matumizi yapi yalikuja kwanza?" tena lingekuwa halina jibu. Hilo ni tatizo la kutumia-mara-mbili likirudi kwa siri kupitia mlango wa pembeni.

f3538a08c433.en: Email a photo to a friend. Your friend now has the photo — and so do you. Nothing left your possession. Send the same photo to ten more people, and now eleven identical copies exist. For photos, that is a feature. For money, it is fatal. If a digital coin were just a file, you could "pay" it to one person, keep a copy, and pay the same coin to someone else. Both payments would look real.
f3538a08c433.sw: Tuma picha kwa barua pepe kwa rafiki. Rafiki yako sasa ana picha — na wewe pia unayo. Hakuna kilichoondoka kwako. Tuma picha ileile kwa watu kumi zaidi, na sasa nakala kumi na moja zinazofanana zipo. Kwa picha, hilo ni sifa nzuri. Kwa pesa, ni la kifo. Ikiwa sarafu ya kidijitali ingekuwa faili tu, ungeweza "kumlipa" mtu mmoja, ukabakiza nakala, na ukamlipa mtu mwingine sarafu ileile. Malipo yote mawili yangeonekana halisi.

f36cf54fd293.en: A share has cash flows, so its price implies a forecast you can disagree with specifically. Most crypto assets have no cash flows at all, which means there is no calculation that produces a value the price can be compared against. Ratios built from on-chain data can be useful for comparing an asset against its own history. They are not valuations, and treating them as though they were is how a narrative gets dressed up as analysis.
f36cf54fd293.sw: Hisa ina mitiririko ya fedha, kwa hivyo bei yake huashiria utabiri ambao unaweza kutokubaliana nao hasa. Rasilimali nyingi za kripto hazina mitiririko ya fedha kabisa, jambo linalomaanisha hakuna hesabu inayozalisha thamani ambayo bei inaweza kulinganishwa nayo. Uwiano uliojengwa kutoka data ya kwenye mnyororo unaweza kuwa na manufaa kwa kulinganisha rasilimali na historia yake yenyewe. Si tathmini, na kuuchukulia kana kwamba ni ndivyo simulizi hupambwa kama uchambuzi.

f36fd5e2d039.en: As you look at any pair or liquidity claim, ask yourself: is a "most traded" or "most liquid" claim backed by a specific, current, named source — or just stated as common knowledge? For an unfamiliar pair, does it include USD, and if so is the other side a major or an emerging currency? If there's no USD at all, it's a minor/cross pair. And remember that rankings change over time — treat any specific ranking as a snapshot, not a permanent fact.
f36fd5e2d039.sw: Unapotazama jozi lolote au dai lolote la ukwasi, jiulize: je, dai la "linalofanyiwa biashara zaidi" au "lenye ukwasi zaidi" linaungwa mkono na chanzo mahususi, cha sasa, kilichotajwa — au limetamkwa tu kama maarifa ya kawaida? Kwa jozi lisilofahamika, je, linajumuisha USD, na kama ndiyo, je, upande mwingine ni sarafu kuu au inayoibukia? Kama hakuna USD kabisa, ni jozi ndogo/la kuvuka. Na kumbuka madaraja hubadilika kwa muda — chukulia daraja lolote mahususi kama picha ya wakati, si ukweli wa kudumu.

f45b29db79de.en: The Bitcoin trade. Bitcoin at 60,000 dollars, with the 2 x ATR stop computed above, which is 3,800 dollars away. Position size = 50 / 3,800 = 0.01316 Bitcoin. At 60,000 dollars, that is 789 dollars of notional exposure. The stop distance is 6.33% of price. Check the risk: 0.01316 x 3,800 = 50 dollars.
f45b29db79de.sw: Biashara ya Bitcoin. Bitcoin katika dola 60,000, ikiwa na kusimamisha kwa mara 2 ya ATR kulikohesabiwa hapo juu, ambako ni dola 3,800 mbali. Ukubwa wa nafasi = 50 / 3,800 = Bitcoin 0.01316. Katika dola 60,000, hiyo ni dola 789 za kufunuliwa kwa kinadharia. Umbali wa kusimamisha ni 6.33% ya bei. Kagua hatari: 0.01316 x 3,800 = dola 50.

f45c20bf5682.en: Positive expected value is not a guarantee and it is not comfort. It says the average of many repetitions is favourable. You get one life, not many repetitions, which is exactly why position sizing exists and why Chapter 3 spends a chapter on it.

f4651c347d7e.en: Fat tails (Chapter 2, Lesson 2). The trader who internalised that extreme moves are normal, not impossible, sized and prepared for one. The trader who trusted the once-in-ten-thousand-years math did not.

f4715c4419a0.en: What to look for in your own position. Establish whether money is flowing into your portfolio or out of it, because that single fact reverses the meaning of a fall. Establish how many years of withdrawals you could cover without selling equities. Check whether your contribution schedule is automatic, since automatic schedules are the ones that survive a crisis. And decide now, in writing, what would make you stop contributing — the honest answer for most readers should be a change in income, not a change in prices.
f4715c4419a0.sw: Cha kuangalia katika msimamo wako mwenyewe. Bainisha kama pesa inatiririka kuingia katika kasha lako au kutoka, kwa sababu ukweli huo mmoja hubadilisha maana ya kushuka. Bainisha ni miaka mingapi ya utoaji ungeweza kugharimia bila kuuza hisa. Kagua kama ratiba yako ya michango ni ya kiotomatiki, kwa kuwa ratiba za kiotomatiki ndizo zinazonusurika mgogoro. Na amua sasa, kwa maandishi, kitakachokufanya uache kuchangia — jibu la kweli kwa wasomaji wengi linapaswa kuwa mabadiliko ya mapato, si mabadiliko ya bei.

f4b40c9452fc.en: The single most-cited source for this claim is the DALBAR Quantitative Analysis of Investor Behavior, which for years reported gaps of five or six percentage points a year. Wade Pfau, writing in Advisor Perspectives in 2017 under the title A Warning to the Advisory Profession: DALBAR's Math is Wrong, showed that the study compares an investor making ongoing contributions against an index return that assumes a single lump sum invested at the start. Those are two different questions. Michael Kitces has made the same criticism independently. Neither DALBAR figure nor anything derived from it belongs in a serious argument.
f4b40c9452fc.sw: Chanzo kinachonukuliwa zaidi kwa dai hili ni DALBAR Quantitative Analysis of Investor Behavior, ambayo kwa miaka mingi iliripoti mapengo ya pointi tano au sita za asilimia kwa mwaka. Wade Pfau, akiandika katika Advisor Perspectives mwaka 2017 chini ya kichwa A Warning to the Advisory Profession: DALBAR's Math is Wrong, alionyesha kuwa utafiti huo hulinganisha mwekezaji anayechangia kwa kuendelea dhidi ya faida ya faharasa inayodhania kiasi kimoja kikubwa kiliwekezwa mwanzoni. Hayo ni maswali mawili tofauti. Michael Kitces ametoa ukosoaji huohuo kwa kujitegemea. Wala takwimu ya DALBAR wala chochote kinachotokana nayo hakistahili kuwa katika hoja makini.

f502e6908271.en: The risk that the same unit of digital money is spent more than once, because digital information can be copied perfectly at almost no cost. Physical cash does not have this problem: hand over a banknote and you no longer hold it.

f50cdd751313.en: An automatic recalibration of how hard the mining puzzle is, keeping block production near a target pace no matter how much computing power joins or leaves the network. Bitcoin retunes every 2,016 blocks — about two weeks — to hold its roughly 10-minute block pace.
f50cdd751313.sw: Urekebishaji wa kiotomatiki wa jinsi kitendawili cha uchimbaji kilivyo kigumu, ukiweka uzalishaji wa vitalu karibu na kasi lengwa bila kujali nguvu ngapi za kihesabu zinajiunga au kuondoka mtandaoni. Bitcoin hurekebisha kila vitalu 2,016 — takriban wiki mbili — kushikilia kasi yake ya vitalu ya takriban dakika 10.

f64ecef429cb.en: Third, much of the traffic is internal. Exchanges consolidate deposits, rotate wallets, and move coins between hot and cold storage as routine operations. Every one of those movements creates addresses and transactions that represent no user, no decision and no trade.
f64ecef429cb.sw: Tatu, sehemu kubwa ya trafiki ni ya ndani. Masoko ya kubadilisha hukusanya amana, huzungusha pochi, na husogeza sarafu kati ya hifadhi ya moto na baridi kama shughuli za kawaida. Kila mmoja wa misogeo hiyo huunda anwani na miamala isiyowakilisha mtumiaji yeyote, uamuzi wowote wala biashara yoyote.

f658f990dc86.en: Search any chart pattern's "success rate" and you'll find numbers like "70% for head-and-shoulders" or "88% for a double bottom." These trace back overwhelmingly to one source: Thomas Bulkowski, a private investor who published his own backtested statistics in books and on a personal website — not peer-reviewed, not independently replicated, and by his own data, not stable across time (failure rates nearly doubled between the bullish 1990s and the more volatile 2000s).
f658f990dc86.sw: Tafuta "kiwango cha mafanikio" cha mtindo wowote wa chati na utapata namba kama "70% kwa head-and-shoulders" au "88% kwa double bottom." Hizi zinarudi kwa wingi mkubwa kwenye chanzo kimoja: Thomas Bulkowski, mwekezaji binafsi aliyechapisha takwimu zake mwenyewe za majaribio ya nyuma katika vitabu na kwenye tovuti binafsi — hazikukaguliwa na wenzake, hazikurudiwa kwa kujitegemea, na kwa mujibu wa data yake mwenyewe, si thabiti kwa muda (viwango vya kushindwa vilikaribia kuongezeka mara mbili kati ya miaka ya 1990 ya kupanda na miaka ya 2000 yenye mtikisiko zaidi).

f6596fcc71bf.en: The process of actually exchanging shares for money after a trade is agreed. It happens a set number of business days after the trade date.

f69b77bfa476.en: Correct. Funding turns positive when longs are crowded, and elevated open interest measures how much leverage is in the system. Together they say the fuel for a cascade is present. They do not say when, or whether, one starts — that distinction is the difference between reading a regime and predicting one.

f6c1c9bfcd4f.en: A paper document promising the holder can redeem it for a real asset — in this case gold — on demand. Merchant receipts like this existed in China as early as the 7th century; goldsmiths in 17th-century England ran a very similar system.
f6c1c9bfcd4f.sw: Hati ya karatasi inayoahidi kwamba mwenye nayo anaweza kuikomboa kwa mali halisi — katika kesi hii dhahabu — anapotaka. Risiti za wafanyabiashara kama hizi zilikuwepo China mapema kama karne ya 7; wahunzi wa dhahabu katika Uingereza ya karne ya 17 waliendesha mfumo unaofanana sana.

f6cf7a718b10.en: In prisoner-of-war camps during the Second World War, cigarettes functioned as real, working currency — divisible, portable, and valued by everyone (even non-smokers) because everyone knew everyone else would accept them. Prices were quoted "in cigarettes," debts were tracked in cigarettes, and the camp's money supply rose and fell with Red Cross parcel deliveries. This is a real, documented case (R.A. Radford's 1945 account of a WWII POW camp economy) — and it's the cleanest proof that money is about trust and function, not what it's made of.
f6cf7a718b10.sw: Katika kambi za wafungwa wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, sigara zilifanya kazi kama sarafu halisi inayofanya kazi — zinazoweza kugawanywa, kubebeka, na kuthaminiwa na kila mtu (hata wasiovuta) kwa sababu kila mtu alijua kwamba kila mtu mwingine angezikubali. Bei zilinukuliwa "kwa sigara," madeni yalifuatiliwa kwa sigara, na kiasi cha pesa cha kambi kilipanda na kushuka kulingana na uwasilishaji wa vifurushi vya Msalaba Mwekundu. Hii ni kesi halisi iliyorekodiwa (maelezo ya R.A. Radford ya mwaka 1945 kuhusu uchumi wa kambi ya wafungwa wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia) — na ndio uthibitisho ulio wazi zaidi kwamba pesa inahusu imani na kazi, si kile iliyotengenezwa nacho.

f6df1cc0b99e.en: An attack in which your mobile phone number is transferred to a SIM card the attacker controls. From that point, calls and text messages intended for you arrive on their device. Any account that sends security codes or password resets by text message becomes reachable, without your password ever being guessed.
f6df1cc0b99e.sw: Shambulizi ambapo namba yako ya simu huhamishwa kwenda kadi ya SIM ambayo mshambuliaji huidhibiti. Kuanzia hapo, simu na ujumbe wa maandishi zilizokusudiwa kwako hufika katika kifaa chao. Akaunti yoyote inayotuma misimbo ya usalama au kuweka upya manenosiri kwa ujumbe wa maandishi huwa inafikika, bila nenosiri lako kukisiwa kamwe.

f7aa9555b39d.en: Correct. Shareholders hold the residual — what is left after fixed obligations. Because those obligations do not shrink with revenue, the whole shortfall lands on the residual, so the shareholders' claim moves by much more than revenue does. This is why share prices are more volatile than the businesses underneath them.
f7aa9555b39d.sw: Sahihi. Wanahisa hushikilia mabaki — kilichobaki baada ya majukumu thabiti. Kwa sababu majukumu hayo hayapungui pamoja na mapato, upungufu wote hutua kwenye mabaki, hivyo dai la wanahisa husogea kwa zaidi mno kuliko mapato yanavyosogea. f7b8ca20a8a7.en: The series 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21... where each number is the sum of the previous two. Dividing a number by its successor converges to ≈0.618 — the "golden ratio" relationship; dividing by the number two positions later gives ≈0.382, and three later ≈0.236.
f7b8ca20a8a7.sw: Mfululizo 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21... ambapo kila namba ni jumla ya mbili zilizotangulia. Kugawanya namba kwa inayoifuata huungana kuelekea ≈0.618 — uhusiano wa "uwiano wa dhahabu"; kugawanya kwa namba iliyo nafasi mbili baadaye hutoa ≈0.382, na tatu baadaye ≈0.236.

f7fa9651194c.en: The risk that the place holding your assets fails, independent of what those assets do. It applies identically to every holding at that venue, so it cannot be diversified away by holding more assets there.

f802fb679600.en: On August 15, 1971, President Nixon announced the U.S. would suspend the dollar's convertibility into gold — "closing the gold window." What was framed as temporary turned out to be permanent. A brief patch (the Smithsonian Agreement, December 1971) failed, and by 1973 major currencies had abandoned fixed pegs entirely.
f802fb679600.sw: Tarehe 15 Agosti 1971, Rais Nixon alitangaza kwamba Marekani ingesimamisha ubadilishaji wa dola kuwa dhahabu — "kufunga dirisha la dhahabu." Kilichowasilishwa kama cha muda kiligeuka kuwa cha kudumu. Kiraka cha muda mfupi (Makubaliano ya Smithsonian, Desemba 1971) kilishindwa, na kufikia mwaka 1973 sarafu kuu zilikuwa zimeacha vifungo thabiti kabisa.

f840bb49e269.en: Three real uses explain why stablecoins now settle more value than most people expect. First, trading pairs: on most exchanges (Lesson 5), coins are priced against a stablecoin, not against bank dollars, so selling into one lets a trader step out of volatility without leaving crypto rails. Second, moving value between venues: a stablecoin transfer settles like any transaction from Lesson 6 — minutes, any hour, any day. Third, dollar access where banking is hard: in countries with high inflation or restricted dollar accounts, a dollar-denominated token that only needs a phone and a private key is genuinely useful. This course is written for underserved investors, so we say this plainly — and just as plainly: the token is only as good as the promise behind it, which is the entire rest of this lesson.
f840bb49e269.sw: Matumizi matatu halisi hueleza kwa nini sarafu imara sasa hutimiza thamani zaidi kuliko watu wengi wanavyotarajia. Kwanza, jozi za biashara: katika masoko mengi ya kubadilisha (Somo la 5), sarafu hupangiwa bei dhidi ya sarafu imara, si dhidi ya dola za benki, kwa hivyo kuuza ndani yake humruhusu mfanyabiashara kutoka nje ya mtikisiko bila kuondoka kwenye reli za kripto. Pili, kuhamisha thamani kati ya viwanja: uhamisho wa sarafu imara hutimizwa kama muamala wowote kutoka Somo la 6 — dakika, saa yoyote, siku yoyote. Tatu, upatikanaji wa dola pale huduma za benki zilipo ngumu: katika nchi zenye mfumuko mkubwa wa bei au akaunti za dola zilizozuiwa, tokeni yenye dhehebu la dola inayohitaji simu na ufunguo wa faragha pekee ni ya manufaa kweli. Kozi hii imeandikwa kwa wawekezaji wasiohudumiwa vya kutosha, kwa hivyo tunasema hili wazi — na kwa uwazi uleule: tokeni ni bora tu kadiri ya ahadi iliyo nyuma yake, ambayo ndiyo somo lililobaki lote.

f84503889a8e.en: The reversal in AUD/JPY was brutal. Between July and October 2008 the pair fell by roughly 45%, from about 104 to below 57, reaching a low near 55 in October 2008 — nearly halving in a matter of months. The yen strengthened sharply across the board as capital fled risky assets and rushed home to safety. Traders who had earned a few percent a year in interest lost many times that in currency losses in a few weeks.
f84503889a8e.sw: Mgeuko katika AUD/JPY ulikuwa mkali. Kati ya Julai na Oktoba 2008 jozi lilishuka kwa takriban 45%, kutoka takriban 104 hadi chini ya 57, likifikia kiwango cha chini karibu na 55 mwezi Oktoba 2008 — likikaribia kupungua nusu ndani ya miezi michache. Yen iliimarika kwa kasi kote kadri mtaji ulivyokimbia mali hatarishi na kukimbilia nyumbani kwa usalama. Wafanyabiashara waliokuwa wamepata asilimia chache kwa mwaka kwa riba walipoteza mara nyingi zaidi ya hiyo kwa hasara za sarafu ndani ya wiki chache.

f891e185cf76.en: A distance means nothing on its own. It means something when you set it against how far the asset routinely travels. Lesson 1 of this chapter did that measurement and settled on a working figure. It compared Fidelity Digital Assets' 90-day realized volatility for bitcoin, averaging in the mid-40s over the two years to 2024 and 2025, with BlackRock's iShares figure of roughly 54% for a window ending near the start of 2025, alongside 15.1% for gold and 10.5% for global equities. It then adopted roughly 46% annualised for bitcoin, stating the choice openly. This lesson uses the same number, so the two lessons stay comparable.

Lililinganisha mtikisiko uliotimizwa wa siku 90 wa Fidelity Digital Assets kwa bitcoin, ukiwa wastani katika 40 za kati katika miaka miwili hadi 2024 na 2025, na takwimu ya iShares ya BlackRock ya takriban 54% kwa dirisha lililoishia karibu na mwanzo wa 2025, sambamba na 15.1% kwa dhahabu na 10.5% kwa hisa za kimataifa. Kisha likakubali takriban 46% kwa mwaka kwa bitcoin, likitaja chaguo wazi. Somo hili hutumia namba ileile, ili masomo mawili yabaki yanayolinganishika.

f8e404baebf1.en: Around any central bank meeting, hold these habits: ask not "will they hike?" but "what does the market already expect, and what would surprise it?" Watch for hawkish/dovish language in policymaker speeches between meetings — markets move on these long before any decision. When you hear "high interest rates mean a strong currency," remember the forward premium puzzle: true as an instinct, unreliable as a rule. And treat carry-trade interest income as compensation for real crash risk, not free money — size positions accordingly (Chapter 1, Lesson 5).

Unaposikia "viwango vya juu vya riba vinamaanisha sarafu imara," kumbuka fumbo la malipo ya mbele: kweli kama silika, isiyotegemewa kama kanuni. f96dbb4dd373.en: In late 2021, U.S. inflation ran notably higher than Eurozone inflation. The textbook expectation was a weaker dollar. Instead, the dollar traded near a 16-month high against the euro — fears of renewed European COVID lockdowns outweighed the inflation differential. The relationship wasn't wrong; it was overridden.

Badala yake, dola ilifanyiwa biashara karibu na kiwango cha juu zaidi cha miezi 16 dhidi ya euro — hofu ya kufungwa upya kwa Ulaya kwa sababu ya COVID zilizidi tofauti ya mfumuko wa bei. fa36e40e5482.en: That is the honest lesson, and it happens to match the direct evidence from Chapter 2. Barber and Odean, in Trading Is Hazardous to Your Wealth, published in the Journal of Finance in 2000, found that the fifth of households who traded most earned 11.4% a year against a market return of 17.9%. That is a gap of 6.5 points, and it is measured on actual trading accounts rather than inferred from fund flows.
