fa6b886d1e4d.en: Practically, exchange custody is a decision about quantity and duration, not a yes-or-no. Chapter 1 Lesson 4 gave you the framework: match custody to the amount, the horizon, and your demonstrated competence. The security-specific version is narrower. Keep on an exchange only what you are actually trading in the near term, and treat everything above that as a balance you are lending to a company for no interest. Turn on two-factor authentication that is not SMS. Turn on a withdrawal address allowlist if the exchange offers one, so that a stolen session cannot send funds to a new address without a waiting period.
fa6b886d1e4d.sw: Kivitendo, utunzaji wa soko la kubadilisha ni uamuzi kuhusu kiasi na muda, si ndiyo-au-hapana. Sura ya 1 Somo la 4 lilikupa mfumo: oanisha utunzaji na kiasi, upeo, na uwezo wako ulioonyeshwa. Toleo maalum la usalama ni finyu zaidi. Weka katika soko la kubadilisha kile tu unachokifanyia biashara kwa muda wa karibu, na chukulia kila kitu juu ya hicho kama salio unalolikopesha kampuni bila riba. Washa uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili usio wa SMS. Washa orodha ya anwani zinazoruhusiwa za utoaji ikiwa soko hutoa moja, ili kipindi kilichoibiwa kisiweze kutuma fedha kwa anwani mpya bila kipindi cha kusubiri.

fa6f6f8abae8.en: Borrowing removes limited liability, and shorting removes the floor. Both convert a bad outcome into one that can exceed what you put in.
fa6f6f8abae8.sw: Kukopa huondoa dhima yenye kikomo, na kufanya short huondoa sakafu. Vyote hugeuza tokeo baya kuwa lile linaloweza kuzidi ulichoweka.

fa76a6fbda08.en: A line chart of the Nasdaq Composite from its peak of 5,048.62 on 10 March 2000, through its trough of 1,114.11 on 9 October 2002, to 23 April 2015 when it first closed above the earlier peak at 5,056.06.
fa76a6fbda08.sw: Chati ya mistari ya Nasdaq Composite kutoka kilele chake cha 5,048.62 tarehe 10 Machi 2000, kupitia bonde lake la 1,114.11 tarehe 9 Oktoba 2002, hadi 23 Aprili 2015 ilipofungwa kwa mara ya kwanza juu ya kilele cha awali katika 5,056.06.

fa7c637ab144.en: Because the reward is paid in the same token and funded by issuance that dilutes every holder — so it can increase your unit count without increasing your share of the asset
fa7c637ab144.sw: Kwa sababu zawadi hulipwa katika tokeni ileile na hufadhiliwa na utoaji unaopunguza thamani ya kila mmiliki — kwa hivyo inaweza kuongeza hesabu yako ya vipimo bila kuongeza sehemu yako ya rasilimali

faa2731660e6.en: Not quite. Switching is not always free, and a cheaper fund is not guaranteed to perform better. The argument is purely about timing: one-off costs against an annual charge that compounds for as long as you hold.
faa2731660e6.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Kuhamia si bure daima, na mfuko wa bei nafuu hauhakikishiwi kufanya vizuri zaidi. Hoja inahusu muda pekee: gharama za mara moja dhidi ya malipo ya kila mwaka yanayojilimbikiza kwa muda wote unaoshikilia.

faa392fb857e.en: Pick the stablecoin you are most likely to actually use. Find its most recent reserve report and answer three questions in writing: (1) What are the reserves — cash and short-term government debt, or something riskier? (2) Is the report an attestation or a full audit, and who signed it? (3) What are the redemption terms — minimums, fees, who is eligible? If you cannot answer all three in 20 minutes, that is itself information.
faa392fb857e.sw: Chagua sarafu imara ambayo unawezekana zaidi kuitumia hasa. Tafuta ripoti yake ya akiba ya hivi karibuni zaidi na ujibu maswali matatu kwa maandishi: (1) Akiba ni nini — fedha taslimu na deni la muda mfupi la serikali, au kitu chenye hatari zaidi? (2) Je, ripoti ni ushuhuda au ukaguzi kamili, na nani aliitia sahihi? (3) Masharti ya ukombozi ni yapi — viwango vya chini kabisa, ada, nani anastahili? Ikiwa huwezi kujibu yote matatu ndani ya dakika 20, hilo lenyewe ni taarifa.

faa612a41760.en: What to look for. When someone quotes a market cap, ask what the circulating supply is and what the total supply is; if market cap divided by FDV is well under 50%, most of the supply has not arrived yet. When someone says a number was wiped off a market, remember that a market cap change is a multiplication changing, not that quantity of cash leaving. Before entering a position, add up the resting bids within 1% and 2% of price and compare that to the size you intend to sell; if your intended exit is larger than the depth, you do not have an exit at that price. Treat reported volume on an unregulated venue as a marketing figure. When a token's volume is high but its book is thin, treat the mismatch as a warning rather than as excitement, because that combination is exactly what wash trading produces. And when someone argues from small cap, ask what the demand argument is.
faa612a41760.sw: Cha kuangalia. Mtu anaponukuu kiasi cha soko, uliza usambazaji unaozunguka ni upi na usambazaji jumla ni upi; ikiwa kiasi cha soko kikigawanywa na FDV ni chini sana ya 50%, sehemu kubwa ya usambazaji haijafika bado. Mtu anaposema namba ilifutwa kutoka soko, kumbuka kwamba mabadiliko ya kiasi cha soko ni kuzidisha kunakobadilika, si kiasi hicho cha fedha kikiondoka. Kabla ya kuingia katika nafasi, jumlisha zabuni zilizopumzika ndani ya 1% na 2% ya bei na ulinganishe hiyo na ukubwa unaokusudia kuuza; ikiwa kutoka kwako kunakokusudiwa ni kukubwa kuliko kina, huna kutoka katika bei hiyo. Chukulia ujazo unaoripotiwa katika uwanja usiodhibitiwa kama takwimu ya utangazaji. Ujazo wa tokeni unapokuwa mkubwa lakini kitabu chake chembamba, chukulia kutolingana huko kama onyo badala ya msisimko, kwa sababu mchanganyiko huo ndio hasa biashara ya kujiosha inayozalisha. Na mtu anapotoa hoja kutoka kiasi kidogo, uliza hoja ya mahitaji ni ipi.

fac8a5a9457d.en: Correct — MACD is built from moving averages and measures their convergence/divergence, the same underlying event as a crossover, just presented differently. No indicator computed from price can contain information price doesn't.
fac8a5a9457d.sw: Sahihi — MACD imejengwa kutoka wastani unaosogea na hupima muunganiko/utengano wao, tukio lile lile la msingi kama mkatizo, likiwasilishwa tofauti tu. Hakuna kiashiria kinachokokotolewa kutoka bei kinachoweza kuwa na taarifa ambayo bei haina.

fadce2ca1447.en: An asset with an average zero/negative correlation across all conditions.
fadce2ca1447.sw: Mali yenye uwiano wa wastani wa sifuri/hasi katika hali zote.

faed3da5a60d.en: Pick any asset that has moved sharply in the last month and reconstruct its loop on paper. Write down the story being told about it in one sentence. Then ask: what evidence is offered for that story, and how much of that evidence is just the price itself? Next, look up the current funding rate for that asset on any venue that publishes one, note the settlement interval, and write down what the sign tells you about which side is crowded - and then write down, honestly, that it tells you nothing about when. Finally, check the Fear & Greed reading for the same day and ask what it told you that the price chart had not already.
faed3da5a60d.sw: Chagua rasilimali yoyote iliyosogea kwa kasi katika mwezi uliopita na ujenge upya kitanzi chake kwenye karatasi. Andika hadithi inayosimuliwa kuihusu katika sentensi moja. Kisha uliza: ni ushahidi gani unaotolewa kwa hadithi hiyo, na ni kiasi gani cha ushahidi huo ni bei yenyewe tu? Kisha, tafuta kiwango cha sasa cha ufadhili cha rasilimali hiyo katika uwanja wowote unaokichapisha, tambua kipindi cha utimizaji, na uandike alama inakuambia nini kuhusu upande upi umejaa - kisha uandike, kwa ukweli, kwamba haikuambii lolote kuhusu lini. Mwishowe, kagua usomaji wa Hofu na Tamaa wa siku ileile na uulize ulikuambia nini ambacho chati ya bei ilikuwa tayari haijakuambia.

fb02f1de4067.en: A company reports growing profits for three years, while cash from operations stays flat. What is the most reasonable reading?
fb02f1de4067.sw: Kampuni huripoti faida zinazokua kwa miaka mitatu, ilhali fedha kutoka shughuli hubaki tuli. Usomaji wenye busara zaidi ni upi?

fb073c0d8896.en: Set the theory against Lesson 7's arithmetic and the practical picture is clear. Sharpe's result says active management in aggregate must underperform after costs. Grossman and Stiglitz say some opportunity must exist for someone. Both are true: there are rewards, they are competed for by well-resourced professionals, and the average participant pays more in costs than they recover.
fb073c0d8896.sw: Weka nadharia dhidi ya hesabu ya Somo la 7 na picha ya kivitendo iko wazi. Tokeo la Sharpe husema usimamizi wa bidii kwa jumla lazima ufanye vibaya baada ya gharama. Grossman na Stiglitz husema fursa fulani lazima iwepo kwa mtu. Vyote ni kweli: kuna tuzo, zinashindaniwa na wataalamu wenye rasilimali nyingi, na mshiriki wa wastani hulipa zaidi katika gharama kuliko anavyorudisha.

fb394cec0eb8.en: An activity where one participant's gain is exactly another's loss. Nothing is created; the pot is only redistributed.
fb394cec0eb8.sw: Shughuli ambapo faida ya mshiriki mmoja ni hasara ya mwingine hasa. Hakuna kinachoundwa; chungu hugawanywa upya tu.

fb44492734d9.en: The correct response is not to abandon diversification but to stop relying on it alone. Holdings that are genuinely different in kind, rather than in region, and cash held outside the market, are what remain effective when equity correlations converge. Chapter 3 Lesson 1 made this point from the risk side; it is the same conclusion reached from the portfolio side.
fb44492734d9.sw: Jibu sahihi si kuacha mtawanyiko bali kuacha kuutegemea peke yake. Umiliki ulio tofauti kweli kwa aina, badala ya kwa kanda, na fedha taslimu inayoshikiliwa nje ya soko, ndivyo vinavyobaki na ufanisi wakati uhusiano wa hisa unapokusanyika. Sura ya 3 Somo la 1 lilitoa hoja hii kutoka upande wa hatari; ni hitimisho lilelile lililofikiwa kutoka upande wa kasha.

fb4644bfae68.en: Take the next investment recommendation you encounter, from any source. Write down the specific piece of information it rests on, and the date that information became public. If the price already moved on that date, you have watched semi-strong efficiency work — and you have learned what the recommendation was actually worth.
fb4644bfae68.sw: Chukua pendekezo lijalo la uwekezaji utakalokutana nalo, kutoka chanzo chochote. Andika kipande mahususi cha taarifa linalotegemea, na tarehe ambayo taarifa hiyo ilikuwa ya umma. Kama bei tayari ilisogea tarehe hiyo, umetazama ufanisi wa nusu-imara ukifanya kazi — na umejifunza pendekezo lilikuwa na thamani gani hasa.

fb6a23d1e959.en: A record of the fees each exchange charges
fb6a23d1e959.sw: Rekodi ya ada ambazo kila soko la kubadilisha hutoza

fb6ff7f9b027.en: The investor made a deliberate decision to increase the position
fb6ff7f9b027.sw: Mwekezaji alifanya uamuzi wa makusudi wa kuongeza nafasi

fb80bb5d653d.en: Not quite. The point is not to trade more, and no general rule about five-year recoveries follows — the previous lesson showed a fifteen-year one. It is that the recovery's best days sat inside its worst weeks, which punishes decisions made for the sake of clarity.
fb80bb5d653d.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Lengo si kufanya biashara zaidi, wala hakuna kanuni ya jumla kuhusu kupona kwa miaka mitano inayofuata — somo lililotangulia lilionyesha kupona kwa miaka kumi na mitano. Ni kwamba siku bora zaidi za kupona zilikaa ndani ya wiki zake mbaya zaidi, jambo linaloadhibu maamuzi yanayofanywa kwa ajili ya uwazi.

fba12bf483f2.en: Two thirds of the time is not always. In the third of cases where the market falls after the investment date, averaging in does better, sometimes substantially. Anyone presenting lump sum as simply correct is describing an average as a certainty — the same error the value-premium lesson warned about.
fba12bf483f2.sw: Theluthi mbili ya muda si daima. Katika theluthi moja ya kesi ambapo soko hushuka baada ya tarehe ya uwekezaji, kupunguza wastani wa bei hufanya vizuri zaidi, wakati mwingine kwa kiasi kikubwa. Yeyote anayewasilisha kiasi kamili kama sahihi tu anaeleza wastani kama uhakika — kosa lile lile ambalo somo la malipo ya ziada ya thamani lilionya kuhusu.

fbc1bf98c396.en: Not quite — a crossover only means the last 20 closes now average below the last 50. It's read as bearish, but guarantees nothing about what price does next.
fbc1bf98c396.sw: Si sahihi kabisa — mkatizo unamaanisha tu kwamba bei 20 za mwisho za kufunga sasa zinawastani chini ya 50 za mwisho. Husomwa kama ya kushuka, lakini haihakikishi chochote kuhusu bei itakayofanya baadaye.

fbe543826ff6.en: The Rise and Fall of the Gold Standard
fbe543826ff6.sw: Kupanda na Kuanguka kwa Kiwango cha Dhahabu

fbe7442dd94d.en: There is also a second way companies return cash, and comparing only dividends misses it entirely.
fbe7442dd94d.sw: Pia kuna njia ya pili ambayo kampuni hurudisha fedha, na kulinganisha gawio tu huikosa kabisa.

fbfeee85d978.en: Correct — hand over a banknote and you no longer have it, but send a digital file and you still hold a perfect copy. Without a ledger to reject the second spend, one coin could pay two people.
fbfeee85d978.sw: Sahihi — kabidhi noti na huna tena, lakini tuma faili la kidijitali na bado unashikilia nakala kamili. Bila leja ya kukataa matumizi ya pili, sarafu moja ingeweza kuwalipa watu wawili.

fc02159833ec.en: In Lesson 1, converting dollars to pesos meant working with two currencies at once. There's a specific term for that relationship.
fc02159833ec.sw: Katika Somo la 1, kubadilisha dola kuwa peso kulimaanisha kufanya kazi na sarafu mbili kwa wakati mmoja. Kuna neno mahususi kwa uhusiano huo.

fc0c2c7bd1a5.en: Find any post claiming an on-chain metric called a top or a bottom. Write down four things: (1) which provider's version of the metric is shown, (2) the exact rule that generates the signal, including the numeric threshold, (3) every past instance where that exact rule fired, including the ones that failed, and (4) whether the rule existed before the dates it is being credited for. Most posts fail at step 2, because there is no stated rule, only a chart and an arrow.
fc0c2c7bd1a5.sw: Tafuta chapisho lolote linalodai kipimo cha kwenye mnyororo kilitabiri kilele au bonde. Andika mambo manne: (1) ni toleo la mtoa data yupi la kipimo linaloonyeshwa, (2) kanuni hasa inayozalisha ishara, ikiwa ni pamoja na kizingiti cha kinambari, (3) kila tukio la awali ambapo kanuni hiyo hasa ilifyatuka, ikiwa ni pamoja na yale yaliyoshindwa, na (4) kama kanuni ilikuwepo kabla ya tarehe ambazo inasifiwa kwazo. Machapisho mengi hushindwa katika hatua ya 2, kwa sababu hakuna kanuni iliyotajwa, chati na mshale tu.

fc0e69926272.en: Stablecoins are how money waits inside crypto. A sustained expansion in their aggregate supply indicates capital arriving and staying; a sustained contraction indicates capital leaving the system rather than rotating within it. It is a coarse measure, it can be distorted by a single large issuer's decisions, and it is still one of the few readings available that describes the system as a whole rather than one asset.
fc0e69926272.sw: Sarafu imara ndivyo pesa husubiri ndani ya kripto. Upanukaji unaodumu katika usambazaji wao jumlifu huonyesha mtaji ukifika na kubaki; upungufu unaodumu huonyesha mtaji ukiondoka katika mfumo badala ya kuzunguka ndani yake. Ni kipimo kibovu, kinaweza kupotoshwa na maamuzi ya mtoaji mmoja mkubwa, na bado ni mojawapo ya usomaji mchache unaopatikana unaoelezea mfumo kwa ujumla badala ya rasilimali moja.

fc10685014c2.en: A genuinely positive-expectancy system can lose over 5, 10, even 20 trades in a row — that is normal variance, not a broken system, and it is the same fat-tailed, streaky randomness you met in Chapter 2. Just as dangerous in reverse: a losing system can win for a while by pure chance, tempting you to trust it and size up. You cannot judge a system, or yourself, on a handful of trades. This is exactly why the plan includes a review over a meaningful sample, and why your risk per trade must be small enough (Chapter 3, Lesson 1) to survive the inevitable losing streaks while the edge has time to show.
fc10685014c2.sw: Mfumo wenye matarajio chanya kweli unaweza kupoteza katika biashara 5, 10, hata 20 mfululizo — huo ni utofauti wa kawaida, si mfumo ulioharibika, na ni ubahatishaji ule ule wa mikia minene na wa mfululizo uliokutana nao katika Sura ya 2. Hatari sawa kwa kinyume: mfumo unaopoteza unaweza kushinda kwa muda kwa bahati tu, ukikushawishi uuamini na kuongeza ukubwa. Huwezi kuhukumu mfumo, wala nafsi yako, kwa biashara chache. Hii ndiyo hasa sababu mpango unajumuisha kupitia katika sampuli yenye maana, na kwa nini hatari yako kwa kila biashara lazima iwe ndogo vya kutosha (Sura ya 3, Somo la 1) kunusurika mifululizo ya hasara isiyoepukika huku faida ikiwa na muda wa kujitokeza.

fc223fa4f354.en: The Foundations track established that extreme moves happen far more often than a normal distribution predicts, and the Forex track showed one in detail. A risk measure calibrated on ordinary weeks will understate the week that matters. Any statement of the form this cannot happen, it would be a six standard deviation event is a statement about the model rather than about the market.
fc223fa4f354.sw: Njia ya Msingi ilibainisha kwamba misogeo ya kupindukia hutokea mara nyingi zaidi mno kuliko mtawanyiko wa kawaida unavyotabiri, na njia ya Forex ilionyesha mmoja kwa undani. Kipimo cha hatari kilichorekebishwa juu ya wiki za kawaida kitaeleza chini wiki inayohusika. Kauli yoyote ya umbo la hii haiwezi kutokea, lingekuwa tukio la mkengeuko sanifu sita ni kauli kuhusu muundo badala ya soko.

fc3a77dfdb1f.en: That plan is eight lines. It answers every question in this lesson, and its main virtue is that a version of you in a bad year can read it and see that a version of you in a calm year had already considered this.
fc3a77dfdb1f.sw: Mpango huo ni mistari minane. Hujibu kila swali katika somo hili, na sifa yake kuu ni kwamba toleo lako la mwaka mbaya linaweza kuusoma na kuona kwamba toleo lako la mwaka wa utulivu lilikuwa tayari limelifikiria hili.

fc4e3b8e0c3f.en: A market with no trend, catalyst, or aligned pillar — where the correct position is usually cash.
fc4e3b8e0c3f.sw: Soko lisilo na mwelekeo, kichocheo, wala nguzo iliyolingana — ambapo nafasi sahihi kwa kawaida ni fedha taslimu.

fc5c1f86a0b2.en: One last caution that applies to every tool in this lesson. A sentiment reading, a mention count and a funding rate are inputs to a question you are asking, never a trigger that acts on your behalf. And treat a compelling narrative as a reason for extra scrutiny rather than less - the more obviously right a story feels, the more people have already bought it. When someone with a large audience promotes an asset, assume they may already hold a position that your buying would benefit, and ask whether they have disclosed it. Chapter 4 covers this failure mode, and outright fraud, in full.
fc5c1f86a0b2.sw: Tahadhari moja ya mwisho inayohusu kila zana katika somo hili. Usomaji wa hisia, hesabu ya matajo na kiwango cha ufadhili ni viingizo kwa swali unaloliuliza, kamwe si kichocheo kinachotenda kwa niaba yako. Na chukulia simulizi ya kuvutia kama sababu ya uchunguzi wa ziada badala ya mdogo - kadiri hadithi inavyohisi kuwa sahihi dhahiri, ndivyo watu wengi zaidi tayari wameinunua. Mtu mwenye hadhira kubwa anapotangaza rasilimali, dhania anaweza kuwa tayari anashikilia nafasi ambayo ununuzi wako ungeinufaisha, na uliza kama ameifichua. Sura ya 4 hushughulikia namna hii ya kushindwa, na udanganyifu wa waziwazi, kikamilifu.

fc5f971b755b.en: The robust empirical finding that UIP fails — high-rate currencies often appreciate instead.
fc5f971b755b.sw: Tokeo imara la kimajaribio kwamba UIP hushindwa — sarafu za viwango vya juu mara nyingi huimarika badala yake.

fc6ca179a08c.en: That is not an argument that you must never hold cash. It is the reason the decision belongs in a document written in advance, checked against a condition, rather than made on a Tuesday in March when the news is at its worst.
fc6ca179a08c.sw: Hiyo si hoja kwamba hupaswi kamwe kushikilia fedha taslimu. Ni sababu inayofanya uamuzi ustahili kuwa katika hati iliyoandikwa mapema, ukikaguliwa dhidi ya sharti, badala ya kufanywa siku ya Jumanne mwezi Machi wakati habari ziko mbaya zaidi.

fc743b5d84ab.en: A usable crypto plan has seven sections. The first four are the standard ones, compressed here because earlier lessons did the work. The last three do not exist in any other track.
fc743b5d84ab.sw: Mpango wa kripto unaotumika una sehemu saba. Nne za kwanza ni za kawaida, zikibanwa hapa kwa sababu masomo ya awali yalifanya kazi. Tatu za mwisho hazipo katika njia nyingine yoyote.

fc7726436736.en: Levels at 23.6/38.2/50/61.8/78.6% of a move, watched as pullback zones.
fc7726436736.sw: Viwango kwa 23.6/38.2/50/61.8/78.6% ya msogeo, vinavyotazamwa kama kanda za kurudi nyuma.

fc77a1532b08.en: The window slides one close at a time, and where the 20 crosses the 50 marks the signal — with the occasional whipsaw baked in.
fc77a1532b08.sw: Dirisha huteleza bei moja ya kufunga kwa wakati, na mahali 20 inapokatiza 50 huashiria ishara — pamoja na whipsaw ya mara kwa mara iliyojengwa ndani.

fc89c4280942.en: Correct. The sequence is structural rather than a comment on anyone's judgement. Nobody writes about an asset that has done nothing, so the information reaches you only after the move. The same study estimated that 73 to 81% of retail investors had likely lost money, and found the largest holders selling into the buying that smaller users were doing.
fc89c4280942.sw: Sahihi. Mfuatano ni wa kimuundo badala ya maoni juu ya hukumu ya yeyote. Hakuna anayeandika kuhusu rasilimali ambayo haijafanya lolote, kwa hivyo taarifa hukufikia tu baada ya msogeo. Utafiti uleule ulikadiria kwamba 73 hadi 81% ya wawekezaji wa rejareja pengine walipoteza pesa, na ulibaini wamiliki wakubwa zaidi wakiuza katika ununuzi ambao watumiaji wadogo zaidi walikuwa wakifanya.

fca6d4d4a274.sw: Mitindo ya chati haina manufaa kabisa

fcaa4adc5800.en: The risk that the order in which returns arrive damages you, even when the average return is unchanged.
fcaa4adc5800.sw: Hatari kwamba mpangilio ambao faida hufika hukudhuru, hata faida ya wastani ikibaki ile ile.

fcc01cdb1391.en: This is why the arithmetic earlier is not pedantry. When the Swiss National Bank floor collapsed in 2015 (Chapter 1, Lesson 7), the traders who survived were not the ones who predicted it — they were the ones whose positions were small enough that a violent move could not end them. Correct pip value feeds correct position size, and correct position size is what keeps you at the table long enough for an edge to matter.
fcc01cdb1391.sw: Ndiyo sababu hesabu ya awali si udogo wa kupita kiasi. Sakafu ya Benki Kuu ya Uswisi ilipoanguka mwaka 2015 (Sura ya 1, Somo la 7), wafanyabiashara walionusurika hawakuwa wale walioitabiri — walikuwa wale ambao nafasi zao zilikuwa ndogo vya kutosha kiasi kwamba msogeo wa nguvu haungeweza kuwamaliza. Thamani sahihi ya pip hulisha ukubwa sahihi wa nafasi, na ukubwa sahihi wa nafasi ndicho kinachokuweka mezani muda mrefu vya kutosha ili faida ihusike.

fcc5874748ab.en: Not quite. Nothing changed about the accounting, and the multiple is not meaningless — it is misleading in a specific, predictable direction for cyclical businesses. Peak earnings make the multiple look lowest just before they fall.
fcc5874748ab.sw: Si sahihi kabisa. Hakuna kilichobadilika kuhusu uhasibu, na kizidishi si kisicho na maana — kinapotosha kwa mwelekeo mahususi unaotabirika kwa biashara za mzunguko. Mapato ya kilele hufanya kizidishi kionekane kidogo zaidi kabla tu hayajashuka.

fcc8f965f9e7.en: Volume looks like the honest number. It is a count of what traded, and a high figure looks like proof that a market is real and active. That is exactly why it is worth faking.
fcc8f965f9e7.sw: Ujazo huonekana kama namba ya kweli. Ni hesabu ya kilichofanyiwa biashara, na takwimu kubwa huonekana kama uthibitisho kwamba soko ni halisi na hai. Ndiyo hasa sababu inastahili kughushiwa.

fccb59365ba1.en: Every country issues its own currency. A Canadian dollar is legal tender in Canada — but it's just a piece of paper anywhere else. Cross a border, and you need the local currency to buy anything.
fccb59365ba1.sw: Kila nchi hutoa sarafu yake yenyewe. Dola ya Kanada ni halali kisheria nchini Kanada — lakini ni kipande cha karatasi tu mahali pengine popote. Vuka mpaka, na unahitaji sarafu ya humo ili kununua chochote.

fcd35943616b.en: Effective leverage (Chapter 3, Lesson 2). The accounts that went negative were running high effective leverage, so a gap larger than their free-margin cushion blew straight through it. Low effective leverage was the difference between a scare and a ruin.
fcd35943616b.sw: Leverage halisi (Sura ya 3, Somo la 2). Akaunti zilizokuwa hasi zilikuwa zikiendesha leverage halisi kubwa, hivyo kuruka kukubwa kuliko mto wao wa margin huru kulipenya moja kwa moja. Leverage halisi ndogo ndiyo ilikuwa tofauti kati ya woga na uharibifu.

Soma duara lilelile kinyume nawe una kuanguka: shaka, uuzaji, bei ya chini, ukanushaji unaoonekana, uuzaji zaidi. Hakuna kuhusu rasilimali ya msingi kilichohitaji kubadilika katika mwelekeo wowote.

fe36020b47d1.en: Chapter 2, Lesson 5 introduced two terms and then stopped short on purpose. It defined the perpetual swap as a derivative that tracks an asset's price and never expires. It defined the funding rate as the periodic payment that flows between long and short holders to keep the perpetual price near spot. It taught you to read that rate as a positioning proxy: persistently positive funding means the long side is crowded and paying to stay there.
fe36020b47d1.sw: Sura ya 2, Somo la 5 lilianzisha maneno mawili kisha likasimama kwa makusudi. Lilifafanua ubadilishano wa kudumu kama kiderivativi kinachofuatilia bei ya rasilimali na kisichokwisha muda kamwe. Lilifafanua kiwango cha ufadhili kama malipo ya mara kwa mara yanayotiririka kati ya wamiliki warefu na wafupi ili kuweka bei ya kudumu karibu na papo hapo. Lilikufundisha kukisoma kiwango hicho kama kipimo mbadala cha msimamo: ufadhili chanya wa kudumu humaanisha upande mrefu umejaa na unalipia kubaki hapo.

fe8e7a33b4a0.en: Real, current spread data (2026) gives a useful sense of scale. On EUR/USD — the most liquid pair in the world — the industry-average spread across retail brokers sits around 0.88 pips on a standard, commission-free account, working out to roughly $8.80 per standard lot round-trip. On "raw" or ECN-style accounts, the quoted spread often drops close to 0.0–0.2 pips, but the broker charges a separate commission (typically $3–7 per lot round-trip) instead — the total cost usually lands in a similar range either way, just structured differently.
fe8e7a33b4a0.sw: Data halisi ya sasa ya spread (2026) inatoa hisia ya manufaa ya ukubwa. Kwenye EUR/USD — jozi lenye ukwasi mkubwa zaidi duniani — spread ya wastani wa sekta katika mabroker wa rejareja iko karibu pip 0.88 kwenye akaunti sanifu isiyo na kamisheni, ikitokea kuwa takriban $8.80 kwa lot sanifu ya kwenda na kurudi. Kwenye akaunti za "raw" au za mtindo wa ECN, spread inayonukuliwa mara nyingi hushuka karibu na pip 0.0–0.2, lakini broker hutoza kamisheni tofauti (kwa kawaida $3–7 kwa lot ya kwenda na kurudi) badala yake — gharama ya jumla kwa kawaida hufikia kiwango kinachofanana kwa vyovyote vile, ikiwa imepangwa tofauti tu.

fe93966b7cef.en: Foundations taught you that an asset's value comes from what it does for someone. A company's share is a claim on that company's future profits. A bond pays a coupon. A rental property produces rent. Those payments are not a guarantee of price, but they are an anchor. When a share price runs far ahead of the profits underneath it, an analyst can put a number on the gap and argue about it.
fe93966b7cef.sw: Misingi ilikufundisha kwamba thamani ya rasilimali hutoka kile inachomfanyia mtu. Hisa ya kampuni ni dai juu ya faida za baadaye za kampuni hiyo. Hatifungani hulipa kuponi. Mali ya kukodisha huzalisha kodi. Malipo hayo si hakikisho la bei, lakini ni nanga. Bei ya hisa inapokimbia mbali mbele ya faida zilizo chini yake, mchambuzi anaweza kuweka namba juu ya pengo na kubishana kulihusu.

fea696426c25.en: Correct. The document exists to move the decision from the stressed moment to the calm one. A written condition — the money is needed, the band was breached, the fee rose, the reason for buying no longer holds — is checkable. A decision made mid-drawdown is a response to how the drawdown feels, which is the thing the plan is meant to overrule.
fea696426c25.sw: Sahihi. Hati ipo ili kuhamisha uamuzi kutoka wakati wa msongo hadi wakati wa utulivu. Sharti lililoandikwa — pesa inahitajika, ukanda ulivukwa, ada ilipanda, sababu ya kununua haipo tena — linaweza kukaguliwa. Uamuzi unaofanywa katikati ya kushuka ni jibu kwa jinsi kushuka kunavyohisi, ambacho ndicho kitu ambacho mpango umekusudiwa kukikataa.

feb41e6ab1cd.en: Correct - a triggered stop is a market order, and a market order needs resting bids to fill against. When depth collapses, those bids sit 4% or 10% away instead of a few basis points away, so the fill arrives far below the stop level and the order itself consumes what depth remains. This is the same failure Forex Chapter 5, Lesson 1 documented when the Swiss franc floor broke in 2015.
feb41e6ab1cd.sw: Sahihi - kusimamisha kulikofyatuka ni agizo la soko, na agizo la soko linahitaji zabuni zilizopumzika za kujazwa dhidi yake. Kina kinapoporomoka, zabuni hizo hukaa 4% au 10% mbali badala ya pointi chache za msingi mbali, kwa hivyo ujazwaji hufika chini sana ya kiwango cha kusimamisha na agizo lenyewe hutumia kina kilichobaki. Huku ndiko kushindwa kuleile ambako Forex Sura ya 5, Somo la 1 lilikuandika sakafu ya faranga ya Uswisi ilipovunjika mwaka 2015.

Tambua ulichukua muda gani. Kwa wasomaji wengi ni chini ya saa moja, ambayo ni bei ndogo kwa kuondoa namna za kushindwa zilizomaliza taasisi tatu kubwa zaidi katika tasnia hii.

ffbe23b18b2e.en: State this honestly: the efficient-markets argument is itself contested, and this course does not present it as settled fact. Decades of research have found anomalies that appear to contradict it, and crypto markets in particular are young, retail-heavy and fragmented in ways that make strong efficiency unlikely. The point is not that markets are perfectly efficient. The point is that anyone claiming the halving mechanically causes a later price rise owes an answer to the question: why did the price not move when everyone learned the schedule?
ffbe23b18b2e.sw: Taja hili kwa ukweli: hoja ya masoko yenye ufanisi yenyewe inapingwa, na kozi hii haiiwasilishi kama ukweli uliotatuliwa. Miongo ya utafiti imepata tofauti zinazoonekana kuipinga, na masoko ya kripto hasa ni machanga, yanategemea rejareja na yametawanyika kwa namna zinazofanya ufanisi imara usiwezekane. Lengo si kwamba masoko yana ufanisi kikamilifu. Lengo ni kwamba yeyote anayedai kupunguzwa nusu husababisha kimitambo kupanda kwa bei baadaye anadaiwa jibu la swali: kwa nini bei haikusogea wakati kila mtu alipojifunza ratiba?

ffcf0583bffe.en: You hold a position with a take-profit limit order at one price and a stop-loss order at another. Whichever level price reaches first executes; the other order is automatically removed. You don't have to manually cancel anything or monitor the position constantly.
ffcf0583bffe.sw: Unashikilia nafasi yenye agizo la kikomo la take-profit kwa bei moja na agizo la stop-loss kwa nyingine. Kiwango chochote ambacho bei itakifikia kwanza hutekelezwa; agizo lingine huondolewa kiotomatiki. Huhitaji kufuta chochote kwa mkono wala kufuatilia nafasi kila mara.

ffe21bd44e3c.en: Morningstar's Mind the Gap study is a genuine improvement. It uses fund flow data rather than a proxy, and its numbers are far more modest. The 2025 edition reported a gap of about 1.2 percentage points a year over the ten years ending 31 December 2024: investors earned roughly 7.0% a year against the funds' 8.2%, a shortfall Morningstar described as about 15% of the funds' total gains.
ffe21bd44e3c.sw: Utafiti wa Morningstar wa Mind the Gap ni maboresho ya kweli. Hutumia data ya mtiririko wa pesa za mfuko badala ya kipimo mbadala, na takwimu zake ni za wastani zaidi. Toleo la 2025 liliripoti pengo la takriban pointi 1.2 za asilimia kwa mwaka kwa miaka kumi iliyoishia 31 Desemba 2024: wawekezaji walipata takriban 7.0% kwa mwaka dhidi ya 8.2% ya mifuko, upungufu ambao Morningstar iliueleza kuwa takriban 15% ya faida jumla za mifuko.

fff04f79b300.en: A mining company earns 5.00 a share at the peak of a commodity cycle, and trades at 30.00 — a P/E of 6. Two years later the commodity price has halved, the company earns 0.50, and the shares trade at 20.00 — a P/E of 40. The low multiple marked the danger and the high one marked the opportunity, which is the reverse of the screening rule.
fff04f79b300.sw: Kampuni ya uchimbaji hupata 5.00 kwa hisa katika kilele cha mzunguko wa bidhaa, na hufanyiwa biashara kwa 30.00 — P/E ya 6. Miaka miwili baadaye bei ya bidhaa imepungua nusu, kampuni hupata 0.50, na hisa hufanyiwa biashara kwa 20.00 — P/E ya 40. Kizidishi kidogo kiliashiria hatari na kikubwa kiliashiria fursa, ambako ni kinyume cha kanuni ya kuchuja.

fff1be3306ee.en: Digital money always needed a referee to stop the same coin being spent twice — Bitcoin's 2008 proposal replaced the referee with a shared ledger and proof-of-work, and made tokens scarce; scarcity, though, is not the same thing as value.
fff1be3306ee.sw: Pesa ya kidijitali daima ilihitaji mwamuzi kuzuia sarafu ileile kutumika mara mbili — pendekezo la Bitcoin la 2008 lilibadilisha mwamuzi na leja inayoshirikiwa na uthibitisho-wa-kazi, na likafanya tokeni kuwa adimu; hata hivyo, uadimu si kitu kilekile na thamani.
